local Themes: {[string]: {[string]: Color3}} = {}
for Name: string, Values: {{number}} in Bases do
    local Colors: {[string]: Color3} = {}
    for Index: number, v: {number} in Values do
        Colors[Keys[Index]] = Color3.fromRGB(v[1], v[2], v[3])
    end
    local _, _, Bright: number = Colors.Main:ToHSV()
    local Sign: number = Bright > 0.5 and -1 or 1
    for Shade: string, v: {any} in Shades do
        if v[3] and Name ~= "Dark" then
            continue
        end

        local Hue: number, Sat: number, Value: number = Colors[v[1]]:ToHSV()
        Colors[Shade] = Color3.fromHSV(Hue, Sat, math.clamp(Value + v[2] * Sign, 0, 1))
    end
    Themes[Name] = Colors
end

function Create.Fade(Root: Instance, Faded: boolean, Saved: {[Instance]: {[string]: number}}, Amount: number)
	for _, v: Instance in Root:GetDescendants() do
		local Properties: {string} = if v:IsA("UIStroke") then {"Transparency"} elseif v:IsA("TextLabel") or v:IsA("TextBox") then {"TextTransparency", "BackgroundTransparency"} elseif v:IsA("ImageLabel") then {"ImageTransparency", "BackgroundTransparency"} elseif v:IsA("GuiObject") then {"BackgroundTransparency"} else {}
		local Object: any = v
		for _, Property: string in Properties do
			Saved[v] = Saved[v] or {}
			Saved[v][Property] = Saved[v][Property] or Object[Property]
			local Base: number = Saved[v][Property]
			Object[Property] = if Faded and Base < 1 then 1 - (1 - Base) * (1 - Amount) else Base
		end
	end
end

return Create

local function Ensure()

function Store.Clean(Name: string): string
    local Result: string = string.gsub(Name, "[\\/:*?\"<>|%c]", "")
    Result = string.gsub(Result, "^%s+", "")
    Result = string.gsub(Result, "%s+$", "")

    return string.sub(Result, 1, 32)
end

function Store.List(): {string}
    local Names: {string} = {}
    if not isfolder(Store.Folder) then
        return Names
    end

    for _, v: string in listfiles(Store.Folder) do
        local Name: string? = string.match(v, "([^/\\]+)%.json$")
        if Name then
            table.insert(Names, Name)
        end
    end

    return Names
end

function Store.Read(Path: string): {[string]: any}
    if not isfile(Path) then
        return {}
    end

    local Success: boolean, Result: any = pcall(function(): any
        return Services.HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(Path))
    end)

    return Success and type(Result) == "table" and Result or {}
end

function Store.Write(Path: string, Data: {[string]: any})
    local Success: boolean, Result: any = pcall(Services.HttpService.JSONEncode, Services.HttpService, Data)
    if not Success then
        warn(`[catvape] could not encode {Path}: {Result}`)
        return
    end
    if isfile(Path) and readfile(Path) == Result then
        return
    end

    Ensure()
    pcall(writefile, Path, Result)
end

function Store.Delete(Name: string)
    local Path: string = `{Store.Folder}/{Name}.json`
    if isfile(Path) then
        pcall(delfile, Path)
    end
end

function Store.Current(): string
    local Success: boolean, Result: any = pcall(readfile, Store.Pointer)
    local Name: string = Success and isfile(Store.Pointer) and type(Result) == "string" and Store.Clean(Result) or ""

    return Name ~= "" and Name or "default"
end

function Store.SetCurrent(Name: string)
    Ensure()
    pcall(writefile, Store.Pointer, Name)
end

function Context.Pause(_)
    SetIdentity(8)
    local Frame: number?, Start: number? = shared.BundleFrame, shared.BundleStart
    if not Frame or not Start or os.clock() - Frame < (os.clock() - Start > 0.6 and 0.016 or 0.006) or not coroutine.isyieldable() then
        return
    end

    task.wait()
    SetIdentity(8)
    if shared.BundleFrame then
        shared.BundleFrame = os.clock()
    end
end

function Context.Icon(self: Context, Name: string): string
    if not self.Icons[Name] then
        local Success: boolean, Result: any = pcall(getcustomasset, `{Theme.Folder}/{Name}.png`)
        self.Icons[Name] = Success and Result or ""
    end

    return self.Icons[Name]
end

function Context.Tween(self: Context, Object: Instance, Goal: {[string]: any}, Info: TweenInfo?)
    local Old: Tween? = self.Tweens[Object]
    if Old then
        Old:Cancel()
        self.Tweens[Object] = nil
    end
    if not Info then
        for Property: string, Value: any in Goal do
            (Object :: any)[Property] = Value
        end

        return
    end

    local Run: Tween = Services.TweenService:Create(Object, Info, Goal)
    self.Tweens[Object] = Run
    Run:Play()
end

function Context.Measure(self: Context, Text: string, Size: number, Face: Font, Width: number?): Vector2
    local Index: string = `{Text}|{Size}|{Width or 0}|{Face.Family}|{Face.Weight.Name}|{Face.Style.Name}`
    if self.Sizes[Index] then
        return self.Sizes[Index]
    end

    local Params: GetTextBoundsParams = Instance.new("GetTextBoundsParams")
    Params.Text = Text
    Params.Size = Size
    Params.Font = Face
    Params.Width = Width or math.huge

    local Success: boolean, Result: any = pcall(Services.TextService.GetTextBoundsAsync, Services.TextService, Params)
    local Bounds: Vector2 = Success and Result or Vector2.new(#Text * Size * 0.5, Size)

    self.Count += 1
    if self.Count > 2048 then
        self.Count = 0
        table.clear(self.Sizes)
    end

    self.Sizes[Index] = Bounds

    return Bounds
end

function Context.Mouse(self: Context): Vector2
    local Mouse: Vector2 = Services.UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    if not self.Scaled then
        return Mouse
    end

    return Mouse + self.Scaled.AbsolutePosition
end

function Context.Drag(self: Context, Gui: GuiObject, Header: number, Gate: (() -> boolean)?)
    Gui.InputBegan:Connect(function(Input: InputObject)
        if Input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and Input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch or Gate and not Gate() then
            return
        end
        local Mouse: Vector2 = self:Mouse()
        if Mouse.Y - Gui.AbsolutePosition.Y > Header * self.Scale.Scale then
            return
        end

        local Grab: Vector2 = Gui.AbsolutePosition - Mouse
        self.Dragging = true
        local Release: RBXScriptConnection
        local Move: RBXScriptConnection = Services.UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(Changed: InputObject)
            if Changed.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and Changed.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                return
            end

            if self.Dragged then
                self.Dragged(Gui)
            end

            local Target: Vector2 = (Services.UserInputService:GetMouseLocation() + Grab) / self.Scale.Scale
            if Services.UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then
                Target = Target // 3 * 3
            end
            Gui.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(Target.X, Target.Y)
        end)
        Release = Input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if Input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                Move:Disconnect()
                Release:Disconnect()
                self.Dragging = false
                self:Save()
                if self.Dropped then
                    self.Dropped()
                end
            end
        end)
    end)
end

function Context.Tip(self: Context, Gui: GuiObject, Text: (string | () -> string)?)
    if not Text then
        return
    end

    local Label: TextLabel = self.Tooltip
    local function Move()
        if not self.Tips then
            return
        end

        local Mouse: Vector2 = (self:Mouse() - self.Scaled.AbsolutePosition) / self.Scale.Scale
        local Width: number = Label.Size.X.Offset
        local Right: boolean = Mouse.X + 16 + Width > self.Scaled.AbsoluteSize.X / self.Scale.Scale
        local X: number = Right and Mouse.X - Width - 16 or Mouse.X + 16
        Label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(X, Mouse.Y + 11 - Label.Size.Y.Offset / 2)
        Label.Visible = true
    end
    local function Fill()
        Label.Text = if type(Text) == "function" then Text() else Text
        local Bounds: Vector2 = self:Measure(Label.ContentText, Label.TextSize, Theme.Font)
        Label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(Bounds.X + 10, Bounds.Y + 10)
    end

    Gui.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        Fill()
        Move()
        self.Refresh = Fill
    end)
    Gui.MouseMoved:Connect(Move)
    Gui.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        Label.Visible = false
        self.Refresh = nil
    end)
end

function Context.Color(self: Context, Offset: number?): Color3
    if not self.Accent.Rainbow then
        return Color3.fromHSV(self.Accent.Hue, self.Accent.Sat, self.Accent.Value)
    end

    return self:Rainbow((self.Accent.Hue - (Offset or 0)) % 1)
end

function Context.Rainbow(_, Hue: number): Color3
    local Sat: number = 0.74 + 0.26 * math.min(Hue / 0.045, 1)
    if Hue > 0.577 then
        Sat = 1 - 0.48 * math.min((Hue - 0.577) / 0.088, 1)
    end
    if Hue > 0.674 then
        Sat = 0.52 + 0.48 * math.min((Hue - 0.674) / 0.149, 1)
    end
    if Hue > 0.869 then
        Sat = 1 - 0.26 * math.min((Hue - 0.869) / 0.131, 1)
    end

    return Color3.fromHSV(Hue, Sat, 1)
end

    ImageLabel = {"BackgroundColor3", "ImageColor3"},
    ImageButton = {"BackgroundColor3", "ImageColor3"},
    ScrollingFrame = {"BackgroundColor3", "ScrollBarImageColor3"},
    UIStroke = {"Color"}
}

local function Hex(Color: Color3): number
    return math.round(Color.R * 255) * 65536 + math.round(Color.G * 255) * 256 + math.round(Color.B * 255)
end

function Context.SetTheme(self: Context, Name: string)
    local Palette: {[string]: Color3}? = Theme.Themes[Name]
    if not Palette or Name == self.Theme then
        return
    end

    local Map: {[number]: Color3} = {}
    local Fresh: {[number]: boolean} = {}
    for Index: string, Color: Color3 in Palette do
        Map[Hex(Theme[Index])] = Color
        Fresh[Hex(Color)] = true
        Theme[Index] = Color
    end
    self.Theme = Name
    self.Shade += 1
    local Shade: number = self.Shade
    local function Pass(Skip: boolean): ()
        for _, Root: Instance in self.Roots do
            for _, Object: Instance in Root:GetDescendants() do
                local Properties: {string} = Tinted[Object.ClassName] or (Object:IsA("GuiObject") and Tinted.GuiObject or {})
                local Goal: {[string]: Color3} = {}
                for _, v: string in Properties do
                    local Index: number = Hex((Object :: any)[v])
                    if Map[Index] and not (Skip and Fresh[Index]) then
                        Goal[v] = Map[Index]
                    end
                end
                if next(Goal) then
                    self:Tween(Object, Goal, Theme.Tween)
                end
            end
        end
        for _, v: () -> () in self.Painters do
            v()
        end
    end

    Pass(false)
    task.delay(0.3, function(): ()
        if self.Shade == Shade and not self.Dead then
            Pass(true)
        end
    end)
end

function Context.Contrast(self: Context, Color: Color3): Color3
    local Hue: number, Sat: number, Value: number = Color:ToHSV()
    if Value >= 0.7 and (Sat < 0.6 or Hue > 0.04 and Hue < 0.56) then
        return Color3.new(0.19, 0.19, 0.19)
    end

    return Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
end

function Context.Clear(_, List: {any})
    for _, v: any in List do
        local Class: string = typeof(v)
        if Class == "function" then
            pcall(v)
        elseif Class == "RBXScriptConnection" and v.Connected then
            pcall(v.Disconnect, v)
        elseif Class == "thread" then
            pcall(task.cancel, v)
        elseif Class == "Instance" then
            pcall(function() v:Destroy(); end)
        elseif Class == "table" and v.Destroy then
            pcall(v.Destroy, v)
        end
    end

    table.clear(List)
end

function Context.Register(self: Context, Index: string, Get: () -> any, Set: (any) -> ())
    table.insert(self.Items, {Key = Index, Get = Get, Set = Set})

    self.Last = os.clock()

    if self.Data[Index] ~= nil then
        Set(self.Data[Index])
    end
end

function Context.Export(self: Context): {[string]: any}
    local Data: {[string]: any} = table.clone(self.Data)
    for _, v: Item in self.Items do
        Data[v.Key] = v.Get()
    end

    return Data
end

function Context.Write(self: Context)
    local Gui: {[string]: any} = {}
    local Profile: {[string]: any} = {}
    for Index: string, Value: any in self:Export() do
        if string.sub(Index, 1, 8) == "Modules/" then
            Profile[Index] = Value
        else
            Gui[Index] = Value
        end
    end

    Store.Write(Store.Gui, Gui)
    Store.Write(`{Store.Folder}/{self.Profile}.json`, Profile)
end

function Context.Save(self: Context)
    if self.Saving or self.Dead then
        return
    end

    self.Saving = true
    task.delay(1, function()
        self.Saving = false
        if not self.Dead then
            self:Write()
        end
    end)
end

function Context.Switch(self: Context, Name: string)
    self:Write()
    self.Profile = Name
    Store.SetCurrent(Name)

    for Index: string in self.Data do
        if string.sub(Index, 1, 8) == "Modules/" then
            self.Data[Index] = nil
        end
    end

    for Index: string, Value: any in Store.Read(`{Store.Folder}/{Name}.json`) do
        self.Data[Index] = Value
    end

    for _, v: Item in self.Items do
        if string.sub(v.Key, 1, 8) == "Modules/" then
            v.Set(self.Data[v.Key])
        end
    end

    self.Last = os.clock()
    self:Save()
end

function Context.Destroy(self: Context)
    if not self.Dead then
        self:Write()
    end

    self.Dead = true

    for _, v: RBXScriptConnection in self.Connections do
        v:Disconnect()
    end
    
    for _, v: Instance in self.Roots do
        v:Destroy()
    end

    for _, v: string in {"Connections", "Painters", "Rainbows", "Binds", "Items", "Queue"} do
        table.clear(rawget(self, v) :: {any})
    end
end

    ColorSlider = (function()
        local Theme = BundledModules.Theme
        local Text = BundledModules.Text
        local Create = BundledModules.Create
        local Services = BundledModules.Services

        local function Parse(Text: string): Color3?
            local Parts: {string} = string.split(Text, ",")
            if #Parts == 3 then
                local Red: number?, Green: number?, Blue: number? = tonumber(Parts[1]), tonumber(Parts[2]), tonumber(Parts[3])
                if Red and Green and Blue then
                    return Color3.fromRGB(math.clamp(Red, 0, 255), math.clamp(Green, 0, 255), math.clamp(Blue, 0, 255))
                end

                return nil
            end

            local Hex: string = string.lower((string.gsub(Text, "[%s#]", "")))
            if #Hex == 3 then
                Hex = string.gsub(Hex, ".", "%0%0")
            end
            if #Hex == 6 and not string.find(Hex, "%X") then
                return Color3.fromHex(Hex)
            end

            return nil
        end

        return function(Ui: Context, Parent: GuiObject, Props: ColorSliderProps, Owner: Owner): ColorSlider
            local Function: (Hue: number, Sat: number, Value: number, Opacity: number) -> () = Props.Function or function() end
            local Darker: Color3 = Parent.BackgroundColor3 == Theme.Main and Theme.Panel or Theme.Deep
            local Back: Color3 = Props.Darker and Darker or Parent.BackgroundColor3
            local Defaults: {number} = {Props.DefaultHue or 0.44, Props.DefaultSat or 1, Props.DefaultValue or 1, Props.DefaultOpacity or 1}
            local Rings: {ImageLabel} = {}
            local Extras: {TextButton} = {}
            local Fills: {Frame} = {}
            local Knobs: {Frame} = {}

                    TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                    Parent = Row
                })

                local Track: Frame = Create.New("Frame", {
                    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
                    Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, Slot == 1 and 39 or 37),
                    Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 2),
                    Parent = Row
                })

                Gradients[Slot] = Create.New("UIGradient", {Parent = Track})

                Fills[Slot] = Create.New("Frame", {
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(Defaults[Slot], 0.04, 0.96), 1),
                    Parent = Track
                })

                local Holder: Frame = Create.New("Frame", {
                    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
                    BackgroundColor3 = Back,
                    Position = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.5),
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 4),
                    Parent = Fills[Slot]
                })

                Knobs[Slot] = Create.New("Frame", {
                    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),

                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14),

            end)

            Handle = {
                Keys = {},
                Hold = Props.Hold == true,
                Binding = false,
                Object = Chip,
                Trigger = Props.Function or function() end,
                SetBind = function(_, Keys: {string}, User: boolean?)
                    if Props.NoRemove and #Keys == 0 then
                        Keys = Default
                    end

                    Handle.Binding = false
                    Handle.Keys = table.clone(Keys)
                    Icon.Image = Ui:Icon(User and "edit" or "bind")

                        CoverLabel.Text = #Keys == 0 and "BIND REMOVED" or `BOUND TO {string.upper(table.concat(Keys, " + "))}`

                        Icon.Visible = true

                        Ui.Binds[Handle] = true
                    end
                    Ui:Save()
                end,
                SetVisible = function(_, Visible: boolean)
                    Chip.Visible = #Handle.Keys > 0 or Visible or not Props.Chip
                end,
                SetColor = function(_, Color: Color3)
                    Icon.ImageColor3 = Color
                    Label.TextColor3 = Color
                    if Mobile then
                        Mobile.BackgroundColor3 = if Props.Lit and Props.Lit() then Color3.new(0, 0.7, 0) else Color3.new()
                    end
                end,
                SetMobile = function(_, Position: Vector2?)
                    if Mobile then
                        Mobile:Destroy()
                        Mobile = nil
                    end
                    if not Position then

                    end

                    local Button: TextButton = Create.New("TextButton", {

                    }, {Create.Corner(20), Create.New("UITextSizeConstraint", {MaxTextSize = 16})})
                    local Pressed: number = 0

                            end
                        end)

                        end
                    end)
                    Button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

                        end

                    end)
                    Mobile = Button
                    Ui:Save()
                end
            }

            Chip.MouseEnter:Connect(function()

                end

            end)

            end
            if not Props.Chip then
                Owner.Options[Props.Name or "Bind"] = Handle
            end
            Ui:Register(Props.Chip and `{Owner.Key}#Bind` or `{Owner.Key}/{Props.Name}`, function(): any
                return {Keys = Handle.Keys, Hold = Handle.Hold, Mobile = Mobile and {X = Mobile.Position.X.Offset, Y = Mobile.Position.Y.Offset, Screen = true}}
            end, function(Value: any)
                local Saved: {[string]: any} = type(Value) == "table" and Value or {}
                local Keys: {string} = {}
                for _, v: any in (type(Saved.Keys) == "table" and Saved.Keys or Default) do
                    if tostring(v) ~= "None" and tostring(v) ~= "Unknown" then
                        table.insert(Keys, tostring(v))
                    end
                end

                Handle.Hold = if Saved.Hold == nil then Props.Hold == true else Saved.Hold == true
                Handle:SetBind(Keys)
                local Spot: any = Saved.Mobile
                if Props.Chip and type(Spot) == "table" and type(Spot.X) == "number" and type(Spot.Y) == "number" then
                    local Point: Vector2 = Vector2.new(Spot.X, Spot.Y)
                    if Spot.Screen ~= true then
                        Point = Point * Ui.Scale.Scale + Ui.Scaled.AbsolutePosition
                    end
                    Handle:SetMobile(Point)
                elseif Mobile then
                    Handle:SetMobile(nil)
                end
            end)

            return Handle
        end

    Font = (function()
        local Theme = BundledModules.Theme
        local Dropdown = BundledModules.Dropdown
        local TextBox = BundledModules.TextBox

        return function(Ui: Context, Parent: GuiObject, Props: FontProps, Owner: Owner): FontHandle
            local Function: (Value: Font) -> () = Props.Function or function() end
            local Fonts: {string} = {Props.Default or "Vape", "Custom"}
            for _, v: EnumItem in Enum.Font:GetEnumItems() do
                if v ~= Enum.Font.Unknown and not table.find(Fonts, v.Name) then
                    table.insert(Fonts, v.Name)
                end
            end

            local Handle: FontHandle = {
                Name = Props.Name,
                Value = Fonts[1] == "Vape" and Theme.Font or Font.fromEnum((Enum.Font :: any)[Fonts[1]])
            } :: any
            local Choice: Dropdown
            local Asset: TextBoxHandle

            Choice = Dropdown(Ui, Parent, {
                Name = Props.Name,
                List = Fonts,
                Darker = Props.Darker,
                Visible = Props.Visible,
                Function = function(Value: string)
                    if Asset then
                        Asset.Object.Visible = Value == "Custom" and Choice.Object.Visible
                    end
                    if Value == "Vape" then
                        Handle.Value = Theme.Font
                    elseif Value ~= "Custom" then
                        Handle.Value = Font.fromEnum((Enum.Font :: any)[Value])
                    elseif Asset then
                        pcall(function()
                            Handle.Value = Font.fromId(tonumber(Asset.Value) :: number)
                        end)
                    end

                    Function(Handle.Value)
                end
            }, Owner)
            Handle.Object = Choice.Object

            Asset = TextBox(Ui, Parent, {
                Name = `{Props.Name} Asset`,
                Placeholder = "font (rbxasset)",
                Darker = true,
                Visible = false,
                Function = function()
                    if Choice.Value ~= "Custom" then
                        return
                    end

                    pcall(function()
                        Handle.Value = Font.fromId(tonumber(Asset.Value) :: number)
                    end)
                    Function(Handle.Value)
                end
            }, Owner)
            Asset.Object.Visible = Choice.Value == "Custom" and Choice.Object.Visible

            Choice.Object:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
                Asset.Object.Visible = Choice.Object.Visible and Choice.Value == "Custom"
            end)
            Owner.Options[Props.Name] = Handle

            return Handle
        end
    end)(),

            local function Kind(Name: string, Icon: string, Size: UDim2, X: number, Tip: string): TargetsButton

                        end

                        Ui:Tween(Fill, {BackgroundColor3 = Goal and Ui:Color(Order * 0.075) or Theme.Main}, Theme.Tween)
                        Ui:Tween(Image, {ImageColor3 = Goal and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or Theme.Icon}, Theme.Tween)
                        Refresh()
                        Ui:Save()
                        Function()
                    end
                }

        local Offset: number = 32
        for _, v: Notice in List do
            Offset += v.Height
            if v.Object.Position.Y.Offset ~= 0 then
                Tween(v.Object, Theme.Slide, {Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -Offset)})

    local function Start(Notice: Notice, Title: string, Message: string, Duration: number, Type: string?): thread
        local Plain: string = string.gsub(Message, "<[^>]+>", "")
        local Line: number = Ui:Measure("A", 14, Theme.Font).Y
        local Bounds: Vector2 = Ui:Measure(Plain, 14, Theme.Font, 200)
        local Lines: number = math.max(math.round(Bounds.Y / Line), 1)
        local Accent: Color3 = Type == "alert" and Color3.fromRGB(250, 50, 56) or Type == "warning" and Color3.fromRGB(236, 129, 44) or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        local Heading: Vector2 = Ui:Measure((string.gsub(Title, "<[^>]+>", "")), 14, Theme.SemiBold)
        local Width: number = math.max(Bounds.X + 80, Heading.X + 66, 266)

        Notice.Height = 75 + (Lines - 1) * 16.8
        Notice.Icon.Image = Ui:Icon(`noti_{Type or "info"}`)
        Notice.Shadow.Image = Notice.Icon.Image
        Notice.Object.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(Width, Notice.Height)
        Notice.Text.LineHeight = 16.8 / Line
        Notice.Text.Text = Message
        Notice.Text.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, Lines * 16.8)

                table.remove(List, Index)
            end
            if Notice.Reuse then
                Cache[Notice.Reuse] = nil
            end

            Notice.Object:Destroy()
            Reflow()
        end)

            end

        end)

    local function Mix(Offset: number): Color3
        local Wave: number = (math.sin((Phase - Offset) * math.pi * 2) + 1) / 2
        local First: Color3 = Color3.fromHSV(GradientColor1.Hue, GradientColor1.Sat, GradientColor1.Value)

        return First:Lerp(Color3.fromHSV(GradientColor2.Hue, GradientColor2.Sat, GradientColor2.Value), Wave)
    end

    Recolor = function()
        local Two: boolean = ColorMode.Value == "Two-color gradient"
        local Base: Color3 = Ui:Color()
        local Shift: Color3 = Gradient.Enabled and Ui:Rainbow((Ui.Accent.Hue - 0.075) % 1) or Base
        Shading.Color = Two and ColorSequence.new(Mix(0), Mix(0.1)) or ColorSequence.new(Base, Shift)
        BadgeShading.Color = Gradient.Enabled and GradientV4.Enabled and Shading.Color or ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
        Custom.TextColor3 = CustomTextColor.Enabled and Color3.fromHSV(CustomTextColorSlider.Hue, CustomTextColorSlider.Sat, CustomTextColorSlider.Value) or Shading.Color.Keypoints[2].Value

        local Chosen: Color3? = ColorMode.Value == "Custom color" and Color3.fromHSV(ColorSlider.Hue, ColorSlider.Sat, ColorSlider.Value) or nil
        for Index: number, v: Label in Labels do
            local Rainbow: Color3? = Ui.Accent.Rainbow and Ui:Color((Gradient.Enabled and Index + 2 or Index) * 0.025) or nil
            v.Text.TextColor3 = Chosen or (Two and Mix(Index * 0.04)) or Rainbow or Shading.Color.Keypoints[2].Value
            if v.Color then
                local Strip: Frame = v.Color.Parent :: Frame
                v.Color.ImageColor3 = v.Text.TextColor3
                Strip.BackgroundColor3 = v.Text.TextColor3
            end
            if BackgroundTint.Enabled and v.Background then
                local Hue: number, Sat: number, Value: number = v.Text.TextColor3:ToHSV()
                v.Background.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(Hue, Sat, math.clamp(Value - 0.75, 0, 1))
            end
        end
    end

    Arrange = function()
        if not (Overlay.Button and Overlay.Button.Enabled) then
            Paint()
            return
        end

        Holder.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1 / Scale.Scale, 1)
        Ui:Tween(Holder, {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(Right and 3 or 0, Top + (Background.Enabled and 3 or 0))}, Smooth)

        local Current: string = `{Background.Enabled}|{BackgroundTransparency.Value}|{Shadow.Enabled}|{Right}|{Face.Family}|{Face.Weight.Name}|{Face.Style.Name}`
        local Moved: {[string]: {Left: number, Top: number, Width: number}} = {}
        if Current ~= Style then
            for Name: string, v: Row in Rows do
                local Spot: UDim2 = v.Object.Position
                local Wide: number = v.Object.Size.X.Offset
                Moved[Name] = {
                    Left = Spot.X.Offset - (v.Object.AnchorPoint.X == 1 and Wide or 0),
                    Top = Spot.Y.Offset,
                    Width = Wide
                }
                v.Object:Destroy()
            end
            table.clear(Rows)
            Style = Current
        end

        local Previous: {string} = {}
        for _, v: Label in Labels do
            if v.Enabled then
                table.insert(Previous, v.Object.Name)
            end
        end
        table.clear(Labels)

        for Name: string, Module: Module in Ui.Modules do
            if HideModules.Enabled and table.find(HideModulesList.ListEnabled, Name) then
                continue
            end
            if HideRender.Enabled and Module.Category.Name == "Render" then
                continue
            end
            if not Module.Enabled and not table.find(Previous, Name) then
                continue
            end

            Shown[Name] = true
            local Entry: Row = Rows[Name] or Build(Name, Right)
            Rows[Name] = Entry
            local Before = Moved[Name]
            if Before then
                Entry.Object.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(Right and Before.Left + Before.Width or Before.Left, Before.Top)
                Entry.Placed = true
            end

            local Extra: string = Module.ExtraText and ` {Module.ExtraText()}` or ""
            if Entry.Text.Text ~= Name or Entry.Extra.Text ~= Extra then
                local First: Vector2 = Ui:Measure(Name, Entry.Text.TextSize, Entry.Text.FontFace)
                local Second: Vector2 = Extra ~= "" and Ui:Measure(Extra, Entry.Extra.TextSize, Entry.Extra.FontFace) or Vector2.zero
                local Left: number = Entry.Text.Position.X.Offset + First.X * Entry.Grow

                Entry.Text.Text, Entry.Extra.Text = Name, Extra
                Entry.Text.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(First.X, First.Y)
                Entry.Extra.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(Second.X, First.Y)
                Entry.Extra.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(Left, Entry.Text.Position.Y.Offset)
                Entry.Width = (First.X + Second.X) * Entry.Grow
                if Entry.Shadow and Entry.Dim then
                    Entry.Shadow.Text, Entry.Dim.Text = Name, Extra
                    Entry.Shadow.Size, Entry.Dim.Size = Entry.Text.Size, Entry.Extra.Size
                    Entry.Shadow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(Entry.Text.Position.X.Offset + 1, Entry.Text.Position.Y.Offset + 1)
                    Entry.Dim.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(Left + 1, Entry.Text.Position.Y.Offset + 1)
                end
            end

            local Target: UDim2 = UDim2.fromOffset(Entry.Width + 16, Entry.Text.Size.Y.Offset * Entry.Grow + 6)
            if not Animations.Enabled then
                Entry.Object.Size = Module.Enabled and Target or UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
            elseif not table.find(Previous, Name) then
                Ui:Tween(Entry.Object, {Size = Target}, Info)
            else
                Entry.Object.Size = Target
            end

            table.insert(Labels, {
                Background = Entry.Background,
                Color = Entry.Color,
                Enabled = Module.Enabled,
                Object = Entry.Object,
                Text = Entry.Text,
                Width = Entry.Width,
                Size = Module.Enabled and Target or UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
            })
        end

            if not Shown[Name] then

                Rows[Name] = nil
            end
        end

            table.sort(Labels, function(a: Label, b: Label): boolean
                return a.Text.Text < b.Text.Text
            end)
        else
            table.sort(Labels, function(a: Label, b: Label): boolean
                return a.Width > b.Width
            end)
        end

            else
                v.Object.Position = Spot
                Entry.Placed = true

                Shape.BottomRightRadius = UDim.new(0, Lower)
            end
        end

    end

local BundledModules = ...
local Services = BundledModules.Services
local Create = BundledModules.Create

local function Rendered(Object: Instance?): boolean
    while Object do
        if Object:IsA("LayerCollector") then
            return Object.Enabled
        end
        if Object:IsA("GuiObject") and not Object.Visible then
            return false
        end

        Object = Object.Parent
    end

    return false
end

local function Refresh(Ui: Context)
    if Ui.Frost and not Ui.Frost.Enabled then
        if Ui.Frosted then
            Ui.Frosted = false
            for _, v: Sheet in Ui.Glass do
                v.Part.Parent = nil
            end
        end

        return
    end

    Ui.Frosted = true
    local Camera: Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local Offset: number = Camera.ViewportSize.Y * 48 / 2560 + 8
    local Frame: CFrame = Camera.CFrame
    for _, v: Sheet in Ui.Glass do
        if v.Frame.BackgroundTransparency >= 1 or not Rendered(v.Frame) then
            v.Part.Parent = nil
            continue
        end

        local Size: Vector2 = v.Frame.AbsoluteSize - Vector2.new(Offset, Offset)
        local Corner: Vector2 = v.Frame.AbsolutePosition + Vector2.new(Offset / 2, Offset / 2)
        if Size.X <= 0 or Size.Y <= 0 then
            v.Part.Parent = nil
            continue
        end

        local First: Ray = Camera:ScreenPointToRay(Corner.X, Corner.Y)
        local Last: Ray = Camera:ScreenPointToRay(Corner.X + Size.X, Corner.Y + Size.Y)
        local TopLeft: Vector3 = First.Origin + First.Direction * 0.001
        local BottomRight: Vector3 = Last.Origin + Last.Direction * 0.001
        local Delta: Vector3 = BottomRight - TopLeft

        if v.Part.Parent ~= Camera then
            v.Part.Parent = Camera
        end
        v.Part.CFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix((TopLeft + BottomRight) / 2, Frame.XVector, Frame.YVector, Frame.ZVector)
        v.Mesh.Scale = Vector3.new(Delta:Dot(Frame.XVector), -Delta:Dot(Frame.YVector), 0)
    end
end

        Locked = true,
        Material = Enum.Material.Glass,
        Name = Services.HttpService:GenerateGUID(false),
        Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 0),
        Transparency = 0.98
    })

    local Mesh: SpecialMesh = Create.New("SpecialMesh", {
        MeshType = Enum.MeshType.Brick,
        Offset = Vector3.new(0, 0, -0.000001),
        Parent = Part
    })

    table.insert(Ui.Glass, {Frame = Frame, Mesh = Mesh, Part = Part})
    table.insert(Ui.Roots, Part)
    if #Ui.Glass == 1 then
        Ui:Connect(Services.RunService.RenderStepped, function()
            Refresh(Ui)
        end)
    end

    return Part

    return Colors
end

local BundledModules = ...
local Services = BundledModules.Services
local getcustomasset: (string) -> string = BundledModules.getcustomasset
local isfile: (string) -> boolean = BundledModules.isfile
local readfile: (string) -> string = BundledModules.readfile

local Fonts: {[string]: FontData | false} = {}
local Indexes: {[string]: {[string]: {any}} | false} = {}

local Font = {}

local function Validate(Data: any): string?
    if type(Data) ~= "table" then
        return "metrics missing or not valid JSON"
    end

    local Names: any = Data.pages or {Data.atlas}
    local Count: number = if type(Names) == "table" then #Names else 0
    local Bad: number = 0
    for _, v: any in (if type(Data.glyphs) == "table" then Data.glyphs else {}) do
        local Valid: boolean = type(v) == "table" and type(v.advance) == "number" and type(v.cells) == "table" and #v.cells == 64
        for _, Cell: any in (if Valid then v.cells else {}) do
            Valid = Valid and type(Cell) == "table" and (#Cell == 6 or #Cell == 7) and type(Cell[7] or 1) == "number"
            Valid = Valid and (Cell[7] or 1) >= 1 and (Cell[7] or 1) <= Count
        end
        Bad += if Valid then 0 else 1
    end

    local Size: any = Data.atlasSize
    return if Data.version ~= 1 then "unsupported version"
        elseif type(Data.glyphs) ~= "table" or type(Data.lineHeight) ~= "number" or type(Data.size) ~= "number" or type(Data.scale) ~= "number" or type(Data.atlas) ~= "string" then "missing fields"
        elseif type(Size) ~= "table" or type(Size[1]) ~= "number" or type(Size[2]) ~= "number" or Size[1] > 1024 or Size[2] > 1024 then "atlas missing or larger than 1024"
        elseif Count < 1 then "no atlas pages"
        elseif Bad > 0 then "malformed glyph cells"
        elseif type(Data.fallback) ~= "number" or Data.glyphs[tostring(Data.fallback)] == nil then "no fallback glyph"
        elseif Data.glyphs["32"] == nil then "no space glyph"
        else nil
end

local function Pages(Folder: string, Names: {string}): ({string}?, string?)
    local Assets: {string} = {}
    for _, Name: string in Names do
        local Path: string = `{Folder}/text/{Name}`
        local Header: boolean, Width: number, Height: number, Whole: boolean = pcall(function(): (number, number, boolean)
            local Content: string = readfile(Path)
            local PageWidth: number, PageHeight: number = string.unpack(">I4I4", Content, 17)

            return PageWidth, PageHeight, string.sub(Content, -8) == "IEND\xAE\x42\x60\x82"
        end)
        local Loaded: boolean, Asset: string = pcall(getcustomasset, Path)
        if not Header or Width > 1024 or Height > 1024 then
            return nil, `page {Name} unreadable or larger than 1024`
        end
        if not Whole then
            return nil, `page {Name} is cut off (no PNG end chunk)`
        end
        if not Loaded or Asset == "" then
            return nil, `page {Name} unavailable`
        end
        table.insert(Assets, Asset)
    end

    return Assets, nil
end

local function Build(Folder: string, Entry: string, ScaleKey: string): (FontData?, string?)
    local Success: boolean, Data: any = pcall(function(): any
        return Services.HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(`{Folder}/text/{Entry}@{ScaleKey}.json`))
    end)
    local Reason: string? = Validate(if Success then Data else nil)
    if Reason then
        return nil, Reason
    end

    local Assets: {string}?, PageReason: string? = Pages(Folder, Data.pages or {Data.atlas})
    if not Assets then
        return nil, PageReason
    end

    local Glyphs: {[number]: Glyph} = {}
    for Code: string, v: any in Data.glyphs do
        Glyphs[tonumber(Code) :: number] = {Advance = v.advance, Cells = v.cells}
    end

    local Kern: {[number]: number} = {}
    for Pair: string, Value: number in (Data.kern or {}) do
        local First: string?, Second: string? = string.match(Pair, "^(%d+),(%d+)$")
        Kern[(tonumber(First) :: number) * 1114112 + (tonumber(Second) :: number)] = Value
    end

    return {
        Entry = Entry,
        ScaleKey = ScaleKey,
        Size = Data.size,
        Scale = Data.scale,
        LineHeight = Data.lineHeight,
        Pages = Assets,
        AtlasSize = Vector2.new(Data.atlasSize[1], Data.atlasSize[2]),
        Fallback = Data.fallback,
        Glyphs = Glyphs,
        Kern = Kern
    }, nil
end

function Font.Load(Folder: string, Entry: string, ScaleKey: string): FontData?
    local Key: string = `{Folder}/{Entry}@{ScaleKey}`
    if Fonts[Key] == nil then
        local Success: boolean, Result: any, Reason: string? = pcall(Build, Folder, Entry, ScaleKey)
        Fonts[Key] = Success and Result or false
        if not Fonts[Key] then
            warn(`[text] {Entry}@{ScaleKey}: {if Success then Reason else "malformed metrics"}, using native text`)
        end
    end

    return Fonts[Key] or nil
end

function Font.Labels(Folder: string): {[string]: {any}}?
    if Indexes[Folder] == nil then
        Indexes[Folder] = false
        for _, Path: string in {`{Folder}/text/labels/labels.json`, `{Folder}/text/labels.json`} do
            local Present: boolean = isfile(Path)
            local Success: boolean, Result: any = pcall(function(): any
                return Services.HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(Path))
            end)
            if Present and not Success then
                warn(`[text] {Path}: not valid JSON, baked labels off`)
            end
            Indexes[Folder] = Indexes[Folder] or (Success and type(Result) == "table" and Result) or false
        end
    end

    return Indexes[Folder] or nil
end

local BundledModules = ...
local Layout = {}

local function Decode(Font: FontData, Text: string, Wrap: boolean): {{number}}
    local Codes: {number} = {}
    pcall(function(): ()
        local Position: number = 1
        repeat
            local Length: number?, Bad: number? = utf8.len(Text, Position)
            local Stop: number = if Length then #Text else (Bad :: number) - 1
            for _, Code: number in utf8.codes(string.sub(Text, Position, Stop)) do
                table.insert(Codes, Code)
            end
            if Bad then
                table.insert(Codes, Font.Fallback)
            end
            Position = if Bad then Bad + 1 else #Text + 1
        until Position > #Text
    end)

    local Lines: {{number}} = {{}}
    for _, Code: number in Codes do
        if Code == 10 and Wrap then
            table.insert(Lines, {})
        elseif Code == 9 then
            for _ = 1, 4 do
                table.insert(Lines[#Lines], 32)
            end
        elseif Code ~= 13 and (Code >= 32 or Code == 10) then
            table.insert(Lines[#Lines], if Code == 10 then 32 elseif Font.Glyphs[Code] then Code else Font.Fallback)
        end
    end

    return Lines
end

local function Pens(Font: FontData, Line: {number}): ({number}, number)
    local Units: {number} = {}
    local Pen: number = 0
    for Index: number, Code: number in Line do
        Pen += if Index > 1 then Font.Kern[Line[Index - 1] * 1114112 + Code] or 0 else 0
        Units[Index] = Pen
        Pen += Font.Glyphs[Code].Advance
    end

    return Units, Pen
end

function Layout.Offset(Align: Enum.TextXAlignment, Width: number, Content: number): number
    local Offset: number = 0
    if Align == Enum.TextXAlignment.Center then
        Offset = (Width - Content) / 2
    elseif Align == Enum.TextXAlignment.Right then
        Offset = Width - Content
    end

    return math.floor(Offset)
end

function Layout.Measure(Font: FontData, Text: string): number
    local _, End: number = Pens(Font, Decode(Font, Text, false)[1])

    return math.ceil(End * Font.Scale * Font.Size / 1024)
end

function Layout.Place(Font: FontData, Text: string, Width: number, Align: Enum.TextXAlignment, Truncate: boolean, Wrap: boolean?): {Placement}
    local Result: {Placement} = {}
    local K: number = Font.Scale * Font.Size / 1024
    local Ellipsis: number = if Font.Glyphs[8230] then 8230 else Font.Fallback
    for Row: number, Source: {number} in Decode(Font, Text, Wrap or false) do
        local Line: {number} = Source
        local Units: {number}, End: number = Pens(Font, Line)
        if Truncate and Width > 0 and math.ceil(End * K) > Width then
            local Keep: number = 0
            for Count: number = #Line, 1, -1 do
                local Last: number = Line[Count]
                local Gap: number = Font.Kern[Last * 1114112 + Ellipsis] or 0
                local Used: number = Units[Count] + Font.Glyphs[Last].Advance + Gap + Font.Glyphs[Ellipsis].Advance
                if math.ceil(Used * K) <= Width then
                    Keep = Count
                    break
                end
            end

            Line = table.move(Line, 1, Keep, 1, {})
            table.insert(Line, Ellipsis)
            Units, End = Pens(Font, Line)
        end

        local Start: number = Layout.Offset(Align, Width, math.ceil(End * K))
        for Index: number, Code: number in Line do
            local Pen: number = Units[Index] * K
            local Whole: number = math.floor(Pen)
            local Phase: number = math.floor((Pen - Whole) * 64 + 0.5)
            local Cell: {number} = Font.Glyphs[Code].Cells[Phase % 64 + 1]
            if Cell[3] > 0 then
                table.insert(Result, {
                    Code = Code,
                    X = Start + Whole + Phase // 64 + Cell[5],
                    Y = (Row - 1) * Font.LineHeight + Cell[6],
                    Cell = Cell
                })
            end
        end
    end

    return Result
end

function Layout.Test(): boolean
    local Glyphs: {[number]: Glyph} = {}
    for _, Code: number in {32, 63, 65, 86, 8230} do
        local Cells: {{number}} = {}
        for Phase: number = 0, 63 do
            table.insert(Cells, if Code == 32 then {0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0} else {Phase, 0, 1, 1, 0, 0})
        end
        Glyphs[Code] = {Advance = 1024, Cells = Cells}
    end

    local Test: FontData = {
        Entry = "test",
        ScaleKey = "x100",
        Size = 16,
        Scale = 1,
        LineHeight = 20,
        Pages = {""},
        AtlasSize = Vector2.new(1, 1),
        Fallback = 63,
        Glyphs = Glyphs,
        Kern = {[65 * 1114112 + 86] = -100}
    }
    local Left: Enum.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

    local Pair: {Placement} = Layout.Place(Test, "AV", 0, Left, false)
    assert(#Pair == 2 and Pair[2].X == 14 and Pair[2].Cell[1] == 28, "AV kern applied")
    assert(Layout.Measure(Test, "AV") == 31, "AV measure")

    local Cut: {Placement} = Layout.Place(Test, "AAAAAAAA", 50, Left, true)
    assert(#Cut == 3 and Cut[3].Code == 8230, "truncation yields ellipsis")
    assert(#Layout.Place(Test, "AAAAAAAA", 0, Left, true) == 8, "no truncation without width")

    assert(#Layout.Place(Test, " \t\n ", 100, Left, false) == 0, "whitespace gives no placements")

    local Bad: {Placement} = Layout.Place(Test, "A\xFFA", 0, Left, false)
    assert(#Bad == 3 and Bad[2].Code == 63, "invalid UTF-8 maps to fallback")
    assert(Layout.Place(Test, "Z", 0, Left, false)[1].Code == 63, "missing glyph maps to fallback")

    assert(Layout.Place(Test, "A", 100, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, false)[1].X == 42, "centered start is whole")
    assert(Layout.Place(Test, "A\nA", 0, Left, false, true)[2].Y == 20, "newline wraps")
    assert(Layout.Place(Test, "A\nA", 0, Left, false, false)[2].X == 32, "newline is a space without wrap")

    return true
end

return Layout]], "=core/text/Layout"))(BundledModules)

local BundledModules = ...
local Theme = BundledModules.Theme2
local Host = BundledModules.Host

local getcustomasset: (string) -> string = BundledModules.getcustomasset
local Services = BundledModules.Services
local Tween = BundledModules.Tween

local Context = {}

local function Snapshot(Root: GuiObject): {[Instance]: {[string]: number}}
    local Saved: {[Instance]: {[string]: number}} = {}
    local Stack: {Instance} = {Root}
    while #Stack > 0 do
        local Object: any = table.remove(Stack)
        local Properties: {string} = if Object:IsA("UIStroke") or Object:IsA("UIShadow") then {"Transparency"} elseif Object:IsA("TextLabel") or Object:IsA("TextButton") or Object:IsA("TextBox") then {"TextTransparency", "BackgroundTransparency"} elseif Object:IsA("ImageLabel") or Object:IsA("ImageButton") or Object:IsA("ViewportFrame") then {"ImageTransparency", "BackgroundTransparency"} elseif Object:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then {"ScrollBarImageTransparency", "BackgroundTransparency"} elseif Object:IsA("GuiObject") then {"BackgroundTransparency"} else {}
        if #Properties > 0 then
            local Values: {[string]: number} = {}
            for _, v: string in Properties do
                Values[v] = Object[v]
            end
            Saved[Object] = Values
        end
        if Object == Root or not Object:IsA("GuiObject") or Object.Visible then
            for _, v: Instance in Object:GetChildren() do
                table.insert(Stack, v)
            end
        end
    end

    return Saved
end

function Context.new(): Context
    return setmetatable({
        Connections = {},
        Painters = {},
        Roots = {},
        Theme = "Dark",
        Shade = 0,
        Icons = {},
        Snaps = {},
        Strips = {},
        Arrows = true,
        Recover = true,
        Widths = {},
        Fades = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}),
        Active = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}),
        Runs = {},
        Cards = {},
        Items = {},
        Owners = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}),
        Accent = Theme.Accent,
        Target = Theme.Accent,
        Rounding = 1,
        Clear = 0,
        Zoom = 1,
        Animations = true
    }, Context) :: any
end

function Context.Connect(self: Context, Signal: RBXScriptSignal, Callback: (...any) -> ()): RBXScriptConnection
    local Connection: RBXScriptConnection = Signal:Connect(Callback)
    table.insert(self.Connections, Connection)

    return Connection
end

function Context.Icon(self: Context, Name: string, Size: number?): string
    local Index: string = Size and `{Name}-{Size}` or Name
    if not self.Icons[Index] then
        local Success: boolean, Result: any = pcall(getcustomasset, `{Theme.Folder}/{Index}.png`)
        self.Icons[Index] = Success and Result or ""
    end

    return self.Icons[Index]
end

function Context.Fit(self: Context, Icon: ImageLabel): ImageLabel
    local Base: UDim2 = Icon.Position
    local Slot: Vector2 = Vector2.new(Icon.Size.X.Offset, Icon.Size.Y.Offset)
    local Anchor: Vector2 = Icon.AnchorPoint
    local function Place(Origin: number, Span: number, Want: number, Pin: number, Scale: number, Offset: number, Factor: number): (number, number)
        local Centre: number = Origin + Scale * Span + Offset * Factor + (0.5 - Pin) * Want
        local Best: number = math.huge
        local Length: number, Start: number = Want, 0
        for _, v: number in {math.max(1, math.floor(Want)), math.max(1, math.ceil(Want))} do
            local From: number = math.round(Centre - v / 2)
            local Miss: number = math.abs(From + v / 2 - Centre) + math.abs(v - Want) * 0.01
            if Miss < Best then
                Best, Length, Start = Miss, v, From
            end
        end

        return (Length - Want) / Span, (Start + Pin * Length - Origin - Offset * Factor) / Span
    end

    local function Snap()
        local Parent: Instance? = Icon.Parent
        if not Parent or not Parent:IsA("GuiBase2d") or Parent.AbsoluteSize.X == 0 or Parent.AbsoluteSize.Y == 0 then
            return
        end

        local Factor: number = 1
        local Node: Instance? = Parent
        while Node do
            local Zoom: UIScale? = Node:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
            Factor *= Zoom and Zoom.Scale or 1
            Node = Node.Parent
        end

        local WideSize: number, WidePos: number = Place(Parent.AbsolutePosition.X, Parent.AbsoluteSize.X, Slot.X * Factor, Anchor.X, Base.X.Scale, Base.X.Offset, Factor)
        local TallSize: number, TallPos: number = Place(Parent.AbsolutePosition.Y, Parent.AbsoluteSize.Y, Slot.Y * Factor, Anchor.Y, Base.Y.Scale, Base.Y.Offset, Factor)
        if math.abs(Icon.Size.X.Scale - WideSize) > 0.000001 or math.abs(Icon.Size.Y.Scale - TallSize) > 0.000001 then
            Icon.Size = UDim2.new(WideSize, Slot.X, TallSize, Slot.Y)
        end
        if math.abs(Icon.Position.X.Scale - WidePos) > 0.000001 or math.abs(Icon.Position.Y.Scale - TallPos) > 0.000001 then
            Icon.Position = UDim2.new(WidePos, Base.X.Offset, TallPos, Base.Y.Offset)
        end
    end

    self:Connect(Icon:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"), Snap)
    self:Connect(Icon:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsolutePosition"), Snap)
    self.Snaps[Snap] = true
    Icon.Destroying:Once(function()
        self.Snaps[Snap] = nil
    end)
    task.defer(Snap)

    return Icon
end

function Context.Measure(self: Context, Text: string, Size: number, Weight: Enum.FontWeight): number
    local Index: string = `{Text}|{Size}|{Weight.Name}`
    if not self.Widths[Index] then
        local Face: string = if Weight == Enum.FontWeight.Bold then "semibold" else string.lower(Weight.Name)
        local Data: FontData? = if Host.Native or Size % 1 ~= 0 then nil else Faces.Load(Host.Folder, `sf-{Face}-{Size}`, "x100")
        if Data then
            self.Widths[Index] = Layout.Measure(Data, Text)
        else
            local Params: GetTextBoundsParams = Instance.new("GetTextBoundsParams")
            Params.Text = Text
            Params.Size = Size
            Params.Font = Font.new(Theme.Font, Weight)
            local Success: boolean, Result: any = pcall(Services.TextService.GetTextBoundsAsync, Services.TextService, Params)
            self.Widths[Index] = Success and Result.X or #Text * Size * 0.55
        end
    end

    return self.Widths[Index]
end

function Context.To(self: Context, Object: Instance, Goal: {[string]: any}, Info: TweenInfo?): Tween?
    local Active: {[string]: Tween} = self.Active[Object] or {}
    self.Active[Object] = Active
    for Property: string in Goal do
        local Old: Tween? = Active[Property]
        if Old then
            Old:Cancel()
            Active[Property] = nil
        end
    end

    if not Info or not self.Animations or self.Quiet then
        local Target: any = Object
        for Property: string, Value: any in Goal do
            Target[Property] = Value
        end

        return nil
    end

    local New: Tween = Tween(Object, Info, Goal)
    for Property: string in Goal do
        Active[Property] = New
    end
    New.Completed:Once(function()
        for Property: string in Goal do
            if Active[Property] == New then
                Active[Property] = nil
            end
        end
    end)

    return New
end

function Context.Run(self: Context, From: number, To: number, Info: TweenInfo, Step: (number) -> (), Done: (() -> ())?): Tween?
    if not self.Animations or self.Quiet then
        Step(To)
        if Done then
            Done()
        end

        return nil
    end

    local Value: NumberValue = Instance.new("NumberValue")
    Value.Value = From
    local Connection: RBXScriptConnection = Value.Changed:Connect(Step)
    local New: Tween = Tween(Value, Info, {Value = To})
    self.Runs[New] = true
    New.Completed:Once(function(State: Enum.PlaybackState)
        Connection:Disconnect()
        Value:Destroy()
        self.Runs[New] = nil
        if State == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed then
            Step(To)
            if Done then
                Done()
            end
        end
    end)

    return New
end

function Context.Fade(self: Context, Root: GuiObject, Shown: boolean, Info: TweenInfo?, Done: (() -> ())?): Tween?
    local State: Fading? = self.Fades[Root]
    if State and State.Run then
        State.Run:Cancel()
    end
    if not State then
        if Root.Visible == Shown then
            if Done then
                Done()
            end

            return
        end

        State = {Alpha = Shown and 1 or 0, Saved = Snapshot(Root)}
        self.Fades[Root] = State
    end

    local Current: Fading = State :: Fading
    local function Step(Alpha: number)
        Current.Alpha = Alpha
        for Object: any, Values: {[string]: number} in Current.Saved do
            for Property: string, Base: number in Values do
                Object[Property] = 1 - (1 - Base) * (1 - Alpha)
            end
        end
    end
    local function Finish()
        if not Shown then
            Root.Visible = false
        end
        Step(0)
        self.Fades[Root] = nil
        if Done then
            Done()
        end
    end

    Step(Current.Alpha)
    Root.Visible = true
    if not Info then
        Finish()

        return
    end

    Current.Run = self:Run(Current.Alpha, Shown and 0 or 1, Info, Step, Finish)

    return Current.Run
end

function Context.Mouse(self: Context): Vector2
    local Mouse: Vector2 = Services.UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    local Camera: Camera? = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not self.Holder or not Camera then
        return Mouse
    end

    local Center: Vector2 = self.Holder.AbsolutePosition + self.Holder.AbsoluteSize / 2

    return Mouse + Center - Camera.ViewportSize / 2 - Vector2.new(self.Holder.Position.X.Offset, self.Holder.Position.Y.Offset)
end

function Context.Register(self: Context, Index: string, Get: () -> any, Set: (any) -> ())
    table.insert(self.Items, {Key = Index, Get = Get, Set = Set})
end

function Context.Export(self: Context): {[string]: any}
    local Data: {[string]: any} = {}
    for _, v: Item in self.Items do
        local Value: any = v.Get()
        if Value ~= nil then
            Data[v.Key] = Value
        end
    end

    return Data
end

function Context.Import(self: Context, Data: {[string]: any}, Quiet: boolean?)
    local Old: boolean? = self.Quiet
    self.Quiet = Quiet or Old
    for _, v: Item in self.Items do
        local Value: any = Data[v.Key]
        if Value ~= nil then
            pcall(v.Set, Value)
        end
    end
    self.Quiet = Old
end

function Context.Paint(self: Context, Painter: () -> ())
    table.insert(self.Painters, Painter)
    Painter()
end

local Tinted: {[string]: {string}} = {
    GuiObject = {"BackgroundColor3"},
    TextLabel = {"BackgroundColor3", "TextColor3"},
    TextButton = {"BackgroundColor3", "TextColor3"},
    TextBox = {"BackgroundColor3", "TextColor3", "PlaceholderColor3"},
    ImageLabel = {"BackgroundColor3", "ImageColor3"},
    ImageButton = {"BackgroundColor3", "ImageColor3"},
    ScrollingFrame = {"BackgroundColor3", "ScrollBarImageColor3"},
    UIStroke = {"Color"}
}

local function Hex(Color: Color3): number
    return math.round(Color.R * 255) * 65536 + math.round(Color.G * 255) * 256 + math.round(Color.B * 255)
end

function Context.SetTheme(self: Context, Name: string)
    local Palette: {[string]: Color3}? = Theme.Themes[Name]
    if not Palette or Name == self.Theme then
        return
    end

    local Map: {[number]: Color3} = {}
    local Fresh: {[number]: boolean} = {}
    for Index: string, Color: Color3 in Palette do
        Map[Hex((Theme :: any)[Index])] = Color
        Fresh[Hex(Color)] = true
        ;(Theme :: any)[Index] = Color
    end
    self.Theme = Name
    self.Shade += 1
    local Shade: number = self.Shade
    local function Pass(Skip: boolean)
        for _, Root: Instance in self.Roots do
            for _, Object: Instance in Root:GetDescendants() do
                local Properties: {string} = Tinted[Object.ClassName] or (Object:IsA("GuiObject") and Tinted.GuiObject or {})
                local Goal: {[string]: Color3} = {}
                for _, v: string in Properties do
                    local Index: number = Hex((Object :: any)[v])
                    if Map[Index] and not (Skip and Fresh[Index]) then
                        Goal[v] = Map[Index]
                    end
                end
                if next(Goal) then
                    self:To(Object, Goal, Theme.Smooth)
                end
            end
        end
        for _, v: () -> () in self.Painters do
            v()
        end
    end

    Pass(false)
    task.delay(0.4, function()
        if self.Shade == Shade then
            Pass(true)
        end
    end)
end

function Context.SetAccent(self: Context, Color: Color3, Instant: boolean?)
    if self.AccentRun then
        self.AccentRun:Cancel()
        self.AccentRun = nil
    end

    local From: Color3 = self.Accent
    local Light: {number} = {}
    for _, v: Color3 in {Color, Theme.Ink} do
        local Total: number = 0
        for Index: number, Channel: number in {v.R, v.G, v.B} do
            local Linear: number = if Channel <= 0.03928 then Channel / 12.92 else ((Channel + 0.055) / 1.055) ^ 2.4
            Total += Linear * ({0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722})[Index]
        end
        table.insert(Light, Total)
    end

    local InkContrast: number = (Light[1] + 0.05) / (Light[2] + 0.05)
    local WhiteContrast: number = 1.05 / (Light[1] + 0.05)

    Theme.OnAccent = if InkContrast >= WhiteContrast then Theme.Ink else Theme.OnDark
    self.Target = Color
    local function Apply(Value: Color3)
        self.Accent = Value
        for _, v: () -> () in self.Painters do
            v()
        end
    end

    if Instant or From == Color then
        Apply(Color)

        return
    end

    self.AccentRun = self:Run(0, 1, Theme.Smooth, function(Alpha: number)
        Apply(From:Lerp(Color, Alpha))
    end, function()
        Apply(Color)
    end)
end

function Context.SetRadius(self: Context, Percent: number)
    self.Rounding = math.clamp(Percent, Theme.Limits.Radius[1], Theme.Limits.Radius[2]) / 100
    for _, Root: Instance in self.Roots do
        for _, v: Instance in Root:GetDescendants() do
            local Base: any = v:IsA("UICorner") and v:GetAttribute("Radius")
            if type(Base) == "number" then
                (v :: UICorner).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, math.round(Base * self.Rounding))
            end
        end
    end
end

function Context.SetPanel(self: Context, Percent: number)
    self.Clear = math.clamp(Percent, Theme.Limits.Panel[1], Theme.Limits.Panel[2]) / 100
    if self.Panel and not self.Fades[self.Panel] then
        self.Panel.BackgroundTransparency = self.Clear
    end
end

function Context.SetScale(self: Context, Choice: number)
    self.Zoom = math.clamp(Choice, Theme.Limits.Scale[1], Theme.Limits.Scale[2])
    local Camera: Camera? = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local Edge: Vector2 = Vector2.one * Theme.Size.Margin * 2
    local Room: Vector2 = Camera and Camera.ViewportSize - Edge or Theme.Size.Window * self.Zoom
    local Fit: number = math.max(0.25, math.min(Room.X / Theme.Size.Window.X, Room.Y / Theme.Size.Window.Y))
    if self.Scale then
        self:To(self.Scale, {Scale = math.min(self.Zoom, Fit)}, Theme.Smooth)
    end
end

function Context.Dismiss(self: Context)
    local Close: (() -> ())? = self.Close
    self.Close = nil
    if self.Catcher then
        self.Catcher.Visible = false
    end
    if Close then
        Close()
    end
end

function Context.Destroy(self: Context)
    self:Dismiss()
    local Pending: {Tween} = {}
    if self.AccentRun then
        table.insert(Pending, self.AccentRun)
    end
    for v: Tween in self.Runs do
        table.insert(Pending, v)
    end
    for _, Properties: {[string]: Tween} in self.Active do
        for _, v: Tween in Properties do
            table.insert(Pending, v)
        end
    end
    for _, v: Tween in Pending do
        v:Cancel()
    end

    for _, v: RBXScriptConnection in self.Connections do
        if v.Connected then
            v:Disconnect()
        end
    end

    table.clear(self.Connections)
    table.clear(self.Painters)
    table.clear(self.Icons)
    table.clear(self.Snaps)
    table.clear(self.Strips)
    table.clear(self.Widths)
    table.clear(self.Cards)
    table.clear(self.Items)

    if self.Hud then
        self.Hud.Destroy()
        self.Hud = nil
    end
    if self.Gui then
        self.Gui:Destroy()
        self.Gui = nil
    end

    Host.Root:Destroy()
end

local function Form(Fields: {[string]: string}): string
