    local function Render()
        local Track: any = Spotify.Track
        local Lyrics: {any}? = Track and Track.Lyrics or nil
        local Changed: boolean = Lyrics ~= Lines
        Lines = Lyrics
        if Changed then
            Timings = Measure(Lyrics or {})
        end
        for Name: string, v: View in Views do
            v.Title.Text = Track and Track.Name or "Spotify"
            v.Artist.Text = Track and Track.Artist or Spotify.Status
            local Asset: string = Track and Track.Cover or ""
            if v.Cover.Image ~= Asset then
                v.Cover.Image = Asset
                v.Cover.ImageTransparency = 1
                Ui:To(v.Cover, {ImageTransparency = Asset ~= "" and 0 or 1}, Theme.Smooth)
            end
            if v.Play then
                local Icon: string = Ui:Icon(Spotify.Playing and "pause" or "play", v.Play.Size.X.Offset)
                if v.Play.Image ~= Icon then
                    v.Play.Image = Icon
                end
            end
            if v.Reel and (Changed or #v.Reel.Labels == 0) then
                Fill(v.Reel, Name == "Fullscreen" and 30 or 15)
                task.defer(function()
                    if v.Reel then
                        Focus(v.Reel, 0, false, true)
                    end
                end)
            end
            if v.Line and Changed then
                v.Line.Text = Track and (Lyrics and "" or "No synced lyrics") or ""
            end
        end
    end

    local function Tick()
        local View: View? = Shown and Views[Layout] or nil
        if not View then
            return
        end

        local Track: any = Spotify.Track
        local Position: number = Spotify.Position()
        local Sung: number = Position + Shift
        View.Fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(Track and math.clamp(Position / Track.Duration, 0, 1) or 0, 1)
        if View.Spent and View.Left then
            View.Spent.Text = Clock(Position)
            View.Left.Text = Track and `-{Clock(Track.Duration - Position)}` or "0:00"
        end
        local Index: number = 0
        for Slot: number, v: Timing in Timings do
            if v.Start > Sung + 150 then
                break
            end
            Index = Slot
        end
        local Timing: Timing? = Timings[Index]
        local Reel: Reel? = View.Reel
        if Reel and #Reel.Labels > 0 then
            if Reel.Index ~= Index or Reel.Resting then
                Focus(Reel, Index, false, false)
            end
            Sing(Reel, Index, Sung)
        end
        local Line: TextLabel? = View.Line
        if Line and Lines then
            local Words: string = Timing and Timing.Text or ""
            if Line.Text ~= Words then
                Line.Text = Words
                Line.TextTransparency = 1
                Line.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(76, 48)
                Ui:To(Line, {TextTransparency = 0, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(76, 44)}, Theme.Show)
            end
            local Gradient: UIGradient? = Line:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")
            local Swept: number = Look.Mode ~= "Sweep" and 1 or Timing and math.clamp((Sung - Timing.Start) / (Timing.Finish - Timing.Start), 0, 1) or 1
            if Gradient then
                Gradient.Offset = Edge(Swept)
            end
        end
    end

    local function Apply()
        for Name: string, v: View in Views do
            local On: boolean = Shown and Name == Layout
            if v.Root.Visible ~= On then
                Ui:Fade(v.Root, On, On and Theme.Show or Theme.Hide)
            end
        end
        if Shown then
            Spotify.Start()
            Render()
            task.defer(function()
                local View: View? = Views[Layout]
                if View and View.Reel then
                    Focus(View.Reel, View.Reel.Index, View.Reel.Resting, true)
                end
            end)
        else
            Spotify.Stop()
        end
    end

    local Spot: Vector2 = Vector2.new(20, 72)
    local function Move(Point: Vector2)
        local Camera: Camera? = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local Screen: Vector2 = Camera and Camera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1920, 1080)
        Spot = Vector2.new(math.round(math.clamp(Point.X, 0, math.max(Screen.X - 300, 0))), math.round(math.clamp(Point.Y, 0, math.max(Screen.Y - 76, 0))))
        for _, Name: string in {"Card", "Compact"} do
            Views[Name].Root.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(Spot.X, Spot.Y)
        end
    end

    local Dragging: Vector2? = nil
    local Origin: Vector2 = Spot
    for _, Name: string in {"Card", "Compact"} do
        Ui:Connect(Views[Name].Root.InputBegan, function(Input: InputObject)
            if Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                Dragging = Vector2.new(Input.Position.X, Input.Position.Y)
                Origin = Spot
            end
        end)
    end
    Ui:Connect(Services.UserInputService.InputChanged, function(Input: InputObject)
        if Dragging and not Pressing and (Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            Move(Origin + Vector2.new(Input.Position.X, Input.Position.Y) - Dragging)
        end
    end)
    Ui:Connect(Services.UserInputService.InputEnded, function(Input: InputObject)
        if Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            Dragging = nil
            Pressing = false
        end
    end)
    Ui:Register("Settings/Main/Spotify/Position", function(): any
        return {Spot.X, Spot.Y}
    end, function(Value: any)
        if type(Value) == "table" and tonumber(Value[1]) and tonumber(Value[2]) then
            Move(Vector2.new(Value[1], Value[2]))
        end
    end)

    table.insert(Spotify.Listeners, Render)
    Ui:Connect(Services.RunService.RenderStepped, Tick)
    if Ui.Gui then
        Ui.Gui.Destroying:Once(function()
            Spotify.Stop()
            Gui:Destroy()
        end)
    end
    Render()

    return {
        SetShown = function(On: boolean)
            Shown = On
            Apply()
        end,
        SetStyle = function(Name: string)
            Look = Styles[Name] or Styles.Karaoke
            for _, v: View in Views do
                if v.Reel then
                    v.Reel.Index = -1
                end
            end
        end,
        SetOffset = function(Milliseconds: number)
            Shift = Milliseconds
        end,
        SetLayout = function(Name: string)
            Layout = Name
            Apply()
        end
    }

local function Read(Path: string): {[string]: any}?
    if not isfile(Path) then
        return
    end

    local Success: boolean, Result: any = pcall(function(): any
        return Services.HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(Path))
    end)

    return Success and type(Result) == "table" and Result or nil
end

local function Convert(Saved: any): any
    if type(Saved) ~= "table" then
        return
    end

    return if Saved.Hue ~= nil then {Hue = Saved.Hue, Sat = Saved.Sat, Value = Saved.Value, Opacity = Saved.Opacity, Rainbow = Saved.Rainbow == true}
        elseif Saved.ValueMin ~= nil then {Min = Saved.ValueMin, Max = Saved.ValueMax}
        elseif Saved.List ~= nil then {List = Saved.List, Enabled = Saved.ListEnabled or {}}
        elseif Saved.Enabled ~= nil then Saved.Enabled == true
        else Saved.Value
end

local function Add(Profile: {[string]: any}, Key: string, Module: any, Legit: boolean): ()
    if type(Module) ~= "table" then
        return
    end

    Profile[Key] = Module.Enabled == true
    local Bind: any = Module.Bind
    if type(Bind) == "table" then
        local Keys: {string} = if type(Bind.Keys) == "table" then Bind.Keys else Bind
        Profile[`{Key}#Bind`] = {Keys = Keys, Hold = Bind.Hold == true}
    elseif type(Bind) == "string" then
        Profile[`{Key}#Bind`] = {Keys = {Bind}, Hold = false}
    end
    if Module.Favorited ~= nil then
        Profile[`{Key}#Favorite`] = Module.Favorited
    end
    if Legit and type(Module.Position) == "table" and type(Module.Position.X) == "number" and type(Module.Position.Y) == "number" then
        Profile[`{Key}#Position`] = {X = Module.Position.X, Y = Module.Position.Y}
    end

    for Name: string, Saved: any in (type(Module.Options) == "table" and Module.Options or {}) do
        if Name == "Targets" and type(Saved) == "table" and Saved.Players ~= nil then
            for Old: string, New: string in Targets do
                if Saved[Old] ~= nil then
                    Profile[`{Key}/Targets/{New}`] = Saved[Old]
                end
            end
            continue
        end

        local Value: any = Convert(Saved)
        if Value ~= nil then
            Profile[`{Key}/{Name}`] = Value
        end
    end
end

local function Fold(Profile: {[string]: any}, Data: {[string]: any}): ()
    local Modules: {[string]: any} = type(Data.Modules) == "table" and Data.Modules or {}
    local Legit: {[string]: any} = type(Data.Legit) == "table" and Data.Legit or {}

    for _, v: {From: string, To: string, Legit: boolean} in Renamed do
        local Old: any = Modules[v.From] or Legit[v.From]
        if type(Old) == "table" and Profile[v.To] == nil then
            Add(Profile, v.To, Old, v.Legit)
        end
    end

    for _, v: {[string]: any} in Folded do
        local Old: any = Modules[v.From] or Legit[v.From]
        if type(Old) ~= "table" then
            continue
        end

        local Key: string = `Modules/{v.To}`
        local On: boolean = Old.Enabled == true
        if v.Option and v.Value == nil then
            Profile[`{Key}/{v.Option}`] = On
        elseif v.Option and On then
            Profile[`{Key}/{v.Option}`] = v.Value
        end
        if not (v.Enable and On) then
            continue
        end

        Profile[Key] = true
        for Option: string, Value: any in (v.Also or {}) do
            Profile[`{Key}/{Option}`] = Value
        end

        local Bind: any = Old.Bind
        local Current: any = Profile[`{Key}#Bind`]
        local Keys: any = type(Bind) == "table" and (if type(Bind.Keys) == "table" then Bind.Keys else Bind) or nil
        if type(Keys) == "table" and #Keys > 0 and (type(Current) ~= "table" or #(Current.Keys or {}) == 0) then
            Profile[`{Key}#Bind`] = {Keys = Keys, Hold = Bind.Hold == true}
        end
    end

    for _, Name: string in Kits do
        local Old: any = Modules[Name]
        if type(Old) == "table" and Old.Enabled == true then
            Profile[`Modules/{Renamed[Name] or Name}`] = true
        end
    end
end

local Port = {}

function Port.Found(): boolean
    if not isfolder(Folder) then
        return false
    end

    for _, Path: string in listfiles(Folder) do
        for _, Place: string in Places do
            if string.match(Path, `[^/\\]+{Place}%.txt$`) then
                return true
            end
        end
    end

    return false
end

function Port.Run(Force: boolean?): (number, string?)
    if not Force and #Store.List() > 0 or not isfolder(Folder) then
        return 0, nil
    end

    local Profiles: {[string]: {[string]: any}} = {}
    for _, Place: string in Places do
        for _, Path: string in listfiles(Folder) do
            local Name: string? = string.match(Path, `([^/\\]+){Place}%.txt$`)
            local Data: {[string]: any}? = Name and Read(Path)
            if not Name or not Data then
                continue
            end

            local Profile: {[string]: any} = Profiles[Name] or {}
            for Module: string, Saved: any in (type(Data.Modules) == "table" and Data.Modules or {}) do
                Add(Profile, `Modules/{Module}`, Saved, false)
            end
            for Module: string, Saved: any in (type(Data.Legit) == "table" and Data.Legit or {}) do
                Add(Profile, `Modules/Legit/{Module}`, Saved, true)
            end
            Fold(Profile, Data)
            Profiles[Name] = Profile
        end
    end

    local Taken: {string} = Store.List()
    local Written: {[string]: string} = {}
    local Count: number = 0
    for Name: string, Profile: {[string]: any} in Profiles do
        local Clean: string = Store.Clean(Name)
        if Clean ~= "" and next(Profile) then
            local Target: string = if table.find(Taken, Clean) then Store.Clean(`{Clean} old`) else Clean
            Store.Write(`{Store.Folder}/{Target}.json`, Profile)
            Written[Clean] = Target
            Count += 1
        end
    end

    local Gui: {[string]: any}? = Read(`{Folder}/2619619496.gui.txt`)
    local Current: string? = Gui and type(Gui.Profile) == "string" and Written[Store.Clean(Gui.Profile)] or nil
    if not Force and Current then
        Store.SetCurrent(Current)
    end

    return Count, Current
end

local Effect: BlurEffect? = nil

local function Rescale()
    Pending = false
    if Auto ~= nil and not Auto.Enabled then
        local Pixels: number = math.max(math.round(14 * (Size and Size.Value or 1)), 6)
        Scale.Scale = if Pixels == 14 then 1 else (Pixels + 0.01) / 14
        return
    end

    local Width: number, Height: number = Gui.AbsoluteSize.X, Gui.AbsoluteSize.Y
    if Services.UserInputService.TouchEnabled then
        Scale.Scale = math.max(Width / 1920, 0.4)
        return
    end

    local Right: number, Bottom: number = 0, 0
    for _, v: GuiObject in Order do
        if v.Visible then
            Right = math.max(Right, v.Position.X.Offset + v.Size.X.Offset)
            Bottom = math.max(Bottom, v.Position.Y.Offset + v.Size.Y.Offset)
        end
    end

    local Fit: number = math.round(14 * math.min(Width / 1920, Height / 1080))
    local Room: number = if Sorting and Sorting.Enabled then Fit else math.floor(14 * math.min(Width / (Right + 6), Height / (Bottom + 6)))
    local Pixels: number = math.max(math.min(Fit, Room), if Services.UserInputService.TouchEnabled then 8 else 6)

    Scale.Scale = if Pixels == 14 then 1 else (Pixels + 0.01) / 14
end

local function Queue()
    if Pending or Ui.Dragging then
        return
    end

    Pending = true
    task.defer(Rescale)
end

local function Focus()
    local On: boolean = (Click.Visible or Legit.Holder.Visible) and Blur ~= nil and Blur.Enabled
    local Current: BlurEffect = Effect or Create.New("BlurEffect", {
        Enabled = false,
        Name = Services.HttpService:GenerateGUID(false),
        Size = 0,
        Parent = Services.Lighting
    })
    if not Effect then
        Effect = Current
        table.insert(Ui.Roots, Current)

        local Lens: DepthOfFieldEffect = Create.New("DepthOfFieldEffect", {
            FarIntensity = 0,
            InFocusRadius = 0.1,
            Name = Services.HttpService:GenerateGUID(false),
            NearIntensity = 1,
            Parent = Services.Lighting
        })
        table.insert(Ui.Roots, Lens)
    end
    Current.Size = On and (Intensity and Intensity.Value or 24) or 0
    Current.Enabled = On
end

local function Show(Visible: boolean, Legitimate: boolean?)
    Click.Visible = Visible and not Legitimate
    Legit.Holder.Visible = Visible and Legitimate == true
    Tooltip.Visible = false
    Focus()
    if not Visible then
        return
    end

    for _, v: () -> () in Ui.Painters do
        v()
    end
    if Cursoring or not Services.UserInputService.MouseEnabled then
        return
    end

    Cursoring = Ui:Connect(Services.RunService.RenderStepped, function()
        if not Click.Visible and not Legit.Holder.Visible then
            Cursor.Visible = false
            if Cursoring then
                Cursoring:Disconnect()
                Cursoring = nil
            end

            return
        end

        Cursor.Visible = not Services.UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled
        if Cursor.Visible then
            local Mouse: Vector2 = Services.UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
            Cursor.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(Mouse.X - 31, Mouse.Y - 32)
        end
    end)
end

local Docks: {[GuiObject]: GuiObject} = {}
local Links: {[GuiObject]: {RBXScriptConnection}} = {}

local function Undock(Child: GuiObject)
    if not Links[Child] then
        return
    end

    for _, v: RBXScriptConnection in Links[Child] do
        v:Disconnect()
    end

    Links[Child] = nil
    Docks[Child] = nil
end

local function Dock(Child: GuiObject, Parent: GuiObject)
    Undock(Child)
    Docks[Child] = Parent

    local function Follow()
        local Below: number = Parent.Visible and Parent.Size.Y.Offset + 10 or 0
        Child.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(Parent.Position.X.Offset, Parent.Position.Y.Offset + Below)
    end

    Links[Child] = {}
    for _, v: string in {"Position", "Size", "Visible"} do
        table.insert(Links[Child], Parent:GetPropertyChangedSignal(v):Connect(Follow))
    end
    Follow()
end

local function Arrange(All: boolean)
    local List: {GuiObject} = {}
    for _, v: GuiObject in Order do
        if v == Main.Object then
            Undock(v)
            v.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 60)
        elseif All or v.Visible then
            Undock(v)
            table.insert(List, v)
        end
    end

    local Columns: number = math.max(math.floor((Gui.AbsoluteSize.X / Scale.Scale - 346) / 230), 1)
    for Index: number, v: GuiObject in List do
        if Index <= Columns then
            v.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(236 + (Index - 1) * 230, 60)
        else
            Dock(v, List[Index - Columns])
        end
    end

    Ui:Save()
end

Ui.Dragged = Undock
Ui.Dropped = Queue
table.insert(Order, Starred.Object)
Ui:Pause()

for _, v: GuiObject in Order do
    for _, Property: string in {"Visible", "Size", "Position"} do
        Ui:Connect(v:GetPropertyChangedSignal(Property), Queue)
    end
end
Ui:Register("Main/Docks", function(): any
    local Saved: {[string]: string} = {}
    for Child: GuiObject, Parent: GuiObject in Docks do
        Saved[Child.Name] = Parent.Name
    end

    return Saved
end, function(Value: any)
    if type(Value) ~= "table" then
        return
    end

    for _, Child: GuiObject in Order do
        for _, Parent: GuiObject in Order do
            if Value[Child.Name] == Parent.Name then
                Dock(Child, Parent)
            end
        end
    end
end)
if Ui.Data["Main/Docks"] == nil then

end

local function Migrate()
    local Count: number, Current: string? = Port.Run(true)
    if Count == 0 then
        Ui.Notify("Config port", "No old catvape BedWars config was found", 5, "warning")
        return
    end

    Saved.Build()
    if Current then
        Ui:Switch(Current)
    end
    Ui.Notify("Config ported", `Brought over {Count} profile{Count == 1 and "" or "s"} from the old catvape script`, 8)
    Ui:Save()
end

Prompt.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
    Prompt.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Hover
end)
Prompt.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
    Prompt.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Main
end)
Prompt.MouseButton1Click:Connect(Migrate)

local Touch: boolean = Services.UserInputService.TouchEnabled or not Services.UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled or shared.VapeDeveloper == true
if Touch then
    local PlayerGui: PlayerGui = Services.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    local Container: Instance? = nil
    local Stats: Instance? = nil
    local Hiding: boolean = false
    local Hidden: Toggle
    local Button: TextButton
    local Icon: ImageLabel
    local Previous: {[GuiObject]: boolean} = {}

    local function Conceal(Child: Instance): ()
        if Hiding and Child:IsA("GuiObject") and Child ~= Button then
            if Previous[Child] == nil then
                Previous[Child] = Child.Visible
            end
            Child.Visible = false
        end
    end

    local function Bar(Enabled: boolean): ()
        Hiding = Enabled
        if Enabled and Container then
            for _, v: Instance in Container:GetChildren() do
                Conceal(v)
            end
        end
        if Enabled and Stats then
            for _, v: Instance in Stats:GetChildren() do
                Conceal(v)
            end
        end
        if not Enabled then
            for Child: GuiObject, Visible: boolean in Previous do
                if Child.Parent then
                    Child.Visible = Visible
                end
            end
            table.clear(Previous)
        end
    end

    local function Paint(): ()
        if not Button then
            return
        end

        local Open: boolean = Click.Visible or Legit.Holder.Visible
        local Hide: boolean = not Open and Hidden ~= nil and Hidden.Enabled
        Button.BackgroundTransparency = Hide and 1 or 0.08
        Icon.ImageTransparency = Hide and 1 or 0
        Bar(Open and Blur ~= nil and Blur.Enabled)
    end

    local function Holder(): Instance
        if Stats and Stats:IsDescendantOf(PlayerGui) then
            return Stats
        end
        if Container and Container:IsDescendantOf(PlayerGui) then
            return Container
        end

        return Gui
    end

    local function Make(Parent: Instance): ()
        if Button then
            if Button.Parent == Parent then
                return
            end
            Button:Destroy()
        end

        Icon = Create.New("ImageLabel", {
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Image = Ui:Icon("vape"),
            Name = "Icon",
            Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 32),
            ZIndex = 11
        })
        Button = Create.New("TextButton", {
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 21),
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.08,
            LayoutOrder = -9999999,
            Name = "VapeButton",
            Position = UDim2.new(1, -90, 0, 4),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 44),
            Text = "",
            ZIndex = 10,
            Parent = Parent
        }, {Create.New("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)}), Icon})
        Paint()
        Button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            Show(not Click.Visible and not Legit.Holder.Visible)
        end)
    end

    local function Added(Child: Instance): ()
        local IsStats: boolean = Child.Name == "TopBarStatsGui"
        if Child.Name ~= "TopBarAppGui" and not IsStats then
            return
        end

        local Top: Instance? = Child:WaitForChild(IsStats and "TopBarStatsScroller" or "TopBarApp", 15)
        if IsStats and Top then
            Top = Top:WaitForChild("TopBarStats", 15)
        end
        if not Top or not Child.Parent or not Gui.Parent or (IsStats and Stats == Top) or (not IsStats and Container == Top) then
            return
        end

        if Child:IsA("ScreenGui") then
            local Order: number = Child.DisplayOrder
            Child.DisplayOrder = Gui.DisplayOrder + 1
            table.insert(Maid, function()
                Child.DisplayOrder = Order
            end)
            pcall(function()
                local OnTop: boolean = Child.OnTopOfCoreBlur
                Child.OnTopOfCoreBlur = true
                table.insert(Maid, function()
                    Child.OnTopOfCoreBlur = OnTop
                end)
            end)
        end

        local Was: boolean = Hiding
        Bar(false)
        if IsStats then
            Stats = Top
        else
            Container = Top
        end
        Make(Holder())
        Ui:Connect(Top.ChildAdded, Conceal)
        Bar(Was)
    end

    local function Removed(Child: Instance): ()
        if (Child.Name ~= "TopBarAppGui" and Child.Name ~= "TopBarStatsGui") or not Gui.Parent then
            return
        end

        local Was: boolean = Hiding
        Bar(false)
        if Container and not Container:IsDescendantOf(PlayerGui) then
            Container = nil
        end
        if Stats and not Stats:IsDescendantOf(PlayerGui) then
            Stats = nil
        end
        Make(Holder())
        Bar(Was)
    end

    Make(Gui)
    table.insert(Maid, function()
        Bar(false)
        Container = nil
        Stats = nil
        Button:Destroy()
    end)
    Ui:Connect(PlayerGui.ChildAdded, Added)
    Ui:Connect(PlayerGui.ChildRemoved, Removed)
    for _, Name: string in {"TopBarAppGui", "TopBarStatsGui"} do
        local Found: Instance? = PlayerGui:FindFirstChild(Name)
        if Found then
            table.insert(Maid, task.spawn(Added, Found))
        end
    end
    Ui:Connect(Click:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"), Paint)
    Ui:Connect(Legit.Holder:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"), Paint)
    Hidden = Interface:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Hide CatVape Button",
        Function = Paint,
        Tooltip = "Hides the button while the menu is closed"
    })
    Paint()
end

Ui:Connect(Services.UserInputService.InputBegan, function(Input: InputObject)
    if Input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift and Ui.Refresh then
        Ui.Refresh()
    end
    if Services.UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() or Input.KeyCode.Value == 0 or Ui.Binding then
        return
    end

    for v: Bind in Ui.Binds do
        if v.Keys[1] == Input.KeyCode.Name then
            task.spawn(v.Trigger, true)
        end
    end
end)
Ui:Connect(Services.UserInputService.InputEnded, function(Input: InputObject)
    if Input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift and Ui.Refresh then
        Ui.Refresh()
    end
    if Services.UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() or Input.KeyCode.Value == 0 then
        return
    end

    local Binding: Bind? = Ui.Binding
    if Binding then
        Ui.Binding = nil
        Binding:SetBind({Input.KeyCode.Name}, true)
        return
    end

    for v: Bind in Ui.Binds do
        if v.Hold and v.Keys[1] == Input.KeyCode.Name then
            task.spawn(v.Trigger, false)
        end
    end
end)
Ui:Connect(Gui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"), Rescale)
Rescale()
if Sorting.Enabled and Sorted ~= Scale.Scale then
    Arrange(false)
end
Ready = true
Ui.Speed, Ui.Rate = Speed, Rate

table.insert(Maid, task.spawn(function()
    local Hue: number = 0
    repeat
        for v: ColorSlider in Ui.Rainbows do
            pcall(v.SetValue, v, Hue)
        end

        local Delta: number = task.wait(1 / Rate.Value)
        Hue = (Hue + Delta * 0.2 * Speed.Value) % 1
    until Ui.Dead
end))
table.insert(Maid, task.spawn(function()
    repeat
        task.wait(0.1)
        if (#Ui.Replay > 0 or #Ui.Queue > 0) and os.clock() - Ui.Last > 0.2 then
            local List: {() -> ()} = table.clone(Ui.Replay)
            table.move(Ui.Queue, 1, #Ui.Queue, #List + 1, List)
            table.clear(Ui.Replay)
            table.clear(Ui.Queue)
            for _, v: () -> () in List do
                local Success: boolean, Result: any = pcall(v)
                if not Success then
                    warn(`[catvape] failed to load a module state: {Result}`)
                end
            end
        end
    until Ui.Dead
end))

Cat = {
    Categories = Categories,
    Modules = Ui.Modules,
    Legit = Legit,
    Ui = Ui,
    Clean = function(_, Item: any): any
        table.insert(Maid, Item)

        return Item
    end,
    CreateNotification = function(_, Title: string, Message: string?, Duration: number?, Type: string?)
        Ui.Notify(Title, Message, Duration, Type)
    end,
    ShowCategory = function(_, Name: string)
        local Link: Entry? = Hidden[Name]
        if Link then
            Link.Object.Visible = true
        end
    end,
    Remove = function(_, Name: string)
        local Module: (Module | LegitModule)? = Ui.Modules[Name] or Legit.Modules[Name]
        if Module then
            Module:Remove()
        end
    end,
    CreateOverlay = function(_, Props: OverlayProps): Overlay
        return Overlay(Ui, Tray, Props)
    end,
    Destroy = Destroy
}

            return setmetatable({}, {
                __index = function(self, Event: string)
                    local MetaTable: any; MetaTable = {
                        __index = {
                            Instance = Instance.new("BindableEvent"),
                            Fire = function(_, ...)
                                (rawget((rawget(MetaTable, "__index") :: any), "Instance") :: BindableEvent):Fire(...)
                            end
                        },
                        __metatable = {}
                    } :: {[any]: any}

                    for _, v in {"Connect", "ConnectParallel", "Once", "Wait"} do
                        local __index: any = rawget(MetaTable, "__index")
                        rawset(__index, v, function(_, ...)
                            local BindableEvent = (rawget(__index, "Instance") :: BindableEvent)
                            return BindableEvent.Event[v](BindableEvent.Event, ...)
                        end)
                    end

                    rawset(self, Event, setmetatable({}, MetaTable))
                    return rawget(self, Event)
                end
            })
        end

                        if not Altar.activeCrates[1] then
                            for _, v: any in Data.Controllers.Store:getState().Consumable.inventory do
                                if v.consumable:find("crate") then
                                    Altar:pickCrate(v.consumable, 1)
                                    task.wait(1.2)

                                    local Active: any = Altar.activeCrates[1]
                                    if Active and Active[2] then
                                        Rewards:Get("OpenRewardCrate"):SendToServer({
                                            crateId = Active[2].attributes.crateId
                                        })
                                    end

                                    break
                                end
                            end

                        task.wait(1)
                    until not AutoGamble.Enabled
                end

local Hold: MatchHold = (function()
    local Services = BundledModules.Services
    local isfile = BundledModules.isfile
    local readfile = BundledModules.readfile
    local newcclosure = BundledModules.newcclosure

    local Hold: MatchHold = shared.CatMatchHold
    if Hold then
        return Hold
    end

    Hold = {
        Flag = "catvape/matchdodge.txt",
        Held = false,
        Claimed = false,
        Started = os.clock(),
        Release = function()
            local Self: MatchHold = shared.CatMatchHold
            if not Self.Held then
                return
            end

            Self.Held = false
            if Self.Connect then
                local Connect: {Remote: RemoteEvent, Args: {any}} = Self.Connect
                Self.Connect = nil
                Connect.Remote:FireServer(table.unpack(Connect.Args, 1, (Connect.Args :: any).n))
            end
            if Self.Ready then
                local Ready: RemoteEvent = Self.Ready
                Self.Ready = nil
                Ready:FireServer()
            end
        end
    }
    shared.CatMatchHold = Hold

    local Match: boolean = game.GameId == 2619619496 and game.PlaceId ~= 6872265039
    local Enabled: boolean = Match and isfile(Hold.Flag) and readfile(Hold.Flag) == "true"
    if Enabled and hookmetamethod and getnamecallmethod and checkcaller and not Services.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("PlayerConnected") then
        Hold.Held = true

        local Old: (...any) -> ...any
        Old = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", newcclosure(function(self: any, ...: any): ...any
            if Hold.Held and not checkcaller() and getnamecallmethod() == "FireServer" then
                local Name: string = tostring(self)
                if Name == "PlayerConnect" then
                    Hold.Connect = {Remote = self, Args = table.pack(...)}

                    return nil
                elseif Name == "PlayerReady" then
                    Hold.Ready = self

                    return nil
                end
            end

            return Old(self, ...)
        end))

        task.delay(45, function()
            if not Hold.Claimed then
                Hold.Release()
            end
        end)
    end

    return Hold
end)()

local Shades: {[string]: {any}} = {
    Panel = {"Main", -0.02},
    Deep = {"Main", -0.04},
    Hover = {"Main", 0.02},
    Track = {"Main", 0.034},
    Badge = {"Main", 0.04},

local Themes: {[string]: {[string]: Color3}} = {}
for Name: string, Values: {{number}} in Bases do
    local Colors: {[string]: Color3} = {}
    for Index: number, v: {number} in Values do
        Colors[Keys[Index]] = Color3.fromRGB(v[1], v[2], v[3])
    end
    local _, _, Bright: number = Colors.Main:ToHSV()
    local Sign: number = Bright > 0.5 and -1 or 1
    for Shade: string, v: {any} in Shades do
        if v[3] and Name ~= "Dark" then
            continue
        end

        local Hue: number, Sat: number, Value: number = Colors[v[1]]:ToHSV()
        Colors[Shade] = Color3.fromHSV(Hue, Sat, math.clamp(Value + v[2] * Sign, 0, 1))
    end
    Themes[Name] = Colors
end

function Create.Fade(Root: Instance, Faded: boolean, Saved: {[Instance]: {[string]: number}}, Amount: number)

		for _, Property: string in Properties do
			Saved[v] = Saved[v] or {}
			Saved[v][Property] = Saved[v][Property] or Object[Property]
			local Base: number = Saved[v][Property]
			Object[Property] = if Faded and Base < 1 then 1 - (1 - Base) * (1 - Amount) else Base
		end
	end
end

local function Ensure()

function Store.Clean(Name: string): string
    local Result: string = string.gsub(Name, "[\\/:*?\"<>|%c]", "")
    Result = string.gsub(Result, "^%s+", "")
    Result = string.gsub(Result, "%s+$", "")

    return string.sub(Result, 1, 32)
end

function Store.List(): {string}
    local Names: {string} = {}
    if not isfolder(Store.Folder) then
        return Names
    end

    for _, v: string in listfiles(Store.Folder) do
        local Name: string? = string.match(v, "([^/\\]+)%.json$")
        if Name then
            table.insert(Names, Name)
        end
    end

    return Names
end

function Store.Read(Path: string): {[string]: any}
    if not isfile(Path) then
        return {}
    end

    local Success: boolean, Result: any = pcall(function(): any
        return Services.HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(Path))
    end)

    return Success and type(Result) == "table" and Result or {}
end

function Store.Write(Path: string, Data: {[string]: any})
    local Success: boolean, Result: any = pcall(Services.HttpService.JSONEncode, Services.HttpService, Data)
    if not Success then
        warn(`[catvape] could not encode {Path}: {Result}`)
        return
    end
    if isfile(Path) and readfile(Path) == Result then
        return
    end

    Ensure()
    pcall(writefile, Path, Result)
end

function Store.Delete(Name: string)
    local Path: string = `{Store.Folder}/{Name}.json`
    if isfile(Path) then
        pcall(delfile, Path)
    end
end

function Store.Current(): string
    local Success: boolean, Result: any = pcall(readfile, Store.Pointer)
    local Name: string = Success and isfile(Store.Pointer) and type(Result) == "string" and Store.Clean(Result) or ""

    return Name ~= "" and Name or "default"
end

function Store.SetCurrent(Name: string)
    Ensure()
    pcall(writefile, Store.Pointer, Name)
end

function Context.Pause(_)

    if not Frame or not Start or os.clock() - Frame < (os.clock() - Start > 0.6 and 0.016 or 0.006) or not coroutine.isyieldable() then

    task.wait()
    SetIdentity(8)
    if shared.BundleFrame then

    end

function Context.Icon(self: Context, Name: string): string
    if not self.Icons[Name] then
        local Success: boolean, Result: any = pcall(getcustomasset, `{Theme.Folder}/{Name}.png`)
        self.Icons[Name] = Success and Result or ""
    end

    return self.Icons[Name]
end

function Context.Tween(self: Context, Object: Instance, Goal: {[string]: any}, Info: TweenInfo?)
    local Old: Tween? = self.Tweens[Object]
    if Old then
        Old:Cancel()
        self.Tweens[Object] = nil
    end
    if not Info then
        for Property: string, Value: any in Goal do
            (Object :: any)[Property] = Value
        end

        return
    end

    local Run: Tween = Services.TweenService:Create(Object, Info, Goal)
    self.Tweens[Object] = Run
    Run:Play()
end

function Context.Measure(self: Context, Text: string, Size: number, Face: Font, Width: number?): Vector2
    local Index: string = `{Text}|{Size}|{Width or 0}|{Face.Family}|{Face.Weight.Name}|{Face.Style.Name}`
    if self.Sizes[Index] then
        return self.Sizes[Index]
    end

    local Params: GetTextBoundsParams = Instance.new("GetTextBoundsParams")
    Params.Text = Text
    Params.Size = Size
    Params.Font = Face
    Params.Width = Width or math.huge

    local Success: boolean, Result: any = pcall(Services.TextService.GetTextBoundsAsync, Services.TextService, Params)
    local Bounds: Vector2 = Success and Result or Vector2.new(#Text * Size * 0.5, Size)

    self.Count += 1
    if self.Count > 2048 then
        self.Count = 0
        table.clear(self.Sizes)
    end

    self.Sizes[Index] = Bounds

    return Bounds
end

function Context.Mouse(self: Context): Vector2
    local Mouse: Vector2 = Services.UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    if not self.Scaled then
        return Mouse
    end

    return Mouse + self.Scaled.AbsolutePosition
end

function Context.Drag(self: Context, Gui: GuiObject, Header: number, Gate: (() -> boolean)?)
    Gui.InputBegan:Connect(function(Input: InputObject)
        if Input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and Input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch or Gate and not Gate() then
            return
        end
        local Mouse: Vector2 = self:Mouse()
        if Mouse.Y - Gui.AbsolutePosition.Y > Header * self.Scale.Scale then
            return
        end

        local Grab: Vector2 = Gui.AbsolutePosition - Mouse
        self.Dragging = true
        local Release: RBXScriptConnection
        local Move: RBXScriptConnection = Services.UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(Changed: InputObject)
            if Changed.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and Changed.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                return
            end

            if self.Dragged then
                self.Dragged(Gui)
            end

            local Target: Vector2 = (Services.UserInputService:GetMouseLocation() + Grab) / self.Scale.Scale
            if Services.UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then
                Target = Target // 3 * 3
            end
            Gui.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(Target.X, Target.Y)
        end)
        Release = Input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if Input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                Move:Disconnect()
                Release:Disconnect()
                self.Dragging = false
                self:Save()
                if self.Dropped then
                    self.Dropped()
                end
            end
        end)
    end)
end

function Context.Tip(self: Context, Gui: GuiObject, Text: (string | () -> string)?)
    if not Text then
        return
    end

    local Label: TextLabel = self.Tooltip
    local function Move()
        if not self.Tips then
            return
        end

        local Mouse: Vector2 = (self:Mouse() - self.Scaled.AbsolutePosition) / self.Scale.Scale
        local Width: number = Label.Size.X.Offset
        local Right: boolean = Mouse.X + 16 + Width > self.Scaled.AbsoluteSize.X / self.Scale.Scale
        local X: number = Right and Mouse.X - Width - 16 or Mouse.X + 16
        Label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(X, Mouse.Y + 11 - Label.Size.Y.Offset / 2)
        Label.Visible = true
    end
    local function Fill()
        Label.Text = if type(Text) == "function" then Text() else Text
        local Bounds: Vector2 = self:Measure(Label.ContentText, Label.TextSize, Theme.Font)
        Label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(Bounds.X + 10, Bounds.Y + 10)
    end

    Gui.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        Fill()
        Move()
        self.Refresh = Fill
    end)
    Gui.MouseMoved:Connect(Move)
    Gui.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        Label.Visible = false
        self.Refresh = nil
    end)
end

function Context.Color(self: Context, Offset: number?): Color3
    if not self.Accent.Rainbow then
        return Color3.fromHSV(self.Accent.Hue, self.Accent.Sat, self.Accent.Value)
    end

    return self:Rainbow((self.Accent.Hue - (Offset or 0)) % 1)
end

function Context.Rainbow(_, Hue: number): Color3
    local Sat: number = 0.74 + 0.26 * math.min(Hue / 0.045, 1)
    if Hue > 0.577 then
        Sat = 1 - 0.48 * math.min((Hue - 0.577) / 0.088, 1)
    end
    if Hue > 0.674 then
        Sat = 0.52 + 0.48 * math.min((Hue - 0.674) / 0.149, 1)
    end
    if Hue > 0.869 then
        Sat = 1 - 0.26 * math.min((Hue - 0.869) / 0.131, 1)
    end

    return Color3.fromHSV(Hue, Sat, 1)
end

local Tinted: {[string]: {string}} = {
    GuiObject = {"BackgroundColor3"},
    TextLabel = {"BackgroundColor3", "TextColor3"},
    TextButton = {"BackgroundColor3", "TextColor3"},
    TextBox = {"BackgroundColor3", "TextColor3", "PlaceholderColor3"},
    ImageLabel = {"BackgroundColor3", "ImageColor3"},
    ImageButton = {"BackgroundColor3", "ImageColor3"},
    ScrollingFrame = {"BackgroundColor3", "ScrollBarImageColor3"},
    UIStroke = {"Color"}
}

local function Hex(Color: Color3): number
    return math.round(Color.R * 255) * 65536 + math.round(Color.G * 255) * 256 + math.round(Color.B * 255)
end

function Context.SetTheme(self: Context, Name: string)
    local Palette: {[string]: Color3}? = Theme.Themes[Name]
    if not Palette or Name == self.Theme then
        return
    end

    local Map: {[number]: Color3} = {}
    local Fresh: {[number]: boolean} = {}
    for Index: string, Color: Color3 in Palette do
        Map[Hex(Theme[Index])] = Color
        Fresh[Hex(Color)] = true
        Theme[Index] = Color
    end
    self.Theme = Name
    self.Shade += 1
    local Shade: number = self.Shade
    local function Pass(Skip: boolean): ()
        for _, Root: Instance in self.Roots do
            for _, Object: Instance in Root:GetDescendants() do
                local Properties: {string} = Tinted[Object.ClassName] or (Object:IsA("GuiObject") and Tinted.GuiObject or {})
                local Goal: {[string]: Color3} = {}
                for _, v: string in Properties do
                    local Index: number = Hex((Object :: any)[v])
                    if Map[Index] and not (Skip and Fresh[Index]) then
                        Goal[v] = Map[Index]
                    end
                end
                if next(Goal) then
                    self:Tween(Object, Goal, Theme.Tween)
                end
            end
        end
        for _, v: () -> () in self.Painters do
            v()
        end
    end

    Pass(false)
    task.delay(0.3, function(): ()
        if self.Shade == Shade and not self.Dead then
            Pass(true)
        end
    end)
end

function Context.Contrast(self: Context, Color: Color3): Color3
    local Hue: number, Sat: number, Value: number = Color:ToHSV()
    if Value >= 0.7 and (Sat < 0.6 or Hue > 0.04 and Hue < 0.56) then
        return Color3.new(0.19, 0.19, 0.19)
    end

    return Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
end

function Context.Clear(_, List: {any})
    for _, v: any in List do
        local Class: string = typeof(v)
        if Class == "function" then
            pcall(v)
        elseif Class == "RBXScriptConnection" and v.Connected then
            pcall(v.Disconnect, v)
        elseif Class == "thread" then
            pcall(task.cancel, v)
        elseif Class == "Instance" then
            pcall(function() v:Destroy(); end)
        elseif Class == "table" and v.Destroy then
            pcall(v.Destroy, v)
        end
    end

    table.clear(List)
end

function Context.Register(self: Context, Index: string, Get: () -> any, Set: (any) -> ())
    table.insert(self.Items, {Key = Index, Get = Get, Set = Set})

    self.Last = os.clock()

    if self.Data[Index] ~= nil then
        Set(self.Data[Index])
    end
end

function Context.Export(self: Context): {[string]: any}
    local Data: {[string]: any} = table.clone(self.Data)
    for _, v: Item in self.Items do
        Data[v.Key] = v.Get()
    end

    return Data
end

function Context.Write(self: Context)
    local Gui: {[string]: any} = {}
    local Profile: {[string]: any} = {}
    for Index: string, Value: any in self:Export() do
        if string.sub(Index, 1, 8) == "Modules/" then
            Profile[Index] = Value
        else
            Gui[Index] = Value
        end
    end

    Store.Write(Store.Gui, Gui)
    Store.Write(`{Store.Folder}/{self.Profile}.json`, Profile)
end

function Context.Save(self: Context)
    if self.Saving or self.Dead then
        return
    end

    self.Saving = true
    task.delay(1, function()
        self.Saving = false
        if not self.Dead then
            self:Write()
        end
    end)
end

function Context.Switch(self: Context, Name: string)
    self:Write()
    self.Profile = Name
    Store.SetCurrent(Name)

    for Index: string in self.Data do
        if string.sub(Index, 1, 8) == "Modules/" then
            self.Data[Index] = nil
        end
    end

    for Index: string, Value: any in Store.Read(`{Store.Folder}/{Name}.json`) do
        self.Data[Index] = Value
    end

    for _, v: Item in self.Items do
        if string.sub(v.Key, 1, 8) == "Modules/" then
            v.Set(self.Data[v.Key])
        end
    end

    self.Last = os.clock()
    self:Save()
end

function Context.Destroy(self: Context)
    if not self.Dead then
        self:Write()
    end

    self.Dead = true

    for _, v: RBXScriptConnection in self.Connections do
        v:Disconnect()
    end
    
    for _, v: Instance in self.Roots do
        v:Destroy()
    end

    for _, v: string in {"Connections", "Painters", "Rainbows", "Binds", "Items", "Queue"} do
        table.clear(rawget(self, v) :: {any})
    end
end

    ColorSlider = (function()
        local Theme = BundledModules.Theme

        local function Parse(Text: string): Color3?
            local Parts: {string} = string.split(Text, ",")
            if #Parts == 3 then
                local Red: number?, Green: number?, Blue: number? = tonumber(Parts[1]), tonumber(Parts[2]), tonumber(Parts[3])
                if Red and Green and Blue then
                    return Color3.fromRGB(math.clamp(Red, 0, 255), math.clamp(Green, 0, 255), math.clamp(Blue, 0, 255))
                end

                return nil
            end

            local Hex: string = string.lower((string.gsub(Text, "[%s#]", "")))
            if #Hex == 3 then
                Hex = string.gsub(Hex, ".", "%0%0")
            end
            if #Hex == 6 and not string.find(Hex, "%X") then
                return Color3.fromHex(Hex)
            end

            return nil
        end

        return function(Ui: Context, Parent: GuiObject, Props: ColorSliderProps, Owner: Owner): ColorSlider
            local Function: (Hue: number, Sat: number, Value: number, Opacity: number) -> () = Props.Function or function() end
            local Darker: Color3 = Parent.BackgroundColor3 == Theme.Main and Theme.Panel or Theme.Deep
            local Back: Color3 = Props.Darker and Darker or Parent.BackgroundColor3
            local Defaults: {number} = {Props.DefaultHue or 0.44, Props.DefaultSat or 1, Props.DefaultValue or 1, Props.DefaultOpacity or 1}
            local Rings: {ImageLabel} = {}
            local Extras: {TextButton} = {}
            local Fills: {Frame} = {}
            local Knobs: {Frame} = {}
            local Gradients: {UIGradient} = {}
            local Clicked: number = 0
            local Generation: number = 0
            local Quiet: boolean = true

                        end)

                        if Pressed ~= -1 then

                        end
                    end)

                            return
                        end

                        Handle:SetColor(Label.TextColor3)
                    end)
                    Mobile = Button
                    Ui:Save()
                end

                Tween(v.Object, Theme.Slide, {Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -Offset)})
            else
                v.Object.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -Offset)
            end
            Offset += 3
        end
    end

    local function Build(): Notice
        local Object: ImageLabel = Create.New("ImageLabel", {

            Title = Title,
            Back = Back,
            Text = Text,
            Progress = Progress
        }
    end

    local function Start(Notice: Notice, Title: string, Message: string, Duration: number, Type: string?): thread
        local Plain: string = string.gsub(Message, "<[^>]+>", "")
        local Line: number = Ui:Measure("A", 14, Theme.Font).Y
        local Bounds: Vector2 = Ui:Measure(Plain, 14, Theme.Font, 200)
        local Lines: number = math.max(math.round(Bounds.Y / Line), 1)
        local Accent: Color3 = Type == "alert" and Color3.fromRGB(250, 50, 56) or Type == "warning" and Color3.fromRGB(236, 129, 44) or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        local Heading: Vector2 = Ui:Measure((string.gsub(Title, "<[^>]+>", "")), 14, Theme.SemiBold)
        local Width: number = math.max(Bounds.X + 80, Heading.X + 66, 266)

        Notice.Height = 75 + (Lines - 1) * 16.8
        Notice.Icon.Image = Ui:Icon(`noti_{Type or "info"}`)
        Notice.Shadow.Image = Notice.Icon.Image
        Notice.Object.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(Width, Notice.Height)
        Notice.Text.LineHeight = 16.8 / Line
        Notice.Text.Text = Message
        Notice.Text.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, Lines * 16.8)
        Notice.Back.LineHeight = Notice.Text.LineHeight
        Notice.Back.Size = Notice.Text.Size
        Notice.Back.Text = Plain
        Notice.Title.Text = `<stroke joins='round' thickness='0.3' transparency='0.5'>{Title}</stroke>`
        Notice.Title.TextColor3 = Type == "alert" and Accent or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        Notice.Progress.BackgroundColor3 = Accent
        Notice.Progress.Size = UDim2.new(1, -13, 0, 1)
        Reflow()

        Tween(Notice.Object, Theme.Slide, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)})
        Tween(Notice.Progress, TweenInfo.new(Duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 1)})

        return task.delay(Duration, function()
            Tween(Notice.Object, Theme.Slide, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)})
            task.wait(0.2)
            local Index: number? = table.find(List, Notice)
            if Index then
                table.remove(List, Index)
            end
            if Notice.Reuse then
                Cache[Notice.Reuse] = nil
            end

            Notice.Object:Destroy()
            Reflow()
        end)
    end

    return function(Title: string, Text: string?, Duration: number?, Type: string?, Reuse: string?)
        if Ui.Dead or (Ui.Allow and not Ui.Allow.Enabled) then
            return
        end

        task.spawn(function()
            local Notice: Notice? = Reuse and Cache[Reuse] or nil
            if Notice and Notice.Object.Parent and table.find(List, Notice) then
                if Notice.Thread then
                    pcall(task.cancel, Notice.Thread)
                end
                Notice.Thread = Start(Notice, Title, Text or "", Duration or 4, Type)

                return
            end

            local Created: Notice = Build()
            Created.Reuse = Reuse
            table.insert(List, Created)
            if Reuse then
                Cache[Reuse] = Created
            end
            Created.Thread = Start(Created, Title, Text or "", Duration or 4, Type)
        end)
    end

    local function Mix(Offset: number): Color3
        local Wave: number = (math.sin((Phase - Offset) * math.pi * 2) + 1) / 2
        local First: Color3 = Color3.fromHSV(GradientColor1.Hue, GradientColor1.Sat, GradientColor1.Value)

        return First:Lerp(Color3.fromHSV(GradientColor2.Hue, GradientColor2.Sat, GradientColor2.Value), Wave)
    end

    Recolor = function()
        local Two: boolean = ColorMode.Value == "Two-color gradient"
        local Base: Color3 = Ui:Color()
        local Shift: Color3 = Gradient.Enabled and Ui:Rainbow((Ui.Accent.Hue - 0.075) % 1) or Base
        Shading.Color = Two and ColorSequence.new(Mix(0), Mix(0.1)) or ColorSequence.new(Base, Shift)
        BadgeShading.Color = Gradient.Enabled and GradientV4.Enabled and Shading.Color or ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
        Custom.TextColor3 = CustomTextColor.Enabled and Color3.fromHSV(CustomTextColorSlider.Hue, CustomTextColorSlider.Sat, CustomTextColorSlider.Value) or Shading.Color.Keypoints[2].Value

        local Chosen: Color3? = ColorMode.Value == "Custom color" and Color3.fromHSV(ColorSlider.Hue, ColorSlider.Sat, ColorSlider.Value) or nil
        for Index: number, v: Label in Labels do
            local Rainbow: Color3? = Ui.Accent.Rainbow and Ui:Color((Gradient.Enabled and Index + 2 or Index) * 0.025) or nil
            v.Text.TextColor3 = Chosen or (Two and Mix(Index * 0.04)) or Rainbow or Shading.Color.Keypoints[2].Value
            if v.Color then
                local Strip: Frame = v.Color.Parent :: Frame
                v.Color.ImageColor3 = v.Text.TextColor3
                Strip.BackgroundColor3 = v.Text.TextColor3
            end
            if BackgroundTint.Enabled and v.Background then
                local Hue: number, Sat: number, Value: number = v.Text.TextColor3:ToHSV()
                v.Background.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(Hue, Sat, math.clamp(Value - 0.75, 0, 1))
            end
        end
    end

    Arrange = function()
        if not (Overlay.Button and Overlay.Button.Enabled) then
            Paint()
            return
        end

        local Right: boolean = Overlay.Children.AbsolutePosition.X > Ui.Gui.AbsoluteSize.X / 2
        Logo.Visible = Watermark.Enabled
        local Smooth: TweenInfo? = Animations.Enabled and Info or nil
        local Width: number = 220 / Scale.Scale

        Custom.Visible = Custom.Text ~= "" and CustomText.Enabled
        CustomShadow.Visible = Custom.Visible and Shadow.Enabled
        if Custom.Visible then
            local Size: Vector2 = Ui:Measure(Custom.ContentText, Custom.TextSize, Custom.FontFace)
            Custom.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(Size.X, Size.Y)
            local Spot: UDim2 = UDim2.new(Right and 1 / Scale.Scale or 0, Right and -Size.X or 0, 0, Logo.Visible and 36 or 8)
            Ui:Tween(Custom, {Position = Spot}, Smooth)
        end

        Holder.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1 / Scale.Scale, 1)
        Ui:Tween(Holder, {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(Right and 3 or 0, Top + (Background.Enabled and 3 or 0))}, Smooth)

        local Face: Font = FontOption.Value
        local Current: string = `{Background.Enabled}|{BackgroundTransparency.Value}|{Shadow.Enabled}|{Right}|{Face.Family}|{Face.Weight.Name}|{Face.Style.Name}`
        local Moved: {[string]: {Left: number, Top: number, Width: number}} = {}
        if Current ~= Style then
            for Name: string, v: Row in Rows do
                local Spot: UDim2 = v.Object.Position
                local Wide: number = v.Object.Size.X.Offset
                Moved[Name] = {
                    Left = Spot.X.Offset - (v.Object.AnchorPoint.X == 1 and Wide or 0),
                    Top = Spot.Y.Offset,
                    Width = Wide
                }
                v.Object:Destroy()
            end
            table.clear(Rows)
            Style = Current
        end

        local Previous: {string} = {}
        for _, v: Label in Labels do
            if v.Enabled then
                table.insert(Previous, v.Object.Name)
            end
        end
        table.clear(Labels)

        local Shown: {[string]: boolean} = {}
        for Name: string, Module: Module in Ui.Modules do
            if HideModules.Enabled and table.find(HideModulesList.ListEnabled, Name) then
                continue
            end
            if HideRender.Enabled and Module.Category.Name == "Render" then
                continue
            end
            if not Module.Enabled and not table.find(Previous, Name) then
                continue
            end

            Shown[Name] = true
            local Entry: Row = Rows[Name] or Build(Name, Right)
            Rows[Name] = Entry
            local Before = Moved[Name]
            if Before then
                Entry.Object.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(Right and Before.Left + Before.Width or Before.Left, Before.Top)
                Entry.Placed = true
            end

            local Extra: string = Module.ExtraText and ` {Module.ExtraText()}` or ""
            if Entry.Text.Text ~= Name or Entry.Extra.Text ~= Extra then
                local First: Vector2 = Ui:Measure(Name, Entry.Text.TextSize, Entry.Text.FontFace)
                local Second: Vector2 = Extra ~= "" and Ui:Measure(Extra, Entry.Extra.TextSize, Entry.Extra.FontFace) or Vector2.zero
                local Left: number = Entry.Text.Position.X.Offset + First.X * Entry.Grow

                Entry.Text.Text, Entry.Extra.Text = Name, Extra
                Entry.Text.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(First.X, First.Y)
                Entry.Extra.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(Second.X, First.Y)
                Entry.Extra.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(Left, Entry.Text.Position.Y.Offset)
                Entry.Width = (First.X + Second.X) * Entry.Grow
                if Entry.Shadow and Entry.Dim then
                    Entry.Shadow.Text, Entry.Dim.Text = Name, Extra
                    Entry.Shadow.Size, Entry.Dim.Size = Entry.Text.Size, Entry.Extra.Size
                    Entry.Shadow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(Entry.Text.Position.X.Offset + 1, Entry.Text.Position.Y.Offset + 1)
                    Entry.Dim.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(Left + 1, Entry.Text.Position.Y.Offset + 1)
                end
            end

            local Target: UDim2 = UDim2.fromOffset(Entry.Width + 16, Entry.Text.Size.Y.Offset * Entry.Grow + 6)
            if not Animations.Enabled then
                Entry.Object.Size = Module.Enabled and Target or UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
            elseif not table.find(Previous, Name) then
                Ui:Tween(Entry.Object, {Size = Target}, Info)
            else
                Entry.Object.Size = Target
            end

            table.insert(Labels, {
                Background = Entry.Background,
                Color = Entry.Color,
                Enabled = Module.Enabled,
                Object = Entry.Object,
                Text = Entry.Text,
                Width = Entry.Width,
                Size = Module.Enabled and Target or UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
            })
        end

        for Name: string, v: Row in Rows do
            if not Shown[Name] then
                v.Object:Destroy()
                Rows[Name] = nil
            end
        end

        if Sort.Value == "Alphabetical" then
            table.sort(Labels, function(a: Label, b: Label): boolean
                return a.Text.Text < b.Text.Text
            end)
        else
            table.sort(Labels, function(a: Label, b: Label): boolean
                return a.Width > b.Width
            end)
        end

        local Offset: number = 0
        for Index: number, v: Label in Labels do
            local Spot: UDim2 = UDim2.fromOffset(Right and Width or 0, Offset)
            local Entry: Row = Rows[v.Object.Name]
            if Entry.Placed and Animations.Enabled then
                Ui:Tween(v.Object, {Position = Spot, Size = v.Size}, Info)
            else
                v.Object.Position = Spot
                Entry.Placed = true
            end
            Offset += v.Size.Y.Offset

            if v.Color and v.Background then
                local Fill: Frame = v.Background
                local Corner: UICorner = Fill:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner") :: UICorner
                local Upper: number = (not Labels[Index - 1] or Labels[Index - 1].Size.X.Offset < v.Size.X.Offset) and 4 or 0
                local Lower: number = (not Labels[Index + 1] or Labels[Index + 1].Size.X.Offset < v.Size.X.Offset) and 4 or 0
                local CapTop: number = Index == 1 and 0 or 4
                local CapBottom: number = Index == #Labels and 0 or 4
                local Line: Frame = Fill:FindFirstChild("Line") :: Frame

                Line.Visible = Index ~= 1
                v.Color.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(Right and -4 or 0, -CapTop)
                v.Color.Size = UDim2.new(0, 8, 1, CapTop + CapBottom)
                local Shape: any = Corner
                Shape.TopLeftRadius = UDim.new(0, Upper)
                Shape.TopRightRadius = UDim.new(0, Upper)
                Shape.BottomLeftRadius = UDim.new(0, Lower)
                Shape.BottomRightRadius = UDim.new(0, Lower)
            end
        end

        Paint()
    end

    local Side: boolean = Overlay.Children.AbsolutePosition.X > Ui.Gui.AbsoluteSize.X / 2
    Ui:Connect(Overlay.Children:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsolutePosition"), function()
        local Right: boolean = Overlay.Children.AbsolutePosition.X > Ui.Gui.AbsoluteSize.X / 2
        if Side ~= Right then
            Side = Right
            Update()
        end
    end)
    table.insert(Ui.Huds, function()
        Paint()
    end)
    Cat:Clean(task.spawn(function()
        repeat
            local Delta: number = task.wait(Ui.Rate and 1 / Ui.Rate.Value or 0.1)
            if Overlay.Button and Overlay.Button.Enabled and ColorMode.Value == "Two-color gradient" then
                Phase = (Phase + Delta * 0.2 * (Ui.Speed and Ui.Speed.Value or 1)) % 1
                Paint()
            end
        until Ui.Dead
    end))

    Ui.Listing = Update
    Ready = true
    Sync()

    return Overlay
end]], "=ui/dropdown/huds/TextGUI"))(BundledModules)

        if shared.BundleFrame and os.clock() - shared.BundleFrame > (os.clock() - shared.BundleStart > 0.6 and 0.016 or 0.006) and coroutine.isyieldable() then

        end

        BundledModules.Glass = assert(loadstring([[
local BundledModules = ...
local Services = BundledModules.Services
local Create = BundledModules.Create

local function Rendered(Object: Instance?): boolean
    while Object do
        if Object:IsA("LayerCollector") then
            return Object.Enabled
        end
        if Object:IsA("GuiObject") and not Object.Visible then
            return false
        end

        Object = Object.Parent
    end

    return false
end

local function Refresh(Ui: Context)
    if Ui.Frost and not Ui.Frost.Enabled then
        if Ui.Frosted then
            Ui.Frosted = false
            for _, v: Sheet in Ui.Glass do
                v.Part.Parent = nil
            end
        end

        return
    end

    Ui.Frosted = true
    local Camera: Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local Offset: number = Camera.ViewportSize.Y * 48 / 2560 + 8
    local Frame: CFrame = Camera.CFrame
    for _, v: Sheet in Ui.Glass do
        if v.Frame.BackgroundTransparency >= 1 or not Rendered(v.Frame) then
            v.Part.Parent = nil
            continue
        end

        local Size: Vector2 = v.Frame.AbsoluteSize - Vector2.new(Offset, Offset)
        local Corner: Vector2 = v.Frame.AbsolutePosition + Vector2.new(Offset / 2, Offset / 2)
        if Size.X <= 0 or Size.Y <= 0 then
            v.Part.Parent = nil
            continue
        end

        local First: Ray = Camera:ScreenPointToRay(Corner.X, Corner.Y)
        local Last: Ray = Camera:ScreenPointToRay(Corner.X + Size.X, Corner.Y + Size.Y)
        local TopLeft: Vector3 = First.Origin + First.Direction * 0.001
        local BottomRight: Vector3 = Last.Origin + Last.Direction * 0.001
        local Delta: Vector3 = BottomRight - TopLeft

        if v.Part.Parent ~= Camera then
            v.Part.Parent = Camera
        end
        v.Part.CFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix((TopLeft + BottomRight) / 2, Frame.XVector, Frame.YVector, Frame.ZVector)
        v.Mesh.Scale = Vector3.new(Delta:Dot(Frame.XVector), -Delta:Dot(Frame.YVector), 0)
    end
end

return function(Ui: Context, Frame: GuiObject): Part?
    if Services.UserInputService.TouchEnabled then
        return
    end

    local Part: Part = Create.New("Part", {
        Anchored = true,
        CanCollide = false,
        CanQuery = false,
        CanTouch = false,
        CastShadow = false,
        Color = Color3.new(),
        Locked = true,
        Material = Enum.Material.Glass,
        Name = Services.HttpService:GenerateGUID(false),
        Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 0),
        Transparency = 0.98
    })

    local Mesh: SpecialMesh = Create.New("SpecialMesh", {
        MeshType = Enum.MeshType.Brick,
        Offset = Vector3.new(0, 0, -0.000001),

local BundledModules = ...
local Services = BundledModules.Services
local getcustomasset: (string) -> string = BundledModules.getcustomasset
local isfile: (string) -> boolean = BundledModules.isfile
local readfile: (string) -> string = BundledModules.readfile

local Fonts: {[string]: FontData | false} = {}
local Indexes: {[string]: {[string]: {any}} | false} = {}

local Font = {}

local function Validate(Data: any): string?
    if type(Data) ~= "table" then
        return "metrics missing or not valid JSON"
    end

    local Names: any = Data.pages or {Data.atlas}
    local Count: number = if type(Names) == "table" then #Names else 0
    local Bad: number = 0
    for _, v: any in (if type(Data.glyphs) == "table" then Data.glyphs else {}) do
        local Valid: boolean = type(v) == "table" and type(v.advance) == "number" and type(v.cells) == "table" and #v.cells == 64
        for _, Cell: any in (if Valid then v.cells else {}) do
            Valid = Valid and type(Cell) == "table" and (#Cell == 6 or #Cell == 7) and type(Cell[7] or 1) == "number"
            Valid = Valid and (Cell[7] or 1) >= 1 and (Cell[7] or 1) <= Count
        end
        Bad += if Valid then 0 else 1
    end

    local Size: any = Data.atlasSize
    return if Data.version ~= 1 then "unsupported version"
        elseif type(Data.glyphs) ~= "table" or type(Data.lineHeight) ~= "number" or type(Data.size) ~= "number" or type(Data.scale) ~= "number" or type(Data.atlas) ~= "string" then "missing fields"
        elseif type(Size) ~= "table" or type(Size[1]) ~= "number" or type(Size[2]) ~= "number" or Size[1] > 1024 or Size[2] > 1024 then "atlas missing or larger than 1024"
        elseif Count < 1 then "no atlas pages"
        elseif Bad > 0 then "malformed glyph cells"
        elseif type(Data.fallback) ~= "number" or Data.glyphs[tostring(Data.fallback)] == nil then "no fallback glyph"
        elseif Data.glyphs["32"] == nil then "no space glyph"
        else nil
end

local function Pages(Folder: string, Names: {string}): ({string}?, string?)
    local Assets: {string} = {}
    for _, Name: string in Names do
        local Path: string = `{Folder}/text/{Name}`
        local Header: boolean, Width: number, Height: number, Whole: boolean = pcall(function(): (number, number, boolean)
            local Content: string = readfile(Path)
            local PageWidth: number, PageHeight: number = string.unpack(">I4I4", Content, 17)

            return PageWidth, PageHeight, string.sub(Content, -8) == "IEND\xAE\x42\x60\x82"
        end)
        local Loaded: boolean, Asset: string = pcall(getcustomasset, Path)
        if not Header or Width > 1024 or Height > 1024 then
            return nil, `page {Name} unreadable or larger than 1024`
        end
        if not Whole then
            return nil, `page {Name} is cut off (no PNG end chunk)`
        end
        if not Loaded or Asset == "" then
            return nil, `page {Name} unavailable`
        end
        table.insert(Assets, Asset)
    end

    return Assets, nil
end

local function Build(Folder: string, Entry: string, ScaleKey: string): (FontData?, string?)
    local Success: boolean, Data: any = pcall(function(): any
        return Services.HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(`{Folder}/text/{Entry}@{ScaleKey}.json`))
    end)
    local Reason: string? = Validate(if Success then Data else nil)
    if Reason then
        return nil, Reason
    end

    local Assets: {string}?, PageReason: string? = Pages(Folder, Data.pages or {Data.atlas})
    if not Assets then
        return nil, PageReason
    end

    local Glyphs: {[number]: Glyph} = {}
    for Code: string, v: any in Data.glyphs do
        Glyphs[tonumber(Code) :: number] = {Advance = v.advance, Cells = v.cells}
    end

    local Kern: {[number]: number} = {}
    for Pair: string, Value: number in (Data.kern or {}) do
        local First: string?, Second: string? = string.match(Pair, "^(%d+),(%d+)$")
        Kern[(tonumber(First) :: number) * 1114112 + (tonumber(Second) :: number)] = Value
    end

    return {
        Entry = Entry,
        ScaleKey = ScaleKey,
        Size = Data.size,
        Scale = Data.scale,
        LineHeight = Data.lineHeight,
        Pages = Assets,
        AtlasSize = Vector2.new(Data.atlasSize[1], Data.atlasSize[2]),
        Fallback = Data.fallback,
        Glyphs = Glyphs,
        Kern = Kern
    }, nil
end

function Font.Load(Folder: string, Entry: string, ScaleKey: string): FontData?
    local Key: string = `{Folder}/{Entry}@{ScaleKey}`
    if Fonts[Key] == nil then
        local Success: boolean, Result: any, Reason: string? = pcall(Build, Folder, Entry, ScaleKey)
        Fonts[Key] = Success and Result or false
        if not Fonts[Key] then
            warn(`[text] {Entry}@{ScaleKey}: {if Success then Reason else "malformed metrics"}, using native text`)
        end
    end

    return Fonts[Key] or nil
end

function Font.Labels(Folder: string): {[string]: {any}}?
    if Indexes[Folder] == nil then
        Indexes[Folder] = false
        for _, Path: string in {`{Folder}/text/labels/labels.json`, `{Folder}/text/labels.json`} do
            local Present: boolean = isfile(Path)
            local Success: boolean, Result: any = pcall(function(): any
                return Services.HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(Path))
            end)
            if Present and not Success then
                warn(`[text] {Path}: not valid JSON, baked labels off`)
            end
            Indexes[Folder] = Indexes[Folder] or (Success and type(Result) == "table" and Result) or false
        end
    end

    return Indexes[Folder] or nil
end

local BundledModules = ...
local Layout = {}

local function Decode(Font: FontData, Text: string, Wrap: boolean): {{number}}
    local Codes: {number} = {}
    pcall(function(): ()
        local Position: number = 1
        repeat
            local Length: number?, Bad: number? = utf8.len(Text, Position)
            local Stop: number = if Length then #Text else (Bad :: number) - 1
            for _, Code: number in utf8.codes(string.sub(Text, Position, Stop)) do
                table.insert(Codes, Code)
            end
            if Bad then
                table.insert(Codes, Font.Fallback)
            end
            Position = if Bad then Bad + 1 else #Text + 1
        until Position > #Text
    end)

    local Lines: {{number}} = {{}}
    for _, Code: number in Codes do
        if Code == 10 and Wrap then
            table.insert(Lines, {})
        elseif Code == 9 then
            for _ = 1, 4 do
                table.insert(Lines[#Lines], 32)
            end
        elseif Code ~= 13 and (Code >= 32 or Code == 10) then
            table.insert(Lines[#Lines], if Code == 10 then 32 elseif Font.Glyphs[Code] then Code else Font.Fallback)
        end
    end

    return Lines
end

local function Pens(Font: FontData, Line: {number}): ({number}, number)
    local Units: {number} = {}
    local Pen: number = 0
    for Index: number, Code: number in Line do
        Pen += if Index > 1 then Font.Kern[Line[Index - 1] * 1114112 + Code] or 0 else 0
        Units[Index] = Pen
        Pen += Font.Glyphs[Code].Advance
    end

    return Units, Pen
end

function Layout.Offset(Align: Enum.TextXAlignment, Width: number, Content: number): number
    local Offset: number = 0
    if Align == Enum.TextXAlignment.Center then
        Offset = (Width - Content) / 2
    elseif Align == Enum.TextXAlignment.Right then
        Offset = Width - Content
    end

    return math.floor(Offset)
end

function Layout.Measure(Font: FontData, Text: string): number
    local _, End: number = Pens(Font, Decode(Font, Text, false)[1])

    return math.ceil(End * Font.Scale * Font.Size / 1024)
end

function Layout.Place(Font: FontData, Text: string, Width: number, Align: Enum.TextXAlignment, Truncate: boolean, Wrap: boolean?): {Placement}
    local Result: {Placement} = {}
    local K: number = Font.Scale * Font.Size / 1024
    local Ellipsis: number = if Font.Glyphs[8230] then 8230 else Font.Fallback
    for Row: number, Source: {number} in Decode(Font, Text, Wrap or false) do
        local Line: {number} = Source
        local Units: {number}, End: number = Pens(Font, Line)
        if Truncate and Width > 0 and math.ceil(End * K) > Width then
            local Keep: number = 0
            for Count: number = #Line, 1, -1 do
                local Last: number = Line[Count]
                local Gap: number = Font.Kern[Last * 1114112 + Ellipsis] or 0
                local Used: number = Units[Count] + Font.Glyphs[Last].Advance + Gap + Font.Glyphs[Ellipsis].Advance
                if math.ceil(Used * K) <= Width then
                    Keep = Count
                    break
                end
            end

            Line = table.move(Line, 1, Keep, 1, {})
            table.insert(Line, Ellipsis)
            Units, End = Pens(Font, Line)
        end

        local Start: number = Layout.Offset(Align, Width, math.ceil(End * K))
        for Index: number, Code: number in Line do
            local Pen: number = Units[Index] * K
            local Whole: number = math.floor(Pen)
            local Phase: number = math.floor((Pen - Whole) * 64 + 0.5)
            local Cell: {number} = Font.Glyphs[Code].Cells[Phase % 64 + 1]
            if Cell[3] > 0 then
                table.insert(Result, {
                    Code = Code,
                    X = Start + Whole + Phase // 64 + Cell[5],
                    Y = (Row - 1) * Font.LineHeight + Cell[6],
                    Cell = Cell
                })
            end
        end
    end

    return Result
end

function Layout.Test(): boolean
    local Glyphs: {[number]: Glyph} = {}
    for _, Code: number in {32, 63, 65, 86, 8230} do
        local Cells: {{number}} = {}
        for Phase: number = 0, 63 do
            table.insert(Cells, if Code == 32 then {0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0} else {Phase, 0, 1, 1, 0, 0})
        end
        Glyphs[Code] = {Advance = 1024, Cells = Cells}
    end

    local Test: FontData = {
        Entry = "test",
        ScaleKey = "x100",
        Size = 16,
        Scale = 1,
        LineHeight = 20,
        Pages = {""},
        AtlasSize = Vector2.new(1, 1),
        Fallback = 63,
        Glyphs = Glyphs,
        Kern = {[65 * 1114112 + 86] = -100}
    }
    local Left: Enum.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

    local Pair: {Placement} = Layout.Place(Test, "AV", 0, Left, false)
    assert(#Pair == 2 and Pair[2].X == 14 and Pair[2].Cell[1] == 28, "AV kern applied")
    assert(Layout.Measure(Test, "AV") == 31, "AV measure")

    local Cut: {Placement} = Layout.Place(Test, "AAAAAAAA", 50, Left, true)
    assert(#Cut == 3 and Cut[3].Code == 8230, "truncation yields ellipsis")
    assert(#Layout.Place(Test, "AAAAAAAA", 0, Left, true) == 8, "no truncation without width")

    assert(#Layout.Place(Test, " \t\n ", 100, Left, false) == 0, "whitespace gives no placements")

    local Bad: {Placement} = Layout.Place(Test, "A\xFFA", 0, Left, false)
    assert(#Bad == 3 and Bad[2].Code == 63, "invalid UTF-8 maps to fallback")
    assert(Layout.Place(Test, "Z", 0, Left, false)[1].Code == 63, "missing glyph maps to fallback")

    assert(Layout.Place(Test, "A", 100, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, false)[1].X == 42, "centered start is whole")
    assert(Layout.Place(Test, "A\nA", 0, Left, false, true)[2].Y == 20, "newline wraps")
    assert(Layout.Place(Test, "A\nA", 0, Left, false, false)[2].X == 32, "newline is a space without wrap")

    return true
end

local BundledModules = ...
local Theme = BundledModules.Theme2
local Host = BundledModules.Host

local getcustomasset: (string) -> string = BundledModules.getcustomasset

local Context = {}
