local function Snapshot(Root: GuiObject): {[Instance]: {[string]: number}}
    local Saved: {[Instance]: {[string]: number}} = {}
    local Stack: {Instance} = {Root}
    while #Stack > 0 do
        local Object: any = table.remove(Stack)
        local Properties: {string} = if Object:IsA("UIStroke") or Object:IsA("UIShadow") then {"Transparency"} elseif Object:IsA("TextLabel") or Object:IsA("TextButton") or Object:IsA("TextBox") then {"TextTransparency", "BackgroundTransparency"} elseif Object:IsA("ImageLabel") or Object:IsA("ImageButton") or Object:IsA("ViewportFrame") then {"ImageTransparency", "BackgroundTransparency"} elseif Object:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then {"ScrollBarImageTransparency", "BackgroundTransparency"} elseif Object:IsA("GuiObject") then {"BackgroundTransparency"} else {}
        if #Properties > 0 then
            local Values: {[string]: number} = {}
            for _, v: string in Properties do
                Values[v] = Object[v]
            end
            Saved[Object] = Values
        end
        if Object == Root or not Object:IsA("GuiObject") or Object.Visible then
            for _, v: Instance in Object:GetChildren() do
                table.insert(Stack, v)
            end
        end
    end

    return Saved
end

function Context.new(): Context

function Context.Connect(self: Context, Signal: RBXScriptSignal, Callback: (...any) -> ()): RBXScriptConnection

function Context.Icon(self: Context, Name: string, Size: number?): string
    local Index: string = Size and `{Name}-{Size}` or Name
    if not self.Icons[Index] then
        local Success: boolean, Result: any = pcall(getcustomasset, `{Theme.Folder}/{Index}.png`)
        self.Icons[Index] = Success and Result or ""
    end

    return self.Icons[Index]
end

function Context.Fit(self: Context, Icon: ImageLabel): ImageLabel
    local Base: UDim2 = Icon.Position
    local Slot: Vector2 = Vector2.new(Icon.Size.X.Offset, Icon.Size.Y.Offset)
    local Anchor: Vector2 = Icon.AnchorPoint
    local function Place(Origin: number, Span: number, Want: number, Pin: number, Scale: number, Offset: number, Factor: number): (number, number)
        local Centre: number = Origin + Scale * Span + Offset * Factor + (0.5 - Pin) * Want
        local Best: number = math.huge
        local Length: number, Start: number = Want, 0
        for _, v: number in {math.max(1, math.floor(Want)), math.max(1, math.ceil(Want))} do
            local From: number = math.round(Centre - v / 2)
            local Miss: number = math.abs(From + v / 2 - Centre) + math.abs(v - Want) * 0.01
            if Miss < Best then
                Best, Length, Start = Miss, v, From
            end
        end

        return (Length - Want) / Span, (Start + Pin * Length - Origin - Offset * Factor) / Span
    end

    local function Snap()
        local Parent: Instance? = Icon.Parent
        if not Parent or not Parent:IsA("GuiBase2d") or Parent.AbsoluteSize.X == 0 or Parent.AbsoluteSize.Y == 0 then
            return
        end

        local Factor: number = 1
        local Node: Instance? = Parent
        while Node do
            local Zoom: UIScale? = Node:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
            Factor *= Zoom and Zoom.Scale or 1
            Node = Node.Parent
        end

        local WideSize: number, WidePos: number = Place(Parent.AbsolutePosition.X, Parent.AbsoluteSize.X, Slot.X * Factor, Anchor.X, Base.X.Scale, Base.X.Offset, Factor)
        local TallSize: number, TallPos: number = Place(Parent.AbsolutePosition.Y, Parent.AbsoluteSize.Y, Slot.Y * Factor, Anchor.Y, Base.Y.Scale, Base.Y.Offset, Factor)
        if math.abs(Icon.Size.X.Scale - WideSize) > 0.000001 or math.abs(Icon.Size.Y.Scale - TallSize) > 0.000001 then
            Icon.Size = UDim2.new(WideSize, Slot.X, TallSize, Slot.Y)
        end
        if math.abs(Icon.Position.X.Scale - WidePos) > 0.000001 or math.abs(Icon.Position.Y.Scale - TallPos) > 0.000001 then
            Icon.Position = UDim2.new(WidePos, Base.X.Offset, TallPos, Base.Y.Offset)
        end
    end

    self:Connect(Icon:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"), Snap)
    self:Connect(Icon:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsolutePosition"), Snap)
    self.Snaps[Snap] = true
    Icon.Destroying:Once(function()
        self.Snaps[Snap] = nil
    end)
    task.defer(Snap)

    return Icon
end

function Context.Measure(self: Context, Text: string, Size: number, Weight: Enum.FontWeight): number
    local Index: string = `{Text}|{Size}|{Weight.Name}`
    if not self.Widths[Index] then
        local Face: string = if Weight == Enum.FontWeight.Bold then "semibold" else string.lower(Weight.Name)
        local Data: FontData? = if Host.Native or Size % 1 ~= 0 then nil else Faces.Load(Host.Folder, `sf-{Face}-{Size}`, "x100")
        if Data then
            self.Widths[Index] = Layout.Measure(Data, Text)
        else
            local Params: GetTextBoundsParams = Instance.new("GetTextBoundsParams")
            Params.Text = Text
            Params.Size = Size
            Params.Font = Font.new(Theme.Font, Weight)
            local Success: boolean, Result: any = pcall(Services.TextService.GetTextBoundsAsync, Services.TextService, Params)
            self.Widths[Index] = Success and Result.X or #Text * Size * 0.55
        end
    end

    return self.Widths[Index]
end

function Context.To(self: Context, Object: Instance, Goal: {[string]: any}, Info: TweenInfo?): Tween?
    local Active: {[string]: Tween} = self.Active[Object] or {}
    self.Active[Object] = Active
    for Property: string in Goal do
        local Old: Tween? = Active[Property]
        if Old then
            Old:Cancel()
            Active[Property] = nil
        end
    end

    if not Info or not self.Animations or self.Quiet then
        local Target: any = Object
        for Property: string, Value: any in Goal do
            Target[Property] = Value
        end

        return nil
    end

    local New: Tween = Tween(Object, Info, Goal)
    for Property: string in Goal do
        Active[Property] = New
    end
    New.Completed:Once(function()
        for Property: string in Goal do
            if Active[Property] == New then
                Active[Property] = nil
            end
        end
    end)

    return New
end

function Context.Run(self: Context, From: number, To: number, Info: TweenInfo, Step: (number) -> (), Done: (() -> ())?): Tween?
    if not self.Animations or self.Quiet then
        Step(To)
        if Done then
            Done()
        end

        return nil
    end

    local Value: NumberValue = Instance.new("NumberValue")
    Value.Value = From
    local Connection: RBXScriptConnection = Value.Changed:Connect(Step)
    local New: Tween = Tween(Value, Info, {Value = To})
    self.Runs[New] = true
    New.Completed:Once(function(State: Enum.PlaybackState)
        Connection:Disconnect()
        Value:Destroy()
        self.Runs[New] = nil
        if State == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed then
            Step(To)
            if Done then
                Done()
            end
        end
    end)

    return New
end

function Context.Fade(self: Context, Root: GuiObject, Shown: boolean, Info: TweenInfo?, Done: (() -> ())?): Tween?
    local State: Fading? = self.Fades[Root]
    if State and State.Run then
        State.Run:Cancel()
    end
    if not State then
        if Root.Visible == Shown then
            if Done then
                Done()
            end

            return
        end

        State = {Alpha = Shown and 1 or 0, Saved = Snapshot(Root)}
        self.Fades[Root] = State
    end

    local Current: Fading = State :: Fading
    local function Step(Alpha: number)
        Current.Alpha = Alpha
        for Object: any, Values: {[string]: number} in Current.Saved do
            for Property: string, Base: number in Values do
                Object[Property] = 1 - (1 - Base) * (1 - Alpha)
            end
        end
    end
    local function Finish()
        if not Shown then
            Root.Visible = false
        end
        Step(0)
        self.Fades[Root] = nil
        if Done then
            Done()
        end
    end

    Step(Current.Alpha)
    Root.Visible = true
    if not Info then
        Finish()

        return
    end

    Current.Run = self:Run(Current.Alpha, Shown and 0 or 1, Info, Step, Finish)

    return Current.Run
end

function Context.Mouse(self: Context): Vector2
    local Mouse: Vector2 = Services.UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    local Camera: Camera? = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not self.Holder or not Camera then
        return Mouse
    end

    local Center: Vector2 = self.Holder.AbsolutePosition + self.Holder.AbsoluteSize / 2

    return Mouse + Center - Camera.ViewportSize / 2 - Vector2.new(self.Holder.Position.X.Offset, self.Holder.Position.Y.Offset)
end

function Context.Register(self: Context, Index: string, Get: () -> any, Set: (any) -> ())
    table.insert(self.Items, {Key = Index, Get = Get, Set = Set})
end

function Context.Export(self: Context): {[string]: any}
    local Data: {[string]: any} = {}
    for _, v: Item in self.Items do
        local Value: any = v.Get()
        if Value ~= nil then
            Data[v.Key] = Value
        end
    end

    return Data
end

function Context.Import(self: Context, Data: {[string]: any}, Quiet: boolean?)
    local Old: boolean? = self.Quiet
    self.Quiet = Quiet or Old
    for _, v: Item in self.Items do
        local Value: any = Data[v.Key]
        if Value ~= nil then
            pcall(v.Set, Value)
        end
    end
    self.Quiet = Old
end

function Context.Paint(self: Context, Painter: () -> ())
    table.insert(self.Painters, Painter)
    Painter()
end

local Tinted: {[string]: {string}} = {
    GuiObject = {"BackgroundColor3"},
    TextLabel = {"BackgroundColor3", "TextColor3"},
    TextButton = {"BackgroundColor3", "TextColor3"},
    TextBox = {"BackgroundColor3", "TextColor3", "PlaceholderColor3"},
    ImageLabel = {"BackgroundColor3", "ImageColor3"},
    ImageButton = {"BackgroundColor3", "ImageColor3"},
    ScrollingFrame = {"BackgroundColor3", "ScrollBarImageColor3"},
    UIStroke = {"Color"}
}

local function Hex(Color: Color3): number
    return math.round(Color.R * 255) * 65536 + math.round(Color.G * 255) * 256 + math.round(Color.B * 255)
end

function Context.SetTheme(self: Context, Name: string)
    local Palette: {[string]: Color3}? = Theme.Themes[Name]
    if not Palette or Name == self.Theme then
        return
    end

    local Map: {[number]: Color3} = {}
    local Fresh: {[number]: boolean} = {}
    for Index: string, Color: Color3 in Palette do
        Map[Hex((Theme :: any)[Index])] = Color
        Fresh[Hex(Color)] = true
        ;(Theme :: any)[Index] = Color
    end
    self.Theme = Name
    self.Shade += 1
    local Shade: number = self.Shade
    local function Pass(Skip: boolean)
        for _, Root: Instance in self.Roots do
            for _, Object: Instance in Root:GetDescendants() do
                local Properties: {string} = Tinted[Object.ClassName] or (Object:IsA("GuiObject") and Tinted.GuiObject or {})
                local Goal: {[string]: Color3} = {}
                for _, v: string in Properties do
                    local Index: number = Hex((Object :: any)[v])
                    if Map[Index] and not (Skip and Fresh[Index]) then
                        Goal[v] = Map[Index]
                    end
                end
                if next(Goal) then
                    self:To(Object, Goal, Theme.Smooth)
                end
            end
        end
        for _, v: () -> () in self.Painters do
            v()
        end
    end

    Pass(false)
    task.delay(0.4, function()
        if self.Shade == Shade then
            Pass(true)
        end
    end)
end

function Context.SetAccent(self: Context, Color: Color3, Instant: boolean?)
    if self.AccentRun then
        self.AccentRun:Cancel()
        self.AccentRun = nil
    end

    local From: Color3 = self.Accent
    local Light: {number} = {}
    for _, v: Color3 in {Color, Theme.Ink} do
        local Total: number = 0
        for Index: number, Channel: number in {v.R, v.G, v.B} do
            local Linear: number = if Channel <= 0.03928 then Channel / 12.92 else ((Channel + 0.055) / 1.055) ^ 2.4
            Total += Linear * ({0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722})[Index]
        end
        table.insert(Light, Total)
    end

    local InkContrast: number = (Light[1] + 0.05) / (Light[2] + 0.05)
    local WhiteContrast: number = 1.05 / (Light[1] + 0.05)

    Theme.OnAccent = if InkContrast >= WhiteContrast then Theme.Ink else Theme.OnDark
    self.Target = Color
    local function Apply(Value: Color3)
        self.Accent = Value
        for _, v: () -> () in self.Painters do
            v()
        end
    end

    if Instant or From == Color then
        Apply(Color)

        return
    end

    self.AccentRun = self:Run(0, 1, Theme.Smooth, function(Alpha: number)
        Apply(From:Lerp(Color, Alpha))
    end, function()
        Apply(Color)
    end)
end

function Context.SetRadius(self: Context, Percent: number)
    self.Rounding = math.clamp(Percent, Theme.Limits.Radius[1], Theme.Limits.Radius[2]) / 100
    for _, Root: Instance in self.Roots do
        for _, v: Instance in Root:GetDescendants() do
            local Base: any = v:IsA("UICorner") and v:GetAttribute("Radius")
            if type(Base) == "number" then
                (v :: UICorner).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, math.round(Base * self.Rounding))
            end
        end
    end
end

function Context.SetPanel(self: Context, Percent: number)
    self.Clear = math.clamp(Percent, Theme.Limits.Panel[1], Theme.Limits.Panel[2]) / 100
    if self.Panel and not self.Fades[self.Panel] then
        self.Panel.BackgroundTransparency = self.Clear
    end
end

function Context.SetScale(self: Context, Choice: number)
    self.Zoom = math.clamp(Choice, Theme.Limits.Scale[1], Theme.Limits.Scale[2])
    local Camera: Camera? = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local Edge: Vector2 = Vector2.one * Theme.Size.Margin * 2
    local Room: Vector2 = Camera and Camera.ViewportSize - Edge or Theme.Size.Window * self.Zoom
    local Fit: number = math.max(0.25, math.min(Room.X / Theme.Size.Window.X, Room.Y / Theme.Size.Window.Y))
    if self.Scale then
        self:To(self.Scale, {Scale = math.min(self.Zoom, Fit)}, Theme.Smooth)
    end
end

function Context.Dismiss(self: Context)
    local Close: (() -> ())? = self.Close
    self.Close = nil
    if self.Catcher then
        self.Catcher.Visible = false
    end
    if Close then
        Close()
    end
end

function Context.Destroy(self: Context)
    self:Dismiss()
    local Pending: {Tween} = {}
    if self.AccentRun then
        table.insert(Pending, self.AccentRun)
    end
    for v: Tween in self.Runs do
        table.insert(Pending, v)
    end
    for _, Properties: {[string]: Tween} in self.Active do
        for _, v: Tween in Properties do
            table.insert(Pending, v)
        end
    end
    for _, v: Tween in Pending do
        v:Cancel()
    end

    for _, v: RBXScriptConnection in self.Connections do
        if v.Connected then
            v:Disconnect()
        end
    end

    table.clear(self.Connections)
    table.clear(self.Painters)
    table.clear(self.Icons)
    table.clear(self.Snaps)
    table.clear(self.Strips)
    table.clear(self.Widths)
    table.clear(self.Cards)
    table.clear(self.Items)

    if self.Hud then
        self.Hud.Destroy()
        self.Hud = nil
    end
    if self.Gui then
        self.Gui:Destroy()
        self.Gui = nil
    end

    Host.Root:Destroy()
end

local function Sha1(Message: string): string
    local Length: number = #Message
    local Zeros: string = string.rep("\0", (55 - Length) % 64)
    local Padded: string = `{Message}\128{Zeros}{string.pack(">I8", Length * 8)}`
    local Hash: {number} = {0x67452301, 0xefcdab89, 0x98badcfe, 0x10325476, 0xc3d2e1f0}
    local Words: {number} = table.create(80, 0)
    for Chunk: number = 1, #Padded, 64 do
        for Index: number = 1, 16 do
            Words[Index] = string.unpack(">I4", Padded, Chunk + (Index - 1) * 4)
        end
        for Index: number = 17, 80 do
            Words[Index] = bit32.lrotate(bit32.bxor(Words[Index - 3], Words[Index - 8], Words[Index - 14], Words[Index - 16]), 1)
        end

        local A: number, B: number, C: number, D: number, E: number = table.unpack(Hash)
        for Index: number = 1, 80 do
            local Mix: number, Round: number
            if Index <= 20 then
                Mix, Round = bit32.bor(bit32.band(B, C), bit32.band(bit32.bnot(B), D)), 0x5a827999
            elseif Index <= 40 then

            elseif Index <= 60 then

                Mix, Round = bit32.bxor(B, C, D), 0xca62c1d6
            end
            local Next: number = bit32.band(bit32.lrotate(A, 5) + Mix + E + Round + Words[Index], 0xffffffff)
            A, B, C, D, E = Next, A, bit32.lrotate(B, 30), C, D
        end
        for Index: number, v: number in {A, B, C, D, E} do
            Hash[Index] = bit32.band(Hash[Index] + v, 0xffffffff)
        end
    end

    return string.pack(">I4I4I4I4I4", table.unpack(Hash))
end

local function Hmac(Key: string, Message: string): string
    local Block: string = #Key > 64 and Sha1(Key) or Key
    Block ..= string.rep("\0", 64 - #Block)
    local Inner: string = string.gsub(Block, ".", function(Character: string): string
        return string.char(bit32.bxor(string.byte(Character), 0x36))
    end)
    local Outer: string = string.gsub(Block, ".", function(Character: string): string
        return string.char(bit32.bxor(string.byte(Character), 0x5c))
    end)

    return Sha1(`{Outer}{Sha1(`{Inner}{Message}`)}`)
end

    Sha1 = Sha1,
    Hmac = Hmac,
    Totp = function(Key: string, Counter: number): string
        local Digest: string = Hmac(Key, string.pack(">I8", Counter))
        local Offset: number = bit32.band(string.byte(Digest, 20), 0x0f) + 1
        local Code: number = bit32.band(string.unpack(">I4", Digest, Offset), 0x7fffffff)

        return string.format("%06d", Code % 1000000)
    end,
    Decode = function(Data: string): string
        local Clean: string = string.gsub(Data, "[^%w%+/]", "")
        local Bytes: {string} = {}
        for Index: number = 1, #Clean, 4 do
            local Joined: number = 0
            local Count: number = 0
            for Slot: number = Index, math.min(Index + 3, #Clean) do
                Joined = Joined * 64 + (string.find(Alphabet, string.sub(Clean, Slot, Slot), 1, true) :: number) - 1
                Count += 1
            end
            Joined *= 64 ^ (4 - Count)
            for Slot: number = 1, Count - 1 do
                table.insert(Bytes, string.char(bit32.extract(Joined, 24 - Slot * 8, 8)))
            end
        end

        return table.concat(Bytes)
    end

    local Success: boolean, Response: any = pcall(request, Options)

local function Parse(Raw: string): {Line}
    local Lines: {Line} = {}
    for Row: string in string.gmatch(Raw, "[^\n]+") do
        local Minutes: string?, Seconds: string?, Words: string? = string.match(Row, "^%[(%d+):(%d+%.?%d*)%]%s*(.-)%s*$")
        if Minutes and Seconds and Words and Words ~= "" then
            table.insert(Lines, {Time = (tonumber(Minutes) :: number) * 60000 + (tonumber(Seconds) :: number) * 1000, Text = Words})
        end
    end

    return Lines
end

local function Lrclib(Track: Track): {Line}?
    local Headers: {[string]: string} = {["User-Agent"] = "catvape-hud"}
    local Query: string = Form({track_name = Track.Name, artist_name = Track.Artist, album_name = Track.Album, duration = tostring(math.round(Track.Duration / 1000))})
    local Data: any = Decode(Fetch({Url = `https://lrclib.net/api/get?{Query}`, Method = "GET", Headers = Headers}).Body)
    if not (type(Data) == "table" and Data.syncedLyrics) then
        local Search: string = Form({track_name = Track.Name, artist_name = Track.Artist})
        local Results: any = Decode(Fetch({Url = `https://lrclib.net/api/search?{Search}`, Method = "GET", Headers = Headers}).Body)
        Data = nil
        for _, v: any in type(Results) == "table" and Results or {} do
            if type(v) == "table" and v.syncedLyrics then
                Data = v
                break
            end
        end
    end
    local Lines: {Line}? = Data and Parse(Data.syncedLyrics) or nil

    return Lines and #Lines > 0 and Lines or nil
end

local function Cover(Image: string?): string?
    local Id: string? = Image and string.match(Image, "([%w]+)$")
    if not Id then
        return nil
    end

    local Path: string = `{Covers}/{Id}.jpg`
    if not isfile(Path) then
        if not isfolder(Covers) then
            makefolder(Covers)
        end
        local Response: {[string]: any} = Fetch({Url = `https://i.scdn.co/image/{Id}`, Method = "GET"})
        if Response.StatusCode ~= 200 then
            return nil
        end
        writefile(Path, Response.Body)
    end
    local Success: boolean, Asset: any = pcall(getcustomasset, Path)

    return Success and Asset or nil
end

    local Spotify: any

    local function Login(): (boolean, string?)
        local Headers: {[string]: string} = Base()
        Headers.Cookie = `sp_dc={Saved.Cookie};`
        local Response: {[string]: any} = Fetch({Url = "https://open.spotify.com", Method = "GET", Headers = Headers})
        local Stamp: string? = Response.Headers and (Response.Headers.Date or Response.Headers.date)

            Spotify.Skew = Server.UnixTimestampMillis + 500 - DateTime.now().UnixTimestampMillis
        end
        if Response.StatusCode == 401 or Response.StatusCode == 403 then
            return false, "Cookie is invalid or expired, copy sp_dc again"
        end

        local Page: string = Response.Body or ""
        local Script: string? = string.match(Page, "(https://[^\"']+/web%-player%.[0-9a-f]+%.js)")

            return false, "Couldn't read the Spotify web player"
        end

            return false, "Spotify changed its login, tell the dev"

            return false, "Spotify refused the login"
        end
        if Auth.isAnonymous then
            return false, "Cookie is invalid or expired, copy sp_dc again"
        end

            Method = "POST",
            Headers = {Accept = "application/json", ["Content-Type"] = "application/json", ["User-Agent"] = Agent},
            Body = Http:JSONEncode({
                client_data = {
                    client_id = Auth.clientId,
                    client_version = Config.clientVersion,
                    js_sdk_data = {device_brand = "unknown", device_id = Config.correlationId, device_model = "unknown", device_type = "computer", os = "windows", os_version = "NT 10.0"}
                }
            })
        }).Body)
        local Hosts: any = Decode(Fetch({Url = "https://apresolve.spotify.com/?type=dealer-g2&type=spclient", Method = "GET", Headers = Base()}).Body)
        local Dealer: string? = Hosts and Hosts["dealer-g2"] and Hosts["dealer-g2"][1]
        local Client: string? = Hosts and Hosts.spclient and Hosts.spclient[1]
        if not (Granted and Granted.granted_token and Dealer and Client) then
            return false, "Couldn't reach Spotify's servers"
        end

        local Lookup: number? = string.find(Code, "fetchEntitiesForRecentlyPlayed\",\"query\",", 1, true)
        local Ending: number? = Lookup and string.find(Code, "\",null", Lookup, true)
        Session = {
            Token = Auth.accessToken,
            Expires = (tonumber(Auth.accessTokenExpirationTimestampMs) or 0) / 1000,
            Client = Granted.granted_token.token,
            Correlation = Config.correlationId,
            Dealer = string.match(Dealer, "^[^:]+"),
            Host = string.match(Client, "^[^:]+"),
            Query = Lookup and Ending and string.sub(Code, Lookup + 41, Ending - 1) or nil,
            Device = (string.gsub(string.rep(".", 40), ".", function(): string
                return string.format("%x", math.random(0, 15))
            end))
        }

        return true, nil
    end

    local function Describe(Uri: string, Metadata: any): {Name: string, Artist: string}
        if Names[Uri] then
            return Names[Uri]
        end

        local Entry: {Name: string, Artist: string} = {Name = Metadata.title or "Unknown", Artist = ""}
        Names[Uri] = Entry
        if string.find(Uri, "spotify:local", 1, true) then
            local Raw: string = string.gsub(string.match(Uri, "^spotify:local:([^:]*)") or "", "+", " ")
            Entry.Artist = (string.gsub(Raw, "%%(%x%x)", function(Code: string): string
                return string.char(tonumber(Code, 16) :: number)
            end))

            return Entry
        end
        if not (Session and Session.Query) then
            return Entry
        end

        local Data: any = Decode(Fetch({
            Url = "https://api-partner.spotify.com/pathfinder/v2/query",
            Method = "POST",
            Headers = Signed({Accept = "application/json", ["Content-Type"] = "application/json"}),
            Body = Http:JSONEncode({
                extensions = {persistedQuery = {sha256Hash = Session.Query, version = 1}},
                variables = {uris = {Uri}},
                operationName = "fetchEntitiesForRecentlyPlayed"
            })
        }).Body)
        local Found: any = Data and Data.data and Data.data.lookup and Data.data.lookup[1] and Data.data.lookup[1].data
        if type(Found) == "table" then
            local Artists: {string} = {}
            for _, v: any in Found.artists and Found.artists.items or {} do
                if v.profile and v.profile.name then
                    table.insert(Artists, v.profile.name)
                end
            end
            Entry.Name = Found.name or Entry.Name
            Entry.Artist = table.concat(Artists, ", ")
        end

        return Entry
    end

    local function Netease(Track: Track): {Line}?
        local Headers: {[string]: string} = {["User-Agent"] = Agent, Referer = "https://music.163.com/"}
        local Wanted: string = Clean(string.gsub(Track.Name, "%s*[%(%[].*$", "") :: string)
        local Data: any = Decode(Fetch({Url = `https://music.163.com/api/search/get?{Form({type = "1", limit = "8", s = `{Track.Name} {Track.Artist}`})}`, Method = "GET", Headers = Headers}).Body)
        local Candidates: {any} = {}
        for _, v: any in type(Data) == "table" and Data.result and Data.result.songs or {} do
            local Gap: number = math.abs((tonumber(v.duration) or 0) - Track.Duration)
            local Name: string = Clean(string.gsub(tostring(v.name or ""), "%s*[%(%[].*$", "") :: string)
            if Gap < 3000 and Name ~= "" and (string.find(Name, Wanted, 1, true) or string.find(Wanted, Name, 1, true)) then
                v.Gap = Gap
                table.insert(Candidates, v)
            end
        end
        table.sort(Candidates, function(Left: any, Right: any): boolean
            return Left.Gap < Right.Gap
        end)

        local Raw: string? = nil
        for Index: number = 1, math.min(#Candidates, 4) do
            local Found: any = Decode(Fetch({Url = `https://music.163.com/api/song/lyric?id={string.format("%d", Candidates[Index].id)}&lv=-1&kv=-1&tv=-1&yv=-1`, Method = "GET", Headers = Headers}).Body)
            local Body: any = type(Found) == "table" and Found.yrc and Found.yrc.lyric
            if type(Body) == "string" and string.find(Body, "%(%d+,%d+,") then
                Raw = Body
                break
            end
        end
        if not Raw then
            return nil
        end

        local Lines: {Line} = {}
        for Row: string in string.gmatch(Raw, "[^\n]+") do
            local Begin: string?, Length: string? = string.match(Row, "^%[(%d+),(%d+)%]")
            if Begin and Length then
                local Marks: {{At: number, After: number, Start: number, Span: number}} = {}
                for At: number, From: string, Span: string, After: number in string.gmatch(Row, "()%((%d+),(%d+),%-?%d+%)()") :: any do
                    table.insert(Marks, {At = At, After = After, Start = tonumber(From) :: number, Span = tonumber(Span) :: number})
                end
                local Words: {Word} = {}
                local Parts: {string} = {}
                local Open: Word? = nil
                for Index: number, Mark in Marks do
                    local Next = Marks[Index + 1]
                    local Chunk: string = string.sub(Row, Mark.After, Next and Next.At - 1 or #Row)
                    table.insert(Parts, Chunk)
                    local Body: string = string.match(Chunk, "^%s*(.-)%s*$") or ""
                    if Body ~= "" then
                        if Open and not string.match(Parts[#Parts - 1] or " ", "%s$") and not string.match(Chunk, "^%s") then
                            Open.Text ..= Body
                            Open.Finish = Mark.Start + Mark.Span
                        else
                            local Fresh: Word = {Text = Body, Start = Mark.Start, Finish = Mark.Start + Mark.Span}
                            Open = Fresh
                            table.insert(Words, Fresh)
                        end
                    end
                end
                local Text: string = string.match(table.concat(Parts), "^%s*(.-)%s*$") or ""
                local Label: string? = string.match(Text, "^([^:]*):")
                local Role: string = string.match(string.lower(Label or ""), "^%s*(%a+)") or ""
                local Credit: boolean = string.find(Text, "\u{FF1A}", 1, true) ~= nil or (Label ~= nil and (string.find(Label, "[\128-\255]") ~= nil or Roles[Role] == true))
                if #Words > 0 and Text ~= "" and not Credit then
                    local Start: number = tonumber(Begin) :: number
                    table.insert(Lines, {Time = Start, Text = Text, Finish = Start + (tonumber(Length) :: number), Words = Words})
                end
            end
        end

        return #Lines > 0 and Lines or nil
    end

    local function Align(Lines: {Line}, Guide: {Line})
        local Keys: {string} = {}
        for Index: number, v: Line in Guide do
            Keys[Index] = Clean(v.Text)
        end
        local Shifts: {number} = {}
        for _, v: Line in Lines do
            local Key: string = Clean(v.Text)
            local Nearest: number? = nil
            for Index: number, Other: string in Keys do
                local Size: number = math.min(#Key, #Other)
                local Shift: number = Guide[Index].Time - v.Time
                if Size >= 6 and string.sub(Key, 1, Size) == string.sub(Other, 1, Size) and math.abs(Shift) < 8000 and (not Nearest or math.abs(Shift) < math.abs(Nearest)) then
                    Nearest = Shift
                end
            end
            if Nearest then
                table.insert(Shifts, Nearest)
            end
        end
        if #Shifts < 3 then
            return
        end

        table.sort(Shifts)
        local Shift: number = Shifts[math.ceil(#Shifts / 2)]
        if Shift == 0 then
            return
        end

        for _, v: Line in Lines do
            v.Time += Shift
            v.Finish = v.Finish and v.Finish + Shift
            for _, Piece: Word in (v.Words or {}) :: {Word} do
                Piece.Start += Shift
                Piece.Finish += Shift
            end
        end
    end

    local function Native(Uri: string): {Line}?
        local Id: string? = string.match(Uri, "^spotify:track:(%w+)$")
        if not Id or not Session then
            return nil
        end

        local Data: any = Decode(Fetch({
            Url = `https://spclient.wg.spotify.com/color-lyrics/v2/track/{Id}?format=json&vocalRemoval=false&market=from_token`,
            Method = "GET",
            Headers = Signed({Accept = "application/json", ["app-platform"] = "WebPlayer"})
        }).Body)
        local Found: any = type(Data) == "table" and Data.lyrics
        if type(Found) ~= "table" or Found.syncType == "UNSYNCED" then
            return nil
        end

        local Lines: {Line} = {}
        for _, v: any in Found.lines or {} do
            local Words: string = tostring(v.words or "")
            if Words ~= "" and Words ~= "\u{266A}" then
                table.insert(Lines, {Time = tonumber(v.startTimeMs) or 0, Text = Words})
            end
        end

        return #Lines > 0 and Lines or nil
    end

    local function Lyrics(Track: Track, Uri: string): {Line}?
        local Success: boolean, Guide: any = pcall(Native, Uri)
        local Lines: {Line}? = Success and Guide or nil
        local Worded: boolean, Words: any = pcall(Netease, Track)
        if Worded and type(Words) == "table" then
            if Lines then
                Align(Words, Lines)
            end

            return Words
        end
        if Lines then
            return Lines
        end

        local Fallback: boolean, Found: any = pcall(Lrclib, Track)

        return Fallback and Found or nil
    end

    local function Apply(Cluster: any)
        local State: any = Cluster.player_state
        local Item: any = State and State.track
        if not Item or not Item.uri or Item.uri == "" then
            Spotify.Status = "Nothing playing"
            Spotify.Track = nil
            Spotify.Playing = false
            Emit()

            return
        end

        local Paused: boolean = State.is_paused == true or State.is_playing == false
        local Now: number = DateTime.now().UnixTimestampMillis
        local Server: number? = tonumber(Cluster.server_timestamp_ms)
        if Server and math.abs(Server - Now) < 3600000 then
            Spotify.Skew = if Spotify.Exact then math.max(Spotify.Skew, Server - Now) else Server - Now
            Spotify.Exact = true
        end
        local Behind: number = Paused and 0 or math.clamp(Now + Spotify.Skew - (tonumber(State.timestamp) or 0), 0, 600000)
        Spotify.Active = Cluster.active_device_id
        Spotify.Status = "Connected"
        Spotify.Playing = not Paused
        Spotify.Progress = (tonumber(State.position_as_of_timestamp) or 0) + Behind
        Spotify.Stamp = os.clock()
        if Spotify.Track and Spotify.Track.Id == Item.uri then
            Spotify.Track.Duration = tonumber(State.duration) or Spotify.Track.Duration
            Emit()

            return
        end

        local Metadata: any = Item.metadata or {}
        local Track: Track = {
            Id = Item.uri,
            Name = Metadata.title or "Unknown",
            Artist = "",
            Album = Metadata.album_title or "",
            Duration = tonumber(State.duration) or 1
        }
        Spotify.Track = Track
        Emit()
        task.spawn(function()
            local Entry: {Name: string, Artist: string} = Describe(Item.uri, Metadata)
            Track.Name, Track.Artist = Entry.Name, Entry.Artist
            Emit()
            local Image: string? = Metadata.image_xlarge_url or Metadata.image_large_url or Metadata.image_url
            if not Image then
                local Embed: any = Decode(Fetch({Url = `https://open.spotify.com/oembed?url={Http:UrlEncode(Item.uri)}`, Method = "GET", Headers = Base()}).Body)
                Image = type(Embed) == "table" and Embed.thumbnail_url or nil
            end
            Track.Cover = Cover(Image and (string.gsub(Image, "ab67616d00001e02", "ab67616d0000b273")))
            Emit()
            local Success: boolean, Lines: any = pcall(Lyrics, Track, Item.uri)
            Track.Lyrics = Success and Lines or nil
            if Spotify.Track == Track then
                Emit()
            end
        end)
    end

    local function Register(Connection: string)
        local Current: any = Session
        local Device: string = Current.Device
        local Capabilities: {[string]: any} = {
            change_volume = true,
            enable_play_token = true,
            supports_file_media_type = true,
            play_token_lost_behavior = "pause",
            disable_connect = false,
            audio_podcasts = true,
            video_playback = true,
            manifest_formats = {"file_ids_mp3", "file_urls_mp3", "manifest_urls_audio_ad", "manifest_ids_video", "file_urls_external", "file_ids_mp4", "file_ids_mp4_dual"},
            supports_preferred_media_type = true,
            supports_playback_offsets = true,
            supports_playback_speed = true
        }
        local Body: string = Http:JSONEncode({
            device = {
                brand = "spotify",
                capabilities = Capabilities,
                device_id = Device,
                device_type = "computer",
                metadata = {},
                model = "web_player",
                name = "catvape",
                platform_identifier = "web_player windows 10;firefox 158.0;desktop",
                is_group = false,
                is_public = false,
                correlation_id = Current.Correlation,
                client_version = Version
            },
            outro_endcontent_snooping = false,
            connection_id = Connection,
            client_version = Version,
            volume = 65535
        })
        Fetch({
            Url = `https://{Current.Host}/track-playback/v1/devices`,
            Method = "POST",
            Headers = Signed({["Content-Type"] = "application/json"}),
            Body = (string.gsub(Body, "\"metadata\":%[%]", "\"metadata\":{}"))
        })
        local Response: {[string]: any} = Fetch({
            Url = `https://{Current.Host}/connect-state/v1/devices/hobs_{Device}`,
            Method = "PUT",
            Headers = Signed({Accept = "application/json", ["Content-Type"] = "application/json", ["x-spotify-connection-id"] = Connection}),
            Body = Http:JSONEncode({member_type = "CONNECT_STATE", device = {device_info = {capabilities = {can_be_player = false, hidden = true, needs_full_player_state = true}}}})
        })
        local Cluster: any = Decode(Response.Body)
        if type(Cluster) == "table" then
            Apply(Cluster)
        else
            Fail(`Spotify said {Response.StatusCode}`)
        end
    end

    local function Connect(Current: number)
        local Pinged: number? = nil
        local Ping: number = os.clock() + 30
        local Success: boolean, Result: any = pcall(WebSocket.connect, `wss://{(Session :: any).Dealer}/?access_token={(Session :: any).Token}`)
        if not Success then
            Fail("Couldn't open the live connection")

            return
        end

        Socket = Result
        local Closed: boolean = false
        Result.OnMessage:Connect(function(Message: string)
            local Data: any = Decode(Message)
            if type(Data) ~= "table" then
                return
            end
            if Data.type == "pong" then
                Pinged = nil
            elseif Data.headers and Data.headers["Spotify-Connection-Id"] then
                task.spawn(Register, Data.headers["Spotify-Connection-Id"])
            end
            for _, v: any in Data.payloads or {} do
                if type(v) == "table" and v.cluster and v.cluster.player_state then
                    Apply(v.cluster)
                    break
                end
            end
        end)
        Result.OnClose:Connect(function()
            Closed = true
        end)
        while Running and Generation == Current and not Closed do
            task.wait(0.25)
            local Now: number = os.clock()
            if Pinged and Now - Pinged > 10 or os.time() > (Session :: any).Expires - 60 then
                break
            end
            if Now > Ping then
                pcall(Result.Send, Result, "{\"type\":\"ping\"}")
                Pinged, Ping = Now, Now + 30
            end
        end
        Socket = nil
        if not Closed then
            pcall(Result.Close, Result)
        end
    end

    Spotify = {
        Status = Saved.Cookie and "Connecting" or "Not connected",
        Track = nil :: Track?,
        Playing = false,
        Progress = 0,
        Stamp = os.clock(),
        Active = nil :: string?,
        Skew = 0,
        Exact = false,
        Listeners = {} :: {() -> ()},
        Linked = Saved.Cookie ~= nil,
        Position = function(): number
            if not Spotify.Track then
                return 0
            end

            local Moved: number = Spotify.Playing and (os.clock() - Spotify.Stamp) * 1000 or 0

            return math.clamp(Spotify.Progress + Moved, 0, Spotify.Track.Duration)
        end,
        SetCookie = function(Raw: string)
            local Value: string = string.match(Raw, "sp_dc=([^;%s]+)") or string.match(Raw, "^%s*([^;%s]+)") or ""
            Saved.Cookie = Value ~= "" and Value or nil
            Spotify.Linked = Saved.Cookie ~= nil
            Save()
            Session = nil
            if Running then
                Spotify.Stop()
                Spotify.Start()
            end
        end,
        Logout = function()
            Saved.Cookie = nil
            Spotify.Linked = false
            Save()
            Session = nil
            Generation += 1
            if Socket then
                pcall(Socket.Close, Socket)
            end
            Running = false
            Fail("Not connected")
        end,
        Control = function(Action: string)
            local Current: any = Session
            if not Spotify.Track or not Current or not Spotify.Active then
                return
            end
            if Action == "play" or Action == "pause" then
                Spotify.Progress = Spotify.Position()
                Spotify.Stamp = os.clock()
                Spotify.Playing = Action == "play"
                Emit()
            end

            local Endpoint: string = ({play = "resume", pause = "pause", next = "skip_next", previous = "skip_prev"} :: {[string]: string})[Action]
            task.spawn(function()
                local Response: {[string]: any} = Fetch({
                    Url = `https://{Current.Host}/connect-state/v1/player/command/from/{Current.Device}/to/{Spotify.Active}`,
                    Method = "POST",
                    Headers = Signed({["Content-Type"] = "application/json"}),
                    Body = Http:JSONEncode({command = {endpoint = Endpoint}})
                })
                if (Response.StatusCode or 0) >= 400 then
                    Spotify.Status = Response.StatusCode == 403 and "Controls need Premium" or `Control failed ({Response.StatusCode})`
                    Emit()
                end
            end)
        end,
        Start = function()
            if Running then
                return
            end

            Running = true
            Generation += 1
            local Current: number = Generation
            task.spawn(function()
                while Running and Generation == Current do
                    if not Saved.Cookie then
                        Fail("Not connected")
                        task.wait(2)
                        continue
                    end
                    if not Session or os.time() > Session.Expires - 60 then
                        Spotify.Status = "Connecting"
                        Emit()
                        local Success: boolean, Ok: any, Problem: any = pcall(Login)
                        if not (Success and Ok) then
                            Fail(Success and Problem or "Login crashed")
                            task.wait(15)
                            continue
                        end
                    end
                    Connect(Current)
                    task.wait(2)
                end
            end)
        end,
        Stop = function()
            Running = false
            Generation += 1
            if Socket then
                pcall(Socket.Close, Socket)
            end
        end
    }

    return Spotify
end]], "=ui/compacted/libraries/Spotify"))(BundledModules)

        if shared.BundleFrame and os.clock() - shared.BundleFrame > (os.clock() - shared.BundleStart > 0.6 and 0.016 or 0.006) and coroutine.isyieldable() then
            task.wait()
            shared.BundleFrame = os.clock()
        end

        BundledModules.Glyphs = assert(loadstring([[
local BundledModules = ...
local Create = BundledModules.Create
local getcustomasset: (string) -> string = BundledModules.getcustomasset
local readfile: (string) -> string = BundledModules.readfile
local Font = BundledModules.Faces
local Layout = BundledModules.Layout

local Services = BundledModules.Services

local Sheets: {[string]: string | false} = {}
local Queue: {() -> ()} = {}
local Draining: boolean = false

local function Drain(): ()
    local Start: number = os.clock()
    local Index: number = 0
    repeat
        Index += 1
        Queue[Index]()
    until Index >= #Queue or os.clock() - Start > 0.006
    local Rest: {() -> ()} = table.move(Queue, Index + 1, #Queue, 1, {})
    table.clear(Queue)
    table.move(Rest, 1, #Rest, 1, Queue)
    if #Queue > 0 then
        Services.RunService.Heartbeat:Once(Drain)
    else
        Draining = false
    end
end

local Label = {}

local function Sheet(Folder: string, Name: string): string?
    local File: string = if string.find(Name, ".", 1, true) then Name else `{Name}.png`
    local Path: string = `{Folder}/text/labels/{File}`
    if Sheets[Path] == nil then
        local Success: boolean, Result: any = pcall(getcustomasset, Path)
        local Read: boolean, Whole: boolean = pcall(function(): boolean
            return string.sub(readfile(Path), -8) == "IEND\xAE\x42\x60\x82"
        end)
        Sheets[Path] = Success and Result ~= "" and Read and Whole and Result or false
        if not Sheets[Path] then
            warn(`[text] {Path}: sheet unavailable, drawing glyphs instead`)
        end
    end

    return Sheets[Path] or nil
end

function Label.Attach(Object: any, Entry: string, Ui: TextHost): TextHandle
    if not Ui.Pool then
        Ui.Pool = {}
        Ui.Root.Destroying:Once(function(): ()
            for _, v: ImageLabel in (Ui.Pool :: {ImageLabel}) do
                v:Destroy()
            end
            table.clear(Ui.Pool :: {ImageLabel})
        end)
    end

    local IsBox: boolean = Object:IsA("TextBox")
    local Holder: Frame = Create.New("Frame", {
        Name = "Glyphs",
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Size = UDim2.new(),
        ZIndex = Object.ZIndex,
        Parent = Object
    })
    local Scaler: UIScale = Create.New("UIScale", {Parent = Holder})
    Create.New("UISizeConstraint", {
        MaxSize = Vector2.zero,
        Parent = Holder
    })

    local Mark: Frame? = if IsBox then Create.New("Frame", {
        Name = "Selection",
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(107, 161, 249),
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Visible = false,
        ZIndex = Object.ZIndex,
        Parent = Holder
    }) else nil

    local Caret: Frame? = if IsBox then Create.New("Frame", {
        Name = "Caret",
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Visible = false,
        ZIndex = Object.ZIndex,
        Parent = Holder
    }) else nil

    local Used: {ImageLabel} = {}
    local Wide: {UIScale} = {}
    local Chain: {GuiObject} = {}
    local Watched: {GuiObject} = {}
    local Connections: {RBXScriptConnection} = {}
    local Watches: {RBXScriptConnection} = {}
    local Backs: {RBXScriptConnection} = {}
    local Last: {[string]: any} = {}
    local Origin: Vector2 = Vector2.zero
    local Inset: Vector2 = Vector2.zero
    local Box: Vector2 = Vector2.one
    local Truncation: Enum.TextTruncate = Object.TextTruncate
    local Mine: Enum.TextTruncate = Object.TextTruncate
    local Product: number = 1
    local ScaleKey: string = ""
    local Baked: boolean = false
    local Needed: number = 0
    local Base: number = Object.Size.X.Offset
    local LastSet: number = Base
    local Scroll: number = 0
    local Lead: number = 0
    local Moved: number = 0
    local Pressed: number = -math.huge
    local Press: number = 0
    local Ticker: RBXScriptConnection? = nil
    local Drag: RBXScriptConnection? = nil
    local Render: () -> ()

    local function Backdrop(): Color3?
        local Current: any = Object
        local Color: Color3? = nil
        local Done: boolean = false
        table.clear(Chain)
        repeat
            Done = not (Current and Current:IsA("GuiObject"))
            if not Done then
                table.insert(Chain, Current)
                Done = Current.BackgroundTransparency < 1
                Color = if Current.BackgroundTransparency == 0 then Current.BackgroundColor3 else nil
                Current = Current.Parent
            end
        until Done

        return Color
    end

    local function Rewatch(Active: boolean): ()
        local Same: boolean = Active and #Chain == #Watched
        for Index: number, v: GuiObject in Chain do
            Same = Same and Watched[Index] == v
        end
        if not Same then
            for _, v: RBXScriptConnection in Backs do
                v:Disconnect()
            end
            table.clear(Backs)
            table.clear(Watched)
            for _, v: GuiObject in (if Active then Chain else {}) do
                table.insert(Watched, v)
                table.insert(Backs, v:GetPropertyChangedSignal("BackgroundColor3"):Connect(Render))
                table.insert(Backs, v:GetPropertyChangedSignal("BackgroundTransparency"):Connect(Render))
            end
        end
    end

    local function Acquire(): ImageLabel
        local Image: ImageLabel = table.remove(Ui.Pool :: {ImageLabel}) or Create.New("ImageLabel", {
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            ResampleMode = Enum.ResamplerMode.Pixelated,
            ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Stretch
        })
        Image.ZIndex = Object.ZIndex
        Image.Parent = Holder

        return Image
    end

    local function Draw(Data: FontData): ()
        local Source: string = if IsBox and Object.Text == "" then Object.PlaceholderText else Object.Text
        local Focus: boolean = IsBox and Object:IsFocused()
        local XAlign: Enum.TextXAlignment = Object.TextXAlignment
        local YAlign: Enum.TextYAlignment = Object.TextYAlignment
        local Truncate: boolean = Truncation ~= Enum.TextTruncate.None and not Focus
        local Wrap: boolean = Object.TextWrapped
        local Auto: boolean = Object.AutomaticSize == Enum.AutomaticSize.X or Object.AutomaticSize == Enum.AutomaticSize.XY
        local Pad: UIPadding? = Object:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIPadding")
        local Size: Vector2 = Object.AbsoluteSize
        local PadL: UDim = if Pad then Pad.PaddingLeft else UDim.new()
        local PadR: UDim = if Pad then Pad.PaddingRight else UDim.new()
        local PadT: UDim = if Pad then Pad.PaddingTop else UDim.new()
        local PadB: UDim = if Pad then Pad.PaddingBottom else UDim.new()
        local Left: number = PadL.Scale * Size.X + PadL.Offset * Product
        local Right: number = PadR.Scale * Size.X + PadR.Offset * Product
        local Top: number = PadT.Scale * Size.Y + PadT.Offset * Product
        local Bottom: number = PadB.Scale * Size.Y + PadB.Offset * Product
        local Content: number = math.floor(math.max(Size.X - Left - Right, 0))
        local Full: number = Layout.Measure(Data, Source)
        local Typed: number = if Object.Text == "" then 0 else Full
        local Cursor: number = if Focus then Object.CursorPosition else -1
        local Before: number = if Cursor > 1 then Layout.Measure(Data, string.sub(Object.Text, 1, Cursor - 1)) else 0
        local Over: boolean = Focus and Content > 0 and Typed > Content
        local Width: number = if not Over and (XAlign ~= Enum.TextXAlignment.Left or Truncate) then Content else 0
        local Seen: number = math.min(math.max(Scroll, Before - Content + 1), Before)
        Scroll = if Over then math.clamp(Seen, 0, Typed - Content + 1) else 0
        Lead = if Over then -Scroll else Layout.Offset(XAlign, Content, Typed)
        local Lines: number = if Wrap then 1 + select(2, string.gsub(Source, "\n", "")) else 1
        local Free: number = Size.Y - Top - Bottom - Lines * Data.LineHeight
        local Shift: number = 0
        if YAlign == Enum.TextYAlignment.Center then
            Shift = Free / 2
        elseif YAlign == Enum.TextYAlignment.Bottom then
            Shift = Free
        end
        Origin = Vector2.new(0, Shift)
        Inset = Vector2.new(Left, Top)
        Box = Vector2.new(math.max(Size.X - Left - Right, 1), math.max(Size.Y - Top - Bottom, 1))

        local Tint: Color3 = if IsBox and Object.Text == "" then Object.PlaceholderColor3 else Object.TextColor3
        local Labels: {[string]: {any}}? = Font.Labels(Ui.Folder)
        local Key: string? = nil
        local Look: boolean = Labels ~= nil and Source ~= "" and Object.TextTransparency == 0 and not Focus
        if Look then
            local Back: Color3? = Backdrop()
            Key = if Back then `{Entry}|{Tint:ToHex()}|{Back:ToHex()}|{ScaleKey}|{Source}` else nil
        end

        local Hit: {any}? = if Key and Labels then Labels[Key :: string] else nil
        local Asset: string? = if Hit and #Hit >= 5 and (not Truncate or Full <= Content) then Sheet(Ui.Folder, Hit[1]) else nil
        local Pick: string? = if Asset then Key else nil
        Rewatch(Look)

        local Same: boolean = Last.Source == Source and Last.Width == Width and Last.Scale == ScaleKey and Last.Align == XAlign and Last.Truncate == Truncate and Last.Wrap == Wrap and Last.Pick == Pick and Last.Auto == Auto and Last.Over == Over and Last.Scroll == Scroll
        if not Same then
            Last = {
                Source = Source,
                Width = Width,
                Scale = ScaleKey,
                Align = XAlign,
                Truncate = Truncate,
                Wrap = Wrap,
                Pick = Pick,
                Auto = Auto,
                Over = Over,
                Scroll = Scroll
            }
            Baked = Pick ~= nil
            Needed = math.ceil((Full + Left + Right) / Data.Scale)

            local Atlas: string? = nil
            local Placements: {Placement}
            if Hit and Asset and Pick then
                Atlas = Asset
                Placements = {{
                    Code = 0,
                    X = Layout.Offset(XAlign, Content, Full) - (Hit[6] or 0),
                    Y = -(Hit[7] or 0),
                    Cell = {Hit[2], Hit[3], Hit[4], Hit[5], 0, 0}
                }}
            else
                local Align: Enum.TextXAlignment = if Over then Enum.TextXAlignment.Left else XAlign
                Placements = Layout.Place(Data, Source, Width, Align, Truncate, Wrap)
            end

            for _ = #Used + 1, #Placements do
                table.insert(Used, Acquire())
            end
            for _ = #Used, #Placements + 1, -1 do
                local Spare: ImageLabel = table.remove(Used) :: ImageLabel
                Spare.Parent = nil
                table.insert(Ui.Pool :: {ImageLabel}, Spare)
            end

            for Index: number, v: Placement in Placements do
                local Image: ImageLabel = Used[Index]
                local X: number = v.X - Scroll
                local Cut: number = if Over then math.max(-X, 0) else 0
                local Edge: number = math.min(X + v.Cell[3], Content)
                local Keep: number = if Over then math.max(Edge - math.max(X, 0), 0) else v.Cell[3]
                Image.Visible = Keep > 0
                Image.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(X + Cut, v.Y)
                Image.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(Keep, v.Cell[4])
                Image.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new(v.Cell[1] + Cut, v.Cell[2])
                Image.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(Keep, v.Cell[4])
                Image.Image = Atlas or Data.Pages[v.Cell[7] or 1]
                Image.ImageColor3 = if Baked then Color3.new(1, 1, 1) else Tint
                Image.ImageTransparency = Object.TextTransparency
            end
        end

        if Caret and Mark then
            local Anchor: number = if Focus then Object.SelectionStart else -1
            local Low: number = math.min(Anchor, Cursor)
            local High: number = math.max(Anchor, Cursor)
            local From: number = if Low > 1 then Layout.Measure(Data, string.sub(Object.Text, 1, Low - 1)) else 0
            local To: number = if High > 1 then Layout.Measure(Data, string.sub(Object.Text, 1, High - 1)) else 0
            From, To = math.clamp(Lead + From, 0, Content), math.clamp(Lead + To, 0, Content)

            Mark.Visible = Low > 0 and To > From
            Mark.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(From, 0)
            Mark.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(To - From, Data.LineHeight)
            Caret.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(Lead + Before, 0)
            Caret.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(1, Data.LineHeight)
            Caret.BackgroundColor3 = Object.TextColor3
            Caret.BackgroundTransparency = Object.TextTransparency
        end

        if Auto then
            local Target: number = math.max(Base, Needed)
            if Object.Size.X.Offset ~= Target then
                LastSet = Target
                Object.Size = UDim2.new(Object.Size.X.Scale, Target, Object.Size.Y.Scale, Object.Size.Y.Offset)
            end
        end

        local Position: Vector2 = Object.AbsolutePosition
        local OffsetX: number = math.ceil(Position.X + Inset.X + Origin.X - 0.502) - (Position.X + Inset.X)
        local OffsetY: number = math.ceil(Position.Y + Inset.Y + Origin.Y - 0.502) - (Position.Y + Inset.Y)
        Holder.Position = UDim2.fromScale(OffsetX / Box.X, OffsetY / Box.Y)
    end

    local Waiting: GuiObject? = nil
    local Wait: RBXScriptConnection? = nil

    Render = function(): ()
        local Current: Instance? = Object
        local Blocker: GuiObject? = nil
        repeat
            if (Current :: Instance):IsA("GuiObject") and not (Current :: GuiObject).Visible then
                Blocker = Current :: GuiObject
            end
            Current = if Blocker or (Current :: Instance):IsA("LayerCollector") then nil else (Current :: Instance).Parent
        until Current == nil

        if Blocker then
            if Waiting ~= Blocker then
                if Wait then
                    Wait:Disconnect()
                end
                local Hidden: GuiObject = Blocker
                Waiting = Hidden
                Wait = Hidden:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function(): ()
                    if Hidden.Visible and Wait then
                        Wait:Disconnect()
                        Wait, Waiting = nil, nil
                        Render()
                    end
                end)
            end

            return
        end

        if ScaleKey == "" then
            return
        end

        local Data: FontData? = Font.Load(Ui.Folder, Entry, ScaleKey)
        local Native: boolean = Data == nil
        local Want: Enum.TextTruncate = if Native then Truncation else Enum.TextTruncate.None
        Object.MaxVisibleGraphemes = if Native then -1 else 0
        if Object.TextTruncate ~= Want then
            Mine = Want
            Object.TextTruncate = Want
        end
        Holder.Visible = not Native
        if Data and not Native then
            Draw(Data)
        end
    end

    local function Update(): ()
        local Best: number = math.huge
        Product = 1
        for _, v: UIScale in Wide do
            Product *= v.Scale
        end
        Product = math.max(Product, 0.01)
        for Name: string, Value: number in Ui.Scales do
            if math.abs(Value - Product) < Best then
                Best = math.abs(Value - Product)
                ScaleKey = Name
            end
        end
        Scaler.Scale = 1 / Product
        Render()
    end

    local function Scan(): ()
        local Current: Instance? = Object
        for _, v: RBXScriptConnection in Watches do
            v:Disconnect()
        end
        table.clear(Watches)
        table.clear(Wide)
        repeat
            local Found: UIScale? = (Current :: Instance):FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
            if Found then
                table.insert(Wide, Found)
                table.insert(Watches, Found:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Scale"):Connect(Update))
            end
            Current = (Current :: Instance).Parent
        until Current == nil
    end

    local function Disconnect(): ()
        for _, List: {RBXScriptConnection} in {Connections, Watches, Backs} do
            for _, v: RBXScriptConnection in List do
                v:Disconnect()
            end
            table.clear(List)
        end
        if Ticker then
            Ticker:Disconnect()
            Ticker = nil
        end
        if Wait then
            Wait:Disconnect()
            Wait, Waiting = nil, nil
        end
        if Drag then
            Drag:Disconnect()
            Drag = nil
        end
    end

    local function Index(X: number): number
        local Data: FontData? = Font.Load(Ui.Folder, Entry, ScaleKey)
        if not Data then
            return Object.CursorPosition
        end

        local Text: string = Object.Text
        local Stops: {number} = {}
        local Decoded: boolean = pcall(function(): ()
            for Position: number in utf8.codes(Text) do
                table.insert(Stops, Position)
            end
        end)
        for Position: number = 1, if Decoded then 0 else #Text do
            Stops[Position] = Position
        end
        table.insert(Stops, #Text + 1)

        local Target: number = X - Object.AbsolutePosition.X - Inset.X - Lead
        local Low: number, High: number = 1, #Stops
        repeat
            local Middle: number = (Low + High + 1) // 2
            if Layout.Measure(Data, string.sub(Text, 1, Stops[Middle] - 1)) <= Target then
                Low = Middle
            else
                High = Middle - 1
            end
        until Low >= High

        local Here: number = Layout.Measure(Data, string.sub(Text, 1, Stops[Low] - 1))
        local After: number = Stops[math.min(Low + 1, #Stops)]
        local Next: number = if Low < #Stops then Layout.Measure(Data, string.sub(Text, 1, After - 1)) else math.huge

        return if Next - Target < Target - Here then Stops[Low + 1] else Stops[Low]
    end

    local Names: {string} = {"Text", "TextXAlignment", "TextYAlignment", "TextWrapped", "AbsoluteSize", "AutomaticSize"}
    local Tints: {string} = {"TextColor3", "TextTransparency"}
    if IsBox then
        table.insert(Names, "PlaceholderText")
        table.insert(Tints, "PlaceholderColor3")
        table.insert(Connections, Object.Focused:Connect(function(): ()
            Moved = os.clock()
            if Ticker then
                Ticker:Disconnect()
            end
            Ticker = Services.RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(): ()
                local On: boolean = (os.clock() - Moved) % 1 < 0.5
                if (Caret :: Frame).Visible ~= On then
                    (Caret :: Frame).Visible = On
                end
            end)
            Render()
        end))
        table.insert(Connections, Object.FocusLost:Connect(function(): ()
            if Ticker then
                Ticker:Disconnect()
                Ticker = nil
            end
            (Caret :: Frame).Visible = false
            Render()
        end))
        for _, Name: string in {"CursorPosition", "SelectionStart"} do
            table.insert(Connections, Object:GetPropertyChangedSignal(Name):Connect(function(): ()
                Moved = os.clock()
                if Name == "CursorPosition" and os.clock() - Pressed < 0.1 and Object.SelectionStart == -1 and Object.CursorPosition ~= Index(Press) then
                    Object.CursorPosition = Index(Press)
                end
                Render()
            end))
        end
        table.insert(Connections, Object.InputBegan:Connect(function(Input: InputObject): ()
            if Input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                return
            end

            Pressed, Press = os.clock(), Input.Position.X
            if Drag then
                Drag:Disconnect()
            end
            task.defer(function(): ()
                if Object:IsFocused() and Object.SelectionStart == -1 then
                    Object.CursorPosition = Index(Press)
                end
            end)
            Drag = Services.UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(Changed: InputObject): ()
                if not Services.UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then
                    (Drag :: RBXScriptConnection):Disconnect()
                    Drag = nil
                elseif Changed.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and Object:IsFocused() then
                    local Start: number = Index(Press)
                    local At: number = Index(Changed.Position.X)
                    Object.SelectionStart = if At ~= Start then Start else -1
                    Object.CursorPosition = At
                end
            end)
        end))
    end
    for _, Name: string in Names do
        table.insert(Connections, Object:GetPropertyChangedSignal(Name):Connect(Render))
    end
    for _, Name: string in Tints do
        table.insert(Connections, Object:GetPropertyChangedSignal(Name):Connect(function(): ()
            local Color: Color3 = if IsBox and Object.Text == "" then Object.PlaceholderColor3 else Object.TextColor3
            for _, v: ImageLabel in Used do
                v.ImageColor3 = if Baked then Color3.new(1, 1, 1) else Color
                v.ImageTransparency = Object.TextTransparency
            end
            Render()
        end))
    end
    table.insert(Connections, Object:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsolutePosition"):Connect(function(): ()
        local Position: Vector2 = Object.AbsolutePosition
        local OffsetX: number = math.ceil(Position.X + Inset.X + Origin.X - 0.502) - (Position.X + Inset.X)
        local OffsetY: number = math.ceil(Position.Y + Inset.Y + Origin.Y - 0.502) - (Position.Y + Inset.Y)
        Holder.Position = UDim2.fromScale(OffsetX / Box.X, OffsetY / Box.Y)
    end))
    table.insert(Connections, Object:GetPropertyChangedSignal("TextTruncate"):Connect(function(): ()
        if Object.TextTruncate ~= Mine then
            Truncation = Object.TextTruncate
            Render()
        end
    end))
    table.insert(Connections, Object:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ZIndex"):Connect(function(): ()
        Holder.ZIndex = Object.ZIndex
        for _, v: GuiObject in Holder:GetChildren() :: {any} do
            if v:IsA("GuiObject") then
                v.ZIndex = Object.ZIndex
            end
        end
    end))
    table.insert(Connections, Object:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"):Connect(function(): ()
        if Object.Size.X.Offset ~= LastSet then
            Base = Object.Size.X.Offset
            LastSet = Base
            Render()
        end
    end))
    table.insert(Connections, Object.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(): ()
        Scan()
        Update()
    end))
    table.insert(Connections, Object.Destroying:Once(Disconnect))

    table.insert(Queue, function(): ()
        if Holder.Parent then
            Scan()
            Update()
        end
    end)
    if not Draining then
        Draining = true
        task.defer(Drain)
    end

    return {
        Render = Render,
        Destroy = function(): ()
            Disconnect()
            for _, v: ImageLabel in Used do
                v.Parent = nil
                table.insert(Ui.Pool :: {ImageLabel}, v)
            end
            table.clear(Used)
            Holder:Destroy()
            Object.MaxVisibleGraphemes = -1
        end
    }
end

local Sweep: NumberSequence = NumberSequence.new({
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0),
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.42, 0),
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.58, 0.62),
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.62)

local Styles: {[string]: Style} = {
    Karaoke = {Mode = "Sweep", Halo = 0.45, Rise = 2, Glow = 0.8, Tint = 0.4, Ease = TweenInfo.new(0.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)},
    Bounce = {Mode = "Sweep", Halo = 0, Rise = 5, Glow = 1, Tint = 0.55, Ease = TweenInfo.new(0.32, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)},
    Glow = {Mode = "Sweep", Halo = 1, Rise = 0, Glow = 1, Tint = 0.55, Ease = TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)},
    Fade = {Mode = "Fade", Halo = 0, Rise = 1, Glow = 1, Tint = 1, Ease = TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)},

local function Edge(Progress: number): Vector2
    return Vector2.new(Progress * 1.16 - 0.58, 0)
end

local function Dots(Start: number, Finish: number): Timing
    local Share: number = (Finish - Start) / 3
    local Words: {Piece} = {}
    for Index: number = 0, 2 do
        table.insert(Words, {Text = "\u{2022}", Start = Start + Share * Index, Finish = Start + Share * (Index + 1)})
    end

    return {Text = "\u{2022} \u{2022} \u{2022}", Start = Start, Finish = Finish, Gap = true, Words = Words}
end

local Sections: {string} = {"chorus", "verse", "intro", "outro", "bridge", "hook", "refrain", "interlude", "instrumental", "breakdown", "drop", "spoken", "skit", "solo"}

local function Strip(Text: string): string
    local Rest: string = Text
    while true do
        local Tag: string?, After: string? = string.match(Rest, "^%s*([<%[%(][^>%]%)]*[>%]%)])%s*(.*)$")
        local Lower: string = string.lower(Tag or "")
        local Known: boolean = false
        for _, v: string in Sections do
            if string.find(Lower, v, 1, true) then
                Known = true
                break
            end
        end
        if not (Tag and After and Known) then
            break
        end
        Rest = After
    end

    return Rest
end

local function Measure(Source: {any}): {Timing}
    local Timings: {Timing} = {}
    local Lines: {any} = {}
    for _, v: any in Source do
        local Text: string = Strip(v.Text)
        if string.match(Text, "%S") then
            if Text == v.Text then
                table.insert(Lines, v)
            else
                local Kept: {any}? = nil
                if v.Words then
                    Kept = {}
                    for _, Word: any in v.Words do
                        if Strip(Word.Text) == Word.Text and string.find(Text, Word.Text, 1, true) then
                            table.insert(Kept :: {any}, Word)
                        end
                    end
                end
                table.insert(Lines, {Time = Kept and Kept[1] and Kept[1].Start or v.Time, Text = Text, Finish = v.Finish, Words = Kept and #Kept > 0 and Kept or nil})
            end
        end
    end
    if Lines[1] and Lines[1].Time > 4000 then
        table.insert(Timings, Dots(0, Lines[1].Time - 250))
    end
    for Index: number, v: any in Lines do
        local Next: any = Lines[Index + 1]
        local Words: {Piece} = {}
        local Finish: number
        if v.Words then
            for _, Word: any in v.Words do
                table.insert(Words, {Text = Word.Text, Start = Word.Start, Finish = math.max(Word.Finish, Word.Start + 1)})
            end
            Finish = v.Finish or Words[#Words].Finish
        else
            local Pieces: {string} = {}
            local Total: number = 0
            for Word: string in string.gmatch(v.Text, "%S+") do
                table.insert(Pieces, Word)
                Total += #Word + 1
            end
            local Limit: number = (Next and Next.Time or v.Time + 5000) - v.Time
            local Span: number = math.min(v.Finish and v.Finish - v.Time or Limit, Total * 72 + 450, Limit)
            local Done: number = 0
            for _, Word: string in Pieces do
                local Share: number = (#Word + 1) / math.max(Total, 1) * Span
                table.insert(Words, {Text = Word, Start = v.Time + Done, Finish = v.Time + Done + Share})
                Done += Share
            end
            Finish = v.Time + Span
        end
        if #Words > 0 then
            table.insert(Timings, {Text = v.Text, Start = v.Time, Finish = Finish, Gap = false, Words = Words})
        end
        if Next and Next.Time - Finish > 4500 then
            table.insert(Timings, Dots(Finish + 400, Next.Time - 250))
        end
    end

    return Timings
end

local function Clock(Milliseconds: number): string
    local Seconds: number = math.floor(Milliseconds / 1000)

    return string.format("%d:%02d", Seconds // 60, Seconds % 60)
end

return function(Ui: Context, Bar: Hud, Spotify: any): any
    local New = Create.New
    local Gui: ScreenGui = New("ScreenGui", {
        Name = "FinchMusic",
        IgnoreGuiInset = true,
        ResetOnSpawn = false,
        DisplayOrder = 99,
        ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
    })
    Gui.Parent = cloneref(gethui())
    table.insert(Ui.Roots, Gui)
    local Views: {[string]: View} = {}
    local Shown: boolean = false
    local Layout: string = "Card"

    local Pressing: boolean = false

    local function Cover(Parent: Instance, Position: UDim2, Size: number, Radius: number): (ImageLabel, Frame)
        local Blank: Frame = New("Frame", {
            Position = Position,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(Size, Size),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Control,
            Parent = Parent
        }, {Create.Corner(Radius)})
        local Glyph: number = Size >= 120 and 40 or 18
        Ui:Fit(New("ImageLabel", {
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),

            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Image = Ui:Icon("music", Glyph),
            ImageColor3 = Theme.Muted,
            Parent = Blank
        }))
        local Image: ImageLabel = New("ImageLabel", {
            Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            ImageTransparency = 1,
            ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop,
            Parent = Blank
        }, {Create.Corner(Radius)})

        return Image, Blank
    end

    local function Progress(Parent: Instance, Position: UDim2, Width: number): Frame

                end
            end)
        end

        return Play
    end

    local function Lyrics(Parent: Instance, Position: UDim2, Size: Vector2, Type: number, Gap: number, Surface: Color3): Reel
        local Area: Frame = New("Frame", {

            ClipsDescendants = true,
            Parent = Parent
        })

            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Parent = Area
        }, {
            New("UIListLayout", {
