                SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
            })
        })
        for _, Top: boolean in {true, false} do
            New("Frame", {
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, Top and 0 or 1),
                Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, Top and 0 or 1),
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, math.floor(Size.Y * 0.22)),
                BackgroundColor3 = Surface,
                ZIndex = 2,
                Parent = Area
            }, {
                New("UIGradient", {
                    Rotation = Top and 90 or -90,
                    Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0, 1)
                })
            })
        end
        local Note: TextLabel = Text(Type, Enum.FontWeight.Medium, {
            Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
            Text = "",
            TextColor3 = Theme.Muted,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
            Parent = Area
        })

        local Halo: Frame = New("Frame", {
            Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            ZIndex = 1,
            Parent = Area
        })
        local Blob: ImageLabel = New("ImageLabel", {
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, math.round(Type * 2.4), 1, math.round(Type * 1.8)),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Image = Ui:Icon("glow", 64),
            ImageColor3 = Ui.Accent,
            ImageTransparency = 1,
            ZIndex = 1,
            Parent = Halo
        })
        local Copies: {TextLabel} = {}
        for Ring: number = 1, 2 do
            for Turn: number = 0, 7 do
                local Angle: number = Turn * math.pi / 4
                table.insert(Copies, Text(Type, Enum.FontWeight.SemiBold, {
                    Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.round(math.cos(Angle) * Ring), math.round(math.sin(Angle) * Ring)),
                    Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
                    TextColor3 = Ui.Accent,
                    TextTransparency = 1,
                    ZIndex = 1,
                    Parent = Halo
                }))
            end
        end
        Halo.Visible = false

        return {Area = Area, Holder = Holder, Note = Note, Labels = {}, Words = {}, Index = -1, Resting = false, Halo = Halo, Copies = Copies, Blob = Blob}
    end

    local function Focus(Reel: Reel, Index: number, Resting: boolean, Instant: boolean)
        Reel.Index, Reel.Resting = Index, Resting
        for Slot: number, Words: {TextLabel} in Reel.Words do
            local Distance: number = math.abs(Slot - math.max(Index, 1))
            local Active: boolean = Slot == Index and not Resting
            local Goal: {[string]: any} = {
                TextColor3 = Active and Theme.Text or Theme.Dim,
                TextTransparency = Active and 0 or math.min(0.3 + Distance * 0.14, 0.82)
            }
            local Info: TweenInfo? = not Instant and Distance <= 6 and Theme.Smooth or nil
            for _, v: TextLabel in Words do
                Ui:To(v, Goal, Info)
                if v.Position ~= UDim2.new() or v.TextStrokeTransparency < 1 then
                    Ui:To(v, {Position = UDim2.new(), TextStrokeTransparency = 1}, Info)
                end
                local Gradient: UIGradient? = v:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")
                if Gradient then
                    if Active and Look.Mode == "Line" then
                        Gradient.Offset = Edge(0)
                        Ui:To(Gradient, {Offset = Edge(1)}, Look.Ease)
                    else
                        Gradient.Offset = Edge(Active and 0 or 1)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        Reel.Sung = nil
        for _, v: TextLabel in Reel.Copies do
            Ui:To(v, {TextTransparency = 1}, Theme.Fast)
        end
        Ui:To(Reel.Blob, {ImageTransparency = 1}, Theme.Fast)

        local Label: Frame? = Reel.Labels[math.max(Index, 1)]
        if not Label then
            return
        end

        local Middle: number = Label.AbsolutePosition.Y - Reel.Holder.AbsolutePosition.Y + Label.AbsoluteSize.Y / 2
        Ui:To(Reel.Holder, {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, math.round(Reel.Area.AbsoluteSize.Y / 2 - Middle))}, not Instant and Theme.Smooth or nil)
    end

    local function Fill(Reel: Reel, Type: number)
        Reel.Halo.Parent = Reel.Area
        Reel.Halo.Visible = false
        for _, v: Frame in Reel.Labels do
            v:Destroy()
        end
        table.clear(Reel.Labels)
        table.clear(Reel.Words)
        Reel.Holder.Position = UDim2.new()
        Reel.Note.Text = not Spotify.Track and (Spotify.Status == "Nothing playing" and "Play something on Spotify" or "Connect in Settings > Spotify") or (Lines and "" or "No synced lyrics")
        for Index: number, v: Timing in Timings do
            local Row: Frame = New("Frame", {
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
                AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                LayoutOrder = Index,
                Parent = Reel.Holder
            }, {
                New("UIListLayout", {
                    FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
                    Wraps = true,
                    Padding = UDim.new(0, math.round(Type * (v.Gap and 0.45 or 0.28))),
                    SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
                })
            })
            local Words: {TextLabel} = {}
            for Slot: number, Word: Piece in v.Words do
                local Width: number = math.ceil(Ui:Measure(Word.Text, Type, Enum.FontWeight.SemiBold)) + 1
                local Holder: Frame = New("Frame", {
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(Width, Type + 6),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    LayoutOrder = Slot,
                    Parent = Row
                })
                local Label: TextLabel = Text(Type, Enum.FontWeight.SemiBold, {
                    Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
                    Text = Word.Text,
                    TextColor3 = Theme.Dim,
                    TextTransparency = 0.6,
                    TextStrokeTransparency = 1,
                    ZIndex = 2,
                    Parent = Holder
                })
                New("UIGradient", {Transparency = Sweep, Offset = Edge(1), Parent = Label})
                table.insert(Words, Label)
            end
            table.insert(Reel.Labels, Row)
            table.insert(Reel.Words, Words)
        end
        Reel.Index = -1
    end

    local function Settle(Label: TextLabel)
        Ui:To(Label, {Position = UDim2.new(), TextColor3 = Theme.Text, TextStrokeTransparency = 1}, Theme.Show)
    end

    local function Sing(Reel: Reel, Index: number, Position: number)
        local Timing: Timing? = Timings[Index]
        local Words: {TextLabel}? = Reel.Words[Index]
        if not Timing or not Words then
            return
        end

        if Look.Mode == "Line" then
            return
        end

        local Current: TextLabel? = nil
        local Held: boolean = false
        for Slot: number, Word: Piece in Timing.Words do
            local Label: TextLabel? = Words[Slot]
            local Gradient: UIGradient? = Label and Label:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")
            local Progress: number = math.clamp((Position - Word.Start) / (Word.Finish - Word.Start), 0, 1)
            if Gradient and Look.Mode == "Sweep" then
                Gradient.Offset = Edge(Progress)
            elseif Gradient and Position >= Word.Start and Gradient.Offset.X < 0 and not (Ui.Active[Gradient] and Ui.Active[Gradient].Offset) then
                Ui:To(Gradient, {Offset = Edge(1)}, Look.Ease)
            end
            if Position >= Word.Start and Position < Word.Finish then
                Current = Label
                Held = Word.Finish - Word.Start > 900
            end
        end
        if Current == Reel.Sung then
            return
        end

        if Reel.Sung then
            Settle(Reel.Sung)
        end
        Reel.Sung = Current
        local Strength: number = Current and Look.Halo * (Held and 1.25 or 1) or 0
        if Strength <= 0 then
            for _, v: TextLabel in Reel.Copies do
                Ui:To(v, {TextTransparency = 1}, Theme.Show)
            end
            Ui:To(Reel.Blob, {ImageTransparency = 1}, Theme.Show)
        elseif Current then
            Reel.Halo.Visible = true
            Reel.Halo.Parent = Current.Parent
            Reel.Halo.Position = UDim2.new()
            Ui:To(Reel.Halo, {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, -(Look.Rise + (Held and Look.Rise > 0 and 1 or 0)))}, Look.Ease)
            for Slot: number, v: TextLabel in Reel.Copies do
                v.Text = Current.Text
                v.TextColor3 = Ui.Accent
                v.TextTransparency = 1
                Ui:To(v, {TextTransparency = 1 - math.min((Slot <= 8 and 0.6 or 0.32) * Strength, 0.9)}, Look.Ease)
            end
            Reel.Blob.ImageColor3 = Ui.Accent
            Reel.Blob.ImageTransparency = 1
            Ui:To(Reel.Blob, {ImageTransparency = 1 - math.min(0.8 * Strength, 0.9)}, Look.Ease)
        end
        if Current then
            Current.TextStrokeColor3 = Ui.Accent
            Ui:To(Current, {
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, -(Look.Rise + (Held and Look.Rise > 0 and 1 or 0))),
                TextColor3 = Ui.Accent:Lerp(Theme.Text, Held and Look.Tint * 0.4 or Look.Tint),
                TextStrokeTransparency = Look.Glow < 1 and (Held and Look.Glow - 0.2 or Look.Glow) or 1
            }, Look.Ease)
        end
    end

    local function Base(Name: string, Size: Vector2): (Frame, Frame)
        local Root: Frame, Body: Frame = Bar.Panel({

        }, Theme.Radius.Hud)
        Root.Name = Name

        return Root, Body
    end

    local function Render()
        local Track: any = Spotify.Track
        local Lyrics: {any}? = Track and Track.Lyrics or nil
        local Changed: boolean = Lyrics ~= Lines
        Lines = Lyrics
        if Changed then
            Timings = Measure(Lyrics or {})
        end
        for Name: string, v: View in Views do
            v.Title.Text = Track and Track.Name or "Spotify"
            v.Artist.Text = Track and Track.Artist or Spotify.Status
            local Asset: string = Track and Track.Cover or ""
            if v.Cover.Image ~= Asset then
                v.Cover.Image = Asset
                v.Cover.ImageTransparency = 1
                Ui:To(v.Cover, {ImageTransparency = Asset ~= "" and 0 or 1}, Theme.Smooth)
            end
            if v.Play then
                local Icon: string = Ui:Icon(Spotify.Playing and "pause" or "play", v.Play.Size.X.Offset)
                if v.Play.Image ~= Icon then
                    v.Play.Image = Icon
                end
            end
            if v.Reel and (Changed or #v.Reel.Labels == 0) then
                Fill(v.Reel, Name == "Fullscreen" and 30 or 15)
                task.defer(function()
                    if v.Reel then
                        Focus(v.Reel, 0, false, true)
                    end
                end)
            end
            if v.Line and Changed then
                v.Line.Text = Track and (Lyrics and "" or "No synced lyrics") or ""
            end
        end
    end

    local function Tick()
        local View: View? = Shown and Views[Layout] or nil
        if not View then
            return
        end

        local Track: any = Spotify.Track
        local Position: number = Spotify.Position()
        local Sung: number = Position + Shift
        View.Fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(Track and math.clamp(Position / Track.Duration, 0, 1) or 0, 1)
        if View.Spent and View.Left then
            View.Spent.Text = Clock(Position)
            View.Left.Text = Track and `-{Clock(Track.Duration - Position)}` or "0:00"
        end
        local Index: number = 0
        for Slot: number, v: Timing in Timings do
            if v.Start > Sung + 150 then
                break
            end
            Index = Slot
        end
        local Timing: Timing? = Timings[Index]
        local Reel: Reel? = View.Reel
        if Reel and #Reel.Labels > 0 then
            if Reel.Index ~= Index or Reel.Resting then
                Focus(Reel, Index, false, false)
            end
            Sing(Reel, Index, Sung)
        end
        local Line: TextLabel? = View.Line
        if Line and Lines then
            local Words: string = Timing and Timing.Text or ""
            if Line.Text ~= Words then
                Line.Text = Words
                Line.TextTransparency = 1
                Line.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(76, 48)
                Ui:To(Line, {TextTransparency = 0, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(76, 44)}, Theme.Show)
            end
            local Gradient: UIGradient? = Line:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")
            local Swept: number = Look.Mode ~= "Sweep" and 1 or Timing and math.clamp((Sung - Timing.Start) / (Timing.Finish - Timing.Start), 0, 1) or 1
            if Gradient then
                Gradient.Offset = Edge(Swept)
            end
        end
    end

    local function Apply()
        for Name: string, v: View in Views do
            local On: boolean = Shown and Name == Layout
            if v.Root.Visible ~= On then
                Ui:Fade(v.Root, On, On and Theme.Show or Theme.Hide)
            end
        end
        if Shown then
            Spotify.Start()
            Render()
            task.defer(function()
                local View: View? = Views[Layout]
                if View and View.Reel then
                    Focus(View.Reel, View.Reel.Index, View.Reel.Resting, true)
                end
            end)
        else
            Spotify.Stop()
        end
    end

        local Camera: Camera? = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local Screen: Vector2 = Camera and Camera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1920, 1080)

        for _, Name: string in {"Card", "Compact"} do
            Views[Name].Root.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(Spot.X, Spot.Y)
        end
    end

        end
    end)
    Ui:Connect(Services.UserInputService.InputEnded, function(Input: InputObject)

            Dragging = nil
            Pressing = false
        end
    end)

        return {Spot.X, Spot.Y}

        end
    end)

            Gui:Destroy()
        end)
    end
    Render()

    }

local function Read(Path: string): {[string]: any}?
    if not isfile(Path) then
        return
    end

    local Success: boolean, Result: any = pcall(function(): any
        return Services.HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(Path))
    end)

    return Success and type(Result) == "table" and Result or nil
end

local function Convert(Saved: any): any
    if type(Saved) ~= "table" then
        return
    end

    return if Saved.Hue ~= nil then {Hue = Saved.Hue, Sat = Saved.Sat, Value = Saved.Value, Opacity = Saved.Opacity, Rainbow = Saved.Rainbow == true}
        elseif Saved.ValueMin ~= nil then {Min = Saved.ValueMin, Max = Saved.ValueMax}
        elseif Saved.List ~= nil then {List = Saved.List, Enabled = Saved.ListEnabled or {}}
        elseif Saved.Enabled ~= nil then Saved.Enabled == true
        else Saved.Value
end

local function Add(Profile: {[string]: any}, Key: string, Module: any, Legit: boolean): ()
    if type(Module) ~= "table" then
        return
    end

    Profile[Key] = Module.Enabled == true
    local Bind: any = Module.Bind
    if type(Bind) == "table" then
        local Keys: {string} = if type(Bind.Keys) == "table" then Bind.Keys else Bind
        Profile[`{Key}#Bind`] = {Keys = Keys, Hold = Bind.Hold == true}
    elseif type(Bind) == "string" then
        Profile[`{Key}#Bind`] = {Keys = {Bind}, Hold = false}
    end
    if Module.Favorited ~= nil then
        Profile[`{Key}#Favorite`] = Module.Favorited
    end
    if Legit and type(Module.Position) == "table" and type(Module.Position.X) == "number" and type(Module.Position.Y) == "number" then
        Profile[`{Key}#Position`] = {X = Module.Position.X, Y = Module.Position.Y}
    end

    for Name: string, Saved: any in (type(Module.Options) == "table" and Module.Options or {}) do
        if Name == "Targets" and type(Saved) == "table" and Saved.Players ~= nil then
            for Old: string, New: string in Targets do
                if Saved[Old] ~= nil then
                    Profile[`{Key}/Targets/{New}`] = Saved[Old]
                end
            end
            continue
        end

        local Value: any = Convert(Saved)
        if Value ~= nil then
            Profile[`{Key}/{Name}`] = Value
        end
    end
end

local function Fold(Profile: {[string]: any}, Data: {[string]: any}): ()
    local Modules: {[string]: any} = type(Data.Modules) == "table" and Data.Modules or {}
    local Legit: {[string]: any} = type(Data.Legit) == "table" and Data.Legit or {}

    for _, v: {From: string, To: string, Legit: boolean} in Renamed do
        local Old: any = Modules[v.From] or Legit[v.From]
        if type(Old) == "table" and Profile[v.To] == nil then
            Add(Profile, v.To, Old, v.Legit)
        end
    end

    for _, v: {[string]: any} in Folded do
        local Old: any = Modules[v.From] or Legit[v.From]
        if type(Old) ~= "table" then
            continue
        end

        local Key: string = `Modules/{v.To}`
        local On: boolean = Old.Enabled == true
        if v.Option and v.Value == nil then
            Profile[`{Key}/{v.Option}`] = On
        elseif v.Option and On then
            Profile[`{Key}/{v.Option}`] = v.Value
        end
        if not (v.Enable and On) then
            continue
        end

        Profile[Key] = true
        for Option: string, Value: any in (v.Also or {}) do
            Profile[`{Key}/{Option}`] = Value
        end

        local Bind: any = Old.Bind
        local Current: any = Profile[`{Key}#Bind`]
        local Keys: any = type(Bind) == "table" and (if type(Bind.Keys) == "table" then Bind.Keys else Bind) or nil
        if type(Keys) == "table" and #Keys > 0 and (type(Current) ~= "table" or #(Current.Keys or {}) == 0) then
            Profile[`{Key}#Bind`] = {Keys = Keys, Hold = Bind.Hold == true}
        end
    end

    for _, Name: string in Kits do
        local Old: any = Modules[Name]
        if type(Old) == "table" and Old.Enabled == true then
            Profile[`Modules/{Renamed[Name] or Name}`] = true
        end
    end
end

local Port = {}

function Port.Found(): boolean
    if not isfolder(Folder) then
        return false
    end

    for _, Path: string in listfiles(Folder) do
        for _, Place: string in Places do
            if string.match(Path, `[^/\\]+{Place}%.txt$`) then
                return true
            end
        end
    end

    return false
end

function Port.Run(Force: boolean?): (number, string?)
    if not Force and #Store.List() > 0 or not isfolder(Folder) then
        return 0, nil
    end

    local Profiles: {[string]: {[string]: any}} = {}
    for _, Place: string in Places do
        for _, Path: string in listfiles(Folder) do
            local Name: string? = string.match(Path, `([^/\\]+){Place}%.txt$`)
            local Data: {[string]: any}? = Name and Read(Path)
            if not Name or not Data then
                continue
            end

            local Profile: {[string]: any} = Profiles[Name] or {}
            for Module: string, Saved: any in (type(Data.Modules) == "table" and Data.Modules or {}) do
                Add(Profile, `Modules/{Module}`, Saved, false)
            end
            for Module: string, Saved: any in (type(Data.Legit) == "table" and Data.Legit or {}) do
                Add(Profile, `Modules/Legit/{Module}`, Saved, true)
            end
            Fold(Profile, Data)
            Profiles[Name] = Profile
        end
    end

    local Taken: {string} = Store.List()
    local Written: {[string]: string} = {}
    local Count: number = 0
    for Name: string, Profile: {[string]: any} in Profiles do
        local Clean: string = Store.Clean(Name)
        if Clean ~= "" and next(Profile) then
            local Target: string = if table.find(Taken, Clean) then Store.Clean(`{Clean} old`) else Clean
            Store.Write(`{Store.Folder}/{Target}.json`, Profile)
            Written[Clean] = Target
            Count += 1
        end
    end

    local Gui: {[string]: any}? = Read(`{Folder}/2619619496.gui.txt`)
    local Current: string? = Gui and type(Gui.Profile) == "string" and Written[Store.Clean(Gui.Profile)] or nil
    if not Force and Current then
        Store.SetCurrent(Current)
    end

    return Count, Current
end

return Port]], "=ui/dropdown/libraries/Port"))(BundledModules)

local function Rescale()
    Pending = false
    if Auto ~= nil and not Auto.Enabled then
        local Pixels: number = math.max(math.round(14 * (Size and Size.Value or 1)), 6)
        Scale.Scale = if Pixels == 14 then 1 else (Pixels + 0.01) / 14
        return
    end

    local Width: number, Height: number = Gui.AbsoluteSize.X, Gui.AbsoluteSize.Y
    if Services.UserInputService.TouchEnabled then
        Scale.Scale = math.max(Width / 1920, 0.4)
        return
    end

    local Right: number, Bottom: number = 0, 0
    for _, v: GuiObject in Order do
        if v.Visible then
            Right = math.max(Right, v.Position.X.Offset + v.Size.X.Offset)
            Bottom = math.max(Bottom, v.Position.Y.Offset + v.Size.Y.Offset)
        end
    end

    local Fit: number = math.round(14 * math.min(Width / 1920, Height / 1080))
    local Room: number = if Sorting and Sorting.Enabled then Fit else math.floor(14 * math.min(Width / (Right + 6), Height / (Bottom + 6)))
    local Pixels: number = math.max(math.min(Fit, Room), if Services.UserInputService.TouchEnabled then 8 else 6)

    Scale.Scale = if Pixels == 14 then 1 else (Pixels + 0.01) / 14
end

local function Queue()
    if Pending or Ui.Dragging then
        return
    end

    Pending = true
    task.defer(Rescale)
end

local function Focus()
    local On: boolean = (Click.Visible or Legit.Holder.Visible) and Blur ~= nil and Blur.Enabled
    local Current: BlurEffect = Effect or Create.New("BlurEffect", {
        Enabled = false,
        Name = Services.HttpService:GenerateGUID(false),
        Size = 0,
        Parent = Services.Lighting
    })
    if not Effect then
        Effect = Current
        table.insert(Ui.Roots, Current)

        local Lens: DepthOfFieldEffect = Create.New("DepthOfFieldEffect", {
            FarIntensity = 0,
            InFocusRadius = 0.1,
            Name = Services.HttpService:GenerateGUID(false),
            NearIntensity = 1,
            Parent = Services.Lighting
        })
        table.insert(Ui.Roots, Lens)
    end
    Current.Size = On and (Intensity and Intensity.Value or 24) or 0
    Current.Enabled = On
end

    Click.Visible = Visible and not Legitimate
    Legit.Holder.Visible = Visible and Legitimate == true
    Tooltip.Visible = false
    Focus()
    if not Visible then
        return
    end

    for _, v: () -> () in Ui.Painters do
        v()
    end
    if Cursoring or not Services.UserInputService.MouseEnabled then
        return
    end

    Cursoring = Ui:Connect(Services.RunService.RenderStepped, function()
        if not Click.Visible and not Legit.Holder.Visible then
            Cursor.Visible = false
            if Cursoring then
                Cursoring:Disconnect()
                Cursoring = nil
            end

            return
        end

        Cursor.Visible = not Services.UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled
        if Cursor.Visible then
            local Mouse: Vector2 = Services.UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
            Cursor.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(Mouse.X - 31, Mouse.Y - 32)
        end
    end)
end

local Docks: {[GuiObject]: GuiObject} = {}
local Links: {[GuiObject]: {RBXScriptConnection}} = {}

local function Undock(Child: GuiObject)
    if not Links[Child] then
        return
    end

    for _, v: RBXScriptConnection in Links[Child] do
        v:Disconnect()
    end

    Links[Child] = nil
    Docks[Child] = nil
end

local function Dock(Child: GuiObject, Parent: GuiObject)
    Undock(Child)
    Docks[Child] = Parent

    local function Follow()
        local Below: number = Parent.Visible and Parent.Size.Y.Offset + 10 or 0
        Child.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(Parent.Position.X.Offset, Parent.Position.Y.Offset + Below)
    end

    Links[Child] = {}
    for _, v: string in {"Position", "Size", "Visible"} do
        table.insert(Links[Child], Parent:GetPropertyChangedSignal(v):Connect(Follow))
    end
    Follow()
end

local function Arrange(All: boolean)
    local List: {GuiObject} = {}
    for _, v: GuiObject in Order do
        if v == Main.Object then
            Undock(v)
            v.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 60)
        elseif All or v.Visible then
            Undock(v)
            table.insert(List, v)
        end
    end

    local Columns: number = math.max(math.floor((Gui.AbsoluteSize.X / Scale.Scale - 346) / 230), 1)
    for Index: number, v: GuiObject in List do
        if Index <= Columns then
            v.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(236 + (Index - 1) * 230, 60)
        else
            Dock(v, List[Index - Columns])
        end
    end

    Ui:Save()
end

local function Destroy()
    if Ui.Dead then
        return
    end

    Ui:Write()
    Ui.Dead = true
    for _, v: Module in Ui.Modules do
        v:Toggle(false)
    end
    for _, v: LegitModule in Legit.Modules do
        v:Toggle(false)
    end
    Ui:Clear(Maid)
    Ui:Destroy()
end

    Tooltip = "Removes catvape from the current game"

local function Migrate()
    local Count: number, Current: string? = Port.Run(true)
    if Count == 0 then
        Ui.Notify("Config port", "No old catvape BedWars config was found", 5, "warning")
        return
    end

    Saved.Build()
    if Current then
        Ui:Switch(Current)
    end
    Ui.Notify("Config ported", `Brought over {Count} profile{Count == 1 and "" or "s"} from the old catvape script`, 8)
    Ui:Save()
end

Prompt.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
    Prompt.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Hover
end)
Prompt.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
    Prompt.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Main
end)
Prompt.MouseButton1Click:Connect(Migrate)

local Touch: boolean = Services.UserInputService.TouchEnabled or not Services.UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled or shared.VapeDeveloper == true
if Touch then
    local PlayerGui: PlayerGui = Services.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    local Container: Instance? = nil
    local Stats: Instance? = nil
    local Hiding: boolean = false
    local Hidden: Toggle
    local Button: TextButton
    local Icon: ImageLabel
    local Previous: {[GuiObject]: boolean} = {}

    local function Conceal(Child: Instance): ()
        if Hiding and Child:IsA("GuiObject") and Child ~= Button then
            if Previous[Child] == nil then
                Previous[Child] = Child.Visible
            end
            Child.Visible = false
        end
    end

    local function Bar(Enabled: boolean): ()
        Hiding = Enabled
        if Enabled and Container then
            for _, v: Instance in Container:GetChildren() do
                Conceal(v)
            end
        end
        if Enabled and Stats then
            for _, v: Instance in Stats:GetChildren() do
                Conceal(v)
            end
        end
        if not Enabled then
            for Child: GuiObject, Visible: boolean in Previous do
                if Child.Parent then
                    Child.Visible = Visible
                end
            end
            table.clear(Previous)
        end
    end

    local function Paint(): ()
        if not Button then
            return
        end

        local Open: boolean = Click.Visible or Legit.Holder.Visible
        local Hide: boolean = not Open and Hidden ~= nil and Hidden.Enabled
        Button.BackgroundTransparency = Hide and 1 or 0.08
        Icon.ImageTransparency = Hide and 1 or 0
        Bar(Open and Blur ~= nil and Blur.Enabled)
    end

    local function Holder(): Instance
        if Stats and Stats:IsDescendantOf(PlayerGui) then
            return Stats
        end
        if Container and Container:IsDescendantOf(PlayerGui) then
            return Container
        end

        return Gui
    end

    local function Make(Parent: Instance): ()
        if Button then
            if Button.Parent == Parent then
                return
            end
            Button:Destroy()
        end

        Icon = Create.New("ImageLabel", {
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Image = Ui:Icon("vape"),
            Name = "Icon",
            Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 32),
            ZIndex = 11
        })
        Button = Create.New("TextButton", {
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 21),
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.08,
            LayoutOrder = -9999999,
            Name = "VapeButton",
            Position = UDim2.new(1, -90, 0, 4),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 44),
            Text = "",
            ZIndex = 10,
            Parent = Parent
        }, {Create.New("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)}), Icon})
        Paint()
        Button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            Show(not Click.Visible and not Legit.Holder.Visible)
        end)
    end

    local function Added(Child: Instance): ()
        local IsStats: boolean = Child.Name == "TopBarStatsGui"
        if Child.Name ~= "TopBarAppGui" and not IsStats then
            return
        end

        local Top: Instance? = Child:WaitForChild(IsStats and "TopBarStatsScroller" or "TopBarApp", 15)
        if IsStats and Top then
            Top = Top:WaitForChild("TopBarStats", 15)
        end
        if not Top or not Child.Parent or not Gui.Parent or (IsStats and Stats == Top) or (not IsStats and Container == Top) then
            return
        end

        if Child:IsA("ScreenGui") then
            local Order: number = Child.DisplayOrder
            Child.DisplayOrder = Gui.DisplayOrder + 1
            table.insert(Maid, function()
                Child.DisplayOrder = Order
            end)
            pcall(function()
                local OnTop: boolean = Child.OnTopOfCoreBlur
                Child.OnTopOfCoreBlur = true
                table.insert(Maid, function()
                    Child.OnTopOfCoreBlur = OnTop
                end)
            end)
        end

        local Was: boolean = Hiding
        Bar(false)
        if IsStats then
            Stats = Top
        else
            Container = Top
        end
        Make(Holder())
        Ui:Connect(Top.ChildAdded, Conceal)
        Bar(Was)
    end

    local function Removed(Child: Instance): ()
        if (Child.Name ~= "TopBarAppGui" and Child.Name ~= "TopBarStatsGui") or not Gui.Parent then
            return
        end

        local Was: boolean = Hiding
        Bar(false)
        if Container and not Container:IsDescendantOf(PlayerGui) then
            Container = nil
        end
        if Stats and not Stats:IsDescendantOf(PlayerGui) then
            Stats = nil
        end
        Make(Holder())
        Bar(Was)
    end

    Make(Gui)
    table.insert(Maid, function()
        Bar(false)
        Container = nil
        Stats = nil
        Button:Destroy()
    end)
    Ui:Connect(PlayerGui.ChildAdded, Added)
    Ui:Connect(PlayerGui.ChildRemoved, Removed)
    for _, Name: string in {"TopBarAppGui", "TopBarStatsGui"} do
        local Found: Instance? = PlayerGui:FindFirstChild(Name)
        if Found then
            table.insert(Maid, task.spawn(Added, Found))
        end
    end
    Ui:Connect(Click:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"), Paint)
    Ui:Connect(Legit.Holder:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"), Paint)
    Hidden = Interface:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Hide CatVape Button",
        Function = Paint,
        Tooltip = "Hides the button while the menu is closed"
    })
    Paint()
end

Ui:Connect(Services.UserInputService.InputBegan, function(Input: InputObject)
    if Input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift and Ui.Refresh then
        Ui.Refresh()
    end
    if Services.UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() or Input.KeyCode.Value == 0 or Ui.Binding then
        return
    end

    for v: Bind in Ui.Binds do
        if v.Keys[1] == Input.KeyCode.Name then
            task.spawn(v.Trigger, true)
        end
    end
end)
Ui:Connect(Services.UserInputService.InputEnded, function(Input: InputObject)
    if Input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift and Ui.Refresh then
        Ui.Refresh()
    end
    if Services.UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() or Input.KeyCode.Value == 0 then
        return
    end

    local Binding: Bind? = Ui.Binding
    if Binding then
        Ui.Binding = nil
        Binding:SetBind({Input.KeyCode.Name}, true)
        return
    end

    for v: Bind in Ui.Binds do
        if v.Hold and v.Keys[1] == Input.KeyCode.Name then
            task.spawn(v.Trigger, false)
        end
    end
end)
Ui:Connect(Gui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"), Rescale)
Rescale()

    Arrange(false)
end

Ui.Speed, Ui.Rate = Speed, Rate

table.insert(Maid, task.spawn(function()
    local Hue: number = 0
    repeat
        for v: ColorSlider in Ui.Rainbows do
            pcall(v.SetValue, v, Hue)
        end

        local Delta: number = task.wait(1 / Rate.Value)
        Hue = (Hue + Delta * 0.2 * Speed.Value) % 1
    until Ui.Dead
end))
table.insert(Maid, task.spawn(function()
    repeat
        task.wait(0.1)
        if (#Ui.Replay > 0 or #Ui.Queue > 0) and os.clock() - Ui.Last > 0.2 then
            local List: {() -> ()} = table.clone(Ui.Replay)
            table.move(Ui.Queue, 1, #Ui.Queue, #List + 1, List)
            table.clear(Ui.Replay)
            table.clear(Ui.Queue)
            for _, v: () -> () in List do
                local Success: boolean, Result: any = pcall(v)
                if not Success then
                    warn(`[catvape] failed to load a module state: {Result}`)
                end
            end
        end
    until Ui.Dead
end))

        if shared.BundleFrame and os.clock() - shared.BundleFrame > (os.clock() - shared.BundleStart > 0.6 and 0.016 or 0.006) and coroutine.isyieldable() then
            task.wait()
            shared.BundleFrame = os.clock()
        end

        BundledModules.CreateEvent = function()
            return setmetatable({}, {
                __index = function(self, Event: string)
                    local MetaTable: any; MetaTable = {
                        __index = {
                            Instance = Instance.new("BindableEvent"),
                            Fire = function(_, ...)
                                (rawget((rawget(MetaTable, "__index") :: any), "Instance") :: BindableEvent):Fire(...)
                            end
                        },
                        __metatable = {}
                    } :: {[any]: any}

                    for _, v in {"Connect", "ConnectParallel", "Once", "Wait"} do
                        local __index: any = rawget(MetaTable, "__index")
                        rawset(__index, v, function(_, ...)
                            local BindableEvent = (rawget(__index, "Instance") :: BindableEvent)
                            return BindableEvent.Event[v](BindableEvent.Event, ...)
                        end)
                    end

                    rawset(self, Event, setmetatable({}, MetaTable))
                    return rawget(self, Event)
                end
            })
        end

        if shared.BundleFrame and os.clock() - shared.BundleFrame > (os.clock() - shared.BundleStart > 0.6 and 0.016 or 0.006) and coroutine.isyieldable() then
            task.wait()
            shared.BundleFrame = os.clock()
        end

        BundledModules.TargetCheck = assert(loadstring([[
local BundledModules = ...
local Services = BundledModules.Services

local Function: (Player, Player, ((Player, Player) -> boolean)?) -> boolean = function(Local: Player, Target: Player, Custom: ((Player, Player) -> boolean)?): boolean
	if Custom then
		return Custom(Local, Target)
	end

	if #Services.Teams:GetChildren() > 0 then
		return Local.Team == nil or Local.Team ~= Target.Team
	end

	return true
end

return Function]], "=core/entity/components/TargetCheck"))(BundledModules)

        if shared.BundleFrame and os.clock() - shared.BundleFrame > (os.clock() - shared.BundleStart > 0.6 and 0.016 or 0.006) and coroutine.isyieldable() then
            task.wait()
            shared.BundleFrame = os.clock()
        end

        BundledModules.UI2 = assert(loadstring([[
local BundledModules = ...
local Queue: {any} = {}
shared.CatQueue = Queue

local Maid = {

		local Library: any = shared.Cat

            task.wait()
            shared.BundleFrame = os.clock()

        BundledModules.Entity = assert(loadstring([[
local BundledModules = ...
local CreateEvent = BundledModules.CreateEvent
local Services = BundledModules.Services
local TargetCheck = BundledModules.TargetCheck

local LocalPlayer = Services.Players.LocalPlayer

local UI = BundledModules.UI2

local Params: RaycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
Params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
Params.RespectCanCollide = true

local Entity = setmetatable({
	Entities = {},
	Events = CreateEvent()
}, {
	__index = function(self, Index: string): any
		local Local: any = rawget(self, "LocalPlayer")

		return Local and rawget(Local, Index) or nil
	end
})

Entity.Sorts = {
	Distance = function(Origin: Vector3, A: PlayerType, B: PlayerType): boolean
	    return ((A.RootPart :: BasePart).Position - Origin).Magnitude < ((B.RootPart :: BasePart).Position - Origin).Magnitude
	end,
	Health = function(Origin: Vector3, A: PlayerType2, B: PlayerType2): boolean
	    return (A.Humanoid :: Humanoid).Health < (B.Humanoid :: Humanoid).Health
	end,
	Mouse = (function()
	    local Services = BundledModules.Services

	    return function(_, A: Target, B: Target): boolean
	        local Camera: Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	        local Mouse: Vector2 = Services.UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
	        local First: Vector3, Shown: boolean = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(A.RootPart.Position)
	        local Second: Vector3, Seen: boolean = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(B.RootPart.Position)
	        local Left: number = Shown and (Vector2.new(First.X, First.Y) - Mouse).Magnitude or math.huge
	        local Right: number = Seen and (Vector2.new(Second.X, Second.Y) - Mouse).Magnitude or math.huge

	        return Left < Right
	    end
	end)(),
	Angle = function(Origin: Vector3, A: Target, B: Target): boolean
		local Look: Vector3 = Entity.RootPart.CFrame.LookVector * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
		local First: Vector3 = (A.RootPart.Position - Origin) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
		local Second: Vector3 = (B.RootPart.Position - Origin) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
		local Left: number = First.Magnitude > 0 and math.acos(math.clamp(Look:Dot(First.Unit), -1, 1)) or 0
		local Right: number = Second.Magnitude > 0 and math.acos(math.clamp(Look:Dot(Second.Unit), -1, 1)) or 0

		return Left < Right
	end
}

Entity.Priorities = {
	Closest = function(Origin: Vector3, Target: Target): number
		return (Target.RootPart.Position - Origin).Magnitude
	end,
	Farthest = function(Origin: Vector3, Target: Target): number
		return -(Target.RootPart.Position - Origin).Magnitude
	end,
	["Lowest health"] = function(_, Target: Target): number
		return Target.Humanoid.Health
	end,
	["Highest health"] = function(_, Target: Target): number
		return -Target.Humanoid.Health
	end,
	Crosshair = function(_, Target: Target): number
		local Camera: Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local Point: Vector3, Visible: boolean = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(Target.RootPart.Position)

		return Visible and (Vector2.new(Point.X, Point.Y) - Camera.ViewportSize / 2).Magnitude or math.huge
	end
}

Entity.Targets = function(Settings: Search): {Target}
	local Result: {Target} = {}
	local Local: any = rawget(Entity, "LocalPlayer")
	if not Local or not Local.Alive or not Local.RootPart then
		return Result
	end

	local Origin: Vector3 = Settings.Origin or Local.RootPart.Position
	local Camera: Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local Mouse: Vector2 = Settings.Mouse or Services.UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
	local Invisible: ((Target) -> boolean)? = rawget(Entity, "Invisible")
	for _, v: Target in Entity.Entities do
		local Character: Model? = v.Character
		if v.Self or not v.Alive or not Character or not Character.Parent or not v.RootPart or not v.Humanoid or v.Humanoid.Health <= 0 then
			continue
		end
		if (v.NPC and not Settings.NPCs) or (not v.NPC and Settings.Players == false) then
			continue
		end
		if not Settings.Teammates and not v.TargetCheck() then
			continue
		end
		if Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField") then
			continue
		end
		if Settings.Range and (v.RootPart.Position - Origin).Magnitude > Settings.Range then
			continue
		end
		if Settings.Invisible then
			local Head: BasePart? = Character:FindFirstChild("Head") :: BasePart?
			if (Invisible and Invisible(v)) or (not Invisible and Head and Head.Transparency >= 1) then
				continue
			end
		end
		if Settings.FOV then
			local Point: Vector3, Visible: boolean = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(v.RootPart.Position)
			if not Visible or (Vector2.new(Point.X, Point.Y) - Mouse).Magnitude > Settings.FOV then
				continue
			end
		end
		if Settings.Wallcheck then
			local Ignore: {Instance} = {Character, Camera}
			if Local.Character then
				table.insert(Ignore, Local.Character)
			end
			Params.FilterDescendantsInstances = Ignore
			if workspace:Raycast(Origin, v.RootPart.Position - Origin, Params) then
				continue
			end
		end
		if Settings.Check and not Settings.Check(v) then
			continue
		end

		table.insert(Result, v)
	end

	local Sort: any = Settings.Sort
	local Order: (Vector3, Target, Target) -> boolean = type(Sort) == "function" and Sort or Entity.Sorts[Sort or "Distance"] or Entity.Sorts.Distance
	if Sort == "Mouse" then
		local Gaps: {[Target]: number} = {}
		for _, v: Target in Result do
			local Point: Vector3, Visible: boolean = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(v.RootPart.Position)
			Gaps[v] = Visible and (Vector2.new(Point.X, Point.Y) - Mouse).Magnitude or math.huge
		end

		Order = function(_, A: Target, B: Target): boolean
			return Gaps[A] < Gaps[B]
		end
	end
	local Rank: ((Vector3, Target) -> number)? = Settings.Priority and Entity.Priorities[Settings.Priority]
	table.sort(Result, function(A: Target, B: Target): boolean
		if Rank then
			local Left: number, Right: number = Rank(Origin, A), Rank(Origin, B)
			if Left ~= Right then
				return Left < Right
			end
		end

		return Order(Origin, A, B)
	end)

	return Result
end

local function Added(Player: Player)
	local PlayerTable = {
		Alive = false,
		Connections = {},
		Name = Player.Name,
		Player = Player,
		Self = Player == LocalPlayer,
		Health = 0,
		MaxHealth = 100,
		TargetCheck = function(Target: Player?): boolean
			return TargetCheck(Target or LocalPlayer, Player, rawget(Entity, "TeamCheck"))
		end
	}
	Entity.Entities[Player.UserId] = PlayerTable

	if PlayerTable.Self then
		Entity.LocalPlayer = PlayerTable
	end

	local function Load(Character: Model)
		local Humanoid: Humanoid? = Character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10) :: Humanoid?
		local Root: BasePart? = Character.PrimaryPart or Character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10) :: BasePart?
		if not Humanoid or not Root or Player.Character ~= Character or Humanoid.Health <= 0 then
			return
		end

		PlayerTable.Character = Character
		PlayerTable.Humanoid = Humanoid
		PlayerTable.RootPart = Root
		PlayerTable.Health = Humanoid.Health
		PlayerTable.MaxHealth = Humanoid.MaxHealth
		PlayerTable.Alive = true

		table.insert(PlayerTable.Connections, Humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(function(Health: number)
			PlayerTable.Health = Health
			PlayerTable.MaxHealth = Humanoid.MaxHealth
		end))
		table.insert(PlayerTable.Connections, Humanoid.Died:Once(function()
			if PlayerTable.Alive and PlayerTable.Character == Character then
				PlayerTable.Alive = false
				PlayerTable.Character = nil

				Entity.Events.Died:Fire(PlayerTable)
			end
		end))
	end

	table.insert(PlayerTable.Connections, Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(Load))
	table.insert(PlayerTable.Connections, Player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(Character: Model)
		if PlayerTable.Character == Character then
			PlayerTable.Alive = false
			PlayerTable.Character = nil
		end
	end))
	if Player.Character then
		task.spawn(Load, Player.Character)
	end
end

Entity.Remove = function(Index: any)
	local PlayerTable = rawget(Entity.Entities, Index)
	if not PlayerTable then
		return
	end

	for __, Connection: RBXScriptConnection in PlayerTable.Connections do
		if Connection.Connected then
			Connection:Disconnect()
		end
	end

	Entity.Entities[Index] = nil
end

Entity.Add = function(Character: Model, Check: ((Target) -> boolean)?): Target?
	if rawget(Entity.Entities, Character) or Services.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(Character) then
		return rawget(Entity.Entities, Character)
	end

	local Humanoid: Humanoid? = Character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10) :: Humanoid?
	local Root: BasePart? = Character.PrimaryPart or Character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10) :: BasePart?
	if not Humanoid or not Root or not Character.Parent or rawget(Entity.Entities, Character) then
		return rawget(Entity.Entities, Character)
	end

	local PlayerTable
	PlayerTable = {
		Alive = Humanoid.Health > 0,
		Connections = {},
		Name = Character.Name,
		NPC = true,
		Self = false,
		Character = Character,
		Humanoid = Humanoid,
		RootPart = Root,
		Health = Humanoid.Health,
		MaxHealth = Humanoid.MaxHealth,
		TargetCheck = function(): boolean
			return not Check or Check(PlayerTable)
		end
	}
	Entity.Entities[Character] = PlayerTable

	table.insert(PlayerTable.Connections, Humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(function(Health: number)
		PlayerTable.Health = Health
		PlayerTable.MaxHealth = Humanoid.MaxHealth
	end))
	table.insert(PlayerTable.Connections, Humanoid.Died:Once(function()
		if PlayerTable.Alive then
			PlayerTable.Alive = false

			Entity.Events.Died:Fire(PlayerTable)
		end
	end))
	table.insert(PlayerTable.Connections, Character.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
		if not Character:IsDescendantOf(game) then
			Entity.Remove(Character)
		end
	end))

	return PlayerTable
end

        BundledModules.Motion = function(Position: Vector3, Velocity: Vector3, Target: Vector3, Accel: number, Gravity: number, Airborne: boolean, Time: number): (Vector3, Vector3)
            local Flat: Vector3 = Vector3.new(Velocity.X, 0, Velocity.Z)
            local Gap: Vector3 = Flat - Target
            local Span: number = Gap.Magnitude
            local Settle: number = math.min(Span / Accel, Time)
            local Pull: Vector3 = if Span > 1e-6 then Gap / Span * Accel else Vector3.zero
            local Moved: Vector3 = Flat * Settle - Pull * (0.5 * Settle * Settle) + Target * (Time - Settle)
            local Now: Vector3 = if Settle < Time then Target else Flat - Pull * Time
            local Rise: number = if Airborne then Velocity.Y * Time - 0.5 * Gravity * Time * Time else 0
            local Vertical: number = if Airborne then Velocity.Y - Gravity * Time else 0

            return Position + Moved + Vector3.new(0, Rise, 0), Now + Vector3.new(0, Vertical, 0)
        end

        BundledModules.Fall = {
            Constants = BundledModules.Constants,
            Floor = (function()
                local Constants = BundledModules.Constants

                return function(Map: Instance): number
                    local Floor: number = math.huge
                    for _, v: Instance in Map:GetDescendants() do
                        if v:IsA("BasePart") and v.CanCollide then
                            local Bottom: number = v.Position.Y - (v.Size.Y + math.abs(v.CFrame.UpVector.X) * v.Size.X + math.abs(v.CFrame.UpVector.Z) * v.Size.Z) / 2
                            Floor = math.min(Floor, Bottom)
                        end
                    end

                    return if Floor == math.huge then -math.huge else Floor - Constants.Void
                end
            end)(),
            Ledger = (function()
                local Constants = BundledModules.Constants

                return function(Ledger: FallLedger, Root: BasePart, Feet: number, Params: RaycastParams): boolean
                    local Half: Vector3 = Root.Size * 0.5 * Constants.Corner
                    local Probe: Vector3 = Vector3.new(0, -(Feet + Constants.Probe), 0)
                    local Stable: boolean = true
                    for _, v: Vector3 in {Vector3.new(Half.X, 0, Half.Z), Vector3.new(-Half.X, 0, Half.Z), Vector3.new(Half.X, 0, -Half.Z), Vector3.new(-Half.X, 0, -Half.Z)} do
                        Stable = Stable and workspace:Raycast(Root.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(v), Probe, Params) ~= nil
                    end

                    local Last: FallSpot? = Ledger.Spots[#Ledger.Spots]
                    if Stable and (not Last or (Last.CFrame.Position - Root.Position).Magnitude > Constants.Spacing) then
                        table.insert(Ledger.Spots, {CFrame = Root.CFrame, Time = os.clock()})
                        if #Ledger.Spots > Ledger.Size then
                            table.remove(Ledger.Spots, 1)
                        end
                    end

                    return Stable
                end
            end)(),
            Predict = (function()
                local Constants = BundledModules.Constants
                local Motion = BundledModules.Motion

                return function(State: FallState): FallPrediction
                    local Gravity: number = workspace.Gravity
                    local Position: Vector3, Velocity: Vector3 = State.Position, State.Velocity
                    local Grounded: boolean = State.Grounded
                    local Time: number, Peak: number = 0, Position.Y
                    local Edge: number? = if Grounded then nil else 0
                    local Land: Vector3?, Kind: string? = nil, nil
                    local Lift: Vector3 = Vector3.new(0, State.Body - State.Radius, 0)
                    local Legs: Vector3 = Vector3.new(0, -State.Feet, 0)
                    local Probe: Vector3 = Vector3.new(0, -(State.Feet + Constants.Probe), 0)
                    local Aim: Vector3? = State.Aim

                    repeat
                        local Rate: number = if State.Instant then Constants.Accel.Instant elseif Grounded then Constants.Accel.Ground else Constants.Accel.Air
                        local Target: Vector3 = State.Target
                        if Aim then
                            local Gap: Vector3 = (Aim - Position) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
                            local Reach: number = Gap.Magnitude
                            local Brake: number = math.min(State.Speed or Target.Magnitude, math.sqrt(2 * Rate * Reach))
                            Target = if Reach > 1e-3 then Gap / Reach * Brake else Vector3.zero
                        end

                        local Speed: number = math.max(Velocity.Magnitude, Target.Magnitude, 1)
                        local Step: number = math.clamp(Constants.Stride / Speed, Constants.Step.Min, Constants.Step.Max)
                        local Next: Vector3, After: Vector3 = Motion(Position, Velocity, Target, Rate, Gravity, not Grounded, Step)
                        local Path: Vector3 = Next - Position

                        if Grounded then
                            local Wall: RaycastResult? = Path.Magnitude > 1e-3 and workspace:Raycast(Position, Path, State.Params) or nil
                            if Wall and Wall.Normal.Y < Constants.Slope then
                                Next, After = Vector3.new(Position.X, Next.Y, Position.Z), Vector3.new(0, After.Y, 0)
                            end

                            local Support: RaycastResult? = workspace:Raycast(Next, Probe, State.Params)
                            if Support and Support.Normal.Y >= Constants.Slope then
                                Next = Vector3.new(Next.X, Support.Position.Y + State.Feet, Next.Z)
                            else
                                Grounded, Edge = false, Time + Step
                                After = Vector3.new(After.X, math.min(Velocity.Y, 0), After.Z)
                            end
                        else
                            local Hit: RaycastResult? = Path.Magnitude > 1e-3 and workspace:Spherecast(Position - Lift, State.Radius, Path, State.Params) or nil
                            local Share: number = if Hit then math.clamp(Hit.Distance / Path.Magnitude, 0, 1) else 1
                            local Contact: Vector3 = Position + Path * Share
                            local Footing: RaycastResult? = After.Y <= 0 and workspace:Raycast(Contact, Legs, State.Params) or nil
                            if Footing and Footing.Normal.Y >= Constants.Slope then
                                local Above: number = Position.Y - State.Feet - Footing.Position.Y
                                local Sink: number = Position.Y - Contact.Y
                                local Part: number = if Above > 0 and Sink > 1e-6 then math.clamp(Above / Sink, 0, 1) * Share else Share
                                Land = Footing.Position
                                Step *= Part
                                Next = Position + Path * Part
                            elseif Hit and Hit.Normal.Y >= Constants.Slope then
                                Land = Hit.Position
                                Step *= Share
                                Next = Contact
                            elseif Hit then
                                local Push: number = After:Dot(Hit.Normal)
                                After = if Push < 0 then After - Hit.Normal * Push else After
                                Next = Vector3.new(Position.X, Next.Y, Position.Z)
                            end

                            Peak = math.max(Peak, Next.Y)
                            Kind = if not Land and Next.Y - State.Feet < State.Void then "Void" else nil
                        end

                        Position, Velocity, Time = Next, After, Time + Step
                    until Land or Kind or Time >= Constants.Horizon or (Grounded and Time >= Constants.Lookahead)

                    if not Land and not Kind and not Grounded then
                        local Below: RaycastResult? = workspace:Raycast(Position, Vector3.new(0, -1000, 0), State.Params)
                        local Height: number = Position.Y - State.Feet - (if Below then Below.Position.Y else State.Void)
                        local Rise: number = Velocity.Y
                        Time += (Rise + math.sqrt(math.max(Rise * Rise + 2 * Gravity * math.max(Height, 0), 0))) / Gravity
                        Land = if Below then Below.Position else nil
                        Kind = if Below then nil else "Void"
                    end

                    local Drop: number = if Land then Peak - State.Feet - Land.Y else 0
                    Kind = Kind or (if Drop >= Constants.Lethal then "Lethal" else nil)

                    return {
                        Danger = Kind ~= nil,
                        Kind = Kind,
                        Time = Time,
                        Edge = Edge,
                        Ground = if Land then Time elseif Grounded then 0 else nil,
                        Land = Land,
                        Drop = Drop,
                        Peak = Peak
                    }
                end
            end)()
        }

local Models: {[string]: {Fit: (number, any) -> boolean?, At: (any, number) -> (number, number)}} = {
	Kin = (function()

	            return M.X0 + M.VX * (Time - M.T0), M.Z0 + M.VZ * (Time - M.T0)
	        end
	    }
	end)(),
	Line = (function()
	    local Linear = BundledModules.Linear
	    local Tune = BundledModules.Tune

	    return {

	            return Linear(Hi, Tune.Wl, M)

	        end
	    }
	end)(),
	Strafe = (function()
	    local Fit = BundledModules.Fit
	    local Samples = BundledModules.Samples
	    local Tune = BundledModules.Tune

	    local Scratch = {
	        X = 0,
	        Y = 0,
	        Z = 0,
	        VX = 0,
	        VY = 0,
	        VZ = 0
	    }

	    local U: {number} = table.create(Samples.Cap, 0)
	    local TT: {number} = table.create(48, 0)
	    local TU: {number} = table.create(48, 0)
	    local TS: {number} = table.create(48, 0)

	    return {
	        Fit = function(Hi: number, M: Motion5): boolean?
	            if not Tune.Patterns then

	            end

	            local Lo: number = Hi
	            while Lo > 1 and Samples.Buffer.T[Hi] - Samples.Buffer.T[Lo - 1] <= Tune.Ws do
	                Lo -= 1
	            end

	            if Hi - Lo + 1 < 16 or Samples.Buffer.T[Hi] - Samples.Buffer.T[Lo] < Tune.Ws * 0.6 then
	                return
	            end

	            Fit(Lo, Hi, Scratch)

	            local Sxx, Sxz, Szz = 0, 0, 0
	            for i = Lo, Hi do
	                local Tau: number = Samples.Buffer.T[i] - Samples.Buffer.T[Hi]

	                local Rz: number = Samples.Buffer.Z[i] - (Scratch.Z + Scratch.VZ * Tau)
	                Sxx += Rx * Rx
	                Sxz += Rx * Rz
	                Szz += Rz * Rz
	            end

	            local Spread: number = math.sqrt((Sxx - Szz) ^ 2 + 4 * Sxz * Sxz)
	            if (Sxx + Szz - Spread) > 0.25 * (Sxx + Szz + Spread) then

	            end

	            local Angle: number = 0.5 * math.atan2(2 * Sxz, Sxx - Szz)
	            local DX, DZ = math.cos(Angle), math.sin(Angle)
	            local Min, Max = math.huge, -math.huge

	                local Tau: number = Samples.Buffer.T[i] - Samples.Buffer.T[Hi]
	                U[i] = (Samples.Buffer.X[i] - (Scratch.X + Scratch.VX * Tau)) * DX + (Samples.Buffer.Z[i] - (Scratch.Z + Scratch.VZ * Tau)) * DZ
	                Min, Max = math.min(Min, U[i]), math.max(Max, U[i])
	            end

	            if Max - Min < 1.2 then
	                return
	            end

	            while Start <= Hi and math.abs(U[Start] - U[Lo]) < Delta do
	                Start += 1
	            end

	            if Start > Hi then
	                return
	            end

	            local ExtU, ExtT = U[Start], Samples.Buffer.T[Start]

	            for j = Start + 1, Hi do
	                if Sign * U[j] > Sign * ExtU then
	                    ExtU, ExtT = U[j], Samples.Buffer.T[j]
	                elseif Sign * (ExtU - U[j]) >= Delta and K < 40 then
	                    K += 1
	                    TT[K], TU[K], TS[K] = ExtT, ExtU, Sign
	                    Sign = -Sign
	                    ExtU, ExtT = U[j], Samples.Buffer.T[j]
	                end
	            end

	            if K < 3 then
	                return
	            end

	            local Mean: number = (TT[K] - TT[1]) / (K - 1)
	            local Var: number = 0
	            for k = 1, K - 1 do
	                Var += (TT[k + 1] - TT[k] - Mean) ^ 2
	            end

	            local Std: number = math.sqrt(Var / (K - 1))
	            if Mean < 0.12 or Mean > 1.5 or Std > Tune.StrafeCV * Mean then
	                return
	            end

	            local HiSum, HiCount, LoSum, LoCount = 0, 0, 0, 0
	            for k = 1, K do
	                if TS[k] > 0 then
	                    HiSum, HiCount = HiSum + TU[k], HiCount + 1
	                else
	                    LoSum, LoCount = LoSum + TU[k], LoCount + 1
	                end
	            end

	            M.Hi, M.Lo = HiSum / HiCount, LoSum / LoCount
	            if M.Hi - M.Lo < 1 then
	                return
	            end

	            M.T0, M.X0, M.Z0, M.VX, M.VZ = Samples.Buffer.T[Hi], Scratch.X, Scratch.Z, Scratch.VX, Scratch.VZ
	            M.DX, M.DZ, M.Mid, M.Half, M.Sig, M.TK, M.Up = DX, DZ, (M.Hi + M.Lo) / 2, Mean, math.max(Std, 0.02), TT[K], TS[K]

	            return true
	        end,
	        At = function(M: Motion5, Time: number): (number, number)
	            local Q: number = ((Time - M.TK) / M.Half) % 2
	            Q = Q > 1 and 2 - Q or Q

	            local From: number = M.Up > 0 and M.Hi or M.Lo
	            local To: number = M.Up > 0 and M.Lo or M.Hi
	            local Sigma: number = M.Sig * math.sqrt(math.max(1, (Time - M.TK) / M.Half))
	            local R: number = M.Mid + math.exp(-0.5 * (math.pi * Sigma / M.Half) ^ 2) * (From + (To - From) * Q - M.Mid)

	            return M.X0 + M.VX * (Time - M.T0) + M.DX * R, M.Z0 + M.VZ * (Time - M.T0) + M.DZ * R
	        end
	    }
	end)(),
	Circle = (function()
	    local Samples = BundledModules.Samples
	    local Tune = BundledModules.Tune

	    return {
	        Fit = function(Hi: number, M: Motion6): boolean?
	            if not Tune.Patterns then
	                return
	            end

	            local Lo: number = Hi
	            while Lo > 1 and Samples.Buffer.T[Hi] - Samples.Buffer.T[Lo - 1] <= Tune.Wc do
	                Lo -= 1
	            end

	            local N: number = Hi - Lo + 1
	            local Span: number = Samples.Buffer.T[Hi] - Samples.Buffer.T[Lo]
	            if N < 16 or Span < Tune.Wc * 0.55 then
	                return
	            end

	            local Mx, Mz = 0, 0
	            for i = Lo, Hi do
	                Mx += Samples.Buffer.X[i]
	                Mz += Samples.Buffer.Z[i]
	            end

	            Mx, Mz = Mx / N, Mz / N

	            local Suu, Svv, Suv, Suuu, Svvv, Suvv, Svuu = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
	            for i = Lo, Hi do
	                local A: number, B: number = Samples.Buffer.X[i] - Mx, Samples.Buffer.Z[i] - Mz
	                Suu += A * A
	                Svv += B * B
	                Suv += A * B
	                Suuu += A * A * A
	                Svvv += B * B * B
	                Suvv += A * B * B
	                Svuu += B * A * A
	            end

	            local Den: number = 2 * (Suu * Svv - Suv * Suv)
	            if math.abs(Den) < 1e-6 then
	                return
	            end

	            local Uc: number = (Svv * (Suuu + Suvv) - Suv * (Svvv + Svuu)) / Den
	            local Vc: number = (Suu * (Svvv + Svuu) - Suv * (Suuu + Suvv)) / Den
	            local R: number = math.sqrt(Uc * Uc + Vc * Vc + (Suu + Svv) / N)
	            local CX, CZ = Mx + Uc, Mz + Vc
	            if R < 0.8 or R > 50 then
	                return
	            end

	            local Prev: number = math.atan2(Samples.Buffer.Z[Lo] - CZ, Samples.Buffer.X[Lo] - CX)
	            local Phi: number = Prev
	            local S1, S2, Sp, Spt, Resid = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
	            for i = Lo, Hi do
	                local Angle: number = math.atan2(Samples.Buffer.Z[i] - CZ, Samples.Buffer.X[i] - CX)
	                local Step: number = Angle - Prev
	                Phi += Step - 2 * math.pi * math.floor((Step + math.pi) / (2 * math.pi))
	                Prev = Angle

	                local Tau: number = Samples.Buffer.T[i] - Samples.Buffer.T[Hi]
	                S1 += Tau
	                S2 += Tau * Tau
	                Sp += Phi
	                Spt += Phi * Tau
	                Resid += (math.sqrt((Samples.Buffer.X[i] - CX) ^ 2 + (Samples.Buffer.Z[i] - CZ) ^ 2) - R) ^ 2
	            end

	            local Slope: number = (N * Spt - S1 * Sp) / (N * S2 - S1 * S1)
	            if math.sqrt(Resid / N) > 0.1 * R + 0.2 or math.abs(Slope) < 0.6 or math.abs(Slope) * Span < 0.8 or R * math.abs(Slope) < 3 then
	                return
	            end

	            M.T0, M.CX, M.CZ, M.R, M.W, M.Phi = Samples.Buffer.T[Hi], CX, CZ, R, Slope, (Sp - Slope * S1) / N

	            return true
	        end,
	        At = function(M: Motion6, Time: number): (number, number)
	            return M.CX + M.R * math.cos(M.Phi + M.W * (Time - M.T0)), M.CZ + M.R * math.sin(M.Phi + M.W * (Time - M.T0))
	        end
	    }
	end)()
}

Models.Idle = Models.Kin

Pattern.Select = function(N: number, Out: Motion7)
	local Train: number = N
	while Train > 1 and Samples.Buffer.T[Train] > Samples.Buffer.T[N] - Tune.Hb do
		Train -= 1
	end

	Linear(N, Tune.Wl, Cand.Line)
	Out.SVX, Out.SVZ = Cand.Line.VX, Cand.Line.VZ

	local Kind: string = "Kin"
	local Best: number = math.huge
	if Train >= 6 and N - Train >= 3 then
		table.clear(Errs)
		for _, v: string in Kinds do
			Cand[v].Kind = v
			if not Models[v].Fit(Train, Cand[v]) then
				continue
			end

			local Sum: number = 0
			for j = Train + 1, N do
				local X: number, Z: number = Models[v].At(Cand[v], Samples.Buffer.T[j])
				Sum += (X - Samples.Buffer.X[j]) ^ 2 + (Z - Samples.Buffer.Z[j]) ^ 2
			end

			Errs[v] = math.sqrt(Sum / (N - Train))
		end

		local Score: number = math.huge
		for _, v: string in Kinds do
			if v ~= "Strafe" and v ~= "Circle" and Errs[v] and Errs[v] * (v == "Vel" and Tune.VelBias or 1) < Score then
				Kind, Best, Score = v, Errs[v], Errs[v] * (v == "Vel" and Tune.VelBias or 1)
			end
		end

		local Base: number = Best
		for _, v: string in Kinds do
			if (v == "Strafe" or v == "Circle") and Errs[v] and Errs[v] < Tune.Win * Base and Errs[v] < Best then
				Kind, Best = v, Errs[v]
			end
		end
	end

	Out.Kind = Kind
	if not Models[Kind].Fit(N, Out) then
		Out.Kind = "Kin"
		Out.T0, Out.X0, Out.Z0, Out.VX, Out.VZ = Samples.Buffer.T[N], Samples.Buffer.X[N], Samples.Buffer.Z[N], 0, 0
		Linear(N, Tune.Wk, Out)
	end

	Out.Err = Best == math.huge and 5 or Best
	if (Out.Kind == "Kin" or Out.Kind == "Line" or Out.Kind == "Vel") and math.sqrt(Out.VX ^ 2 + Out.VZ ^ 2) < Tune.Dead then
		Out.Kind, Out.VX, Out.VZ = "Idle", 0, 0
	end
end

Predict.NewOut = function(): Out

		Y = 0,
		Z = 0,
		Conf = 0,
		Kind = "None",
		Model = Pattern.NewModel()
	}

Predict.Run = function(Track: Track3, Horizon: number, World: World, Out: Out)
	local N: number = Samples.Gather(Track, 1.7)
	if N < 3 then
		Out.X, Out.Y, Out.Z, Out.Conf, Out.Kind = Samples.Buffer.X[N] or 0, Samples.Buffer.Y[N] or 0, Samples.Buffer.Z[N] or 0, 0, "None"
		return
	end

	local H: number = math.clamp(Horizon, 0, 10)
	Pattern.Select(N, Out.Model)

	local X0: number, Z0: number = Pattern.At(Out.Model, Samples.Buffer.T[N])
	local Gravity: number = Tune.Vertical and World.Gravity or 0
	local Air: boolean = not (Tune.Vertical and World.Grounded)
	local Lo: number = N
	while Lo > 1 and Samples.Buffer.T[N] - Samples.Buffer.T[Lo - 1] <= (Tune.Vertical and Tune.Wa or Tune.Wk) do
		Lo -= 1
	end

	for i = Lo, N do
		Samples.Buffer.Y[i] += 0.5 * Gravity * (Samples.Buffer.T[i] - Samples.Buffer.T[N]) ^ 2
	end

	Fit(Lo, N, Scratch)

	local Y: number = Air and Scratch.Y or Samples.Buffer.Y[N]
	local VY: number = Air and Scratch.VY or 0
	if Air and Tune.Vertical and Out.Model.Kind == "Vel" then
		Y, VY = Samples.Buffer.Y[N], Samples.Buffer.VY[N]
	end

	local PX: number, PZ: number = X0, Z0
	local Steps: number = math.clamp(math.ceil(H / 0.1), 1, 10)
	local Prev: number = 0
	for k = 1, Steps do
		local Tau: number = H * k / Steps
		local Dt: number = Tau - Prev
		Prev = Tau

		local MX: number, MZ: number = Pattern.At(Out.Model, Samples.Buffer.T[N] + Tau)
		local DX: number, DZ: number = MX - X0, MZ - Z0
		if Tune.Long then
			local Decay: number = Tune.TauD * (1 - math.exp(-Tau / Tune.TauD))
			local Keep: number = Tau <= Tune.W0 and 1 or math.exp(-(Tau - Tune.W0) / Tune.Tw)
			DX, DZ = Out.Model.SVX * Decay + Keep * (DX - Out.Model.SVX * Decay), Out.Model.SVZ * Decay + Keep * (DZ - Out.Model.SVZ * Decay)
		end

		local TX: number, TZ: number = X0 + DX, Z0 + DZ
		if Tune.Collision and World.Block then
			local F: number?, NX: number, NZ: number = World.Block(PX, Y, PZ, TX, TZ)
			if F then
				local Gap: number = math.max(0, F - 0.05 / math.max(math.sqrt((TX - PX) ^ 2 + (TZ - PZ) ^ 2), 0.05))
				local Into: number = math.min(((TX - PX) * NX + (TZ - PZ) * NZ) * (1 - Gap), 0)
				TX, TZ = TX - Into * NX, TZ - Into * NZ
			end
		end

		PX, PZ = TX, TZ

		if not Tune.Vertical then
			Y += VY * Dt
		elseif Air then
			local NextY: number = Y + VY * Dt - 0.5 * Gravity * Dt * Dt
			local NextVY: number = VY - Gravity * Dt
			local Floor: number? = World.Floor and World.Floor(PX, Y, PZ)
			if Floor and NextVY <= 0 and NextY <= Floor + World.Offset then
				Y, VY, Air = Floor + World.Offset, 0, false
			else
				Y, VY = math.max(NextY, World.Void), NextVY
			end
		elseif World.Floor then
			local Floor: number? = World.Floor(PX, Y, PZ)
			if Floor then
				Y = Floor + World.Offset
			else
				VY, Air = 0, true
			end
		end
	end

	Out.X, Out.Y, Out.Z, Out.Kind = PX, Y, PZ, Out.Model.Kind
	Out.Conf = math.clamp(math.min(1, (Samples.Buffer.T[N] - Samples.Buffer.T[1]) / 0.5) / (1 + Out.Model.Err / Tune.ErrScale) * math.exp(-H / Tune.HScale), 0, 1)
end

return Predict]], "=games/bedwars/libraries/prediction/components/Predict"))(BundledModules)

Recorder.Report = function(): {[string]: {[number]: {Mean: number, P90: number, Count: number}}}
	local Result: {[string]: {[number]: {Mean: number, P90: number, Count: number}}} = {}
	for _, Variant: {[string]: any} in Variants do
		Result[Variant.Name] = {}

		local Line: string = string.format("%-15s", Variant.Name)
		for HI, H: number in Horizons do
			local List: {number} = table.clone(Errors[Variant.Name] and Errors[Variant.Name][HI] or {})
			table.sort(List)

			local Sum: number = 0
			for _, v: number in List do
				Sum += v
			end

			Result[Variant.Name][HI] = {Mean = Sum / math.max(#List, 1), P90 = List[math.max(1, math.ceil(#List * 0.9))] or 0, Count = #List}
			Line ..= string.format("  %.2fs %5.2f/%5.2f n=%d", H, Result[Variant.Name][HI].Mean, Result[Variant.Name][HI].P90, #List)
		end

		print(`[prediction] {Line}`)
	end

	return Result
end

Recorder.Start = function(Prediction: any, Raw: (any, number) -> (Vector3, number), Duration: number)
	Recorder.Stop()
	table.clear(Errors)

	local Started: number = os.clock()
	local Next: number = 0
	Connection = Services.RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local Now: number = os.clock()
		if Now - Started > Duration then
			Recorder.Stop()
			Recorder.Report()
			return
		end

		for Index = #Pending, 1, -1 do
			local v: {[string]: any} = Pending[Index]
			if Now < v.Due then
				continue
			end

			table.remove(Pending, Index)
			if not v.Root.Parent or not Prediction.State(v.Target) or Prediction.State(v.Target).Root ~= v.Root then
				continue
			end

			for Variant, Item: {[string]: any} in Variants do
				Errors[Item.Name] = Errors[Item.Name] or {}
				Errors[Item.Name][v.HI] = Errors[Item.Name][v.HI] or {}
				table.insert(Errors[Item.Name][v.HI], (v.Root.Position - v.Predicted[Variant]).Magnitude)
			end
		end

		if Now < Next then
			return
		end

		Next = Now + 0.1
		for _, v: any in Entity.Entities do
			if not Prediction.State(v) or Prediction.State(v).Track.Count < 30 or (v.Self and not Prediction.Self) then
				continue
			end

			for HI, H: number in Horizons do
				local Predicted: {Vector3} = {Prediction.State(v).Root.Position + Prediction.State(v).Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity * H}
				for Variant = 2, #Variants do
					Tune.Velocity, Tune.Patterns, Tune.Vertical, Tune.Collision, Tune.Long = Variants[Variant].Velocity, Variants[Variant].Patterns, Variants[Variant].Vertical, Variants[Variant].Collision, Variants[Variant].Long
					Predicted[Variant] = Raw(v, H)
				end

				table.insert(Pending, {Target = v, Root = Prediction.State(v).Root, HI = HI, Due = Now + H, Predicted = Predicted})
			end
		end

		Tune.Velocity, Tune.Patterns, Tune.Vertical, Tune.Collision, Tune.Long = true, true, true, true, true
	end)
end

return Recorder]], "=games/bedwars/libraries/prediction/components/Recorder"))(BundledModules)

local BundledModules = ...

local Dirty: boolean = true
local Running: boolean = false
local World = {
	Gravity = 196.2,
	Grounded = true,
	Offset = 3,
	Void = -500,
	Floor = function(X: number, Y: number, Z: number): number?
		local Result: RaycastResult? = workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(X, Y, Z), Vector3.new(0, -300, 0), Params)

		return Result and Result.Position.Y or nil
	end,
	Block = function(X: number, Y: number, Z: number, TX: number, TZ: number): (number?, number, number)
		local Direction: Vector3 = Vector3.new(TX - X, 0, TZ - Z)
		if Direction.Magnitude < 0.001 then
			return nil, 0, 0
		end

		local Result: RaycastResult? = workspace:Spherecast(Vector3.new(X, Y, Z), 1, Direction, Params)
		local Flat: Vector3 = Result and Vector3.new(Result.Normal.X, 0, Result.Normal.Z) or Vector3.zero
		if not Result or Flat.Magnitude < 0.3 then
			return nil, 0, 0
		end

		return Result.Distance / Direction.Magnitude, Flat.Unit.X, Flat.Unit.Z
	end
}

local Prediction = {
	Interp = Tune.Interp,
	Tune = Tune

local function Get(Target: any): State?
	local Player: Player? = typeof(Target) == "Instance" and Target or Target and Target.Player
	if not Player then
		return
	end

	return States[Player.UserId]
end

local function Stop()
	Running = false
	for _, Connection: RBXScriptConnection in Connections do
		if Connection.Connected then
			Connection:Disconnect()
		end
	end

	table.clear(Connections)
	table.clear(States)
end

local function Start()
	if Running then
		return
	end

	Running, Dirty = true, true
	table.insert(Connections, Services.RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local Now: number = os.clock()
		for User: number, v: any in Entity.Entities do
			if not v.Alive or not v.RootPart or not v.RootPart.Parent or not v.Humanoid or v.Humanoid.Health <= 0 then
				if States[User] then
					States[User], Dirty = nil, true
				end

				continue
			end

			local Position: Vector3 = v.RootPart.Position
			if not States[User] then
				States[User], Dirty = {Track = Samples.New(), Root = v.RootPart, Out = Predict.NewOut(), Offset = 3, OffsetAt = 0, Last = 0, Position = Position}, true
			end

			if States[User].Root ~= v.RootPart or (Position - States[User].Position).Magnitude > 200 * math.max(Now - States[User].Last, 1 / 60) then
				States[User].Track.Head, States[User].Track.Count, States[User].Root, Dirty = 0, 0, v.RootPart, true
			end

			if Now - States[User].Last >= 1 / 75 then
				local Velocity: Vector3 = v.RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity
				States[User].Last, States[User].Position = Now, Position
				Samples.Push(States[User].Track, Now, Position.X, Position.Y, Position.Z, Velocity.X, Velocity.Y, Velocity.Z)
			end
		end
	end))

	table.insert(Connections, Services.Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(Player: Player)
		States[Player.UserId], Dirty = nil, true
	end))
end

local function Run(Target: any, Horizon: number): (Vector3, number)
	local State: State? = Get(Target)
	if not State or not State.Root.Parent then
		return Vector3.zero, 0
	end

	if Dirty then
		local List: {Instance} = {}
		for _, v: State in States do
			if v.Root.Parent then
				table.insert(List, v.Root.Parent)
			end
		end

		Params.FilterDescendantsInstances, Dirty = List, false
	end

	local Humanoid: Humanoid? = State.Root.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	World.Gravity, World.Void = workspace.Gravity, workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight
	World.Grounded = not Humanoid or Humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air

	local Now: number = os.clock()
	if World.Grounded and Now - State.OffsetAt > 1 then
		local Floor: number? = World.Floor(State.Root.Position.X, State.Root.Position.Y, State.Root.Position.Z)
		State.Offset, State.OffsetAt = Floor and State.Root.Position.Y - Floor or State.Offset, Now
	end

	World.Offset = State.Offset
	Predict.Run(State.Track, Horizon, World, State.Out)

	return Vector3.new(State.Out.X, State.Out.Y, State.Out.Z), State.Out.Conf
end

Prediction.Stop = Stop

Prediction.Predict = function(Target: any, Seconds: number): (Vector3, number)
	return Run(Target, Seconds + Ping.Get() + Prediction.Interp)
end

Prediction.Record = function(Duration: number?)
	Recorder.Start(Prediction, Run, Duration or 60)
end

	Recorder.Stop()
	Stop()
end)
