local BundledModules = ...
local Prediction = BundledModules.Prediction

local Ballistic = {}

Ballistic.Point = function(Launch: Vector3, Point: Vector3, Speed: number, Gravity: number): (Vector3?, number)
	local Offset: Vector3 = Point - Launch
	local Flat: Vector3 = Vector3.new(Offset.X, 0, Offset.Z)
	local Root: number = Speed ^ 4 - Gravity * (Gravity * Flat.Magnitude * Flat.Magnitude + 2 * Offset.Y * Speed * Speed)
	if Root < 0 or Flat.Magnitude < 0.01 then
		return nil, 0
	end

	local Pitch: number = Gravity > 0 and math.atan((Speed * Speed - math.sqrt(Root)) / (Gravity * Flat.Magnitude)) or math.atan2(Offset.Y, Flat.Magnitude)

	return Flat.Unit * math.cos(Pitch) + Vector3.yAxis * math.sin(Pitch), Flat.Magnitude / (Speed * math.cos(Pitch))
end

Ballistic.Solve = function(Target: Target, Launch: Vector3, Speed: number, Gravity: number, Lead: boolean?, Offset: Vector3?): (Vector3?, number, number)
	local Tracked: boolean = Prediction.State(Target) ~= nil
	local Time: number = (Target.RootPart.Position - Launch).Magnitude / Speed
	local Direction: Vector3?, Point: Vector3 = nil, Target.RootPart.Position
	for _ = 1, 4 do
		local Drift: Vector3 = Lead and Target.RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1) * Time or Vector3.zero
		Point = (Tracked and Prediction.Predict(Target, Time) or Target.RootPart.Position + Drift) + (Offset or Vector3.zero)

		local Next: number
		Direction, Next = Ballistic.Point(Launch, Point, Speed, Gravity)
		if not Direction then
			return nil, Time, (Point - Launch).Magnitude
		end

		Time = Next
	end

	return Direction, Time, (Point - Launch).Magnitude
end

Ballistic.Clear = function(Launch: Vector3, Velocity: Vector3, Gravity: number, Time: number, Params: RaycastParams): (boolean, RaycastResult?)
	local Last: Vector3 = Launch
	local Steps: number = math.clamp(math.ceil(Time / 0.05), 1, 60)
	for Step: number = 1, Steps do
		local Moment: number = Time * Step / Steps
		local Point: Vector3 = Launch + Velocity * Moment - Vector3.new(0, 0.5 * Gravity * Moment * Moment, 0)
		local Hit: RaycastResult? = workspace:Raycast(Last, Point - Last, Params)
		if Hit then
			return false, Hit
		end

		Last = Point
	end

	return true, nil
end

return Ballistic]], "=games/bedwars/components/Ballistic"))(BundledModules)

local function Update()
	local Now: {[string]: number} = os.date("*t")
	local Hour: number = TwentyFourHour.Enabled and Now.hour or (Now.hour > 12 and Now.hour - 12 or (Now.hour == 0 and 12 or Now.hour))
	local IsDigital: boolean = ClockType.Value == "Digital"
	local HourText: string = string.format("%02d", Hour)
	local MinuteText: string = string.format("%02d", Now.min)
	local Meridiem: string = Now.hour >= 12 and "pm" or "am"
	local Weekday: string = os.date("%a"):lower()
	local DateText: string = string.format(IsDigital and "%02d / %02d" or "%02d/%02d", American and Now.month or Now.day, American and Now.day or Now.month)

	Analog.Visible = not IsDigital
	Digital.Visible = IsDigital
	ShowDate.Object.Visible = IsDigital
	DigitalDate.Visible = ShowDate.Enabled
	DigitalWeekday.Visible = ShowDate.Enabled
	AnalogMeridiem.Visible = not TwentyFourHour.Enabled
	DigitalMeridiem.Visible = not TwentyFourHour.Enabled
	Holder.Size = IsDigital and UDim2.fromOffset(140 + (ShowDate.Enabled and 48 or 0) + (TwentyFourHour.Enabled and 0 or 24), 64) or UDim2.fromOffset(140, 130)
	Hand.Rotation = (Hour * 30) + (Now.min / 2)

	for Label: TextLabel, Text: string in {
		[AnalogHour] = HourText,
		[AnalogMinute] = MinuteText,
		[AnalogWeekday] = Weekday,
		[AnalogDate] = DateText,
		[AnalogMeridiem] = Meridiem,
		[DigitalHour] = HourText,
		[DigitalMinute] = MinuteText,
		[DigitalMeridiem] = Meridiem,
		[DigitalDate] = DateText,
		[DigitalWeekday] = Weekday
	} do
		Label.Text = Text
		Shadows[Label].Text = Text
	end

	for Label: TextLabel, Position: UDim2 in {
		[DigitalMeridiem] = UDim2.fromOffset(78 + UI.Context:Measure(MinuteText, 14, UI.Font).X * 2, 46),
		[DigitalDate] = UDim2.fromOffset(Holder.Size.X.Offset - 12, 24),
		[DigitalWeekday] = UDim2.fromOffset(Holder.Size.X.Offset - 12, 40)
	} do
		Label.Position = Position
		Shadows[Label].Position = Position + UDim2.fromOffset(1, 1)
	end

	for Label: TextLabel, Shadow: TextLabel in Shadows do
		Shadow.Visible = not Background.Enabled and Label.Visible
	end
end

        BundledModules.FFlagEditor = assert(loadstring([[
local BundledModules = ...
local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

local Services = BundledModules.Services

local FFlagEditor
local Box, List

local Directory: string = "catvape"
local Prefixes: {string} = {"DFFlag", "DFInt", "DFLog", "DFString", "SFFlag", "FFlag", "FInt", "FLog", "FString"}
local Marker: string = "CVFF1:"

local function Unpack(Text: string): string
	local Size: string?, Body: string? = Text:match(`^{Marker}(%d+):(.+)$`)
	if not Size or not Body then
		return Text
	end

	local Success: boolean, Plain: any = pcall(function(): string
		return lz4decompress(base64decode(Body :: string), tonumber(Size))
	end)

	return Success and type(Plain) == "string" and Plain or Text
end

local function Apply()
	if not FFlagEditor or not FFlagEditor.Enabled then
		return
	end
	if not setfflag then
		Cat:CreateNotification("FFlagEditor", "Your executor can't set fflags", 8, "warning")

		return
	end

	local Applied: number = 0
	for _, v: string in List.ListEnabled do
		local Name: string?, Value: string? = v:match("^%s*(.-)%s*=%s*(.-)%s*$")
		for _, Prefix: string in Prefixes do
			if Name and Name:sub(1, #Prefix) == Prefix then
				Name = Name:sub(#Prefix + 1)

				break
			end
		end

		if Name and Name ~= "" and Value and Value ~= "" and pcall(setfflag, Name, Value) then
			Applied += 1
		end
	end

	if Applied > 0 then
		Cat:CreateNotification("FFlagEditor", `Applied {Applied} fflag{Applied == 1 and "" or "s"}, join a new game for them to take effect`, 12, "info")
	end
end

local function Ingest(Text: string, Source: string)
	local Success: boolean, Json: any = pcall(function(): any
		return Services.HttpService:JSONDecode(Unpack(Text))
	end)
	if not Success or type(Json) ~= "table" then
		Cat:CreateNotification("FFlagEditor", `{Source} is not valid fflag json`, 12, "warning")

		return
	end

	local Added: number, Dropped: number = 0, 0
	for Key: any, v: any in Json do
		local Entry: string? = nil
		for _, Prefix: string in Prefixes do
			if type(Key) == "string" and #Key > #Prefix and Key:sub(1, #Prefix) == Prefix and (type(v) == "string" or type(v) == "number" or type(v) == "boolean") then
				Entry = `{Key}={tostring(v)}`

				break
			end
		end

		if Entry and not table.find(List.List, Entry) then
			table.insert(List.List, Entry)
			table.insert(List.ListEnabled, Entry)
			Added += 1
		elseif not Entry then
			Dropped += 1
		end
	end

local BundledModules = ...

	[Enum.KeyCode.A] = "A",
	[Enum.KeyCode.S] = "S",
	[Enum.KeyCode.D] = "D",
	[Enum.KeyCode.Space] = "Space"

local function AddLabel(Parent: Instance, Name: string, Text: string): TextLabel
	local Label: TextLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	Label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	Label.FontFace = UI.Font
	Label.Name = Name
	Label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 22)

	Label.TextSize = 14
	Label.Parent = Parent

	return Label

local function PressKey(Entry: any, Down: boolean)
	if Entry.Pressed ~= Down then
		Entry.Pressed = Down
		Entry.Shadow.Enabled = Down

		Tween(Entry.Object, TweenInfo.new(0.05, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
			BackgroundColor3 = Down and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or Released,
			BackgroundTransparency = Down and 0 or 0.294
		})
		Tween(Entry.Bar, TweenInfo.new(0.05, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
			BackgroundColor3 = Down and Pressed or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		})
		Tween(Entry.Label, TweenInfo.new(0.05, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
			TextColor3 = Down and Pressed or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		})

		if Entry.Point then
			Tween(Entry.Point, TweenInfo.new(0.05, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
				BackgroundColor3 = Down and Pressed or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
			})
		end

		if Entry.Mouse then
			Tween(Entry.Mouse, TweenInfo.new(0.05, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
				BackgroundColor3 = Down and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or Released,
				BackgroundTransparency = Down and 0 or 0.294
			})
		end
	end
end

local function RefreshLayout()
	local IconStyle: boolean = MouseStyle.Value == "Icon"
	local ArrowStyle: boolean = KeyStyle.Value == "Arrow"
	local Spacebar: boolean = ShowSpacebar.Enabled

	for KeyName: string, v: any in Keys do
		v.Object.Visible = not ShowCpsOnly.Enabled and (KeyName ~= "Space" or Spacebar) and not (IconStyle and (KeyName == "LMB" or KeyName == "RMB"))
		v.Label.Visible = not ArrowStyle or KeyName == "LMB" or KeyName == "RMB" or KeyName == "Space"

		if v.Icon then
			v.Icon.Visible = ArrowStyle
		end
	end

	MouseIcons.Visible = IconStyle and not ShowCpsOnly.Enabled
	CpsDivider.Visible = not ShowCpsOnly.Enabled
	CpsLabel.Visible = ShowCpsOnly.Enabled
	CpsRight.Visible = not ShowCpsOnly.Enabled

	local Spots: {{any}}
	if ShowCpsOnly.Enabled then
		Holder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 40)
		CpsHolder.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
		CpsHolder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(110, 20)
		CpsBackground.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
		CpsBackground.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(39 + UI.Context:Measure("CPS", 14, UI.Font).X, 24)
		Spots = {{CpsLeft, 22, 14, Enum.TextXAlignment.Right}, {CpsLabel, 25, 14, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left}}
	else
		local KeysY: number = IconStyle and 8 or 4
		local MouseX: number = IconStyle and 122 or 0
		local MouseY: number = (IconStyle and KeysY - 12 or KeysY + 80) + (Spacebar and 28 or 0)
		local CpsWidth: number = IconStyle and 80 or 110
		Holder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(108 + (IconStyle and 96 or 0), (IconStyle and 80 or 144) + (Spacebar and 28 or 0))
		MouseIcons.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(MouseX - 4, MouseY)
		CpsHolder.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(MouseX, MouseY + (IconStyle and 44 or 34))
		CpsHolder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(CpsWidth, 20)
		CpsBackground.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 4)
		CpsBackground.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(CpsWidth, 24)
		CpsDivider.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(CpsWidth / 2, 8)
		Spots = {{CpsLeft, 10, 16, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left}, {CpsRight, CpsWidth - 10, 16, Enum.TextXAlignment.Right}}

		for _, v: any in {
			{Key = Keys.W, X = 38, Y = KeysY - 4, Width = 34, Height = 34},
			{Key = Keys.A, X = 0, Y = KeysY + 38, Width = 34, Height = 34},
			{Key = Keys.S, X = 38, Y = KeysY + 38, Width = 34, Height = 34},
			{Key = Keys.D, X = 76, Y = KeysY + 38, Width = 34, Height = 34},
			{Key = Keys.Space, X = 0, Y = KeysY + 79, Width = 110.5, Height = 22},
			{Key = Keys.LMB, X = MouseX, Y = MouseY, Width = 52.7, Height = 32},
			{Key = Keys.RMB, X = MouseX + 56.7, Y = MouseY, Width = 52.7, Height = 32}
		} do
			v.Key.Object.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(v.X, v.Y - 1)
			v.Key.Object.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(v.Width, v.Height + 1)
			v.Key.Label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((v.Width / 2) - 100, 5.75)

			if v.Key.Icon then
				v.Key.Icon.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((v.Width / 2) - 4.4, 6)
			end
		end
	end

	for _, v: {any} in Spots do
		v[1].AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(v[4] == Enum.TextXAlignment.Right and 1 or 0, 0.5)
		v[1].Position = UDim2.fromOffset(v[2], v[3])
		v[1].TextXAlignment = v[4]
	end
end

local function InputChanged(Input: InputObject, Down: boolean)
	local Name: string? = Keybinds[Input.KeyCode]
	if Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
		Name = "LMB"

		if Down then
			table.insert(LeftClicks, tick() + 1)
		end
	elseif Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
		Name = "RMB"

		if Down then
			table.insert(RightClicks, tick() + 1)
		end
	end

	if Name and Keys[Name] then
		PressKey(Keys[Name], Down)
	end
end

Keystrokes = Cat.Legit:CreateModule({
	Name = "Keystrokes",
	Category = "HUD",
	Icon = "legit_keystrokes",
	Size = UDim2.fromOffset(108, 172),
	Function = function(Callback: boolean)
		if Callback then
			Keystrokes:Clean(Services.UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(Input: InputObject)
				InputChanged(Input, true)
			end))

			Keystrokes:Clean(Services.UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(Input: InputObject)
				InputChanged(Input, false)
			end))

			Keystrokes:Clean(Services.RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
				local Now: number = tick()
				for _, v: {Clicks: {number}, Label: TextLabel, Shown: number} in Counters do
					if v.Clicks[1] and v.Clicks[1] < Now then
						repeat
							table.remove(v.Clicks, 1)
						until not v.Clicks[1] or v.Clicks[1] >= Now
					end

					if #v.Clicks ~= v.Shown then
						v.Shown = #v.Clicks
						v.Label.Text = tostring(v.Shown)
					end
				end
			end))
		else
			table.clear(LeftClicks)
			table.clear(RightClicks)

			for _, v: any in Keys do
				PressKey(v, false)
			end
		end
	end,
	Tooltip = "Shows when your movement keys or mouse buttons are pressed, as well as mouse clicks per second"
})

local function CreatePolygon(Set, LineCount: number, WedgeCount: number)
    for i: number = 1, LineCount do
        local Line: Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
        Line.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        Line.BorderSizePixel = 0
        Line.Visible = false

        table.insert(Set.Instances, Line)
    end

        Wedge.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(128, 128)

        Wedge.Parent = ScreenGui

        table.insert(Set.Instances, Wedge)
    end

local function PaintPolygon(Set)
    local Properties = Set.Props
    local Transparency: number = 1 - math.clamp(Properties.Transparency, 0, 1)
    for _, v: Frame in Set.Lines do
        v.BackgroundColor3 = Properties.Color
        v.BackgroundTransparency = Transparency
        v.Visible = Properties.Visible and not Properties.Filled
        v.ZIndex = Properties.ZIndex
    end
    for _, v: ImageLabel in Set.Wedges do
        v.ImageColor3 = Properties.Color
        v.ImageTransparency = Transparency
        v.Visible = Properties.Visible and Properties.Filled
        v.ZIndex = Properties.ZIndex
    end
end

local function SetLine(Frame: Frame, From: Vector2, To: Vector2, Thickness: number)
    local Direction: Vector2 = To - From
    Frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((From.X + To.X) / 2, (From.Y + To.Y) / 2)
    Frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(Direction.Magnitude, Thickness)
    Frame.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(Direction.Y, Direction.X))
end

local function SetWedge(Set, First: number, Second: number, A: Vector2, B: Vector2, C: Vector2)
    local AB, AC, BC = B - A, C - A, C - B
    local ABDot, ACDot, BCDot = AB:Dot(AB), AC:Dot(AC), BC:Dot(BC)
    if ABDot > ACDot and ABDot > BCDot then
        A, C = C, A
    elseif ACDot > BCDot and ACDot > ABDot then
        A, B = B, A
    end

    AB, BC = B - A, C - B
    if BC.Magnitude <= 0 then
        Set.Wedges[First].Size = UDim2.new()
        Set.Wedges[Second].Size = UDim2.new()
        return
    end

    local Unit: Vector2 = BC.Unit
    local Height: number = Unit.X * AB.Y - Unit.Y * AB.X
    local Theta: number = math.deg(math.atan2(Unit.Y, Unit.X))
    local Tall: number = math.abs(Height)
    local Row: number = Height >= 0 and 128 or 0
    Set.Wedges[First].ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new(0, Row)
    Set.Wedges[First].Rotation = Theta
    Set.Wedges[First].Position = UDim2.fromOffset((A.X + B.X) / 2, (A.Y + B.Y) / 2)
    Set.Wedges[First].Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.abs(Unit:Dot(AB)), Tall)
    Set.Wedges[Second].ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new(128, Row)
    Set.Wedges[Second].Rotation = Theta
    Set.Wedges[Second].Position = UDim2.fromOffset((A.X + C.X) / 2, (A.Y + C.Y) / 2)
    Set.Wedges[Second].Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.abs(Unit:Dot(C - A)), Tall)
end

local function GetAsset(Data: string)
    if Data == "" or Data:find("://") then
        return Data
    end
    if not ImageCache[Data] then
        if not writefile or not getcustomasset then
            return ""
        end
        local FilePath: string = `{Render.Directory}/assets/drawing/{HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)}.png`
        writefile(FilePath, Data)
        ImageCache[Data] = getcustomasset(FilePath)
    end

    return ImageCache[Data]
end

Render.new = function(Class: string)
    local ClassData = Classes[Class]
    if not ClassData or Class == "Base" then
        return
    end

    local Set = {
        Class = Class,
        Exists = true,
        Instances = {},
        Lines = {},
        Props = table.clone(Classes.Base.Properties),
        Wedges = {}
    }
    for Property: string, v: any in ClassData.Properties do
        Set.Props[Property] = v
    end
    ClassData.Create(Set)

    local Address: string = tostring(Set):match("0x(%x+)") or "0000000000000000"
    local Proxy = newproxy(true)
    local Meta = getmetatable(Proxy)

    local function Remove()
        if not Set.Exists then
            return
        end
        Set.Exists = false
        for _, v: Instance in Set.Instances do
            v:Destroy()
        end
        table.clear(Set.Instances)
        table.clear(Set.Lines)
        table.clear(Set.Wedges)
        Render.Objects[Proxy] = nil
    end

    Meta.__index = function(_, Key)
        if Key == "Remove" or Key == "Destroy" then
            return Remove
        end
        if Key == "__OBJECT_EXISTS" then
            return Set.Exists
        end

        return Set.Props[Key]
    end
    Meta.__newindex = function(_, Key, Value)
        local Old = Set.Props[Key]
        if Old == nil or Key == "TextBounds" then
            return
        end
        if typeof(Value) ~= typeof(Old) then
            error(`invalid argument #3 to '__newindex' ({typeof(Old)} expected, got {typeof(Value)})`, 2)
        end

        Set.Props[Key] = Key == "ZIndex" and math.floor(Value) or Value
        if not Set.Exists then
            return
        end
        if Paints[Key] then
            ClassData.Paint(Set)
        elseif Key == "Filled" or Key == "Thickness" then
            ClassData.Shape(Set)
            ClassData.Paint(Set)
        else
            ClassData.Shape(Set)
        end
    end
    Meta.__tostring = function()
        return `DrawingObject: 0x{Address}`
    end

    ClassData.Shape(Set)
    ClassData.Paint(Set)
    Render.Objects[Proxy] = Set

    return Proxy
end

Render.clear = function()
    for Object: any in table.clone(Render.Objects) do
        Object:Remove()
    end
    table.clear(Render.Objects)
end

Render.install = function()
    if Render.Installed then
        return
    end
    Render.Installed = true

    ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    ScreenGui.DisplayOrder = 2147483647
    ScreenGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    ScreenGui.Name = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
    ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    ScreenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Global
    if not pcall(function()
        ScreenGui.Parent = gethui and gethui() or cloneref(game:GetService("CoreGui"))
    end) then
        ScreenGui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    end

    MeasureLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    MeasureLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    MeasureLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(9999, 9999)
    MeasureLabel.Text = ""
    MeasureLabel.TextTransparency = 1
    MeasureLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    MeasureLabel.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
    MeasureLabel.Parent = ScreenGui

    if not isfolder(`{Render.Directory}/assets/drawing`) then
        makefolder(`{Render.Directory}/assets/drawing`)
    end
    if not isfile(`{Render.Directory}/assets/drawing/wedge.png`) then
        writefile(`{Render.Directory}/assets/drawing/wedge.png`, base64decode(WedgeImage))
    end
    local Success, Asset = pcall(getcustomasset, `{Render.Directory}/assets/drawing/wedge.png`)
    WedgeAsset = Success and Asset or ""

    Render.Old = {
        Drawing = Drawing,
        cleardrawcache = cleardrawcache,
        isrenderobj = isrenderobj
    }
    getgenv().Drawing = {
        Fonts = Render.Fonts,
        clear = Render.clear,
        new = Render.new
    }
    getgenv().cleardrawcache = function()
        Render.clear()
        if Render.Old.cleardrawcache then
            Render.Old.cleardrawcache()
        end
    end
    getgenv().isrenderobj = function(Object)
        return Render.Objects[Object] ~= nil or (Render.Old.isrenderobj and Render.Old.isrenderobj(Object)) == true
    end
    getgenv().getrenderproperty = function(Object, Property: string)
        return Object[Property]
    end
    getgenv().setrenderproperty = function(Object, Property: string, Value)
        Object[Property] = Value
    end
end

    getgenv().cleardrawcache = Render.Old.cleardrawcache
    getgenv().isrenderobj = Render.Old.isrenderobj
    table.clear(ImageCache)
end

	local Dark: TextLabel? = nil

	return setmetatable({}, {
		__newindex = function(_, Index: string, Value: any)
			if Index == "Shadow" and Value and not Dark then
				local Copy: TextLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
				Copy.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				Copy.FontFace = Object.FontFace
				Copy.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 1)
				Copy.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
				Copy.Text = Object.Text
				Copy.TextColor3 = Color3.new()
				Copy.TextSize = Object.TextSize
				Copy.ZIndex = 0
				Copy.Parent = Object
				Dark = Copy
			elseif Index == "Shadow" then
				if Dark then
					Dark.Visible = Value
				end
			elseif Index == "Text" then
				Object.Text = Value
				if Dark then
					Dark.Text = Value
				end
			elseif Index == "Color" then
				Object.TextColor3 = Value
			elseif Index == "Scale" then
				Scale.Scale = Value
			elseif Index == "Position" then
				Object.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(Value.X, Value.Y)
			else
				(Object :: any)[Index] = Value
			end
		end,
		__index = function(_, Index: string): any
			if Index == "Remove" then
				return function()
					Object:Destroy()
				end
			end

			return nil
		end
	})
end

local function Make(): Box
	local Lines: {DrawingLine} = {}
	local Outlines: {DrawingLine} = {}
	for _ = 1, 8 do
		local Outline: DrawingLine = Drawing.new("Line")
		Outline.Thickness = 3
		Outline.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
		Outline.ZIndex = 1
		Outline.Visible = false

		local Line: DrawingLine = Drawing.new("Line")
		Line.Thickness = 1
		Line.ZIndex = 2
		Line.Visible = false

		table.insert(Outlines, Outline)
		table.insert(Lines, Line)
	end

	local Back: DrawingSquare = Drawing.new("Square")
	Back.Filled = true
	Back.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
	Back.ZIndex = 1
	Back.Visible = false

	local Fill: DrawingSquare = Drawing.new("Square")
	Fill.Filled = true
	Fill.ZIndex = 2
	Fill.Visible = false

	local Name: any = Label(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), 1)
	local Distance: any = Label(Color3.fromRGB(168, 167, 170), 0)
	local Vitals: any = Label(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), 0)

	local Icons: {ImageLabel} = {}
	for _ = 1, 6 do
		local Icon: ImageLabel = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
		Icon.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
		Icon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		Icon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24)
		Icon.Visible = false
		Icon.Parent = Holder

		table.insert(Icons, Icon)
	end

	return {
		Lines = Lines,
		Outlines = Outlines,
		Name = Name,
		Distance = Distance,
		Vitals = Vitals,
		Icons = Icons,
		Back = Back,
		Fill = Fill,
		Used = 0
	}
end

local function Hide(Slot: Box)
	for Index: number, v: DrawingLine in Slot.Lines do
		v.Visible = false
		Slot.Outlines[Index].Visible = false
	end

	Slot.Back.Visible = false
	Slot.Fill.Visible = false
	Slot.Name.Visible = false
	Slot.Distance.Visible = false
	Slot.Vitals.Visible = false
	for _, v: ImageLabel in Slot.Icons do
		v.Visible = false
	end

	Slot.Used = 0
end

local function Destroy(Slot: Box)
	for Index: number, v: DrawingLine in Slot.Lines do
		v:Remove()
		Slot.Outlines[Index]:Remove()
	end

	Slot.Back:Remove()
	Slot.Fill:Remove()
	Slot.Name:Remove()
	Slot.Distance:Remove()
	Slot.Vitals:Remove()
	for _, v: ImageLabel in Slot.Icons do
		v:Destroy()
	end
end

local function Place(Slot: Box, Index: number, AX: number, AY: number, BX: number, BY: number)
	local Length: number = math.max(math.sqrt((BX - AX) ^ 2 + (BY - AY) ^ 2), 1)
	local DX: number = (BX - AX) / Length
	local DY: number = (BY - AY) / Length

	Slot.Lines[Index].From = Vector2.new(AX, AY)
	Slot.Lines[Index].To = Vector2.new(BX, BY)
	Slot.Outlines[Index].From = Vector2.new(AX - DX, AY - DY)
	Slot.Outlines[Index].To = Vector2.new(BX + DX, BY + DY)
end

local function Shape(Slot: Box, Style: string, X0: number, Y0: number, X1: number, Y1: number): number
	if Style == "Full" then
		Place(Slot, 1, X0, Y0, X1, Y0)
		Place(Slot, 2, X0, Y1, X1, Y1)
		Place(Slot, 3, X0, Y0, X0, Y1)
		Place(Slot, 4, X1, Y0, X1, Y1)

		return 4
	end

	if Style == "Rounded" then
		local Cut: number = math.max(1, math.min(5, (X1 - X0) / 4, (Y1 - Y0) / 4))
		Place(Slot, 1, X0 + Cut, Y0, X1 - Cut, Y0)
		Place(Slot, 2, X0 + Cut, Y1, X1 - Cut, Y1)
		Place(Slot, 3, X0, Y0 + Cut, X0, Y1 - Cut)
		Place(Slot, 4, X1, Y0 + Cut, X1, Y1 - Cut)
		Place(Slot, 5, X0, Y0 + Cut, X0 + Cut, Y0)
		Place(Slot, 6, X1 - Cut, Y0, X1, Y0 + Cut)
		Place(Slot, 7, X0, Y1 - Cut, X0 + Cut, Y1)
		Place(Slot, 8, X1 - Cut, Y1, X1, Y1 - Cut)

		return 8
	end

	local Length: number = math.max(3, math.min(X1 - X0, Y1 - Y0) / 4)
	Place(Slot, 1, X0, Y0, X0 + Length, Y0)
	Place(Slot, 2, X0, Y0, X0, Y0 + Length)
	Place(Slot, 3, X1, Y0, X1 - Length, Y0)
	Place(Slot, 4, X1, Y0, X1, Y0 + Length)
	Place(Slot, 5, X0, Y1, X0 + Length, Y1)
	Place(Slot, 6, X0, Y1, X0, Y1 - Length)
	Place(Slot, 7, X1, Y1, X1 - Length, Y1)
	Place(Slot, 8, X1, Y1, X1, Y1 - Length)

	return 8
end

return {
	Edges = Edges,
	Make = Make,
	Hide = Hide,
	Destroy = Destroy,
	Shape = Shape
}]], "=core/box/init"))(BundledModules)

        if shared.BundleFrame and os.clock() - shared.BundleFrame > (os.clock() - shared.BundleStart > 0.6 and 0.016 or 0.006) and coroutine.isyieldable() then
            task.wait()
            shared.BundleFrame = os.clock()
        end

        BundledModules.GhostLib = assert(loadstring([[
local BundledModules = ...
local Services = BundledModules.Services













local Junk: {[string]: boolean} = {
	Script = true,
	LocalScript = true,
	ModuleScript = true,
	Animator = true,
	Sound = true,
	Motor6D = true,
	BillboardGui = true,
	Highlight = true,
	ForceField = true,
	PointLight = true,
	SpotLight = true,
	SurfaceLight = true,
	ParticleEmitter = true,
	Trail = true,
	Beam = true,
	Fire = true,
	Smoke = true,
	Sparkles = true
}

local Group: string = "CatvapeGhost"
local Away: CFrame = CFrame.new(0, 100000, 0)

local function Isolate()
	pcall(function()
		Services.PhysicsService:RegisterCollisionGroup(Group)
	end)

	pcall(function()
		for _, v: {name: string} in Services.PhysicsService:GetRegisteredCollisionGroups() do
			Services.PhysicsService:CollisionGroupSetCollidable(Group, v.name, false)
		end
	end)
end

local function Relevant(v: Instance): boolean
	return v:IsA("BasePart") or v:IsA("Accessory") or v:IsA("CharacterAppearance") or v:IsA("DataModelMesh") or v:IsA("Decal") or v:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") or v:IsA("WrapLayer") or v:IsA("Tool")
end

local function Pair(Original: Instance, Copy: Instance, Pairs: {Pair}, Meshes: {Mesh}, Tiles: {Tile})
	local Left: {Instance} = Original:GetChildren()
	local Right: {Instance} = Copy:GetChildren()
	local Direct: boolean = #Left == #Right
	local Used: {[Instance]: boolean} = {}
	for Index: number, v: Instance in Left do
		local Match: Instance? = nil
		if Direct and Right[Index].Name == v.Name and Right[Index].ClassName == v.ClassName then
			Match = Right[Index]
		else
			for _, Other: Instance in Right do
				if not Used[Other] and Other.Name == v.Name and Other.ClassName == v.ClassName then
					Match = Other

					break
				end
			end
		end

		if not Match then
			continue
		end

		Used[Match] = true
		if v:IsA("BasePart") then
			(Match :: BasePart).Anchored = true
			(Match :: BasePart).CanCollide = false
			(Match :: BasePart).CanQuery = false
			(Match :: BasePart).CanTouch = false
			(Match :: BasePart).CastShadow = false
			pcall(function()
				(Match :: BasePart).CollisionGroup = Group
			end)

			if v:IsA("MeshPart") then
				(Match :: MeshPart).RenderFidelity = Enum.RenderFidelity.Precise
			end

			table.insert(Pairs, {From = v :: BasePart, To = Match :: BasePart})
		elseif v:IsA("DataModelMesh") then
			table.insert(Meshes, {From = v :: DataModelMesh, To = Match :: DataModelMesh, Absolute = v.ClassName == "FileMesh" or (v:IsA("SpecialMesh") and (v :: SpecialMesh).MeshType == Enum.MeshType.FileMesh)})
		elseif v:IsA("Texture") then
			table.insert(Tiles, {From = v :: Texture, To = Match :: Texture})
		end

		Pair(v, Match, Pairs, Meshes, Tiles)
	end
end

local function Rig(Original: Instance, Copy: Instance, Bones: {Joint}, Part: number)
	for _, v: Instance in Original:GetChildren() do
		local Match: Instance? = v:IsA("Bone") and Copy:FindFirstChild(v.Name) or nil
		if Match and Match:IsA("Bone") then
			table.insert(Bones, {From = v :: Bone, To = Match :: Bone, Part = Part})
			Rig(v, Match, Bones, Part)
		end
	end
end

local function Build(Character: Model, Skinned: boolean): (Model?, {Pair}, {Mesh}, {Tile})
	local Locked: {Instance} = {}
	for _, v: Instance in Character:GetDescendants() do
		if not v.Archivable then
			v.Archivable = true
			table.insert(Locked, v)
		end
	end

	local Archivable: boolean = Character.Archivable
	Character.Archivable = true

	local Copy: Model? = Character:Clone()
	Character.Archivable = Archivable
	for _, v: Instance in Locked do
		v.Archivable = false
	end

	if not Copy then
		return nil, {}, {}, {}
	end

	Isolate()

	local Pairs: {Pair} = {}
	local Meshes: {Mesh} = {}
	local Tiles: {Tile} = {}
	Pair(Character, Copy, Pairs, Meshes, Tiles)

	for _, v: Instance in {Copy, table.unpack(Copy:GetDescendants())} do
		for _, Tag: string in v:GetTags() do
			v:RemoveTag(Tag)
		end

		if v:IsA("Humanoid") then
			v.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
			v.HealthDisplayType = Enum.HumanoidHealthDisplayType.AlwaysOff
			pcall(function()
				v.EvaluateStateMachine = false
				v.AutomaticScalingEnabled = false
			end)
		elseif Junk[v.ClassName] and not (Skinned and v:IsA("Motor6D")) then
			v:Destroy()
		end
	end

	return Copy, Pairs, Meshes, Tiles
end

local function Adopt(Entry: Ghost, Copy: Model, Pairs: {Pair}, Meshes: {Mesh}, Tiles: {Tile})
	Entry.Model = Copy
	Entry.Pairs = Pairs
	Entry.Meshes = Meshes
	Entry.Tiles = Tiles
	Entry.Targets = {}
	Entry.Frames = {}
	Entry.Poses = table.create(#Pairs)
	Entry.Dims = table.create(#Pairs)
	Entry.Solid = table.create(#Pairs)
	Entry.Spots = table.create(#Pairs)
	Entry.Bones = {}
	Entry.Joints = {}
	Entry.Movers = {}

	local Known: {[BasePart]: boolean} = {}
	local Driven: {[BasePart]: boolean} = {}
	for Index: number, v: Pair in Pairs do
		Known[v.To] = true
		if Entry.Skinned then
			Rig(v.From, v.To, Entry.Bones, Index)
		end
	end

	for _, v: Pair in (Entry.Skinned and Pairs or {}) do
		for _, Joint: Instance in v.From:GetChildren() do
			local Match: Instance? = Joint:IsA("JointInstance") and v.To:FindFirstChild(Joint.Name) or nil
			if Match and Match:IsA("JointInstance") and Match.Part0 and Match.Part1 and Known[Match.Part0] and Known[Match.Part1] and not Driven[Match.Part1] then
				table.insert(Entry.Joints, {From = Joint :: JointInstance, To = Match})
				Driven[Match.Part1] = true
				Match.Part1.Anchored = false
			end
		end
	end

	for Index: number, v: Pair in Pairs do
		if not Driven[v.To] then
			table.insert(Entry.Movers, Index)
			table.insert(Entry.Targets, v.To)
			table.insert(Entry.Frames, v.To.CFrame)
		end
	end

	Entry.Root = Entry.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	Entry.Head = Entry.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") :: BasePart?
	Entry.Scale = nil
	Entry.Last = nil
	Entry.Dirty = nil
	Entry.Young = true
	Entry.Fresh = true
	Entry.Humanoid = Copy:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	Entry.Built = os.clock()
end

local function Settle(Entry: Ghost)
	local Pairs: {Pair} = {}
	local Meshes: {Mesh} = {}
	local Tiles: {Tile} = {}
	Pair(Entry.Character, Entry.Model, Pairs, Meshes, Tiles)

	for _, v: Instance in Entry.Model:GetDescendants() do
		if Junk[v.ClassName] and not (Entry.Skinned and v:IsA("Motor6D")) then
			v:Destroy()
		end
	end

	local Dirty: number? = Entry.Dirty
	Adopt(Entry, Entry.Model, Pairs, Meshes, Tiles)
	Entry.Dirty = Dirty
	Entry.Posed = false
end

local function Mount(Entry: Ghost, Container: Instance)
	Entry.Model.Parent = Container
	Settle(Entry)

	local Humanoid: Humanoid? = Entry.Humanoid
	if Humanoid then
		pcall(function()
			(Humanoid :: Humanoid).EvaluateStateMachine = false
		end)
	end

	local Kept: {[Instance]: boolean} = {}
	for _, v: Link in Entry.Joints do
		Kept[v.To] = true
	end

	local Strip: {Instance} = {}
	local Layered: boolean = false
	for _, v: Instance in Entry.Model:GetDescendants() do
		if Kept[v] or (Entry.Skinned and v:IsA("Bone")) then
			continue
		end

		if v:IsA("Attachment") or v:IsA("WrapTarget") or v:IsA("Constraint") or v:IsA("WeldConstraint") or v:IsA("JointInstance") then
			table.insert(Strip, v)
		elseif v:IsA("WrapLayer") then
			Layered = true
		end
	end

	for _, v: Instance in Strip do
		if not Layered or not v:IsA("WrapTarget") then
			v:Destroy()
		end
	end

	local Props: Model = Entry.Props or Instance.new("Model")
	Props.Name = "Props"
	Props.Parent = Container
	Entry.Props = Props
	for _, v: Instance in Entry.Model:GetChildren() do
		if (v:IsA("Accessory") or v:IsA("Tool")) and not v:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("WrapLayer", true) then
			v.Parent = Props
		end
	end

	Entry.Mounted = true
end

local Ghosts = {}

function Ghosts.New(Character: Model, Container: Instance, Skinned: boolean?): Ghost?
	local Copy: Model?, Pairs: {Pair}, Meshes: {Mesh}, Tiles: {Tile} = Build(Character, Skinned == true)
	if not Copy then
		return nil
	end

	local Result: Ghost = {
		Character = Character,
		Model = Copy,
		Pairs = Pairs,
		Meshes = Meshes,
		Tiles = Tiles,
		Targets = {},
		Frames = {},
		Poses = {},
		Spots = {},
		Bones = {},
		Skinned = Skinned == true,
		Joints = {},
		Movers = {},
		Dims = {},
		Solid = {},
		Container = Container,
		Built = 0,
		Phase = math.random(0, 3),
		Young = true,
		Fresh = true,
		Posed = false,
		Shown = false,
		Mounted = false,
		Connections = {}
	}
	Adopt(Result, Copy, Pairs, Meshes, Tiles)

	for _, v: string in {"DescendantAdded", "DescendantRemoving"} do
		table.insert(Result.Connections, (Character :: any)[v]:Connect(function(Item: Instance)
			if Relevant(Item) then
				Result.Dirty = os.clock()
			end
		end))
	end

	return Result
end

local function Rebuild(Entry: Ghost)
	local Copy: Model?, Pairs: {Pair}, Meshes: {Mesh}, Tiles: {Tile} = Build(Entry.Character, Entry.Skinned)
	if not Copy then
		Entry.Dirty = nil

		return
	end

	Entry.Model:Destroy()
	if Entry.Props then
		Entry.Props:Destroy()
		Entry.Props = nil
	end

	Adopt(Entry, Copy, Pairs, Meshes, Tiles)
	Entry.Mounted = false
end

function Ghosts.Refresh(Entry: Ghost): boolean
	if Entry.Dirty and os.clock() - Entry.Dirty >= 0.4 then
		Rebuild(Entry)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function Ghosts.Pose(Entry: Ghost, Tick: number)
	local Refresh: boolean = Entry.Fresh or (Tick + Entry.Phase) % 4 == 0
	Entry.Fresh = false
	for Index: number, v: Pair in Entry.Pairs do
		Entry.Poses[Index] = v.From.CFrame
		Entry.Spots[Index] = v.From.Position
		if Refresh then
			Entry.Dims[Index] = v.From.Size
			Entry.Solid[Index] = v.From.Transparency < 0.5 and v.From.LocalTransparencyModifier < 0.5
		end
	end

	if #Entry.Bones > 0 then
		local Sums: {[number]: Vector3} = {}
		local Counts: {[number]: number} = {}
		for _, v: Joint in Entry.Bones do
			Sums[v.Part] = (Sums[v.Part] or Vector3.zero) + v.From.TransformedWorldCFrame.Position
			Counts[v.Part] = (Counts[v.Part] or 0) + 1
		end

		for Index: number, Sum: Vector3 in Sums do
			Entry.Spots[Index] = Sum / Counts[Index]
		end
	end

	Entry.Posed = true
end

function Ghosts.Update(Entry: Ghost, Visible: boolean, Origin: Vector3, Scale: number, Container: Instance, Tick: number)
	if not Visible then
		if Entry.Shown then
			for Index: number in Entry.Frames do
				Entry.Frames[Index] = Away
			end

			workspace:BulkMoveTo(Entry.Targets, Entry.Frames, Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged)
			Entry.Shown = false
		end

		return
	end

	if Entry.Container ~= Container then
		Entry.Container = Container
		if Entry.Mounted then
			Rebuild(Entry)
			Entry.Posed = false
		end
	end

	if Entry.Dirty and os.clock() - Entry.Dirty >= 0.1 and os.clock() - Entry.Built >= 0.25 then
		Rebuild(Entry)
		Entry.Posed = false
	end

	if not Entry.Mounted then
		Mount(Entry, Entry.Container)
	end

	if not Entry.Shown then
		Entry.Shown = true
		Entry.Young = true
	end

	for _, v: Link in Entry.Joints do
		local C0: CFrame, C1: CFrame = v.From.C0, v.From.C1
		v.To.C0 = C0.Rotation + C0.Position * Scale
		v.To.C1 = C1.Rotation + C1.Position * Scale
		if v.From:IsA("Motor6D") then
			local Pose: CFrame, Motor: Motor6D = (v.From :: Motor6D).Transform, v.To :: Motor6D
			Motor.Transform = Pose.Rotation + Pose.Position * Scale
		end
	end

	for _, v: Joint in Entry.Bones do
		local Rest: CFrame, Pose: CFrame = v.From.CFrame, v.From.Transform
		v.To.CFrame = Rest.Rotation + Rest.Position * Scale
		v.To.Transform = Pose.Rotation + Pose.Position * Scale
	end

	local Posed: boolean = Entry.Posed
	for Slot: number, Index: number in Entry.Movers do
		local From: CFrame = Posed and Entry.Poses[Index] or Entry.Pairs[Index].From.CFrame
		Entry.Frames[Slot] = CFrame.new(Origin + (From.Position - Origin) * Scale) * From.Rotation
	end

	workspace:BulkMoveTo(Entry.Targets, Entry.Frames, Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged)
	Entry.Posed = false

	local Refresh: boolean = Entry.Young or (Tick + Entry.Phase) % 4 == 0
	if Entry.Scale ~= Scale or (Tick + Entry.Phase) % 30 == 0 then
		for Index: number, v: Pair in Entry.Pairs do
			v.To.Size = (Entry.Dims[Index] or v.From.Size) * Scale
		end

		for _, v: Mesh in Entry.Meshes do
			v.To.Offset = v.From.Offset * Scale
			if v.Absolute then
				v.To.Scale = v.From.Scale * Scale
			end
		end

		for _, v: Tile in Entry.Tiles do
			v.To.StudsPerTileU = v.From.StudsPerTileU * Scale
			v.To.StudsPerTileV = v.From.StudsPerTileV * Scale
			v.To.OffsetStudsU = v.From.OffsetStudsU * Scale
			v.To.OffsetStudsV = v.From.OffsetStudsV * Scale
		end

		Entry.Scale = Scale
	end

	if Refresh then
		for _, v: Pair in Entry.Pairs do
			local Transparency: number = v.From.Transparency
			if v.To.Transparency ~= Transparency then
				v.To.Transparency = Transparency
			end

			if v.To.CanCollide then
				v.To.CanCollide = false
			end
		end
	end

	Entry.Young = false
end

function Ghosts.Destroy(Entry: Ghost)
	for _, v: RBXScriptConnection in Entry.Connections do
		v:Disconnect()
	end

	Entry.Model:Destroy()
	if Entry.Props then
		Entry.Props:Destroy()
	end
end

return Ghosts]], "=core/ghost/init"))(BundledModules)

            task.wait()
            shared.BundleFrame = os.clock()
        end

        BundledModules.Drag = assert(loadstring([[
local BundledModules = ...
local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

local Services = BundledModules.Services

return function(Object: GuiObject, Released: ((GuiObject) -> ())?): RBXScriptConnection
	return Object.InputBegan:Connect(function(Input: InputObject)
		if not Cat.Ui.Click.Visible or (Input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and Input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then

				return
			end

			Object.Position = Goal

			local View: Vector2 = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
			local FixX: number = math.clamp(Object.AbsolutePosition.X, 0, math.max(View.X - Object.AbsoluteSize.X, 0)) - Object.AbsolutePosition.X
			local FixY: number = math.clamp(Object.AbsolutePosition.Y, 0, math.max(View.Y - Object.AbsoluteSize.Y, 0)) - Object.AbsolutePosition.Y
			if FixX ~= 0 or FixY ~= 0 then
				Object.Position = Goal + UDim2.fromOffset(FixX, FixY)
			end
		end)

			if Input.UserInputState ~= Enum.UserInputState.End then
				return
			end

			Moving:Disconnect()
			Release:Disconnect()
			if Released then
				Released(Object)
			end
		end)
	end)

	local function Update(New: any, Old: any)
		if New.Bedwars ~= Old.Bedwars then
			local Primary: string = string.split(New.Bedwars.kit or "", ",")[1]
			local NewKit: string = (Primary ~= "none" and Primary or "")
			if Data.Storage.EquippedKit ~= NewKit then
				Data.Events.KitChanged:Fire(NewKit)
			end

			Data.Storage.EquippedKit = NewKit
		end
		if New.Game ~= Old.Game then
			Data.Storage.MatchState = New.Game.matchState
		end
		if New.Inventory == Old.Inventory then
			return
		end

		local Current: any = New.Inventory and New.Inventory.observedInventory or {inventory = {}}
		local Previous: any = Old.Inventory and Old.Inventory.observedInventory or {inventory = {}}

		Data.Storage.Inventory = Current

		if not Current.hotbar then
			Current.hotbar = {}
			
			for Index: number, v: InventoryItem in Current.inventory.items or {} do
				table.insert(Current.hotbar, {item = v})
				if Current.inventory.hand and v.tool == Current.inventory.hand.tool then
					Current.hotbarSlot = Index - 1
				end
			end
		end
		if Current ~= Previous then
			Data.Events.InventoryChanged:Fire()
		end

		if Current.inventory.items ~= Previous.inventory.items then
			local Best: InventoryItem?, Damage: number, Range: number = nil, -1, -1
			for _, v: InventoryItem in Current.inventory.items or {} do
				local Sword: any = Data.Instances.Items[v.itemType] and Data.Instances.Items[v.itemType].sword
				if not Sword then
					continue
				end

				local Power: number = Sword.damage or 0
				local Reach: number = Sword.attackRange or Data.Instances.CombatConstant.RAYCAST_SWORD_CHARACTER_DISTANCE
				if Power > Damage or (Power == Damage and Reach > Range) then
					Best, Damage, Range = v, Power, Reach
				end
			end

			Data.Storage.Tools.Sword = Best

			for _, Type: string in {"stone", "wood", "wool"} do
				local Tool: InventoryItem?, Strength: number = nil, 0
				for _, v: InventoryItem in Current.inventory.items or {} do
					local Breaks: any = Data.Instances.Items[v.itemType] and Data.Instances.Items[v.itemType].breakBlock
					if Breaks and (Breaks[Type] or 0) > Strength then
						Tool, Strength = v, Breaks[Type]
					end
				end

				Data.Storage.Tools[Type] = Tool
			end
		end

		if Current.inventory.hand ~= Previous.inventory.hand then
			local Hand: InventoryItem? = Current.inventory.hand
			local Meta: any = Hand and Data.Instances.Items[Hand.itemType] or {}

			Data.Storage.Hand = {
				Amount = Hand and Hand.amount or 0,
				Tool = Hand and Hand.tool,
				Type = Meta.sword and "sword" or Meta.block and "block" or Hand and Hand.itemType:find("bow") and "bow" or ""
			}
		end
	end

	local Changed = Data.Controllers.Store.changed:connect(Update)
	task.spawn(Update, Data.Controllers.Store:getState(), {})

	UI.Cat:Clean(Data.Instances.Network.EntityDamageEventZap.On(function(...)
		Data.Events.EntityDamageEvent:Fire({
			entityInstance = ...,
			damage = select(2, ...),
			damageType = select(3, ...),
			fromPosition = select(4, ...),
			fromEntity = select(5, ...),
			knockbackMultiplier = select(6, ...),
			knockbackId = select(7, ...),
			disableDamageHighlight = select(13, ...)
		})
	end))

	local Client: any = Data.Controllers.ClientScript
	local Had: any = rawget(Client, "Get")
	local OldGet: (any, string, ...any) -> any = Client.Get
	local Wrappers: {[any]: any} = {}
	local Named: {[string]: any} = {}
	local GetHook = function(self: any, Name: string, ...: any): any
		if Named[Name] and select("#", ...) == 0 then
			return Named[Name]
		end

		local Remote: any = OldGet(self, Name, ...)
		if type(Remote) ~= "table" or type(Remote.SendToServer) ~= "function" then
			return Remote
		end

		local Wrapper: any = Wrappers[Remote]
		if not Wrapper then
			Wrapper = setmetatable({
				SendToServer = function(_, ...: any): ...any
					local Hook: ((any, ...any) -> ...any)? = Data.Storage.RemoteHooks[Name]
					if Hook then
						return Hook(Remote, ...)
					end

					return Remote:SendToServer(...)
				end
			}, {__index = Remote})
			Wrappers[Remote] = Wrapper
		end
		if select("#", ...) == 0 then
			Named[Name] = Wrapper
		end

		return Wrapper
	end
	rawset(Client, "Get", GetHook)
	UI.Cat:Clean(function()
		if rawget(Client, "Get") == GetHook then
			rawset(Client, "Get", Had)
		end
	end)

	UI.Cat:Clean(Data.Instances.Network.EntityDeathEventZap.On(function(Event: any)
		Data.Events.EntityDeathEvent:Fire(Event)
	end))

	Data.Storage.PlaceCPS = Data.Instances.CPSConstants.BLOCK_PLACE_CPS
	Data.Storage.BlockPlacer = Data.Controllers.BlockPlacer.new(Data.Controllers.BlockEngine, "wool_white")

	local Breaker: any = Data.Controllers.BlockBreakController.blockBreaker
	local OldHit: (any, ...any) -> any = Breaker.hitBlock
	Breaker.hitBlock = function(self: (typeof(Breaker)), ...: any): any
		Data.Storage.LastBreak = tick()
		for _, Callback: (...any) -> () in Data.Storage.BreakCallbacks do
			Callback(self, ...)
		end

		return OldHit(self, ...)
	end

	for _, v: string in {"MatchEndEvent", "GrapplingHookFunctions"} do
        Data.Controllers.ClientScript:WaitFor(v):andThen(function(Connection)
            UI.Cat:Clean(Connection:Connect(function(...)
                Data.Events[v]:Fire(...)
            end))
        end)
    end

	task.spawn(pcall, function()
		local GameMap: string?
		repeat
			GameMap = (workspace:GetAttribute("MapName") :: string?)
			task.wait(0.1)
		until (GameMap or "") ~= ""

		Data.Storage.Map = workspace.Map.Worlds:WaitForChild(GameMap :: string, 360)
		if not Data.Storage.Map then
			print("couldn't grab game map, got", GameMap)
		end
	end)

	UI.Cat:Clean(function()
		Breaker.hitBlock = OldHit
		Changed:disconnect()
		Data.Storage.BlockPlacer:disable()

		table.clear(Data.Storage.BreakCallbacks)
	end)
end

do
	local Signature: {string} = {"Destroying", "Connect", "HumanoidRootPart", "AssemblyLinearVelocity", "Magnitude", "idle", "Stop", "Play", "time", "math", "random", "walk"}
	local Stub: {Connect: (...any) -> ()} = {Connect = function(): () end}
	local Patched: {[(...any) -> ...any]: DummyPatch} = {}
	local Throttled: {[(...any) -> ...any]: boolean} = {}
	local Running: boolean = true

	local function Release(Item: DummyPatch): ()
		if Item.Wrapper then
			Item.Wrapper:Disconnect()
		end
		if Item.Guard then
			Item.Guard:Disconnect()
		end

		pcall(debug.setupvalue, Item.Handler, Item.Index, Item.Model)
		Patched[Item.Handler] = nil
	end

	local function Patch(Connection: any, Handler: (...any) -> ...any): ()
		local Strings: {[string]: boolean} = {}
		local Count: number = 0
		for _, v: any in debug.getconstants(Handler) do
			if type(v) == "string" and not Strings[v] then
				Strings[v] = true
				Count += 1
			end
		end

		local Index: number?, Model: Model?, Own: RBXScriptConnection? = nil, nil, nil
		for Key: number, v: any in debug.getupvalues(Handler) do
			if typeof(v) == "Instance" and v:IsA("Model") then
				Index, Model = Key, v
			elseif typeof(v) == "RBXScriptConnection" then
				Own = v
			end
		end

		local Shaped: boolean = Count == #Signature and #debug.getprotos(Handler) == 1
		for _, v: string in Signature do
			Shaped = Shaped and Strings[v] == true
		end

		if Shaped and Index and Model and Own and Model.Parent then
			local Body: Model, Slot: number, Link: RBXScriptConnection = Model, Index, Own
			local Proxy: any = setmetatable({}, {
				__index = function(_, Key: string): any
					return if Key == "Destroying" then Stub else (Body :: any)[Key]
				end
			})
			local Item: DummyPatch = {Handler = Handler, Original = Connection, Index = Slot, Model = Body, Own = Link}

			Connection:Disable()
			Item.Wrapper = Services.RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(...): ()
				if not Link.Connected then
					Release(Item)
				else
					debug.setupvalue(Handler, Slot, Proxy)
					local Fine: boolean, Result: any = pcall(Handler, ...)
					debug.setupvalue(Handler, Slot, Body)
					if not Fine then
						error(Result, 0)
					end
				end
			end)
			Item.Guard = Body.Destroying:Once(function(): ()
				Link:Disconnect()
			end)
			Patched[Handler] = Item
		end
	end

	local function Throttle(Handler: (...any) -> ...any): ()
		local Strings: {[string]: boolean} = {}
		for _, v: any in debug.getconstants(Handler) do
			if type(v) == "string" then
				Strings[v] = true
			end
		end

		if Strings.isRecording and Strings.damageRecordingStartTime and Strings.totalDamage and Strings["%.2f"] then
			local Next: number = 0
			local Old: (...any) -> ...any
			Old = hookfunction(Handler, function(...): ...any
				if Running and os.clock() < Next then
					return
				end

				Next = os.clock() + 0.1
				return Old(...)
			end)
		end
		Throttled[Handler] = true
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		repeat
			if #Services.CollectionService:GetTagged("trainingRoomDummy") > 0 then
				for _, v: any in getconnections(Services.RunService.Heartbeat) do
					local Handler: ((...any) -> ...any)? = v.Function
					if Handler and not Patched[Handler] and not Throttled[Handler] and islclosure(Handler) and not isexecutorclosure(Handler) then
						local Source: string = debug.info(Handler, "s")
						if v.Enabled and string.find(Source, "training-room-entity-controller", 1, true) then
							pcall(Patch, v, Handler)
						elseif string.find(Source, "training-room-hud-side", 1, true) or string.find(Source, "training-room-entity-dps-billboard", 1, true) then
							pcall(Throttle, Handler)
						end
					end
				end
			end

			task.wait(2)
		until not Running
	end)

	UI.Cat:Clean(function()
		Running = false
		for _, Item: DummyPatch in Patched do
			Release(Item)
			if Item.Own.Connected then
				pcall(Item.Original.Enable, Item.Original)
			end
		end

		for Handler in Throttled do
			if restorefunction then
				pcall(restorefunction, Handler)
			end
		end

		table.clear(Patched)
		table.clear(Throttled)
	end)
end

do
	local Kits: {[string]: number} = {
		hannah = 5,
		spirit_assassin = 4,
		dasher = 3,
		jade = 2,
		regent = 1
	}

	Entity.Invisible = function(Target: Target): boolean
		local Character: Model = Target.Character :: Model
		return Character:GetAttribute("StatusEffect_invisibility") ~= nil or Character:GetAttribute("StatusEffect_smoke_invisibility") ~= nil or Character:GetAttribute("StatusEffect_ninja_invisible") ~= nil
	end
	Entity.Sorts.Damage = function(_, A: Target, B: Target): boolean
		return ((A.Character :: Model):GetAttribute("LastDamageTakenTime") or 0) < ((B.Character :: Model):GetAttribute("LastDamageTakenTime") or 0)
	end
	Entity.Sorts.Kit = function(_, A: Target, B: Target): boolean
		return (Kits[A.Player and A.Player:GetAttribute("PlayingAsKits") :: string] or 0) > (Kits[B.Player and B.Player:GetAttribute("PlayingAsKits") :: string] or 0)
	end
	Entity.Sorts.Threat = function(_, A: Target, B: Target): boolean
		local Power: {number} = {0, 0}
		for Index: number, v: Target in {A, B} do
			local Found: boolean, Inventory: any = pcall(Data.Controllers.InventoryUtil.getInventory, v.Player)
			if not v.Player or not Found then
				continue
			end

			for _, Item: any in Inventory.items do
				local Meta: any = Data.Instances.Items[Item.itemType]
				if Meta and Meta.sword and Meta.sword.damage > Power[Index] then
					Power[Index] = Meta.sword.damage
				end
			end
		end

		return Power[1] > Power[2]
	end
	Entity.Sorts.Contract = function(Origin: Vector3, A: Target, B: Target): boolean
		local Kit: any = Data.Controllers.Store:getState().Kit
		local Contract: any = Kit and Kit.activeContract and Kit.activeContract.target
		local Bounty: any = Kit and Kit.bountyHunterTarget

		local IsA: boolean = (Contract ~= nil and (A.Character == Contract or A.Player == Contract)) or (Bounty ~= nil and A.Character == Bounty)
		local IsB: boolean = (Contract ~= nil and (B.Character == Contract or B.Player == Contract)) or (Bounty ~= nil and B.Character == Bounty)
		if IsA ~= IsB then
			return IsA
		end

		return ((A.RootPart :: BasePart).Position - Origin).Magnitude < ((B.RootPart :: BasePart).Position - Origin).Magnitude
	end

	local function Track(Character: Instance)
		if not Character:IsA("Model") or (Character:HasTag("inventory-entity") and not Character:HasTag("Monster") and not Character:HasTag("trainingRoomDummy")) then
			return
		end

		Entity.Add(Character :: Model, function(): boolean
			if not Character:HasTag("Drone") then
				return LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Team") ~= Character:GetAttribute("Team")
			end

			local Owner: Player? = Services.Players:GetPlayerByUserId(Character:GetAttribute("PlayerUserId") or 0)
			return not Owner or LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Team") ~= Owner:GetAttribute("Team")
		end)
	end

	for _, v: Instance in Services.CollectionService:GetTagged("entity") do
		task.spawn(Track, v)
	end

	UI.Cat:Clean(Services.CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal("entity"):Connect(Track))
	UI.Cat:Clean(Services.CollectionService:GetInstanceRemovedSignal("entity"):Connect(Entity.Remove))
end

BundledModules.AntiFall = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity
    local Fall = BundledModules.Fall

    local AntiFall
    local Mode, Flag, Visual

    local Ledger: FallLedger = {Spots = {}, Size = Fall.Constants.Ledger}
    local Params: RaycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    Params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
    Params.RespectCanCollide = true

    local Part: Part = Instance.new("Part")
    Part.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
    Part.Transparency = 1
    Part.Anchored = true
    Part.CanCollide = false
    Part.CanTouch = false
    Part.CanQuery = false
    Part.Parent = workspace
    Cat:Clean(Part)

    local ColorBox: BoxHandleAdornment = Instance.new("BoxHandleAdornment")
    ColorBox.AlwaysOnTop = true
    ColorBox.Size = Vector3.new(2.5, 6, 2.5)
    ColorBox.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, -0.5, 0)
    ColorBox.ZIndex = 10
    ColorBox.Visible = false
    ColorBox.Adornee = Part
    ColorBox.Parent = Part

    local Started
    local function Restore()
        if setfflag then
            setfflag("PhysicsSenderMaxBandwidthBps", "38760")
            setfflag("S2PhysicsSenderRate", "15")
        end

        if Started then
            Started = nil
        end
    end

    AntiFall = Cat.Categories.Blatant:CreateModule({
        Name = "AntiFall",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            table.clear(Ledger.Spots)
            ColorBox.Visible = Callback and Visual.Enabled

            if Callback then
                local Map, Void, Feet = nil, -math.huge, 0

                AntiFall:Clean(Services.RunService.PreRender:Connect(function()
                    if Entity.Alive and not Started then
                        Part.CFrame = CFrame.new(Entity.RootPart.Position)
                    end
                end))

                repeat
                    local Busy: boolean = (Cat.Modules.Fly ~= nil and Cat.Modules.Fly.Enabled) or (Cat.Modules.LongJump ~= nil and Cat.Modules.LongJump.Enabled) or Data.Storage.Desyncing

                    if Entity.Alive and Data.Storage.Map and not Busy then
                        if Map ~= Data.Storage.Map then
                            Map = Data.Storage.Map
                            Params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {Map}
                            Void = Fall.Floor(Map)
                        end

                        local Humanoid: Humanoid = Entity.Humanoid
                        local Grounded: boolean = Humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air
                        local Floor: RaycastResult? = Grounded and workspace:Raycast(Entity.RootPart.Position, Vector3.new(0, -(Humanoid.HipHeight + Entity.RootPart.Size.Y + Fall.Constants.Probe), 0), Params) or nil
                        Feet = Floor and Entity.RootPart.Position.Y - Floor.Position.Y or Feet > 0 and Feet or Humanoid.HipHeight + Entity.RootPart.Size.Y / 2

                        local Flat: number = (Entity.RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)).Magnitude
                        local Instant: boolean = (Cat.Modules.Speed ~= nil and Cat.Modules.Speed.Enabled) and Cat.Modules.Speed.Options.Mode.Value == "Blatant" and isnetworkowner(Entity.RootPart)
                        local Pace: number = Instant and Cat.Modules.Speed.Options.Speed.Value or math.max(Humanoid.WalkSpeed, Flat)
                        if Grounded then
                            Fall.Ledger(Ledger, Entity.RootPart, Feet, Params)
                        end

                        local State: FallState = {
                            Position = Entity.RootPart.Position,
                            Velocity = Entity.RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity,
                            Target = Humanoid.MoveDirection * Pace,
                            Feet = Feet,
                            Body = Entity.RootPart.Size.Y / 2,
                            Radius = math.min(Entity.RootPart.Size.X, Entity.RootPart.Size.Z) / 2,
                            Grounded = Grounded,
                            Params = Params,
                            Void = Void,
                            Instant = Instant
                        }
                        local Prediction: FallPrediction = Fall.Predict(State)
                        local Safe: FallSpot? = Ledger.Spots[#Ledger.Spots]
                        local Return: FallPrediction? = nil
                        if Prediction.Danger and Safe then
                            State.Aim, State.Speed = Safe.CFrame.Position, Pace
                            Return = Fall.Predict(State)
                        end

                        if Prediction.Danger and Safe and (Prediction.Edge or 0) <= Fall.Constants.React then
                            if isnetworkowner(Entity.RootPart) then
                                if not Started then
                                    Started = os.clock()
                                end

                                if Mode.Value == "Desync" and setfflag then
                                    setfflag("PhysicsSenderMaxBandwidthBps", "0")
                                    setfflag("S2PhysicsSenderRate", "0")
                                end

                                if (os.clock() - Started) >= 0.2 and Mode.Value == "Teleport" or (os.clock() - Started) >= 2 and Mode.Value == "Desync" then
                                    Entity.RootPart.CFrame = Safe.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, Feet, 0)

                                    if Mode.Value == "Desync" then
                                        Cat:CreateNotification("AntiFall", "Desynced for too long", 4, "alert")
                                    end
                                end
                            elseif Flag.Enabled and replicatesignal and not isnetworkowner(Entity.RootPart) then

                            end
                        else
                            Restore()
                        end
                    else
                        Restore()
                    end

                    Services.RunService.PreSimulation:Wait()
                until not AntiFall.Enabled
            else
                Restore()
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Prevents you from falling from lethal heights"
    })

    Mode = AntiFall:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Mode",
        List = {"Teleport", "Desync"},
        Default = "Desync"
    })
    Flag = AntiFall:CreateToggle({Name = "Work on flag", Tooltip = "AntiFall will work even if you get flagged"})
    Visual = AntiFall:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Show your desync position",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Part then
                ColorBox.Visible = Callback and AntiFall.Enabled
            end
        end,
        Default = true
    })
    AntiFall:CreateColorSlider({
        Name = "Visual Color",
        DefaultSat = 0,
        DefaultOpacity = 0.5,
        Function = function(Hue: number, Sat: number, Value: number, Opacity: number)
            if ColorBox then
                ColorBox.Color3 = Color3.fromHSV(Hue, Sat, Value)
                ColorBox.Transparency = (1 - Opacity)
            end
        end
    })
end)()

BundledModules.FastBreak = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local FastBreak
    local Time, BedCheck, HiveCheck, Blacklist, Blacklisted

    local Blocks: {string}, Session = {}, 0
    local Hook: (any, ...any) -> ()?

    local function IsAllowed(Block: Instance?): boolean
        if not Block then
            return false
        end

        if Blacklist.Enabled then
            for _, v: string in Blocks do
                if v == Block.Name or Block.Name:find(v, 1, true) then
                    return false
                end
            end
        end

        return (not BedCheck.Enabled or Block.Name ~= "bed") and (not HiveCheck.Enabled or Block.Name ~= "beehive")
    end

    FastBreak = Cat.Categories.Blatant:CreateModule({
        Name = "FastBreak",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback then
                Session += 1

                Hook = function(self: any, ...)
                    local Mouse: any = self.clientManager:getBlockSelector():getMouseInfo(1, {
                        ray = select(2, ...)
                    })
                    if IsAllowed(Mouse and Mouse.target and Mouse.target.blockInstance) then
                        Data.Controllers.BlockBreakController.blockBreaker:setCooldown(Time.Value)
                    end
                end
                table.insert(Data.Storage.BreakCallbacks, Hook)

                local Current = Session
                repeat
                    if tick() - Data.Storage.LastBreak > 0.3 then
                        Data.Controllers.BlockBreakController.blockBreaker:setCooldown(0.3)
                    end

                    task.wait(0.1)
                until not FastBreak.Enabled or Session ~= Current
            elseif Hook then
                local Index: number? = table.find(Data.Storage.BreakCallbacks, Hook)
                if Index then
                    table.remove(Data.Storage.BreakCallbacks, Index)
                end

                Data.Controllers.BlockBreakController.blockBreaker:setCooldown(0.3)
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Decreases block hit cooldown"
    })

    Time = FastBreak:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Break speed",
        Min = 0,
        Max = 0.3,
        Default = 0.25,
        Decimal = 100,
        Suffix = "seconds"
    })
    FastBreak:CreateButton({
        Name = "Sync to legit speed",
        Function = function()
            Time:SetValue(0.3)
        end
    })
    BedCheck = FastBreak:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Bed Check",
        Tooltip = "Doesn't increase speed if ur breaking a bed"
    })
    HiveCheck = FastBreak:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Blacklist Beehive",
        Tooltip = "Doesn't increase speed if ur breaking a beehive"
    })
    Blacklist = FastBreak:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Use blacklist",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Blacklisted and Blacklisted.Object then
                Blacklisted.Object.Visible = Callback
            end
        end
    })
    Blacklisted = FastBreak:CreateTextList({
        Name = "Blocks",
        Function = function(List: {string}?)
            table.clear(Blocks)
            for _, v: string in (List or Blacklisted.List) do
                table.insert(Blocks, v:find("iron") and "iron_ore_mesh_block" or v)
            end
        end,
        Darker = true,
        Visible = Blacklist.Enabled
    })
end)()

BundledModules.Inventory = (function()
    local Inventory = {}

    Inventory.Find = function(Tool: Instance?, ItemType: string?, Skip: ((Slot: any) -> boolean)?): any?
        local Snapshot: any = Data.Controllers.Store:getState().Inventory.slotSnapshot
        for _, v: any in (Snapshot and Snapshot.player and Snapshot.player.slots or {}) do
            if (Tool and v.tool == Tool or ItemType and v.itemType == ItemType) and not (Skip and Skip(v)) then
                return v
            end
        end

        return nil
    end

    Inventory.Item = function(ItemType: string, Find: boolean?): InventoryItem?
        for _, v: InventoryItem in (Data.Storage.Inventory.inventory.items or {}) do
            if v.itemType == ItemType or (Find and v.itemType:find(ItemType, 1, true)) then
                return v
            end
        end

        return nil
    end

    Inventory.Move =function(Operation: {[string]: any}, Confirm: (() -> boolean)?, Timeout: number?): boolean
        local Success: boolean, Result: any = pcall(function(): any
            return Data.Controllers.InventoryDraggingController:sendTransaction(Operation, nil):expect()
        end)
        if not Success or Result ~= true then
            return false
        end
        if not Confirm then
            return true
        end

        local Deadline: number = os.clock() + (Timeout or 0.5)
        repeat
            task.wait()
        until Confirm() or os.clock() > Deadline

        return true
    end

    return Inventory
end)()

BundledModules.Fly = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services
    local LocalPlayer: Player = Services.Players.LocalPlayer

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity

    local Inventory = BundledModules.Inventory

    local Fly
    local SpeedSlider, VerticalSlider, WallCheck, PopBalloons, TeleportDown, ShowProgressbar

    local isnetworkowner = isnetworkowner or function(_): boolean
        return true
    end

    local Original: ((...any) -> ...any)
    local Bar, Filtered
    local Up, Down, AirTime, AirLimit = 0, 0, tick(), 2

    local Params: RaycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    Params.RespectCanCollide = true

    local function CreateBar(): {Frame: Frame, Fill: Frame, Label: TextLabel}
        local Frame: Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
        Frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
        Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -200)
        Frame.Size = UDim2.new(0.2, 0, 0, 20)
        Frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
        Frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
        Frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
        Frame.Visible = false
        Frame.Parent = Cat.Ui.Gui

        local Fill: Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
        Fill.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
        Fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
        Fill.BackgroundColor3 = Cat.Ui:Color()
        Fill.Parent = Frame

        local Label: TextLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        Label.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        Label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
        Label.TextColor3 = Color3.new(0.9, 0.9, 0.9)
        Label.TextSize = 20
        Label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        Label.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, -1)
        Label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        Label.Parent = Frame

        return {
            Frame = Frame,
            Fill = Fill,
            Label = Label
        }
    end

    local function Inflate()
        if not LocalPlayer.Character or (LocalPlayer.Character:GetAttribute("InflatedBalloons") or 0) ~= 0 then
            return
        end

        if Inventory.Item("balloon") then
            Data.Controllers.BalloonController:inflateBalloon()
        end
    end

    Fly = Cat.Categories.Blatant:CreateModule({
        Name = "Fly",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback then
                Up, Down, AirTime, Original = 0, 0, tick(), Data.Controllers.BalloonController.deflateBalloon
                Data.Controllers.BalloonController.deflateBalloon = function() end

                local TeleportTick: number, TeleportToggle: boolean, OldY: number? = tick(), true, nil
                if ShowProgressbar.Enabled then
                    Bar = CreateBar()
                    Fly:Clean((Bar :: {Frame: Frame, Fill: Frame, Label: TextLabel}).Frame)
                end

                Inflate()
                if LocalPlayer.Character then
                    Fly:Clean(LocalPlayer.Character.AttributeChanged:Connect(function(Attribute: string)
                        if Attribute == "InflatedBalloons" then
                            Inflate()
                        end
                    end))
                end

                Fly:Clean(LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(Character: Model)
                    AirTime = tick()

                    if Fly.Enabled then
                        Fly:Toggle()
                        Fly:Toggle()
                    end
                end))

                Fly:Clean(Services.RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function(Delta: number)
                    if Entity.Alive and isnetworkowner(Entity.RootPart) then
                        if Entity.Humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
                            AirTime = tick()
                        end

                        local Allowed: boolean = ((LocalPlayer.Character :: Model):GetAttribute("InflatedBalloons") or 0) > 0 or Data.Storage.MatchState == 2
                        if Bar then
                            local Waiting: boolean = not Allowed and TeleportDown.Enabled
                            Bar.Frame.Visible = Waiting
                            if Waiting then
                                local Remaining: number = AirLimit - (tick() - AirTime)
                                local Color: Color3 = Cat.Ui:Color()
                                local Scale: number = math.clamp(Remaining / AirLimit, 0, 1)
                                local Text: string = `{string.format("%.1f", math.max(Remaining, 0))}s`

                                if Bar.Fill.BackgroundColor3 ~= Color then
                                    Bar.Fill.BackgroundColor3 = Color
                                end

                                if Bar.Fill.Size.X.Scale ~= Scale then
                                    Bar.Fill.Size = UDim2.new(Scale, 0, 0, 20)
                                end

                                if Bar.Label.Text ~= Text then
                                    Bar.Label.Text = Text
                                end
                            end
                        end

                        local Mass: number = -0.02 + (Allowed and 6 or 0) * (tick() % 0.4 < 0.2 and -1 or 1) + (Up + Down) * VerticalSlider.Value
                        local Modifiers: any = Data.Controllers.SprintController:getMovementStatusModifier():getModifiers()
                        local Multiplier: number, Increase: boolean = 0, true

                        for Modifier: any in Modifiers do
                            local Constant: number = Modifier.constantSpeedMultiplier or 0
                            if Constant > math.max(Multiplier, 1) then
                                Increase = false
                                Multiplier = Constant - 0.06 * math.round(Constant)
                            end
                        end

                        for Modifier: any in Modifiers do
                            Multiplier += math.max((Modifier.moveSpeedMultiplier or 0) - 1, 0)
                        end

                        if Multiplier > 0 and Increase then
                            Multiplier += 0.16 + 0.02 * math.round(Multiplier)
                        end

                        local Current: number = 20 * (Multiplier + 1)
                        local Destination: Vector3 = Entity.Humanoid.MoveDirection * math.max(SpeedSlider.Value - Current, 0) * Delta
                        if Filtered ~= LocalPlayer.Character then
                            Filtered = LocalPlayer.Character
                            Params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {Filtered, workspace.CurrentCamera}
                        end

                        Params.CollisionGroup = Entity.RootPart.CollisionGroup

                        if WallCheck.Enabled then
                            local Wall: RaycastResult? = workspace:Raycast(Entity.RootPart.Position, Destination, Params)
                            if Wall then
                                Destination = Wall.Position + Wall.Normal - Entity.RootPart.Position
                            end
                        end

                        if not Allowed then
                            if TeleportToggle and not OldY and tick() - AirTime > AirLimit then
                                local Ground: RaycastResult? = workspace:Raycast(Entity.RootPart.Position, Vector3.new(0, -1000, 0), Params)
                                if Ground and TeleportDown.Enabled then
                                    local HipHeight: number = Entity.Humanoid.HipHeight + Entity.RootPart.Size.Y / 2 + (Entity.Humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 and 2 or 0)
                                    TeleportToggle, OldY, TeleportTick = false, Entity.RootPart.Position.Y, tick() + 0.11
                                    Entity.RootPart.CFrame = CFrame.lookAlong(Vector3.new(Entity.RootPart.Position.X, Ground.Position.Y + HipHeight, Entity.RootPart.Position.Z), Entity.RootPart.CFrame.LookVector)
                                end
                            elseif not TeleportToggle and OldY then
                                if TeleportTick < tick() then
                                    Entity.RootPart.CFrame = CFrame.lookAlong(Vector3.new(Entity.RootPart.Position.X, OldY, Entity.RootPart.Position.Z), Entity.RootPart.CFrame.LookVector)
                                    TeleportToggle, OldY = true, nil
                                else
                                    Mass = 0
                                end
                            end
                        end

                        Entity.RootPart.CFrame += Destination
                        Entity.RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Entity.Humanoid.MoveDirection * Current + Vector3.new(0, Mass, 0)
                    else
                        if Bar then
                            Bar.Frame.Visible = false
                        end
                    end
                end))

                Fly:Clean(Services.UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(Input: InputObject)
                    if Services.UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then
                        return
                    end

                    if Input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Space or Input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonA then
                        Up = 1
                    elseif Input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift or Input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL2 then
                        Down = -1
                    end
                end))

                Fly:Clean(Services.UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(Input: InputObject)
                    if Input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Space or Input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonA then
                        Up = 0
                    elseif Input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift or Input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL2 then
                        Down = 0
                    end
                end))

                if Services.UserInputService.TouchEnabled then
                    pcall(function()
                        local Jump: ImageButton = LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.TouchGui.TouchControlFrame.JumpButton
                        Fly:Clean(Jump:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ImageRectOffset"):Connect(function()
                            Up = Jump.ImageRectOffset.X == 146 and 1 or 0
                        end))
                    end)
                end
            else
                Bar = nil
                Data.Controllers.BalloonController.deflateBalloon = Original

                if PopBalloons.Enabled and Entity.Alive and ((LocalPlayer.Character :: Model):GetAttribute("InflatedBalloons") or 0) > 0 then
                    for _ = 1, ((LocalPlayer.Character :: Model):GetAttribute("InflatedBalloons") :: number) do
                        Data.Controllers.BalloonController:deflateBalloon()
                    end
                end
            end
        end,
        ExtraText = function(): string
            return "Heatseeker"
        end,
        Tooltip = "Makes you go zoom"
    })

    SpeedSlider = Fly:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Speed",
        Min = 1,
        Max = 23,
        Default = 23,
        Suffix = function(Value: number)
            return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
        end
    })
    VerticalSlider = Fly:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Vertical Speed",
        Min = 1,
        Max = 150,
        Default = 50,
        Suffix = function(Value: number)
            return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
        end
    })
    WallCheck = Fly:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Wall Check",
        Default = true
    })
    PopBalloons = Fly:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Pop Balloons",
        Default = true
    })
    TeleportDown = Fly:CreateToggle({
        Name = "TP Down",
        Default = true
    })
    ShowProgressbar = Fly:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Show Progressbar",
        Default = true,
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Bar then
                Bar.Frame:Destroy()
                Bar = nil
            end

            if Callback and Fly.Enabled then
                Bar = CreateBar()
                Fly:Clean((Bar :: {Frame: Frame, Fill: Frame, Label: TextLabel}).Frame)
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Shows a bar counting down to the next TP Down while you have no balloons"
    })
end)()

BundledModules.HitBoxes = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat
