    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity

    local HitBoxes
    local Mode, Expand

    local Index: number?
    local Boxes: {[Model]: Part} = {}
    local Session: number = 0

    HitBoxes = Cat.Categories.Blatant:CreateModule({
        Name = "HitBoxes",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback then
                Session += 1

                local Current: number = Session
                if Mode.Value == "Sword" then
                    if not Index then
                        for i: number, v: any in debug.getconstants(Data.Controllers.SwordController.swingSwordInRegion) do
                            if v == 3.8 then
                                Index = i

                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    if Index then
                        debug.setconstant(Data.Controllers.SwordController.swingSwordInRegion, Index, Expand.Value / 3)
                    else
                        Cat:CreateNotification("HitBoxes", "Sword mode could not find the swing range, use Player mode", 5)
                    end
                else
                    repeat
                        for _, v: any in Entity.Entities do
                            local Character: Model? = v.Character
                            if Character and v.Alive and not v.Self and v.RootPart and v.TargetCheck() and (not Boxes[Character] or not Boxes[Character].Parent) then
                                local Box: Part = Instance.new("Part")
                                Box.Name = "HitBox"
                                Box.Size = Vector3.new(3, 6, 3) + Vector3.one * (Expand.Value / 5)
                                Box.CFrame = v.RootPart.CFrame
                                Box.CanCollide = false
                                Box.CanTouch = false
                                Box.Massless = true
                                Box.Transparency = 1
                                Box.Archivable = false

                                local Weld: Motor6D = Instance.new("Motor6D")
                                Weld.Part0 = Box
                                Weld.Part1 = v.RootPart
                                Weld.Parent = Box
                                Box.Parent = Character
                                Boxes[Character] = Box
                            end
                        end

                        for Character: Model, Box: Part in Boxes do
                            if not Character.Parent or not Box.Parent then
                                Box:Destroy()
                                Boxes[Character] = nil
                            end
                        end

                        task.wait(0.25)
                    until not HitBoxes.Enabled or Session ~= Current
                end
            else
                if Index then
                    debug.setconstant(Data.Controllers.SwordController.swingSwordInRegion, Index, 3.8)
                end

                for _, v: Part in Boxes do
                    v:Destroy()
                end

                table.clear(Boxes)
            end
        end,
        ExtraText = function(): string
            return Mode.Value
        end,
        Tooltip = "Makes enemies easier to hit with your own swings"
    })

    Mode = HitBoxes:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Mode",
        List = {"Sword", "Player"},
        Default = "Sword",
        Function = function()
            if HitBoxes.Enabled then
                HitBoxes:Toggle()
                HitBoxes:Toggle()
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Sword - Widens the area your sword swing checks\nPlayer - Puts a bigger invisible hitbox on every enemy"
    })
    Expand = HitBoxes:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Expand",
        Min = 0,
        Max = 14.4,
        Default = 14.4,
        Decimal = 10,
        Function = function(Value: number)
            if HitBoxes.Enabled and Mode.Value == "Sword" and Index then
                debug.setconstant(Data.Controllers.SwordController.swingSwordInRegion, Index, Value / 3)
            elseif HitBoxes.Enabled then
                for _, v: Part in Boxes do
                    v.Size = Vector3.new(3, 6, 3) + Vector3.one * (Value / 5)
                end
            end
        end,
        Suffix = function(Value: number)
            return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
        end
    })
end)()

BundledModules.InfiniteFly = (function()
    local UI = BundledModules.UI
    local Cat = UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services
    local LocalPlayer: Player = Services.Players.LocalPlayer

    local Camera: Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity

    local InfiniteFly
    local VerticalSlider
    local Label: TextLabel?, ShadowLabel: TextLabel?

    local isnetworkowner = isnetworkowner or function(_): boolean
        return true
    end

    local Up, Down = 0, 0
    local Landing: boolean = false
    local Fake: Model?
    local FakeVisible: boolean = true
    local Twins: {[Instance]: BasePart} = {}
    local Hidden: {[Instance]: number | boolean} = {}
    local SimTime: number = 0
    local LagAverage: number?
    local LastView: number?
    local LastRoot: Vector3?
    local RootVelocity: Vector3 = Vector3.zero

    local AirRay: RaycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    AirRay.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

    local HiddenPart: Part = Instance.new("Part")
    HiddenPart.Transparency = 1
    HiddenPart.CanQuery = false
    HiddenPart.CanTouch = false
    HiddenPart.CanCollide = false
    HiddenPart.Anchored = true
    HiddenPart.Parent = workspace
    Cat:Clean(HiddenPart)

    local function FindGround(): RaycastResult?
        for _, v: Vector3 in {Entity.Humanoid.MoveDirection, Vector3.new(1, 0, 0), Vector3.new(0, 0, 1), Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0), Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)} do
            for Step: number = 1, 4 do
                local Ground: RaycastResult? = workspace:Blockcast(Entity.RootPart.CFrame + (v * Step), Vector3.new(3, 3, 3), Vector3.new(0, -175, 0), AirRay)
                if Ground then
                    return Ground
                end
            end
        end

        return nil
    end

    local function CenterGround(Ground: RaycastResult): Vector3
        local Cell: Vector3 = Data.Controllers.BlockController:getBlockPosition(Ground.Position) * 3
        local Center: RaycastResult? = workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(Cell.X, Ground.Position.Y + 1, Cell.Z), Vector3.new(0, -2, 0), AirRay)
        if Center and Center.Normal.Y > 0.99 and math.abs(Center.Position.Y - Ground.Position.Y) < 0.1 and not workspace:Raycast(Center.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.1, 0), Vector3.new(0, 6, 0), AirRay) then
            return Center.Position
        end

        return Ground.Position
    end

    local function Hide(Object: Instance)
        if Hidden[Object] == nil then
            if Object:IsA("BasePart") or Object:IsA("Decal") then
                Hidden[Object] = Object.LocalTransparencyModifier
                Object.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
            elseif Object:IsA("BillboardGui") then
                Hidden[Object] = Object.Enabled
                Object.Enabled = false
            end
        end
    end

    local function Release(Object: Instance)
        local Twin: BasePart? = Twins[Object]
        if Twin then
            Twins[Object] = nil
            Twin:Destroy()
        end

        local Value: (number | boolean)? = Hidden[Object]
        if Value ~= nil then
            Hidden[Object] = nil
            if type(Value) == "boolean" then
                (Object :: BillboardGui).Enabled = Value
            else
                (Object :: BasePart).LocalTransparencyModifier = Value
            end
        end
    end

    local function Match(Real: Instance, Copy: Instance)
        local Copies: {Instance} = Copy:GetChildren()
        local Index: number = 1
        for _, v: Instance in Real:GetChildren() do
            local Twin: Instance? = Copies[Index]
            if Twin and Twin.Name == v.Name and Twin.ClassName == v.ClassName then
                Index += 1
                if v:IsA("BasePart") and Twin:IsA("BasePart") then
                    Twins[v] = Twin
                end

                Match(v, Twin)
            end
        end
    end

    local function CreateFake()
        if Fake then
            Fake:Destroy()
            Fake = nil
        end

        table.clear(Twins)

        local Character: Model = Entity.Character
        local Archivable: boolean = Character.Archivable
        Character.Archivable = true
        local Clone: Model? = Character:Clone()
        Character.Archivable = Archivable

        if Clone then
            Match(Character, Clone)

            local Objects: {Instance} = Clone:GetDescendants()
            table.insert(Objects, Clone)

            local Removed: {Instance} = {}
            for _, v: Instance in Objects do
                for _, Tag: string in v:GetTags() do
                    v:RemoveTag(Tag)
                end

                if v:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or v:IsA("JointInstance") or v:IsA("Constraint") or v:IsA("WeldConstraint") or v:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or v:IsA("Trail") or v:IsA("Beam") or v:IsA("Highlight") or v:IsA("ForceField") or v:IsA("Sound") or v:IsA("ObjectValue") then
                    table.insert(Removed, v)
                elseif v:IsA("BasePart") then
                    v.CanCollide = false
                    v.CanQuery = false
                    v.CanTouch = false
                    v.Anchored = true
                end
            end

            for _, v: Instance in Removed do
                v:Destroy()
            end

            local Humanoid: Humanoid? = Clone:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if Humanoid then
                Humanoid.RequiresNeck = false
                Humanoid.BreakJointsOnDeath = false
                Humanoid.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
                Humanoid.HealthDisplayType = Enum.HumanoidHealthDisplayType.AlwaysOff
                Humanoid.EvaluateStateMachine = false
            end

            Clone.Name = "InfiniteFlyFake"
            Clone.Parent = workspace
            Fake = Clone
            FakeVisible = true
        end
    end

    local function TrackRoot(Delta: number)
        if Entity.Alive then
            local Position: Vector3 = Entity.RootPart.Position
            SimTime += Delta

            if LastRoot and Delta > 0 then
                RootVelocity = Vector3.new(Position.X - LastRoot.X, 0, Position.Z - LastRoot.Z) / Delta
            end

            LastRoot = Position
        end
    end

    local function UpdateView(Delta: number)
        for Object: Instance, Value in Hidden do
            if type(Value) == "number" then
                if (Object :: BasePart).LocalTransparencyModifier ~= 1 then
                    (Object :: BasePart).LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
                end
            elseif (Object :: BillboardGui).Enabled then
                (Object :: BillboardGui).Enabled = false
            end
        end

        if Entity.Alive then
            local Now: number = os.clock()
            local Step: number = math.min(LastView and Now - LastView or Delta, 0.1)
            LastView = Now

            local Lag: number = Now - SimTime
            local Average: number = LagAverage and (LagAverage + (Lag - LagAverage) * math.min(Step / 0.25, 1)) or Lag
            LagAverage = Average

            local Extra: Vector3 = RootVelocity * (Lag - Average)
            if Extra.Magnitude > 2 then
                Extra = Extra.Unit * 2
            end

            local Root: Vector3 = Entity.RootPart.Position
            HiddenPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(Root.X + Extra.X, HiddenPart.Position.Y + Step * ((Up + Down) * VerticalSlider.Value), Root.Z + Extra.Z)

            if Fake then
                local Shift: Vector3 = Vector3.new(HiddenPart.Position.X - Root.X, HiddenPart.Position.Y - (Entity.Character.Head :: BasePart).Position.Y, HiddenPart.Position.Z - Root.Z)
                for Real: Instance, Twin: BasePart in Twins do
                    Twin.CFrame = (Real :: BasePart).CFrame + Shift
                end

                local Visible: boolean = (Camera.CFrame.Position - Camera.Focus.Position).Magnitude > 1
                if Visible ~= FakeVisible then
                    FakeVisible = Visible
                    for _, v: Instance in Fake:QueryDescendants("BasePart, Decal, BillboardGui") do
                        if v:IsA("BillboardGui") then
                            v.Enabled = Visible
                        else
                            (v :: BasePart).LocalTransparencyModifier = Visible and 0 or 1
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local function Finish()
        for Object: Instance in Hidden do
            Release(Object)
        end

        table.clear(Hidden)
        table.clear(Twins)

        if Fake then
            Fake:Destroy()
            Fake = nil
        end

        local Humanoid: Humanoid? = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if Camera.CameraSubject == HiddenPart and Humanoid then
            Camera.CameraSubject = Humanoid
        end

        Landing = false
    end
    Cat:Clean(Finish)

    InfiniteFly = Cat.Categories.Blatant:CreateModule({
        Name = "InfiniteFly",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Label and ShadowLabel then
                Label.Visible = Callback
                ShadowLabel.Visible = Callback
            end

            AirRay.FilterDescendantsInstances = {Data.Storage.Map}

            if Callback then
                if not Entity.Alive or not Data.Storage.Map or Landing or (Cat.Modules.Fly ~= nil and Cat.Modules.Fly.Enabled) or workspace:Raycast(Entity.RootPart.Position, Vector3.new(0, -1000, 0), AirRay) then
                    Cat:CreateNotification("InfiniteFly", "Cannot fly at this state.", 8)
                    InfiniteFly:Toggle()
                else
                    local Root: BasePart = Entity.RootPart
                    local Start: Vector3 = Root.Position

                    HiddenPart.CFrame = (Entity.Character.Head :: BasePart).CFrame
                    pcall(CreateFake)
                    Camera.CameraSubject = HiddenPart

                    for _, v: Instance in Entity.Character:QueryDescendants("BasePart, Decal, BillboardGui") do
                        Hide(v)
                    end

                    InfiniteFly:Clean(Entity.Character.DescendantAdded:Connect(Hide))
                    InfiniteFly:Clean(Entity.Character.DescendantRemoving:Connect(Release))

                    Data.Storage.Desyncing, Landing = true, true
                    Up, Down = 0, 0

                    InfiniteFly:Clean(Services.UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(Input: InputObject)
                        if not Services.UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then
                            if Input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Space or Input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonA then
                                Up = 1
                            elseif Input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift or Input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL2 then
                                Down = -1
                            end
                        end
                    end))

                    InfiniteFly:Clean(Services.UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(Input: InputObject)
                        if Input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Space or Input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonA then
                            Up = 0
                        elseif Input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift or Input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL2 then
                            Down = 0
                        end
                    end))

                    SimTime, LagAverage, LastView, LastRoot, RootVelocity = 0, nil, nil, nil, Vector3.zero
                    InfiniteFly:Clean(Services.RunService.PostSimulation:Connect(TrackRoot))

                    pcall(Services.RunService.UnbindFromRenderStep, Services.RunService, "InfiniteFlyView")
                    Services.RunService:BindToRenderStep("InfiniteFlyView", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value - 1, UpdateView)
                    InfiniteFly:Clean(function()
                        Services.RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("InfiniteFlyView")
                    end)

                    InfiniteFly:Clean(Services.RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function()
                        if not (Cat.Modules.Fly ~= nil and Cat.Modules.Fly.Enabled) then
                            if not Entity.Alive or not isnetworkowner(Root) then
                                Cat:CreateNotification("InfiniteFly", "Network ownership disowned", 10)
                                InfiniteFly:Toggle()
                            elseif workspace:Raycast(Root.Position, Vector3.new(0, -1000, 0), AirRay) then
                                Cat:CreateNotification("InfiniteFly", "Force landing", 3.5)
                                InfiniteFly:Toggle()
                            else
                                if Label and ShadowLabel then
                                    Label.Text = `{math.round((Start - Vector3.new(Root.Position.X, HiddenPart.Position.Y, Root.Position.Z)).Magnitude / 3)} blocks`
                                    ShadowLabel.Text = Label.Text
                                end

                                if Root.Position.Y <= HiddenPart.Position.Y + 4 or FindGround() then
                                    Root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAlong(Vector3.new(Root.Position.X, 195, Root.Position.Z), Root.CFrame.LookVector)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end))
                end
            elseif Data.Storage.Desyncing then
                Data.Storage.Desyncing = false

                local NoFall = Cat.Modules.NoFall
                if NoFall and not NoFall.Enabled then
                    NoFall:Toggle()
                end

                local Fall: number = 0
                local Ground: RaycastResult?

                if Entity.Alive and isnetworkowner(Entity.RootPart) then
                    local Root: BasePart = Entity.RootPart
                    Fall = 1
                    Ground = workspace:Raycast(Root.Position, Vector3.new(0, -1000, 0), AirRay)

                    if Ground then
                        local Height: number = math.max(Root.Position.Y - Ground.Position.Y - Entity.Humanoid.HipHeight - (Root.Size.Y / 2), 0)
                        local Speed: number = math.max(-Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, 0)
                        Fall = (-Speed + math.sqrt((Speed * Speed) + (2 * workspace.Gravity * Height))) / workspace.Gravity
                    end
                end

                task.wait(Fall / 2.55)

                if Ground and Entity.Alive then
                    local Success: boolean, Position: Vector3 = pcall(CenterGround, Ground)
                    Entity.RootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new((Success and Position or Ground.Position) + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0))
                end

                Finish()
                Cat:CreateNotification("InfiniteFly", "Landed", 2.5)
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Makes you go zoom",
        ExtraText = function(): string
            return "Heatseeker"
        end
    })

    VerticalSlider = InfiniteFly:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Vertical Speed",
        Min = 1,
        Max = 150,
        Default = 50,
        Suffix = function(Value: number): string
            return Value <= 1 and "stud" or "studs"
        end
    })
    InfiniteFly:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Show distance",
        Default = true,
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback then
                local Main: TextLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                Main.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(100, 20)
                Main.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 6, 0.5, 60)
                Main.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                Main.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
                Main.Text = "0 blocks"
                Main.ZIndex = 6
                Main.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
                Main.TextSize = 18
                Main.RichText = true
                Main.FontFace = UI.Font
                Main.Visible = InfiniteFly.Enabled
                Main.Parent = Cat.Ui.Gui

                local Shadow: TextLabel = Main:Clone()
                Shadow.ZIndex = 5
                Shadow.Position += UDim2.fromOffset(1, 1)
                Shadow.TextColor3 = Color3.new()
                Shadow.Parent = Cat.Ui.Gui

                Label, ShadowLabel = Main, Shadow
            else
                if ShadowLabel then
                    ShadowLabel:Destroy()
                    ShadowLabel = nil
                end

                if Label then
                    Label:Destroy()
                    Label = nil
                end
            end
        end
    })
end)()

BundledModules.KeepSprint = (function()
    BundledModules.UI.Cat.Categories.Blatant:CreateModule({
        Name = "KeepSprint",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            debug.setconstant(Data.Controllers.SprintController.startSprinting, 5, Callback and "blockSprinting" or "blockSprint")
            Data.Controllers.SprintController:stopSprinting()
        end,
        Tooltip = "Lets you sprint with a speed potion."
    })
end)()

BundledModules.SlotController = (function()
    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity

    local SlotController = {
        Owner = nil :: string?,
        Expires = 0,
        Fight = 0
    }

    SlotController.Switch = function(Tool: Tool, Wait: number?): boolean
        local Hand: ObjectValue? = Entity.Alive and Entity.Character:FindFirstChild("HandInvItem") :: ObjectValue? or nil
        if not Hand or Hand.Value == Tool or not Tool.Parent then
            return false
        end

        task.spawn(function()
            Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("SetInvItem"):CallServerAsync({hand = Tool})
        end)
        Hand.Value = Tool
        if (Wait or 0.05) > 0 then
            task.wait(Wait or 0.05)
        end

        return true
    end

    SlotController.Select = function(Tool: Tool): boolean
        for Index: number, v: any in (Data.Storage.Inventory.hotbar or {}) do
            if v.item and v.item.tool == Tool then
                if Data.Storage.Inventory.hotbarSlot == Index - 1 then
                    return false
                end

                Data.Controllers.Store:dispatch({
                    type = "InventorySelectHotbarSlot",
                    slot = Index - 1
                })

                return true
            end
        end

        return false
    end

    return SlotController
end)()

BundledModules.Killaura = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services
    local LocalPlayer: Player = Services.Players.LocalPlayer

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity
    local Hitreg = BundledModules.Hitreg
    local Animations = BundledModules.Animations
    local Blocks = BundledModules.Blocks
    local Ballistic = BundledModules.Ballistic
    local Ping = BundledModules.Ping
    local SlotController = BundledModules.SlotController
    local AimArrow = BundledModules.AimArrow

    local Killaura
    local Targets, Sort
    local SwingRange, AttackRange, AngleSlider, AirHits, SwingTime, AttackSpeed, HighHitreg, MaxTargets
    local FastHits, Whitelist, UseSophia, UseWhim, UseNazar, UseUmeko, UseLasso, Legit, FireRate
    local ContinueSwing, Mouse, AFKCheck, Attackable, Swing, GUI
    local ShowTarget, BoxAttackTween, BoxAttackSpeed, BoxAttackSpeedEnd, BoxSwingColor, BoxAttackColor
    local TargetParticles, ParticleTexture, ParticleColor1, ParticleColor2, ParticleSize
    local Face, ShowAim, AimColor, Animation, AnimationMode, AnimationSpeed, AnimationTween, Limit, LegitAura

    local Old: ((...any) -> ...any)?
    local Hook: ((...any) -> ...any)?
    local Generator: Random = Random.new()
    local Anchor: AnchorState = Hitreg.Shared
    local SwingWindow: number = Hitreg.Constants.Anchor.Stride * Hitreg.Constants.Anchor.Tick + 0.05
    local Boxes: {BoxHandleAdornment} = {}
    local Particles: {Part} = {}
    local Shown: {[Instance]: boolean} = {}
    local Watchers: {RBXScriptConnection} = {}
    local FireRates: {[string]: number} = {}
    local Trail: {Times: {number}, Positions: {Vector3}} = {Times = {}, Positions = {}}
    local Reference: {Low: Vector3, High: Vector3, Claim: Vector3} = {Low = Vector3.zero, High = Vector3.zero, Claim = Vector3.zero}
    local SophiaStaffs: {string} = {"frost_staff_3", "frost_staff_2", "frost_staff_1"}
    local NazarWeapons: {string} = {"life_bow", "life_crossbow", "life_headhunter"}
    local Arc: RaycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    Arc.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

    local LastEffect: number, LastAttack: number, EffectSwing: number, AnimDelay: number = 0, 0, 0, 0
    local ContinueUntil: number, LastInput: number, LastShot: number, NextSwap: number = 0, tick(), 0, 0
    local SwingGap: number, ShotIndex: number, Session: number = 0.11, 0, 0
    local Firing: boolean = false
    local FaceTarget: Target?, FaceFound: number, FaceSeen: number, Facing: boolean = nil, 0, 0, false
    local FaceSpeed: number = 20
    local ArmWrist: Motor6D?, ArmC0: CFrame?

    local function Track(Position: Vector3, Now: number)
        if #Trail.Times > 0 and Now - Trail.Times[#Trail.Times] > 0.25 then
            table.clear(Trail.Times)
            table.clear(Trail.Positions)
        end

        table.insert(Trail.Times, Now)
        table.insert(Trail.Positions, Position)

        local Stale: boolean
        repeat
            Stale = #Trail.Times > 2 and Now - Trail.Times[2] >= 0.3
            if Stale then
                table.remove(Trail.Times, 1)
                table.remove(Trail.Positions, 1)
            end
        until not Stale
    end

    local function TrailAt(Moment: number, Fallback: Vector3): Vector3
        if #Trail.Times == 0 then
            return Fallback
        end
        if Moment <= Trail.Times[1] then
            return Trail.Positions[1]
        end

        for Index: number = 2, #Trail.Times do
            if Trail.Times[Index] >= Moment then
                local Span: number = Trail.Times[Index] - Trail.Times[Index - 1]

                return Trail.Positions[Index - 1]:Lerp(Trail.Positions[Index], Span > 0 and (Moment - Trail.Times[Index - 1]) / Span or 1)
            end
        end

        return Trail.Positions[#Trail.Positions]
    end

    local function PlaySwing(Sword: InventoryItem, Meta: any)
        local Delay: number = math.max(SwingTime:GetRandomValue(), 0.11)
        local Mount: any = Data.Controllers.TinkerKitController.userMap and Data.Controllers.TinkerKitController.userMap[LocalPlayer]
        if typeof(Mount) ~= "Instance" or not Mount.Parent then
            Mount = nil
            for _, v: Instance in Entity.Character:GetChildren() do
                if v:IsA("Model") and v.Name:match("tinker$") then
                    Mount = v

                    break
                end
            end
        end

        if Mount then
            AnimDelay = tick() + math.max(Delay, 0.35)
            Data.Controllers.AudioManager:playAudio(Data.Instances.Sounds.DRILL_ATTACK_1)
            Data.Controllers.MountAnimationController:playAnimationInMount(Mount, Data.Instances.Animations.TINKER_ATTACK, 1.85)
        else
            AnimDelay = tick() + Delay
            Data.Controllers.SwordController:playSwordEffect(Meta, false, {itemSkin = Sword.itemSkin})
            if (Meta.displayName or ""):find(" Scythe") then
                Data.Controllers.ScytheController:playLocalAnimation()
            end
        end

        SwingGap = Delay
    end

    local function Matches(Names: {string?}): boolean
        for _, v: string in Whitelist.ListEnabled do
            local Needle: string = (tostring(v):lower():gsub("[_%s]+", " "))
            if #Needle == 0 then
                continue
            end

            for _, Name: string? in Names do
                local Clean: string? = Name and (tostring(Name):lower():gsub("[_%s]+", " "))
                if Clean and (Clean == Needle or (` {Clean}`):find(` {Needle}`, 1, true)) then
                    return true
                end
            end
        end

        return false
    end

    local function KitSource(ItemType: string): any
        if UseSophia.Enabled and table.find(SophiaStaffs, ItemType) then
            if Data.Controllers.FrostyGunController.projectileMode == Data.Instances.FrostyGunMode.PROJECTILE then
                return Data.Instances.Items[ItemType].projectileSource
            end
            if tick() >= NextSwap and Data.Controllers.AbilityController:canUseAbility("frosty_gun_swap", {disableBlockedAbilityAlert = true}) then
                NextSwap = tick() + 1
                Data.Controllers.AbilityController:useAbility("frosty_gun_swap")
            end
        end
        if UseWhim.Enabled and ItemType == "mage_spellbook" then
            local Element: string? = Data.Instances.BalanceFile.MAGE_ELEMENT_CYCLE[(LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("MageElementIndex") or 0) + 1]
            local Success: boolean, Unlocked: any = pcall(Data.Controllers.MageKitUtil.getUnlockedMageElements, LocalPlayer)
            if not Element or not Success or type(Unlocked) ~= "table" or not table.find(Unlocked, Element) then
                Element = "BASE"
            end

            local Meta: any = Data.Controllers.MageKitUtil.MageElementMeta[Element :: string]
            if Meta and Meta.projectileSource then
                return Meta.projectileSource
            end
        end
        if UseNazar.Enabled and table.find(NazarWeapons, ItemType) then
            return Data.Instances.Items[ItemType].projectileSource
        elseif UseUmeko.Enabled and ItemType:match("^ninja_chakram_%d+$") and not Data.Controllers.ChakramController.chakramIsLaunched then
            return Data.Instances.Items[ItemType].projectileSource
        end

        return nil
    end

    local function MageSource(ItemType: string): any
        if ItemType ~= "wizard_stick" then
            return nil
        end

        local Chosen: any = Data.Controllers.MageKitUtil.MageElementMeta.BASE
        local Success: boolean, Unlocked: any = pcall(Data.Controllers.MageKitUtil.getUnlockedMageElements, LocalPlayer)
        if Success and type(Unlocked) == "table" then
            for Index: number, v: string in Unlocked do
                local Element: any = Data.Controllers.MageKitUtil.MageElementMeta[v] or Data.Controllers.MageKitUtil.MageElementMeta[Index]
                if Element and Element.projectileSource then
                    Chosen = Element
                end
            end
        end

        return Chosen and Chosen.projectileSource
    end

    local function Shots(): {AuraShot}
        local List: {AuraShot} = {}
        for _, v: InventoryItem in (Data.Storage.Inventory.inventory.items or {}) do
            local Meta: any = Data.Instances.Items[v.itemType]
            local Kit: any = KitSource(v.itemType)
            local Source: any = Kit or (Meta and (Meta.projectileSource or MageSource(v.itemType)))
            if Source then
                local Ammo: string? = v.itemType
                if Source.ammoItemTypes and #Source.ammoItemTypes > 0 then
                    Ammo = nil
                    for _, Item: InventoryItem in Data.Storage.Inventory.inventory.items do
                        if table.find(Source.ammoItemTypes, Item.itemType) then
                            Ammo = Item.itemType

                            break
                        end
                    end
                end

                if Ammo and (Kit or Matches({Ammo, v.itemType, Meta and Meta.displayName})) then
                    table.insert(List, {Item = v, Ammo = Ammo, Projectile = Source.projectileType(Ammo), Source = Source})
                end
            end
        end

        if UseLasso.Enabled then
            for _, v: InventoryItem in (Data.Storage.Inventory.inventory.items or {}) do
                if v.itemType ~= "lasso" then
                    continue
                end

                for _, Entry: AuraShot in List do
                    if Entry.Item.itemType == "lasso" then
                        return List
                    end
                end

                local Source: any = Data.Instances.Items.lasso.projectileSource
                table.insert(List, {Item = v, Ammo = "lasso", Projectile = Source.projectileType("lasso"), Source = Source})

                break
            end
        end

        return List
    end

    local function PlayLaunch(Item: InventoryItem, Source: any)
        local Skin: any = Item.itemSkin and Data.Controllers.ItemSkinMeta.getItemSkinMeta(Item.itemSkin)
        if Skin and type(Skin.projectileSourceOverrides) == "table" then
            Source = table.clone(Source)
            for Key: string, Value: any in Skin.projectileSourceOverrides do
                Source[Key] = Value
            end
        end

        local Config: any = Source.launchSoundConfig
        if Source.launchSound and #Source.launchSound > 0 then
            local Pitch: any = Config and Config.pitch
            Data.Controllers.AudioManager:playAudio(Source.launchSound[math.random(1, #Source.launchSound)], {
                playbackSpeedMultiplier = Pitch and (math.random() * (Pitch.Max - Pitch.Min) + Pitch.Min) or nil,
                volumeMultiplier = Config and Config.volumeMultiplier or 1
            })
        end
        if Source.launchOverlaySound and Source.launchOverlaySound ~= "" then
            local Pitch: any = Config and Config.launchOverlayPitch
            Data.Controllers.AudioManager:playAudio(Source.launchOverlaySound, {
                playbackSpeedMultiplier = Pitch and (math.random() * (Pitch.Max - Pitch.Min) + Pitch.Min) or nil
            })
        end
    end

    local function Watch(Id: string, Origin: Vector3, Velocity: Vector3, Gravity: number, Target: Target, Lifetime: number?)
        local Character: Model? = Target.Character
        if not Character or Velocity.Magnitude <= 0 then
            return
        end

        local Overlap: OverlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
        Overlap.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
        Overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances = {Character}

        local Steps: number = math.clamp(math.ceil(Velocity.Magnitude / 170), 1, 16)
        local Started: number = os.clock()
        local Last: Vector3 = Origin
        local Watcher: RBXScriptConnection
        Watcher = Services.RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            local Elapsed: number = os.clock() - Started
            if Elapsed > (Lifetime or 2) or not Character.Parent then
                Watcher:Disconnect()

                return
            end

            local Position: Vector3 = Origin + Velocity * Elapsed - Vector3.new(0, 0.5 * Gravity * Elapsed * Elapsed, 0)
            for Step: number = 1, Steps do
                if #workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(Last:Lerp(Position, Step / Steps)), Vector3.new(3, 1, 3), Overlap) > 0 then
                    Watcher:Disconnect()
                    Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("ProjectileHit"):SendToServer(Id, Character)

                    return
                end
            end

            if workspace:Raycast(Last, Position - Last, Arc) then
                Watcher:Disconnect()

                return
            end

            Last = Position
        end)
        table.insert(Watchers, Watcher)
    end

    local function Shoot(Target: Target, Origin: Vector3)
        local List: {AuraShot} = Shots()
        if #List > 0 and (not SlotController.Owner or SlotController.Owner == "Killaura" or tick() >= SlotController.Expires) then
            SlotController.Owner, SlotController.Expires = "Killaura", tick() + 1

            ShotIndex = ShotIndex % #List + 1

            local Shot: AuraShot = List[ShotIndex]
            local Meta: any = Data.Instances.ProjectileMeta[Shot.Projectile]
            if tick() > (FireRates[Shot.Item.itemType] or 0) and Meta and type(Meta.launchVelocity) == "number" then
                local Gravity: number = Meta.gravitationalAcceleration or 196.2
                local OldTool: Tool? = Data.Storage.Hand.Tool
                for _, v: any in (Data.Storage.Inventory.hotbar or {}) do
                    if v.item and v.item.tool == Shot.Item.tool then
                        SlotController.Switch(Shot.Item.tool, 0.1)
                        if Legit.Enabled then
                            SlotController.Select(Shot.Item.tool)
                        end

                        break
                    end
                end

                local Offset: Vector3 = Vector3.new(-(Data.Instances.BowConstants.RelX or 0), -(Data.Instances.BowConstants.RelY or 0), -(Data.Instances.BowConstants.RelZ or 0))
                local Launch: Vector3 = (CFrame.new(Origin, Target.RootPart.Position) * CFrame.new(Offset)).Position
                local Direction: Vector3?, Time: number = Ballistic.Solve(Target, Launch, Meta.launchVelocity, Gravity, true)
                local Ignore: {Instance} = {workspace.CurrentCamera, Entity.Character}
                for _, v: Target in Entity.Entities do
                    if v.Character then
                        table.insert(Ignore, v.Character)
                    end
                end
                Arc.FilterDescendantsInstances = Ignore

                if Direction and Time <= (Meta.lifetimeSec or 3) and Ballistic.Clear(Launch, Direction * Meta.launchVelocity, Gravity, Time, Arc) then
                    local Velocity: Vector3 = Direction * Meta.launchVelocity
                    local Id: string = Data.Controllers.IdUtil.generateId(8)
                    Firing = true
                    Watch(Id, Launch, Velocity, Gravity, Target, Meta.lifetimeSec)
                    FireRates[Shot.Item.itemType] = tick() + (Shot.Source.fireDelaySec or 0.1)
                    LastShot = tick() + FireRate.Value

                    task.spawn(function()
                        local Success: boolean, Response: any = pcall(function()
                            local Stamp: number = workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - Ping.Get() / 10
                            local Payload: {shotId: string, drawDurationSec: number} = {
                                shotId = Data.Controllers.IdUtil.generateId(8),
                                drawDurationSec = math.max(1, Shot.Source.maxStrengthChargeSec or 0)
                            }

                            return Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("ProjectileFire"):CallServer(Shot.Item.tool, Shot.Ammo, Shot.Projectile, Launch, Origin, Velocity, Id, Payload, Stamp)
                        end)

                        Firing = false
                        if Success and type(Response) == "table" and Response.accepted then
                            PlayLaunch(Shot.Item, Shot.Source)
                        end
                    end)
                end

                if OldTool then
                    SlotController.Switch(OldTool)
                    if Legit.Enabled then
                        SlotController.Select(OldTool)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local function Visuals(Picks: {AuraPick})
        for Index: number, v: BoxHandleAdornment in Boxes do
            local Pick: AuraPick? = Picks[Index]
            if Pick and not Shown[v] then
                v.Size = Vector3.zero
                Services.TweenService:Create(v, TweenInfo.new(BoxAttackSpeed.Value, Enum.EasingStyle[BoxAttackTween.Value]), {Size = Vector3.new(2.5, 6, 2.5)}):Play()
            elseif not Pick and Shown[v] then
                Services.TweenService:Create(v, TweenInfo.new(BoxAttackSpeedEnd.Value, Enum.EasingStyle[BoxAttackTween.Value]), {Size = Vector3.zero}):Play()
            end

            Shown[v] = Pick ~= nil or nil
            if Pick then
                local Color: any = Pick.Hittable and BoxAttackColor or BoxSwingColor
                v.Adornee = Pick.Target.RootPart
                v.Color3 = Color3.fromHSV(Color.Hue, Color.Sat, Color.Value)
                v.Transparency = 1 - Color.Opacity
            end
        end

        for Index: number, v: Part in Particles do
            local Pick: AuraPick? = Picks[Index]
            if Pick then
                v.Position = Pick.Target.RootPart.Position
                if not Shown[v] then
                    v.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera
                    Shown[v] = true
                end
            elseif Shown[v] ~= false then
                v.Position = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
                v.Parent = nil
                Shown[v] = false
            end
        end
    end

    local function Animate(Current: number)
        local Started: boolean = false
        local Blend: number, Cycle: number = 0, 0
        repeat
            local Viewmodel: Instance? = workspace.CurrentCamera:FindFirstChild("Viewmodel")
            local Hand: Instance? = Viewmodel and Viewmodel:FindFirstChild("RightHand")
            local Wrist: Motor6D? = Hand and Hand:FindFirstChild("RightWrist") :: Motor6D?
            local Pose: ((number) -> CFrame)? = Blocks.Poses[AnimationMode.Value]
            if not Wrist then
                ArmWrist, ArmC0, Started, Blend = nil, nil, false, 0
                task.wait()
            elseif Pose then
                if Wrist ~= ArmWrist then
                    ArmWrist, ArmC0 = Wrist, Wrist.C0
                end

                local Delta: number = Services.RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
                local Fade: number = AnimationTween.Enabled and 0.001 or 0.09
                Blend = math.clamp(Blend + (Data.Storage.Attacking and Delta or -Delta) / Fade, 0, 1)
                if Data.Storage.Attacking and Blend >= 1 then
                    Cycle = (Cycle + Delta * math.max(AnimationSpeed.Value, 0.01) / 0.3) % 1
                elseif Blend <= 0 then
                    Cycle = 0
                end

                Started = Blend > 0
                local Head: BasePart? = (Viewmodel :: Instance):FindFirstChild("Head") :: BasePart?
                if Wrist.Part0 and Wrist.Part1 and Head and Wrist.Parent then
                    local Base: CFrame = Pose(Cycle)
                    local Shift: CFrame = Base * Blocks.Hold:Inverse()
                    local Eye: CFrame = Head.CFrame.Rotation
                    local Gear: Instance? = (Viewmodel :: Instance):FindFirstChildOfClass("Accessory")
                    local Handle: BasePart? = Gear and Gear:FindFirstChild("Handle") :: BasePart?
                    local Offset: CFrame = Handle and Wrist.Part1.CFrame:Inverse() * Handle.CFrame or CFrame.identity
                    local Item: CFrame = Wrist.Part0.CFrame * (ArmC0 :: CFrame) * Wrist.Transform * Wrist.C1:Inverse() * Offset
                    local Move: Vector3 = Eye:VectorToWorldSpace((Base * Blocks.Pivot - Blocks.Hold * Blocks.Pivot) * 3 - Vector3.new(0, 0.75, 0))
                    local Eased: number = Blend * Blend * (3 - 2 * Blend)
                    local Target: CFrame = Item:Lerp(CFrame.new(Item.Position + Move) * Eye * Shift.Rotation * Eye:Inverse() * Item.Rotation, Eased)
                    Wrist.C0 = Wrist.Part0.CFrame:Inverse() * Target * Offset:Inverse() * Wrist.C1 * Wrist.Transform:Inverse()
                end
            else
                if Wrist ~= ArmWrist then
                    ArmWrist, ArmC0 = Wrist, Wrist.C0
                end

                if Data.Storage.Attacking then
                    local First: boolean = not Started
                    Started = true
                    if AnimationMode.Value == "Random" then
                        Animations.Random = {{CFrame = CFrame.Angles(math.rad(math.random(1, 360)), math.rad(math.random(1, 360)), math.rad(math.random(1, 360))), Time = 0.12}}
                    end

                    for _, v: AuraStep in Animations[AnimationMode.Value] do
                        if not Killaura.Enabled or not Data.Storage.Attacking or Session ~= Current or not Wrist.Parent then
                            break
                        end

                        local Duration: number = First and (AnimationTween.Enabled and 0.001 or 0.1) or v.Time / math.max(AnimationSpeed.Value, 0.01)
                        local Tween: Tween = Services.TweenService:Create(Wrist, TweenInfo.new(Duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {C0 = (ArmC0 :: CFrame) * v.CFrame})
                        Tween:Play()
                        Tween.Completed:Wait()
                        First = false
                    end
                elseif Started then
                    Started = false
                    Services.TweenService:Create(Wrist, TweenInfo.new(AnimationTween.Enabled and 0.001 or 0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Exponential), {C0 = ArmC0}):Play()
                end

                if not Started then
                    task.wait()
                end
            end
        until not Killaura.Enabled or not Animation.Enabled or Session ~= Current
    end

    Killaura = Cat.Categories.Blatant:CreateModule({
        Name = "Killaura",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback then
                Session += 1

                local Current: number = Session

                Old = Data.Controllers.SwordController.playSwordEffect
                Hook = function(self: any, Meta: any, Charged: boolean, Config: any): ...any
                    if Killaura.Enabled and Session == Current and (not Config or Config.playAnimation ~= false) then
                        if LegitAura.Enabled then
                            if tick() - LastAttack < 0.4 and Data.Controllers.SwordController.lastSwing == EffectSwing then
                                return
                            end

                            EffectSwing = Data.Controllers.SwordController.lastSwing

                            return (Old :: (...any) -> ...any)(self, Meta, Charged, Config)
                        elseif (tick() - LastAttack >= 0.4 and tick() - AnimDelay >= 0.4) or tick() - LastEffect >= SwingGap then
                            LastEffect, SwingGap = tick(), math.max(SwingTime:GetRandomValue(), 0.11)

                            return (Old :: (...any) -> ...any)(self, Meta, Charged, Config)
                        end
                    else
                        return (Old :: (...any) -> ...any)(self, Meta, Charged, Config)
                    end
                end
                Data.Controllers.SwordController.playSwordEffect = Hook

                local Override: any = Data.Instances.SyncEvents.SwordSwing:setPriority(160):connect(function(Event: any)
                    if tick() - LastAttack < 1 and type(Event.config) == "table" and Event.config.respectAttackSpeedOverride then
                        Event.config.respectAttackSpeedOverride = nil
                    end
                end)
                Killaura:Clean(function()
                    Override:Destroy()
                end)
                Killaura:Clean(Services.RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(Delta: number)
                    Anchor.Frame = math.min(Delta * 2, math.max(Delta, 0.01))
                end))
                local Arrow: any = AimArrow.new()
                Killaura:Clean(function()
                    Arrow:Destroy()
                end)
                Killaura:Clean(Services.RunService.PostSimulation:Connect(function(Delta: number)
                    local Target: Target? = FaceTarget
                    local Active: boolean = Face.Enabled and Entity.Alive and Target ~= nil and Target.RootPart ~= nil and Target.RootPart.Parent ~= nil and tick() - FaceSeen < 0.5
                    if not Active then
                        Arrow:Update(nil, Color3.new(), 1)
                        if Facing and Entity.Alive then
                            Entity.Humanoid.AutoRotate = true
                        end
                        Facing = false

                        return
                    end

                    Facing = true
                    Entity.Humanoid.AutoRotate = false
                    local Time: number = math.min((tick() - FaceFound) / (1 / (FaceSpeed * 0.5)), 1)
                    local Eased: number = FaceSpeed * (Time < 0.5 and 4 * Time * Time * Time or 1 - math.pow(-2 * Time + 2, 3) / 2)
                    local Point: Vector3 = (Target :: Target).RootPart.Position
                    local Direction: Vector3 = Vector3.new(Point.X - Entity.RootPart.Position.X, 0, Point.Z - Entity.RootPart.Position.Z)
                    if Direction.Magnitude > 0 then
                        Entity.RootPart.CFrame = Entity.RootPart.CFrame:Lerp(CFrame.lookAlong(Entity.RootPart.Position, Direction), math.clamp((Eased + 2) * Delta, 0, 1))
                    end
                    Arrow:Update(ShowAim.Enabled and Entity.RootPart.Position + Entity.RootPart.CFrame.LookVector * 50 or nil, Color3.fromHSV(AimColor.Hue, AimColor.Sat, AimColor.Value), 1 - AimColor.Opacity)
                end))
                Killaura:Clean(function()
                    if Facing and Entity.Alive then
                        Entity.Humanoid.AutoRotate = true
                    end
                    Facing, FaceTarget = false, nil
                end)
                Killaura:Clean(Data.Events.EntityDamageEvent:Connect(function(Event: {entityInstance: Model?, damageType: number, fromEntity: Model?})
                    if Event.fromEntity ~= LocalPlayer.Character or Event.damageType ~= 0 or not Event.entityInstance then
                        return
                    end

                    Anchor:Hear(Event.entityInstance)
                end))
                for _, v: RBXScriptSignal in {Services.UserInputService.InputBegan, Services.UserInputService.InputChanged} do
                    Killaura:Clean(v:Connect(function(Input: InputObject)
                        if Input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or Input.Delta.Magnitude > 0 then
                            LastInput = tick()
                        end
                    end))
                end

                if Animation.Enabled then
                    local Fake: (typeof(Data.Instances.Knit)) = {
                        Controllers = setmetatable({
                            ViewmodelController = {
                                isVisible = function(): boolean
                                    return Data.Controllers.ViewmodelController:isVisible()
                                end,
                                playAnimation = function(...): ...any
                                    if LegitAura.Enabled or not Data.Storage.Attacking or not (ArmWrist and ArmWrist.Parent) then
                                        return Data.Controllers.ViewmodelController:playAnimation(select(2, ...))
                                    end

                                    return nil
                                end
                            }
                        }, {
                            __index = Data.Instances.Knit.Controllers
                        })
                    }

                    debug.setupvalue(rawget(rawget(getmetatable(Data.Controllers.SwordController), "__index"), "playSwordEffect"), 7, Fake)
                    debug.setupvalue(Data.Controllers.ScytheController.playLocalAnimation, 3, Fake)
                    task.spawn(Animate, Current)
                end

                local Cooldown: number, LastHit: number, ScanAt: number = 0, 0, 0
                local Remote: any = Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("SwordHit")
                local Found: {Target} = {}
                repeat
                    task.wait()
                    if not Killaura.Enabled or Session ~= Current then
                        break
                    end

                    local Blocked: boolean = (Mouse.Enabled and not Services.UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)) or (AFKCheck.Enabled and tick() - LastInput >= 30) or (GUI.Enabled and Data.Controllers.AppController:isLayerOpen(Data.Instances.Layers.MAIN))
                    if Attackable.Enabled and not Blocked then
                        Blocked = not Entity.Alive or (Entity.Character:GetAttribute("StunnedUntilTime") or 0) > workspace:GetServerTimeNow() or Entity.Character:FindFirstChild("elk") ~= nil or Data.Controllers.StatusEffectUtil:isActive(Entity.Character, "frozen")
                    end

                    local Sword: InventoryItem? = nil
                    if not Blocked and Entity.Alive then
                        Sword = Limit.Enabled and Data.Storage.Inventory.inventory.hand or Data.Storage.Tools.Sword
                        if Sword and (not Sword.tool or (Limit.Enabled and (Data.Storage.Hand.Type ~= "sword" or Data.Controllers.DaoController.chargingMaid)) or (LegitAura.Enabled and tick() - Data.Controllers.SwordController.lastSwing > SwingWindow)) then
                            Sword = nil
                        end
                    end

                    local Meta: any = Sword and Sword.tool and Data.Instances.Items[Sword.tool.Name]
                    local Picks: {AuraPick} = {}
                    Data.Storage.Attacking = false
                    if Sword and Meta and Meta.sword then
                        local Root: BasePart = Entity.RootPart
                        Track(Root.Position, os.clock())
                        if os.clock() - ScanAt >= 1 / 75 then
                            ScanAt = os.clock()
                            Found = Entity.Targets({
                                Origin = Root.Position,
                                Range = SwingRange.Value,
                                Players = Targets.Players.Enabled,
                                NPCs = Targets.NPCs.Enabled,
                                Invisible = Targets.Invisible.Enabled,
                                Wallcheck = Targets.Walls.Enabled,
                                Priority = Targets.Priority.Value,
                                Sort = Sort.Value,
                                Check = function(v: Target): boolean
                                    return not v.Character:HasTag("ItemDrop") and not v.RootPart:HasTag("ItemDrop")
                                end
                            })
                        end

                        local Reach: number = Meta.sword.attackRange or Data.Instances.CombatConstant.RAYCAST_SWORD_CHARACTER_DISTANCE
                        local RangeLimit: number = math.min(AttackRange.Value, Reach + 3.6 - 0.2)
                        local Spare: {AuraPick} = {}
                        local Look: Vector3 = Root.CFrame.LookVector * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
                        local Clock: number = os.clock()
                        Reference.Low, Reference.High, Reference.Claim = TrailAt(Clock - 0.07, Root.Position), TrailAt(Clock - 0.11, Root.Position), TrailAt(Clock - 0.09, Root.Position)
                        for _, v: Target in Found do
                            if v.Alive and v.Character and v.Character.Parent and v.RootPart and v.RootPart.Parent then
                                local Flat: Vector3 = (v.RootPart.Position - Root.Position) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
                                if Flat.Magnitude <= 0.001 or Look.Magnitude <= 0 or math.acos(math.clamp(Look.Unit:Dot(Flat.Unit), -1, 1)) <= math.rad(AngleSlider.Value) / 2 then
                                    local Drift: Vector3 = v.RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity * 0.12
                                    local Behind: Vector3 = v.RootPart.Position - (Drift.Magnitude > 8 and Drift.Unit * 8 or Drift)
                                    local Distance: number = math.max((v.RootPart.Position - Reference.Low).Magnitude, (v.RootPart.Position - Reference.High).Magnitude, (Behind - Reference.Low).Magnitude, (Behind - Reference.High).Magnitude)
                                    table.insert(Distance <= RangeLimit and Picks or Spare, {Target = v, Hittable = Distance <= RangeLimit})
                                    if #Picks >= MaxTargets.Value then
                                        break
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end

                        for _, v: AuraPick in Spare do
                            if #Picks >= MaxTargets.Value then
                                break
                            end

                            table.insert(Picks, v)
                        end

                        if #Picks > 0 then
                            SlotController.Fight = tick() + 1
                            if SlotController.Owner == nil or SlotController.Owner == "Killaura" or SlotController.Owner == "Break" or tick() >= SlotController.Expires then
                                SlotController.Switch(Sword.tool, 0)
                            end
                        end

                        local Swung: boolean = false
                        local Fury: number = Entity.Character:GetAttribute("StatusEffect_fury_potion") and 1 - (Data.Instances.BlackMarketeerBalance.FURY_POTION_ATTACK_SPEED_MULTIPLIER - 1) or 1
                        local SwordSpeed: number = Hitreg.Constants.Fixed[Sword.tool.Name] or Meta.sword.attackSpeed or Hitreg.Constants.Stock
                        Anchor.Stride = math.max(math.ceil((SwordSpeed * Fury - Hitreg.Constants.Tolerance) * 60 - 0.001), 1)
                        for Index: number, Pick: AuraPick in Picks do
                            local Target: Target = Pick.Target
                            Cat.TargetInfo.Targets[Target] = tick() + 1
                            if Index == 1 then
                                Data.Storage.Attacking = true
                                if not Swing.Enabled and AnimDelay < tick() and not LegitAura.Enabled then
                                    PlaySwing(Sword, Meta)
                                    Swung = true
                                end
                            end
                            if Pick.Hittable then
                                local Spacing: number, Floor: number, Stock: boolean = Hitreg.Spacing(SwordSpeed, Fury, HighHitreg.Enabled)
                                local Delay: number = Hitreg.Delay.Base(Hitreg.Constants.Budget, Spacing, Data.Controllers.SwordController.lastAttack, SwordSpeed, Fury, workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
                                if HighHitreg.Enabled then
                                    Delay = Hitreg.Delay.Reach(Delay, Floor, (Target.RootPart.Position - Root.Position).Magnitude, Reach)
                                end

                                Delay = math.max(Delay, AttackSpeed.Value)

                                local Locked: boolean = HighHitreg.Enabled and LocalPlayer:GetNetworkPing() < Hitreg.Constants.Anchor.Ping
                                local Ready: boolean = tick() >= Cooldown + Delay and tick() - LastHit >= math.max(Floor, AttackSpeed.Value)
                                local Due: number = Anchor:Due(workspace:GetServerTimeNow(), os.clock())
                                if Locked then
                                    Ready = Anchor:Spin(Due) <= 0
                                end
                                if Ready and Killaura.Enabled and Session == Current and Entity.Alive and Target.Alive and Target.RootPart.Parent then
                                    Clock = os.clock()
                                    Reference.Low, Reference.High, Reference.Claim = TrailAt(Clock - 0.07, Root.Position), TrailAt(Clock - 0.11, Root.Position), TrailAt(Clock - 0.09, Root.Position)

                                    local Velocity: Vector3 = Target.RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                                    local Drift: Vector3, Lead: Vector3 = Velocity * 0.12, Velocity * 0.05
                                    local Behind: Vector3 = Target.RootPart.Position - (Drift.Magnitude > 8 and Drift.Unit * 8 or Drift)
                                    local Position: Vector3 = Target.RootPart.Position - (Lead.Magnitude > 8 and Lead.Unit * 8 or Lead)
                                    local Distance: number = math.max((Target.RootPart.Position - Reference.Low).Magnitude, (Target.RootPart.Position - Reference.High).Magnitude, (Behind - Reference.Low).Magnitude, (Behind - Reference.High).Magnitude)
                                    local Flat: Vector3 = (Target.RootPart.Position - Root.Position) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
                                    if Distance <= RangeLimit and (Flat.Magnitude <= 0.001 or Look.Magnitude <= 0 or math.acos(math.clamp(Look.Unit:Dot(Flat.Unit), -1, 1)) <= math.rad(AngleSlider.Value) / 2) then
                                        local Airborne: boolean = (Target.Humanoid and Target.Humanoid.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air) or math.abs(Target.RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y) > 0.01
                                        local Gap: Vector3 = Position - Reference.Claim
                                        local Direction: Vector3 = Gap.Magnitude > 0.001 and Gap.Unit or Vector3.new(0, -1, 0)
                                        local Claim: Vector3 = Position - Direction * math.min(Gap.Magnitude, Reach - 1)

                                        Data.Controllers.SwordController.lastAttack = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
                                        LastAttack = tick()
                                        Cooldown = math.max(Cooldown + Delay, tick())
                                        LastHit = tick()
                                        if Airborne and Generator:NextNumber(0, 100) > AirHits:GetRandomValue() then
                                            Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("SwordSwingMiss"):SendToServer({weapon = Sword.tool, chargeRatio = 0})
                                        else
                                            if Locked then
                                                Anchor:Mark(Due, workspace:GetServerTimeNow(), os.clock())
                                            end

                                            Remote:SendToServer({
                                                weapon = Sword.tool,
                                                chargedAttack = {chargeRatio = 0},
                                                entityInstance = Target.Character,
                                                validate = {
                                                    raycast = {
                                                        cameraPosition = {value = Claim},
                                                        cursorDirection = {value = Direction}
                                                    },
                                                    targetPosition = {value = Position},
                                                    selfPosition = {value = Claim}
                                                }
                                            })

                                            if FastHits.Enabled and not Firing and tick() > LastShot then
                                                Shoot(Target, Root.Position)
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            elseif Swung then
                                Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("SwordSwingMiss"):SendToServer({weapon = Sword.tool, chargeRatio = 0})
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    if #Picks > 0 then
                        ContinueUntil = tick() + ContinueSwing:GetRandomValue() / 1000
                    elseif Sword and Meta and Meta.sword and tick() < ContinueUntil and AnimDelay < tick() and not Swing.Enabled and not LegitAura.Enabled then
                        PlaySwing(Sword, Meta)
                        Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("SwordSwingMiss"):SendToServer({weapon = Sword.tool, chargeRatio = 0})
                    end

                    Visuals(Picks)
                    if Picks[1] then
                        if FaceTarget ~= Picks[1].Target then
                            FaceTarget, FaceFound = Picks[1].Target, tick()
                        end
                        FaceSeen = tick()
                    end
                until not Killaura.Enabled or Session ~= Current
            else
                if Hook and Data.Controllers.SwordController.playSwordEffect == Hook then
                    Data.Controllers.SwordController.playSwordEffect = Old
                end

                Old, Hook = nil, nil
                debug.setupvalue(rawget(rawget(getmetatable(Data.Controllers.SwordController), "__index"), "playSwordEffect"), 7, Data.Instances.Knit)
                debug.setupvalue(Data.Controllers.ScytheController.playLocalAnimation, 3, Data.Instances.Knit)
                for _, v: RBXScriptConnection in Watchers do
                    if v.Connected then
                        v:Disconnect()
                    end
                end

                table.clear(Watchers)
                table.clear(Trail.Times)
                table.clear(Trail.Positions)
                Data.Storage.Attacking = false
                LastAttack = 0
                for _, v: BoxHandleAdornment in Boxes do
                    v.Adornee = nil
                    v.Size = Vector3.zero
                    Shown[v] = nil
                end
                for _, v: Part in Particles do
                    v.Parent = nil
                    Shown[v] = false
                end

                if ArmC0 and ArmWrist and ArmWrist.Parent then
                    Services.TweenService:Create(ArmWrist, TweenInfo.new(AnimationTween.Enabled and 0.001 or 0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Exponential), {C0 = ArmC0}):Play()
                end
                if Services.UserInputService.TouchEnabled then
                    pcall(function()
                        LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.MobileUI["2"].Visible = true
                    end)
                end
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Attack players around you\nwithout aiming at them."
    })

    Cat:Clean(function()
        for _, v: Instance in Boxes do
            v:Destroy()
        end
        for _, v: Instance in Particles do
            v:Destroy()
        end
        for _, v: RBXScriptConnection in Watchers do
            v:Disconnect()
        end
    end)

BundledModules.PlacementController = (function()
    local Services = BundledModules.Services
    local LocalPlayer: Player = Services.Players.LocalPlayer

    local Inventory = BundledModules.Inventory

    local PlacementController = {
        Offsets = {} :: {Vector3}
    }
    for X: number = -3, 3, 3 do
        for Y: number = -3, 3, 3 do
            for Z: number = -3, 3, 3 do
                if X ~= 0 or Y ~= 0 or Z ~= 0 then
                    table.insert(PlacementController.Offsets, Vector3.new(X, Y, Z))
                end
            end
        end
    end

    PlacementController.Nearest = function(Position: Vector3): Vector3?
        local Store: any = Data.Controllers.BlockController:getStore()
        local From: Vector3 = Data.Controllers.BlockController:getBlockPosition(Position - Vector3.new(21, 21, 21))
        local To: Vector3 = Data.Controllers.BlockController:getBlockPosition(Position + Vector3.new(21, 21, 21))
        local Closest: Vector3?, Distance: number = nil, 60
        for X: number = From.X, To.X do
            for Y: number = From.Y, To.Y do
                for Z: number = From.Z, To.Z do
                    if not Store:getBlockAt(Vector3.new(X, Y, Z)) then
                        continue
                    end

                    local Center: Vector3 = Vector3.new(X, Y, Z) * 3
                    local Toward: Vector3 = Center + (Position - Center).Unit * 100
                    local Corner: Vector3 = Vector3.new(math.clamp(Toward.X, Center.X - 3, Center.X + 3), math.clamp(Toward.Y, Center.Y - 3, Center.Y + 3), math.clamp(Toward.Z, Center.Z - 3, Center.Z + 3))
                    if (Position - Corner).Magnitude < Distance then
                        Closest, Distance = Corner, (Position - Corner).Magnitude
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        return Closest
    end

    PlacementController.Place = function(Position: Vector3, ItemType: string): any
        local Casting: any = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("IsCasting")
        if Data.Controllers.BlockPlacementController.disabled or (Casting and Casting ~= 0 and Casting ~= "") then
            return
        end

        if not Inventory.Item(ItemType) then
            return nil
        end

        Data.Storage.BlockPlacer.blockType = ItemType

        return Data.Storage.BlockPlacer:placeBlock(Data.Controllers.BlockController:getBlockPosition(Position))
    end

    return PlacementController
end)()

BundledModules.LongJump = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services
    local LocalPlayer: Player = Services.Players.LocalPlayer

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity

    local Inventory = BundledModules.Inventory
    local PlacementController = BundledModules.PlacementController
    local SlotController = BundledModules.SlotController

    local LongJump
    local SpeedSlider, CameraDirection

    local isnetworkowner = BundledModules.isnetworkowner

    local Start: Vector3?
    local Direction: Vector3?
    local JumpTick: number, JumpSpeed: number = tick(), 0
    local Coast: number = 1.1

    local Boosts: {[string]: {Multiplier: number, Duration: number}} = {
        cannon = {Multiplier = 5.25, Duration = 2.3},
        grappling_hook = {Multiplier = 2.5, Duration = 2.5},
        jade_hammer = {Multiplier = 1.4, Duration = 2.5},
        wood_dao = {Multiplier = 4.5, Duration = 2.4}
    }

    local function Ready(Name: string, Item: InventoryItem?): boolean
        local Options: {disableBlockedAbilityAlert: boolean} = {disableBlockedAbilityAlert = true}
        if Name == "cat" then
            return Data.Controllers.AbilityController:canUseAbility("CAT_POUNCE", Options)
        elseif Name == "wood_dao" then
            return ((LocalPlayer.Character :: Model):GetAttribute("CanDashNext") or 0) < workspace:GetServerTimeNow() and Data.Controllers.AbilityController:canUseAbility("dash", Options)
        end

        return Data.Controllers.AbilityController:canUseAbility(`{(Item :: InventoryItem).itemType:find("jade_hammer") and "jade_hammer" or (Item :: InventoryItem).itemType}_jump`, Options)
    end

    local function Break(Block: BasePart)
        if not LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("DenyBlockBreak") and Entity.Alive then
            local Cell: Vector3 = Data.Controllers.BlockController:getBlockPosition(Block.Position)
            local Position: Vector3 = Cell * 3
            if (Entity.RootPart.Position - Position).Magnitude <= 30 then
                if workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - Data.Controllers.SwordController.lastAttack > 0.4 then
                    local Tool: InventoryItem? = Data.Storage.Tools[Data.Instances.Items[Block.Name].block.breakType] or Data.Storage.Tools.stone
                    local Hand: ObjectValue? = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HandInvItem") :: ObjectValue?
                    if Tool and Hand and Hand.Value ~= Tool.tool then
                        local Success: boolean, Equipped: any = Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("SetInvItem"):CallServerAsync({hand = Tool.tool}):await()
                        if not Success or Equipped == false or not Entity.Alive or not Hand.Parent then
                            return
                        end

                        Hand.Value = Tool.tool
                    end
                end

                if Data.Controllers.BlockController:isBlockBreakable({blockPosition = Cell}, LocalPlayer) then
                    Data.Controllers.ClientDamageBlock:Get("DamageBlock"):CallServerAsync({
                        blockRef = {blockPosition = Cell},
                        hitPosition = Position,
                        hitNormal = Vector3.FromNormalId(Enum.NormalId.Top)
                    }):andThen(function(Result: any)
                        if Result and Result ~= "cancelled" then
                            if Result == "destroyed" then
                                Data.Controllers.BlockBreakController.blockBreaker.breakEffect:playBreak(Block.Name, Cell, LocalPlayer)
                            else
                                Data.Controllers.BlockBreakController.blockBreaker.breakEffect:playHit(Block.Name, Cell, LocalPlayer)
                            end

                            local Animation: AnimationTrack? = Data.Controllers.AnimationUtil:playAnimation(LocalPlayer, Data.Controllers.BlockController:getAnimationController():getAssetId(1))
                            Data.Controllers.ViewmodelController:playAnimation(15)
                            task.wait(0.3)
                            if Animation then
                                Animation:Stop()
                                Animation:Destroy()
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local function LaunchSound(Item: InventoryItem)
        local Source: any = Data.Instances.Items[Item.itemType] and Data.Instances.Items[Item.itemType].projectileSource
        local Skin: any = Item.itemSkin and Data.Controllers.ItemSkinMeta.getItemSkinMeta(Item.itemSkin)
        if Source and Skin and type(Skin.projectileSourceOverrides) == "table" then
            Source = table.clone(Source)
            for Index: string, Value: any in Skin.projectileSourceOverrides do
                Source[Index] = Value
            end
        end
        if Source then
            if Source.launchSound and #Source.launchSound > 0 then
                local Pitch: any = Source.launchSoundConfig and Source.launchSoundConfig.pitch
                Data.Controllers.AudioManager:playAudio(Source.launchSound[math.random(1, #Source.launchSound)], {
                    playbackSpeedMultiplier = Pitch and (math.random() * (Pitch.Max - Pitch.Min) + Pitch.Min) or nil,
                    volumeMultiplier = Source.launchSoundConfig and Source.launchSoundConfig.volumeMultiplier or 1
                })
            end

            if Source.launchOverlaySound and Source.launchOverlaySound ~= "" then
                local Pitch: any = Source.launchSoundConfig and Source.launchSoundConfig.launchOverlayPitch
                Data.Controllers.AudioManager:playAudio(Source.launchOverlaySound, {
                    playbackSpeedMultiplier = Pitch and (math.random() * (Pitch.Max - Pitch.Min) + Pitch.Min) or nil
                })
            end
        end
    end

    local Methods: {[string]: (InventoryItem?, Vector3?, Vector3) -> ()} = {
        cannon = function(_, Position: Vector3?, Look: Vector3)
            local HipHeight: number = Entity.Humanoid.HipHeight + Entity.RootPart.Size.Y / 2 + (Entity.Humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 and 2 or 0)
            local Feet: Vector3 = (Position :: Vector3) - Vector3.new(0, HipHeight + Entity.RootPart.Size.Y / 2 - 3, 0)
            local Rounded: Vector3 = Vector3.new(math.round(Feet.X / 3) * 3, math.round(Feet.Y / 3) * 3, math.round(Feet.Z / 3) * 3)
            PlacementController.Place(Rounded, "cannon")

            task.spawn(function()
                local Cell: Vector3 = Data.Controllers.BlockController:getBlockPosition(Rounded)
                local Deadline: number = tick() + 1
                local Block: BasePart?
                repeat
                    task.wait()
                    Block = Data.Controllers.BlockController:getStore():getBlockAt(Cell)
                until Block or tick() > Deadline or not LongJump.Enabled
                if Block and Block.Name == "cannon" and (Entity.RootPart.Position - Block.Position).Magnitude < 20 then
                    local Tool: InventoryItem? = Data.Storage.Tools[Data.Instances.Items[Block.Name].block.breakType]
                    if Tool then
                        SlotController.Switch(Tool.tool)
                    end

                    Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("AimCannon"):SendToServer({
                        cannonBlockPos = Cell,
                        lookVector = Look
                    })

                    local Wait: number = 0.1
                    if Data.Controllers.BlockController:calculateBlockDamage(LocalPlayer, {blockPosition = Cell}) < Block:GetAttribute("Health") then
                        Wait = 0.4
                        Break(Block)
                    end

                    task.delay(Wait, function()
                        for _ = 1, 3 do
                            if Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("LaunchSelfFromCannon"):CallServer({cannonBlockPos = Cell}) then
                                Break(Block)
                                JumpSpeed, JumpTick, Direction = Boosts.cannon.Multiplier * SpeedSlider.Value, tick() + Boosts.cannon.Duration, Vector3.new(Look.X, 0, Look.Z).Unit
