                                break
                            end

                            task.wait(0.1)
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end)
        end,
        cat = function()
            if not Ready("cat") then
                repeat
                    task.wait()
                until Ready("cat") or not LongJump.Enabled
            end

            if Ready("cat") and LongJump.Enabled then
                Data.Controllers.AbilityController:useAbility("CAT_POUNCE")
            end
        end,
        fireball = function(Item: InventoryItem?, Position: Vector3?, Look: Vector3)
            if not Position then
                return
            end

            local Source: any = Data.Instances.Items[(Item :: InventoryItem).itemType] and Data.Instances.Items[(Item :: InventoryItem).itemType].projectileSource
            local From: Vector3 = Position - Look * 0.1
            local Shoot: CFrame = CFrame.lookAlong(From, Vector3.new(0, -60, 0)) * CFrame.new(Vector3.new(-Data.Instances.BowConstants.RelX, -Data.Instances.BowConstants.RelY, -Data.Instances.BowConstants.RelZ))
            SlotController.Switch((Item :: InventoryItem).tool, 0)
            task.wait(0.1)

            local Result: any = Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("ProjectileFire").instance:InvokeServer((Item :: InventoryItem).tool, "fireball", "fireball", Shoot.Position, From, Shoot.LookVector * 60, Data.Controllers.IdUtil.generateId(8), {
                shotId = Data.Controllers.IdUtil.generateId(8),
                drawDurationSec = math.max(1, Source and Source.maxStrengthChargeSec or 0)
            }, workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - 0.045)
            if type(Result) == "table" and Result.accepted then
                LaunchSound(Item :: InventoryItem)
            end
        end,
        grappling_hook = function(Item: InventoryItem?, Position: Vector3?, Look: Vector3)
            if not Position then
                return
            end

            local Source: any = Data.Instances.Items[(Item :: InventoryItem).itemType] and Data.Instances.Items[(Item :: InventoryItem).itemType].projectileSource
            local From: Vector3 = Position - Look * 0.1
            local Shoot: CFrame = CFrame.lookAlong(From, Vector3.new(0, -140, 0)) * CFrame.new(Vector3.new(-Data.Instances.BowConstants.RelX, -Data.Instances.BowConstants.RelY, -Data.Instances.BowConstants.RelZ))
            SlotController.Switch((Item :: InventoryItem).tool, 0)
            task.wait(0.1)

            local Result: any = Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("ProjectileFire").instance:InvokeServer((Item :: InventoryItem).tool, nil, "grappling_hook_projectile", Shoot.Position, From, Shoot.LookVector * 140, Data.Controllers.IdUtil.generateId(8), {
                shotId = Data.Controllers.IdUtil.generateId(8),
                drawDurationSec = math.max(1, Source and Source.maxStrengthChargeSec or 0)
            }, workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - 0.045)
            if type(Result) == "table" and Result.accepted then
                LaunchSound(Item :: InventoryItem)
            end
        end,
        jade_hammer = function(Item: InventoryItem?, Position: Vector3?, Look: Vector3)
            if not Ready("jade_hammer", Item) then
                repeat
                    task.wait()
                until Ready("jade_hammer", Item) or not LongJump.Enabled
            end

            if Ready("jade_hammer", Item) and LongJump.Enabled then
                SlotController.Switch((Item :: InventoryItem).tool, 0)
                Entity.Humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
                Start = (Position :: Vector3) + Vector3.new(0, 3.1, 0)
                task.wait(0.1)
                Data.Controllers.AbilityController:useAbility(`{(Item :: InventoryItem).itemType:find("jade_hammer") and "jade_hammer" or (Item :: InventoryItem).itemType}_jump`)
                JumpSpeed, JumpTick, Direction = Boosts.jade_hammer.Multiplier * SpeedSlider.Value, tick() + Boosts.jade_hammer.Duration, Vector3.new(Look.X, 0, Look.Z).Unit
            end
        end,
        tnt = function(Item: InventoryItem?, Position: Vector3?, Look: Vector3)
            if not Position then
                return
            end

            local HipHeight: number = Entity.Humanoid.HipHeight + Entity.RootPart.Size.Y / 2 + (Entity.Humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 and 2 or 0)
            local Feet: Vector3 = Position - Vector3.new(0, HipHeight + Entity.RootPart.Size.Y / 2 - 3, 0)
            local Rounded: Vector3 = Vector3.new(math.round(Feet.X / 3) * 3, math.round(Feet.Y / 3) * 3, math.round(Feet.Z / 3) * 3)
            Start = Vector3.new(Rounded.X, Position.Y, Rounded.Z) + Look * ((Item :: InventoryItem).itemType == "pirate_gunpowder_barrel" and 2.6 or 0.2)
            PlacementController.Place(Rounded, (Item :: InventoryItem).itemType)
        end,
        wood_dao = function(Item: InventoryItem?, Position: Vector3?, Look: Vector3)
            if not Ready("wood_dao") then
                repeat
                    task.wait()
                until Ready("wood_dao") or not LongJump.Enabled
            end

            if LongJump.Enabled then
                Data.Controllers.SwordController.lastAttack = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
                SlotController.Switch((Item :: InventoryItem).tool, 0.1)
                Services.ReplicatedStorage["events-@easy-games/game-core:shared/game-core-networking@getEvents.Events"].useAbility:FireServer("dash", {
                    direction = Look,
                    origin = Position,
                    weapon = (Item :: InventoryItem).itemType
                })
                JumpSpeed, JumpTick, Direction = Boosts.wood_dao.Multiplier * SpeedSlider.Value, tick() + Boosts.wood_dao.Duration, Vector3.new(Look.X, 0, Look.Z).Unit
            end
        end
    }

    for _, v: string in {"stone_dao", "iron_dao", "diamond_dao", "emerald_dao"} do
        Methods[v] = Methods.wood_dao
    end

    Methods.void_axe = Methods.jade_hammer
    Methods.siege_tnt = Methods.tnt
    Methods.pirate_gunpowder_barrel = Methods.tnt

    LongJump = Cat.Categories.Blatant:CreateModule({
        Name = "LongJump",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback then
                LongJump:Clean(Data.Events.EntityDamageEvent:Connect(function(Event: {entityInstance: Model?, fromEntity: Model?, fromPosition: Vector3?, knockbackMultiplier: {disabled: boolean?, horizontal: number?}?})
                    if not Entity.Alive or Event.entityInstance ~= LocalPlayer.Character or Event.fromEntity ~= LocalPlayer.Character or Event.knockbackMultiplier and Event.knockbackMultiplier.disabled then
                        return
                    end

                    local Position: Vector3? = Event.fromPosition and Vector3.new(Event.fromPosition.X, Event.fromPosition.Y, Event.fromPosition.Z) or Event.fromEntity and (Event.fromEntity.PrimaryPart :: BasePart).Position
                    local Speed: number = Data.Controllers.KnockbackUtil.calculateKnockbackVelocity(Vector3.one, 1, {
                        vertical = 0,
                        horizontal = Event.knockbackMultiplier and Event.knockbackMultiplier.horizontal or 1
                    }).Magnitude * 1.1
                    if Position and Speed >= JumpSpeed then
                        local Away: Vector3 = Entity.RootPart.Position - Position
                        JumpSpeed, JumpTick, Direction = Speed, tick() + 2.5, Vector3.new(Away.X, 0, Away.Z).Unit
                    end
                end))
                LongJump:Clean(Data.Events.GrapplingHookFunctions:Connect(function(Event: {hookFunction: string?})
                    if Entity.Alive and Event.hookFunction == "PLAYER_IN_TRANSIT" then
                        local Look: Vector3 = Entity.RootPart.CFrame.LookVector
                        JumpSpeed, JumpTick, Direction = Boosts.grappling_hook.Multiplier * SpeedSlider.Value, tick() + Boosts.grappling_hook.Duration, Vector3.new(Look.X, 0, Look.Z).Unit
                    end
                end))

                Start = Entity.Alive and Entity.RootPart.Position or nil
                LongJump:Clean(Services.RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function(Delta: number)
                    if not Entity.Alive or not isnetworkowner(Entity.RootPart) then
                        Start = nil

                        return
                    end

                    if JumpTick > tick() then
                        local Modifiers: any = Data.Controllers.SprintController:getMovementStatusModifier():getModifiers()
                        local Multiplier: number, Increase: boolean = 0, true
                        for Active: any in Modifiers do
                            local Constant: number = Active.constantSpeedMultiplier or 0
                            if Constant > math.max(Multiplier, 1) then
                                Increase = false
                                Multiplier = Constant - 0.06 * math.round(Constant)
                            end
                        end
                        for Active: any in Modifiers do
                            Multiplier += math.max((Active.moveSpeedMultiplier or 0) - 1, 0)
                        end
                        if Multiplier > 0 and Increase then
                            Multiplier += 0.16 + 0.02 * math.round(Multiplier)
                        end

                        local Current: number = 20 * (Multiplier + 1)
                        Entity.RootPart.CFrame += (Direction :: Vector3) * math.max(JumpTick - tick() > Coast and JumpSpeed or 0, 0) * Delta
                        Entity.RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = (Direction :: Vector3) * Current + Vector3.new(0, 15, 0)
                        Start = nil
                    else
                        if Start then
                            Entity.RootPart.CFrame = CFrame.lookAlong(Start, Entity.RootPart.CFrame.LookVector)
                        end

                        Entity.RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                        JumpSpeed = 0
                    end
                end))

                local Look: Vector3 = ((CameraDirection.Enabled and workspace.CurrentCamera or Entity.RootPart) :: any).CFrame.LookVector
                local Held: string = Data.Storage.Hand.Tool and Data.Storage.Hand.Tool.Name or ""
                if Methods[Held] then
                    task.spawn(Methods[Held], Inventory.Item(Held), Start, Look)

                    return
                end

                for Name: string, Method: (InventoryItem?, Vector3?, Vector3) -> () in Methods do
                    local Item: InventoryItem? = Inventory.Item(Name, true)
                    if Item or Data.Storage.EquippedKit == Name then
                        task.spawn(Method, Item, Start, Look)

                        break
                    end
                end
            else
                JumpTick, Direction, JumpSpeed = tick(), nil, 0
            end
        end,
        ExtraText = function(): string
            return "Heatseeker"
        end,
        Tooltip = "Lets you jump farther"
    })

    SpeedSlider = LongJump:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Speed",
        Min = 1,
        Max = 37,
        Default = 37,
        Suffix = function(Value: number)
            return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
        end
    })
    CameraDirection = LongJump:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Camera Direction"
    })
end)()

BundledModules.Projectile = (function()
    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Projectile = {}

    Projectile.Fire = function(Item: InventoryItem, Ammo: string, Kind: string, Position: Vector3, Velocity: Vector3): Instance?
        local Id: string = Data.Controllers.IdUtil.generateId(8)
        local Charge: number = Data.Instances.Items[Item.itemType].projectileSource.maxStrengthChargeSec or 0
        local Shot: {shotId: string, drawDurationSec: number} = {
            shotId = Data.Controllers.IdUtil.generateId(8),
            drawDurationSec = math.max(1, Charge)
        }

        local Meta: any = Data.Instances.ProjectileMeta[Kind]
        local Local: Instance? = Data.Controllers.ProjectileController:createLocalProjectile(Meta, Ammo, Kind, Position, Id, Velocity, Shot)
        Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("ProjectileFire"):CallServerAsync(
            Item.tool,
            Ammo,
            Kind,
            Position,
            Position,
            Velocity,
            Id,
            Shot,
            workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - 0.045
        ):andThen(function(Result: any)
            if type(Result) == "table" and Result.accepted and Result.model then
                Result.model.Parent = Services.ReplicatedStorage
            end
        end)

        return Local
    end

    return Projectile
end)()

BundledModules.NoFall = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services
    local LocalPlayer: Player = Services.Players.LocalPlayer

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity
    local Inventory = BundledModules.Inventory
    local Ping = BundledModules.Ping
    local Projectile = BundledModules.Projectile
    local SlotController = BundledModules.SlotController

    local NoFall
    local Mode, Damage, Trigger, Fireball, Telepearl, Legit, Back, BackDelay

    local Disabled: {[Humanoid]: {any}} = {}
    local Busy, Peak = false, nil

    local Params: RaycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    Params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

    local function Freeze(Humanoid: Humanoid)
        if Disabled[Humanoid] then
            return
        end

        Disabled[Humanoid] = {}
        NoFall:Clean(Humanoid.Destroying:Once(function()
            Disabled[Humanoid] = nil
        end))

        for _, v: any in getconnections(Humanoid.StateChanged) do
            local Source: string? = v.Function and debug.info(v.Function, "s")
            if Source and Source:find("fall-damage-controller", 1, true) then
                v:Disable()
                table.insert(Disabled[Humanoid], v)
            end
        end
    end

    local function Throw(Item, Name: string, Speed: number, Swap: number)
        if SlotController.Owner and SlotController.Owner ~= "NoFall" and tick() < SlotController.Expires then
            Busy = false
        else
            SlotController.Owner, SlotController.Expires = "NoFall", tick() + 3

            local OldTool: Tool? = Data.Storage.Hand.Tool
            if OldTool ~= Item.tool then
                SlotController.Switch(Item.tool, 0)
                if Legit.Enabled then
                    SlotController.Select(Item.tool)
                end

                task.wait(Swap)
            end

            if Entity.Alive then
                Projectile.Fire(Item, Name, Name, Entity.RootPart.Position, Vector3.new(0, -Speed, 0))

                if Back.Enabled and OldTool and OldTool ~= Item.tool then
                    task.wait(BackDelay:GetRandomValue())

                    SlotController.Switch(OldTool)
                    if Legit.Enabled then
                        SlotController.Select(OldTool)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    NoFall = Cat.Categories.Blatant:CreateModule({
        Name = "NoFall",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback then
                if Mode.Value == "Blatant" then
                    if Entity.Alive then
                        Freeze(Entity.Humanoid)
                    end

                    local Tracked, LastHit, Last, Done = 0, 0, nil, false
                    NoFall:Clean(Services.RunService.PostSimulation:Connect(function()
                        if Entity.Alive and Data.Storage.MatchState == 1 and not Data.Storage.Desyncing then
                            local Velocity: Vector3 = Entity.RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                            if Entity.Humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
                                Done = false
                            end

                            if Data.Storage.Map and Params.FilterDescendantsInstances[1] ~= Data.Storage.Map then
                                Params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {Data.Storage.Map}
                            end

                            local Height, Ground, Trail = Entity.RootPart.Position.Y, (Damage.Value > 0 and Data.Storage.Map and workspace:Raycast(Entity.RootPart.Position, Vector3.new(0, -500, 0), Params) or nil), math.max(-Velocity.Y, 0) * (Ping.Get() * 2 + 0.08)
                            local Final: number? = Ground and Ground.Position.Y + (Entity.Humanoid.HipHeight + Entity.RootPart.Size.Y / 2) + 21.5 + Damage.Value - Trail

                            local Crossing, Cancel = Final ~= nil and Last ~= nil and Last > Final and Height <= Final, Tracked < -45 and (not Final or Height > Final)

                            Last = Height

                            if not Done and (Crossing or Cancel) then
                                Done = Crossing
                                Entity.RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)
                                Entity.Humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed)
                                Services.RunService.PreRender:Wait()
                                Entity.RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Velocity

                                if os.clock() - LastHit >= 0.1 then
                                    Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("GroundHit"):SendToServer(nil, Vector3.new(0, Tracked, 0), workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
                                    LastHit = os.clock()
                                end
                            end

                            Tracked = Velocity.Y
                        else
                            Tracked, Last, Done = 0, nil, false
                        end
                    end))

                    NoFall:Clean(LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(Character: Model)
                        local Humanoid: Humanoid? = Character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10) :: Humanoid?
                        if not Humanoid or not Humanoid:WaitForChild("Animator", 5) then
                            return
                        end

                        task.wait(0.5)
                        if NoFall.Enabled then
                            Freeze(Humanoid)
                        end
                    end))
                else
                    Busy, Peak = false, nil

                    NoFall:Clean(Services.RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function(Delta: number)
                        if Entity.Alive and Data.Storage.MatchState ~= 0 and not Data.Storage.Desyncing then
                            if Entity.Humanoid.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air then
                                local Fall = Entity.RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y
                                Peak = math.max(Peak or Entity.RootPart.Position.Y, Entity.RootPart.Position.Y + math.max(Fall, 0) ^ 2 / (2 * workspace.Gravity))

                                if not Busy and Fall < 0 then
                                    if Params.FilterDescendantsInstances[1] ~= Data.Storage.Map then
                                        Params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {Data.Storage.Map}
                                    end

                                    local Ground: RaycastResult? = workspace:Raycast(Entity.RootPart.Position, Vector3.new(0, -500, 0), Params)
                                    if Ground then
                                        local Stand: number = Entity.Humanoid.HipHeight + Entity.RootPart.Size.Y / 2
                                        local Height: number = math.max(Entity.RootPart.Position.Y - Stand - Ground.Position.Y, 0)
                                        local Impact: number = math.sqrt(Fall * Fall + 2 * workspace.Gravity * Height)
                                        if Peak - (Ground.Position.Y + Stand) - 21.5 >= Trigger.Value then
                                            local Latency, Drop = Ping.Get() + Ping.Jitter, Entity.RootPart.Position.Y - Ground.Position.Y
                                            for _, v: string in {"fireball", "telepearl"} do
                                                local Allowed: boolean = (v == "fireball" and Fireball or Telepearl).Enabled
                                                local Item: InventoryItem? = Allowed and Inventory.Item(v) or nil
                                                local Meta: any = Data.Instances.ProjectileMeta[Item]
                                                if Item and Item.tool and Meta then
                                                    local Speed: number, Pull: number = Meta.launchVelocity, Meta.gravitationalAcceleration or 0
                                                    local Flight: number = Pull > 0 and (math.sqrt(Speed * Speed + 2 * Pull * Drop) - Speed) / Pull or Drop / Speed
                                                    local Swap: number = Data.Storage.Hand.Tool == Item.tool and 0 or math.max(0.04, Latency)
                                                    local Slack: number = ((Fall + Impact) / workspace.Gravity) - (Swap + Latency + Flight)
                                                    if Slack >= 0 then
                                                        if Slack <= Delta * 2 + (v == "fireball" and 0.05 or 0.15) then
                                                            Busy = true
                                                            task.spawn(Throw, Item, v, Speed, Swap)
                                                        end

                                                        break
                                                    end
                                                end
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            else
                                Busy, Peak = false, nil
                            end
                        end
                    end))
                end
            else
                for _, Connections: {any} in Disabled do
                    for _, v: any in Connections do
                        v:Enable()
                    end
                end

                table.clear(Disabled)
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Prevents taking fall damage."
    })

    Mode = NoFall:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Mode",
        List = {"Blatant", "Legit"},
        Function = function(Value: string)
            for _, v: any in {Trigger, Fireball, Telepearl, Legit, Back} do
                if v and v.Object then
                    v.Object.Visible = Value == "Legit"
                end
            end
            if Damage and Damage.Object then
                Damage.Object.Visible = Value == "Blatant"
            end
            if BackDelay and BackDelay.Object then
                BackDelay.Object.Visible = Value == "Legit" and Back.Enabled
            end

            if NoFall.Enabled then
                NoFall:Toggle()
                NoFall:Toggle()
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Blatant - Fully prevent fall damage\nLegit - Uses items to prevent you from taking fall damage"
    })
    Damage = NoFall:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Fall Damage",
        Min = 0,
        Max = 100,
        Default = 0,
        Decimal = 10,
        Suffix = "hp",
        Visible = Mode.Value == "Blatant",
        Tooltip = "How much health a long fall still takes, 0 takes none\nNoFall lets the fall count again from the exact height that lands you on this much damage"
    })
    Trigger = NoFall:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Health Trigger",
        Min = 0.1,
        Max = 100,
        Default = 10,
        Decimal = 10,
        Suffix = "hp",
        Visible = Mode.Value == "Legit",
        Tooltip = "Only uses an item when the fall would take at least this much health\nCounted from the highest point of the fall, including how much higher you are still going"
    })
    Fireball = NoFall:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Fireball",
        Default = true,
        Visible = Mode.Value == "Legit",
        Tooltip = "Shoots a fireball at the ground so its knockback reaches you right before you land"
    })
    Telepearl = NoFall:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Telepearl",
        Default = true,
        Visible = Mode.Value == "Legit",
        Tooltip = "Throws a pearl at the ground so you teleport onto it before you land, used when a fireball can't make it in time"
    })
    Legit = NoFall:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Legit switch",
        Default = true,
        Visible = Mode.Value == "Legit",
        Tooltip = "Shows the switch to the item on your own screen too"
    })
    Back = NoFall:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Switch back",
        Default = true,
        Visible = Mode.Value == "Legit",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if BackDelay and BackDelay.Object then
                BackDelay.Object.Visible = Callback and Mode.Value == "Legit"
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Goes back to what you were holding after the throw"
    })
    BackDelay = NoFall:CreateTwoSlider({
        Name = "Switch back delay",
        Min = 0,
        Max = 2,
        DefaultMin = 0.1,
        DefaultMax = 0.2,
        Decimal = 100,
        Darker = true,
        Visible = Mode.Value == "Legit" and Back.Enabled,
        Tooltip = "Random wait in seconds between both ends before switching back"
    })
end)()

BundledModules.NoSlow = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Original: ((any, {moveSpeedMultiplier: number?}) -> any)

    Cat.Categories.Blatant:CreateModule({
        Name = "NoSlow",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            local Modifier: any = Data.Controllers.SprintController:getMovementStatusModifier()
            if Callback then
                Original = Modifier.addModifier
                Modifier.addModifier = function(self, New: {moveSpeedMultiplier: number?})
                    if New.moveSpeedMultiplier then
                        New.moveSpeedMultiplier = math.max(New.moveSpeedMultiplier, 1)
                    end

                    return Original(self, New)
                end

                for Active: any in Modifier.modifiers do
                    if (Active.moveSpeedMultiplier or 1) < 1 then
                        Modifier:removeModifier(Active)
                    end
                end
            else
                Modifier.addModifier = Original
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Prevents you from being slowed down"
    })
end)()

BundledModules.Shots = (function()
    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Shots = {
        Kits = {} :: {[string]: string},
        Swap = 0
    }

    for Kit: string, Meta: any in Data.Instances.BedwarsKitMeta do
        for _, v: any in (Meta.kitItems or {}) do
            if type(v) == "table" and type(v.itemType) == "string" then
                Shots.Kits[v.itemType] = Kit
            end
        end
    end

    for _, v: any in Data.Controllers.BedwarsShop.ShopItems do
        if type(v) == "table" and v.itemType and v.requiresKit then
            Shots.Kits[v.itemType] = type(v.requiresKit) == "table" and v.requiresKit[1] or tostring(v.requiresKit)
        end
    end

    Shots.Source = function(ItemType: string, Kit: boolean): any
        local Meta: any = Data.Instances.Items[ItemType]
        if Shots.Kits[ItemType] and not Kit then
            return nil
        end

        if ItemType:match("^frost_staff_%d+$") and Data.Controllers.FrostyGunController.projectileMode ~= Data.Instances.FrostyGunMode.PROJECTILE then
            if tick() >= Shots.Swap and Data.Controllers.AbilityController:canUseAbility("frosty_gun_swap", {disableBlockedAbilityAlert = true}) then
                Shots.Swap = tick() + 1
                Data.Controllers.AbilityController:useAbility("frosty_gun_swap")
            end

            return nil
        end

        if ItemType == "mage_spellbook" or ItemType == "wizard_stick" then
            local Element: string? = Data.Instances.BalanceFile.MAGE_ELEMENT_CYCLE[(Services.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("MageElementIndex") or 0) + 1]
            local Success: boolean, Unlocked: any = pcall(Data.Controllers.MageKitUtil.getUnlockedMageElements, Services.LocalPlayer)
            if not Element or not Success or type(Unlocked) ~= "table" or not table.find(Unlocked, Element) then
                Element = "BASE"
            end
            if ItemType == "wizard_stick" and Success and type(Unlocked) == "table" then
                for _, v: string in Unlocked do
                    Element = Data.Controllers.MageKitUtil.MageElementMeta[v] and Data.Controllers.MageKitUtil.MageElementMeta[v].projectileSource and v or Element
                end
            end

            return Data.Controllers.MageKitUtil.MageElementMeta[Element :: string] and Data.Controllers.MageKitUtil.MageElementMeta[Element :: string].projectileSource
        end

        if ItemType:match("^ninja_chakram_%d+$") and Data.Controllers.ChakramController.chakramIsLaunched then
            return nil
        end

        return Meta and Meta.projectileSource
    end

    Shots.List = function(Kit: boolean, Match: ((Names: {string?}) -> boolean)?): {AuraShot}
        local List: {AuraShot} = {}
        for _, v: InventoryItem in (Data.Storage.Inventory.inventory.items or {}) do
            local Source: any = Shots.Source(v.itemType, Kit)
            if Source then
                local Ammo: string? = v.itemType
                if Source.ammoItemTypes and #Source.ammoItemTypes > 0 then
                    Ammo = nil
                    for _, Item: InventoryItem in Data.Storage.Inventory.inventory.items do
                        if table.find(Source.ammoItemTypes, Item.itemType) then
                            Ammo = Item.itemType

                            break
                        end
                    end
                end

                local Meta: any = Data.Instances.Items[v.itemType]
                if Ammo and (Shots.Kits[v.itemType] or not Match or Match({Ammo, v.itemType, Meta and Meta.displayName})) then
                    table.insert(List, {Item = v, Ammo = Ammo, Projectile = Source.projectileType(Ammo), Source = Source})
                end
            end
        end

        return List
    end

    Shots.Launch = function(Item: InventoryItem, Source: any)
        local Skin: any = Item.itemSkin and Data.Controllers.ItemSkinMeta.getItemSkinMeta(Item.itemSkin)
        if Skin and type(Skin.projectileSourceOverrides) == "table" then
            Source = table.clone(Source)
            for Key: string, Value: any in Skin.projectileSourceOverrides do
                Source[Key] = Value
            end
        end

        local Config: any = Source.launchSoundConfig
        if Source.launchSound and #Source.launchSound > 0 then
            local Pitch: any = Config and Config.pitch
            Data.Controllers.AudioManager:playAudio(Source.launchSound[math.random(1, #Source.launchSound)], {
                playbackSpeedMultiplier = Pitch and (math.random() * (Pitch.Max - Pitch.Min) + Pitch.Min) or nil,
                volumeMultiplier = Config and Config.volumeMultiplier or 1
            })
        end
        if Source.launchOverlaySound and Source.launchOverlaySound ~= "" then
            local Pitch: any = Config and Config.launchOverlayPitch
            Data.Controllers.AudioManager:playAudio(Source.launchOverlaySound, {
                playbackSpeedMultiplier = Pitch and (math.random() * (Pitch.Max - Pitch.Min) + Pitch.Min) or nil
            })
        end
    end

    Shots.Watch = function(Id: string, Origin: Vector3, Velocity: Vector3, Gravity: number, Target: Target, Lifetime: number?, Arc: RaycastParams): RBXScriptConnection?
        local Character: Model? = Target.Character
        if not Character or Velocity.Magnitude <= 0 then
            return nil
        end

        local Overlap: OverlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
        Overlap.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
        Overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances = {Character}

        local Steps: number = math.clamp(math.ceil(Velocity.Magnitude / 170), 1, 16)
        local Started: number = os.clock()
        local Last: Vector3 = Origin
        local Watcher: RBXScriptConnection
        Watcher = Services.RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            local Elapsed: number = os.clock() - Started
            local Position: Vector3 = Origin + Velocity * Elapsed - Vector3.new(0, 0.5 * Gravity * Elapsed * Elapsed, 0)
            local Hit: boolean = false
            for Step: number = 1, Steps do
                Hit = Hit or #workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(Last:Lerp(Position, Step / Steps)), Vector3.new(3, 1, 3), Overlap) > 0
            end

            if Hit then
                Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("ProjectileHit"):SendToServer(Id, Character)
            end
            if Hit or Elapsed > (Lifetime or 2) or not Character.Parent or workspace:Raycast(Last, Position - Last, Arc) then
                Watcher:Disconnect()
            end

            Last = Position
        end)

        return Watcher
    end

    return Shots
end)()

BundledModules.ProjectileAimbot = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity
    local Ballistic = BundledModules.Ballistic
    local Shots = BundledModules.Shots
    local Closest = BundledModules.Closest

    local ProjectileAimbot
    local Mode, Targets, Sort, TargetPart, FOV, Range, Horizontal, Vertical, UseKit, AutoCharge

    local Original, Hook, Launcher, Fire
    local Generator: Random = Random.new()
    local Picks: {string} = {"Root", "Head", "Torso"}

    local function Solve(Kind: string, Launch: Vector3, Speed: number, Gravity: number): Vector3?
        local Meta: any = Data.Instances.ProjectileMeta[Kind]
        local Held: string = Data.Storage.Hand.Tool and Data.Storage.Hand.Tool.Name or ""
        local List: {Target} = Meta and (Meta.combat or Kind == "lasso") and Kind ~= "telepearl" and Speed > 0 and (UseKit.Enabled or not Shots.Kits[Held]) and Entity.Alive and Entity.Targets({
            Origin = Launch,
            FOV = FOV.Value,
            Range = Range.Value,
            Mouse = Services.UserInputService.TouchEnabled and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize / 2 or nil,
            Sort = Sort.Value,
            Players = Targets.Players.Enabled,
            NPCs = Targets.NPCs.Enabled,
            Invisible = Targets.Invisible.Enabled,
            Wallcheck = Targets.Walls.Enabled,
            Priority = Targets.Priority.Value
        }) or {}

        local Headshot: boolean = Held:find("headhunter", 1, true) ~= nil or Held:find("tactical", 1, true) ~= nil or Data.Storage.EquippedKit == "archer"
        local Source: any = Data.Instances.Items[Held] and Data.Instances.Items[Held].projectileSource
        local Relative: any = Source and Source.relativeOverride
        local Shift: Vector3 = Relative and Vector3.new(Relative.relX, Relative.relY, Relative.relZ) or Vector3.new(Data.Instances.BowConstants.RelX or 0, Data.Instances.BowConstants.RelY or 0, Data.Instances.BowConstants.RelZ or 0)
        for i: number = 1, math.min(#List, 5) do
            local Target: Target = List[i]
            local Name: string = TargetPart.Value == "Random" and Picks[Generator:NextInteger(1, #Picks)] or TargetPart.Value == "Dynamic" and (Headshot and "Head" or "Root") or TargetPart.Value
            local Part: Instance? = Name == "Closest" and Closest(Target.Character) or Name == "Head" and Target.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") or Name == "Torso" and (Target.Character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or Target.Character:FindFirstChild("Torso")) or nil
            local Offset: Vector3 = Part and Part:IsA("BasePart") and Part.Position - Target.RootPart.Position or Vector3.zero
            local Start: Vector3 = Launch
            local Direction: Vector3?, Time: number = nil, 0
            for _ = 1, 3 do
                Direction, Time = Ballistic.Solve(Target, Start, Speed, Gravity, true, Offset)
                if Direction then
                    Start = (CFrame.lookAlong(Launch, Direction) * CFrame.new(Shift)).Position
                end
            end

            if Direction and (Horizontal.Value ~= 1 or Vertical.Value ~= 1) then
                local Velocity: Vector3 = Target.RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                local Rise: number = Velocity.Y * Time - workspace.Gravity * Time * Time * 0.5
                local Lead: Vector3 = Vector3.new(Velocity.X * Time * (Horizontal.Value - 1), Rise * (Vertical.Value - 1), Velocity.Z * Time * (Horizontal.Value - 1))
                local Adjusted: Vector3?, Later: number = Ballistic.Solve(Target, Start, Speed, Gravity, true, Offset + Lead)
                if Adjusted then
                    Direction, Time = Adjusted, Later
                end
            end

            if Direction and Time <= (Meta.lifetimeSec or 3) then
                Cat.TargetInfo.Targets[Target] = tick() + 1

                return Direction
            end
        end

        return nil
    end

    local function Aim(Values: any, Kind: any)
        if type(Values) ~= "table" or typeof(Values.initialVelocity) ~= "Vector3" or typeof(Values.positionFrom) ~= "Vector3" or type(Kind) ~= "string" then
            return
        end

        local Meta: any = Data.Instances.ProjectileMeta[Kind]
        local Full: boolean = AutoCharge.Enabled and Meta ~= nil and Meta.combat ~= nil and type(Meta.launchVelocity) == "number"
        local Speed: number = Full and Meta.launchVelocity or Values.initialVelocity.Magnitude
        if Full then
            Values.drawDurationSeconds = 5
            if Values.initialVelocity.Magnitude > 0.001 then
                Values.initialVelocity = Values.initialVelocity.Unit * Speed
            end
        end

        local Success: boolean, Direction: Vector3? = pcall(Solve, Kind, Values.positionFrom, Speed, Values.gravitationalAcceleration or 196.2)
        if Success and Direction then
            Values.initialVelocity = Direction * Speed
        end
    end

    ProjectileAimbot = Cat.Categories.Blatant:CreateModule({
        Name = "ProjectileAimbot",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            local Controller: any = Data.Controllers.ProjectileController
            if Callback then
                Original = Controller.calculateImportantLaunchValues
                Hook = function(self: any, Launch: any, ...: any): any
                    local Values: any = Original(self, Launch, ...)
                    if ProjectileAimbot.Enabled and Mode.Value == "Trajectory" and type(Launch) == "table" then
                        Aim(Values, Launch.projectile)
                    end

                    return Values
                end
                Controller.calculateImportantLaunchValues = Hook

                Launcher = Controller.launchProjectileWithValues
                Fire = function(self: any, Values: any, Tool: any, Source: any, Ammo: any, ...: any): ...any
                    if ProjectileAimbot.Enabled and Mode.Value == "Silent" and type(Source) == "table" and type(Source.projectileType) == "function" and type(Ammo) == "string" then
                        local Valid: boolean, Kind: any = pcall(Source.projectileType, Ammo)
                        if Valid then
                            Aim(Values, Kind)
                        end
                    end

                    return Launcher(self, Values, Tool, Source, Ammo, ...)
                end
                Controller.launchProjectileWithValues = Fire
            else
                if Hook and Controller.calculateImportantLaunchValues == Hook then
                    Controller.calculateImportantLaunchValues = Original
                end
                if Fire and Controller.launchProjectileWithValues == Fire then
                    Controller.launchProjectileWithValues = Launcher
                end
                Original, Hook, Launcher, Fire = nil, nil, nil, nil
            end
        end,
        ExtraText = function(): string
            return Mode.Value
        end,
        Tooltip = "Aims your projectiles at the target for you"
    })

    Mode = ProjectileAimbot:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Mode",
        List = {"Trajectory", "Silent"},
        Default = "Trajectory",
        Tooltip = "Trajectory - Bends the shot itself toward the target, the preview follows it\nSilent - Your aim line stays where you point, only the fired shot is bent onto the target"
    })
    Targets = ProjectileAimbot:CreateTargets({
        Players = true,
        Walls = true
    })

    local Methods: {string} = {"Mouse"}
    for Index: string in Entity.Sorts do
        if not table.find(Methods, Index) then
            table.insert(Methods, Index)
        end
    end

    Sort = ProjectileAimbot:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Target Mode",
        List = Methods,
        Default = "Mouse",
        Tooltip = "Which target in range gets shot first, Mouse picks the one closest to your crosshair"
    })
    TargetPart = ProjectileAimbot:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Target Part",
        List = {"Root", "Head", "Torso", "Closest", "Random", "Dynamic"},
        Default = "Root",
        Tooltip = "Closest aims at the body part nearest your mouse\nRandom picks a new part for every shot\nDynamic aims at the head with headshot bows (headhunter, tactical, or the Archer kit) and at the body with everything else"
    })
    FOV = ProjectileAimbot:CreateSlider({
        Name = "FOV",
        Min = 1,
        Max = 1000,
        Default = 1000,
        Suffix = "px",
        Tooltip = "How far from your mouse a target can be on screen"
    })
    Range = ProjectileAimbot:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Range",
        Min = 1,
        Max = 500,
        Default = 500,
        Suffix = function(Value: number): string
            return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
        end,
        Tooltip = "How far away from you a target can be"
    })
    Horizontal = ProjectileAimbot:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Horizontal prediction",
        Min = 0,
        Max = 2,
        Default = 1,
        Decimal = 100,
        Tooltip = "Scales how far ahead of the target you aim sideways"
    })
    Vertical = ProjectileAimbot:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Vertical prediction",
        Min = 0,
        Max = 2,
        Default = 1,
        Decimal = 100,
        Tooltip = "Scales how far ahead of the target you aim while it rises or falls"
    })
    AutoCharge = ProjectileAimbot:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Auto Charge",
        Default = true,
        Tooltip = "Fires every shot at full charge, so it flies at full speed and deals full damage"
    })
    UseKit = ProjectileAimbot:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Use Kit Items",
        Default = true,
        Tooltip = "Also aims shots from kit items like frost staffs, the spellbook, chakrams and the lasso, off leaves those alone"
    })
end)()

BundledModules.ProjectileAura = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity
    local Ballistic = BundledModules.Ballistic
    local Ping = BundledModules.Ping
    local Shots = BundledModules.Shots
    local SlotController = BundledModules.SlotController

    local ProjectileAura
    local Targets, TargetPart, List, UseKit, FireRate, AFKCheck, Range

    local Generator: Random = Random.new()
    local Picks: {string} = {"Root", "Head", "Torso"}
    local FireDelays: {[string]: number} = {}
    local Arc: RaycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    Arc.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

    local LastInput: number = tick()

    local function Matches(Names: {string?}): boolean
        for _, v: string in List.ListEnabled do
            local Needle: string = (tostring(v):lower():gsub("[_%s]+", " "))
            if #Needle > 0 then
                for _, Name: string? in Names do
                    local Clean: string? = Name and (tostring(Name):lower():gsub("[_%s]+", " "))
                    if Clean and (Clean == Needle or (` {Clean}`):find(` {Needle}`, 1, true)) then
                        return true
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        return false
    end

    local function Shoot(Target: Target, Shot: AuraShot): boolean
        local Meta: any = Data.Instances.ProjectileMeta[Shot.Projectile]
        if Meta and type(Meta.launchVelocity) == "number" and tick() >= (FireDelays[Shot.Item.itemType] or 0) then
            local Origin: Vector3 = Entity.RootPart.Position
            local Gravity: number = Meta.gravitationalAcceleration or 196.2
            local Held: string = Shot.Item.itemType
            local Bow: boolean = Held:find("headhunter", 1, true) ~= nil or Held:find("tactical", 1, true) ~= nil
            local Headshot: boolean = Bow or Data.Storage.EquippedKit == "archer"
            local Name: string = TargetPart.Value
            if Name == "Random" then
                Name = Picks[Generator:NextInteger(1, #Picks)]
            elseif Name == "Dynamic" then
                Name = Headshot and "Head" or "Root"
            end
            local Torso: Instance? = Target.Character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or Target.Character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
            local Part: Instance? = Name == "Head" and Target.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") or Name == "Torso" and Torso or nil
            local Offset: Vector3 = Part and Part:IsA("BasePart") and Part.Position - Target.RootPart.Position or Vector3.zero
            local Bounds: any = Data.Instances.BowConstants
            local Shift: Vector3 = Vector3.new(-(Bounds.RelX or 0), -(Bounds.RelY or 0), -(Bounds.RelZ or 0))
            local Launch: Vector3 = (CFrame.new(Origin, Target.RootPart.Position + Offset) * CFrame.new(Shift)).Position
            local Direction: Vector3?, Time: number = Ballistic.Solve(Target, Launch, Meta.launchVelocity, Gravity, true, Offset)

            local Ignore: {Instance} = {workspace.CurrentCamera, Entity.Character}
            for _, v: Target in Entity.Entities do
                if v.Character then
                    table.insert(Ignore, v.Character)
                end
            end
            Arc.FilterDescendantsInstances = Ignore

            if Direction and Time <= (Meta.lifetimeSec or 3) and Ballistic.Clear(Launch, Direction * Meta.launchVelocity, Gravity, Time, Arc) then
                local OldTool: Tool? = Data.Storage.Hand.Tool
                local Switched: boolean = SlotController.Switch(Shot.Item.tool, 0.1)
                local Velocity: Vector3 = Direction * Meta.launchVelocity
                local Id: string = Data.Controllers.IdUtil.generateId(8)

                Cat.TargetInfo.Targets[Target] = tick() + 1
                FireDelays[Shot.Item.itemType] = tick() + (Shot.Source.fireDelaySec or 0.1)

                local Watcher: RBXScriptConnection? = Shots.Watch(Id, Launch, Velocity, Gravity, Target, Meta.lifetimeSec, Arc)
                if Watcher then
                    ProjectileAura:Clean(Watcher)
                end

                task.spawn(function(): ()
                    local Success: boolean, Response: any = pcall(function(): number
                        local Stamp: number = workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - Ping.Get() / 10
                        local Payload: {shotId: string, drawDurationSec: number} = {
                            shotId = Data.Controllers.IdUtil.generateId(8),
                            drawDurationSec = math.max(1, Shot.Source.maxStrengthChargeSec or 0)
                        }

                        return Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("ProjectileFire"):CallServer(Shot.Item.tool, Shot.Ammo, Shot.Projectile, Launch, Origin, Velocity, Id, Payload, Stamp)
                    end)

                    if Success and type(Response) == "table" and Response.accepted then
                        Shots.Launch(Shot.Item, Shot.Source)
                    else
                        FireDelays[Shot.Item.itemType] = tick()
                    end
                end)

                if OldTool then
                    SlotController.Switch(OldTool, 0)
                end

                return Switched
            end
        end

        return false
    end

    ProjectileAura = Cat.Categories.Blatant:CreateModule({
        Name = "ProjectileAura",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean): ()
            if Callback then
                for _, v: RBXScriptSignal in {Services.UserInputService.InputBegan, Services.UserInputService.InputChanged} do
                    ProjectileAura:Clean(v:Connect(function(Input: InputObject): ()
                        if Input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or Input.Delta.Magnitude > 0 then
                            LastInput = tick()
                        end
                    end))
                end
                ProjectileAura:Clean(function(): ()
                    table.clear(FireDelays)
                    if SlotController.Owner == "ProjectileAura" then
                        SlotController.Owner = nil
                    end
                end)

                LastInput = tick()
                repeat
                    if Entity.Alive and workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - Data.Controllers.SwordController.lastAttack > 0.5 and (not AFKCheck.Enabled or tick() - LastInput < 30) then
                        local Target: Target? = Entity.Targets({
                            Origin = Entity.RootPart.Position,
                            Range = Range.Value,
                            Players = Targets.Players.Enabled,
                            NPCs = Targets.NPCs.Enabled,
                            Invisible = Targets.Invisible.Enabled,
                            Wallcheck = Targets.Walls.Enabled,
                            Priority = Targets.Priority.Value
                        })[1]

                        if Target and (not SlotController.Owner or SlotController.Owner == "ProjectileAura" or tick() >= SlotController.Expires) then
                            for _, Shot: AuraShot in Shots.List(UseKit.Enabled, Matches) do
                                SlotController.Owner, SlotController.Expires = "ProjectileAura", tick() + 1
                                if Shoot(Target, Shot) then
                                    task.wait(FireRate:GetRandomValue())
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    task.wait(0.03)
                until not ProjectileAura.Enabled
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Shoots people around you"
    })

    Targets = ProjectileAura:CreateTargets({
        Players = true,
        Walls = true
    })
    TargetPart = ProjectileAura:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Target Part",
        List = {"Root", "Head", "Torso", "Random", "Dynamic"},
        Default = "Root",
        Tooltip = "Random picks a new part for every shot\nDynamic aims at the head with headshot bows (headhunter, tactical, or the Archer kit) and at the body with everything else"
    })
    List = ProjectileAura:CreateTextList({
        Name = "Projectiles",
        Default = {"arrow", "snowball"}
    })
    UseKit = ProjectileAura:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Use Kit Items",
        Tooltip = "Also shoots kit items like frost staffs, the spellbook, chakrams and life bows, off leaves those alone"
    })
    FireRate = ProjectileAura:CreateTwoSlider({
        Name = "Fire Rate",
        Min = 0,
        Max = 1,
        DefaultMin = 0.05,
        DefaultMax = 0.12,
        Decimal = 100
    })
    AFKCheck = ProjectileAura:CreateToggle({
        Name = "AFK check",
        Tooltip = "Stops firing once you have not touched your mouse or keyboard for 30 seconds"
    })
    Range = ProjectileAura:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Range",
        Min = 1,
        Max = 50,
        Default = 50,
        Suffix = function(Value: number): string
            return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
        end
    })
end)()

BundledModules.Speed = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services
    local LocalPlayer: Player = Services.Players.LocalPlayer

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity
    local Ping = BundledModules.Ping

    local Speed
    local Mode, SpeedSlider, WallCheck, AutoJump, AlwaysJump, DamageBoost, Extra, Calculate

    local isnetworkowner = isnetworkowner or function(_): boolean
        return true
    end

    local Modifier: {moveSpeedMultiplier: number?} = {}
    local Filtered
    local Boost: number, BoostUntil: number, BoostStack: number = 0, 0, 0

    local Params: RaycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    Params.RespectCanCollide = true

    Speed = Cat.Categories.Blatant:CreateModule({
        Name = "Speed",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            local Blatant: boolean = Callback and Mode.Value == "Blatant"
            debug.setconstant(Data.Controllers.WindWalkerController.updateSpeed, 7, Blatant and "constantSpeedMultiplier" or "moveSpeedMultiplier")
            Data.Controllers.StatefulEntityKnockbackController.lastImpulseTime = Blatant and math.huge or time()

            if Callback then
                if not Blatant then
                    Modifier.moveSpeedMultiplier = SpeedSlider.Value / 20

                    local Handle: any = Data.Controllers.SprintController:getMovementStatusModifier():addModifier(Modifier)
                    Speed:Clean(function()
                        Handle:Destroy()
                    end)
                end

                BoostUntil, BoostStack = 0, 0
                Speed:Clean(Data.Events.EntityDamageEvent:Connect(function(Event: {entityInstance: Model?, knockbackMultiplier: {horizontal: number?}?})
                    if DamageBoost.Enabled and Entity.Alive and Event.entityInstance == LocalPlayer.Character and tick() > BoostStack and not (Cat.Modules.LongJump ~= nil and Cat.Modules.LongJump.Enabled) then
                        local Horizontal: number = Event.knockbackMultiplier and Event.knockbackMultiplier.horizontal or 0
                        local Knockback: number = Data.Controllers.KnockbackUtil.calculateKnockbackVelocity(Vector3.one, 1, {vertical = 0, horizontal = Horizontal}).Magnitude * (0.9 + Ping.Get())
                        Boost = Calculate.Enabled and Knockback or Extra.Value
                        BoostStack, BoostUntil = tick() + Knockback / 45, tick() + Horizontal / 3.5
                    end
                end))

                Speed:Clean(Services.RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function(Delta: number)
                    local Bonus: number = tick() < BoostUntil and Boost or 0
                    if Blatant then
                        Data.Controllers.StatefulEntityKnockbackController.lastImpulseTime = math.huge
                    elseif Modifier.moveSpeedMultiplier ~= (SpeedSlider.Value + Bonus) / 20 then
                        Modifier.moveSpeedMultiplier = (SpeedSlider.Value + Bonus) / 20
                        Data.Controllers.SprintController:getMovementStatusModifier():updateModifiers()
                    end
                    if Entity.Alive and not (Cat.Modules.Fly ~= nil and Cat.Modules.Fly.Enabled) and not (Cat.Modules.LongJump ~= nil and Cat.Modules.LongJump.Enabled) and isnetworkowner(Entity.RootPart) then
                        local State: Enum.HumanoidStateType = Entity.Humanoid:GetState()
                        if State ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing then
                            local Direction: Vector3 = Entity.Humanoid.MoveDirection
                            if Blatant then
                                local Modifiers: any = Data.Controllers.SprintController:getMovementStatusModifier():getModifiers()
                                local Multiplier: number, Increase: boolean = 0, true
                                for Modifier: any in Modifiers do
                                    local Constant: number = Modifier.constantSpeedMultiplier or 0
                                    if Constant > math.max(Multiplier, 1) then
                                        Increase = false
                                        Multiplier = Constant - 0.06 * math.round(Constant)
                                    end
                                end

                                for Modifier: any in Modifiers do
                                    Multiplier += math.max((Modifier.moveSpeedMultiplier or 0) - 1, 0)
                                end

                                if Multiplier > 0 and Increase then
                                    Multiplier += 0.16 + 0.02 * math.round(Multiplier)
                                end

                                local Current: number = 20 * (Multiplier + 1) + Bonus
                                local Destination: Vector3 = Direction * math.max(SpeedSlider.Value + Bonus - Current, 0) * Delta
                                if WallCheck.Enabled then
                                    if not LocalPlayer.Character or Filtered ~= LocalPlayer.Character then
                                        Filtered = LocalPlayer.Character
                                        Params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {Filtered, workspace.CurrentCamera}
                                    end

                                    Params.CollisionGroup = Entity.RootPart.CollisionGroup

                                    local Wall: RaycastResult? = workspace:Raycast(Entity.RootPart.Position, Destination, Params)
                                    if Wall then
                                        Destination = Wall.Position + Wall.Normal - Entity.RootPart.Position
                                    end
                                end

                                Entity.RootPart.CFrame += Destination
                                Entity.RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Direction * Current + Vector3.new(0, Entity.RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, 0)
                            end
                            if AutoJump.Enabled and (State == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running or State == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed) and Direction ~= Vector3.zero and (Data.Storage.Attacking or AlwaysJump.Enabled) then
                                Entity.Humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end))
            end
        end,
        ExtraText = function(): string
            return Mode.Value
        end,
        Tooltip = "Increases your movement with various methods"
    })

    Mode = Speed:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Mode",
        List = {"Blatant", "Legit"},
        Function = function(Value: string)
            if WallCheck and WallCheck.Object then
                WallCheck.Object.Visible = Value == "Blatant"
            end

            if Speed.Enabled then
                Speed:Toggle()
                Speed:Toggle()
            end
        end,
        Default = "Blatant",
        Tooltip = "Blatant - Heatseeker, moves your root forward every frame\nLegit - Raises your walkspeed through the games own speed system"
    })
    SpeedSlider = Speed:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Speed",
        Min = 1,
        Max = 23,
        Default = 23,
        Function = function(Value: number)
            if Speed.Enabled and Mode.Value == "Legit" then
                Modifier.moveSpeedMultiplier = Value / 20
                Data.Controllers.SprintController:getMovementStatusModifier():updateModifiers()
            end
        end,
        Suffix = function(Value: number)
            return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
        end
    })
    WallCheck = Speed:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Wall Check",
        Default = true,
        Visible = Mode.Value == "Blatant"
    })
    AutoJump = Speed:CreateToggle({
        Name = "AutoJump",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if AlwaysJump and AlwaysJump.Object then
                AlwaysJump.Object.Visible = Callback
            end
        end
    })
    AlwaysJump = Speed:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Always Jump",
        Darker = true,
        Visible = AutoJump.Enabled
    })
    DamageBoost = Speed:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Damage Boost",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Calculate and Calculate.Object then
                Calculate.Object.Visible = Callback
            end
            if Extra and Extra.Object then
                Extra.Object.Visible = Callback and not Calculate.Enabled
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Goes faster for a moment after you take knockback, while the server still allows it"
    })
    Calculate = Speed:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Auto calculate",
        Default = true,
        Darker = true,
        Visible = DamageBoost.Enabled,
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Extra and Extra.Object then
                Extra.Object.Visible = DamageBoost.Enabled and not Callback
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Works the extra speed out from the knockback you took and your ping"
    })
    Extra = Speed:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Extra speed",
        Min = 1,
        Max = 40,
        Default = 10,
        Darker = true,
        Visible = DamageBoost.Enabled and not Calculate.Enabled,
        Suffix = function(Value: number)
            return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
        end,
        Tooltip = "Added on top of your speed while the boost lasts"
    })
end)()

BundledModules.AimAssist = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services
    local LocalPlayer: Player = Services.Players.LocalPlayer

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity
    local AimArrow = BundledModules.AimArrow
    local Ballistic = BundledModules.Ballistic
    local Closest = BundledModules.Closest

    local AimAssist
    local AimMode, Mode, Sort, AimPart, Targets
    local AimSpeed, Smoothness, Distance, Shake, AngleSlider, ProjectileRange
    local ClickAim, Mouse, StrafeIncrease, BlockBreak, Limit, Projectiles
    local ShowAim, AimColor

    local Started: number, NextSearch: number, RolledSpeed: number = 0, 0, 0
    local LastTarget: Target?

    local function GetProjectile(): (any, any)
        if Projectiles.Enabled then
            local Meta: any = Data.Storage.Hand.Tool and Data.Instances.Items[Data.Storage.Hand.Tool.Name]
            local Source: any = Meta and not Meta.sword and Meta.projectileSource
            if Source and Source.projectileType then
                local Handler: any = Data.Controllers.DefaultProjectileSourceController and Data.Controllers.DefaultProjectileSourceController.projectileHandler
                local Item: any = Handler and Handler.projectileSourceController and Handler.projectileSourceController:getHandItem()
                if Handler and (not Item or Item.tool ~= Data.Storage.Hand.Tool) then
                    Handler = nil
                end

                local Type: string? = Handler and Handler.projectile
                if not Type then
                    local Ammo: string? = Data.Storage.Hand.Tool.Name
                    if Source.ammoItemTypes and #Source.ammoItemTypes > 0 then
                        Ammo = nil
                        for _, v: InventoryItem in (Data.Storage.Inventory.inventory.items or {}) do
                            if table.find(Source.ammoItemTypes, v.itemType) then
                                Ammo = v.itemType

                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    Type = Ammo and Source.projectileType(Ammo)
                end

                local Projectile: any = Type and Data.Instances.ProjectileMeta[Type]
                if Projectile and (Projectile.combat or Type == "lasso") and type(Projectile.launchVelocity) == "number" then
                    return Projectile, Handler
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local function GetCameraAim(Launch: Vector3, Point: Vector3, Handler: any): Vector3
        local Camera: Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local Origin: Vector3 = Camera.CFrame.Position
        local Direction: Vector3 = (Point - Launch).Unit
        local Offset: Vector3 = Launch - Origin
        local Reach: number = Offset.Magnitude * (Data.Instances.BowConstants.CameraMultiplier or 10)
        local Look: Vector3 = Direction
        if Reach > 0.01 then
            local Along: number = Offset:Dot(Direction)
            local Travel: number = math.sqrt(math.max(Along * Along - Offset:Dot(Offset) + Reach * Reach, 0)) - Along
            Look = (Offset + Direction * Travel).Unit
        end

        local Lift: number = Data.Instances.BowConstants.YTargetOffset or 0.05
        local Scale: number = Look.Y * Lift + math.sqrt(math.max(Look.Y * Look.Y * Lift * Lift - Lift * Lift + 1, 0))
        local Desired: Vector3 = Look * Scale - Vector3.new(0, Lift, 0)
        local Cursor: Mouse = LocalPlayer:GetMouse()
        local Screen: Vector2 = Vector2.new(Cursor.X, Cursor.Y)
        if Handler then
            Screen = Handler.lockedAimPoint or (Handler.inputInfo and Handler.inputInfo.initialPosition) or Screen
            if Handler.startAtCenterOfCamera then
                Screen = Camera.ViewportSize / 2
            end
        elseif Services.UserInputService.TouchEnabled then
            Screen = Camera.ViewportSize / 2 - Vector2.new(0, Services.GuiService:GetGuiInset().Y / 2)
        end

        local Ray: Vector3 = Camera.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(Camera:ScreenPointToRay(Screen.X, Screen.Y).Direction)
        local Vertical: number = math.sqrt(Ray.Y * Ray.Y + Ray.Z * Ray.Z)
        local Pitch: number = math.asin(math.clamp(Desired.Y / math.max(Vertical, 0.001), -1, 1)) - math.atan2(Ray.Y, -Ray.Z)
        local Forward: number = Ray.Y * math.sin(Pitch) + Ray.Z * math.cos(Pitch)
        local Yaw: number = math.atan2(-Desired.X, -Desired.Z) - math.atan2(-Ray.X, -Forward)
        local Rotation: CFrame = CFrame.new(Origin) * CFrame.Angles(0, Yaw, 0) * CFrame.Angles(Pitch, 0, 0)

        return Origin + Rotation.LookVector * (Point - Origin).Magnitude
    end

    local function GetProjectileAim(Target: Target, Projectile: any, Handler: any, Offset: Vector3?): Vector3?
        local Values: any = Handler and Data.Controllers.ProjectileController:calculateImportantLaunchValues(Handler, false, Data.Storage.Hand.Tool)
        local Launch: Vector3 = Values and Values.positionFrom or (Data.Controllers.ProjectileController:getLaunchPosition(Data.Storage.Hand.Tool) or Entity.RootPart.Position) + (Handler and Handler.fromPositionOffset or Vector3.new(0, 2, 0))
        local Speed: number = Values and Values.initialVelocity.Magnitude or Projectile.launchVelocity
        local Gravity: number = Values and Values.gravitationalAcceleration or Projectile.gravitationalAcceleration or 196.2
        local Direction: Vector3?, Time: number, Distance: number = Ballistic.Solve(Target, Launch, Speed, Gravity, nil, Offset)
        if not Direction or Time > (Projectile.lifetimeSec or 3) then
            return
        end

        return GetCameraAim(Launch, Launch + Direction * Distance, Handler)
    end

    local function Aim(Origin: CFrame, Point: Vector3, DeltaTime: number): CFrame
        local Strafing: boolean = StrafeIncrease.Enabled and (Services.UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) or Services.UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D))
        local Speed: number
        if Mode.Value == "Adaptive" then
            local Time: number = math.min(tick() - Started, 1)
            local Progress: number = Time < 0.5 and 4 * Time * Time * Time or 1 - math.pow(-2 * Time + 2, 3) / 2
            Speed = (RolledSpeed * 0.1 * Progress + (1 - Progress) + (Strafing and 10 or 5)) / Smoothness.Value
        else
            Speed = (RolledSpeed + (Strafing and 10 or 0)) / Smoothness.Value
        end

        local Jitter: Vector3 = Vector3.new(Random.new():NextNumber() - 0.5, Random.new():NextNumber() - 0.5, Random.new():NextNumber() - 0.5) * Shake.Value * DeltaTime

        return Origin:Lerp(CFrame.lookAt(Origin.Position, Point + Jitter), math.clamp(Speed * DeltaTime, 0, 1))
    end

    AimAssist = Cat.Categories.Combat:CreateModule({
        Name = "AimAssist",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback then
                local RotateTime: number = 0
                local Arrow = AimArrow.new()
                AimAssist:Clean(function()
                    Arrow:Destroy()
                end)
                AimAssist:Clean(Services.RunService.PostSimulation:Connect(function(DeltaTime: number)
                    local Turned = false
                    if Entity.Alive then
                        Entity.Humanoid.AutoRotate = tick() > RotateTime

                        local Projectile: any, Handler: any = GetProjectile()
                        local Charging: boolean = Projectile ~= nil and Data.Controllers.ProjectileController.isTargeting == true
                        local Swing: number = tick() - Data.Controllers.SwordController.lastSwing
                        if not (Mouse.Enabled and not Charging and not Services.UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) and Swing > 0.15) and not (ClickAim.Enabled and not Charging and Swing > 0.3) and not (BlockBreak.Enabled and tick() - Data.Storage.LastBreak < 0.3) and not (Limit.Enabled and Data.Storage.Hand.Type ~= "sword" and not Projectile) then
                            local Found: {Target} = Entity.Targets({
                                Range = Projectile and ProjectileRange.Value or Distance.Value,
                                Players = Targets.Players.Enabled,
                                NPCs = Targets.NPCs.Enabled,
                                Invisible = Targets.Invisible.Enabled,
                                Wallcheck = Targets.Walls.Enabled,
                                Priority = Targets.Priority.Value,
                                Sort = Sort.Value
                            })

                            if not (LastTarget and tick() < NextSearch and table.find(Found, LastTarget)) then
                                if Found[1] ~= LastTarget then
                                    Started = tick()
                                end

                                LastTarget, NextSearch, RolledSpeed = Found[1], tick() + 1, AimSpeed:GetRandomValue()
                            end

                            if LastTarget then
                                local Facing: Vector3 = Entity.RootPart.CFrame.LookVector * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
                                local Flat: Vector3 = (LastTarget.RootPart.Position - Entity.RootPart.Position) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
                                local Angle: number = Facing.Magnitude > 0 and Flat.Magnitude > 0 and math.acos(math.clamp(Facing.Unit:Dot(Flat.Unit), -1, 1)) or 0
                                if Angle < math.rad(AngleSlider.Value) / 2 then
                                    local Part: BasePart? = AimPart.Value == "Closest" and Closest(LastTarget.Character) or nil
                                    local Point: Vector3? = Part and Part.Position or LastTarget.RootPart.Position
                                    if Projectile then
                                        Point = GetProjectileAim(LastTarget, Projectile, Handler, Part and Part.Position - LastTarget.RootPart.Position)
                                    end

                                    if Point then
                                        Cat.TargetInfo.Targets[LastTarget] = tick() + 1

                                        local Camera: Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
                                        local Head: BasePart? = Entity.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") :: BasePart?
                                        local FirstPerson: boolean = Head ~= nil and Head.LocalTransparencyModifier == 1
                                        if AimMode.Value == "First person" or (AimMode.Value == "Dynamic" and FirstPerson) then
                                            if FirstPerson then
                                                Camera.CFrame = Aim(Camera.CFrame, Point, DeltaTime)
                                            end
                                        elseif not FirstPerson then
                                            if Projectile then
                                                Camera.CFrame = Aim(Camera.CFrame, Point, DeltaTime)
                                            else
                                                local Direction: Vector3 = Aim(Entity.RootPart.CFrame, Point, DeltaTime).LookVector * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
                                                if Direction.Magnitude > 0 then
                                                    Entity.Humanoid.AutoRotate = false
                                                    Entity.RootPart.CFrame = CFrame.lookAlong(Entity.RootPart.Position, Direction)
                                                    RotateTime = tick() + 0.1
                                                    Turned = true
                                                end
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    else
                        LastTarget = nil
                    end
                    Arrow:Update(ShowAim.Enabled and Turned and Entity.RootPart.Position + Entity.RootPart.CFrame.LookVector * 50 or nil, Color3.fromHSV(AimColor.Hue, AimColor.Sat, AimColor.Value), 1 - AimColor.Opacity)
                end))
            else
                LastTarget = nil
                if Entity.Alive then
                    Entity.Humanoid.AutoRotate = true
                end
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Smoothly aims to closest valid target with sword"
    })

    AimMode = AimAssist:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Aim perspective",
        List = {"First person", "Third person", "Dynamic"},
        Default = "First person",
        Tooltip = "First person - Uses your camera to aim\nThird person - Moves your character to where your supposed to look\nDynamic - Uses first person mode if ur in first person, and uses third person if ur in third person"
    })
    Mode = AimAssist:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Mode",
        List = {"Simple", "Adaptive"},
        Default = "Simple",
        Tooltip = "Simple - Smooth aiming\nAdaptive - Advanced tracking with adaptive behavior"
    })
    Targets = AimAssist:CreateTargets({
        Players = true,
        Walls = true
    })
    ClickAim = AimAssist:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Click aim",
        Default = true
    })
    Mouse = AimAssist:CreateToggle({Name = "Require mouse down"})
    StrafeIncrease = AimAssist:CreateToggle({Name = "Strafe increase"})
    BlockBreak = AimAssist:CreateToggle({Name = "Check block break"})
    AimSpeed = AimAssist:CreateTwoSlider({
        Name = "Aim speed",
        Min = 1,
        Max = 20,
        DefaultMin = 6,
        DefaultMax = 6,
        Tooltip = "Picks a random speed between the two values every time it looks for a target, so on each lock-on and once a second while it stays on the same one"
    })
    Smoothness = AimAssist:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Smoothness",
        Min = 1,
        Max = 20,
        Default = 1,
        Decimal = 10,
        Tooltip = "Divides the aim speed to soften the snap, 1 leaves aiming unchanged"
    })
    Distance = AimAssist:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Distance",
        Min = 1,
        Max = 30,
        Default = 30,
        Suffix = function(Value: number)
            return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
        end
    })
    Shake = AimAssist:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Shake",
        Min = 0,
        Max = 100,
        Default = 0,
        Tooltip = "Adds random jitter to simulate human aim"
    })
    AngleSlider = AimAssist:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Max angle",
        Min = 1,
        Max = 360,
        Default = 70
    })
    Limit = AimAssist:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Limit to items",
        Tooltip = "Only attacks when sword is held, or a projectile weapon while Projectiles is on"
    })
    Projectiles = AimAssist:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Projectiles",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if ProjectileRange and ProjectileRange.Object then
                ProjectileRange.Object.Visible = Callback
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "While you hold a bow or another damaging projectile, aims where the shot will meet a moving target instead of at their body, always at the body's center. Click aim then aims while you draw, and third person turns your camera since shots follow it"
    })
    ProjectileRange = AimAssist:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Projectile Range",
        Min = 1,
        Max = 300,
        Default = 200,
        Suffix = function(Value: number)
            return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
        end,
        Tooltip = "How far away a target can be while you hold a projectile, used instead of Distance",
        Darker = true,
