        Visible = Projectiles.Enabled
    })

    local Methods: {string} = {"Angle", "Damage", "Distance"}
    for Index: string in Entity.Sorts do
        if not table.find(Methods, Index) then
            table.insert(Methods, Index)
        end
    end

    Sort = AimAssist:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Target mode",
        List = Methods,
        Default = "Angle"
    })
    AimPart = AimAssist:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Target area",
        List = {"Center", "Closest"},
        Default = "Center",
        Tooltip = "Center aims at the middle of the body, Closest aims at the body part nearest your mouse"
    })
    ShowAim = AimAssist:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Show aim direction",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if AimColor and AimColor.Object then
                AimColor.Object.Visible = Callback
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Draws an arrow around your cursor pointing where third person aiming is turning your character"
    })
    AimColor = AimAssist:CreateColorSlider({
        Name = "Aim direction color",
        DefaultHue = 0.44,
        DefaultSat = 1,
        DefaultValue = 1,
        DefaultOpacity = 1,
        Darker = true,
        Visible = false
    })
end)()

BundledModules.AutoClicker = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services
    local LocalPlayer: Player = Services.Players.LocalPlayer

    local AutoClicker
    local BlockCPS, BuyCPS, BuyDelay, SwingCPS
    local Sword, Block, Shop, Blacklist, Wool

    local Thread: thread?
    local Inputs = {Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1, Enum.KeyCode.ButtonR2}
    local function Click(Type: string?)
        if Data.Controllers.AppController:isLayerOpen(Data.Instances.Layers.MAIN) then
            return
        end

        if Sword.Enabled and (Type or "sword") == "sword" and not Data.Storage.Triggering then
            local Controller: any = Data.Controllers.SwordController
            if Data.Storage.Hand.Type == "sword" then
                if Controller.disableSwingState then
                    return
                end

                if Services.UserInputService.TouchEnabled then
                    Controller:mobileSwingPressed()
                else
                    Controller:swingSwordAtMouse()
                end
            elseif Data.Storage.Hand.Tool and Data.Controllers.KaidaUtil.summoner_isItemClaw(Data.Storage.Hand.Tool.Name) then
                Data.Controllers.SummonerClawHandController:attack(Data.Storage.Hand.Tool.Name)
            end
        end

        if Block.Enabled and Data.Storage.Hand.Type == "block" and (Type or "block") == "block" then
            local Placer = Data.Controllers.BlockPlacementController.blockPlacer
            if Placer and (workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - Data.Controllers.BlockCpsController.lastPlaceTimestamp) >= ((1 / 12) * 0.5) then
                if Services.UserInputService.TouchEnabled then
                    task.spawn(Placer.autoBridge, Placer, workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - Data.Controllers.KnockbackController:getLastKnockbackTime() >= 0.2)
                else
                    local Mouse = Placer.clientManager:getBlockSelector():getMouseInfo(0)
                    if Mouse then
                        task.spawn(Placer.placeBlock, Placer, Mouse.placementPosition)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local function AutoClick(Type: string?)
        return task.spawn(function()
            local Elapsed: number = 0
            local Interval: number = 1 / ((Type or Data.Storage.Hand.Type) == "block" and BlockCPS or SwingCPS):GetRandomValue()
            repeat
                Elapsed += Services.RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
                local Swinging: boolean = (Type or Data.Storage.Hand.Type) ~= "block"
                local Ready: boolean = if Swinging then tick() - Data.Controllers.SwordController.lastSwing >= math.max(Interval, 1 / 9 + 0.001) else Elapsed >= Interval
                if Ready then
                    Elapsed = 0
                    Interval = 1 / ((Type or Data.Storage.Hand.Type) == "block" and BlockCPS or SwingCPS):GetRandomValue()
                    Click(Type)
                end
            until not AutoClicker.Enabled
        end)
    end

    AutoClicker = Cat.Categories.Combat:CreateModule({
        Name = "AutoClicker",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback then
                AutoClicker:Clean(Services.UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(Input: InputObject)
                    if not (table.find(Inputs, Input.UserInputType) or table.find(Inputs, Input.KeyCode)) then
                        return
                    end

                    if Thread then
                        pcall(task.cancel, Thread)
                    end
                    Thread = AutoClick()
                end))
                AutoClicker:Clean(Services.UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(Input: InputObject)
                    if Thread and (table.find(Inputs, Input.UserInputType) or table.find(Inputs, Input.KeyCode)) then
                        pcall(task.cancel, Thread)
                        Thread = nil
                    end
                end))

                if Services.UserInputService.TouchEnabled then
                    local Mobile: thread? = nil
                    local Hooked: {[Instance]: boolean} = {}
                    local function Stop()
                        if Mobile then
                            pcall(task.cancel, Mobile)
                            Mobile = nil
                        end
                    end
                    local function Hook(Button: Instance)
                        if Hooked[Button] or not Button:IsA("GuiButton") or not tonumber(Button.Name) then
                            return
                        end

                        Hooked[Button] = true
                        AutoClicker:Clean(Button.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
                            Stop()
                            Mobile = AutoClick()
                        end))
                        AutoClicker:Clean(Button.MouseButton1Up:Connect(Stop))
                    end
                    local function Watch(MobileUI: Instance)
                        if MobileUI.Name ~= "MobileUI" then
                            return
                        end

                        for _, v: Instance in MobileUI:GetChildren() do
                            Hook(v)
                        end
                        AutoClicker:Clean(MobileUI.ChildAdded:Connect(Hook))
                    end

                    AutoClicker:Clean(Stop)
                    for _, v: Instance in LocalPlayer.PlayerGui:GetChildren() do
                        Watch(v)
                    end
                    AutoClicker:Clean(LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.ChildAdded:Connect(Watch))
                end

                local Start: number?
                repeat
                    if Shop.Enabled and (Thread or Services.UserInputService.TouchEnabled) and Data.Controllers.AppController:isAppOpen("BedwarsItemShopApp") then
                        if not Start then
                            Start = os.clock()
                        end

                        local Position: Vector2 = (Services.UserInputService:GetMouseLocation() - Services.GuiService:GetGuiInset())
                        local ShopItems: {GuiObject} = LocalPlayer.PlayerGui:GetGuiObjectsAtPosition(Position.X, Position.Y)

                        if #ShopItems > 0 and (os.clock() - (Start or 0)) >= BuyDelay.Value then
                            local Found: boolean?
                            for _, v in ShopItems do
                                if v.Name:sub(-12) == "ShopItemCard" and not table.find(Blacklist.ListEnabled, ({v.Name:gsub("_ShopItemCard", "")})[1]:find("wool") and "wool" or ({v.Name:gsub("_ShopItemCard", "")})[1]) then
                                    Found = true

                                    firesignal(v.Activated)
                                    task.wait(1 / BuyCPS:GetRandomValue())

                                    break
                                end
                            end

                            if not Found then
                                Start = nil
                            end
                        end
                    elseif Start then
                        Start = nil
                    end
                    task.wait()
                until not AutoClicker.Enabled
            elseif Thread then
                pcall(task.cancel, Thread)
                Thread = nil
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Repeats clicks automatically while holding ".. (Services.UserInputService.TouchEnabled and "your finger down" or "left click")
    })

    Sword = AutoClicker:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Swing Sword",
        Default = true,
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if SwingCPS and SwingCPS.Object then
                SwingCPS.Object.Visible = Callback
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Swings your sword while\nholding ".. (Services.UserInputService.TouchEnabled and "your finger down" or "left click").. " with AutoClicker"
    })
    SwingCPS = AutoClicker:CreateTwoSlider({
        Name = "Swing CPS",
        Tooltip = "Clicks per second when swinging a sword",
        Min = 1,
        Max = 20,
        DefaultMin = 20,
        DefaultMax = 20,
        Darker = true
    })
    Shop = AutoClicker:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Shop Clicker",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if BuyCPS and BuyCPS.Object then
                BuyCPS.Object.Visible = Callback
            end

            if BuyDelay and BuyDelay.Object then
                BuyDelay.Object.Visible = Callback
            end

            if Blacklist and Blacklist.Object then
                Blacklist.Object.Visible = Callback
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "When enabled, AutoClicker will work whenever you hold click on a shop item"
    })
    Blacklist = AutoClicker:CreateTextList({
        Name = "Blacklist",
        Tooltip = "items blacklisted",
        Darker = true,
        Visible = Shop.Enabled
    })
    BuyDelay = AutoClicker:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Delay",
        Tooltip = "How long it'll take to start AutoClicking",
        Min = 0,
        Max = 2,
        Default = 0.05,
        Decimal = 100,
        Suffix = "seconds",
        Darker = true,
        Visible = Shop.Enabled
    })
    BuyCPS = AutoClicker:CreateTwoSlider({
        Name = "Buy CPS",
        Tooltip = "Clicks per second when buying a shop item",
        Min = 1,
        Max = 40,
        DefaultMin = 20,
        DefaultMax = 40,
        Darker = true,
        Visible = Shop.Enabled
    })
    Block = AutoClicker:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Place Blocks",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if BlockCPS and BlockCPS.Object then
                BlockCPS.Object.Visible = Callback
            end

            if Wool and Wool.Object then
                Wool.Object.Visible = Callback
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "When enabled, AutoClicker will work with blocks"
    })
    Wool = AutoClicker:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Wool only",
        Tooltip = "Places blocks only while holding a wool block",
        Darker = true,
        Visible = Block.Enabled
    })
    BlockCPS = AutoClicker:CreateTwoSlider({
        Name = "Place CPS",
        Tooltip = "Clicks per second when placing blocks",
        Min = 1,
        Max = 20,
        DefaultMin = 20,
        DefaultMax = 20,
        Darker = true,
        Visible = Block.Enabled
    })
end)()

BundledModules.HitregAdjuster = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services
    local LocalPlayer: Player = Services.Players.LocalPlayer

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity
    local Hitregs = BundledModules.Hitreg
    local Constants = Hitregs.Constants

    local HitregAdjuster
    local Hitreg

    local Hold: number = 0
    local Anchor: AnchorState = Hitregs.Shared

    HitregAdjuster = Cat.Categories.Combat:CreateModule({
        Name = "HitregAdjuster",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback then
                local Sword: any = Data.Controllers.SwordController
                local SwordSpeed: number = Constants.Stock
                local LastSwing, Gap = 0, Constants.Stock

                local Shorten: any = Data.Instances.SyncEvents.SwordSwing:setPriority(150):connect(function(Event: any)
                    SwordSpeed = Event.attackSpeed
                    local Fury: number = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:GetAttribute("StatusEffect_fury_potion") and 1 - (Data.Instances.BlackMarketeerBalance.FURY_POTION_ATTACK_SPEED_MULTIPLIER - 1) or 1
                    local Base: number = SwordSpeed / Fury
                    local Meta: any = Data.Instances.Items[Event.swordType]
                    local MetaSpeed: number? = Meta and Meta.sword and Meta.sword.attackSpeed
                    if MetaSpeed and math.abs(Base - MetaSpeed) < 0.000001 then
                        Base = MetaSpeed
                    end

                    Anchor.Stride = math.max(math.ceil((Base * Fury - Constants.Tolerance) * 60 - 0.001), 1)
                    if Hitreg.Value >= 35 then
                        Event.attackSpeed = Constants.Lock.Floor * Fury
                        Gap = Event.attackSpeed

                        return
                    end

                    local Stock: boolean = Base == Constants.Stock
                    local Mode: {Spacing: number, Floor: number} = Hitreg.Value >= 35 and Constants.High or Constants.Safe
                    local Spacing: number = Stock and Mode.Spacing or Constants.Weapons[Base] or Base + Constants.Margin
                    if Hitreg.Value ~= 35 then
                        Spacing = math.max(Spacing, 10 / math.max(Hitreg.Value - 1, 1))
                    end
                    Spacing = math.max(Spacing * Fury, Constants.Budget)

                    Event.attackSpeed = math.max(Spacing, math.max(Base * Fury - Constants.Correction, 0))
                    Gap = Event.attackSpeed
                end)
                local Restore: any = Data.Instances.SyncEvents.SwordSwing:setPriority(300):connect(function(Event: any)
                    Event.attackSpeed = SwordSpeed
                end)
                local Stamp: any = Data.Instances.SyncEvents.SwordSwing:setPriority(500):connect(function(Event: any)
                    if not Event:isCancelled() then
                        LastSwing = os.clock()
                    end
                end)

                local Old: (...any) -> ...any = Sword.sendServerRequest
                local Trail: TrailState = Hitregs.Trail.new()
                local Pending: {any}? = nil
                local function Ready(): (boolean, number)
                    local Now: number = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
                    local Due: number = Anchor:Due(Now, os.clock())
                    if Hitreg.Value < 35 and Anchor.Stamp ~= 0 and not Anchor.Pending then
                        Due = math.max(Due, Anchor.Stamp + 10 / Hitreg.Value - Now)
                    end

                    return Anchor:Spin(Due) <= 0, Due
                end
                local function Send(Args: {any}, Due: number): boolean
                    local Target: any = Args[2]
                    local Victim: Model? = Target and Target.getInstance and Target:getInstance()
                    local Part: BasePart? = Victim and Victim.PrimaryPart
                    local Hand: any = Sword:getHandItem()
                    local Tool: Tool? = Hand and Hand.tool
                    local Meta: any = Tool and Data.Instances.Items[Tool.Name]
                    if not Part or not Tool or not Meta or not Meta.sword or not Entity.Alive or Sword.disableSwingState then
                        return false
                    end

                    local Root: BasePart = Entity.RootPart
                    local Clock: number = os.clock()
                    local Reach: number = Meta.sword.attackRange or Data.Instances.CombatConstant.RAYCAST_SWORD_CHARACTER_DISTANCE
                    local Low, High = Trail:At(Clock - 0.07, Root.Position), Trail:At(Clock - 0.11, Root.Position)
                    local Drift: Vector3 = Part.AssemblyLinearVelocity * 0.12
                    local Behind: Vector3 = Part.Position - (Drift.Magnitude > 8 and Drift.Unit * 8 or Drift)
                    local Distance: number = math.max((Part.Position - Low).Magnitude, (Part.Position - High).Magnitude, (Behind - Low).Magnitude, (Behind - High).Magnitude)
                    if Distance > Reach + 3.4 then
                        return false
                    end

                    Anchor:Mark(Due, workspace:GetServerTimeNow(), os.clock())
                    Old(table.unpack(Args, 1, Args.n))

                    return true
                end
                local function Hook(...: any): ...any
                    local Open: boolean, Due: number = Ready()
                    if Open then
                        Pending = nil
                        Send(table.pack(...), Due)

                        return nil
                    end

                    local Waiting: boolean = Pending ~= nil
                    Pending = table.pack(...)
                    if not Waiting then
                        task.spawn(function()
                            repeat
                                Services.RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
                                Open, Due = Ready()
                            until Open or not Pending or not HitregAdjuster.Enabled

                            local Args: {any}? = Pending
                            Pending = nil
                            if Args and HitregAdjuster.Enabled then
                                Send(Args, Due)
                            end
                        end)
                    end

                    return nil
                end
                Sword.sendServerRequest = Hook

                HitregAdjuster:Clean(Services.RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(Delta: number)
                    Anchor.Frame = math.min(Delta * 2, math.max(Delta, 0.01))
                    if Entity.Alive then
                        Trail:Track(Entity.RootPart.Position, os.clock())
                    end
                end))
                HitregAdjuster:Clean(Data.Events.EntityDamageEvent:Connect(function(Event: {entityInstance: Model?, damageType: number, fromEntity: Model?})
                    if Event.fromEntity ~= LocalPlayer.Character or Event.damageType ~= 0 or not Event.entityInstance then
                        return
                    end

                    Anchor:Hear(Event.entityInstance)
                end))

                local Touch: boolean = Services.UserInputService.TouchEnabled
                local OldHold: boolean = Sword:isHoldAutoSwingDisabled()
                if not Touch then
                    Sword:disableHoldAutoSwing()
                end
                HitregAdjuster:Clean(Services.UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(Input: InputObject)
                    if Touch or Input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1 or Input.KeyCode ~= Enum.KeyCode.ButtonR2 then
                        return
                    end

                    Hold += 1
                    local Current: number = Hold
                    task.spawn(function()
                        repeat
                            if os.clock() - LastSwing >= Gap and Data.Storage.Hand.Type == "sword" and not Sword.disableSwingState then
                                Sword:swingSwordAtMouse()
                            end
                            Services.RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
                        until Hold ~= Current or not Services.UserInputService:IsGamepadButtonDown(Input.UserInputType, Input.KeyCode)
                    end)
                end))

                HitregAdjuster:Clean(function()
                    if Sword.sendServerRequest == Hook then
                        Sword.sendServerRequest = Old
                    end
                    Pending = nil
                    Shorten:Destroy()
                    Restore:Destroy()
                    Stamp:Destroy()
                    Hold += 1
                    if not OldHold and not Touch then
                        Sword:enableHoldAutoSwing()
                    end
                end)
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Swaps the games attack cooldown for a hit count of your own"
    })

    Hitreg = HitregAdjuster:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Hitreg",
        Min = 1,
        Max = 36,
        Default = 35,
        Suffix = function(Value: number): string
            return Value == 1 and "hit / 10s" or "hits / 10s"
        end,
        Tooltip = "35 and 36 time every hit to the server hit window like Killaura, lower values space your hits out (fury potion still speeds it up)"
    })
end)()

BundledModules.Reach = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Reach
    local AttackRange, BreakRange, PlaceRange

    local Original
    local Default: number = Data.Instances.CombatConstant.RAYCAST_SWORD_CHARACTER_DISTANCE

    local function Shift(Remote: any, Attack: any, ...: any): ...any
        local Validate: any = type(Attack) == "table" and Attack.validate
        local From: any = Validate and Validate.selfPosition and Validate.selfPosition.value
        local To: any = Validate and Validate.targetPosition and Validate.targetPosition.value
        if typeof(From) == "Vector3" and typeof(To) == "Vector3" then
            local Meta: any = Attack.weapon and Data.Instances.Items[Attack.weapon.Name]
            local Range: number = Meta and Meta.sword and Meta.sword.attackRange or Default
            local Delta: Vector3 = To - From
            if Delta.Magnitude > 0.001 then
                Validate.selfPosition.value = From + Delta.Unit * math.max(Delta.Magnitude - (Range - 0.001), 0)
            end
        end

        return Remote:SendToServer(Attack, ...)
    end

    Reach = Cat.Categories.Combat:CreateModule({
        Name = "Reach",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            Data.Instances.CombatConstant.RAYCAST_SWORD_CHARACTER_DISTANCE = Callback and AttackRange.Value or 14.4

            if Callback then
                Data.Storage.RemoteHooks.SwordHit = Shift

                Original = Data.Controllers.BlockSelector.getMouseInfo
                Data.Controllers.BlockSelector.getMouseInfo = function(self, Mode: number, Arguments: {[any]: any})
                    Arguments = Arguments or {}
                    Arguments.range = Mode == 0 and PlaceRange.Value or Mode == 1 and BreakRange.Value or Arguments.range

                    return Original(self, Mode, Arguments)
                end
            else
                if Data.Storage.RemoteHooks.SwordHit == Shift then
                    Data.Storage.RemoteHooks.SwordHit = nil
                end
                if Original then
                    Data.Controllers.BlockSelector.getMouseInfo = Original
                    Original = nil
                end
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Allows you to attack, break and place further"
    })

    AttackRange = Reach:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Attack Range",
        Min = 1,
        Max = math.floor(Data.Instances.CombatConstant.RAYCAST_SWORD_CHARACTER_DISTANCE * 1.4),
        Default = Data.Instances.CombatConstant.RAYCAST_SWORD_CHARACTER_DISTANCE,
        Decimal = 10,
        Suffix = function(Value: number): string
            return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
        end
    })
    BreakRange = Reach:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Break Range",
        Min = 1,
        Max = 18,
        Default = Data.Controllers.BlockBreakUtil.DEFAULT_BREAK_RANGE,
        Decimal = 10,
        Suffix = function(Value: number): string
            return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
        end
    })

    PlaceRange = Reach:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Place Range",
        Min = 1,
        Max = 60,
        Default = 24,
        Suffix = function(Value: number): string
            return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
        end
    })
    Reach:CreateButton({
        Name = "Sync to legit range",
        Function = function()
            AttackRange:SetValue(14.4)
            BreakRange:SetValue(18)
            PlaceRange:SetValue(18)
        end,
        Tooltip = "Sets every range to what the game allows normally: 14.4 attack, 18 break, 18 place"
    })
end)()

BundledModules.SilentAura = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services
    local LocalPlayer: Player = Services.Players.LocalPlayer

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity
    local Hitreg = BundledModules.Hitreg
    local AimArrow = BundledModules.AimArrow

    local SilentAura
    local Targets, Mode, Area
    local Speed, SwingTime, Range, Angle, AirHits
    local Perfect, Mouse, Dynamic, LegitAura, SilentAim, Limit
    local Show, TargetColor, AttackColor, ShowAim, AimColor

    local Original: ((...any) -> ...any)?
    local Generator: Random = Random.new()
    local Lock: LockState = Hitreg.Lock.new()
    local Parts: {[Model]: {Instance}} = {}
    local LastEffect: number, LastAttack: number, LastSwing: number, TinkerSwing: number = 0, 0, 0, 0
    local Session: number = 0

    local Box: BoxHandleAdornment = Instance.new("BoxHandleAdornment")
    Box.AlwaysOnTop = true
    Box.Size = Vector3.new(2.5, 6, 2.5)
    Box.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, -0.5, 0)
    Box.ZIndex = 0
    Box.Parent = Cat.Ui.Gui
    Cat:Clean(Box)

    SilentAura = Cat.Categories.Combat:CreateModule({
        Name = "SilentAura",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback then
                Session += 1

                local Current: number = Session

                Original = Data.Controllers.SwordController.playSwordEffect
                Data.Controllers.SwordController.playSwordEffect = function(self, Meta: any, Charged: boolean, Config: any)
                    if not SilentAura.Enabled or (Config and Config.playAnimation == false) then
                        return (Original :: (...any) -> ...any)(self, Meta, Charged, Config)
                    end
                    if (tick() - LastAttack < 0.4 or tick() - LastSwing < 0.4) and tick() - LastEffect < (Perfect.Enabled and 0.11 or math.max(SwingTime.Value, 0.11)) then
                        return
                    end

                    LastEffect = tick()

                    return (Original :: (...any) -> ...any)(self, Meta, Charged, Config)
                end

                local LastTarget: Target?
                local LastFound: number, FoundAt: number, LastAttacked: number = 0, tick(), tick()
                local Arrow: any = AimArrow.new()
                SilentAura:Clean(function()
                    Arrow:Destroy()
                end)
                SilentAura:Clean(Services.RunService.PostSimulation:Connect(function(DeltaTime: number)
                    local Aiming: boolean = false
                    if Entity.Alive then
                        if LastTarget and LastTarget.Character and LastTarget.RootPart and LastTarget.RootPart.Parent and tick() - LastFound < 0.5 then
                            Cat.TargetInfo.Targets[LastTarget] = tick() + 0.5
                            Entity.Humanoid.AutoRotate = not SilentAim.Enabled

                            local Time: number = math.min((tick() - FoundAt) / (1 / (Speed.Value * 0.5)), 1)
                            local AimSpeed: number = Speed.Value * (Time < 0.5 and 4 * Time * Time * Time or 1 - math.pow(-2 * Time + 2, 3) / 2)
                            if SilentAim.Enabled then
                                local Direction: Vector3 = Vector3.new(LastTarget.RootPart.Position.X - Entity.RootPart.Position.X, 0, LastTarget.RootPart.Position.Z - Entity.RootPart.Position.Z)
                                if Direction.Magnitude > 0 then
                                    Entity.RootPart.CFrame = Entity.RootPart.CFrame:Lerp(CFrame.lookAlong(Entity.RootPart.Position, Direction), math.clamp((AimSpeed + 2) * DeltaTime, 0, 1))
                                end
                                Aiming = ShowAim.Enabled
                            else
                                local Camera: Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
                                local Point: Vector3 = LastTarget.RootPart.Position
                                if Area.Value == "Closest" then
                                    if not Parts[LastTarget.Character] then
                                        table.clear(Parts)
                                        Parts[LastTarget.Character] = LastTarget.Character:GetChildren()
                                    end

                                    local Closest: number = math.huge
                                    for _, v: Instance in Parts[LastTarget.Character] do
                                        if not v.Parent or not v:IsA("BasePart") then
                                            continue
                                        end

                                        local Screen: Vector3, Visible: boolean = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(v.Position)
                                        local Gap: number = (Services.UserInputService:GetMouseLocation() - Vector2.new(Screen.X, Screen.Y)).Magnitude
                                        if Visible and Gap < Closest then
                                            Closest, Point = Gap, v.Position
                                        end
                                    end
                                end

                                local Jitter: Vector3 = Vector3.new(Generator:NextNumber() - 0.5, Generator:NextNumber() - 0.5, Generator:NextNumber() - 0.5) * 15 * DeltaTime
                                Camera.CFrame = Camera.CFrame:Lerp(CFrame.lookAt(Camera.CFrame.Position, Point + Jitter), AimSpeed * DeltaTime)
                            end
                        else
                            Entity.Humanoid.AutoRotate = true
                        end
                    end
                    Arrow:Update(Aiming and Entity.RootPart.Position + Entity.RootPart.CFrame.LookVector * 50 or nil, Color3.fromHSV(AimColor.Hue, AimColor.Sat, AimColor.Value), 1 - AimColor.Opacity)
                end))

                Lock:Reset()
                SilentAura:Clean(Services.RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(Delta: number)
                    Lock.Frame = Delta
                end))
                SilentAura:Clean(Data.Events.EntityDamageEvent:Connect(function(Event: {entityInstance: Model?, damageType: number, fromEntity: Model?})
                    if Event.fromEntity ~= LocalPlayer.Character or Event.damageType ~= 0 or not Event.entityInstance then
                        return
                    end

                    local Stamp: any = Event.entityInstance:GetAttribute("LastDamageTakenTime")
                    if type(Stamp) == "number" then
                        Lock:Learn(Stamp)
                    end
                end))

                local Cooldown: number, LastHit: number = 0, 0
                local Swung: number?
                repeat
                    task.wait()
                    if SilentAura.Enabled and Session == Current then
                        local Swing: number = tick() - Data.Controllers.SwordController.lastSwing
                        local Sword: InventoryItem? = nil
                        if Entity.Alive and not (Mouse.Enabled and not Services.UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) and (Data.Controllers.SwordController.lastSwing == Swung or Swing > 0.3)) and not (LegitAura.Enabled and Swing > 0.3) and (Entity.Character:GetAttribute("StunnedUntilTime") or 0) - workspace:GetServerTimeNow() <= 0 and not Data.Controllers.AppController:isLayerOpen(Data.Instances.Layers.MAIN) then
                            Sword = Limit.Enabled and Data.Storage.Inventory.inventory.hand or Data.Storage.Tools.Sword
                            if Sword and (not Sword.tool or (Limit.Enabled and (Data.Storage.Hand.Type ~= "sword" or Data.Controllers.DaoController.chargingMaid))) then
                                Sword = nil
                            end
                        end

                        if Sword then
                            local Meta: any = Data.Instances.Items[Sword.tool.Name]
                            local LocalPosition: Vector3 = Entity.RootPart.Position
                            local Target: Target? = Entity.Targets({
                                Origin = LocalPosition,
                                Range = Data.Instances.CombatConstant.RAYCAST_SWORD_CHARACTER_DISTANCE + Range.Value,
                                Players = Targets.Players.Enabled,
                                NPCs = Targets.NPCs.Enabled,
                                Invisible = Targets.Invisible.Enabled,
                                Wallcheck = Targets.Walls.Enabled,
                                Priority = Targets.Priority.Value,
                                Sort = Mode.Value
                            })[1]

                            local Color: any = tick() - LastAttacked < 0.1 and AttackColor or TargetColor
                            Box.Adornee = Show.Enabled and Target and Target.RootPart or nil
                            Box.Transparency = 1 - Color.Opacity
                            Box.Color3 = Color3.fromHSV(Color.Hue, Color.Sat, Color.Value)

                            if Target and Data.Storage.Hand.Tool ~= Sword.tool then
                                for Index: number, v: any in (Data.Storage.Inventory.hotbar or {}) do
                                    if v.item and v.item.tool == Sword.tool and Data.Storage.Inventory.hotbarSlot ~= Index - 1 then
                                        Data.Controllers.Store:dispatch({
                                            type = "InventorySelectHotbarSlot",
                                            slot = Index - 1
                                        })

                                        break
                                    end
                                end
                            elseif Target then
                                local Facing: Vector3 = ((Services.UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled and workspace.CurrentCamera or Entity.RootPart) :: any).CFrame.LookVector * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
                                local Delta: Vector3 = Target.RootPart.Position - LocalPosition
                                local Flat: Vector3 = Delta * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
                                local Dot: number = Flat.Magnitude > 0 and Facing.Magnitude > 0 and Facing.Unit:Dot(Flat.Unit) or 0
                                if Dot >= math.cos(math.rad(Angle.Value) / 2) then
                                    if not LegitAura.Enabled and tick() - Data.Controllers.SwordController.lastSwing >= (Perfect.Enabled and (Meta.sword.attackSpeed or 0.11) or math.max(SwingTime.Value, 0.11)) then
                                        Swung = tick()
                                        LastSwing = Swung :: number

                                        local Mount: any = Data.Controllers.TinkerKitController and Data.Controllers.TinkerKitController.userMap and Data.Controllers.TinkerKitController.userMap[LocalPlayer]
                                        if typeof(Mount) ~= "Instance" or not Mount.Parent then
                                            Mount = nil
                                            for _, v: Instance in Entity.Character:GetChildren() do
                                                if v:IsA("Model") and v.Name:match("tinker$") then
                                                    Mount = v

                                                    break
                                                end
                                            end
                                        end

                                        if Mount then
                                            if tick() >= TinkerSwing + 0.35 then
                                                TinkerSwing = tick()
                                                Data.Controllers.AudioManager:playAudio(Data.Instances.Sounds.DRILL_ATTACK_1)
                                                Data.Controllers.MountAnimationController:playAnimationInMount(Mount, Data.Instances.Animations.TINKER_ATTACK, 1.85)
                                            end
                                        else
                                            Data.Controllers.SwordController:playSwordEffect(Meta, false, {itemSkin = Sword.itemSkin})
                                        end

                                        Data.Controllers.SwordController.lastSwing = Swung
                                    end

                                    if LastTarget ~= Target or Dot < -0.5 then
                                        FoundAt = tick()
                                    end

                                    LastTarget, LastFound = Target, tick()
                                    if Delta.Magnitude <= Data.Instances.CombatConstant.RAYCAST_SWORD_CHARACTER_DISTANCE then
                                        LastAttacked = tick()

                                        local SwordSpeed: number = Hitreg.Constants.Fixed[Sword.tool.Name] or Meta and Meta.sword and Meta.sword.attackSpeed or Hitreg.Constants.Stock
                                        local Fury: number = Entity.Character:GetAttribute("StatusEffect_fury_potion") and 1 - (Data.Instances.BlackMarketeerBalance.FURY_POTION_ATTACK_SPEED_MULTIPLIER - 1) or 1
                                        local Reach: number = Meta and Meta.sword and Meta.sword.attackRange or Data.Instances.CombatConstant.RAYCAST_SWORD_CHARACTER_DISTANCE
                                        local Spacing: number, Floor: number, Stock: boolean = Hitreg.Spacing(SwordSpeed, Fury, Dynamic.Enabled)
                                        local Delay: number = Hitreg.Delay.Base(Hitreg.Constants.Budget, Spacing, Data.Controllers.SwordController.lastAttack, SwordSpeed, Fury, workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
                                        if Dynamic.Enabled then
                                            Delay = Hitreg.Delay.Reach(Delay, Floor, Delta.Magnitude, Reach)
                                        end

                                        local Locked: boolean = Stock and Dynamic.Enabled and LocalPlayer:GetNetworkPing() < Hitreg.Constants.Lock.Ping
                                        local Ready: boolean = tick() >= Cooldown + Delay and tick() - LastHit >= Floor
                                        if Locked then
                                            Ready = Lock:Spin(Lock:Remaining(LastHit, tick(), os.clock())) <= 0
                                        end

                                        if Ready then
                                            local Airborne: boolean = (Target.Humanoid and Target.Humanoid.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air) or math.abs(Target.RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y) > 0.01
                                            local Direction: Vector3 = CFrame.lookAt(LocalPosition, Target.RootPart.Position).LookVector
                                            Data.Controllers.SwordController.lastAttack = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
                                            LastAttack = tick()
                                            Cooldown = math.max(Cooldown + Delay, tick())
                                            LastHit = tick()

                                            if not Airborne or Generator:NextNumber(0, 100) <= AirHits:GetRandomValue() then
                                                if Locked then
                                                    Lock:Record(os.clock(), workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
                                                end

                                                Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("SwordHit"):SendToServer({
                                                    weapon = Sword.tool,
                                                    chargedAttack = {chargeRatio = 0},
                                                    entityInstance = Target.Character,
                                                    validate = {
                                                        raycast = {
                                                            cameraPosition = {value = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position},
                                                            cursorDirection = {value = Direction}
                                                        },
                                                        targetPosition = {value = (Target.Character :: Model):GetPivot().Position},
                                                        selfPosition = {value = LocalPosition + Direction * math.max(Delta.Magnitude - (Reach - 0.001), 0)}
                                                    }
                                                })
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            else
                                LastFound = 0
                            end
                        else
                            Box.Adornee = nil
                            LastFound = 0
                        end
                    end
                until not SilentAura.Enabled or Session ~= Current
            else
                if Original then
                    Data.Controllers.SwordController.playSwordEffect = Original
                    Original = nil
                end

                LastEffect, LastAttack, LastSwing = 0, 0, 0
                table.clear(Parts)
                Box.Adornee = nil
                if Entity.Alive then
                    Entity.Humanoid.AutoRotate = true
                end
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Automatically aims and attacks nearby target"
    })

    Targets = SilentAura:CreateTargets({
        Players = true,
        NPCs = true
    })
    Speed = SilentAura:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Aim speed",
        Min = 1,
        Max = 10,
        Default = 6,
        Decimal = 5,
        Tooltip = "How fast the Aura is going to aim"
    })
    SwingTime = SilentAura:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Swing time",
        Min = 0,
        Max = 0.5,
        Default = 0.42,
        Decimal = 100,
        Darker = true,
        Visible = false
    })
    Range = SilentAura:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Extra swing distance",
        Min = 0,
        Max = 6,
        Default = 3,
        Decimal = 5,
        Suffix = function(Value: number)
            return Value <= 1 and "stud" or "studs"
        end,
        Tooltip = "Where you will start swinging, not attacking"

    Angle = SilentAura:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Max angle",
        Min = 1,
        Max = 360,
        Default = 180
    })
    AirHits = SilentAura:CreateTwoSlider({
        Name = "Air hit chance",
        Min = 0,

        DefaultMin = 100,

        Tooltip = "Chance to land a hit while the target is off the ground, rolled fresh between the two values on every swing"

    local Methods: {string} = {"Health", "Damage", "Distance"}
    for Index: string in Entity.Sorts do

        end
    end

    Mode = SilentAura:CreateDropdown({

    })
    Area = SilentAura:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Target area",
        List = {"Center", "Closest"},
        Default = "Center",
        Tooltip = "Where the Aura will aim towards",
        Visible = false
    })
    Perfect = SilentAura:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Perfect Swing",
        Default = true,
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if SwingTime and SwingTime.Object then
                SwingTime.Object.Visible = not Callback
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Follows sword item's swing time"
    })
    Mouse = SilentAura:CreateToggle({Name = "Require mouse down"})
    Dynamic = SilentAura:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Dynamic hits",
        Default = true,
        Tooltip = "Syncs your hits to the server tick for 36 hits every 10 seconds instead of a safe 34"
