BundledModules.Sprint = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity

    local Sprint
    local Original: ((...any) -> ...any)?
    local Hook: ((...any) -> ...any)?

    Sprint = Cat.Categories.Combat:CreateModule({
        Name = "Sprint",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            local Controller: any = Data.Controllers.SprintController
            if not Callback then
                if Hook and Controller.stopSprinting == Hook then
                    Controller.stopSprinting = Original
                end
                Original, Hook = nil, nil
                Controller:stopSprinting()

                return
            end

            Original = Controller.stopSprinting
            Hook = function(...: any): ...any
                local Call: any = (Original :: (...any) -> ...any)(...)
                Controller:startSprinting()

                return Call
            end
            Controller.stopSprinting = Hook

            repeat
                if Entity.Alive and not Controller.sprinting then
                    Controller:startSprinting()
                end

                task.wait(0.25)
            until not Sprint.Enabled
        end,
        Tooltip = "Keeps you sprinting all the time, also after you respawn"
    })
end)()

BundledModules.TriggerBot = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services
    local LocalPlayer: Player = Services.Players.LocalPlayer

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity

    local TriggerBot
    local Targets, CPS, Extra, Delay, Mouse, FirstHit

    local Session: number = 0
    local Aggressors: {[Model]: boolean} = {}

    TriggerBot = Cat.Categories.Combat:CreateModule({
        Name = "TriggerBot",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback then
                Session += 1

                local Current: number = Session
                TriggerBot:Clean(Data.Events.EntityDamageEvent:Connect(function(Event: {entityInstance: Model?, fromEntity: Model?})
                    if Event.entityInstance == LocalPlayer.Character and Event.fromEntity then
                        Aggressors[Event.fromEntity] = true
                    end
                end))
                TriggerBot:Clean(LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
                    table.clear(Aggressors)
                end))

                local Hovered: Target?, Since: number, Wait: number, Next: number = nil, 0, 0, 0
                repeat
                    task.wait()

                    local Target: Target? = nil
                    if Entity.Alive and Data.Storage.Hand.Type == "sword" and not Data.Controllers.SwordController.disableSwingState and not Data.Controllers.DaoController.chargingMaid and not Data.Controllers.AppController:isLayerOpen(Data.Instances.Layers.MAIN) and (not Mouse.Enabled or Services.UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)) then
                        local Meta: any = Data.Instances.Items[Data.Storage.Hand.Tool.Name]
                        local Reach: number = Meta and Meta.sword and Meta.sword.attackRange or Data.Instances.CombatConstant.RAYCAST_SWORD_CHARACTER_DISTANCE
                        local Look: Vector3 = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)

                        for _, v: Target in Entity.Targets({
                            Origin = Entity.RootPart.Position,
                            Range = Reach + Extra:GetRandomValue(),
                            Players = Targets.Players.Enabled,
                            NPCs = Targets.NPCs.Enabled,
                            Invisible = Targets.Invisible.Enabled,
                            Wallcheck = Targets.Walls.Enabled,
                            Priority = Targets.Priority.Value
                        }) do
                            local Flat: Vector3 = (v.RootPart.Position - Entity.RootPart.Position) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
                            local Facing: boolean = Flat.Magnitude < 0.01 or Look.Magnitude < 0.01 or Look.Unit:Dot(Flat.Unit) >= math.cos(math.rad(45))
                            if Facing and (not FirstHit.Enabled or Aggressors[v.Character :: Model]) then
                                Target = v

                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    Data.Storage.Triggering = Target ~= nil

                    if Target ~= Hovered then
                        Hovered, Since, Wait = Target, tick(), Delay:GetRandomValue() / 1000
                    end

                    if Target and tick() - Since >= Wait and tick() >= Next then
                        local Speed: number = Data.Instances.Items[Data.Storage.Hand.Tool.Name].sword.attackSpeed
                        local Remaining: number = Data.Controllers.SwordController:getRemainingSwingCooldown(Data.Storage.Hand.Tool.Name)
                        if Remaining <= 0 or Remaining * 1.01 >= math.min(Speed * Data.Instances.SwordsConstants.swordSwingBufferMultiplier, 0.2) then
                            Next = tick() + 1 / CPS:GetRandomValue()
                            if Services.UserInputService.TouchEnabled then
                                Data.Controllers.SwordController:mobileSwingPressed()
                            else
                                Data.Controllers.SwordController:swingSwordAtMouse()
                            end
                        end
                    end
                until not TriggerBot.Enabled or Session ~= Current
            else
                Data.Storage.Triggering = false
                table.clear(Aggressors)
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Swings your sword for you while a target is in front of you, within the 90 degrees a bedwars swing reaches"
    })

    Targets = TriggerBot:CreateTargets({
        Players = true,
        Walls = true
    })
    CPS = TriggerBot:CreateTwoSlider({
        Name = "CPS",
        Min = 1,
        Max = 12,
        DefaultMin = 8,
        DefaultMax = 10,
        Tooltip = "Clicks that would land right before your sword is ready wait for it instead, so the game never stacks a second swing on top"
    })
    Extra = TriggerBot:CreateTwoSlider({
        Name = "Extra Swing Range",
        Min = 0,
        Max = 10,
        DefaultMin = 2,
        DefaultMax = 3,
        Decimal = 10,
        Tooltip = "How many studs past your sword's reach it already starts swinging, hits still only land inside your reach"
    })
    Delay = TriggerBot:CreateTwoSlider({
        Name = "Mouse over delay",
        Min = 0,
        Max = 500,
        DefaultMin = 50,
        DefaultMax = 100,
        Darker = true,
        Tooltip = "How many milliseconds a target has to be in front of you before it starts attacking"
    })
    Mouse = TriggerBot:CreateToggle({Name = "Require mouse down"})
    FirstHit = TriggerBot:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Select first hit",
        Tooltip = "Waits for the opponent to hit you first before attacking them"
    })
end)()

BundledModules.Velocity = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity

    local Velocity
    local Chance, Horizontal, Vertical
    local Targeting, Targets

    local Original

    Velocity = Cat.Categories.Combat:CreateModule({
        Name = "Velocity",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback then
                Original = Data.Controllers.KnockbackUtil.applyKnockback
                Data.Controllers.KnockbackUtil.applyKnockback = function(...)
                    if Random.new():NextNumber(0, 100) > Chance:GetRandomValue() then
                        return Original(...)
                    end

                    local Arguments = {...}

                    if ((not Targeting.Enabled) or #Entity.Targets({
                        Range = 50,
                        Players = Targets.Players.Enabled,
                        NPCs = Targets.NPCs.Enabled,
                        Invisible = Targets.Invisible.Enabled,
                        Wallcheck = Targets.Walls.Enabled
                    }) > 0) and Arguments[4] then
                        if Horizontal.Value == 0 and Vertical.Value == 0 then
                            return
                        end

                        Arguments[4].horizontal = (Arguments[4].horizontal or 1) * (Horizontal.Value / 100)
                        Arguments[4].vertical = (Arguments[4].vertical or 1) * (Vertical.Value / 100)
                    end

                    return Original(unpack(Arguments))
                end
            elseif Original then
                Data.Controllers.KnockbackUtil.applyKnockback = Original
                Original = nil
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Reduces knockback taken"
    })

    Horizontal = Velocity:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Horizontal",
        Min = 0,
        Max = 100,
        Suffix = "%",
        Default = 0
    })
    Vertical = Velocity:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Vertical",
        Min = 0,
        Max = 100,
        Suffix = "%",
        Default = 0
    })
    Chance = Velocity:CreateTwoSlider({
        Name = "Chance",
        Min = 0,
        Max = 100,
        DefaultMin = 100,
        DefaultMax = 100,
        Tooltip = "Chance of the knockback reduction to take effect"
    })
    Targeting = Velocity:CreateToggle({Name = 'Only when targeting'})
    Targets = Velocity:CreateTargets({
        Players = true
    })
end)()

BundledModules.ArmorSwitch = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity
    local Inventory = BundledModules.Inventory

    local ArmorSwitch
    local Mode, Targets, Range

    local function SetArmor(Slot: number, Equip: boolean?)
        if Equip then
            local Best: InventoryItem?, Reduction: number = nil, 0
            for _, v: InventoryItem in (Data.Storage.Inventory.inventory.items or {}) do
                local Meta: any = Data.Instances.Items[v.itemType]
                if Meta and Meta.armor and Meta.armor.slot == Slot and (Meta.armor.damageReductionMultiplier or 0) > Reduction then
                    Best, Reduction = v, Meta.armor.damageReductionMultiplier or 0
                end
            end
            if Best then
                local Source: any = Inventory.Find(Best.tool)
                if Source and Source.container ~= "armor" then
                    Inventory.Move({operation = "quick_move", slot = {container = Source.container, index = Source.index}})
                end
            end
        else
            Inventory.Move({operation = "quick_move", slot = {container = "armor", index = Slot}})
        end
    end

    ArmorSwitch = Cat.Categories.Inventory:CreateModule({
        Name = "ArmorSwitch",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback then
                if Mode.Value ~= "Toggle" then
                    ArmorSwitch:Toggle()
                    for i: number = 0, 2 do
                        SetArmor(i, Data.Storage.Inventory.inventory.armor[i + 1] == "empty")
                    end

                    return
                end

                repeat
                    local State: boolean = #Entity.Targets({
                        Range = Range.Value,
                        Players = Targets.Players.Enabled,
                        NPCs = Targets.NPCs.Enabled,
                        Priority = Targets.Priority.Value,
                        Wallcheck = Targets.Walls.Enabled
                    }) > 0

                    for i: number = 0, 2 do
                        if (Data.Storage.Inventory.inventory.armor[i + 1] ~= "empty") ~= State and ArmorSwitch.Enabled then
                            SetArmor(i)
                        end
                    end
                    task.wait(0.1)
                until not ArmorSwitch.Enabled
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Puts on / takes off armor when toggled for baiting"
    })

    Mode = ArmorSwitch:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Mode",
        List = {"Toggle", "On Key"}
    })
    Targets = ArmorSwitch:CreateTargets({
        Players = true,
        NPCs = true
    })
    Range = ArmorSwitch:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Range",
        Min = 1,
        Max = 30,
        Default = 30,
        Suffix = function(Value: number)
            return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
        end
    })
end)()

BundledModules.AutoBuy = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services
    local LocalPlayer: Player = Services.Players.LocalPlayer

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity

    local Inventory = BundledModules.Inventory

    local AutoBuy
    local Sword, Armor, Upgrades, BedwarsCheck, GUI, SmartCheck, Item

    local Session: number = 0
    local ShopLoaded: boolean = false
    local ShopId: string? = nil
    local Queue: string = ""
    local Kits: {string} = {}
    local NPCTick: number = tick()
    local Count: number = 0
    local Custom: {[number]: BuyCallback} = {}
    local CustomPost: {[number]: BuyCallback} = {}
    local Functions: {[number]: BuyCallback} = {}
    local Callbacks: {{[number]: BuyCallback}} = {Custom, Functions, CustomPost}
    local UpgradeToggles: {Toggle} = {}

    local Swords: {string} = {
        "wood_sword",
        "stone_sword",
        "iron_sword",
        "diamond_sword",
        "emerald_sword"
    }

    local Daos: {string} = {
        "wood_dao",
        "stone_dao",
        "iron_dao",
        "diamond_dao",
        "emerald_dao"
    }

    local KitSwords: {[string]: string} = {
        ice_queen = "ice_sword",
        ember = "infernal_saber",
        lumen = "light_sword"
    }

    local BedwarsQueues: {string} = {
        "combined_kit_to4",
        "overpowered",
        "hyper_gen_to4",
        "all_random_kit_to4",
        "all_same_kit_to4"
    }

    local Armors: {string} = {
        "none",
        "leather_chestplate",
        "iron_chestplate",
        "diamond_chestplate",
        "emerald_chestplate"
    }

    local Axes: {string} = {
        "none",
        "wood_axe",
        "stone_axe",
        "iron_axe",
        "diamond_axe"
    }

    local Pickaxes: {string} = {
        "none",
        "wood_pickaxe",
        "stone_pickaxe",
        "iron_pickaxe",
        "diamond_pickaxe"
    }

    local function GetKits(): {string}
        local Result: {string} = {}
        local Attribute: any = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("PlayingAsKits")
        for _, v: string in string.split(`{Data.Storage.EquippedKit},{typeof(Attribute) == "string" and Attribute or ""}`, ",") do
            if v ~= "" and v ~= "none" and not table.find(Result, v) then
                table.insert(Result, v)
            end
        end

        return Result
    end

    local function HasKit(Wanted: {string}?): boolean
        if not Wanted then
            return false
        end

        for _, v: string in Kits do
            if table.find(Wanted, v) then
                return true
            end
        end

        return false
    end

    local function IsHidden(ShopItem: any): boolean
        if (not ShopItem.requiresKit or #ShopItem.requiresKit <= 0 or HasKit(ShopItem.requiresKit)) and (not ShopItem.ignoreAttribute or ShopItem.ignoreAttribute == "" or not LocalPlayer:GetAttribute(ShopItem.ignoreAttribute)) and (not ShopItem.requireAttribute or ShopItem.requireAttribute == "" or LocalPlayer:GetAttribute(ShopItem.requireAttribute)) then
            return HasKit(ShopItem.ignoredByKit)
        end

        return true
    end

    local function GetSwords(): {string}
        if HasKit({"dasher"}) then
            return Daos
        end

        for _, v: string in Kits do
            if KitSwords[v] then
                local List: {string} = table.clone(Swords)
                List[5] = KitSwords[v]

                return List
            end
        end

        return Swords
    end

    local function GetBestArmor(Slot: number): InventoryItem?
        local Best: InventoryItem?, Reduction: number = nil, 0
        for _, v: InventoryItem in (Data.Storage.Inventory.inventory.items or {}) do
            local Meta: any = Data.Instances.Items[v.itemType] or {}
            if Meta.armor and Meta.armor.slot == Slot and (Meta.armor.damageReductionMultiplier or 0) > Reduction then
                Best, Reduction = v, Meta.armor.damageReductionMultiplier
            end
        end

        return Best
    end

    local function GetShop(): (boolean, boolean, string?)
        local ItemShop: boolean, UpgradeShop: boolean, NewId: string? = false, false, nil
        if not Entity.Alive then
            return ItemShop, UpgradeShop, NewId
        end

        local LocalPosition: Vector3 = Entity.RootPart.Position
        for _, Tag: string in {"BedwarsItemShop", "TeamUpgradeShopkeeper"} do
            for _, v: Instance in Services.CollectionService:GetTagged(Tag) do
                if not v:IsA("BasePart") or (v.Position - LocalPosition).Magnitude > 20 then
                    continue
                end

                if Tag == "BedwarsItemShop" then
                    ItemShop, NewId = true, v.Name
                else
                    UpgradeShop = true
                end
            end
        end

        return ItemShop, UpgradeShop, NewId
    end

    local function CanBuy(ShopItem: any, Currency: {[string]: number}, Amount: number?): boolean
        if not Currency[ShopItem.currency] then
            local Stack: InventoryItem? = Inventory.Item(ShopItem.currency)
            Currency[ShopItem.currency] = Stack and Stack.amount or 0
        end
        if not IsHidden(ShopItem) and not ShopItem.lockedByForge and not ShopItem.disabled and (not ShopItem.require or not ShopItem.require.teamUpgrade or (Data.Controllers.Store:getState().Bedwars.teamUpgrades[ShopItem.require.teamUpgrade.upgradeId] or -1) >= ShopItem.require.teamUpgrade.lowestTierIndex) then
            return Currency[ShopItem.currency] >= ShopItem.price * (Amount or 1)
        end

        return false
    end

    local function BuyItem(ShopItem: any, Currency: {[string]: number})
        if not ShopId then
            return
        end

        Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("BedwarsPurchaseItem"):CallServerAsync({
            itemType = ShopItem.itemType,
            shopId = ShopId
        }):andThen(function(Success: boolean)
            if not Success then
                return
            end

            local Meta: any = Data.Instances.Items[ShopItem.itemType]
            Cat:CreateNotification("AutoBuy", `Bought {Meta and Meta.displayName or ShopItem.itemType}`, 3)
            Data.Controllers.AudioManager:playAudio(Data.Instances.Sounds.BEDWARS_PURCHASE_ITEM)
            Data.Controllers.Store:dispatch({
                type = "BedwarsAddItemPurchased",
                itemType = ShopItem.itemType
            })
            if ShopItem.tiered and not ShopItem.nextTier then
                Data.Controllers.BedwarsShopController.alreadyPurchasedMap[ShopItem.itemType] = true
            end
        end)
        Currency[ShopItem.currency] -= ShopItem.price
    end

    local function BuyTool(Tool: any?, Tools: {string}, Currency: {[string]: number}): boolean
        local Bought: boolean = false
        local Buyable: any = nil
        local Found: number? = Tool and table.find(Tools, Tool.itemType)
        for Index: number = Found and Found + 1 or math.huge, #Tools do
            local ShopItem: any = Data.Controllers.BedwarsShop.getShopItem(Tools[Index], LocalPlayer)
            if ShopItem and not IsHidden(ShopItem) then
                if CanBuy(ShopItem, Currency) then
                    local Meta: any = Data.Instances.Items[Tools[Index]]
                    if SmartCheck.Enabled and Meta and Meta.breakBlock and Index > 2 then
                        if Armor.Enabled then
                            local Worn: any = (Data.Storage.Inventory.inventory.armor or {})[2]
                            local WornType: string = Worn and Worn ~= "empty" and Worn.itemType or "none"
                            if (table.find(Armors, WornType) or 3) < 3 then
                                break
                            end
                        end
                        if Sword.Enabled then
                            local Weapon: InventoryItem? = Data.Storage.Tools.Sword
                            if Weapon and (table.find(GetSwords(), Weapon.itemType) or 2) < 2 then
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    Bought, Buyable = true, ShopItem
                end
                if ShopItem.nextTier then
                    break
                end
            end
        end

        if Buyable then
            BuyItem(Buyable, Currency)
        end

        return Bought
    end

    AutoBuy = Cat.Categories.Inventory:CreateModule({
        Name = "AutoBuy",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback then
                Session += 1

                local Current: number = Session
                repeat
                    task.wait()
                until (Data.Controllers.Store:getState().Game.queueType or "bedwars_test") ~= "bedwars_test" or Session ~= Current or not AutoBuy.Enabled
                if Session == Current and AutoBuy.Enabled then
                    Queue = Data.Controllers.Store:getState().Game.queueType or "bedwars_test"
                    if not BedwarsCheck.Enabled or Queue:find("bedwars") or table.find(BedwarsQueues, Queue) then
                        repeat
                            ShopLoaded = ShopLoaded or pcall(Data.Controllers.ShopOverride.getBedwarsShopOverrides)
                            if not ShopLoaded then
                                task.wait(2)
                            end
                        until ShopLoaded or Session ~= Current or not AutoBuy.Enabled
                        if Session == Current and AutoBuy.Enabled then
                            AutoBuy:Clean(Data.Events.InventoryChanged:Connect(function()
                                if NPCTick - tick() > 1 then
                                    NPCTick = tick()
                                end
                            end))

                            local LastUpgradeShop: boolean? = nil
                            repeat
                                local ItemShop: boolean, UpgradeShop: boolean, NewId: string? = GetShop()
                                ShopId = NewId

                                local Near: boolean = ItemShop or UpgradeShop
                                local MenuOpen: boolean = Data.Controllers.AppController:isAppOpen("BedwarsItemShopApp") or Data.Controllers.AppController:isAppOpen("TeamUpgradeApp")
                                if (GUI.Enabled and not MenuOpen) or (not GUI.Enabled and MenuOpen) then
                                    Near = false
                                end
                                if Near and LastUpgradeShop ~= UpgradeShop then
                                    if NPCTick - tick() > 1 then
                                        NPCTick = tick()
                                    end

                                    LastUpgradeShop = UpgradeShop
                                end

                                if Near and NPCTick <= tick() and Data.Storage.MatchState ~= 2 then
                                    Kits = GetKits()

                                    local Currency: {[string]: number} = {}
                                    local Bought: boolean = false
                                    for _, v: {[number]: BuyCallback} in Callbacks do
                                        for _, Buy: BuyCallback in v do
                                            local Success: boolean, Result: boolean? = pcall(Buy, Currency, ItemShop, UpgradeShop)
                                            if Success and Result then
                                                Bought = true
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end

                                    NPCTick = tick() + (Bought and 0.4 or math.huge)
                                end

                                task.wait(0.1)
                            until not AutoBuy.Enabled or Session ~= Current
                        end
                    end
                end
            else
                NPCTick = tick()
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Automatically buys items when you go near the shop"
    })

    Sword = AutoBuy:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Buy Sword",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            NPCTick = tick()
            Functions[2] = Callback and function(Currency: {[string]: number}, ItemShop: boolean): boolean?
                if not ItemShop then
                    return
                end

                return BuyTool(Data.Storage.Tools.Sword, GetSwords(), Currency)
            end or nil
        end
    })
    Armor = AutoBuy:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Buy Armor",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            NPCTick = tick()
            Functions[1] = Callback and function(Currency: {[string]: number}, ItemShop: boolean): boolean?
                if not ItemShop then
                    return
                end

                local Worn: any = (Data.Storage.Inventory.inventory.armor or {})[2]
                local Chest: any = Worn ~= "empty" and Worn or GetBestArmor(1)

                return BuyTool({itemType = Chest and Chest.itemType or "none"}, Armors, Currency)
            end or nil
        end,
        Default = true
    })
    AutoBuy:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Buy Axe",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            NPCTick = tick()
            Functions[3] = Callback and function(Currency: {[string]: number}, ItemShop: boolean): boolean?
                if not ItemShop then
                    return
                end

                return BuyTool(Data.Storage.Tools.wood or {itemType = "none"}, Axes, Currency)
            end or nil
        end
    })
    AutoBuy:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Buy Pickaxe",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            NPCTick = tick()
            Functions[4] = Callback and function(Currency: {[string]: number}, ItemShop: boolean): boolean?
                if not ItemShop then
                    return
                end

                return BuyTool(Data.Storage.Tools.stone, Pickaxes, Currency)
            end or nil
        end
    })
    Upgrades = AutoBuy:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Buy Upgrades",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            for _, v: Toggle in UpgradeToggles do
                v.Object.Visible = Callback
            end
        end,
        Default = true
    })
    for UpgradeId: string, v: any in Data.Instances.TeamUpgradeMeta do
        Count += 1

        local Slot: number = 4 + Count + (v.name == "Armor" and 20 or 0)
        local Name: string = v.name == "Armor" and "Protection" or v.name
        table.insert(UpgradeToggles, AutoBuy:CreateToggle({
            Name = `Buy {Name}`,
            Function = function(Callback: boolean)
                NPCTick = tick()
                Functions[Slot] = Callback and function(Currency: {[string]: number}, _: boolean, UpgradeShop: boolean): boolean?
                    if not UpgradeShop or not Upgrades.Enabled then
                        return
                    end
                    if v.disabledInQueue and table.find(v.disabledInQueue, Queue) then
                        return
                    end

                    local Owned: {[string]: number} = Data.Controllers.Store:getState().Bedwars.teamUpgrades[LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Team")] or {}
                    local Bought: boolean = false
                    for Tier: number = (Owned[UpgradeId] or 0) + 1, #v.tiers do
                        local Cost: any = v.tiers[Tier]
                        if Cost.availableOnlyInQueue and not table.find(Cost.availableOnlyInQueue, Queue) then
                            continue
                        end
                        if not CanBuy({currency = "diamond", price = Cost.cost}, Currency) then
                            break
                        end

                        Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("RequestPurchaseTeamUpgrade"):CallServerAsync(UpgradeId):andThen(function(Success: boolean)
                            if Success then
                                Cat:CreateNotification("AutoBuy", `Bought {Name} {Tier}`, 3)
                            end
                        end)
                        Currency.diamond -= Cost.cost
                        Bought = true
                    end

                    return Bought
                end or nil
            end,
            Darker = true,
            Default = (UpgradeId == "ARMOR" or UpgradeId == "DAMAGE")
        }))
    end
    BedwarsCheck = AutoBuy:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Only Bedwars",
        Function = function()
            if AutoBuy.Enabled then
                AutoBuy:Toggle()
                AutoBuy:Toggle()
            end
        end,
        Default = true,
        Tooltip = "Only buys in BedWars modes, including Kit Fusion and Hyper Kits"
    })
    GUI = AutoBuy:CreateToggle({
        Name = "GUI check",
        Tooltip = "On: only buys while the shop menu is open. Off: pauses while the shop menu is open so it never fights your own purchases"
    })
    SmartCheck = AutoBuy:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Smart check",
        Default = true,
        Tooltip = "Buys iron armor before iron axe"
    })
    Item = AutoBuy:CreateTextList({
        Name = "Item",
        Placeholder = "priority/item/amount/after",
        Function = function(List: {string})
            table.clear(Custom)
            table.clear(CustomPost)
            for _, v: string in List do
                local Fields: {string} = v:split("/")
                local Priority: number? = tonumber(Fields[1])
                if not Priority then
                    continue
                end

                local Target: {[number]: BuyCallback} = Fields[4] and CustomPost or Custom
                Target[Priority] = function(Currency: {[string]: number}, ItemShop: boolean): boolean?
                    if ItemShop then
                        local ShopItem: any = Data.Controllers.BedwarsShop.getShopItem(Fields[2], LocalPlayer)
                        local Amount: number? = tonumber(Fields[3])
                        if ShopItem and Amount then
                            local ItemType: string = Fields[2] == "wool_white" and Data.Controllers.BedwarsShop.getTeamWoolById(LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Team")) or Fields[2]
                            local Stack: InventoryItem? = Inventory.Item(ItemType)
                            local Owned: number = Stack and Stack.amount or 0

                            local Needed: number = (Amount - Owned) // math.max(ShopItem.amount, 1)
                            if Needed > 0 and CanBuy(ShopItem, Currency, Needed) then
                                for _ = 1, Needed do
                                    BuyItem(ShopItem, Currency)
                                end

                                return true
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    return nil
                end
            end
        end
    })
end)()

BundledModules.AutoChestSplit = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services
    local LocalPlayer: Player = Services.Players.LocalPlayer

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity
    local Inventory = BundledModules.Inventory

    local AutoChestSplit
    local Items, Range, Minimum, EnemyOnly, Delay

    local function Nearest(Tag: string, Origin: Vector3, Reach: number): Instance?
        local Closest: Instance?, Gap: number = nil, Reach
        for _, v: Instance in Services.CollectionService:GetTagged(Tag) do
            local Part: BasePart? = if v:IsA("BasePart") then v elseif v:IsA("Model") then v.PrimaryPart or v:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true) else nil
            if Part and (Part.Position - Origin).Magnitude <= Gap then
                Closest, Gap = v, (Part.Position - Origin).Magnitude
            end
        end

        return Closest
    end

    AutoChestSplit = Cat.Categories.Inventory:CreateModule({
        Name = "AutoChestSplit",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback then
                local Next: number = 0
                repeat
                    local Origin: Vector3? = Entity.Alive and Entity.RootPart.Position or nil
                    if Origin and Data.Storage.MatchState == 1 and tick() >= Next and #Items.ListEnabled > 0 and Nearest("personal-chest", Origin, Range.Value) then
                        local Crate: Instance? = Nearest("team-crate", Origin, math.huge)
                        local Personal: Instance? = Services.ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Inventories")
                        Personal = Personal and Personal:FindFirstChild(`{LocalPlayer.Name}_personal`)
                        if Personal and (not EnemyOnly.Enabled or (Crate and Crate:GetAttribute("Team") ~= LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Team"))) then
                            Next = tick() + Delay.Value
                            for _, v: string in Items.ListEnabled do
                                local Item: InventoryItem? = Inventory.Item(v)
                                if Item and (Item.amount or 1) >= Minimum.Value then
                                    task.spawn(function()
                                        Data.Controllers.ClientScript:GetNamespace("Inventory"):Get("ChestGiveItem"):CallServer(Personal, Item.tool)
                                    end)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    task.wait(0.1)
                until not AutoChestSplit.Enabled
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Puts your split items into your personal chest as soon as you stand at one"
    })

    Items = AutoChestSplit:CreateTextList({
        Name = "Items",
        Default = {"diamond", "emerald"},
        Tooltip = "Which items count as the split, by item id"
    })
    Range = AutoChestSplit:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Range",
        Min = 1,
        Max = 18,
        Default = 18,
        Suffix = function(Value: number): string
            return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
        end,
        Tooltip = "How close to the chest you have to be, the server stops taking items at about 20"
    })
    Minimum = AutoChestSplit:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Minimum",
        Min = 1,
        Max = 64,
        Default = 1,
        Tooltip = "Leaves the stack alone until you have at least this many"
    })
    EnemyOnly = AutoChestSplit:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Enemy base only",
        Default = true,
        Tooltip = "Only stores items at a chest in an enemy base, judged by whose crate is closest"
    })
    Delay = AutoChestSplit:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Delay",
        Min = 0,
        Max = 5,
        Default = 0.5,
        Decimal = 10,
        Suffix = "s"
    })
end)()

BundledModules.AutoConsume = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services
    local LocalPlayer: Player = Services.Players.LocalPlayer

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity

    local AutoConsume
    local Health, SpeedPotion, Apple, ShieldPotion
    local AutoEat, Speed, Heal, Shield, Dizzy, Range, Delay, Animation

    local Cooldowns: {[Instance]: number} = {}
    local Consuming: {[string]: boolean} = {}

    local function Consume(Item: InventoryItem, Tries: number): boolean
        local Meta: any = Data.Instances.Items[Item.itemType]
        if Consuming[Item.itemType] then
            return false
        end

        Consuming[Item.itemType] = true
        for _ = 1, Tries do
            Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("StartConsume"):SendToServer({item = Item.tool})

            task.wait(Meta and Meta.consumable and Meta.consumable.consumeTime or 0)

            if Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("ConsumeItem"):CallServer({item = Item.tool}) then
                Consuming[Item.itemType] = nil

                return true
            end
        end

        Consuming[Item.itemType] = nil

        return false
    end

    local function Check(Attribute: string?)
        if Entity.Alive then
            local Items: {[string]: InventoryItem} = {}
            for _, v: InventoryItem in (Data.Storage.Inventory.inventory.items or {}) do
                Items[v.itemType] = Items[v.itemType] or v
            end

            local Character: Model = Entity.Character
            if SpeedPotion.Enabled and (not Attribute or Attribute == "StatusEffect_speed") and Items.speed_potion and not Character:GetAttribute("StatusEffect_speed") then
                task.spawn(Consume, Items.speed_potion, 4)
            end

            if Apple.Enabled and (not Attribute or Attribute:find("Health")) and (Character:GetAttribute("Health") or 0) / (Character:GetAttribute("MaxHealth") or 1) <= Health.Value / 100 then
                local Food: InventoryItem? = Items.orange or (not Character:GetAttribute("StatusEffect_golden_apple") and Items.golden_apple) or Items.apple
                if Food then
                    task.spawn(Consume, Food, 1)
                end
            end

            if ShieldPotion.Enabled and (not Attribute or Attribute:find("Shield")) and (Character:GetAttribute("Shield_POTION") or 0) == 0 then
                local Potion: InventoryItem? = Items.big_shield or Items.mini_shield
                if Potion then
                    task.spawn(Consume, Potion, 1)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    AutoConsume = Cat.Categories.Inventory:CreateModule({
        Name = "AutoConsume",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback then
                AutoConsume:Clean(Data.Events.InventoryChanged:Connect(function()
                    Check()
                end))
                for _, v: Model? in {LocalPlayer.Character} do
                    AutoConsume:Clean((v :: Model).AttributeChanged:Connect(function(Attribute: string)
                        if Attribute:find("Shield") or Attribute:find("Health") or Attribute == "StatusEffect_speed" then
                            Check(Attribute)
                        end
                    end))
                end

                AutoConsume:Clean(LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(Character: Model)
                    AutoConsume:Clean(Character.AttributeChanged:Connect(function(Attribute: string)
                        if Attribute:find("Shield") or Attribute:find("Health") or Attribute == "StatusEffect_speed" then
                            Check(Attribute)
                        end
                    end))
                end))

                task.spawn(Check)

                repeat
                    if AutoEat.Enabled and Entity.Alive then
                        for _, v: Instance in Services.CollectionService:GetTagged("forest_environment_plant") do
                            local Part: BasePart? = v:IsA("Model") and v.PrimaryPart or v:IsA("BasePart") and v or nil
                            local Id, Type = v:GetAttribute("Id"), v:GetAttribute("MushroomType")

                            if Part and Id and tick() > (Cooldowns[v] or 0) and (Entity.RootPart.Position - Part.Position).Magnitude <= Range.Value then
                                if Type == 2 and Speed.Enabled or Type == 0 and Heal.Enabled and (Entity.Character:GetAttribute("Health") or 0) < (Entity.Character:GetAttribute("MaxHealth") or 0) or Type == 1 and Shield.Enabled or Type == 3 and Dizzy.Enabled then
                                    if Animation.Enabled then
                                        Data.Controllers.GameAnimationUtil:playAnimation(LocalPlayer.Character, Data.Instances.Animations.PUNCH)
                                        Data.Controllers.ViewmodelController:playAnimation(Data.Instances.Animations.FP_USE_ITEM)
                                    end

                                    Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("CollectCollectableEntity"):SendToServer({
                                        id = Id,
                                        collectableName = v.Name
                                    })
                                    Cooldowns[v] = tick() + 1
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    task.wait(Delay.Value)
                until not AutoConsume.Enabled or not AutoEat.Enabled
            else
                table.clear(Cooldowns)
                table.clear(Consuming)
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Automatically heals for you when health or shield is under threshold."
    })

    Health = AutoConsume:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Health Percent",
        Min = 1,
        Max = 99,
        Default = 70,
        Suffix = "%"
    })
    SpeedPotion = AutoConsume:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Speed Potions",
        Default = true
    })
    Apple = AutoConsume:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Apple",
        Default = true
    })
    ShieldPotion = AutoConsume:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Shield Potions",
        Default = true
    })
    AutoEat = AutoConsume:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Mushrooms",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            for _, v: any in {Speed, Heal, Shield, Dizzy, Range, Delay, Animation} do
                if v and v.Object then
                    v.Object.Visible = Callback
                end
            end

            if AutoConsume.Enabled then
                AutoConsume:Toggle()
                AutoConsume:Toggle()
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Eats mushrooms for you when you are in range"
    })
    Speed = AutoConsume:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Speed",
        Default = true,
        Darker = true,
        Visible = false,
        Tooltip = "Speed mushrooms"
    })
    Heal = AutoConsume:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Heal",
        Default = true,
        Darker = true,
        Visible = false,
        Tooltip = "Heal mushrooms"
    })
    Shield = AutoConsume:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Shield",
        Default = true,
        Darker = true,
        Visible = false,
        Tooltip = "Shield mushrooms"
    })
    Dizzy = AutoConsume:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Dizzy",
        Darker = true,
        Visible = false,
        Tooltip = "Dizzy mushrooms"
    })
    Range = AutoConsume:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Range",
        Min = 1,
        Max = 12,
        Default = 10,
        Suffix = function(Value: number)
            return Value <= 1 and "stud" or "studs"
        end,
        Darker = true,
        Visible = false
    })
    Delay = AutoConsume:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Delay",
        Min = 0.05,
        Max = 1,
        Default = 0.1,
        Decimal = 100,
        Suffix = "seconds",
        Darker = true,
        Visible = false
    })
    Animation = AutoConsume:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Animation",
        Default = true,
        Darker = true,
        Visible = false,
        Tooltip = "Plays the pickup animation"
    })
end)()

BundledModules.AutoFish = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services
    local LocalPlayer: Player = Services.Players.LocalPlayer

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity
    local Ballistic = BundledModules.Ballistic

    local AutoFish
    local Blacklist, Show, Minigame, MinigameMode, CompleteDelay, Reaction, Clicks, Cast, CastDelay, GUI

    local Session, Rejects: {Vector3}, Original = 0, {}, nil

    local Params: RaycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    Params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

    local function GetBobber(): Instance?
        for _, v: Instance in workspace:GetChildren() do
            if v.Name == "fisherman_bobber" and v:GetAttribute("ProjectileShooter") == LocalPlayer.UserId then
                return v
            end
        end

        return nil
    end

    local function GetCastSpot(): Vector3?
        local LocalPosition: Vector3 = Entity.RootPart.Position
        local OpenSpot: Vector3?

        for Distance: number = 5, 17, 3 do
            for Angle: number = 0, 330, 30 do
                local Spot: Vector3 = LocalPosition + (CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(Angle), 0).LookVector * Distance)
                local RayResult: RaycastResult? = Data.Controllers.GameQueryUtil:raycast(Spot + Vector3.new(0, 8, 0), Vector3.new(0, -26, 0), Params)
                local CheckPosition: Vector3 = RayResult and RayResult.Position or Spot
                local Rejected: boolean = false
                for _, v: Vector3 in Rejects do
                    if (v - CheckPosition).Magnitude < 4 then
                        Rejected = true

                        break
                    end
                end

                if not RayResult then
                    if not OpenSpot and not Rejected then
                        OpenSpot = Spot
                    end
                elseif RayResult.Material == Enum.Material.Water and not Rejected then
                    return RayResult.Position
                end
            end
        end

        return OpenSpot
    end

    local function PlayMinigame(Current: number)
        local Marker, Zone
        local Deadline: number = tick() + 3

        repeat
            for _, v: Instance in LocalPlayer.PlayerGui:GetDescendants() do
                if v.Name == "Marker" and v.Parent and v.Parent.Name == "Minigame" then
                    local FoundZone = v.Parent:FindFirstChild("FishZone")
                    if FoundZone then
                        Marker, Zone = v, FoundZone

                        break
                    end
                end
            end
            if not Marker then
                task.wait()
            end
        until Marker or tick() > Deadline
        if not Marker or not Zone then
            return
        end

        local Speed: number, AimOffset: number = Data.Instances.FishermanUtil.startingMarkerIncrementSpeed, 0
        repeat
            if not Marker.Parent or not Zone.Parent then
                return
            end

            if GUI.Enabled and Data.Controllers.AppController:isLayerOpen(Data.Instances.Layers.MAIN) then
                Services.TweenService:Create(Marker, TweenInfo.new(Data.Instances.FishermanUtil.totalDecaySpeedSec * (Marker.Position.X.Scale + Marker.Size.X.Scale), Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
                    Position = UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, 0)
                }):Play()
                Speed = Data.Instances.FishermanUtil.startingMarkerIncrementSpeed
                repeat
                    task.wait(0.1)
                until not (GUI.Enabled and Data.Controllers.AppController:isLayerOpen(Data.Instances.Layers.MAIN)) or not Marker.Parent or not AutoFish.Enabled or not Minigame.Enabled or Session ~= Current
            else
                local Width: number = Marker.AbsoluteSize.X
                local Center: number = Marker.AbsolutePosition.X + (Width / 2)
                local Delta: number = ((Zone.AbsolutePosition.X + (Zone.AbsoluteSize.X / 2) + AimOffset) - Center) / math.max(Width, 1)
                if Delta > 0.2 then
                    Services.TweenService:Create(Marker, TweenInfo.new(math.max(Speed, Data.Instances.FishermanUtil.holdMinimumMarkerIncrementSpeed), Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
                        Position = UDim2.new(math.min(Marker.Position.X.Scale + Data.Instances.FishermanUtil.markerIncrementAmount, 1 - Marker.Size.X.Scale), 0, 0.5, 0)
                    }):Play()

                    Speed -= 0.01

                    task.wait(0.05)
                elseif Delta < -0.2 then
                    Services.TweenService:Create(Marker, TweenInfo.new(Data.Instances.FishermanUtil.totalDecaySpeedSec * (Marker.Position.X.Scale + Marker.Size.X.Scale), Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
                        Position = UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, 0)
                    }):Play()

                    Speed = Data.Instances.FishermanUtil.startingMarkerIncrementSpeed
                    AimOffset = (math.random() - 0.5) * Width * 0.1

                    task.wait(Reaction:GetRandomValue())
                else
                    local Period: number = 1 / Clicks:GetRandomValue()
                    Services.TweenService:Create(Marker, TweenInfo.new(math.max(Data.Instances.FishermanUtil.startingMarkerIncrementSpeed, Data.Instances.FishermanUtil.holdMinimumMarkerIncrementSpeed), Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
                        Position = UDim2.new(math.min(Marker.Position.X.Scale + Data.Instances.FishermanUtil.markerIncrementAmount, 1 - Marker.Size.X.Scale), 0, 0.5, 0)
                    }):Play()
                    task.wait(Period * (0.35 + (math.random() * 0.25)))

                    Services.TweenService:Create(Marker, TweenInfo.new(Data.Instances.FishermanUtil.totalDecaySpeedSec * (Marker.Position.X.Scale + Marker.Size.X.Scale), Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
                        Position = UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, 0)
                    }):Play()

                    Speed = Data.Instances.FishermanUtil.startingMarkerIncrementSpeed
                    AimOffset = (math.random() - 0.5) * Width * 0.1

                    task.wait(Period * (0.35 + (math.random() * 0.25)))
                end
            end
        until not AutoFish.Enabled or not Minigame.Enabled or Session ~= Current
    end

    AutoFish = Cat.Categories.Inventory:CreateModule({
        Name = "AutoFish",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback then
                Session += 1

                local Current: number = Session
                Original = Data.Controllers.FishingMinigameController.startMinigame
                Data.Controllers.FishingMinigameController.startMinigame = function(...): ...any
                    if Minigame.Enabled and MinigameMode.Value == "Instant" then
                        local Deadline: number = tick() + Data.Instances.FishermanUtil.minigameDuration
                        repeat
                            if not (GUI.Enabled and Data.Controllers.AppController:isLayerOpen(Data.Instances.Layers.MAIN)) then
                                break
                            end

                            task.wait(0.1)
                        until tick() >= Deadline

                        task.wait(CompleteDelay:GetRandomValue())

                        return select(3, ...)({win = true})
                    end

                    local Call: any = Original(...)
                    if Minigame.Enabled then
                        task.spawn(PlayMinigame, Current)
                    end

                    return Call
                end

                AutoFish:Clean(Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("FishFound"):Connect(function(Event: {dropData: {drops: {{itemType: string, amount: number?}}}})
                    local Reroll: boolean = #Blacklist.ListEnabled > 0
                    for _, v: {itemType: string, amount: number?} in Event.dropData.drops do
                        local Amount: number = tonumber(v.amount) or 0
                        if Show.Enabled then
                            local ItemDisplay: string = Data.Instances.Items[v.itemType] and Data.Instances.Items[v.itemType].displayName or v.itemType
                            Cat:CreateNotification("AutoFish", `You can get {Amount} {ItemDisplay:lower()}{Amount >= 2 and "s" or ""} on ur next fish`, 20, "info")
                        end
                        if not table.find(Blacklist.ListEnabled, v.itemType) then
                            Reroll = false
                        end
                    end

                    if Reroll and Entity.Alive then
                        Entity.Humanoid.Jump = true
                    end
                end))

                repeat
                    task.wait(0.1)
                    if Data.Storage.Map and Params.FilterDescendantsInstances[1] ~= Data.Storage.Map then
                        Params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {Data.Storage.Map}
                    end

                    if AutoFish.Enabled and Session == Current and Entity.Alive and Cast.Enabled and Data.Storage.Map and Data.Storage.Hand.Tool and Data.Storage.Hand.Tool.Name == "fishing_rod" and not GetBobber() and not (GUI.Enabled and Data.Controllers.AppController:isLayerOpen(Data.Instances.Layers.MAIN)) then
                        local Spot: Vector3? = GetCastSpot()
                        if not Spot and #Rejects > 0 then
                            table.clear(Rejects)
                            Spot = GetCastSpot()
                        end

                        if Spot then
                            task.wait(CastDelay:GetRandomValue())

                            if AutoFish.Enabled and Session == Current and not (GUI.Enabled and Data.Controllers.AppController:isLayerOpen(Data.Instances.Layers.MAIN)) then
                                local Item: any = Data.Controllers.FishingRodController:getHandItem()
                                if Item and not Data.Controllers.FishingRodController.projectileHandler and Data.Controllers.FishingRodController:canLaunch() then
                                    Data.Controllers.FishingRodController:beginHolding(Item, nil, Data.Controllers.FishingRodController.aimingMaid, false)
                                    task.wait()

                                    local Handler: any = Data.Controllers.FishingRodController.projectileHandler
                                    if Handler and Entity.Alive then
                                        local Meta: any = Data.Instances.ProjectileMeta.fisherman_bobber
                                        local Origin: Vector3 = (Data.Controllers.ProjectileController:getLaunchPosition(Item.tool) or Entity.RootPart.Position) + Handler.fromPositionOffset
                                        local Direction: Vector3? = Ballistic.Point(Origin, Spot + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0), Meta.launchVelocity, Meta.gravitationalAcceleration or 0)
                                        Handler.targetPoint = Direction and Origin + Direction * Meta.launchVelocity or Spot
                                    end

                                    Data.Controllers.FishingRodController:releaseChargeInput(Data.Controllers.FishingRodController.aimingMaid, function(): boolean
                                        return true
                                    end, nil)
                                end

                                task.wait(2.5)

                                local Bobber: Instance? = GetBobber()
                                if not Bobber or not Bobber:GetAttribute("WaitingForFish") then
                                    table.insert(Rejects, Spot)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                until not AutoFish.Enabled or Session ~= Current
            else
                table.clear(Rejects)

                if Original then
                    Data.Controllers.FishingMinigameController.startMinigame = Original
                    Original = nil
                end
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Automatically fishes with fishing rod"
    })

    Blacklist = AutoFish:CreateTextList({
        Name = "Blacklisted loot",
        Default = {"iron"},
        Tooltip = "Jumps to cancel the catch when every item the fish drops is blacklisted"
    })
    Show = AutoFish:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Show loot drops",
        Tooltip = "Notifies ur next lootdrops"
    })
    Minigame = AutoFish:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Auto Minigame",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if not Clicks or not Clicks.Object then
                return
            end

            MinigameMode.Object.Visible = Callback
            CompleteDelay.Object.Visible = Callback and MinigameMode.Value == "Instant"
            Reaction.Object.Visible = Callback and MinigameMode.Value == "Legit"
            Clicks.Object.Visible = Callback and MinigameMode.Value == "Legit"
        end,
        Default = true,
        Tooltip = "Automatically completes the minigame"
    })
    MinigameMode = AutoFish:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Minigame mode",
        List = {"Instant", "Legit"},
        Darker = true,
        Function = function(Value: string)
            if not Clicks or not Clicks.Object then
                return
            end

            CompleteDelay.Object.Visible = Minigame.Enabled and Value == "Instant"
            Reaction.Object.Visible = Minigame.Enabled and Value == "Legit"
            Clicks.Object.Visible = Minigame.Enabled and Value == "Legit"
        end,
        Tooltip = "Instant wins the moment the minigame opens, Legit plays the bar out itself"
    })
    CompleteDelay = AutoFish:CreateTwoSlider({
        Name = "Complete delay",
        Min = 0,
        Max = 25,
        Decimal = 5,
        DefaultMin = 0.1,
        DefaultMax = 0.9,
        Darker = true,
        Visible = Minigame.Enabled and MinigameMode.Value == "Instant"
    })
    Reaction = AutoFish:CreateTwoSlider({
        Name = "Reaction",
        Min = 0,
        Max = 1,
        Decimal = 100,
        DefaultMin = 0.06,
        DefaultMax = 0.19,
        Darker = true,
        Visible = Minigame.Enabled and MinigameMode.Value == "Legit",
        Tooltip = "How long it takes to notice the fish moved away before it lets go"
    })
    Clicks = AutoFish:CreateTwoSlider({
        Name = "Clicks",
        Min = 3,
        Max = 20,
        DefaultMin = 8,
        DefaultMax = 13,
        Darker = true,
        Visible = Minigame.Enabled and MinigameMode.Value == "Legit",
        Suffix = "cps",
        Tooltip = "How fast it taps to hover the bar on the fish"
    })
    Cast = AutoFish:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Auto Cast",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if CastDelay and CastDelay.Object then
                CastDelay.Object.Visible = Callback
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Finds a spot to fish at and casts there, ignoring where ur camera looks"
    })
    CastDelay = AutoFish:CreateTwoSlider({
        Name = "Cast delay",
        Min = 0,
        Max = 5,
        Decimal = 5,
        DefaultMin = 0.3,
        DefaultMax = 1.2,
        Darker = true,
        Visible = Cast.Enabled
    })
    GUI = AutoFish:CreateToggle({
        Name = "GUI Check",
        Tooltip = "Waits while a game menu like the shop or ur inventory is open before casting or playing the minigame"
    })
end)()

BundledModules.HotbarList = (function()

            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Image = Ui:Icon("add"),
            ImageColor3 = Theme.Green,
            ImageTransparency = 0.3,
            Position = UDim2.new(1, -26, 0, 7),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14),
            Parent = Add
        })

            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
            AutoButtonColor = false,
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Main,
            Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(416, 347),
            Text = "",
            Visible = false,
            Parent = Ui.Click
        }, {
            Create.Corner(5),
            Create.New("UIShadow", {BlurRadius = UDim.new(0, 13), Transparency = 0.25})
        })

        local Title: TextLabel = Create.New("TextLabel", {
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            FontFace = Theme.SemiBold,
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 11),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -60, 0, 20),
            Text = "Hotbar",
            TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
            TextSize = 13,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            Parent = Window
        })

        local Close: ImageButton = Create.New("ImageButton", {
            AutoButtonColor = false,
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Image = Ui:Icon("close"),
            ImageColor3 = Theme.Bright,
            ImageTransparency = 0.5,
            Position = UDim2.new(1, -35, 0, 9),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24),
            Parent = Window
        }, {Create.New("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)})})

        Create.New("TextLabel", {
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            FontFace = Theme.Font,
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 90),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 14),
            Text = "Left click a slot to pick it, right click to clear it",

            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,

        })

        Create.New("Frame", {
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Panel,
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 1),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -2, 1, -2),
            Parent = Field
        }, {Create.Corner(5)})

        local Box: TextBox = Create.New("TextBox", {
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            ClearTextOnFocus = false,
            FontFace = Theme.Font,
            PlaceholderColor3 = Theme.Muted,
            PlaceholderText = "Search items...",
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 0),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 1, 0),
            Text = "",
            TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
            TextSize = 13,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            Parent = Field
        })

        Create.New("ImageLabel", {
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Image = Ui:Icon("search"),
            ImageColor3 = Theme.Icon,
            Position = UDim2.new(1, -26, 0, 8),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14),
            Parent = Field
        })

        local Grid: ScrollingFrame = Create.New("ScrollingFrame", {
            AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            CanvasSize = UDim2.new(),
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 151),
            ScrollBarImageTransparency = 0.75,
            ScrollBarThickness = 2,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(396, 184),
            Parent = Window
        }, {
            Create.New("UIGridLayout", {
                CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 4),

                SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder

        local function Paint()
            local Hotbar: {[string]: string}? = Editing and Handle.Hotbars[Editing]
            for Slot: number, v: ImageLabel in Icons do
                local Item: string? = Hotbar and Hotbar[tostring(Slot)]
                v.Image = Item and Data.Instances.Items[Item] and Data.Instances.Items[Item].image or ""
                Strokes[Slot].Color = Slot == Picked and Ui:Color(Index * 0.075) or Theme.Hover
                Strokes[Slot].Thickness = Slot == Picked and 2 or 1
            end
        end

            for _, v: Instance in Presets do
                v:Destroy()
            end
            table.clear(Presets)
            Row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40 + #Handle.Hotbars * 31)

            for Position: number, Hotbar: {[string]: string} in Handle.Hotbars do
                local Selected: boolean = Position == Handle.Selected
                local Preset: TextButton = Create.New("TextButton", {
                    AutoButtonColor = false,
                    BackgroundColor3 = Selected and Theme.Track or Theme.Main,
                    Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 40 + (Position - 1) * 31),
                    Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 28),
                    Text = "",
                    Parent = Row
                }, {Create.Corner(4)})
                Ui:Tip(Preset, Selected and "Active hotbar, click to edit it" or "Click to make this the active hotbar")

                for Slot: number = 1, 9 do

                    Create.New("ImageLabel", {

                        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18),

                    AutoButtonColor = false,
                    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    Image = Ui:Icon("closemini"),
                    ImageColor3 = Theme.Bright,
                    ImageTransparency = 0.5,
                    Position = UDim2.new(1, -22, 0, 6),
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16),
                    Parent = Preset
                }, {Create.New("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)})})

                Preset.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                    if Position ~= Handle.Selected then
                        Preset.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Hover
                    end
                end)
                Preset.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                    Preset.BackgroundColor3 = Position == Handle.Selected and Theme.Track or Theme.Main
                end)
                Preset.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                    if Position == Handle.Selected then
                        Editing, Picked = Position, 1
                        Title.Text = `Hotbar {Position}`
                        Window.Visible = true
                        Paint()

                        return
                    end

                    Handle.Selected = Position
                    Build()
                    Ui:Save()
                end)
                Remove.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                    Remove.ImageTransparency = 0.3
                    Ui:Tween(Remove, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.6}, Theme.Tween)
                end)
                Remove.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                    Remove.ImageTransparency = 0.5
                    Ui:Tween(Remove, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}, Theme.Tween)
                end)
                Remove.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                    table.remove(Handle.Hotbars, Position)
                    if Position < Handle.Selected then
                        Handle.Selected -= 1
                    elseif Position == Handle.Selected then
                        Handle.Selected = 1
                    end
                    if Editing == Position then
                        Editing, Window.Visible = nil, false
                    elseif Editing and Editing > Position then
                        Editing -= 1
                        Title.Text = `Hotbar {Editing}`
                    end

                    Build()
                    Ui:Save()
                end)

                table.insert(Presets, Preset)
            end
        end

        for Slot: number = 1, 9 do
            local Button: TextButton = Create.New("TextButton", {
                AutoButtonColor = false,
                BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Panel,
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12 + (Slot - 1) * 44, 44),

            Stroke.Parent = Button

            local Icon: ImageLabel = Create.New("ImageLabel", {
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28),
                Parent = Button
            })

            Create.New("TextLabel", {
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                FontFace = Theme.Font,
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 3),
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10),
                Text = tostring(Slot),
                TextColor3 = Theme.Muted,
                TextSize = 9,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                Parent = Button
            })

            Button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

                Paint()
