                if Editing and Handle.Hotbars[Editing] then
                    Handle.Hotbars[Editing][tostring(Slot)] = nil
                    Paint()
                    Build()
                    Ui:Save()
                end
            end)

            table.insert(Icons, Icon)
            table.insert(Strokes, Stroke)
        end

        local function Fill()
            for _, v: Instance in Cells do
                v:Destroy()
            end
            table.clear(Cells)

            local Text: string = (string.gsub(string.lower(Box.Text), " ", "_"))
            local Found: {string} = Text == "" and Suggested or {}
            if Text ~= "" then
                for Name: string, v: any in Data.Instances.Items do
                    if v.image and string.find(Name, Text, 1, true) then
                        table.insert(Found, Name)
                    end
                end
                table.sort(Found)
            end

            for Order: number, Name: string in Found do
                local Cell: TextButton = Create.New("TextButton", {
                    AutoButtonColor = false,
                    BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Panel,
                    LayoutOrder = Order,
                    Text = "",
                    Parent = Grid
                }, {
                    Create.Corner(5),
                    Create.New("ImageLabel", {
                        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
                        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                        Image = Data.Instances.Items[Name] and Data.Instances.Items[Name].image or "",
                        Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
                        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28)
                    })
                })
                Ui:Tip(Cell, Tips[Name] or Name)

                Cell.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                    Cell.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Track
                end)
                Cell.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                    Cell.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Panel
                end)
                Cell.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                    if Editing and Handle.Hotbars[Editing] then
                        Handle.Hotbars[Editing][tostring(Picked)] = Name
                        Picked = Picked % 9 + 1
                        Paint()
                        Build()
                        Ui:Save()
                    end
                end)

                table.insert(Cells, Cell)
            end
        end

        Box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(Fill)

        Handle = {
            Name = Props.Name,
            Hotbars = {},
            Selected = 1,
            Object = Row,
            Window = Window
        }

        table.insert(Ui.Painters, function()
            if Window.Visible then
                Paint()
            end
        end)

        Add.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            Plus.ImageTransparency = 0
            Ui:Tween(Holder, {BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Icon}, Theme.Tween)
        end)
        Add.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            Plus.ImageTransparency = 0.3
            Ui:Tween(Holder, {BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Track}, Theme.Tween)
        end)
        Add.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            table.insert(Handle.Hotbars, {})
            Build()
            Ui:Save()
        end)
        Close.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            Close.ImageTransparency = 0.3
            Ui:Tween(Close, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.6}, Theme.Tween)
        end)
        Close.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            Close.ImageTransparency = 0.5
            Ui:Tween(Close, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}, Theme.Tween)
        end)
        Close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            Editing, Window.Visible = nil, false
        end)

        Fill()
        Build()
        Owner.Options[Props.Name] = Handle
        Ui:Register(`{Owner.Key}/{Props.Name}`, function(): any
            return {Selected = Handle.Selected, Hotbars = Handle.Hotbars}
        end, function(Value: any)
            local Saved: {[string]: any} = type(Value) == "table" and Value or {}
            table.clear(Handle.Hotbars)
            for _, v: any in (type(Saved.Hotbars) == "table" and Saved.Hotbars or {}) do
                local Hotbar: {[string]: string} = {}
                for Slot: any, Item: any in (type(v) == "table" and v or {}) do
                    Hotbar[tostring(Slot)] = tostring(Item)
                end
                table.insert(Handle.Hotbars, Hotbar)
            end

            local Last: number = math.max(#Handle.Hotbars, 1)
            Handle.Selected = type(Saved.Selected) == "number" and math.clamp(Saved.Selected, 1, Last) or 1
            Editing, Window.Visible = nil, false
            Build()
        end)

        return Handle
    end
end)()

BundledModules.AutoHotbar = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local HotbarList = BundledModules.HotbarList
    local Inventory = BundledModules.Inventory

    local AutoHotbar
    local Mode, Clear, Hotbar

    local Active: boolean = false

    local function GetBow(): InventoryItem?
        local Best: InventoryItem?, Damage: number = nil, 0
        for _, v: InventoryItem in (Data.Storage.Inventory.inventory.items or {}) do
            local Source: any = Data.Instances.Items[v.itemType] and Data.Instances.Items[v.itemType].projectileSource
            if Source and table.find(Source.ammoItemTypes, "arrow") then
                local Power: number = Data.Instances.ProjectileMeta[Source.projectileType("arrow")].combat.damage or 0
                if Power > Damage then
                    Best, Damage = v, Power
                end
            end
        end

        return Best
    end

    local function Arrange()
        local Wanted: {[number]: string} = {}
        for Key: string, Item: string in (Hotbar.Hotbars[Hotbar.Selected] or {}) do
            local Slot: number? = tonumber(Key)
            if not Slot or Slot < 1 or Slot > 9 or Slot % 1 ~= 0 then
                continue
            end

            Wanted[Slot] = Item

            if Item == "diamond_sword" then
                local Weapon: InventoryItem? = Data.Storage.Tools.Sword
                Wanted[Slot] = Weapon and Weapon.itemType or "wood_sword"
            elseif Item == "diamond_pickaxe" then
                local Pickaxe: InventoryItem? = Data.Storage.Tools.stone
                Wanted[Slot] = Pickaxe and Pickaxe.itemType or "wood_pickaxe"
            elseif Item == "diamond_axe" then
                local Axe: InventoryItem? = Data.Storage.Tools.wood
                Wanted[Slot] = Axe and Axe.itemType or "wood_axe"
            elseif Item == "wood_bow" then
                local Bow: InventoryItem? = GetBow()
                Wanted[Slot] = Bow and Bow.itemType or "wood_bow"
            elseif Item == "wool_white" then
                local Sorted: {InventoryItem} = table.clone(Data.Storage.Inventory.inventory.items)
                table.sort(Sorted, function(a: InventoryItem, b: InventoryItem): boolean
                    return a.amount < b.amount
                end)
                for _, Stack: InventoryItem in Sorted do
                    local Block: any = Data.Instances.Items[Stack.itemType] and Data.Instances.Items[Stack.itemType].block
                    if Block and not Block.seeThrough then
                        Wanted[Slot] = Stack.itemType

                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        local Placed: {[number]: boolean} = {}
        for i: number = 1, 9 do
            local Held: any = Data.Storage.Inventory.hotbar[i]
            if Wanted[i] and Held and Held.item and Held.item.itemType == Wanted[i] then
                Placed[i - 1] = true
            end
        end

        for i: number = 1, 9 do
            local ItemType: string? = Wanted[i]
            if not ItemType or Placed[i	 - 1] then
                continue
            end

            local Source: any = Inventory.Find(nil, ItemType, function(v: any): boolean
                return v.container == "armor" or (v.container == "hotbar" and Placed[v.index] == true)
            end)
            if not Source then
                continue
            end

            Inventory.Move({
                operation = "swap_hotbar",
                slot = {container = Source.container, index = Source.index},
                target = {container = "hotbar", index = i - 1}
            }, function(): boolean
                local Held: any = Data.Storage.Inventory.hotbar[i]

                return Held ~= nil and Held.item ~= nil and Held.item.itemType == ItemType
            end)
        end

        if not Clear.Enabled then
            return
        end

        local Keep: {[string]: boolean} = {}
        for _, v: string in Wanted do
            Keep[v] = true
        end

        local Snapshot: any = Data.Controllers.Store:getState().Inventory.slotSnapshot
        for _, v: any in table.clone(Snapshot and Snapshot.player and Snapshot.player.slots or {}) do
            if v.container == "hotbar" and not Keep[v.itemType] then
                Inventory.Move({
                    operation = "quick_move",
                    slot = {
                        container = "hotbar",
                        index = v.index
                    }
                })
            end
        end
    end

    local function Sort()
        if Active then
            return
        end

        Active = true

        local Success: boolean, Error: any = pcall(Arrange)
        if not Success then
            task.spawn(function() error(Error); end)
        end

        Active = false
    end

    AutoHotbar = Cat.Categories.Inventory:CreateModule({
        Name = "AutoHotbar",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback then
                task.spawn(Sort)
                if Mode.Value == "On Key" then
                    AutoHotbar:Toggle()

                    return
                end

                AutoHotbar:Clean(Data.Events.InventoryChanged:Connect(Sort))
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Automatically arranges your hotbar"
    })

    Mode = AutoHotbar:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Activation",
        List = {"Toggle", "On Key"},
        Function = function()
            if AutoHotbar.Enabled then
                AutoHotbar:Toggle()
                AutoHotbar:Toggle()
            end
        end
    })
    Clear = AutoHotbar:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Clear Hotbar",
        Tooltip = "Moves everything that is not in your hotbar list out of the hotbar"
    })
    Hotbar = HotbarList(Cat.Ui, AutoHotbar, {
        Name = "Hotbars",
        Tooltip = "Click to add a hotbar, click a hotbar to make it active and click the active one to edit its items"
    })
end)()

BundledModules.AutoSteal = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services
    local LocalPlayer: Player = Services.Players.LocalPlayer

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity
    local Inventory = BundledModules.Inventory

    local AutoSteal
    local Range, Delay, GUI

    local Stash: {{Type: string, Expire: number}} = {}

    local function Steal(Crate: Instance)
        local Value: ObjectValue? = Crate:FindFirstChild("ChestFolderValue") :: ObjectValue?
        local Folder: Instance? = Value and Value.Value
        local Loot: {Instance} = {}
        for _, v: Instance in Folder and Folder:GetChildren() or {} do
            if v:IsA("Accessory") then
                table.insert(Loot, v)
            end
        end

        if Folder and #Loot > 0 then
            local Remotes: any = Data.Controllers.ClientScript:GetNamespace("Inventory")
            local Watching: ObjectValue? = Entity.Character and Entity.Character:FindFirstChild("ObservedChestFolder") :: ObjectValue?
            local Previous: Instance? = Watching and Watching.Value
            Remotes:Get("SetObservedChest"):SendToServer(Folder)
            for _, v: Instance in Loot do
                task.spawn(function()
                    local Success: boolean, Result: any = pcall(function(): any
                        return Remotes:Get("ChestGetItem"):CallServer(Folder, v)
                    end)
                    if Success and Result then
                        table.insert(Stash, {Type = v.Name, Expire = tick() + 5})
                    end
                end)
            end
            Remotes:Get("SetObservedChest"):SendToServer(Previous)
        end
    end

    local function Deposit()
        local Folder: Instance? = Services.ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Inventories")
        local Personal: Instance? = Folder and Folder:FindFirstChild(`{LocalPlayer.Name}_personal`)
        local Pending: {{Type: string, Expire: number}} = if Personal then table.clone(Stash) else {}
        if Personal then
            table.clear(Stash)
        end

        for _, v: {Type: string, Expire: number} in Pending do
            local Item: InventoryItem? = Inventory.Item(v.Type)
            if Item then
                task.spawn(function()
                    local Success: boolean, Result: any = pcall(function(): any
                        return Data.Controllers.ClientScript:GetNamespace("Inventory"):Get("ChestGiveItem"):CallServer(Personal, Item.tool)
                    end)
                    if not (Success and Result) and tick() < v.Expire then
                        table.insert(Stash, v)
                    end
                end)
            elseif tick() < v.Expire then
                table.insert(Stash, v)
            end
        end
    end

    AutoSteal = Cat.Categories.Inventory:CreateModule({
        Name = "AutoSteal",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            table.clear(Stash)
            if Callback then
                local Next: number = 0
                repeat
                    local Open: boolean = not GUI.Enabled or Data.Controllers.AppController:isAppOpen("ChestApp")
                    if Entity.Alive and Data.Storage.MatchState == 1 and tick() > Next and Open then
                        Next = tick() + Delay.Value
                        local Origin: Vector3 = Entity.RootPart.Position
                        local Team: any = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Team")
                        for _, v: Instance in Services.CollectionService:GetTagged("team-crate") do
                            if v:IsA("BasePart") and v:GetAttribute("Team") ~= Team and (Origin - v.Position).Magnitude <= Range.Value then
                                Steal(v)
                            end
                        end

                        for _, v: Instance in #Stash > 0 and Services.CollectionService:GetTagged("personal-chest") or {} do
                            if v:IsA("BasePart") and (Origin - v.Position).Magnitude <= Range.Value then
                                Deposit()
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    task.wait(0.1)
                until not AutoSteal.Enabled
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Takes the loot out of enemy team crates and puts it in your personal chest"
    })

    Range = AutoSteal:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Range",
        Min = 1,
        Max = 18,
        Default = 18,
        Suffix = function(Value: number): string
            return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
        end
    })
    Delay = AutoSteal:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Delay",
        Min = 0,
        Max = 1,
        Default = 0,
        Decimal = 100,
        Suffix = "s"
    })
    GUI = AutoSteal:CreateToggle({
        Name = "GUI check",
        Tooltip = "Only steals while a chest menu is open"
    })
end)()

BundledModules.FastConsume = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services
    local LocalPlayer: Player = Services.Players.LocalPlayer

    local FastConsume
    local Value

    local OldStart, OldShow

    FastConsume = Cat.Categories.Inventory:CreateModule({
        Name = "FastConsume",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback then
                OldStart, OldShow = Data.Controllers.ClickHold.startClick, Data.Controllers.ClickHold.showProgress

                Data.Controllers.ClickHold.startClick = function(self: any)
                    self.startedClickTime = tick()

                    local Duration: number = math.max(self.durationSeconds * (Value.Value / 40), self.durationSeconds - 0.2)
                    local Handle: any = self:showProgress(Duration)
                    local Clicked: number = self.startedClickTime
                    task.defer(function()
                        task.wait(Duration)
                        if Handle == self.handle and Clicked == self.startedClickTime and self.closeOnComplete then
                            self:hideProgress()
                            if self.onComplete then
                                self.onComplete()
                            end
                            if self.onPartialComplete then
                                self.onPartialComplete(1)
                            end

                            self.startedClickTime = -1
                        end
                    end)
                end

                Data.Controllers.ClickHold.showProgress = function(self: any, Duration: number): any
                    local Roact: any = debug.getupvalue(OldShow :: (...any) -> ...any, 1)
                    local Countdown: any = Roact.mount(Roact.createElement("ScreenGui", {}, {
                        Roact.createElement("Frame", {
                            [Roact.Ref] = self.wrapperRef,
                            Size = UDim2.new(),
                            Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.55),
                            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
                            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
                            BackgroundTransparency = 0.8
                        }, {
                            Roact.createElement("Frame", {
                                [Roact.Ref] = self.progressRef,
                                Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1),
                                BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
                                BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
                            })
                        })
                    }), LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui"))

                    self.handle = Countdown

                    local Grow: Tween = Services.TweenService:Create(self.wrapperRef:getValue(), TweenInfo.new(0.1), {Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.11, 0.005)})
                    local Fill: Tween = Services.TweenService:Create(self.progressRef:getValue(), TweenInfo.new(Duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)})
                    Grow:Play()
                    Fill:Play()
                    table.insert(self.tweens, Fill)
                    table.insert(self.tweens, Grow)

                    return Countdown
                end
            else
                if OldStart and OldShow then
                    Data.Controllers.ClickHold.startClick = OldStart
                    Data.Controllers.ClickHold.showProgress = OldShow
                end

                OldStart, OldShow = nil, nil
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Makes you use/consume quicker"
    })

    Value = FastConsume:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Multiplier",
        Min = 0,
        Max = 100,
        Tooltip = "40 is normal speed, lower is faster\nThe server throws away anything finished more than about 0.25s early, so it never goes past 0.2s faster"
    })
end)()

BundledModules.BedAlarm = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity

    local BedAlarm
    local Highlight, Pearls, Range, Volume

    local PearlTypes: {string} = {"telepearl", "boba_pearl", "teleport_hat"}
    local Params: RaycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    Params.RespectCanCollide = true
    local Highlighted: {[Model]: boolean} = {}
    local Alerted: number = 0

    local function FindBed(): BasePart?
        if not Entity.Alive then
            return nil
        end

        for _, v: BasePart in Services.CollectionService:GetTagged("bed") do
            if tonumber(v:GetAttribute("TeamId")) == tonumber(Services.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Team")) then
                return v
            end
        end

        return nil
    end

    local function Alert(Message: string, Bed: BasePart, Intruders: {Target})
        Alerted = os.clock() + 3.05

        if Highlight.Enabled then
            for _, v: Target in Intruders do
                if v.Player and v.Character and not Highlighted[v.Character] then
                    Highlighted[v.Character] = true
                    Data.Controllers.BedAlarmController:addIntruderPlayerHighlight(v.Player)
                end
            end
        end

        local Near: boolean = (Entity.RootPart.Position - Bed.Position).Magnitude < 30
        Data.Controllers.NotificationController:sendInfoNotification({message = Message})
        Data.Controllers.AudioManager:playAudio(Near and Data.Instances.Sounds.BED_ALARM or Data.Instances.Sounds.BED_ALARM_TRIGGERED_FAR, {
            volumeMultiplier = Volume.Value,
            position = Near and Bed.Position or nil,
            rollOffMaxDistance = 100
        })
    end

    BedAlarm = Cat.Legit:CreateModule({
        Name = "BedAlarm",
        Category = "Game",
        Icon = "legit_bedalarm",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback then
                Alerted = 0

                local Launched: any = Data.Instances.SyncEvents.ProjectileLaunched:connect(function(Event: {projectileType: string, origin: Vector3, launchVelocity: Vector3, shooter: Instance})
                    if Pearls.Enabled and table.find(PearlTypes, Event.projectileType) and typeof(Event.origin) == "Vector3" and typeof(Event.launchVelocity) == "Vector3" then
                        local Shooter: Target?
                        local Ignore: {Instance} = {Event.shooter}
                        for _, v: Target in Entity.Entities do
                            table.insert(Ignore, v.Character :: Model)

                            if v.Character == Event.shooter and v.TargetCheck() then
                                Shooter = v
                            end
                        end

                        local Bed: BasePart? = Shooter and FindBed()
                        if Bed and os.clock() >= Alerted then
                            local Meta: any = Data.Instances.ProjectileMeta[Event.projectileType]
                            local Drop: Vector3 = Vector3.new(0, -(Meta and Meta.gravitationalAcceleration or 196.2), 0)
                            local Landing: Vector3 = Event.origin
                            Params.FilterDescendantsInstances = Ignore

                            for Step: number = 1, 100 do
                                local Time: number = Step * 0.05
                                local Point: Vector3 = Event.origin + Event.launchVelocity * Time + Drop * (0.5 * Time * Time)
                                local Hit: RaycastResult? = workspace:Raycast(Landing, Point - Landing, Params)
                                if Hit then
                                    Landing = Hit.Position

                                    break
                                end

                                Landing = Point
                            end

                            if (Landing - Bed.Position).Magnitude <= Range.Value then
                                Alert("[Bed Alarm]: An intruder pearled to your bed!", Bed, {Shooter :: Target})
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
                BedAlarm:Clean(function()
                    Launched:Destroy()
                end)

                repeat
                    local Bed: BasePart? = FindBed()
                    local Intruders: {Target} = Bed and Entity.Targets({
                        Origin = Bed.Position,
                        Range = Range.Value,
                        Players = true
                    }) or {}

                    if Bed and Intruders[1] and os.clock() > Alerted then
                        Alert("[Bed Alarm]: An intruder is near your bed!", Bed, Intruders)
                    end

                    task.wait(0.1)
                until not BedAlarm.Enabled
            else
                table.clear(Highlighted)
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Notifies when an enemy is near your bed"
    })

    Highlight = BedAlarm:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Highlight intruders",
        Default = true,
        Tooltip = "Outlines the intruders through walls\n(just like bedwars own bed alarm)"
    })
    Pearls = BedAlarm:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Pearl detection",
        Default = true,
        Tooltip = "Also alarms the moment an enemy throws a pearl that lands at your bed"
    })
    Range = BedAlarm:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Range",
        Min = 1,
        Max = 100,
        Default = 70,
        Suffix = function(Value: number): string
            return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
        end
    })
    Volume = BedAlarm:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Volume multiplier",
        Min = 0.1,
        Max = 2,
        Default = 1.4,
        Decimal = 100
    })
end)()

BundledModules.BedBreakEffect = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local BedBreakEffect
    local List

    local Ids: {[string]: string} = {}
    local Names: {string} = {}
    local Token: number = 0

    BedBreakEffect = Cat.Legit:CreateModule({
        Name = "BedBreakEffect",
        Category = "Game",
        Icon = "legit_bedbreakeffect",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            Token += 1

            if Callback and firesignal then
                local Current: number = Token
                Data.Controllers.ClientScript:WaitFor("BedwarsBedBreak"):andThen(function(Connection: any)
                    if Token == Current then
                        BedBreakEffect:Clean(Connection:Connect(function(Event: {player: Player?, bedBlockPosition: Vector3, brokenBedTeam: {id: string}})
                            firesignal(Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("BedBreakEffectTriggered").Remote.instance.OnClientEvent, {
                                player = Event.player,
                                cframe = CFrame.new(Event.bedBlockPosition * 3),
                                effectType = Ids[List.Value],
                                teamId = Event.brokenBedTeam.id,
                                centerBedPosition = Event.bedBlockPosition * 3
                            })
                        end))
                    end
                end)
            elseif Callback then
                Cat:CreateNotification("Bed Break Effect", "This executor can't trigger the game's bed break effect", 5)
                BedBreakEffect:Toggle()
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Plays any bed break effect you pick when you break a bed"
    })

    for Id: string, v: {name: string} in Data.Instances.BedBreakEffectMeta do
        table.insert(Names, v.name)
        Ids[v.name] = Id
    end

    table.sort(Names)
    List = BedBreakEffect:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Effect",
        List = Names
    })
end)()

BundledModules.CrossHair = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local CrossHair
    local Mode, Cursor, Preset, Image
    local Length, Thickness, Gap, Rotation, Dot, TStyle, Color, Outline, OutlineColor

    local Holder: Frame?
    local Arms: {Frame} = {}
    local Presets: {[string]: string} = {
        PC = Data.Instances.Images.ui.hud.viewmodel_crosshair,
        Mobile = Data.Instances.Images.ui.mobile_controls.mobile_crosshairs,
        Turret = Data.Instances.Images.ui.common.turret_crosshair,
        ["Mouse lock"] = "rbxasset://textures/MouseLockedCursor.png"
    }

    local function Draw()
        if not Holder then
            return
        end

        local Back: CanvasGroup = Arms[1].Parent :: CanvasGroup
        local Front: CanvasGroup = Arms[6].Parent :: CanvasGroup
        local Near: number = 100 - math.floor(Thickness.Value / 2)
        local Far: number = Near + Thickness.Value
        local Size: number = Gap.Value == 0 and Length.Value > 0 and math.max(Dot.Value, Thickness.Value) or Dot.Value
        local Center: number = math.floor(100 + (Thickness.Value % 2 - Size) / 2)
        local Rects: {Rect} = {
            Rect.new(Near, Near - Gap.Value - Length.Value, Far, Near - Gap.Value),
            Rect.new(Near, Far + Gap.Value, Far, Far + Gap.Value + Length.Value),
            Rect.new(Near - Gap.Value - Length.Value, Near, Near - Gap.Value, Far),
            Rect.new(Far + Gap.Value, Near, Far + Gap.Value + Length.Value, Far),
            Rect.new(Center, Center, Center + Size, Center + Size)
        }

        Holder.Rotation = Rotation.Value
        Back.Visible = Outline.Enabled
        Back.GroupTransparency = 1 - OutlineColor.Opacity
        Front.GroupTransparency = 1 - Color.Opacity
        for Index: number, v: Frame in Arms do
            local Slot: number = (Index - 1) % 5 + 1
            local Border: number = Index <= 5 and 1 or 0

            v.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(Rects[Slot].Min.X - Border, Rects[Slot].Min.Y - Border)
            v.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(Rects[Slot].Width + Border * 2, Rects[Slot].Height + Border * 2)
            v.Visible = if Slot == 5 then Size > 0 else Length.Value > 0 and not (TStyle.Enabled and Slot == 1)
            v.BackgroundColor3 = Index <= 5 and Color3.fromHSV(OutlineColor.Hue, OutlineColor.Sat, OutlineColor.Value) or Color3.fromHSV(Color.Hue, Color.Sat, Color.Value)
        end
    end

    CrossHair = Cat.Legit:CreateModule({
        Name = "CrossHair",
        Category = "Game",
        Icon = "legit_crosshair",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            local Icon: string = Mode.Value == "Custom" and Cat.Ui:Icon("blank") or Presets[Preset.Value] or tonumber(Image.Value) and `rbxassetid://{Image.Value}` or Image.Value
            Data.Instances.Images.ui.hud.viewmodel_crosshair = Callback and Icon or Presets.PC
            Data.Instances.Images.ui.mobile_controls.mobile_crosshairs = Callback and Icon or Presets.Mobile

            if Callback and Mode.Value == "Custom" then
                local Frame: Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
                Frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
                Frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                Frame.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
                Frame.Visible = false
                Frame.Parent = Cat.Ui.Gui
                Holder = CrossHair:Clean(Frame)

                for Layer: number = 1, 2 do
                    local Group: CanvasGroup = Instance.new("CanvasGroup")
                    Group.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
                    Group.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                    Group.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
                    Group.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 200)
                    Group.ZIndex = Layer
                    Group.Parent = Frame

                    for _ = 1, 5 do
                        local Arm: Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
                        Arm.BorderSizePixel = 0
                        Arm.Parent = Group

                        table.insert(Arms, Arm)
                    end
                end

                Draw()

                CrossHair:Clean(Services.RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
                    local Shown: boolean = if Cursor.Enabled then Services.UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled else Data.Controllers.ViewmodelController.crosshair and not Data.Controllers.ViewmodelController.shiftlockActive
                    local Location: Vector2 = Services.UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
                    local Position: UDim2 = Cursor.Enabled and UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(Location.X), math.floor(Location.Y)) or UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)

                    if Frame.Visible ~= Shown then
                        Frame.Visible = Shown
                    end
                    if Frame.Position ~= Position then
                        Frame.Position = Position
                    end
                end))

                if Cursor.Enabled then
                    Services.UserInputService.OverrideMouseIconBehavior = Enum.OverrideMouseIconBehavior.ForceHide
                    CrossHair:Clean(Services.UserInputService:GetPropertyChangedSignal("OverrideMouseIconBehavior"):Connect(function()
                        if Services.UserInputService.OverrideMouseIconBehavior == Enum.OverrideMouseIconBehavior.None then
                            Services.UserInputService.OverrideMouseIconBehavior = Enum.OverrideMouseIconBehavior.ForceHide
                        end
                    end))
                    CrossHair:Clean(function()
                        if Services.UserInputService.OverrideMouseIconBehavior == Enum.OverrideMouseIconBehavior.ForceHide then
                            Services.UserInputService.OverrideMouseIconBehavior = Enum.OverrideMouseIconBehavior.None
                        end
                    end)
                end
            elseif not Callback then
                Holder = nil
                table.clear(Arms)
            end

            if Data.Controllers.ViewmodelController.crosshair then
                Data.Controllers.ViewmodelController:hideCrosshair()
                Data.Controllers.ViewmodelController:showCrosshair()
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Swaps the first person crosshair for a game image or one you build yourself"
    })

    Mode = CrossHair:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Mode",
        List = {"Custom", "Image"},
        Default = "Custom",
        Function = function(Value: string)
            if OutlineColor then
                for _, v: any in {Cursor, Length, Thickness, Gap, Rotation, Dot, TStyle, Color, Outline} do
                    v.Object.Visible = Value == "Custom"
                end

                OutlineColor.Object.Visible = Value == "Custom" and Outline.Enabled
                Preset.Object.Visible = Value == "Image"
                Image.Object.Visible = Value == "Image" and Preset.Value == "Image ID"
            end

            if CrossHair.Enabled then
                CrossHair:Toggle()
                CrossHair:Toggle()
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Custom - Draws your own crosshair from the options below\nImage - Uses one of the game's crosshairs or any image id"
    })
    Cursor = CrossHair:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Mouse",
        Function = function()
            if CrossHair.Enabled then
                CrossHair:Toggle()
                CrossHair:Toggle()
            end
        end,
        Visible = Mode.Value == "Custom",
        Tooltip = "Uses the crosshair as your mouse too, in third person and menus"
    })
    Preset = CrossHair:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Image",
        List = {"PC", "Mobile", "Turret", "Mouse lock", "Image ID"},
        Default = "PC",
        Function = function(Value: string)
            if Image then
                Image.Object.Visible = Value == "Image ID"
            end

            if CrossHair.Enabled then
                CrossHair:Toggle()
                CrossHair:Toggle()
            end
        end,
        Darker = true,
        Visible = Mode.Value == "Image"
    })
    Image = CrossHair:CreateTextBox({
        Name = "Image ID",
        Placeholder = "roblox image id",
        Function = function(_, Enter: boolean?)
            if Enter and CrossHair.Enabled then
                CrossHair:Toggle()
                CrossHair:Toggle()
            end
        end,
        Darker = true,
        Visible = Mode.Value == "Image" and Preset.Value == "Image ID"
    })
    Length = CrossHair:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Length",
        Min = 0,
        Max = 40,
        Default = 8,
        Suffix = "px",
        Function = Draw,
        Visible = Mode.Value == "Custom",
        Tooltip = "0 hides the lines, pair it with Dot for a dot only crosshair"
    })
    Thickness = CrossHair:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Thickness",
        Min = 1,
        Max = 10,
        Default = 2,
        Suffix = "px",
        Function = Draw,
        Visible = Mode.Value == "Custom"
    })
    Gap = CrossHair:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Gap",
        Min = 0,
        Max = 40,
        Default = 4,
        Suffix = "px",
        Function = Draw,
        Visible = Mode.Value == "Custom"
    })
    Rotation = CrossHair:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Rotation",
        Min = 0,
        Max = 90,
        Default = 0,
        Suffix = "degrees",
        Function = Draw,
        Visible = Mode.Value == "Custom"
    })
    Dot = CrossHair:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Dot",
        Min = 0,
        Max = 10,
        Default = 0,
        Suffix = "px",
        Function = Draw,
        Visible = Mode.Value == "Custom",
        Tooltip = "Size of the center dot, 0 hides it"
    })
    TStyle = CrossHair:CreateToggle({
        Name = "T Style",
        Function = Draw,
        Visible = Mode.Value == "Custom",

BundledModules.DamageIndicator = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local DamageIndicator
    local FontOption, Color, Size, Hold, Outline

    local Settings: {[string]: any}?
    local Index: number?
    local Old: {[string]: any} = {}
    local OldFont: EnumItem?

    DamageIndicator = Cat.Legit:CreateModule({
        Name = "DamageIndicator",
        Category = "Game",
        Icon = "legit_damageindicator",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if not Settings or not Index then
                for _, v: any in debug.getupvalues(Data.Controllers.DamageIndicatorController.spawnDamageIndicator) do
                    if type(v) == "table" and rawget(v, "textSize") and rawget(v, "baseColor") then
                        Settings = v

                        break
                    end
                end

                for i: number, v: any in debug.getconstants(Data.Controllers.DamageIndicatorController.spawnDamageIndicator) do
                    if typeof(v) == "EnumItem" and v.EnumType == Enum.Font then
                        Index = i

                        break
                    end
                end
            end

            if Settings and Index then
                if Callback then
                    Old, OldFont = table.clone(Settings), debug.getconstant(Data.Controllers.DamageIndicatorController.spawnDamageIndicator, Index)
                    debug.setconstant(Data.Controllers.DamageIndicatorController.spawnDamageIndicator, Index, (Enum.Font :: any)[FontOption.Value])

                    Settings.strokeThickness = Outline.Enabled and 1.5 or 0
                    Settings.textSize = Size.Value
                    Settings.blowUpSize = Size.Value
                    Settings.blowUpDuration = 0
                    Settings.blowUpCompleteDuration = 0
                    Settings.baseColor = Color3.fromHSV(Color.Hue, Color.Sat, Color.Value)
                    Settings.anchoredDuration = Hold.Value
                else
                    for Key: string, v: any in Old do
                        Settings[Key] = v
                    end

                    if OldFont then
                        debug.setconstant(Data.Controllers.DamageIndicatorController.spawnDamageIndicator, Index, OldFont)
                    end

                    table.clear(Old)
                    OldFont = nil
                end
            elseif Callback then
                Cat:CreateNotification("DamageIndicator", "Couldn't find the damage indicator settings, the game probably updated", 5)
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Restyles the damage numbers that pop out when you hit someone"
    })

    FontOption = DamageIndicator:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Font",
        List = (function(): {string}
            local List: {string} = {"GothamBlack"}
            for _, v: EnumItem in Enum.Font:GetEnumItems() do
                if v ~= Enum.Font.Unknown and not table.find(List, v.Name) then
                    table.insert(List, v.Name)
                end
            end

            return List
        end)(),
        Function = function(Value: string)
            if DamageIndicator.Enabled and Index then
                debug.setconstant(Data.Controllers.DamageIndicatorController.spawnDamageIndicator, Index, (Enum.Font :: any)[Value])
            end
        end
    })
    Color = DamageIndicator:CreateColorSlider({
        Name = "Color",
        DefaultHue = 0.01,
        DefaultSat = 0.73,
        Function = function(Hue: number, Sat: number, Value: number)
            if DamageIndicator.Enabled and Settings then
                Settings.baseColor = Color3.fromHSV(Hue, Sat, Value)
            end
        end
    })
    Size = DamageIndicator:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Size",
        Min = 8,
        Max = 64,
        Default = 28,
        Suffix = "px",
        Function = function(Value: number)
            if DamageIndicator.Enabled and Settings then
                Settings.textSize = Value
                Settings.blowUpSize = Value
            end
        end
    })
    Hold = DamageIndicator:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Hold",
        Min = 0,
        Max = 1,
        Default = 0.4,
        Decimal = 10,
        Suffix = "s",
        Function = function(Value: number)
            if DamageIndicator.Enabled and Settings then
                Settings.anchoredDuration = Value
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "How long the number stays put before it floats away"
    })
    Outline = DamageIndicator:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Outline",
        Default = true,
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if DamageIndicator.Enabled and Settings then
                Settings.strokeThickness = Callback and 1.5 or 0
            end
        end
    })
end)()

BundledModules.FOV = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Camera: Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

    local Tween = BundledModules.Tween

    local FOV
    local Value

    local Original, OriginalGet

    FOV = Cat.Legit:CreateModule({
        Name = "FOV",
        Category = "Game",
        Icon = "legit_fov",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback then
                Original, OriginalGet = Data.Controllers.FovController.setFOV, Data.Controllers.FovController.getFOV
                Data.Controllers.FovController.setFOV = function(self: any, _: number?): ...any
                    local From: number = Camera.FieldOfView
                    local Call = Original(self, Value.Value)

                    Camera.FieldOfView = From
                    Tween(Camera, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {FieldOfView = self.fov})

                    return Call
                end
                Data.Controllers.FovController.getFOV = function(): number
                    return Value.Value
                end

                Data.Controllers.FovController:setFOV(Data.Controllers.Store:getState().Settings.fov)
            elseif Original then
                local OriginalFOV: number = Camera.FieldOfView
                Data.Controllers.FovController.setFOV, Data.Controllers.FovController.getFOV = Original, OriginalGet
                Data.Controllers.FovController:setFOV(Data.Controllers.Store:getState().Settings.fov)

                Camera.FieldOfView = OriginalFOV
                Tween(Camera, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {FieldOfView = Data.Controllers.FovController.fov})

                Original, OriginalGet = nil, nil
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Changes how wide your camera sees"
    })

    Value = FOV:CreateSlider({
        Name = "FOV",
        Min = 30,
        Max = 120,
        Default = 90,
        Suffix = "degrees",
        Function = function()
            if FOV.Enabled then
                Data.Controllers.FovController:setFOV(Data.Controllers.Store:getState().Settings.fov)
            end
        end
    })
end)()

BundledModules.HitColor = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local HitColor

    local Fill: Color3 = Color3.new(1, 0, 0)
    local Transparency: number = 0.4
    local Tinted: {[Highlight]: boolean} = {}

    local function Refresh()
        for Highlight: Highlight in Tinted do
            if Highlight.Parent then
                Highlight.FillColor, Highlight.FillTransparency = Fill, Transparency
            else
                Tinted[Highlight] = nil
            end
        end
    end

    HitColor = Cat.Legit:CreateModule({
        Name = "HitColor",
        Category = "Game",
        Icon = "legit_hitcolor",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback then
                HitColor:Clean(Data.Events.EntityDamageEvent:Connect(function(Event: {entityInstance: Model?})
                    local Character: Model? = Event.entityInstance
                    if not Character then
                        return
                    end

                    task.defer(function()
                        local Highlight: Instance? = HitColor.Enabled and Character:FindFirstChild("_DamageHighlight_") or nil
                        if Highlight and Highlight:IsA("Highlight") then
                            Tinted[Highlight] = true
                            Highlight.FillColor, Highlight.FillTransparency = Fill, Transparency
                        end
                    end)
                end))
            else
                for Highlight: Highlight in Tinted do
                    if Highlight.Parent then
                        Highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
                        Highlight.FillTransparency = 0.4
                    end
                end
                table.clear(Tinted)
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Changes the color of the flash players get when they take damage"
    })

    HitColor:CreateColorSlider({
        Name = "Color",
        DefaultHue = 0,
        DefaultSat = 1,
        DefaultValue = 1,
        DefaultOpacity = 0.6,
        Function = function(Hue: number, Sat: number, Value: number, Opacity: number)
            Fill, Transparency = Color3.fromHSV(Hue, Sat, Value), 1 - Opacity
            if HitColor and HitColor.Enabled then
                Refresh()
            end
        end
    })
end)()

BundledModules.HitFix = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local HitFix

    local Constant: number?
    local Upvalue: number?

    HitFix = Cat.Legit:CreateModule({
        Name = "HitFix",
        Category = "Game",
        Icon = "legit_hitfix",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            local Sword: any = Data.Controllers.SwordController
            if not Constant or not Upvalue then
                for i: number, v: any in debug.getconstants(Sword.swingSwordAtMouse) do
                    if v == "Raycast" or v == "raycast" then
                        Constant = i

                        break
                    end
                end

                for i: number, v: any in debug.getupvalues(Sword.swingSwordAtMouse) do
                    if v == workspace or v == Data.Controllers.GameQueryUtil then
                        Upvalue = i

                        break
                    end
                end
            end

            if Constant and Upvalue then
                debug.setconstant(Sword.swingSwordAtMouse, Constant, Callback and "raycast" or "Raycast")
                debug.setupvalue(Sword.swingSwordAtMouse, Upvalue, Callback and Data.Controllers.GameQueryUtil or workspace)
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Lines your hits up with the game's own raycast"
    })
end)()

BundledModules.NoClickDelay = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local NoClickDelay
    local Delay

    local Old, Last = nil, 0

    NoClickDelay = Cat.Legit:CreateModule({
        Name = "NoClickDelay",
        Category = "Game",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            local Sword = Data.Controllers.SwordController
            if Callback then
                Old = Sword.isClickingTooFast
                Sword.isClickingTooFast = function(self): boolean
                    if tick() - Last < 1 / Delay.Value then
                        return true
                    end

                    Last = tick()
                    self.lastSwing = tick()

                    return false
                end
            elseif Old then
                Sword.isClickingTooFast, Old = Old, nil
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Removes the 9 clicks a second cap the client puts on swinging"
    })

    Delay = NoClickDelay:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Delay",
        Min = 1,
        Max = 30,
        Default = 20,
        Suffix = "CPS",
        Tooltip = "Highest clicks per second a swing still goes through at"
    })
end)()

BundledModules.PotionStatus = (function()
    local UI = BundledModules.UI
    local Cat = UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity

    local PotionStatus
    local ShowPositive, ShowNegative, Background, BackgroundColor

    local Effects: {[string]: number} = {}
    local Seen: {[string]: boolean} = {}
    local Replacements: {[string]: string} = {
        speed = "rbxassetid://71873445837330"
    }
    local Negative: {[string]: boolean} = {
        bleed = true,
        burn = true,
        cold = true,
        curse_of_the_altar = true,
        decay = true,
        dizzy = true,
        feeble = true,
        frost_bite = true,
        frosted = true,
        frozen = true,
        grave_trap = true,
        greased = true,
        grounded = true,
        grounded_enchant = true,
        hungry = true,
        infected_poison = true,
        isabel_shield_broken = true,
        lunar_venom = true,
        mage_burn = true,
        oil_spilled = true,
        oiled = true,
        on_ice = true,
        owl_target = true,
        poison = true,
        powdered = true,
        shield_down = true,
        shrink = true,
        silas_halloween_hex = true,
        silence = true,
        skeleton_poison = true,
        snae_poison_arrow = true,
        snake_poison_sword = true,
        soaked = true,
        SPIDER_WEB_SLOW = true,
        stacking_decay = true,
        Vengeful_venom = true,
        void_hunter_marked = true,
        weak_armor = true,
        werewolf_fear = true,
        zapped_1 = true,
        zapped_2 = true,
        zapped_3 = true
    }
    local Holder: Frame

    local function Text(Parent: Instance, Position: UDim2, Size: number, Color: Color3, Shadow: boolean): TextLabel
        local Label: TextLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        Label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        Label.FontFace = UI.Font
        Label.Position = Position
        Label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(108, 20)
        Label.TextColor3 = Color
        Label.TextSize = Size
        Label.TextTransparency = Shadow and 0.5 or 0
        Label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        Label.ZIndex = Shadow and 0 or 1
        Label.Parent = Parent

        return Label
    end

    local function Added(Active: {statusEffect: string, expireTime: number})
        Effects[Active.statusEffect] = Active.expireTime
        local Duration: number = Active.expireTime - workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
        local Meta: any = Data.Instances.Items[Active.statusEffect] or Data.Instances.Items[`{Active.statusEffect}_potion`]
        local Effect: Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
        Effect.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        Effect.Parent = Holder

        local Ring: Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
        Ring.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        Ring.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 4)
        Ring.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(50, 50)
        Ring.Parent = Effect

        local Backing: Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
        Backing.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        Backing.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4.5, 4.5)
        Backing.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(41, 41)
        Backing.Parent = Ring

        local BackingCorner: UICorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        BackingCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        BackingCorner.Parent = Backing

        local BackingStroke: UIStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        BackingStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        BackingStroke.Thickness = 3.6
        BackingStroke.Transparency = 0.216
        BackingStroke.Parent = Backing

        local Gradients: {[string]: UIGradient} = {}
        local Strokes: {[string]: UIStroke} = {}
        for _, Side: string in {"Left", "Right"} do
            local Clip: Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
            Clip.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            Clip.ClipsDescendants = true
            Clip.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(Side == "Right" and 25 or 0, 0)
            Clip.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(25, 50)
            Clip.Parent = Ring

            local Arc: Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
            Arc.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            Arc.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(Side == "Right" and -21 or 4, 4)
            Arc.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(42, 42)
            Arc.Parent = Clip

            local ArcCorner: UICorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
            ArcCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
            ArcCorner.Parent = Arc

            local ArcStroke: UIStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
            ArcStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(5, 134, 105)
            ArcStroke.Thickness = 4
            ArcStroke.Parent = Arc

            local ArcGradient: UIGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
            ArcGradient.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.501, 1),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)
            })
            ArcGradient.Parent = ArcStroke

            Gradients[Side] = ArcGradient
            Strokes[Side] = ArcStroke
        end

        local Sidebar: Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
        Sidebar.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
        Sidebar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 170)
        Sidebar.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
        Sidebar.BorderSizePixel = 0
        Sidebar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 53, 0.5, 1)
        Sidebar.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 27)
        Sidebar.Parent = Effect

        local Image: ImageLabel = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
        Image.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
        Image.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        Image.Image = Replacements[Active.statusEffect] or (Meta and Meta.image) or Data.Instances.ImageList.POTION_ART
        Image.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0.5, 0)
        Image.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 30)
        Image.Parent = Effect

        local Title: string = (`{Active.statusEffect:sub(1, 1):upper()}{Active.statusEffect:sub(2)}`):gsub("_", " ")
        Text(Effect, UDim2.fromOffset(67, 10), 15, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), false).Text = Title
        Text(Effect, UDim2.fromOffset(68, 11), 15, Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0), true).Text = Title
        Effect.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(UI.Context:Measure(Title, 15, UI.Font).X + 80, 57)

        local Time: TextLabel = Text(Effect, UDim2.fromOffset(67, 29), 14, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), false)
        local TimeShadow: TextLabel = Text(Effect, UDim2.fromOffset(68, 30), 14, Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0), true)
        Time.Text = "00:00"
        TimeShadow.Text = "00:00"

        local Seconds: number = 0
        local ShownSeconds: number?
        local ShownColor: Color3?
        repeat
            local Remaining: number = math.max(Active.expireTime - workspace:GetServerTimeNow(), 0)
            local Percent: number = Remaining / Duration
            local Tint: Color3 = Percent > 0.5 and Color3.fromRGB(5, 134, 105) or (Percent > 0.25 and Color3.fromRGB(236, 129, 44) or Color3.fromRGB(250, 50, 56))
            local Theta: number = math.min(Percent, 1) * 360
            Seconds = math.floor(Remaining)
            Gradients.Left.Rotation = math.clamp(Theta, 180, 360)
            Gradients.Right.Rotation = math.clamp(Theta, 0, 180)

            if Tint ~= ShownColor then
                ShownColor = Tint
                Strokes.Left.Color = Tint
                Strokes.Right.Color = Tint
                Time.TextColor3 = Tint
            end
            if Seconds ~= ShownSeconds then
                ShownSeconds = Seconds
                Time.Text = string.format("%02d:%02d", Seconds // 60, Seconds % 60)
                TimeShadow.Text = Time.Text
            end

            task.wait()
        until Seconds <= 0 or Effects[Active.statusEffect] ~= Active.expireTime or not PotionStatus.Enabled

        Effect:Destroy()

        if Effects[Active.statusEffect] == Active.expireTime then
            Effects[Active.statusEffect] = nil
        end
    end

    PotionStatus = Cat.Legit:CreateModule({
        Name = "PotionStatus",
        Category = "HUD",
        Icon = "legit_potionstatus",
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(240, 64),
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback then
                repeat
                    table.clear(Seen)

                    if Entity.Alive then
                        for _, v: {statusEffect: string, expireTime: number?} in Data.Controllers.StatusEffectUtil:getAllActive(Services.LocalPlayer.Character) do
                            local Harmful: boolean = Negative[v.statusEffect] == true
                            if (v.expireTime or 0) - workspace:GetServerTimeNow() > 0 and (Harmful and ShowNegative.Enabled or not Harmful and ShowPositive.Enabled) then
                                Seen[v.statusEffect] = true

                                if Effects[v.statusEffect] ~= v.expireTime then
                                    task.spawn(Added, v)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    for Effect: string in Effects do
                        if not Seen[Effect] then
                            Effects[Effect] = nil
                        end
                    end

                    task.wait(0.1)
                until not PotionStatus.Enabled
            else
                table.clear(Effects)
                table.clear(Seen)
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Shows your currently active effects"
    })

    Holder = PotionStatus.Children
    Holder.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    Holder.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5

    local HolderCorner: UICorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    HolderCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
    HolderCorner.Parent = Holder

    local Layout: UIListLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    Layout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left
    Layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    Layout.Parent = Holder

    Cat:Clean(Layout:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(function()
        Holder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(Layout.AbsoluteContentSize.X, Layout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y)
    end))

    ShowPositive = PotionStatus:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Show Positive Effects",
        Default = true
    })
    ShowNegative = PotionStatus:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Show Negative Effects",
        Default = true
    })
    Background = PotionStatus:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Render background",
        Default = true,
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if BackgroundColor then
                Holder.BackgroundTransparency = Callback and 1 - BackgroundColor.Opacity or 1
                BackgroundColor.Object.Visible = Callback
            end
        end
    })
    BackgroundColor = PotionStatus:CreateColorSlider({
        Name = "Background Color",
        DefaultValue = 0,
        DefaultOpacity = 0.5,
        Function = function(Hue: number, Sat: number, Value: number, Opacity: number)
            Holder.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(Hue, Sat, Value)
            Holder.BackgroundTransparency = Background.Enabled and 1 - Opacity or 1
        end,
        Darker = true
    })
end)()

BundledModules.ReachDisplay = (function()

        Name = "ReachDisplay",
        Category = "HUD",

        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback then
                ReachDisplay:Clean(Data.Events.EntityDamageEvent:Connect(function(Event: {entityInstance: Model?, fromEntity: Instance?})
                    if Event.fromEntity == Services.LocalPlayer.Character and Event.entityInstance and Event.entityInstance.PrimaryPart and Entity.Alive then
                        Reach = string.format("%.2f", (Entity.RootPart.Position - Event.entityInstance.PrimaryPart.Position).Magnitude)
                        Expire = tick() + 1
                    end
                end))

                repeat
                    Label.Text = `{Expire > tick() and Reach or "0.00"} studs`
                    task.wait(0.1)
                until not ReachDisplay.Enabled
            else
                Expire = 0
                Label.Text = "0.00 studs"
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Shows how far away you were from the last player you hit"
    })

    Label = HudText(ReachDisplay, "0.00 studs")
end)()

BundledModules.ViewModel = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services
    local LocalPlayer: Player = Services.LocalPlayer

    local ViewModel
    local Depth, Horizontal, Vertical, Size, NoBob, Visuals, FillColor, OutlineColor
    local Rotations: {Slider} = {}

    local Original, OriginalC1, Rig
    local RootJoint, RootC0, RootOffset

    local Highlights: {Highlight} = {}

    local function Highlight(Accessory: Instance)
        local Handle: Instance? = Accessory:FindFirstChild("Handle")
        if not Handle then
            return
        end

        local Glow: Highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
        Glow.FillColor = Color3.fromHSV(FillColor.Hue, FillColor.Sat, FillColor.Value)
        Glow.FillTransparency = 1 - FillColor.Opacity
        Glow.OutlineColor = Color3.fromHSV(OutlineColor.Hue, OutlineColor.Sat, OutlineColor.Value)
        Glow.OutlineTransparency = 1 - OutlineColor.Opacity
        Glow.Parent = Handle

        table.insert(Highlights, Glow)
    end

    local function Start()
        local Model: any
        repeat
            Model = workspace.CurrentCamera:FindFirstChild("Viewmodel")
            if not Model then
                task.wait(0.1)
            end
        until Model or not ViewModel.Enabled

        if Model and ViewModel.Enabled and Rig ~= Model then
            Rig = Model
            Model:ScaleTo(1)
            OriginalC1 = Model.RightHand.RightWrist.C1
            Model.RightHand.RightWrist.C1 = OriginalC1 * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(Rotations[1].Value), math.rad(Rotations[2].Value), math.rad(Rotations[3].Value))

            local LowerTorso: Instance? = Model:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso")
            local Accessory: Instance? = Model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Accessory")
            local Reference: any = Accessory and Accessory:FindFirstChild("Handle") or Model:FindFirstChild("RightHand")

            RootJoint = LowerTorso and LowerTorso:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Motor6D")
            RootC0 = RootJoint and RootJoint.C0
            RootOffset = Reference and Model.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(Reference.Position)
            Model:ScaleTo(Size.Value)
            if RootJoint and RootC0 and RootOffset then
                RootJoint.C0 = (RootC0 - RootC0.Position) + (RootC0.Position * Size.Value) + (RootOffset * (1 - Size.Value))
            end

            if Visuals.Enabled then
                for _, v: Instance in Model:GetChildren() do
                    if v:IsA("Accessory") then
                        Highlight(v)
                    end
                end
            end

            ViewModel:Clean(Model.ChildAdded:Connect(function(Child: Instance)
                if Child:IsA("Accessory") then
                    if Visuals.Enabled then
                        for i: number = #Highlights, 1, -1 do
                            if not Highlights[i].Parent then
                                table.remove(Highlights, i)
                            end
                        end

                        Highlight(Child)
                    end

                    if Size.Value ~= 1 then
                        if Data.Storage.MatchState == 0 then
                            repeat
                                task.wait()
                            until Data.Storage.MatchState ~= 0

                            task.wait(0.5)
                        end

                        Data.Controllers.ScaleModel.scaleTool(Child, Size.Value)
                    end
                end
            end))

            Data.Controllers.InventoryViewmodelController:handleStore(Data.Controllers.Store:getState())
        end
    end

    ViewModel = Cat.Legit:CreateModule({
        Name = "ViewModel",
        Category = "Game",
        Icon = "legit_viewmodel",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback then
                if NoBob.Enabled then
                    Original = Data.Controllers.ViewmodelController.playAnimation
                    Data.Controllers.ViewmodelController.playAnimation = function(self: any, Type: number, ...: any): ...any
                        if Type == Data.Instances.Animations.FP_WALK then
                            return
                        end

                        return Original(self, Type, ...)
                    end
                end

                ViewModel:Clean(workspace.CurrentCamera.ChildAdded:Connect(function(Child: Instance)
                    if Child.Name == "Viewmodel" then
                        Start()
                    end
                end))

                for Name: string, v: number in {DEPTH_OFFSET = -Depth.Value, HORIZONTAL_OFFSET = Horizontal.Value, VERTICAL_OFFSET = Vertical.Value} do
                    LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.TS.controllers.global.viewmodel["viewmodel-controller"]:SetAttribute(`ConstantManager_{Name}`, v)
                end

                Start()
            else
                local Model: any = workspace.CurrentCamera:FindFirstChild("Viewmodel")
                if Original then
                    Data.Controllers.ViewmodelController.playAnimation = Original
                    Original = nil
                end

                if Model and OriginalC1 then
                    Model:ScaleTo(1)
                    Model.RightHand.RightWrist.C1 = OriginalC1

                    if RootJoint and RootC0 then
                        RootJoint.C0 = RootC0
                    end
                end

                for _, v: Highlight in Highlights do
                    v:Destroy()
                end

                for _, Name: string in {"DEPTH_OFFSET", "HORIZONTAL_OFFSET", "VERTICAL_OFFSET"} do
                    LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.TS.controllers.global.viewmodel["viewmodel-controller"]:SetAttribute(`ConstantManager_{Name}`, 0)
                end

                OriginalC1, Rig, RootJoint, RootC0, RootOffset = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
                table.clear(Highlights)

                Data.Controllers.InventoryViewmodelController:handleStore(Data.Controllers.Store:getState())
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Moves, resizes and restyles your first person hand"
    })

    Depth = ViewModel:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Depth",
        Min = 0,
        Max = 2,
        Default = 0.8,
        Decimal = 10,
        Function = function(Value: number)
            if ViewModel.Enabled then
                LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.TS.controllers.global.viewmodel["viewmodel-controller"]:SetAttribute("ConstantManager_DEPTH_OFFSET", -Value)
            end
        end
    })
    Horizontal = ViewModel:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Horizontal",
        Min = 0,
        Max = 2,
        Default = 0.8,
        Decimal = 10,
        Function = function(Value: number)
            if ViewModel.Enabled then
                LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.TS.controllers.global.viewmodel["viewmodel-controller"]:SetAttribute("ConstantManager_HORIZONTAL_OFFSET", Value)
            end
        end
    })
    Vertical = ViewModel:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Vertical",
        Min = -0.2,
        Max = 2,
        Default = -0.2,
        Decimal = 10,
        Function = function(Value: number)
            if ViewModel.Enabled then
                LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.TS.controllers.global.viewmodel["viewmodel-controller"]:SetAttribute("ConstantManager_VERTICAL_OFFSET", Value)
            end
        end
    })
    Size = ViewModel:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Size",
        Min = 0.1,
        Max = 2,
        Default = 1,
        Decimal = 10,
        Function = function(Value: number)
            local Model: any = workspace.CurrentCamera:FindFirstChild("Viewmodel")
            if ViewModel.Enabled and Model then
                Model:ScaleTo(Value)

                if RootJoint and RootC0 and RootOffset then
                    RootJoint.C0 = (RootC0 - RootC0.Position) + (RootC0.Position * Value) + (RootOffset * (1 - Value))
                end
            end
        end
    })
    for _, v: string in {"Rotation X", "Rotation Y", "Rotation Z"} do
        table.insert(Rotations, ViewModel:CreateSlider({
            Name = v,
            Min = 0,
            Max = 360,
            Suffix = "degrees",
            Function = function()
                local Model: any = workspace.CurrentCamera:FindFirstChild("Viewmodel")
                if ViewModel.Enabled and OriginalC1 and Model then
                    Model.RightHand.RightWrist.C1 = (OriginalC1 + OriginalC1.Position * (Size.Value - 1)) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(Rotations[1].Value), math.rad(Rotations[2].Value), math.rad(Rotations[3].Value))
                end
            end
        }))
    end
    NoBob = ViewModel:CreateToggle({
        Name = "No Bobbing",
        Default = true,
        Function = function()
            if ViewModel.Enabled then
                ViewModel:Toggle()
                ViewModel:Toggle()
            end
        end
    })
    Visuals = ViewModel:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Visuals",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if OutlineColor then
                FillColor.Object.Visible = Callback
                OutlineColor.Object.Visible = Callback
            end

            if ViewModel.Enabled then
                ViewModel:Toggle()
                ViewModel:Toggle()
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Highlights the item held in your hand"
    })
    FillColor = ViewModel:CreateColorSlider({
        Name = "Fill Color",
        DefaultSat = 0,
        DefaultOpacity = 0.5,
        Darker = true,
        Visible = Visuals.Enabled,
        Function = function(Hue: number, Sat: number, Value: number, Opacity: number)
            for _, v: Highlight in Highlights do
                v.FillColor = Color3.fromHSV(Hue, Sat, Value)
                v.FillTransparency = 1 - Opacity
            end
        end
    })
    OutlineColor = ViewModel:CreateColorSlider({
        Name = "Outline Color",
        DefaultValue = 0,
        Darker = true,
        Visible = Visuals.Enabled,
        Function = function(Hue: number, Sat: number, Value: number, Opacity: number)
            for _, v: Highlight in Highlights do
                v.OutlineColor = Color3.fromHSV(Hue, Sat, Value)
                v.OutlineTransparency = 1 - Opacity
            end
        end
    })
end)()

BundledModules.WinEffect = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local WinEffect
    local List

    local Ids: {[string]: string} = {}
    local Names: {string} = {}

    WinEffect = Cat.Legit:CreateModule({
        Name = "WinEffect",
        Category = "Game",
        Icon = "legit_wineffect",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback and getconnections then
                WinEffect:Clean(Data.Events.MatchEndEvent:Connect(function()
                    for _, v: any in getconnections(Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("WinEffectTriggered").Remote.instance.OnClientEvent) do
                        if v.Function then
                            v.Function({
                                winEffectType = Ids[List.Value],
                                winningPlayer = Services.LocalPlayer
                            })
                        end
                    end
                end))
            elseif Callback then
                Cat:CreateNotification("WinEffect", "This executor cannot trigger the game's win effect callbacks", 5)
                WinEffect:Toggle()
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Allows you to select any clientside win effect"
    })

    for Id: string, v: {name: string} in Data.Instances.WinEffectMeta do
        table.insert(Names, v.name)
        Ids[v.name] = Id
    end

    table.sort(Names)
    List = WinEffect:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Effects",
        List = Names
    })
end)()

BundledModules.BedESP = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity
    local Boxes = BundledModules.Boxes

    local BedESP
    local BoundingBox, BoxStyle, TeamColor, BoxColor, Name, HealthBar, HealthText, Distance, HideOwn, DistanceCheck, MaxDistance

    local Beds: {[BasePart]: any} = {}

    local function Measure(Bed: BasePart): {Vector3}
        local Min: Vector3, Max: Vector3 = Vector3.one * math.huge, Vector3.one * -math.huge
        for _, v: Instance in Bed:GetChildren() do
            if v:IsA("BasePart") and v.Name ~= "Blanket" then
                local Offset: CFrame, Half: Vector3 = Bed.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(v.CFrame), v.Size / 2
                if v.Name == "Legs" then
                    Offset, Half = Offset * CFrame.new(0, -0.4, 0), Half - Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0)
                end

                for _, Sign: Vector3 in Boxes.Edges do
                    local Point: Vector3 = Offset * (Half * Sign)
                    Min, Max = Min:Min(Point), Max:Max(Point)
                end
            end
        end

        if Min.X == math.huge then
            Min, Max = -Bed.Size / 2, Bed.Size / 2
        end

        local Corners: {Vector3} = {}
        for _, Sign: Vector3 in Boxes.Edges do
            table.insert(Corners, Bed.CFrame * ((Min + Max) / 2 + (Max - Min) / 2 * Sign))
        end

        return Corners
    end

    local function Added(Bed: Instance)
        if Beds[Bed] or not Bed:IsA("BasePart") then
            return
        end

        local TeamId: number? = tonumber(Bed:GetAttribute("TeamId"))
        local Queue: any = Data.Instances.QueueMeta[Data.Controllers.Store:getState().Game.queueType or ""]
        local Team: any = Queue and Queue.teams and TeamId and Queue.teams[TeamId]
        local Cover: Instance? = Bed:FindFirstChild("Bed")
        Beds[Bed] = {
            Slot = Boxes.Make(),
            Corners = Measure(Bed),
            Cell = Data.Controllers.BlockController:getBlockPosition(Bed.Position),
            Team = TeamId,
            Name = `{Team and Team.displayName or `Team {TeamId or "?"}`} Bed`,
            Color = Cover and Cover:IsA("BasePart") and Cover.Color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
            Shown = false
        }
    end

    local function Health(Bed: BasePart, Cell: Vector3): number
        local Success: boolean, Block: any = pcall(function(): any
            return Data.Controllers.BlockController:getStore():getBlockData(Cell)
        end)
        local Value: number = Success and Block and (Block:GetAttribute("1") or Block:GetAttribute("Health")) or Bed:GetAttribute("Health") or 1

        return Value
    end

    BedESP = Cat.Categories.Render:CreateModule({
        Name = "BedESP",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback then
                for _, v: Instance in Services.CollectionService:GetTagged("bed") do
                    Added(v)
                end

                BedESP:Clean(Services.CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal("bed"):Connect(function(Bed: Instance)
                    task.delay(0.2, function()
                        if BedESP.Enabled and Bed.Parent then
                            Added(Bed)
                        end
                    end)
                end))
                BedESP:Clean(Services.CollectionService:GetInstanceRemovedSignal("bed"):Connect(function(Bed: Instance)
                    if Beds[Bed] then
                        Boxes.Destroy(Beds[Bed].Slot)
                        Beds[Bed] = nil
                    end
                end))

                BedESP:Clean(Services.RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
                    local Camera: Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
