                    local Custom: Color3 = Color3.fromHSV(BoxColor.Hue, BoxColor.Sat, BoxColor.Value)
                    local Own: number? = tonumber(Services.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Team"))
                    local Origin: Vector3 = Entity.Alive and Entity.RootPart.Position or Camera.CFrame.Position
                    for Bed: BasePart, Info: any in Beds do
                        local Slot: Box = Info.Slot
                        local Studs: number = (Origin - Bed.Position).Magnitude
                        local X0: number, Y0: number, X1: number, Y1: number = math.huge, math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge
                        local Show: boolean = Bed.Parent ~= nil and (not HideOwn.Enabled or Info.Team ~= Own) and (not DistanceCheck.Enabled or Studs <= MaxDistance.Value)
                        if Show then
                            for _, Corner: Vector3 in Info.Corners do
                                local Point: Vector3 = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(Corner)
                                Show = Show and Point.Z > 0
                                X0, Y0 = math.min(X0, Point.X), math.min(Y0, Point.Y)
                                X1, Y1 = math.max(X1, Point.X), math.max(Y1, Point.Y)
                            end
                        end

                        if Show then
                            X0, Y0, X1, Y1 = math.floor(X0), math.floor(Y0), math.ceil(X1), math.ceil(Y1)
                            local Color: Color3 = TeamColor.Enabled and Info.Color or Custom
                            local Used: number = BoundingBox.Enabled and Boxes.Shape(Slot, BoxStyle.Value, X0, Y0, X1, Y1) or 0
                            for Index: number, Line: DrawingLine in Slot.Lines do
                                Line.Visible = Index <= Used
                                Line.Color = Color
                                Slot.Outlines[Index].Visible = Index <= Used
                            end
                            Slot.Used = Used

                            local Points: number = (HealthBar.Enabled or HealthText.Enabled) and Health(Bed, Info.Cell) or 1
                            local Ratio: number = math.clamp(Points / (Bed:GetAttribute("MaxHealth") or 1), 0, 1)
                            local Tint: Color3 = (Color3.fromRGB(235, 77, 75)):Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(138, 192, 147), Ratio)
                            Slot.Back.Visible = HealthBar.Enabled
                            Slot.Fill.Visible = HealthBar.Enabled
                            if HealthBar.Enabled then
                                Slot.Back.Position = Vector2.new(X0 - 6, Y0 - 1)
                                Slot.Back.Size = Vector2.new(4, Y1 - Y0 + 2)
                                Slot.Fill.Position = Vector2.new(X0 - 5, Y1 - (Y1 - Y0) * Ratio)
                                Slot.Fill.Size = Vector2.new(2, (Y1 - Y0) * Ratio)
                                Slot.Fill.Color = Tint
                            end

                            Slot.Name.Visible = Name.Enabled
                            if Name.Enabled then
                                Slot.Name.Text = Info.Name
                                Slot.Name.Color = Color
                                Slot.Name.Position = Vector2.new((X0 + X1) / 2, Y0 - 4)
                            end

                            Slot.Vitals.Visible = HealthText.Enabled
                            if HealthText.Enabled then
                                Slot.Vitals.Text = `{math.floor(Points)} hp`
                                Slot.Vitals.Color = Tint
                                Slot.Vitals.Position = Vector2.new((X0 + X1) / 2, Y1 + 2)
                            end

                            Slot.Distance.Visible = Distance.Enabled
                            if Distance.Enabled then
                                Slot.Distance.Text = `{math.floor(Studs)} {math.floor(Studs) == 1 and "stud" or "studs"}`
                                Slot.Distance.Position = Vector2.new((X0 + X1) / 2, Y1 + (HealthText.Enabled and 24 or 2))
                            end
                        elseif Info.Shown then
                            Boxes.Hide(Slot)
                        end
                        Info.Shown = Show
                    end
                end))
            else
                for _, v: any in Beds do
                    Boxes.Destroy(v.Slot)
                end
                table.clear(Beds)
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Draws a box, name, health and distance over every bed"
    })

    BoundingBox = BedESP:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Bounding box",
        Default = true,
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if BoxStyle and BoxStyle.Object then
                BoxStyle.Object.Visible = Callback
            end
        end
    })
    BoxStyle = BedESP:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Box style",
        List = {"Corners", "Full", "Rounded"},
        Default = "Corners",
        Darker = true,
        Visible = BoundingBox.Enabled
    })
    TeamColor = BedESP:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Team color",
        Default = true,
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if BoxColor and BoxColor.Object then
                BoxColor.Object.Visible = not Callback
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Colors the box and name with the bed's team color"
    })
    BoxColor = BedESP:CreateColorSlider({
        Name = "Color",
        DefaultSat = 0,
        Darker = true,
        Visible = not TeamColor.Enabled
    })
    Name = BedESP:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Name",
        Default = true
    })
    HealthBar = BedESP:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Health bar",
        Default = true
    })
    HealthText = BedESP:CreateToggle({Name = "Health text"})
    Distance = BedESP:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Distance",
        Default = true
    })
    HideOwn = BedESP:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Hide own bed",
        Default = true,
        Tooltip = "Hides your own team's bed"
    })
    DistanceCheck = BedESP:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Distance check",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if MaxDistance and MaxDistance.Object then
                MaxDistance.Object.Visible = Callback
            end
        end
    })
    MaxDistance = BedESP:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Max distance",
        Min = 10,
        Max = 1000,
        Default = 250,
        Darker = true,
        Visible = DistanceCheck.Enabled,
        Suffix = function(Value: number): string
            return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
        end
    })

    Cat:Clean(function()
        for _, v: any in Beds do
            Boxes.Destroy(v.Slot)
        end
        table.clear(Beds)
    end)
end)()

BundledModules.BedPlates = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local BedPlates
    local Background, Color, LayerCounter, LayerColor

    local Plates, Keys, Sides = {}, {}, {}
    for _, v: Enum.NormalId in Enum.NormalId:GetEnumItems() do
        table.insert(Sides, Vector3.FromNormalId(v) * 3)
    end

    local Folder: Folder = Instance.new("Folder")
    Folder.Parent = Cat.Ui.Gui

    local function Scan(Bed: BasePart, Start: Vector3, Layers: {[string]: number})
        for _, v: Vector3 in Sides do
            local Found: {[string]: number} = {}
            for Depth: number = 1, 15 do
                local Block: Instance? = Data.Controllers.BlockController:getStore():getBlockAt(Data.Controllers.BlockController:getBlockPosition(Start + v * Depth))
                if not Block or Block == Bed or Block.Name == "bed" then
                    break
                end
                if not Block:GetAttribute("NoBreak") then
                    Found[Block.Name] = (Found[Block.Name] or 0) + 1
                end
            end

            for i: string, v2: number in Found do
                Layers[i] = math.max(Layers[i] or 0, v2)
            end
        end
    end

    local function Refresh(Bed: BasePart, Plate: BillboardGui)
        local Layers: {[string]: number} = {}
        Scan(Bed, Bed.Position, Layers)
        Scan(Bed, Bed.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0, 3), Layers)

        local Sorted: {PlateLayer} = {}
        for i: string, v: number in Layers do
            table.insert(Sorted, {Name = i, Count = v})
        end
        table.sort(Sorted, function(a: PlateLayer, b: PlateLayer): boolean
            local Left: number = Data.Instances.Items[a.Name] and Data.Instances.Items[a.Name].block and Data.Instances.Items[a.Name].block.health or 0
            local Right: number = Data.Instances.Items[b.Name] and Data.Instances.Items[b.Name].block and Data.Instances.Items[b.Name].block.health or 0

            return Left == Right and a.Name < b.Name or Left > Right
        end)

        Plate.Enabled = #Sorted > 0

        local Parts: {string} = {tostring(LayerCounter.Enabled)}
        for _, v: PlateLayer in Sorted do
            table.insert(Parts, `{v.Name}:{v.Count}`)
        end

        local Key: string = table.concat(Parts, ",")
        if Keys[Plate] == Key then
            return
        end

        Keys[Plate] = Key
        for _, v: Instance in Plate.Frame:GetChildren() do
            if v:IsA("ImageLabel") then
                v:Destroy()
            end
        end

        for _, v: PlateLayer in Sorted do
            local Icon: ImageLabel = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
            Icon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 32)
            Icon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            Icon.Image = Data.Instances.Items[v.Name] and Data.Instances.Items[v.Name].image or ""
            Icon.Parent = Plate.Frame

            if v.Count > 1 and LayerCounter.Enabled then
                local Amount: TextLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                Amount.Name = "Amount"
                Amount.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
                Amount.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                Amount.Text = tostring(v.Count)
                Amount.TextColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(LayerColor.Hue, LayerColor.Sat, LayerColor.Value)
                Amount.TextSize = 16
                Amount.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3
                Amount.Font = Enum.Font.Arial
                Amount.Parent = Icon
            end
        end
    end

    local function Added(Bed: Instance)
        if Plates[Bed] or not Bed:IsA("BasePart") then
            return
        end

        local Plate: BillboardGui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        Plate.Name = "bed"
        Plate.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
        Plate.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(36, 36)
        Plate.AlwaysOnTop = true
        Plate.ClipsDescendants = false
        Plate.Adornee = Bed

        local Frame: Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
        Frame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        Frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(Color.Hue, Color.Sat, Color.Value)
        Frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - (Background.Enabled and Color.Opacity or 0)
        Frame.Parent = Plate

        local Shadow: UIShadow = Instance.new("UIShadow")
        Shadow.BlurRadius = UDim.new(0, 13)
        Shadow.Transparency = 0.25
        Shadow.Enabled = Background.Enabled
        Shadow.Parent = Frame

        local Layout: UIListLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
        Layout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
        Layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)
        Layout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
        Layout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
        Layout:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(function()
            Plate.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(Layout.AbsoluteContentSize.X + 4, 36), 36)
        end)
        Layout.Parent = Frame

        local Corner: UICorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        Corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
        Corner.Parent = Frame

        Plate.Parent = Folder
        Plates[Bed] = Plate
        Refresh(Bed, Plate)
    end

    local function Removed(Bed: Instance)
        local Plate: BillboardGui? = Plates[Bed]
        if not Plate then
            return
        end

        Keys[Plate] = nil
        Plates[Bed] = nil
        Plate:Destroy()
    end

    local function Nearby(Block: Instance)
        if not Block:IsA("BasePart") then
            return
        end

        for i: BasePart, v: BillboardGui in Plates do
            if (Block.Position - i.Position).Magnitude <= 30 then
                Refresh(i, v)
            end
        end
    end

    BedPlates = Cat.Categories.Render:CreateModule({
        Name = "BedPlates",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback then
                for _, v: Instance in Services.CollectionService:GetTagged("bed") do
                    Added(v)
                end

                BedPlates:Clean(Services.CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal("bed"):Connect(Added))
                BedPlates:Clean(Services.CollectionService:GetInstanceRemovedSignal("bed"):Connect(Removed))

                local Blocks: Instance? = Data.Storage.Map and Data.Storage.Map:FindFirstChild("Blocks")
                if Blocks then
                    BedPlates:Clean(Blocks.ChildAdded:Connect(function(Block: Instance)
                        task.defer(Nearby, Block)
                    end))
                    BedPlates:Clean(Blocks.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(Block: Instance)
                        task.defer(Nearby, Block)
                    end))
                end
            else
                for Bed: BasePart in Plates do
                    Removed(Bed)
                end
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Displays blocks over the bed"
    })

    Background = BedPlates:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Background",
        Default = true,
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Color and Color.Object then
                Color.Object.Visible = Callback
            end

            for _, v: BillboardGui in Plates do
                v.Frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - (Callback and Color.Opacity or 0);
                v.Frame:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIShadow").Enabled = Callback
            end
        end
    })
    Color = BedPlates:CreateColorSlider({
        Name = "Background Color",
        DefaultValue = 0,
        DefaultOpacity = 0.5,
        Function = function(Hue: number, Sat: number, Value: number, Opacity: number)
            for _, v: BillboardGui in Plates do
                v.Frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(Hue, Sat, Value)
                v.Frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - (Background.Enabled and Opacity or 0)
            end
        end,
        Darker = true
    })
    LayerCounter = BedPlates:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Layer Counter",
        Default = true,
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if LayerColor and LayerColor.Object then
                LayerColor.Object.Visible = Callback
            end

            for i: BasePart, v: BillboardGui in Plates do
                Refresh(i, v)
            end
        end
    })
    LayerColor = BedPlates:CreateColorSlider({
        Name = "Counter Text Color",
        DefaultSat = 0,
        DefaultValue = 1,
        Function = function(Hue: number, Sat: number, Value: number)
            for _, i: BillboardGui in Plates do
                for _, v: Instance in i.Frame:GetDescendants() do
                    if v:IsA("TextLabel") and v.Name == "Amount" then
                        v.TextColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(Hue, Sat, Value)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    })
end)()

BundledModules.Chams = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local gethui = BundledModules.gethui
    local Services = BundledModules.Services
    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity
    local GhostLib = BundledModules.GhostLib

    local Chams
    local Targets
    local Fill
    local FillColor
    local FillTransparency
    local Outline
    local OutlineColor
    local OutlineTransparency
    local Self
    local Style
    local Walls
    local ModelDistance
    local ModelPlayers
    local ModelAlpha
    local Highlights: {[any]: Highlight} = {}
    local Skins: {[any]: Skin} = {}
    local Patterns: {[string]: string} = {Grid = "chams-grid", Scanlines = "chams-scan", Hex = "chams-hex"}
    local Bound: boolean = false
    local Ghosts: {[any]: Ghost} = {}
    local Holder: Folder? = nil
    local Stage: ViewportFrame? = nil
    local Mirror: Camera? = nil
    local Faded: {[BasePart]: number} = {}
    local Placement: {[any]: number} = {}
    local Hold: {[any]: number} = {}
    local Lights: {[any]: {Part: Part, Light: SpotLight, Root: BasePart?, Range: number, Brightness: number}} = {}
    local Nearests: {[any]: number} = {}
    local Roots: {[any]: number} = {}
    local Tick: number = 0
    local LastOrigin: Vector3 = Vector3.zero
    local LastLook: Vector3 = Vector3.zAxis
    local Candidates: {Candidate} = {}
    local Entries: {[any]: Candidate} = {}
    local SunBase: {Instance} = {}
    local Filter: {Instance} = {}
    local Seen: {[BasePart]: boolean} = {}
    local Active: {[any]: boolean} = {}
    local Present: {[any]: boolean} = {}
    local Fractions: {number} = {0.9, 0.75, 0.6, 0.45, 0.3, 0.2, 0.1, 0.05}
    local SunRays: RaycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    SunRays.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    SunRays.IgnoreWater = true
    local Sight: RaycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    Sight.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    Sight.RespectCanCollide = true
    local Rays: RaycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    Rays.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    Rays.IgnoreWater = true

    local function Show()
        if not Holder or not Holder.Parent then
            Holder = Instance.new("Folder")
            Holder.Name = "CatvapeModels"
            Holder.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera
        end

        return Holder
    end

    local function Overlay(): ViewportFrame
        if not Stage or not Stage.Parent then
            local Gui: ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
            Gui.Name = "Models"
            Gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
            Gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true

            Mirror = Instance.new("Camera")
            Stage = Instance.new("ViewportFrame")
            Stage.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
            Stage.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            Stage.CurrentCamera = Mirror
            Mirror.Parent = Stage
            Stage.Parent = Gui
            Gui.Parent = gethui()
        end

        return Stage :: ViewportFrame
    end

    local function Illuminate(v: any, Entry: Ghost?, Scale: number, Needed: boolean, Sun: Vector3?)
        local Item: {Part: Part, Light: SpotLight, Root: BasePart?, Range: number, Brightness: number}? = Lights[v]
        if Needed and Entry and Entry.Shown and Sun then
            if not Item or not Item.Part.Parent then
                local Part: Part = Instance.new("Part")
                Part.Anchored = true
                Part.CanCollide = false
                Part.CanQuery = false
                Part.CanTouch = false
                Part.CastShadow = false
                Part.Transparency = 1
                Part.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)

                local Light: SpotLight = Instance.new("SpotLight")
                Light.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
                Light.Angle = 100
                Light.Shadows = false
                Light.Parent = Part
                Part.Parent = Show()
                Item = {Part = Part, Light = Light, Root = nil, Range = 0, Brightness = 0}
                Lights[v] = Item
            end

            if Item then
                local Root: BasePart? = Item.Root
                if not Root or Root.Parent ~= Entry.Model then
                    Root = (Entry.Model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or Entry.Model.PrimaryPart) :: BasePart?
                    Item.Root = Root
                end

                if Root then
                    local Height: number = 5.5 * Scale
                    local Center: Vector3 = Root.Position
                    Item.Part.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Center + Sun * (2.2 * Height), Center)

                    local Range: number = 3.1 * Height
                    if Item.Range ~= Range then
                        Item.Range = Range
                        Item.Light.Range = Range
                    end

                    local Brightness: number = math.max(Services.Lighting.Brightness, 1) * 1.15
                    if Item.Brightness ~= Brightness then
                        Item.Brightness = Brightness
                        Item.Light.Brightness = Brightness
                    end

                    if not Item.Light.Enabled then
                        Item.Light.Enabled = true
                    end
                end
            end
        elseif Item and Item.Light.Enabled then
            Item.Light.Enabled = false
        end
    end

    local function Drop(v: any)
        if Ghosts[v] then
            GhostLib.Destroy(Ghosts[v])
            Ghosts[v] = nil
        end

        if Lights[v] then
            Lights[v].Part:Destroy()
            Lights[v] = nil
        end
    end

    local function Restore(Entry: Skin)
        for _, v: {Part: BasePart, Material: Enum.Material, Color: Color3, Texture: string?} in Entry.Parts do
            pcall(function()
                v.Part.Material = v.Material
                v.Part.Color = v.Color
                if v.Texture and v.Part:IsA("MeshPart") then
                    v.Part.TextureID = v.Texture
                end
            end)
        end

        for _, v: {Mesh: SpecialMesh, Texture: string} in Entry.Meshes do
            pcall(function()
                v.Mesh.TextureId = v.Texture
            end)
        end

        for _, v: {Item: Instance, Parent: Instance?, Transparency: number?} in Entry.Hidden do
            pcall(function()
                if v.Transparency then
                    (v.Item :: Decal).Transparency = v.Transparency
                else
                    v.Item.Parent = v.Parent
                end
            end)
        end
    end

    local function Capture(Character: Model, Name: string, Color: Color3): Skin
        local Entry: Skin = {Character = Character, Style = Name, Color = Color, Parts = {}, Meshes = {}, Hidden = {}}
        local Asset: string = Patterns[Name] and Cat.Ui:Icon(Patterns[Name]) or ""
        local Material: Enum.Material = Name == "ForceField" and Enum.Material.ForceField or Name == "Neon" and Enum.Material.Neon or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
        for _, v: Instance in Character:GetDescendants() do
            if v:IsA("BasePart") and v.Transparency < 1 then
                table.insert(Entry.Parts, {Part = v, Material = v.Material, Color = v.Color, Texture = v:IsA("MeshPart") and v.TextureID or nil})
                if v:IsA("MeshPart") then
                    v.TextureID = Asset
                end

                v.Material = Material
                v.Color = Color
            elseif v:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
                table.insert(Entry.Meshes, {Mesh = v, Texture = v.TextureId})
                v.TextureId = Asset
            elseif v:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then
                table.insert(Entry.Hidden, {Item = v, Parent = v.Parent})
                v.Parent = nil
            elseif v:IsA("Decal") then
                table.insert(Entry.Hidden, {Item = v, Parent = v.Parent, Transparency = v.Transparency})
                v.Transparency = 1
            end
        end

        return Entry
    end

    local function Release(v: any)
        if Skins[v] then
            Restore(Skins[v])
            Skins[v] = nil
        end
    end

    local function Cast(Origin: Vector3, Point: Vector3, Base: {Instance}): number
        local Hit: RaycastResult? = workspace:Raycast(Origin, Point - Origin, Rays)
        if not Hit then
            return math.huge
        end

        local Part: Instance = Hit.Instance
        if not Part:IsA("BasePart") or Part:IsA("Terrain") or (Part.Transparency < 0.6 and Part.LocalTransparencyModifier < 0.6) then
            return Hit.Distance
        end

        local Skip: {Instance} = table.clone(Base)
        local Result: number = math.huge
        for _ = 1, 3 do
            table.insert(Skip, Part)
            Rays.FilterDescendantsInstances = Skip

            Hit = workspace:Raycast(Origin, Point - Origin, Rays)
            if not Hit then
                break
            end

            Part = Hit.Instance
            if not Part:IsA("BasePart") or Part:IsA("Terrain") or (Part.Transparency < 0.6 and Part.LocalTransparencyModifier < 0.6) then
                Result = Hit.Distance

                break
            end
        end

        Rays.FilterDescendantsInstances = Base

        return Result
    end

    local function Sample(Entry: Ghost, Index: number, Sub: number): Vector3
        if Sub == 0 then
            return Entry.Spots[Index]
        end

        local Dimensions: Vector3 = Entry.Dims[Index]
        local Offset: Vector3 = Vector3.new((Sub % 2 == 1 and 1 or -1) * Dimensions.X * 0.4, (Sub > 2 and -1 or 1) * Dimensions.Y * 0.4, 0)

        return Entry.Spots[Index] + Entry.Poses[Index]:VectorToWorldSpace(Offset)
    end

    local function Occluded(Origin: Vector3, Entry: Ghost, Distance: number, Base: {Instance}, Full: boolean): number
        Rays.FilterDescendantsInstances = Base

        if Entry.Last then
            local Index: number, Sub: number = Entry.Last // 8, Entry.Last % 8
            if Entry.Poses[Index] and Entry.Dims[Index] then
                local Hit: number = Cast(Origin, Sample(Entry, Index, Sub), Base)
                if Hit < math.huge then
                    return Hit
                end
            end

            Entry.Last = nil
        end

        local Slot: number = Entry.Phase + Tick
        for Index: number in Entry.Pairs do
            if Entry.Solid[Index] == false then
                continue
            end

            local Subs: number = (Distance > 120 or Entry.Dims[Index].Magnitude <= 1.2) and 0 or Distance > 50 and 2 or 4
            for Sub: number = 0, Subs do
                Slot += 1
                if not Full and Slot % 3 ~= 0 then
                    continue
                end

                local Hit: number = Cast(Origin, Sample(Entry, Index, Sub), Base)
                if Hit < math.huge then
                    Entry.Last = Index * 8 + Sub

                    return Hit
                end
            end
        end

        for _, v: Joint in Entry.Bones do
            Slot += 1
            if not Full and Slot % 3 ~= 0 then
                continue
            end

            local Hit: number = Cast(Origin, v.From.TransformedWorldCFrame.Position, Base)
            if Hit < math.huge then
                return Hit
            end
        end

        return math.huge
    end

    local function Reveal(From: Vector3, Position: Vector3, Filter: {Instance}, Seen: {[BasePart]: boolean}): number
        local Skip: {Instance} = table.clone(Filter)
        local Nearest: number = math.huge
        for _ = 1, 6 do
            Rays.FilterDescendantsInstances = Skip

            local Hit: RaycastResult? = workspace:Raycast(From, Position - From, Rays)
            if not Hit then
                break
            end

            if Hit.Instance:IsA("BasePart") and not Hit.Instance:IsA("Terrain") and (Hit.Instance.Transparency >= 0.6 or Hit.Instance.LocalTransparencyModifier >= 0.6) then
                table.insert(Skip, Hit.Instance)
            else
                Nearest = math.min(Nearest, Hit.Distance)
                if not Hit.Instance:IsA("BasePart") or Hit.Instance:IsA("Terrain") then
                    break
                end

                Seen[Hit.Instance] = true
                table.insert(Skip, Hit.Instance)
            end
        end

        return Nearest
    end

    local function Step()
        Tick += 1

        local Camera: Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local Origin: Vector3 = Camera.CFrame.Position
        local Size: Vector2 = Camera.ViewportSize
        local Tangent: number = math.tan(math.rad(Camera.FieldOfView / 2))
        local Copying: boolean = Style.Value == "Model"
        local XRay: boolean = Style.Value == "X-Ray"
        local Special: boolean = Copying or XRay
        local Sun: Vector3 = Services.Lighting:GetSunDirection()
        local Builds: number = 0
        local Tint: Color3 = Color3.fromHSV(FillColor.Hue, FillColor.Sat, FillColor.Value)
        local Edge: Color3 = Color3.fromHSV(OutlineColor.Hue, OutlineColor.Sat, OutlineColor.Value)
        local Look: Vector3 = Camera.CFrame.LookVector
        local Jump: boolean = (Origin - LastOrigin).Magnitude > 1.5 or Look:Dot(LastLook) < 0.995
        LastOrigin, LastLook = Origin, Look
        table.clear(Candidates)
        table.clear(Seen)
        table.clear(Present)
        if Special or Targets.Walls.Enabled then
            table.clear(Filter)
            for _, v: any in Entity.Entities do
                local Model: Model? = if v.NPC then v.Character else v.Player.Character
                if Model then
                    table.insert(Filter, Model)
                end

                local UUID: string = tostring(Model and Model:GetAttribute("EntityUUID"))
                local Shell: Model? = v.NPC and Data.Controllers.StatefulEntityUtil.uuidToClientEntity[UUID]
                if Shell then
                    table.insert(Filter, Shell)
                end
            end

            table.insert(Filter, Camera)
            Rays.FilterDescendantsInstances = Filter
            Sight.FilterDescendantsInstances = Filter
        end

        for _, v: any in Entity.Entities do
            Present[v] = true

            if (not v.Self or Self.Enabled) and (not v.NPC or Targets.NPCs.Enabled) and (v.NPC or Targets.Players.Enabled) and (not Targets.Invisible.Enabled or not v.Character or not Entity.Invisible(v)) and (not Targets.Walls.Enabled or not v.RootPart or not workspace:Raycast(Origin, v.RootPart.Position - Origin, Sight)) then
                if v.NPC or v.Player.Parent then
                    if not Special and not Highlights[v] then
                        Highlights[v] = Instance.new("Highlight")
                        Highlights[v].Parent = gethui()
                    end

                    local Character: Model? = if v.NPC then v.Character else v.Player.Character
                    if v.NPC and Character then
                        local UUID: string = tostring(Character:GetAttribute("EntityUUID"))
                        Character = Data.Controllers.StatefulEntityUtil.uuidToClientEntity[UUID] or Character
                    end

                    local Humanoid: Humanoid? = v.Humanoid
                    if not v.NPC and (not Humanoid or Humanoid.Parent ~= Character) then
                        Humanoid = Character and Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    end

                    local Alive: boolean = Humanoid ~= nil and Humanoid.Health > 0
                    local Shown: Model? = Alive and not Special and Character or nil
                    if Highlights[v] and Highlights[v].Adornee ~= Shown then
                        Highlights[v].Adornee = Shown
                    end

                    local Entry: Ghost? = Ghosts[v]
                    if Entry and not (Copying and Alive and Character and Entry.Character == Character) then
                        Drop(v)
                        Entry = nil
                    end

                    if Copying and Alive and Character then
                        local Root: BasePart? = v.RootPart
                        if not Root or Root.Parent ~= Character then
                            Root = (Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or Character.PrimaryPart) :: BasePart?
                        end

                        local Local: Vector3 = Root and Camera.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(Root.Position) or Vector3.zero
                        if Root and Local.Magnitude <= ModelDistance.Value then
                            if not Entry and Builds < 1 then
                                Entry = GhostLib.New(Character, Show(), v.NPC == true)
                                Ghosts[v] = Entry
                                Builds += 1
                            end

                            local Depth: number = -Local.Z
                            if Entry and Walls.Enabled and (Local.Magnitude < 8 or (Depth > 0 and math.abs(Local.Y) <= Depth * Tangent + 4 and math.abs(Local.X) <= Depth * Tangent * (Size.X / Size.Y) + 4)) then
                                GhostLib.Pose(Entry, Tick)

                                local Base: {Instance} = Filter

                                local Hit: number = Occluded(Origin, Entry, Local.Magnitude, Base, Jump or Hold[v] == nil)
                                Hold[v] = Hit < math.huge and 4 or math.max((Hold[v] or 0) - 1, 0)

                                local Nearest: number = math.huge
                                if Hit < math.huge or Hold[v] > 0 then
                                    local Cached: number? = Roots[v]
                                    if not Cached or (Tick + Entry.Phase) % 3 == 0 then
                                        Rays.FilterDescendantsInstances = Base
                                        Cached = math.min(Cast(Origin, Root.Position, Base), Entry.Head and Cast(Origin, Entry.Head.Position, Base) or math.huge)
                                        Roots[v] = Cached
                                    end

                                    Nearest = math.min(Hit, Cached :: number)
                                    if Nearest == math.huge then
                                        Nearest = Nearests[v] or Local.Magnitude * 0.5
                                    end

                                    Nearests[v] = Nearest
                                else
                                    Roots[v] = nil
                                end

                                if Nearest < math.huge then
                                    local Item: Candidate = Entries[v] or {Key = v, Distance = 0, Scale = 1, Light = false, Entry = Entry}
                                    Entries[v] = Item

                                    local Fraction: number = Placement[v] or 0.9
                                    if not Placement[v] or (Tick + Entry.Phase) % 5 == 0 then
                                        local Direction: Vector3 = (Root.Position - Origin).Unit
                                        SunBase[1] = Camera
                                        SunBase[2] = Character
                                        SunRays.FilterDescendantsInstances = SunBase

                                        local RealLit: boolean = workspace:Raycast(Root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0), Sun * 500, SunRays) == nil
                                        local Lit: boolean = workspace:Raycast(Origin + Direction * Nearest * Fraction, Sun * 500, SunRays) == nil
                                        if Lit ~= RealLit then
                                            Fraction = 0.9
                                            Lit = workspace:Raycast(Origin + Direction * Nearest * Fraction, Sun * 500, SunRays) == nil
                                            if Lit ~= RealLit then
                                                for _, Option: number in Fractions do
                                                    if (workspace:Raycast(Origin + Direction * Nearest * Option, Sun * 500, SunRays) == nil) == RealLit then
                                                        Fraction = Option
                                                        Lit = RealLit

                                                        break
                                                    end
                                                end
                                            end
                                        end

                                        Placement[v] = Fraction
                                        Item.Light = RealLit and not Lit
                                    end

                                    local Wanted: number = math.clamp(Nearest * Fraction / (Local.Magnitude + 3), 0.005, 0.6)
                                    local Current: number? = Entry.Scale
                                    Item.Scale = Current and Current <= Wanted and Current >= Wanted * 0.8 and Current or math.max(Wanted * 0.9, 0.005)
                                    Item.Distance = Local.Magnitude
                                    Item.Entry = Entry
                                    table.insert(Candidates, Item)
                                end
                            else
                                Hold[v] = nil
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    if XRay and Alive and Character then
                        local Root: BasePart? = v.RootPart
                        if not Root or Root.Parent ~= Character then
                            Root = (Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or Character.PrimaryPart) :: BasePart?
                        end

                        local Local: Vector3 = Root and Camera.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(Root.Position) or Vector3.zero
                        local Depth: number = -Local.Z
                        if Root and Local.Magnitude <= ModelDistance.Value and (Local.Magnitude < 8 or (Depth > 0 and math.abs(Local.Y) <= Depth * Tangent + 4 and math.abs(Local.X) <= Depth * Tangent * (Size.X / Size.Y) + 4)) then
                            Reveal(Origin, Root.Position, Filter, Seen)

                            local Head: Instance? = Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
                            if Head then
                                Reveal(Origin, (Head :: BasePart).Position, Filter, Seen)
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    local Wanted: string? = Alive and Style.Value ~= "Highlight" and not Special and Style.Value or nil
                    if Skins[v] and (Skins[v].Character ~= Character or Skins[v].Style ~= Wanted) then
                        Release(v)
                    end

                    if Wanted and Character and not Skins[v] then
                        Skins[v] = Capture(Character, Wanted, Tint)
                    elseif Skins[v] and Skins[v].Color ~= Tint then
                        Skins[v].Color = Tint
                        for _, Piece: {Part: BasePart, Material: Enum.Material, Color: Color3, Texture: string?} in Skins[v].Parts do
                            Piece.Part.Color = Tint
                        end
                    end

                    local Light: Highlight? = Highlights[v]
                    if Light then
                        local Depth: Enum.HighlightDepthMode = Walls.Enabled and Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop or Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
                        if Light.DepthMode ~= Depth then
                            Light.DepthMode = Depth
                        end

                        if Light.FillColor ~= Tint then
                            Light.FillColor = Tint
                        end

                        if Light.OutlineColor ~= Edge then
                            Light.OutlineColor = Edge
                        end

                        local FillAlpha: number = Fill.Enabled and FillTransparency.Value / 100 or 1
                        if Light.FillTransparency ~= FillAlpha then
                            Light.FillTransparency = FillAlpha
                        end

                        local OutlineAlpha: number = Outline.Enabled and OutlineTransparency.Value / 100 or 1
                        if Light.OutlineTransparency ~= OutlineAlpha then
                            Light.OutlineTransparency = OutlineAlpha
                        end
                    end
                else
                    Release(v)
                    Drop(v)
                    if Highlights[v] then
                        Highlights[v]:Destroy()
                        Highlights[v] = nil
                    end
                end
            else
                Release(v)
                Drop(v)
                if Highlights[v] then
                    Highlights[v].Adornee = nil
                end
            end
        end

        for _, List: {[any]: any} in {Highlights, Skins, Ghosts} do
            for k: any in List do
                if not Present[k] then
                    Release(k)
                    Drop(k)
                    if Highlights[k] then
                        Highlights[k]:Destroy()
                        Highlights[k] = nil
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        for v: BasePart in Seen do
            if not Faded[v] then
                Faded[v] = v.LocalTransparencyModifier
                v.LocalTransparencyModifier = math.max(Faded[v], 0.85)
            end
        end

        for v: BasePart, Old: number in Faded do
            if not Seen[v] then
                v.LocalTransparencyModifier = Old
                Faded[v] = nil
            end
        end

        table.sort(Candidates, function(a: Candidate, b: Candidate): boolean
            return a.Distance < b.Distance
        end)

        local Overlaid: boolean = ModelAlpha.Value > 0
        table.clear(Active)
        for Index: number, v: Candidate in Candidates do
            if Index > ModelPlayers.Value then
                break
            end

            Active[v.Key] = true
            GhostLib.Update(v.Entry, true, Origin, Overlaid and 1 or v.Scale, Overlaid and Overlay() or Show(), Tick)
            Illuminate(v.Key, v.Entry, v.Scale, v.Light and not Overlaid, Sun)
        end

        for k: any, v: Ghost in Ghosts do
            if not Active[k] then
                GhostLib.Update(v, false, Vector3.zero, 1, v.Container, Tick)
                Illuminate(k, nil, 1, false)
                if Builds < 1 and GhostLib.Refresh(v) then
                    Builds += 1
                end
            end
        end

        if Overlaid and Stage and Mirror then
            Mirror.CFrame = Camera.CFrame
            Mirror.FieldOfView = Camera.FieldOfView
            Stage.ImageTransparency = ModelAlpha.Value / 100
            Stage.Ambient = Services.Lighting.Ambient
            local Level: number = math.clamp(Services.Lighting.Brightness / 3, 0, 1)
            Stage.LightColor = Color3.new(Level, Level, Level)
            Stage.LightDirection = -Sun
        elseif not Overlaid and Stage and Stage.Parent then
            Stage.Parent:Destroy()
            Stage, Mirror = nil, nil
        end
    end

    local function Stop()
        if Bound then
            Services.RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("CatvapeChams")
            Bound = false
        end

        for v: any in Ghosts do
            Drop(v)
        end

        if Holder then
            Holder:Destroy()
            Holder = nil
        end

        if Stage and Stage.Parent then
            Stage.Parent:Destroy()
        end

        Stage, Mirror = nil, nil

        for v: BasePart, Old: number in Faded do
            v.LocalTransparencyModifier = Old
        end

        table.clear(Faded)

        table.clear(Placement)
        table.clear(Hold)
        table.clear(Nearests)
        table.clear(Roots)
        table.clear(Entries)
        table.clear(Lights)

        for v: any in Skins do
            Release(v)
        end

        for _, v: Highlight in Highlights do
            v.Adornee = nil
        end
    end

    Chams = Cat.Categories.Render:CreateModule({
        Name = "Chams",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            Stop()

            if Callback then
                Services.RunService:BindToRenderStep("CatvapeChams", Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value, Step)
                Bound = true
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Highlights players and NPCs through walls"
    })

    Targets = Chams:CreateTargets({
        Players = true,
        NoPriority = true
    })
    Style = Chams:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Style",
        List = {"Highlight", "Model", "X-Ray", "ForceField", "Neon", "Grid", "Scanlines", "Hex"},
        Default = "X-Ray",
        Function = function(Value: string)
            if ModelDistance and ModelPlayers and ModelAlpha then
                ModelDistance.Object.Visible = Value == "Model" or Value == "X-Ray"
                ModelPlayers.Object.Visible = Value == "Model"
                ModelAlpha.Object.Visible = Value == "Model"
            end
        end
    })
    ModelDistance = Chams:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Model distance",
        Min = 25,
        Max = 1000,
        Default = 250,
        Darker = true,
        Visible = Style.Value == "Model" or Style.Value == "X-Ray",
        Suffix = function(Value: number): string
            return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
        end,
        Tooltip = "Players farther than this are skipped by the Model and X-Ray styles. Model only draws players that are behind something, so it needs Through walls"
    })
    ModelPlayers = Chams:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Model players",
        Min = 1,
        Max = 20,
        Default = 6,
        Darker = true,
        Visible = Style.Value == "Model",
        Suffix = function(Value: number): string
            return Value == 1 and "player" or "players"
        end,
        Tooltip = "Most players drawn at once in Model style, nearest first, because each one costs frame time"
    })
    ModelAlpha = Chams:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Model transparency",
        Min = 0,
        Max = 100,
        Default = 0,
        Suffix = "%",
        Darker = true,
        Visible = Style.Value == "Model",
        Tooltip = "0 draws the real model with the game renderer. Above 0 fades the whole model evenly with a screen overlay, which looks softer"
    })
    Fill = Chams:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Fill",
        Default = true
    })
    FillColor = Chams:CreateColorSlider({
        Name = "Fill color",
        DefaultHue = 0,
        DefaultSat = 0.73
    })
    FillTransparency = Chams:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Fill transparency",
        Min = 0,
        Max = 100,
        Default = 50,
        Suffix = "%"
    })
    Outline = Chams:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Outline",
        Default = true
    })
    OutlineColor = Chams:CreateColorSlider({
        Name = "Outline color",
        DefaultSat = 0
    })
    OutlineTransparency = Chams:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Outline transparency",
        Min = 0,
        Max = 100,
        Default = 0,
        Suffix = "%"
    })
    Walls = Chams:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Through walls",
        Default = true
    })
    Self = Chams:CreateToggle({Name = "Show self"})

    Cat:Clean(function()
        Stop()
        for _, v: Highlight in Highlights do
            v:Destroy()
        end
        table.clear(Highlights)
    end)
end)()

BundledModules.CropESP = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local LabelPool = BundledModules.LabelPool

    local CropESP
    local Color, Transparency, Scale

    local Tags: {[Instance]: TextLabel} = {}
    local Labels: LabelPool = LabelPool()

    local function Added(Crop: Instance)
        if Tags[Crop] then
            return
        end

        local Label: TextLabel = Labels.Acquire()
        Label.Text = Data.Instances.Items[Crop.Name] and Data.Instances.Items[Crop.Name].displayName or "Crop"
        Label.TextSize = 14 * Scale.Value
        Label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(Color.Hue, Color.Sat, Color.Value)
        Label.BackgroundTransparency = Transparency.Value

        local Bounds: Vector2 = Cat.Ui:Measure(Label.ContentText, Label.TextSize, Label.FontFace)
        Label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(Bounds.X + 8, Bounds.Y + 7)
        Tags[Crop] = Label
    end

    CropESP = Cat.Categories.Render:CreateModule({
        Name = "CropESP",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback then
                for _, v: Instance in Services.CollectionService:GetTagged("HarvestableCrop") do
                    Added(v)
                end

                CropESP:Clean(Services.CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal("HarvestableCrop"):Connect(Added))
                CropESP:Clean(Services.CollectionService:GetInstanceRemovedSignal("HarvestableCrop"):Connect(function(Crop: Instance)
                    local Label: TextLabel? = Tags[Crop]
                    if not Label then
                        return
                    end

                    Tags[Crop] = nil
                    Label.Visible = false
                    table.insert(Labels.Free, Label)
                end))

                CropESP:Clean(Services.RunService.PreRender:Connect(function()
                    local Camera: Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
                    for Crop: Instance, Label: TextLabel in Tags do
                        if Crop.Parent then
                            local Position: Vector3 = Crop:IsA("Model") and Crop:GetPivot().Position or (Crop :: BasePart).Position
                            local Screen: Vector3, Visible: boolean = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(Position + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0))

                            if Label.Visible ~= Visible then
                                Label.Visible = Visible
                            end

                            if Visible then
                                Label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(Screen.X, Screen.Y)
                            end
                        else
                            Tags[Crop] = nil
                            Label.Visible = false

                            table.insert(Labels.Free, Label)
                        end
                    end
                end))
            else
                table.clear(Tags)
                table.clear(Labels.Free)
                Labels.Folder:ClearAllChildren()
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Renders crops that are ready to harvest"
    })

    Color = CropESP:CreateColorSlider({
        Name = "Text Color",
        Function = function(Hue: number, Sat: number, Value: number)
            for _, v: TextLabel in Tags do
                v.TextColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(Hue, Sat, Value)
            end
        end
    })
    Transparency = CropESP:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Transparency",
        Min = 0,
        Max = 1,
        Default = 0.5,
        Decimal = 100,
        Function = function(Value: number)
            for _, v: TextLabel in Tags do
                v.BackgroundTransparency = Value
            end
        end
    })
    Scale = CropESP:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Scale",
        Min = 0.1,
        Max = 1.5,
        Default = 1,
        Decimal = 10,
        Function = function(Value: number)
            for _, v: TextLabel in Tags do
                v.TextSize = 14 * Value

                local Bounds: Vector2 = Cat.Ui:Measure(v.ContentText, v.TextSize, v.FontFace)
                v.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(Bounds.X + 8, Bounds.Y + 7)
            end
        end
    })
end)()

BundledModules.ESP = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Drawing = BundledModules.Drawing

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity
    local Boxes = BundledModules.Boxes

    local Camera: Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

    local ESP
    local Targets, Look, BoundingBox, BoxColor, BoxStyle, Name, NameColor, HealthBar, HealthText, Distance, HeldItem, Armor, Enchant, Rank, DistanceCheck, MaxDistance, TeamCheck, TeamColor, Scale, Background, Inline, Self

    local Slots: {[any]: Box} = {}
    local Styled: {[Box]: string} = {}
    local Loadouts: {[any]: {Expires: number, Images: {string}}} = {}
    local Enchants: {[string]: string} = {}
    local Ranks: {[Player]: string} = {}
    for _, v: any in Data.Instances.EnchantMeta do
        Enchants[`StatusEffect_{(string.gsub(v.statusEffect, "_%d+$", ""))}`] = v.image
    end

    local Tags: {[any]: Tag} = {}
    local Layer: ScreenGui?

    local Sight: RaycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    Sight.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    Sight.RespectCanCollide = true

    local function Shade(Player: Player): Color3?
        local Id: any = Player:GetAttribute("Team")
        if Id ~= nil then
            for _, v: any in Data.Controllers.Store:getState().Game.teams or {} do
                if tostring(v.id) == tostring(Id) and typeof(v.color) == "Color3" then
                    return v.color
                end
            end
        end

        local Team: Team? = Player.Team
        local Brick: BrickColor? = if tostring(Player.TeamColor) ~= "White" then Player.TeamColor elseif Team and tostring(Team.TeamColor) ~= "White" then Team.TeamColor else nil

        return Brick and Brick.Color or nil
    end

    local function Loadout(Player: Player): {string}
        local Images: {string} = {}
        local Success: boolean, Inventory: any = pcall(Data.Controllers.InventoryUtil.getInventory, Player)
        if Success and HeldItem.Enabled and Inventory.hand and Data.Instances.Items[Inventory.hand.itemType] then
            table.insert(Images, Data.Instances.Items[Inventory.hand.itemType].image)
        end

        if Success and Armor.Enabled then
            local Worn: {[number]: string} = {}
            for _, v: any in Inventory.armor or {} do
                local Meta: any = type(v) == "table" and Data.Instances.Items[v.itemType]
                if Meta and Meta.armor then
                    Worn[Meta.armor.slot] = Meta.image
                end
            end

            for Slot: number = 0, 2 do
                if Worn[Slot] then
                    table.insert(Images, Worn[Slot])
                end
            end
        end

        if Enchant.Enabled and Player.Character then
            for Attribute: string in Player.Character:GetAttributes() do
                local Image: string? = Enchants[(string.gsub(Attribute, "_%d+$", ""))]
                if Image then
                    table.insert(Images, Image)

                    break
                end
            end
        end

        if Rank.Enabled and not Ranks[Player] then
            Ranks[Player] = ""
            task.spawn(function()
                local Fetched: boolean, Result: any = pcall(function(): any
                    return Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("FetchRanks"):CallServer({Player.UserId})
                end)
                local Division: number? = Fetched and type(Result) == "table" and Result[1] and Result[1].rankDivision or nil
                Ranks[Player] = Division and Data.Instances.RankMeta[Division] and Data.Instances.RankMeta[Division].image or ""
            end)
        end

        if Rank.Enabled and Ranks[Player] ~= "" then
            table.insert(Images, Ranks[Player])
        end

        return Images
    end

    local function Make(): Tag
        local Main: DrawingSquare = Drawing.new("Square")
        Main.Thickness = 1
        Main.ZIndex = 2
        Main.Filled = false
        Main.Visible = false

        local Outer: DrawingSquare = Drawing.new("Square")
        Outer.Transparency = 0.35
        Outer.Thickness = 1
        Outer.ZIndex = 1
        Outer.Filled = false
        Outer.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        Outer.Visible = false

        local Inner: DrawingSquare = Drawing.new("Square")
        Inner.Transparency = 0.35
        Inner.Thickness = 1
        Inner.ZIndex = 1
        Inner.Filled = false
        Inner.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        Inner.Visible = false

        local Bar: DrawingLine = Drawing.new("Line")
        Bar.Thickness = 1
        Bar.ZIndex = 2
        Bar.Visible = false

        local Edge: DrawingLine = Drawing.new("Line")
        Edge.Transparency = 0.35
        Edge.Thickness = 3
        Edge.ZIndex = 1
        Edge.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        Edge.Visible = false

        local Label: TextLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        Label.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
        Label.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        Label.BorderSizePixel = 0
        Label.Font = Enum.Font.Arial
        Label.RichText = true
        Label.TextSize = 14
        Label.Visible = false

        local Zoom: UIScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
        Zoom.Parent = Label

        local Icons: {ImageLabel} = {}
        for Index: number = 1, 5 do
            local Icon: ImageLabel = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
            Icon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            Icon.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-60 + Index * 30, -30)
            Icon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 30)
            Icon.Visible = false
            Icon.Parent = Label

            table.insert(Icons, Icon)
        end

        Label.Parent = Layer

        return {
            Main = Main,
            Outer = Outer,
            Inner = Inner,
            Bar = Bar,
            Edge = Edge,
            Label = Label,
            Zoom = Zoom,
            Icons = Icons,
            Text = "",
            Key = ""
        }
    end

    local function Conceal(Slot: Tag): ()
        for _, v: any in {Slot.Main, Slot.Outer, Slot.Inner, Slot.Bar, Slot.Edge} do
            v.Visible = false
        end

        Slot.Label.Visible = false
    end

    local function Erase(Slot: Tag): ()
        for _, v: any in {Slot.Main, Slot.Outer, Slot.Inner, Slot.Bar, Slot.Edge} do
            v:Remove()
        end

        Slot.Label:Destroy()
    end

    local function Equip(Player: Player): {string}
        local Images: {string} = {"", "", "", "", ""}
        local Success: boolean, Inventory: any = pcall(Data.Controllers.InventoryUtil.getInventory, Player)
        if not Success then
            return Images
        end

        if HeldItem.Enabled and Inventory.hand and Data.Instances.Items[Inventory.hand.itemType] then
            Images[1] = Data.Instances.Items[Inventory.hand.itemType].image
        end

        if Armor.Enabled then
            for _, v: any in Inventory.armor or {} do
                local Meta: any = type(v) == "table" and Data.Instances.Items[v.itemType]
                if Meta and Meta.armor and Meta.armor.slot >= 0 and Meta.armor.slot <= 2 then
                    Images[Meta.armor.slot + 2] = Meta.image
                end
            end
        end

        local Kit: any = Player:GetAttribute("PlayingAsKits")
        local KitMeta: any = Kit and Kit ~= "none" and Data.Instances.BedwarsKitMeta[Kit]
        if KitMeta and KitMeta.renderImage then
            Images[5] = KitMeta.renderImage
        end

        return Images
    end

    local function Legacy(): ()
        local Lines: Color3 = Color3.fromHSV(BoxColor.Hue, BoxColor.Sat, BoxColor.Value)
        local Label: Color3 = Color3.fromHSV(NameColor.Hue, NameColor.Sat, NameColor.Value)
        if Targets.Walls.Enabled then
            local Ignore: {Instance} = {Camera}
            for _, v: any in Entity.Entities do
                if v.Character then
                    table.insert(Ignore, v.Character)
                end
            end

            Sight.FilterDescendantsInstances = Ignore
        end

        local Seen: {[any]: boolean} = {}
        for _, v: any in Entity.Entities do
            Seen[v] = true

            if not ((not v.Self or Self.Enabled) and (not v.NPC or Targets.NPCs.Enabled) and (v.NPC or Targets.Players.Enabled) and (not TeamCheck.Enabled or v.Self or v.NPC or v.TargetCheck()) and (v.NPC or v.Player:GetAttribute("Spectator") ~= true) and (v.NPC or v.Player.Parent)) then
                if Tags[v] then
                    Conceal(Tags[v])
                end

                continue
            end

            Tags[v] = Tags[v] or Make()

            local Slot: Tag = Tags[v]
            local Character: Model? = v.Character
            local Humanoid: Humanoid? = v.Humanoid
            local Root: BasePart? = v.RootPart
            if not (v.Alive and Character and Humanoid and Root and Humanoid.Health > 0) then
                Conceal(Slot)

                continue
            end

            local Shell: Model? = v.NPC and Data.Controllers.StatefulEntityUtil.uuidToClientEntity[tostring(Character:GetAttribute("EntityUUID"))]
            local Smooth: BasePart? = Shell and Shell:FindFirstChild("RootPart") :: BasePart?
            local Center: Vector3 = Smooth and Smooth.Position or Root.Position
            local Studs: number = (Camera.CFrame.Position - Center).Magnitude
            if not ((not DistanceCheck.Enabled or Studs <= MaxDistance.Value) and (not Targets.Invisible.Enabled or not Entity.Invisible(v)) and (not Targets.Walls.Enabled or not workspace:Raycast(Camera.CFrame.Position, Center - Camera.CFrame.Position, Sight))) then
                Conceal(Slot)

                continue
            end

            local Point: Vector3, OnScreen: boolean = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(Center)
            if not OnScreen then
                Conceal(Slot)

                continue
            end

            local Hip: number = Humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 and 2 or Humanoid.HipHeight
            local Facing: CFrame = CFrame.lookAlong(Center, Camera.CFrame.LookVector)
            local Corner: Vector3 = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(Facing:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(2, Hip, 0)))
            local Opposite: Vector3 = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(Facing:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(-2, -Hip - 1, 0)))
            local Width: number = math.floor(Corner.X - Opposite.X)
            local Height: number = math.floor(Opposite.Y - Corner.Y)
            local X0: number = math.floor(Point.X - Width / 2)
            local Y0: number = math.floor(Point.Y - Height / 2)

            local Tint: Color3? = TeamColor.Enabled and v.Player and Shade(v.Player) or nil
            local Ratio: number = math.clamp(Humanoid.Health / math.max(Humanoid.MaxHealth, 1), 0, 1)
            for _, Square: DrawingSquare in {Slot.Main, Slot.Outer, Slot.Inner} do
                Square.Visible = BoundingBox.Enabled
            end

            if BoundingBox.Enabled then
                Slot.Main.Position = Vector2.new(X0, Y0)
                Slot.Main.Size = Vector2.new(Width, Height)
                Slot.Main.Color = Tint or Lines
                Slot.Outer.Position = Vector2.new(X0 - 1, Y0 - 1)
                Slot.Outer.Size = Vector2.new(Width + 2, Height + 2)
                Slot.Inner.Position = Vector2.new(X0 + 1, Y0 + 1)
                Slot.Inner.Size = Vector2.new(Width - 2, Height - 2)
            end

            Slot.Bar.Visible = HealthBar.Enabled
            Slot.Edge.Visible = HealthBar.Enabled
            if HealthBar.Enabled then
                Slot.Bar.From = Vector2.new(X0 - 6, Y0 + Height)
                Slot.Bar.To = Vector2.new(X0 - 6, Y0 + Height - Height * Ratio)
                Slot.Bar.Color = Color3.fromHSV(Ratio / 2.5, 0.89, 0.75)
                Slot.Edge.From = Vector2.new(X0 - 6, Y0 + Height + 1)
                Slot.Edge.To = Vector2.new(X0 - 6, Y0 - 1)
            end

            local Shown: string = Name.Enabled and (if v.NPC then v.Name else v.Player.DisplayName) or ""
            if HealthText.Enabled then
                local Hue: Color3 = Color3.fromHSV(Ratio / 2.5, 0.89, 0.75)
                Shown = `{Shown} <font color="rgb({math.floor(Hue.R * 255)},{math.floor(Hue.G * 255)},{math.floor(Hue.B * 255)})">{math.round(Humanoid.Health)}</font>`
            end
            if Distance.Enabled then
                Shown = `<font color="rgb(85, 255, 85)">[</font><font color="rgb(255, 255, 255)">{math.floor(Studs)}</font><font color="rgb(85, 255, 85)">]</font> {Shown}`
            end

            local Key: string = `{Scale.Value}|{Background.Enabled}`
            if Slot.Key ~= Key then
                Slot.Key = Key
                Slot.Zoom.Scale = Scale.Value
                Slot.Label.BackgroundTransparency = Background.Enabled and 0.5 or 1
            end

            if Slot.Text ~= Shown then
                Slot.Text = Shown

                local Bounds: Vector2 = Services.TextService:GetTextSize((string.gsub(Shown, "<[^>]+>", "")), 14, Enum.Font.Arial, Vector2.new(1000, 1000))
                Slot.Label.Text = Shown
                Slot.Label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(Bounds.X + 8, Bounds.Y + 7)
            end

            local Head: Vector3 = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(Center + Vector3.new(0, Hip + 1, 0))
            Slot.Label.Visible = Shown ~= ""
            Slot.Label.TextColor3 = Tint or Label
            Slot.Label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(Head.X, Head.Y)

            if v.Player and (HeldItem.Enabled or Armor.Enabled) and (not Loadouts[v] or Loadouts[v].Expires < tick()) then
                Loadouts[v] = {Expires = tick() + 0.5, Images = Equip(v.Player)}
            end

            local Images: {string} = Loadouts[v] and Loadouts[v].Images or {}
            for Index: number, Icon: ImageLabel in Slot.Icons do
                local Image: string = Images[Index] or ""
                if Icon.Image ~= Image then
                    Icon.Image = Image
                end

                Icon.Visible = Image ~= ""
            end
        end

        for k: any, v: Tag in Tags do
            if not Seen[k] then
                Erase(v)
                Tags[k] = nil
                Loadouts[k] = nil
            end
        end
    end

    ESP = Cat.Categories.Render:CreateModule({
        Name = "ESP",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback then
                if Look.Value == "Legacy" then
                    Layer = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
                    Layer.Name = "EspLegacy"
                    Layer.IgnoreGuiInset = true
                    Layer.ResetOnSpawn = false
                    Layer.Parent = Services.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
                    ESP:Clean(function()
                        for _, v: Tag in Tags do
                            Erase(v)
                        end

                        table.clear(Tags)
                        if Layer then
                            Layer:Destroy()
                            Layer = nil
                        end
                    end)
                    ESP:Clean(Services.RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(Legacy))

                    return
                end

                ESP:Clean(Services.RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
                    local Lines: Color3 = Color3.fromHSV(BoxColor.Hue, BoxColor.Sat, BoxColor.Value)
                    local Label: Color3 = Color3.fromHSV(NameColor.Hue, NameColor.Sat, NameColor.Value)
                    if Targets.Walls.Enabled then
                        local Ignore: {Instance} = {Camera}
                        for _, v: any in Entity.Entities do
                            if v.Character then
                                table.insert(Ignore, v.Character)
                            end
                        end

                        Sight.FilterDescendantsInstances = Ignore
                    end

                    local Seen: {[any]: boolean} = {}
                    for _, v: any in Entity.Entities do
                        Seen[v] = true

                        if (not v.Self or Self.Enabled) and (not v.NPC or Targets.NPCs.Enabled) and (v.NPC or Targets.Players.Enabled) and (not TeamCheck.Enabled or v.Self or v.NPC or v.TargetCheck()) and (v.NPC or v.Player:GetAttribute("Spectator") ~= true) then
                            if v.NPC or v.Player.Parent then
                                Slots[v] = Slots[v] or Boxes.Make()

                                local Slot: Box = Slots[v]
                                local Character: Model? = v.Character
                                local Humanoid: Humanoid? = v.Humanoid
                                local Root: BasePart? = v.RootPart
                                if v.Alive and Character and Humanoid and Root and Humanoid.Health > 0 then
                                    local UUID: string = tostring(Character:GetAttribute("EntityUUID"))
                                    local Shell: Model? = v.NPC and Data.Controllers.StatefulEntityUtil.uuidToClientEntity[UUID]
                                    local Smooth: BasePart? = Shell and Shell:FindFirstChild("RootPart") :: BasePart?
                                    local Center: Vector3 = Smooth and Smooth.Position or Root.Position
                                    local Studs: number = (Camera.CFrame.Position - Center).Magnitude
                                    if (not DistanceCheck.Enabled or Studs <= MaxDistance.Value) and (not Targets.Invisible.Enabled or not Entity.Invisible(v)) and (not Targets.Walls.Enabled or not workspace:Raycast(Camera.CFrame.Position, Center - Camera.CFrame.Position, Sight)) then
                                        local Head: BasePart? = Character:FindFirstChild("Head") :: BasePart?
                                        local Up: number = Root.Size.Y / 2 + (Head and Head.Size.Y or 0) + 0.8
                                        local Legs: number = Head and Humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 and 2 or Humanoid.HipHeight
                                        local Down: number = Root.Size.Y / 2 + Legs + 0.8
                                        local Axis: Vector3 = Camera.CFrame.UpVector
                                        local Top: Vector3 = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(Center + Axis * Up)
                                        local Bottom: Vector3 = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(Center - Axis * Down)
                                        if Top.Z > 0 and Bottom.Z > 0 then
                                            local Half: number = (Bottom.Y - Top.Y) * 0.34
                                            local X0: number, Y0: number = math.floor(Top.X - Half), math.floor(Top.Y)
                                            local X1: number, Y1: number = math.floor(Top.X + Half), math.floor(Bottom.Y)

                                            local Tint: Color3? = TeamColor.Enabled and v.Player and Shade(v.Player) or nil
                                            local Used: number = BoundingBox.Enabled and Boxes.Shape(Slot, BoxStyle.Value, X0, Y0, X1, Y1) or 0
                                            for Index: number, Line: DrawingLine in Slot.Lines do
                                                Line.Visible = Index <= Used
                                                Line.Color = Tint or Lines
                                                Slot.Outlines[Index].Visible = Index <= Used
                                            end
                                            Slot.Used = Used

                                            local Ratio: number = math.clamp(Humanoid.Health / math.max(Humanoid.MaxHealth, 1), 0, 1)
                                            Slot.Back.Visible = HealthBar.Enabled
                                            Slot.Fill.Visible = HealthBar.Enabled

                                            if HealthBar.Enabled then
                                                Slot.Back.Position = Vector2.new(X0 - 6, Y0 - 1)
                                                Slot.Back.Size = Vector2.new(4, Y1 - Y0 + 2)
                                                Slot.Fill.Position = Vector2.new(X0 - 5, Y1 - (Y1 - Y0) * Ratio)
                                                Slot.Fill.Size = Vector2.new(2, (Y1 - Y0) * Ratio)
                                                Slot.Fill.Color = (Color3.fromRGB(235, 77, 75)):Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(138, 192, 147), Ratio)
                                            end

                                            local Size: number = Scale.Value
                                            local Style: string = `{Size}|{Background.Enabled}`
                                            if Styled[Slot] ~= Style then
                                                Styled[Slot] = Style
                                                Slot.Name.RichText = true
                                                for _, Text: any in {Slot.Name, Slot.Vitals, Slot.Distance} do
                                                    Text.Scale = Size
                                                    Text.BackgroundTransparency = Background.Enabled and 0.6 or 1
                                                end
                                                for _, Icon: ImageLabel in Slot.Icons do
                                                    Icon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24 * Size, 24 * Size)
                                                end
                                            end

                                            Slot.Name.Visible = Name.Enabled
                                            if Name.Enabled then
                                                local Shown: string = if v.NPC then v.Name else v.Player.DisplayName
                                                if Inline.Enabled and HealthText.Enabled then
                                                    local Hue: Color3 = Color3.fromHSV(Ratio / 2.5, 0.89, 0.75)
                                                    Shown = `{Shown} <font color="rgb({math.floor(Hue.R * 255)},{math.floor(Hue.G * 255)},{math.floor(Hue.B * 255)})">{math.round(Humanoid.Health)}</font>`
                                                end
                                                if Inline.Enabled and Distance.Enabled then
                                                    Shown = `<font color="rgb(85, 255, 85)">[</font><font color="rgb(255, 255, 255)">{math.floor(Studs)}</font><font color="rgb(85, 255, 85)">]</font> {Shown}`
                                                end
                                                Slot.Name.Text = Shown
                                                Slot.Name.Color = Tint or Label
                                                Slot.Name.Position = Vector2.new((X0 + X1) / 2, Y0 - 4)
                                            end

                                            local Separate: boolean = not (Inline.Enabled and Name.Enabled)
                                            Slot.Vitals.Visible = HealthText.Enabled and Separate
                                            if HealthText.Enabled and Separate then
                                                Slot.Vitals.Text = `{math.floor(Humanoid.Health)} hp`
                                                Slot.Vitals.Color = (Color3.fromRGB(235, 77, 75)):Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(138, 192, 147), Ratio)
                                                Slot.Vitals.Position = Vector2.new((X0 + X1) / 2, Y1 + 2)
                                            end

                                            Slot.Distance.Visible = Distance.Enabled and Separate
                                            if Distance.Enabled and Separate then
                                                Slot.Distance.Text = `{math.floor(Studs)} {math.floor(Studs) == 1 and "stud" or "studs"}`
                                                Slot.Distance.Position = Vector2.new((X0 + X1) / 2, Y1 + (HealthText.Enabled and 22 * Size + 2 or 2))
                                            end

                                            if v.Player and (HeldItem.Enabled or Armor.Enabled or Enchant.Enabled or Rank.Enabled) and (not Loadouts[v] or Loadouts[v].Expires < tick()) then
                                                Loadouts[v] = {Expires = tick() + 0.5, Images = Loadout(v.Player)}
                                            end

                                            local Images: {string} = Loadouts[v] and Loadouts[v].Images or {}
                                            local Width: number = ((#Images - 1) * 22 + 24) * Size
                                            for Index: number, Icon: ImageLabel in Slot.Icons do
                                                Icon.Visible = Images[Index] ~= nil
                                                if Images[Index] then
                                                    if Icon.Image ~= Images[Index] then
                                                        Icon.Image = Images[Index]
                                                    end

                                                    Icon.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor((X0 + X1) / 2 - Width / 2 + (Index - 1) * 22 * Size), Name.Enabled and Y0 - 7 - 20 * Size or Y0 - 2)
                                                end
                                            end
                                        else
                                            Boxes.Hide(Slot)
                                        end
                                    else
                                        Boxes.Hide(Slot)
                                    end
                                else
                                    Boxes.Hide(Slot)
                                end
                            else
                                if Slots[v] then
                                    Styled[Slots[v]] = nil
                                    Boxes.Destroy(Slots[v])
                                    Slots[v] = nil
                                end
                            end
                        else
                            if Slots[v] then
