                                Boxes.Hide(Slots[v])
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    for k: any, v: Box in Slots do
                        if not Seen[k] then
                            Styled[v] = nil
                            Boxes.Destroy(v)
                            Slots[k] = nil
                            Loadouts[k] = nil
                        end
                    end
                end))
            else
                for _, v: Box in Slots do
                    Boxes.Hide(v)
                end

                table.clear(Loadouts)
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Draws a box, name, health and distance over players and NPCs"
    })

    Targets = ESP:CreateTargets({
        Players = true,
        NoPriority = true
    })
    Look = ESP:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Style",
        List = {"Modern", "Legacy"},
        Default = "Modern",
        Function = function(Value: string)
            for _, v: any in {Inline, Enchant, Rank} do
                if v and v.Object then
                    v.Object.Visible = Value == "Modern"
                end
            end
            if BoxStyle and BoxStyle.Object then
                BoxStyle.Object.Visible = Value == "Modern" and BoundingBox.Enabled
            end

            if ESP.Enabled then
                for k: any, v: Box in Slots do
                    Styled[v] = nil
                    Boxes.Destroy(v)
                    Slots[k] = nil
                end

                ESP:Toggle()
                ESP:Toggle()
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Modern is the current look\nLegacy draws the old script name tags and 2D boxes, and ignores Box style, Inline tag, Enchant and Rank"
    })
    BoundingBox = ESP:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Bounding box",
        Default = true,
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if BoxStyle and BoxStyle.Object then
                BoxStyle.Object.Visible = Callback and (not Look or Look.Value == "Modern")
            end
        end
    })
    BoxStyle = ESP:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Box style",
        List = {"Corners", "Full", "Rounded"},
        Default = "Corners",
        Darker = true,
        Visible = BoundingBox.Enabled
    })
    BoxColor = ESP:CreateColorSlider({
        Name = "Box color",
        DefaultSat = 0
    })
    Name = ESP:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Name",
        Default = true
    })
    NameColor = ESP:CreateColorSlider({
        Name = "Name color",
        DefaultSat = 0
    })
    HealthBar = ESP:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Health bar",
        Default = true
    })
    HealthText = ESP:CreateToggle({Name = "Health text"})
    Distance = ESP:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Distance",
        Default = true
    })
    HeldItem = ESP:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Held item",
        Function = function()
            table.clear(Loadouts)
        end,
        Tooltip = "Shows the item they are holding above their name"
    })
    Armor = ESP:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Armor",
        Function = function()
            table.clear(Loadouts)
        end,
        Tooltip = "Shows the helmet, chestplate and boots they are wearing"
    })
    Enchant = ESP:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Enchant",
        Function = function()
            table.clear(Loadouts)
        end,
        Tooltip = "Shows the icon of the enchant they have active"
    })
    Rank = ESP:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Rank",
        Function = function()
            table.clear(Loadouts)
        end,
        Tooltip = "Shows their ranked division icon, fetched once per player"
    })
    DistanceCheck = ESP:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Distance check",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if MaxDistance and MaxDistance.Object then
                MaxDistance.Object.Visible = Callback
            end
        end
    })
    MaxDistance = ESP:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Max distance",
        Min = 10,
        Max = 1000,
        Default = 250,
        Darker = true,
        Visible = DistanceCheck.Enabled,
        Suffix = function(Value: number): string
            return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
        end
    })
    Scale = ESP:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Scale",
        Min = 0.1,
        Max = 1.5,
        Default = 1,
        Decimal = 10
    })
    Inline = ESP:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Inline tag",
        Default = true,
        Tooltip = "Puts the distance and health inside the name tag like the old NameTags, off shows them under the box"
    })
    Background = ESP:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Text background",
        Default = true
    })
    TeamColor = ESP:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Team color",
        Tooltip = "Colors each box and name with the team color of that player"
    })
    TeamCheck = ESP:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Team check",
        Tooltip = "Hides your teammates"
    })
    Self = ESP:CreateToggle({Name = "Show self"})

    Cat:Clean(function()
        for _, v: Box in Slots do
            Boxes.Destroy(v)
        end
        table.clear(Slots)
        table.clear(Styled)
        for _, v: Tag in Tags do
            Erase(v)
        end

        table.clear(Tags)
        if Layer then
            Layer:Destroy()
            Layer = nil
        end
    end)
end)()

BundledModules.ItemESP = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat
    local Font: Font = BundledModules.UI.Font

    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity
    local Boxes = BundledModules.Boxes

    local ItemESP
    local Distance, Shadow, Scale, Whitelist, TextColor, Icons, Traps, Mine, TrapList, Pots, Hives, BoxToggle, BoxStyle, BoxColor

    local Tags: {[Instance]: any} = {}

    local Names: {[string]: string} = {
        glue_trap = "Gloop",
        grave_trap = "Grave",
        grave_trap_block = "Grave",
        invisible_landmine = "Landmine",
        lucky_block_trap = "Lucky Trap",
        snap_trap = "Snap Trap",
        spike_trap = "Spikes",
        tesla_trap = "Tesla"
    }

    local function Style(Tag: any)
        local Color: Color3 = Color3.fromHSV(TextColor.Hue, TextColor.Sat, TextColor.Value)
        for Index: number, v: any in {Tag.Slot.Name, Tag.Slot.Distance, Tag.Slot.Vitals} do
            v.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            v.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(Index == 1 and 0.5 or Index == 2 and 1 or 0, 0.5)
            v.Scale = Scale.Value
            v.Shadow = Shadow.Enabled
        end

        Tag.Slot.Name.Color = Color
        Tag.Slot.Vitals.Color = Color
        Tag.Pic = nil
    end

    local function Add(Item: Instance, Kind: string, Name: string)
        local Meta: any = Data.Instances.Items[Item.Name]
        local Tag: any = {Slot = Boxes.Make(), Image = Meta and Meta.image, Name = Name, Kind = Kind}
        if Tag.Image then
            Tag.Slot.Icons[1].Image = Tag.Image
        end

        Style(Tag)
        Tags[Item] = Tag
    end

    local function Added(Item: Instance)
        if Tags[Item] or not Item:IsA("BasePart") then
            return
        end

        local Name: string = Data.Instances.Items[Item.Name] and Data.Instances.Items[Item.Name].displayName or Item.Name
        if #Whitelist.ListEnabled > 0 then
            local Allowed: boolean = false
            for _, v: string in Whitelist.ListEnabled do
                if v:lower() == Item.Name:lower() or v:lower() == Name:lower() then
                    Allowed = true

                    break
                end
            end
            if not Allowed then
                return
            end
        end

        Add(Item, "Item", Name)
    end

    local function Placed(Block: Instance)
        if Tags[Block] or not Block:IsA("BasePart") then
            return
        end

        if Pots.Enabled and Block.Name == "desert_pot" then
            Add(Block, "Pot", "Pot")
        elseif Traps.Enabled and Names[Block.Name] and table.find(TrapList.ListEnabled, Names[Block.Name]) then
            Add(Block, "Trap", Names[Block.Name])
        end
    end

    local function Hive(Block: Instance)
        if Tags[Block] or not Block:IsA("BasePart") then
            return
        end

        local Owner: Player? = Services.Players:GetPlayerByUserId(Block:GetAttribute("PlacedByUserId") or 0)
        Add(Block, "Hive", Owner and `{Owner.DisplayName}'s hive` or "Beehive")
    end

    local function IsMine(Block: Instance): boolean
        local UserId: number? = Block:GetAttribute("PlacedByUserId")
        if not UserId or UserId == 0 then
            return false
        end

        if UserId == Services.LocalPlayer.UserId then
            return true
        end

        local Placer: Player? = Services.Players:GetPlayerByUserId(UserId)

        return Placer ~= nil and Placer:GetAttribute("Team") == Services.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Team")
    end

    local function Bounds(Part: BasePart, Camera: Camera): {number}?
        local MinX: number, MinY: number = math.huge, math.huge
        local MaxX: number, MaxY: number = -math.huge, -math.huge
        for _, v: Vector3 in Boxes.Edges do
            local Point: Vector3 = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(Part.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(v * Part.Size / 2))
            if Point.Z <= 0 then
                return nil
            end

            MinX, MaxX = math.min(MinX, Point.X), math.max(MaxX, Point.X)
            MinY, MaxY = math.min(MinY, Point.Y), math.max(MaxY, Point.Y)
        end

        return {math.floor(MinX) - 3, math.floor(MinY) - 3, math.ceil(MaxX) + 3, math.ceil(MaxY) + 3}
    end

    local function Draw(Slot: Box, Color: Color3, Area: {number}?)
        local Used: number = Area and Boxes.Shape(Slot, BoxStyle.Value, Area[1], Area[2], Area[3], Area[4]) or 0
        for Index: number, Line: DrawingLine in Slot.Lines do
            Line.Visible = Index <= Used
            Line.Color = Color
            Slot.Outlines[Index].Visible = Index <= Used
        end

        Slot.Used = Used
    end

    local function Restart()
        if ItemESP and ItemESP.Enabled then
            ItemESP:Toggle()
            ItemESP:Toggle()
        end
    end

    ItemESP = Cat.Categories.Render:CreateModule({
        Name = "ItemESP",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback then
                for _, v: Instance in Services.CollectionService:GetTagged("ItemDrop") do
                    Added(v)
                end

                ItemESP:Clean(Services.CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal("ItemDrop"):Connect(Added))

                if Traps.Enabled or Pots.Enabled then
                    for _, v: Instance in Services.CollectionService:GetTagged("block") do
                        Placed(v)
                    end

                    ItemESP:Clean(Services.CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal("block"):Connect(Placed))
                end

                if Hives.Enabled then
                    for _, v: Instance in Services.CollectionService:GetTagged("beehive") do
                        Hive(v)
                    end

                    ItemESP:Clean(Services.CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal("beehive"):Connect(Hive))
                end

                local function Removed(Item: Instance)
                    if Tags[Item] then
                        Boxes.Destroy(Tags[Item].Slot)
                        Tags[Item] = nil
                    end
                end

                ItemESP:Clean(Services.CollectionService:GetInstanceRemovedSignal("ItemDrop"):Connect(Removed))
                ItemESP:Clean(Services.CollectionService:GetInstanceRemovedSignal("block"):Connect(Removed))
                ItemESP:Clean(Services.CollectionService:GetInstanceRemovedSignal("beehive"):Connect(Removed))

                ItemESP:Clean(Services.RunService.PreRender:Connect(function()
                    local Camera: Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
                    local LocalPosition: Vector3? = Entity.Alive and Entity.RootPart.Position or nil
                    local Lines: Color3 = Color3.fromHSV(BoxColor.Hue, BoxColor.Sat, BoxColor.Value)
                    for Item: Instance, Tag: any in Tags do
                        if Item.Parent then
                            local Position: Vector3 = (Item :: BasePart).Position
                            local Allowed: boolean = Position.Y > -200 and (Tag.Kind ~= "Trap" or Mine.Enabled or not IsMine(Item))
                            local Area: {number}? = Allowed and Bounds(Item :: BasePart, Camera) or nil
                            local Show: boolean = Area ~= nil
                            local Pic: boolean = Icons.Enabled and Tag.Image ~= nil
                            local Slot: Box = Tag.Slot

                            if Show then
                                local Bees: boolean = Tag.Kind == "Hive"
                                local Amount: number = if Bees then Item:GetAttribute("Level") or 0 else Item:GetAttribute("Amount") or 1
                                local Gap: number? = Distance.Enabled and (LocalPosition and math.floor((LocalPosition - Position).Magnitude) or 0) or nil
                                if Tag.Amount ~= Amount or Tag.Distance ~= Gap or Tag.Pic ~= Pic then
                                    Tag.Amount, Tag.Distance, Tag.Pic = Amount, Gap, Pic
                                    Tag.Width = Pic and 28 or Cat.Ui:Measure(Tag.Name, 14, Font).X + 10
                                    Slot.Name.Text = Tag.Name
                                    Slot.Vitals.Text = if Bees then `{Amount} {Amount == 1 and "bee" or "bees"}` elseif Amount >= 2 then `x{Amount}` else ""
                                    Slot.Distance.Text = Gap and `{Gap}m` or ""
                                end

                                local Size: number = 28 * Scale.Value
                                local Half: number = (Tag.Width / 2 - 5) * Scale.Value
                                local Edges: {number} = Area :: {number}
                                local Screen: Vector2 = Vector2.new((Edges[1] + Edges[3]) / 2, Edges[2] - math.max(Size, 20 * Scale.Value) / 2 - 2)
                                Slot.Name.Visible = not Pic
                                Slot.Name.Position = Vector2.new(Screen.X, Screen.Y)
                                Slot.Distance.Visible = Gap ~= nil
                                Slot.Distance.Position = Vector2.new(Screen.X - Half, Screen.Y)
                                Slot.Vitals.Visible = Bees or Amount >= 2
                                Slot.Vitals.Position = Vector2.new(Screen.X + Half, Screen.Y)

                                local Icon: ImageLabel = Slot.Icons[1]
                                Icon.Visible = Pic
                                Icon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(Size, Size)
                                Icon.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(Screen.X - Size / 2), math.floor(Screen.Y + Size / 2))
                            elseif Tag.Shown then
                                Boxes.Hide(Slot)
                            end
                            Tag.Shown = Show

                            if (Area and BoxToggle.Enabled) or Slot.Used > 0 then
                                Draw(Slot, Lines, BoxToggle.Enabled and Area or nil)
                            end
                        else
                            Tags[Item] = nil
                            Boxes.Destroy(Tag.Slot)
                        end
                    end
                end))
            else
                for _, v: any in Tags do
                    Boxes.Destroy(v.Slot)
                end

                table.clear(Tags)
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Renders tags over dropped items, and optionally traps and pots"
    })

    Distance = ItemESP:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Distance",
        Tooltip = "Shows the distance of the item"
    })
    Shadow = ItemESP:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Text shadow",
        Default = true,
        Function = function()
            for _, Tag: any in Tags do
                Style(Tag)
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Draws a dark copy of the text behind it so it reads on bright floors"
    })
    Scale = ItemESP:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Scale",
        Min = 0.1,
        Max = 1.5,
        Default = 1,
        Decimal = 10,
        Function = function(Value: number)
            for _, Tag: any in Tags do
                Tag.Slot.Name.Scale = Value
                Tag.Slot.Distance.Scale = Value
                Tag.Slot.Vitals.Scale = Value
            end
        end
    })
    TextColor = ItemESP:CreateColorSlider({
        Name = "Text color",
        DefaultSat = 0,
        Function = function(Hue: number, Sat: number, Val: number)
            for _, Tag: any in Tags do
                Tag.Slot.Name.Color = Color3.fromHSV(Hue, Sat, Val)
                Tag.Slot.Vitals.Color = Color3.fromHSV(Hue, Sat, Val)
            end
        end
    })
    Icons = ItemESP:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Icons",
        Function = function()
            for _, Tag: any in Tags do
                Tag.Pic = nil
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Shows the item icon instead of its name"
    })
    Traps = ItemESP:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Traps",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Mine and Mine.Object then
                Mine.Object.Visible = Callback
            end

            if TrapList and TrapList.Object then
                TrapList.Object.Visible = Callback
            end

            Restart()
        end,
        Tooltip = "Also shows traps and landmines, which have no visual at all"
    })
    Mine = ItemESP:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Your traps",
        Default = true,
        Darker = true,
        Visible = Traps.Enabled,
        Tooltip = "Also shows the ones your own team placed"
    })
    TrapList = ItemESP:CreateTextList({
        Name = "Trap list",
        Function = Restart,
        Default = {
            "Gloop",
            "Grave",
            "Landmine",
            "Lucky Trap",
            "Snap Trap",
            "Spikes",
            "Tesla"
        },
        Darker = true,
        Visible = Traps.Enabled
    })
    Pots = ItemESP:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Pots",
        Function = Restart,
        Tooltip = "Also shows desert pots"
    })
    Hives = ItemESP:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Beehives",
        Function = Restart,
        Tooltip = "Also shows beehives with their owner and how many bees are in them"
    })
    BoxToggle = ItemESP:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Boxes",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if BoxStyle and BoxStyle.Object then
                BoxStyle.Object.Visible = Callback
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Draws a box around each entry"
    })
    BoxStyle = ItemESP:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Box style",
        List = {"Corners", "Full", "Rounded"},
        Default = "Corners",
        Darker = true,
        Visible = BoxToggle.Enabled
    })
    BoxColor = ItemESP:CreateColorSlider({
        Name = "Box color",
        DefaultSat = 0
    })
    Whitelist = ItemESP:CreateTextList({
        Name = "Allowed items",
        Function = Restart,
        Darker = true,
        Tooltip = "Only shows the items in this list, by name or item id.\nLeave it empty to show every item"
    })

    Cat:Clean(function()
        for _, v: any in Tags do
            Boxes.Destroy(v.Slot)
        end

        table.clear(Tags)
    end)
end)()

BundledModules.KitDisplay = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat
    local UI = BundledModules.UI

    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local KitDisplay
    local ShowPrevious

    local Histories: {[number]: {string}} = {}
    local Fetching: {[number]: boolean} = {}
    local Thumbnails: {[number]: string} = {}
    local Connections: {[Instance]: {RBXScriptConnection}} = {}

    local function GetPlayer(Entry: Instance, Name: string): Player?
        for _, v: Player in Services.Players:GetPlayers() do
            if v.Name == Name or v.DisplayName == Name or v:GetAttribute("DisguiseDisplayName") == Name then
                return v
            end
        end

        if type(Data.Controllers.StreamerModeController.getDisplayName) == "function" then
            for _, v: Player in Services.Players:GetPlayers() do
                local Success: boolean, DisplayName: any = pcall(
                    Data.Controllers.StreamerModeController.getDisplayName,
                    Data.Controllers.StreamerModeController,
                    v
                )
                if Success and DisplayName == Name then
                    return v
                end
            end
        end

        local PlayerRender: Instance? = Entry:FindFirstChild("PlayerRender", true)
        if PlayerRender and PlayerRender:IsA("ImageLabel") and PlayerRender.Image ~= "" then
            for _, v: Player in Services.Players:GetPlayers() do
                if not Thumbnails[v.UserId] then
                    local Success: boolean, Thumbnail: string, Ready: boolean = pcall(
                        Services.Players.GetUserThumbnailAsync,
                        Services.Players,
                        v.UserId,
                        Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot,
                        Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size352x352
                    )
                    if Success and Ready then
                        Thumbnails[v.UserId] = Thumbnail
                    end
                end
                if Thumbnails[v.UserId] == PlayerRender.Image then
                    return v
                end
            end
        end

        if Name == Entry:GetAttribute("KitDisplayOriginalName") then
            return Services.Players:GetPlayerByUserId(Entry:GetAttribute("KitDisplayUserId") or 0)
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function GetPreviousKits(Player: Player): {string}
        local UserId: number = Player.UserId
        if Histories[UserId] then
            return Histories[UserId]
        end

        local Deadline: number = os.clock() + 15
        repeat
            if not Fetching[UserId] then
                break
            end
            if not KitDisplay.Enabled or os.clock() >= Deadline then
                return {}
            end
            task.wait()
        until false
        if Histories[UserId] then
            return Histories[UserId]
        end

        Fetching[UserId] = true
        local Success: boolean, Kits: any = pcall(function(): {string}?
            local Result: any = Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("RequestMatchHistory"):CallServer(Player.Name)
            if type(Result) ~= "table" or type(Result.matchHistory) ~= "table" then
                return nil
            end

            local List: {string} = {}
            table.sort(Result.matchHistory, function(A: any, B: any): boolean
                return (tonumber(A.matchStartTime) or 0) > (tonumber(B.matchStartTime) or 0)
            end)
            for i: number, Match: any in Result.matchHistory do
                if i > 8 then
                    break
                end
                local Kit: string = "none"
                for _, MatchPlayer: any in Match.players or {} do
                    if MatchPlayer.playerInfo and MatchPlayer.playerInfo.userId == UserId then
                        local Stats: any = MatchPlayer["bedwars"]
                        Kit = Stats and Stats.kit or "none"
                        break
                    end
                end
                table.insert(List, Kit)
            end
            return List
        end)
        Fetching[UserId] = nil

        if Success and type(Kits) == "table" then
            Histories[UserId] = Kits
            return Kits
        end
        return {}
    end

    local function RenderPreviousKits(Card: Instance, Player: Player): ()
        local Old: Instance? = Card:FindFirstChild("PreviousKits")
        if Old then
            Old:Destroy()
        end

        if ShowPrevious.Enabled then
            local Holder: Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
            Holder.Name = "PreviousKits"
            Holder.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
            Holder.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.03)
            Holder.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.86, 0.24)
            Holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            Holder.BorderSizePixel = 0
            Holder.ClipsDescendants = true
            Holder.ZIndex = 3
            Holder.Parent = Card
            KitDisplay:Clean(Holder)

            local Corner: UICorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
            Corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
            Corner.Parent = Holder

            local Padding: UIPadding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
            Padding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 3)
            Padding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 3)
            Padding.Parent = Holder

            local Layout: UIListLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
            Layout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
            Layout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
            Layout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
            Layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 2)
            Layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
            Layout.Parent = Holder

            local Kits: {string} = GetPreviousKits(Player)
            if KitDisplay.Enabled and ShowPrevious.Enabled and Holder.Parent then
                if #Kits == 0 then
                    Holder:Destroy()
                else
                    for i: number, Kit: string in Kits do
                        local Meta: any = Data.Instances.BedwarsKitMeta[string.split(Kit, ",")[1]]
                            or Data.Instances.BedwarsKitMeta.none

                        local Icon: ImageLabel = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
                        Icon.Name = `Kit{i}`
                        Icon.LayoutOrder = i
                        Icon.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
                        Icon.SizeConstraint = Enum.SizeConstraint.RelativeYY
                        Icon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                        Icon.Image = Meta and Meta.renderImage or ""
                        Icon.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
                        Icon.ZIndex = 4
                        Icon.Parent = Holder

                        local Order: TextLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                        Order.Name = "Order"
                        Order.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 1)
                        Order.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(13, 13)
                        Order.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new()
                        Order.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                        Order.BorderSizePixel = 0
                        Order.FontFace = UI.Font
                        Order.Text = tostring(i)
                        Order.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
                        Order.TextSize = 9
                        Order.ZIndex = 5
                        Order.Parent = Icon

                        local OrderCorner: UICorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
                        OrderCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
                        OrderCorner.Parent = Order
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local function SetKit(Image: ImageLabel, Player: Player): ()
        local Meta: any = Data.Instances.BedwarsKitMeta[string.split(Player:GetAttribute("PlayingAsKits") or "none", ",")[1]]
            or Data.Instances.BedwarsKitMeta.none
        Image.Image = Meta and Meta.renderImage or ""
        Image.Position = UDim2.fromScale(1.05, 0)
        Services.TweenService:Create(Image, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Cubic, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
            Position = UDim2.fromScale(1.05, 0.5)
        }):Play()
    end

    local function RenderKit(Entry: Instance): ()
        task.wait(0.3)

        local PlayerName: Instance? = Entry:FindFirstChild("PlayerName", true)
        if not KitDisplay.Enabled or not Entry.Parent or not PlayerName then
            return
        end

        local OriginalName: string = PlayerName:GetAttribute("NickHiderOriginalText") or PlayerName.Text
        local Player: Player? = GetPlayer(Entry, OriginalName)
        if not KitDisplay.Enabled or not Entry.Parent or not Player then
            return
        end

        local Frame: Instance? = Entry:FindFirstChild("1")
        local Card: Instance? = Frame and Frame:FindFirstChild("MatchDraftPlayerCard")
        if not Card then
            return
        end

        for _, Connection: RBXScriptConnection in Connections[Entry] or {} do
            Connection:Disconnect()
        end

        local Image: any = Card:FindFirstChild("KitImage")
        if not Image then
            Image = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
            Image.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            Image.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
            Image.Position = UDim2.fromScale(1.05, 0)
            Image.Name = "KitImage"
            Image.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1.5, 1.5)
            Image.ZIndex = 1
            Image.ImageTransparency = 0.4
            Image.SliceCenter = Rect.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
            Image.SliceScale = 1
            Image.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop
            Image.Parent = Card
            KitDisplay:Clean(Image)

            local Ratio: UIAspectRatioConstraint = Instance.new("UIAspectRatioConstraint")
            Ratio.Name = "1"
            Ratio.AspectRatio = 1
            Ratio.AspectType = Enum.AspectType.FitWithinMaxSize
            Ratio.DominantAxis = Enum.DominantAxis.Width
            Ratio.Parent = Image
        end

        SetKit(Image, Player)
        task.spawn(RenderPreviousKits, Card, Player)

        Entry:SetAttribute("KitDisplayUserId", Player.UserId)
        Entry:SetAttribute("KitDisplayOriginalName", OriginalName)

        local Connection: RBXScriptConnection? = Player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("PlayingAsKits"):Connect(function(): ()
            if KitDisplay.Enabled and Image.Parent then
                SetKit(Image, Player)
            end
        end)
        local NameConnection: RBXScriptConnection = PlayerName:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Once(function(): ()
            if Connection then
                Connection:Disconnect()
                Connection = nil
            end
            RenderKit(Entry)
        end)
        Connections[Entry] = {Connection, NameConnection}
        KitDisplay:Clean(NameConnection)
        KitDisplay:Clean(Connection)
    end

    KitDisplay = Cat.Categories.Render:CreateModule({
        Name = "KitDisplay",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback then
                KitDisplay:Clean(function(): ()
                    table.clear(Connections)
                    table.clear(Histories)
                    table.clear(Fetching)
                    table.clear(Thumbnails)
                end)

                local BodyContainer: Instance?
                repeat
                    local App: Instance? = Services.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("MatchDraftApp")
                    local Background: Instance? = App and App:FindFirstChild("DraftAppBackground")
                    local Frame: Instance? = Background and Background:FindFirstChild("1")
                    BodyContainer = Frame and Frame:FindFirstChild("BodyContainer")
                    if not BodyContainer then
                        task.wait(0.1)
                    end
                until BodyContainer or not KitDisplay.Enabled

                if KitDisplay.Enabled and BodyContainer then
                    for Team: number = 1, 2 do
                        if KitDisplay.Enabled then
                            local Column: Instance?
                            local Deadline: number = os.clock() + 10
                            repeat
                                Column = BodyContainer:FindFirstChild(`Team{Team}Column`)
                                if not Column then
                                    task.wait(0.1)
                                end
                            until Column or not KitDisplay.Enabled or os.clock() >= Deadline

                            if Column then
                                KitDisplay:Clean(Column.ChildAdded:Connect(RenderKit))
                                for _, v: Instance in Column:GetChildren() do
                                    task.spawn(RenderKit, v)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Lets you see everyone's kit in the match draft"
    })

    ShowPrevious = KitDisplay:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Show previous kits",
        Function = function(): ()
            if KitDisplay.Enabled then
                KitDisplay:Toggle()
                KitDisplay:Toggle()
            end
        end,
        Default = true,
        Tooltip = "Shows the kits each player used in their last 8 games, newest first"
    })
end)()

BundledModules.KitESP = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity
    local Boxes = BundledModules.Boxes

    local KitESP
    local Distance, Shadow, Scale, BoxToggle, BoxStyle, BoxColor

    local Tags: {[Instance]: any} = {}
    local Connections: {RBXScriptConnection} = {}

    local ESPKits: {[string]: {string}} = {
        alchemist = {"alchemist_ingedients", "wild_flower"},
        beekeeper = {"bee", "bee"},
        bigman = {"treeOrb", "natures_essence_1"},
        black_market_trader = {"shadow_coin", "shadow_coin"},
        ghost_catcher = {"ghost", "ghost_orb"},
        metal_detector = {"hidden-metal", "iron"},
        sheep_herder = {"SheepModel", "purple_hay_bale"},
        sorcerer = {"alchemy_crystal", "wild_flower"},
        star_collector = {"stars", "crit_star"}
    }

    local function GetPart(Ent: Instance): BasePart?
        if Ent:IsA("BasePart") then
            return Ent
        end
        if Ent:IsA("Model") then
            return Ent.PrimaryPart or Ent:FindFirstChild("Root") :: BasePart? or Ent:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
        end

        return Ent:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
    end

    local function Style(Tag: any)
        Tag.Slot.Distance.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        Tag.Slot.Distance.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
        Tag.Slot.Distance.Scale = Scale.Value
        Tag.Slot.Distance.Shadow = Shadow.Enabled
    end

    local function Bounds(Ent: Instance, Camera: Camera): {number}?
        local Frame: CFrame, Size: Vector3
        if Ent:IsA("Model") then
            local Success: boolean, Pivot: CFrame, Extent: Vector3 = pcall(Ent.GetBoundingBox, Ent)
            if not Success then
                return nil
            end
            Frame, Size = Pivot, Extent
        else
            local Part: BasePart? = GetPart(Ent)
            if not Part then
                return nil
            end
            Frame, Size = Part.CFrame, Part.Size
        end

        local MinX: number, MinY: number = math.huge, math.huge
        local MaxX: number, MaxY: number = -math.huge, -math.huge
        for _, v: Vector3 in Boxes.Edges do
            local Point: Vector3 = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(Frame:PointToWorldSpace(v * Size / 2))
            if Point.Z <= 0 then
                return nil
            end

            MinX, MaxX = math.min(MinX, Point.X), math.max(MaxX, Point.X)
            MinY, MaxY = math.min(MinY, Point.Y), math.max(MaxY, Point.Y)
        end

        return {math.floor(MinX) - 3, math.floor(MinY) - 3, math.ceil(MaxX) + 3, math.ceil(MaxY) + 3}
    end

    local function Draw(Slot: Box, Color: Color3, Area: {number}?)
        local Used: number = Area and Boxes.Shape(Slot, BoxStyle.Value, Area[1], Area[2], Area[3], Area[4]) or 0
        for Index: number, Line: DrawingLine in Slot.Lines do
            Line.Visible = Index <= Used
            Line.Color = Color
            Slot.Outlines[Index].Visible = Index <= Used
        end

        Slot.Used = Used
    end

    local function Clear()
        for _, v: RBXScriptConnection in Connections do
            v:Disconnect()
        end
        for _, v: any in Tags do
            Boxes.Destroy(v.Slot)
        end

        table.clear(Connections)
        table.clear(Tags)
    end

    local function Added(Ent: Instance, Icon: string)
        if Tags[Ent] then
            return
        end

        local Meta: any = Data.Instances.Items[Icon]
        local Tag: any = {Slot = Boxes.Make(), Image = Meta and Meta.image or ""}
        Tag.Slot.Icons[1].Image = Tag.Image
        Style(Tag)
        Tags[Ent] = Tag
    end

    local function Watch(Kit: {string})
        table.insert(Connections, Services.CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal(Kit[1]):Connect(function(Ent: Instance)
            Added(Ent, Kit[2])
        end))
        table.insert(Connections, Services.CollectionService:GetInstanceRemovedSignal(Kit[1]):Connect(function(Ent: Instance)
            if Tags[Ent] then
                Boxes.Destroy(Tags[Ent].Slot)
                Tags[Ent] = nil
            end
        end))

        for _, v: Instance in Services.CollectionService:GetTagged(Kit[1]) do
            Added(v, Kit[2])
        end
    end

    KitESP = Cat.Categories.Render:CreateModule({
        Name = "KitESP",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if not Callback then
                Clear()
                return
            end

            KitESP:Clean(Services.RunService.PreRender:Connect(function()
                local Camera: Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
                local LocalPosition: Vector3? = Entity.Alive and Entity.RootPart.Position or nil
                local Lines: Color3 = Color3.fromHSV(BoxColor.Hue, BoxColor.Sat, BoxColor.Value)
                for Ent: Instance, Tag: any in Tags do
                    if not Ent.Parent then
                        Tags[Ent] = nil
                        Boxes.Destroy(Tag.Slot)
                        continue
                    end

                    local Area: {number}? = Bounds(Ent, Camera)
                    local Slot: Box = Tag.Slot
                    if Area then
                        local Part: BasePart? = GetPart(Ent)
                        local Gap: number? = Distance.Enabled and (LocalPosition and Part and math.floor((LocalPosition - Part.Position).Magnitude) or 0) or nil
                        if Tag.Distance ~= Gap then
                            Tag.Distance = Gap
                            Slot.Distance.Text = Gap and `{Gap}m` or ""
                        end

                        local Size: number = 28 * Scale.Value
                        local Screen: Vector2 = Vector2.new((Area[1] + Area[3]) / 2, Area[2] - Size / 2 - 2)
                        Slot.Distance.Visible = Gap ~= nil
                        Slot.Distance.Position = Vector2.new(Screen.X - 9 * Scale.Value, Screen.Y)

                        local Icon: ImageLabel = Slot.Icons[1]
                        Icon.Visible = true
                        Icon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(Size, Size)
                        Icon.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(Screen.X - Size / 2), math.floor(Screen.Y + Size / 2))
                    elseif Tag.Shown then
                        Boxes.Hide(Slot)
                    end
                    Tag.Shown = Area ~= nil

                    if (Area and BoxToggle.Enabled) or Slot.Used > 0 then
                        Draw(Slot, Lines, BoxToggle.Enabled and Area or nil)
                    end
                end
            end))

            local Current: string?
            repeat
                local Kits: {string} = {}
                local Attribute: any = Services.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("PlayingAsKits")
                local Joined: string = `{Data.Storage.EquippedKit},{typeof(Attribute) == "string" and Attribute or ""}`
                for _, v: string in string.split(Joined, ",") do
                    if v ~= "" and v ~= "none" and not table.find(Kits, v) then
                        table.insert(Kits, v)
                    end
                end

                local Key: string = table.concat(Kits, ",")
                if Key ~= Current then
                    Current = Key
                    Clear()
                    for _, v: string in Kits do
                        if ESPKits[v] then
                            Watch(ESPKits[v])
                        end
                    end
                end

                task.wait(1)
            until not KitESP.Enabled
        end,
        Tooltip = "Shows icons on kit related objects, for every kit you have (both kits in Kit Fusion)"
    })

    Distance = KitESP:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Distance",
        Tooltip = "Shows how far away each object is"
    })
    Shadow = KitESP:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Text shadow",
        Default = true,
        Function = function()
            for _, Tag: any in Tags do
                Style(Tag)
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Draws a dark copy of the text behind it so it reads on bright floors"
    })
    Scale = KitESP:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Scale",
        Min = 0.1,
        Max = 1.5,
        Default = 1,
        Decimal = 10,
        Function = function(Value: number)
            for _, Tag: any in Tags do
                Tag.Slot.Distance.Scale = Value
            end
        end
    })
    BoxToggle = KitESP:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Boxes",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if BoxStyle and BoxStyle.Object then
                BoxStyle.Object.Visible = Callback
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Draws a box around each object"
    })
    BoxStyle = KitESP:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Box style",
        List = {"Corners", "Full", "Rounded"},
        Default = "Corners",
        Darker = true,
        Visible = BoxToggle.Enabled
    })
    BoxColor = KitESP:CreateColorSlider({
        Name = "Box color",
        DefaultSat = 0
    })

    Cat:Clean(Clear)
end)()

BundledModules.Weather = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services
    local getcustomasset: (string) -> string = BundledModules.getcustomasset
    local isfile: (string) -> boolean = BundledModules.isfile

    local Slots: number = 24
    local Params: RaycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    Params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    Params.RespectCanCollide = true

    local function Texture(Name: string, Fallback: string?): string?
        local Path: string = `catvape/assets/weather/{Name}.png`
        local Success: boolean, Result: any = pcall(function()
            return isfile(Path) and getcustomasset(Path)
        end)
        if Success and Result then
            return Result
        end

        warn(`[catvape] Weather: {Name}.png is missing or won't load, {Fallback and "using a fallback texture" or "skipping that layer"}`)

        return Fallback
    end

    return function(): Weather
        local Weather: Weather
        local Folder: Folder
        local Flash: ColorCorrectionEffect
        local LensFrame: Frame
        local NearPart: Part, FarPart: Part, MistPart: Part
        local Rain: ParticleEmitter, Veil: ParticleEmitter, Mist: ParticleEmitter
        local Loops: {Sound} = {}
        local Equalizers: {EqualizerSoundEffect} = {}
        local Shots: {Sound} = {}
        local Splashes: {ParticleEmitter} = {}
        local Ripples: {ParticleEmitter} = {}
        local Bolts: {Part} = {}
        local Drops: {ImageLabel} = {}
        local Level: number = 0.7
        local ThunderOn: boolean, LensOn: boolean, HasLens: boolean = true, true, false
        local Covered: boolean, Muffled: boolean = false, false
        local NearRate: number = 0
        local Version: number = 0

        local function Build(): ()
            local Streak: string = Texture("streak", "rbxassetid://17737615358") :: string
            local Puff: string = Texture("mist", "rbxasset://textures/particles/smoke_main.dds") :: string
            local SplashImage: string? = Texture("splash", nil)
            local RippleImage: string? = Texture("ripple", nil)
            local LensImage: string? = Texture("lens", nil)
            HasLens = LensImage ~= nil

            Folder = Instance.new("Folder")
            Folder.Name = "Weather"
            Cat:Clean(Folder)
            Cat:Clean(function(): ()
                Version += 1
            end)

            local Made: {Part} = {}
            for Index: number, Size: Vector3 in {Vector3.new(170, 1, 170), Vector3.new(800, 1, 800), Vector3.new(220, 2, 220), Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)} do
                local Part: Part = Instance.new("Part")
                Part.Name = "Layer"
                Part.Anchored = true
                Part.CanCollide = false
                Part.CanQuery = false
                Part.CanTouch = false
                Part.CastShadow = false
                Part.Transparency = 1
                Part.Size = Size
                Part.Parent = Folder
                Made[Index] = Part
            end
            NearPart, FarPart, MistPart = Made[1], Made[2], Made[3]

            Rain = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
            Rain.Texture = Streak
            Rain.Orientation = Enum.ParticleOrientation.FacingCameraWorldUp
            Rain.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Bottom
            Rain.Speed = NumberRange.new(130, 160)
            Rain.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.36, 0.4)
            Rain.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(1.5, 1.5)
            Rain.Acceleration = Vector3.new(6, 0, 2)
            Rain.Size = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 3.5, 0.8), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 3.5, 0.8)})
            Rain.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.1)
            Rain.LightInfluence = 0.4
            Rain.LightEmission = 0.6
            Rain.Rate = 0
            Rain.Enabled = false
            Rain.Parent = NearPart

            Veil = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
            Veil.Texture = Streak
            Veil.Orientation = Enum.ParticleOrientation.FacingCameraWorldUp
            Veil.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Bottom
            Veil.Speed = NumberRange.new(150, 170)
            Veil.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.8, 0.88)
            Veil.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(1.5, 1.5)
            Veil.Acceleration = Vector3.new(6, 0, 2)
            Veil.Size = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 7, 1.5), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 7, 1.5)})
            Veil.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.4)
            Veil.LightInfluence = 0.4
            Veil.LightEmission = 0.6
            Veil.Rate = 0
            Veil.Enabled = false
            Veil.Parent = FarPart

            Mist = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
            Mist.Texture = Puff
            Mist.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top
            Mist.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.5, 2)
            Mist.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(6, 9)
            Mist.Drag = 0.5
            Mist.Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360)
            Mist.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-8, 8)
            Mist.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(120, 130, 146))
            Mist.Size = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 18), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 40)})
            Mist.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.2, 0.95), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.8, 0.96), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})
            Mist.LightInfluence = 1
            Mist.LightEmission = 0
            Mist.Rate = 0
            Mist.Enabled = false
            Mist.Parent = MistPart

            for Index: number = 1, Slots do
                if SplashImage then
                    local Pad: Attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
                    Pad.Name = "Splash"
                    Pad.Parent = Made[4]

                    local Splash: ParticleEmitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
                    Splash.Texture = SplashImage
                    Splash.FlipbookLayout = Enum.ParticleFlipbookLayout.Grid4x4
                    Splash.FlipbookMode = Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.OneShot
                    Splash.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.35, 0.4)
                    Splash.Speed = NumberRange.new(0)
                    Splash.Size = NumberSequence.new(1.4)
                    Splash.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.2)
                    Splash.LightInfluence = 1
                    Splash.LightEmission = 0
                    Splash.Rate = 0
                    Splash.Enabled = false
                    Splash.Parent = Pad
                    Splashes[Index] = Splash
                end
                if RippleImage then
                    local Pad: Attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
                    Pad.Name = "Ripple"
                    Pad.Parent = Made[4]

                    local Ripple: ParticleEmitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
                    Ripple.Texture = RippleImage
                    Ripple.Orientation = Enum.ParticleOrientation.VelocityPerpendicular
                    Ripple.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top
                    Ripple.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.6, 0.65)
                    Ripple.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.05)
                    Ripple.Size = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.2), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1.7)})
                    Ripple.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.25), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.6, 0.6), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})
                    Ripple.LightInfluence = 1
                    Ripple.LightEmission = 0
                    Ripple.Rate = 0
                    Ripple.Enabled = false
                    Ripple.Parent = Pad
                    Ripples[Index] = Ripple
                end
            end

            for Index: number, Name: string in {"PIRATE_EVENT_RAIN_LOOP", "WIND_AMBIENCE", "LIGHTNING_THUNDER_STORM_LOOP"} do
                local Loop: Sound = Instance.new("Sound")
                Loop.Name = Name
                Loop.SoundId = Data.Instances.Sounds[Name]
                Loop.Looped = true
                Loop.Volume = 0

                local Equalizer: EqualizerSoundEffect = Instance.new("EqualizerSoundEffect")
                Equalizer.Name = "EQ"
                Equalizer.Parent = Loop
                Loop.Parent = Folder
                Loops[Index] = Loop
                Equalizers[Index] = Equalizer
            end
            for Index: number, Name: string in {"LIGHTNING_STRIKE_1", "LIGHTNING_STRIKE_2", "PIRATE_EVENT_THUNDER", "PIRATE_EVENT_THUNDER"} do
                local Shot: Sound = Instance.new("Sound")
                Shot.Name = Name
                Shot.SoundId = Data.Instances.Sounds[Name]

                local Equalizer: EqualizerSoundEffect = Instance.new("EqualizerSoundEffect")
                Equalizer.Name = "EQ"
                Equalizer.Parent = Shot
                Shot.Parent = Folder
                Shots[Index] = Shot
            end
            task.spawn(function(): ()
                pcall(function(): ()
                    Services.ContentProvider:PreloadAsync(Shots)
                end)
            end)

            for Index: number = 1, 40 do
                local Bolt: Part = Instance.new("Part")
                Bolt.Name = "Bolt"
                Bolt.Anchored = true
                Bolt.CanCollide = false
                Bolt.CanQuery = false
                Bolt.CanTouch = false
                Bolt.CastShadow = false
                Bolt.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                Bolt.Color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 220, 255)
                Bolt.Transparency = 1
                Bolt.Parent = Folder
                Bolts[Index] = Bolt
            end

            Flash = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
            Flash.Name = "WeatherFlash"
            Flash.Brightness = 0
            Cat:Clean(Flash)

            LensFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
            LensFrame.Name = "WeatherLens"
            LensFrame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
            LensFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            LensFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
            LensFrame.ZIndex = -100
            LensFrame.Interactable = false
            Cat:Clean(LensFrame)
            for Index: number = 1, 10 do
                local Drop: ImageLabel = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
                Drop.Name = "Drop"
                Drop.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
                Drop.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                Drop.BorderSizePixel = 0
                Drop.Image = LensImage or ""
                Drop.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(256, 256)
                Drop.ImageTransparency = 1
                Drop.Visible = false
                Drop.Parent = LensFrame
                Drops[Index] = Drop
            end
        end

        local function Apply(): ()
            Veil.Rate = 1200 * Level
            Mist.Rate = 12 * Level
            LensFrame.Parent = (LensOn and HasLens) and Cat.Ui.Gui or nil

            local Volumes: {number} = {0.6 * Level, 0.35, ThunderOn and 0.25 or 0}
            for Index: number, v: Sound in Loops do
                Services.TweenService:Create(v, TweenInfo.new(2), {Volume = Volumes[Index]}):Play()
            end
        end

        local function Drip(Camera: Camera): ()
            local Label: ImageLabel?
            for _, v: ImageLabel in Drops do
                if not v.Visible then
                    Label = v
                    break
                end
            end

            if Label then
                local Slide: number = math.random(40, 160)
                local Length: number = 1.5 + math.random() * 1.5
                local Size: number = math.random(18, 48) * Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 720
                local X: number, Y: number
                repeat
                    X, Y = math.random(), math.random()
                until math.abs(X - 0.5) > 0.22 or Y > 0.72 or Y + Slide / Camera.ViewportSize.Y < 0.28

                Label.Position = UDim2.fromScale(X, Y)
                Label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(Size, Size)
                Label.Rotation = math.random(-12, 12)
                Label.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new(256 * math.random(0, 1), 256 * math.random(0, 1))
                Label.ImageTransparency = 1
                Label.Visible = true

                local Shown: ImageLabel = Label
                task.spawn(function(): ()
                    Services.TweenService:Create(Shown, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {ImageTransparency = 0.2}):Play()
                    local Glide: TweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(Length, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)
                    Services.TweenService:Create(Shown, Glide, {Position = UDim2.new(X, 0, Y, Slide)}):Play()
                    task.wait(Length - 0.5)
                    Services.TweenService:Create(Shown, TweenInfo.new(0.5), {ImageTransparency = 1}):Play()
                    task.wait(0.5)
                    Shown.Visible = false
                end)
            end
        end

        local function Tick(Current: number): ()
            local Slot: number = 0
            repeat
                local Camera: Camera? = workspace.CurrentCamera
                if Camera then
                    local Origin: Vector3 = Camera.CFrame.Position
                    if Folder.Parent ~= Camera then
                        Folder.Parent = Camera
                    end
                    Params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {Services.Players.LocalPlayer.Character or Folder, Folder}

                    NearPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(Origin + Vector3.new(0, 45, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(7))
                    FarPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(Origin + Vector3.new(0, 120, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(7))

                    local Roof: RaycastResult? = workspace:Raycast(Origin, Vector3.new(0, 250, 0), Params)
                    local Floor: RaycastResult? = workspace:Raycast(Origin, Vector3.new(0, -300, 0), Params)
                    Covered = Roof ~= nil
                    MistPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(Origin.X, (Floor and Floor.Position.Y or Origin.Y - 8) + 3, Origin.Z)

                    if Covered ~= Muffled then
                        Muffled = Covered
                        local Gains: {HighGain: number, MidGain: number} = {HighGain = Covered and -25 or 0, MidGain = Covered and -8 or 0}
                        for _, v: EqualizerSoundEffect in Equalizers do
                            Services.TweenService:Create(v, TweenInfo.new(0.6), Gains):Play()
                        end
                    end

                    NearRate += ((Covered and 0 or 7000 * Level) - NearRate) * 0.4
                    if math.abs(Rain.Rate - NearRate) > 0.5 then
                        Rain.Rate = NearRate
                    end

                    for _ = 1, math.floor(24 * Level) do
                        local Angle: number = math.random() * math.pi * 2
                        local Radius: number = 80 * math.random() ^ 1.8
                        local Sky: Vector3 = Origin + Vector3.new(math.cos(Angle) * Radius, 60, math.sin(Angle) * Radius)
                        local Hit: RaycastResult? = workspace:Raycast(Sky, Vector3.new(0, -200, 0), Params)
                        if Hit and Hit.Normal.Y > 0.7 then
                            Slot = Slot % Slots + 1
                            if Splashes[Slot] then
                                (Splashes[Slot].Parent :: Attachment).WorldPosition = Hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.42, 0)
                                Splashes[Slot]:Emit(1)
                            end
                            if Ripples[Slot] then
                                (Ripples[Slot].Parent :: Attachment).WorldPosition = Hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.06, 0)
                                Ripples[Slot]:Emit(1)
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    if LensOn and HasLens and not Covered and math.random() < 0.25 * Level * math.clamp(0.4 + Camera.CFrame.LookVector.Y, 0, 1) then
                        Drip(Camera)
                    end
                end
                task.wait(0.1)
            until Version ~= Current
        end

        local function Strike(Distance: number): ()
            local Current: number = Version
            local Camera: Camera? = workspace.CurrentCamera
            local Peak: number = math.clamp(0.55 / Distance, 0, 0.6)

            task.spawn(function(): ()
                task.wait(Distance / 0.343)
                if Version == Current then
                    local Rumble: Sound = Shots[Shots[3].Playing and 4 or 3]
                    local Volume: number = 1.2 / (0.6 + Distance) * (Covered and 0.5 or 1)
                    if Distance < 1.5 then
                        local Crack: Sound = Shots[math.random(2)]
                        Crack.Volume = Volume
                        Crack:Play()
                        task.wait(0.4)
                    end

                    (Rumble :: any).EQ.HighGain = Distance < 1.5 and 0 or -6 * Distance
                    Rumble.PlaybackSpeed = Distance < 1.5 and 1 or 0.85 + math.random() * 0.1
                    Rumble.Volume = Volume
                    Rumble:Play()
                end
            end)

            if Distance < 1.8 and Camera then
                local Origin: Vector3 = Camera.CFrame.Position
                local Look: Vector3 = Camera.CFrame.LookVector
                local Flat: Vector3 = Vector3.new(Look.X, 0, Look.Z)
                if Flat.Magnitude < 0.01 then
                    Flat = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
                end

                local Aim: Vector3 = CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(math.random(-70, 70)), 0) * Flat.Unit
                local Spot: Vector3 = Origin + Aim * math.random(300, 900)
                local Hit: RaycastResult? = workspace:Raycast(Spot + Vector3.new(0, 600, 0), Vector3.new(0, -1200, 0), Params)
                local Ground: Vector3 = Hit and Hit.Position or Vector3.new(Spot.X, Origin.Y - 30, Spot.Z)
                local Points: {Vector3} = {Ground}
                local Used: number = 0
                for Index: number = 1, 24 do
                    local Height: number = Index / 24
                    local Spread: number = math.sin(math.pi * Height) * 28
                    local Jitter: Vector3 = Vector3.new(math.random() * 2 - 1, 0, math.random() * 2 - 1) * Spread
                    table.insert(Points, Ground + Jitter + Vector3.new(0, 500 * Height, 0))
                    Used += 1
                    Bolts[Used].Size = Vector3.new(5, 5, (Points[Index + 1] - Points[Index]).Magnitude)
                    Bolts[Used].CFrame = CFrame.lookAt((Points[Index] + Points[Index + 1]) / 2, Points[Index + 1])
                    Bolts[Used].Transparency = 0
                end
                for _ = 1, 3 do
                    local From: Vector3 = Points[math.random(6, 18)]
                    local Sideways: Vector3 = Vector3.new(math.random(-30, 30), -35, math.random(-30, 30))
                    for _ = 1, 4 do
                        local To: Vector3 = From + Sideways + Vector3.new(math.random(-8, 8), 0, math.random(-8, 8))
                        Used += 1
                        Bolts[Used].Size = Vector3.new(2.5, 2.5, (To - From).Magnitude)
                        Bolts[Used].CFrame = CFrame.lookAt((From + To) / 2, To)
                        Bolts[Used].Transparency = 0
                        From = To
                    end
                end
                task.delay(0.2, function(): ()
                    for _, v: Part in Bolts do
                        v.Transparency = 1
                    end
                end)
            end

            local Flickers: number = math.random(2, 3)
            local Count: number = 0
            repeat
                Count += 1
                Flash.Brightness = Peak
                Flash.TintColor = Color3.fromRGB(225, 235, 255)
                task.wait(0.06)
                Flash.Brightness = 0
                task.wait(math.random(5, 12) / 100)
            until Count >= Flickers or Version ~= Current

            if Version == Current then
                Flash.Brightness = Peak * 0.7
                local Decay: TweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
                Services.TweenService:Create(Flash, Decay, {Brightness = 0}):Play()
                task.wait(0.4)
            end
            Flash.TintColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        end

        local function Scheduler(Current: number): ()
            repeat
                task.wait(math.random(8, 25) * (1.5 - Level))
                if Version == Current and ThunderOn then
                    Strike(0.4 + math.random() * 5.6)
                end
            until Version ~= Current
        end

        Weather = {
            Running = false,
            Start = function(Intensity: number, Thunder: boolean, Lens: boolean): ()
                Level, ThunderOn, LensOn = math.clamp(Intensity, 0.1, 1), Thunder, Lens
                if Weather.Running then
                    Apply()
                else
                    if not Folder then
                        Build()
                    end

                    Version += 1
                    Weather.Running = true
                    Covered, Muffled, NearRate = false, false, 0

                    local Current: number = Version
                    Folder.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera
                    Flash.Parent = Services.Lighting
                    for _, v: ParticleEmitter in {Rain, Veil, Mist} do
                        v.Enabled = true
                    end
                    for _, v: ParticleEmitter in Splashes do
                        v.Enabled = true
                    end
                    for _, v: ParticleEmitter in Ripples do
                        v.Enabled = true
                    end
                    for Index: number, v: Sound in Loops do
                        Equalizers[Index].HighGain, Equalizers[Index].MidGain = 0, 0
                        v.Volume = 0
                        v:Play()
                    end

                    Apply()
                    task.spawn(Tick, Current)
                    task.spawn(Scheduler, Current)
                end
            end,
            Stop = function(): ()
                if Weather.Running then
                    Version += 1
                    Weather.Running = false

                    local Current: number = Version
                    for _, v: ParticleEmitter in {Rain, Veil, Mist} do
                        v.Rate = 0
                        v.Enabled = false
                    end
                    for _, v: ParticleEmitter in Splashes do
                        v.Enabled = false
                    end
                    for _, v: ParticleEmitter in Ripples do
                        v.Enabled = false
                    end
                    for _, v: Sound in Loops do
                        Services.TweenService:Create(v, TweenInfo.new(1.2), {Volume = 0}):Play()
                    end
                    for _, v: Part in Bolts do
                        v.Transparency = 1
                    end

                    Flash.Brightness = 0
                    if Flash.Parent then
                        Flash.Parent = nil
                    end
                    if LensFrame.Parent then
                        LensFrame.Parent = nil
                    end
                    task.delay(1.3, function(): ()
                        if Version == Current and Folder.Parent then
                            for _, v: Sound in Loops do
                                v:Stop()
                            end
                            for _, v: Sound in Shots do
                                v:Stop()
                            end
                            Folder.Parent = nil
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end,
            Set = function(Intensity: number, Thunder: boolean, Lens: boolean): ()
                Level, ThunderOn, LensOn = math.clamp(Intensity, 0.1, 1), Thunder, Lens
                if Weather.Running then
                    Apply()
                end
            end
        }

        return Weather
    end
end)()
