    local Sky: Sky = Instance.new("Sky")
    Sky.Name = "Shaders"
    Cat:Clean(Sky)
    local Atmosphere: Atmosphere = Instance.new("Atmosphere")
    Atmosphere.Name = "Shaders"
    Cat:Clean(Atmosphere)
    local Color: ColorCorrectionEffect = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
    Color.Name = "Shaders"
    Cat:Clean(Color)
    local Bloom: BloomEffect = Instance.new("BloomEffect")
    Bloom.Name = "Shaders"
    Cat:Clean(Bloom)
    local Rays: SunRaysEffect = Instance.new("SunRaysEffect")
    Rays.Name = "Shaders"
    Cat:Clean(Rays)
    local Default: Sky = Instance.new("Sky")
    Cat:Clean(Default)
    local Neutral: ColorCorrectionEffect = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
    Cat:Clean(Neutral)

    local Modifier: any
    local Applied: {[Instance]: {[string]: any}} = {}
    local Targets: {[Instance]: {[string]: any}} = {}
    local Originals: {[Instance]: {[string]: any}} = {}
    local Theirs: {[string]: any} = {}
    local Checked: {[string]: boolean} = {}
    local Version: number = 0
    local Moving: boolean, Hidden: boolean, Pending: boolean = false, false, false

    local function Blend(From: any, To: any, Alpha: number, Property: string): any
        if type(From) == "number" and Property == "ClockTime" then
            return (From + ((To - From + 12) % 24 - 12) * Alpha) % 24
        elseif type(From) == "number" then
            return From + (To - From) * Alpha
        elseif typeof(From) == "Color3" then
            return From:Lerp(To, Alpha)
        end

        return Alpha < 0.5 and From or To
    end

    local function Write(Goal: {[Instance]: {[string]: any}}, From: {[Instance]: {[string]: any}}, Alpha: number, Dip: number): ()
        for Object: Instance, Properties: {[string]: any} in Goal do
            local Current: {[string]: any} = {}
            for Property: string, Value: any in Properties do
                local Start: any = From[Object] and From[Object][Property]
                if Start == nil then
                    Start = Value
                end

                Current[Property] = Blend(Start, Value, Alpha, Property)
            end

            if Object == Services.Lighting then
                Current.ExposureCompensation -= Dip * 1.2 + Data.Controllers.LightingController.lightingModifier.exposureCompensationOffset
                Current.Brightness -= Data.Controllers.LightingController.lightingModifier.brightnessOffset
                Modifier:setProperties(Current)
            else
                if Current.Density then
                    Current.Density = math.min(Current.Density + Dip * 0.45, 1)
                end
                for Property: string, Value: any in Current do
                    (Object :: any)[Property] = Value
                end
            end

            Applied[Object] = {}
            for Property: string in Properties do
                Applied[Object][Property] = (Object :: any)[Property]
            end
        end
    end

    local function Transition(Goal: {[Instance]: {[string]: any}}, Length: number, Midpoint: () -> ()): boolean
        Version += 1
        Moving = true

        local Current: number = Version
        local From: {[Instance]: {[string]: any}} = {}
        for Object: Instance, Properties: {[string]: any} in Goal do
            From[Object] = {}
            for Property: string in Properties do
                From[Object][Property] = (Object :: any)[Property]
            end
        end

        local Start: number = os.clock()
        local Passed: boolean = false
        local Linear: number
        repeat
            Linear = Length > 0 and math.clamp((os.clock() - Start) / Length, 0, 1) or 1
            if Linear >= 0.5 and not Passed then
                Passed = true
                Midpoint()
            end

            local Alpha: number = Services.TweenService:GetValue(Linear, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)

            Write(Goal, From, Alpha, math.sin(Linear * math.pi))
            if Linear < 1 then
                task.wait()
            end
        until Linear >= 1 or Version ~= Current

        if Version == Current then
            Moving = false
        end

        return Version == Current
    end

    local function Guard(Object: Instance, Property: string): ()
        local Held: {[string]: any}? = Applied[Object]
        if Moving or Pending or not Held or Held[Property] == nil or (Object :: any)[Property] == Held[Property] then
            return
        end

        Pending = true
        task.defer(function()
            if Shaders.Enabled and not Moving then
                Write(Targets, Targets, 1, 0)
            end
            Pending = false
        end)
    end

    local function Hide(Object: Instance): ()
        if Originals[Object] or Object == Sky or Object == Atmosphere or Object == Bloom or Object == Rays then
            return
        end

        if Object:IsA("Clouds") or Object:IsA("BloomEffect") or Object:IsA("SunRaysEffect") then
            Originals[Object] = {Enabled = (Object :: any).Enabled}
            Targets[Object] = {Enabled = false}
            Write({[Object] = Targets[Object]}, {}, 1, 0)
            Shaders:Clean(Object.Changed:Connect(function(Property: string)
                Guard(Object, Property)
            end))
        elseif Object:IsA("Sky") or Object:IsA("Atmosphere") or (Object.Name == "Clouds" and Object.Parent and Object.Parent:IsA("Workspace")) then
            Originals[Object] = {Parent = Object.Parent}
            Theirs[Object.ClassName] = Object
            Object.Parent = nil
        end
    end

    local function Show(Final: boolean): ()
        for Object: Instance, Properties: {[string]: any} in Originals do
            if Final or not (Object:IsA("Sky") or Object:IsA("Atmosphere")) then
                for Property: string, Value: any in Properties do
                    pcall(function()
                        (Object :: any)[Property] = Value
                    end)
                end
                Originals[Object] = nil
                Targets[Object] = nil
            end
        end

        if Final then
            table.clear(Theirs)
        end
    end

    local function Off(): {[Instance]: {[string]: any}}
        local Goal: {[Instance]: {[string]: any}} = {
            [Sky] = {},
            [Atmosphere] = {Density = 0},
            [Color] = {},
            [Bloom] = {Intensity = 0},
            [Rays] = {Intensity = 0}
        }

        for Property: string in Presets.Night.Sky do
            Goal[Sky][Property] = (Theirs.Sky or Default)[Property]
        end
        for Property: string in Presets.Night.Color do
            Goal[Color][Property] = (Neutral :: any)[Property]
        end
        if Theirs.Atmosphere then
            for Property: string in Presets.Night.Atmosphere do
                Goal[Atmosphere][Property] = Theirs.Atmosphere[Property]
            end
        end

        return Goal
    end

    local function Switch(): ()
        local Name: string = (Mode.Value == "Day" and Rain.Enabled) and "Storm" or Mode.Value
        local Preset: {[string]: {[string]: any}} = Presets[Name]
        if Checked[Name] == nil then
            local Faces: {string} = {Preset.Sky.SkyboxBk, Preset.Sky.SkyboxDn, Preset.Sky.SkyboxFt, Preset.Sky.SkyboxLf, Preset.Sky.SkyboxRt, Preset.Sky.SkyboxUp}
            local Loaded: number = 0
            pcall(function()
                Services.ContentProvider:PreloadAsync(Faces, function(_: string, Status: Enum.AssetFetchStatus)
                    Loaded += Status == Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Success and 1 or 0
                end)
            end)
            Checked[Name] = Loaded == #Faces
            if Loaded < #Faces then
                warn(`[catvape] Shaders: the {Name} skybox didn't load, using the default sky instead`)
            end
        end
        if not Shaders.Enabled then
            return
        end

        local Goal: {[Instance]: {[string]: any}} = {
            [Services.Lighting] = Preset.Lighting,
            [Sky] = table.clone(Preset.Sky),
            [Atmosphere] = Preset.Atmosphere,
            [Color] = Preset.Color,
            [Bloom] = Preset.Bloom,
            [Rays] = Preset.Rays
        }

        if not Checked[Name] then
            for _, v: string in {"SkyboxBk", "SkyboxDn", "SkyboxFt", "SkyboxLf", "SkyboxRt", "SkyboxUp"} do
                Goal[Sky][v] = (Default :: any)[v]
            end
        end
        for Object: Instance, Properties: {[string]: any} in Targets do
            if Goal[Object] == nil and Originals[Object] then
                Goal[Object] = Properties
            end
        end
        Targets = Goal

        if Name ~= "Storm" then
            Weather.Stop()
        end
        if Transition(Goal, Duration.Value, function()
            Hidden = true
            for _, v: Instance in Services.Lighting:GetChildren() do
                Hide(v)
            end
            for _, v: Instance in workspace.Terrain:GetChildren() do
                Hide(v)
            end
            if workspace:FindFirstChild("Clouds") then
                Hide(workspace.Clouds)
            end
        end) then
            if Name == "Storm" and Shaders.Enabled then
                Weather.Start(Intensity.Value / 100, Thunder.Enabled, Lens.Enabled)
            else
                Weather.Stop()
            end
        end
    end

    Shaders = Cat.Categories.Render:CreateModule({
        Name = "Shaders",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback then
                if not Sky.Parent then
                    for _, v: Instance in Services.Lighting:GetChildren() do
                        if v:IsA("Sky") or v:IsA("Atmosphere") then
                            Hide(v)
                        end
                    end
                    Write(Off(), {}, 1, 0)
                    for _, v: Instance in {Sky, Atmosphere, Color, Bloom, Rays} do
                        v.Parent = Services.Lighting
                    end
                end
                Modifier = Modifier or Data.Controllers.LightingController.lightingModifier:addModifier(100000, {})

                for _, v: Instance in {Services.Lighting, Sky, Atmosphere, Color, Bloom, Rays} do
                    Shaders:Clean(v.Changed:Connect(function(Property: string)
                        Guard(v, Property)
                    end))
                end
                for Object: Instance in Targets do
                    if Originals[Object] then
                        Shaders:Clean(Object.Changed:Connect(function(Property: string)
                            Guard(Object, Property)
                        end))
                    end
                end
                Shaders:Clean(Services.Lighting.ChildAdded:Connect(function(Child: Instance)
                    if Hidden or Child:IsA("Sky") or Child:IsA("Atmosphere") then
                        task.defer(Hide, Child)
                    end
                end))
                Shaders:Clean(workspace.Terrain.ChildAdded:Connect(function(Child: Instance)
                    if Hidden then
                        task.defer(Hide, Child)
                    end
                end))
                Shaders:Clean(workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(Child: Instance)
                    if Hidden and Child.Name == "Clouds" then
                        task.defer(Hide, Child)
                    end
                end))

                Switch()
            elseif Modifier then
                Weather.Stop()

                local Live: {[string]: any} = {}
                for Property: string in Presets.Night.Lighting do
                    Live[Property] = (Services.Lighting :: any)[Property]
                end

                Modifier:Destroy()
                Modifier = Data.Controllers.LightingController.lightingModifier:addModifier(100000, {})

                local Goal: {[Instance]: {[string]: any}} = Off()
                Goal[Services.Lighting] = {}
                for Property: string in Live do
                    Goal[Services.Lighting][Property] = (Services.Lighting :: any)[Property]
                end
                Write({[Services.Lighting] = Live}, {}, 1, 0)

                if Transition(Goal, Cat.Ui.Dead and 0 or Duration.Value, function()
                    Hidden = false
                    Show(false)
                end) then
                    Modifier:Destroy()
                    Modifier = nil
                    for _, v: Instance in {Sky, Atmosphere, Color, Bloom, Rays} do
                        v.Parent = nil
                    end
                    Show(true)
                    table.clear(Applied)
                    table.clear(Targets)
                end
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Realistic day, evening or night lighting with no clouds, client side only"
    })

    Mode = Shaders:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Mode",
        List = {"Day", "Evening", "Night"},
        Default = "Day",
        Function = function()
            if Shaders.Enabled then
                task.spawn(Switch)
            end
        end
    })
    Duration = Shaders:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Fade",
        Min = 0.2,
        Max = 5,
        Default = 1.5,
        Decimal = 10,
        Suffix = function(Value: number): string
            return Value == 1 and "second" or "seconds"
        end,
        Tooltip = "How long switching modes or toggling takes"
    })
    Rain = Shaders:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Rain",
        Default = false,
        Function = function(): ()
            if Shaders.Enabled and Mode.Value == "Day" then
                task.spawn(Switch)
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Rainstorm with thunder in Day mode"
    })
    Intensity = Shaders:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Rain intensity",
        Min = 10,
        Max = 100,
        Default = 70,
        Suffix = "%",
        Function = function(Value: number): ()
            if Weather.Running then
                Weather.Set(Value / 100, Thunder.Enabled, Lens.Enabled)
            end
        end
    })
    Thunder = Shaders:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Thunder",
        Default = true,
        Function = function(Callback: boolean): ()
            if Weather.Running then
                Weather.Set(Intensity.Value / 100, Callback, Lens.Enabled)
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Lightning flashes and distant thunder while it rains"
    })
    Lens = Shaders:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Lens drops",
        Default = true,
        Function = function(Callback: boolean): ()
            if Weather.Running then
                Weather.Set(Intensity.Value / 100, Thunder.Enabled, Callback)
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Raindrops running down your screen"
    })
end)()

BundledModules.SkinChanger = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services
    local LocalPlayer: Player = Services.LocalPlayer

    local require = BundledModules.require
    local ItemSkinType: {[string]: string} = require(Services.ReplicatedStorage.TS.games.bedwars["item-skin"]["item-skin-types"]).ItemSkinType

    local SkinChanger

    local Options: {[string]: any} = {}
    local Skins: {[string]: {[string]: string}} = {}
    local Families: {[string]: string} = {}
    local Groups: {[string]: {string}} = {}
    local Fallback: {[string]: {[string]: string}} = {}
    local Names: {[string]: string} = {}
    local Extras: {[string]: string} = {}
    local Order: {string} = {}
    local Sounds: {[string]: {swing: any, hit: any}} = {}
    local Applied: {[Instance]: {Model: string, Parts: {BasePart}, Size: Vector3, Grip: CFrame?}} = {}
    local Originals: {[Instance]: {Value: any}} = {}

    local Watching: RBXScriptConnection?
    local LastHand: string?
    local Queued, Resound = false, false

    local Tiers: {[string]: boolean} = {leather = true, chainmail = true, wood = true, stone = true, gold = true, iron = true, diamond = true, emerald = true}
    local KitPrefixes: {[string]: boolean} = {tactical = true, flower = true, falconer = true, life = true, feather = true}

    local function Titleize(Text: string): string
        return (Text:gsub("_", " "):gsub("%a+", function(Word: string): string
            return `{Word:sub(1, 1):upper()}{Word:sub(2)}`
        end))
    end

    for _, v: string in ItemSkinType do
        local Meta: any = Data.Controllers.ItemSkinMeta.getItemSkinMeta(v)
        local Item: any = Meta and Meta.itemType and Data.Instances.Items[Meta.itemType]
        if Item and not (Item.block and not Item.image) then
            local Label: string = `_{v}_`
            for Segment: string in Meta.itemType:gmatch("[^_]+") do
                Label = Label:gsub(`_{Segment}_`, "_")
            end

            Label = Label:gsub("^_+", ""):gsub("_+$", "")
            Label = Titleize(Label ~= "" and Label or v)

            Skins[Meta.itemType] = Skins[Meta.itemType] or {}
            Skins[Meta.itemType][Label] = v
        end
    end

    for ItemType: string in Skins do
        local Family: string = ItemType:gsub("_%d+$", "")
        local Tier: string?, Base: string? = Family:match("^([^_]+)_(.+)$")
        Family = Tier and Tiers[Tier] and Base or Family

        local Kit: string?, Rest: string? = Family:match("^([^_]+)_(.+)$")
        Family = Kit and KitPrefixes[Kit] and Rest or Family
        Family = Family:gsub("_left$", "")
        Family = Family:gsub("_helmet$", "_armor"):gsub("_chestplate$", "_armor"):gsub("_leggings$", "_armor"):gsub("_boots$", "_armor")

        if not Groups[Family] then
            Groups[Family] = {}
            table.insert(Order, Family)
        end

        Families[ItemType] = Family
        table.insert(Groups[Family], ItemType)
    end

    for Family: string, Members: {string} in Groups do
        table.sort(Members)
        Fallback[Family] = {}
        for _, ItemType: string in Members do
            for Label: string, Skin: string in Skins[ItemType] do
                Fallback[Family][Label] = Fallback[Family][Label] or Skin
            end
        end

        Names[Family] = Titleize(#Members > 1 and Family or Members[1])
    end

    table.sort(Order, function(A: string, B: string): boolean
        return Names[A] < Names[B]
    end)

    for _, v: string in {"lobby_kaida_claw", "bear_claws", "summoner_claw_1", "summoner_claw_2", "summoner_claw_3", "summoner_claw_4"} do
        if Services.ReplicatedStorage.Items:FindFirstChild(v) then
            Extras[Titleize((v:gsub("^lobby_", "")))] = v
        end
    end

    local function Resolve(ItemType: string): (string?, string?)
        local Family: string? = SkinChanger.Enabled and Families[ItemType] or nil
        local Option: any = Family and Options[Family]
        local Label: string? = Option and Option.Value

        if not Label or Label == "None" then
            return nil, nil
        end
        if Extras[Label] then
            return nil, Extras[Label]
        end

        local Skin: string? = Skins[ItemType][Label] or Fallback[Families[ItemType]][Label]
        return Skin, Skin
    end

    local function SetToolSkin(Tool: Instance?, Skin: string?)
        if typeof(Tool) == "Instance" then
            if Skin then
                Originals[Tool] = Originals[Tool] or {Value = Tool:GetAttribute("ItemSkin")}
                if Tool:GetAttribute("ItemSkin") ~= Skin then
                    Tool:SetAttribute("ItemSkin", Skin)
                end
            elseif Originals[Tool] then
                local Original: {Value: any} = Originals[Tool]
                Originals[Tool] = nil
                Tool:SetAttribute("ItemSkin", Original.Value)
            end
        end
    end

    local function ApplyModel(Accessory: Instance)
        local _, Model: string? = Resolve(Accessory.Name)
        local Handle: any = Accessory:FindFirstChild("Handle")
        local Template: any = Model and Services.ReplicatedStorage.Items:FindFirstChild(Model)

        if Model and Handle and Template and not Applied[Accessory] then
            local Grip: Attachment? = Handle:FindFirstChild("RightGripAttachment")
            local TemplateGrip: Attachment? = Template.Handle:FindFirstChild("RightGripAttachment")
            local Record = {
                Model = Model,
                Parts = {},
                Size = Handle.Size,
                Grip = Grip and Grip.CFrame or nil
            }
            Applied[Accessory] = Record

            for _, v: Instance in Handle:GetChildren() do
                if v:IsA("BasePart") and v:GetAttribute("SkinHidden") == nil then
                    v:SetAttribute("SkinHidden", v.Transparency)
                    v.Transparency = 1
                end
            end

            if Handle:IsA("MeshPart") and Template.Handle:IsA("MeshPart") then
                Handle:ApplyMesh(Template.Handle)
            end

            Handle.Size = Template.Handle.Size
            if Grip and TemplateGrip then
                Grip.CFrame = TemplateGrip.CFrame
            end

            for _, v: Instance in Template.Handle:GetChildren() do
                if v:IsA("BasePart") then
                    local Part: BasePart = v:Clone()
                    Part.CanCollide = false
                    Part.CanTouch = false
                    Part.CanQuery = false
                    Part.Massless = true
                    Part.CFrame = Handle.CFrame * (Template.Handle.CFrame:Inverse() * v.CFrame)
                    Part.Parent = Handle

                    local Weld: WeldConstraint = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
                    Weld.Part0 = Handle
                    Weld.Part1 = Part
                    Weld.Parent = Part
                    table.insert(Record.Parts, Part)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local function RestoreModel(Accessory: Instance)
        local Record: any = Applied[Accessory]
        local Handle: any = Accessory:FindFirstChild("Handle")
        local Template: any = Services.ReplicatedStorage.Items:FindFirstChild(Accessory.Name)
        Applied[Accessory] = nil

        for _, Part: BasePart in Record.Parts do
            Part:Destroy()
        end

        for _, Child: Instance in Handle and Handle:GetChildren() or {} do
            local Transparency: number? = Child:GetAttribute("SkinHidden")
            if Transparency then
                (Child :: BasePart).Transparency = Transparency
                Child:SetAttribute("SkinHidden", nil)
            end
        end

        if Handle then
            if Template and Handle:IsA("MeshPart") and Template.Handle:IsA("MeshPart") then
                Handle:ApplyMesh(Template.Handle)
            end

            Handle.Size = Record.Size

            local Grip: Attachment? = Handle:FindFirstChild("RightGripAttachment")
            if Grip and Record.Grip then
                Grip.CFrame = Record.Grip
            end
        end
    end

    local function ApplySounds()
        for ItemType: string in Skins do
            local Meta: any = Data.Instances.Items[ItemType]
            if Meta and Meta.sword then
                local Skin: string? = Resolve(ItemType)
                local SkinMeta: any = Skin and Data.Controllers.ItemSkinMeta.getItemSkinMeta(Skin)
                local Sword: any = SkinMeta and SkinMeta.sword

                if Sword and (Sword.swingSounds or Sword.hitSounds) then
                    Sounds[ItemType] = Sounds[ItemType] or {swing = Meta.sword.swingSounds, hit = Meta.sword.hitSounds}
                    Meta.sword.swingSounds = Sword.swingSounds or Sounds[ItemType].swing
                    Meta.sword.hitSounds = Sword.hitSounds or Sounds[ItemType].hit
                elseif Sounds[ItemType] then
                    Meta.sword.swingSounds = Sounds[ItemType].swing
                    Meta.sword.hitSounds = Sounds[ItemType].hit
                    Sounds[ItemType] = nil
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local function ApplySkins(Force: boolean?)
        local Inventory: any = Data.Storage.Inventory.inventory
        local HandSkin: string = Inventory.hand and Inventory.hand.itemSkin or ""
        local Changed: boolean = Force == true

        for _, v: any in Inventory.items or {} do
            local Skin: string? = Resolve(v.itemType)
            SetToolSkin(v.tool, Skin)
            if (v.itemSkin or "") ~= (Skin or "") then
                v.itemSkin = Skin
                Changed = true
            end
        end

        if Inventory.hand then
            local Skin: string? = Resolve(Inventory.hand.itemType)
            SetToolSkin(Inventory.hand.tool, Skin)
            if (Inventory.hand.itemSkin or "") ~= (Skin or "") then
                Inventory.hand.itemSkin = Skin or ""
                Changed = true
            end
        end

        local Hand: string? = Inventory.hand and Inventory.hand.itemType
        if Changed or Hand ~= LastHand then
            local HandChanged: boolean = Hand ~= LastHand or (Inventory.hand and Inventory.hand.itemSkin or "") ~= HandSkin
            LastHand = Hand
            if HandChanged then
                Data.Controllers.InventoryViewmodelController:handleStore(Data.Controllers.Store:getState())
            end

            local Character: Model? = LocalPlayer.Character
            for _, v: Instance in Character and Character:GetChildren() or {} do
                if v:IsA("Accessory") then
                    local _, Model: string? = Resolve(v.Name)
                    if Applied[v] and Applied[v].Model ~= Model then
                        RestoreModel(v)
                    end

                    ApplyModel(v)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local function Queue(Full: boolean?)
        Resound = Resound or Full == true
        if not Queued then
            Queued = true
            task.defer(function()
                Queued = false
                local Wanted: boolean = Resound
                Resound = false

                if SkinChanger.Enabled then
                    if Wanted then
                        ApplySounds()
                    end

                    ApplySkins(Wanted)
                end
            end)
        end
    end

    local function Watch(Character: Model)
        if Watching then
            Watching:Disconnect()
        end

        Watching = Character.ChildAdded:Connect(function(Child: Instance)
            if Child:IsA("Accessory") and Child:WaitForChild("Handle", 3) and SkinChanger.Enabled then
                ApplyModel(Child)
            end
        end)
    end

    SkinChanger = Cat.Categories.Render:CreateModule({
        Name = "SkinChanger",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback then
                SkinChanger:Clean(Data.Events.InventoryChanged:Connect(Queue))
                SkinChanger:Clean(Data.Events.EntityDamageEvent:Connect(function(Event: {entityInstance: Model?, fromEntity: Instance?, damageType: number})
                    if Event.fromEntity == LocalPlayer.Character and Event.damageType == 0 then
                        local Tool: Instance? = Data.Storage.Hand.Type == "sword" and Data.Storage.Hand.Tool or (Data.Storage.Tools.Sword and Data.Storage.Tools.Sword.tool)
                        local Skin: string? = Tool and Originals[Tool] and Tool:GetAttribute("ItemSkin")
                        local Meta: any = Skin and Data.Controllers.ItemSkinMeta.getItemSkinMeta(Skin)
                        local Hits: {string}? = Meta and Meta.sword and Meta.sword.hitSounds

                        if Hits and #Hits > 0 then
                            local Root: BasePart? = Event.entityInstance and (Event.entityInstance :: Model).PrimaryPart
                            Data.Controllers.AudioManager:playAudio(Hits[math.random(1, #Hits)], {position = Root and Root.Position})
                        end
                    end
                end))

                SkinChanger:Clean(LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(Character: Model)
                    LastHand = nil
                    Watch(Character)

                    task.spawn(function()
                        for _ = 1, 10 do
                            task.wait(0.4)
                            if not SkinChanger.Enabled then
                                return
                            end

                            ApplySkins()
                        end
                    end)
                end))

                if LocalPlayer.Character then
                    Watch(LocalPlayer.Character)
                end
            elseif Watching then
                Watching:Disconnect()
                Watching = nil
            end

            ApplySounds()
            ApplySkins(true)

            if not Callback then
                for Accessory: Instance in Applied do
                    RestoreModel(Accessory)
                end

                table.clear(Originals)
                LastHand = nil
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Reskins the items and blocks you hold"
    })

    for _, Family: string in Order do
        local List: {string}, Seen: {[string]: boolean} = {}, {}
        for _, ItemType: string in Groups[Family] do
            for SkinName: string in Skins[ItemType] do
                if not Seen[SkinName] then
                    Seen[SkinName] = true
                    table.insert(List, SkinName)
                end
            end
        end

        for _, ItemType: string in Groups[Family] do
            local Meta: any = Data.Instances.Items[ItemType]
            if Meta and Meta.sword then
                for SkinName: string in Extras do
                    table.insert(List, SkinName)
                end

                break
            end
        end

        table.sort(List)
        table.insert(List, 1, "None")
        Options[Family] = SkinChanger:CreateDropdown({
            Name = Names[Family],
            List = List,
            Function = function()
                if SkinChanger.Enabled then
                    Queue(true)
                end
            end
        })
    end
end)()

BundledModules.AntiSuffocate = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity

    local AntiSuffocate

    local Body: {number} = {0.5, 2.5, 4.5}
    local Head: {number} = {4.5}
    local Limit: number = 0.25

    local function ShouldFree(Position: Vector3, Feet: number, Samples: {number}): boolean
        local Controller: any = Data.Controllers.BlockController
        for _, v: number in Samples do
            if Controller:getStore():getBlockAt(Controller:getBlockPosition(Vector3.new(Position.X, Feet + v, Position.Z))) then
                return false
            end
        end

        return true
    end

    AntiSuffocate = Cat.Categories.Utility:CreateModule({
        Name = "AntiSuffocate",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback then
                local Since

                repeat
                    if Entity.Alive and Entity.RootPart and Entity.Humanoid then
                        local Root: BasePart = Entity.RootPart
                        local Position: Vector3 = Root.Position
                        local Feet: number = Position.Y - Entity.Humanoid.HipHeight - Root.Size.Y / 2

                        if not ShouldFree(Position, Feet, Head) then
                            Since = Since or os.clock()

                            if os.clock() - Since >= Limit then
                                local Lift: number = 0
                                repeat
                                    Lift += 3
                                until ShouldFree(Position, Feet + Lift, Body) or Lift >= 30

                                Root.CFrame += Vector3.new(0, Lift, 0)
                                Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                                Since = nil
                            end
                        else
                            Since = nil
                        end
                    else
                        Since = nil
                    end

                    task.wait(0.05)
                until not AntiSuffocate.Enabled
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Teleports you up out of blocks that are placed on top of you"
    })
end)()

BundledModules.Abaddon = (function()
    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity

    return function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
        local AutoKit: Module = Section("Abaddon")
        local Limit, Range, Delay

        AutoKit.Kits.scarab = function()
            local NextPlace: number = 0

            repeat
                if Entity.Alive and tick() >= NextPlace and Data.Controllers.AbilityController:canUseAbility("place_scarab_hive", {disableBlockedAbilityAlert = true}) then
                    local Origin: Vector3 = Entity.RootPart.Position
                    local Hives: number = 0

                    for _, v: Instance in Services.CollectionService:GetTagged("scarab_spawner") do
                        local Part: any = v:IsA("Model") and v.PrimaryPart or v
                        if Part and Part:GetAttribute("PlacedByUserId") == Services.LocalPlayer.UserId and (Part.Position - Origin).Magnitude <= Range.Value then
                            Hives += 1
                        end
                    end

                    if Hives < Limit.Value then
                        NextPlace = tick() + Delay.Value
                        Data.Controllers.AbilityController:useAbility("place_scarab_hive")
                    end
                end

                task.wait(0.1)
            until not AutoKit.Enabled
        end

        Limit = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Hives",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 10,
            Default = 3,
            Tooltip = "Stops once this many of your hives are already standing nearby"
        })
        Range = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Range",
            Min = 5,
            Max = 100,
            Default = 40,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
            end,
            Tooltip = "How far out hives still count toward the limit"
        })
        Delay = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Delay",
            Min = 0.1,
            Max = 5,
            Default = 1.5,
            Decimal = 100,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value == 1 and "sec" or "secs"
            end
        })

        AutoKit.Settings.scarab = {Limit, Range, Delay}
    end
end)()

BundledModules.Adetunde = (function()
    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Inventory = BundledModules.Inventory

    return function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
        local AutoKit: Module = Section("Adetunde")
        local Last, GUI

        local Upgrades: {string} = {}
        local Toggles: {[string]: any} = {}

        for Upgrade: string in Data.Instances.AdetundeUpgradeMeta do
            table.insert(Upgrades, Upgrade)
        end
        table.sort(Upgrades)

        local function GetBuyOrder(Tiers: {[string]: number}): {string}
            local LastUpgrade: string? = Last.Value ~= "None" and Last.Value or nil
            local Order: {string} = {}
            local Waiting: boolean = false

            for _, v: string in Upgrades do
                if Tiers[v] ~= nil and v ~= LastUpgrade then
                    table.insert(Order, v)
                    if Toggles[v].Enabled and Data.Instances.AdetundeUpgradeMeta[v].tiers[Tiers[v] + 1] then
                        Waiting = true
                    end
                end
            end

            if LastUpgrade and Tiers[LastUpgrade] and not Waiting then
                table.insert(Order, LastUpgrade)
            end

            return Order
        end

        AutoKit.Kits.frost_hammer_kit = function()
            repeat
                if not GUI.Enabled or Data.Controllers.AppController:isAppOpen("FrostyHammerApp") then
                    local Tiers: {[string]: number} = Data.Controllers.AdetundeUtil.getUpgradesFromHammer(Services.LocalPlayer) or {}

                    for _, Upgrade: string in GetBuyOrder(Tiers) do
                        local Crystal: any = Inventory.Item("frost_crystal")
                        if not Crystal then
                            break
                        end

                        local NextUpgrade: any = Toggles[Upgrade].Enabled and Data.Instances.AdetundeUpgradeMeta[Upgrade].tiers[Tiers[Upgrade] + 1]
                        if NextUpgrade and Crystal.amount >= NextUpgrade.price then
                            Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("UpgradeFrostyHammer"):CallServer(Upgrade)
                            task.wait(0.1)
                        end
                    end
                end

                task.wait(0.5)
            until not AutoKit.Enabled
        end

        local Settings: {any} = {}

        for _, v: string in Upgrades do
            Toggles[v] = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
                Name = `Adetunde buy {v}`,
                Default = true
            })
            table.insert(Settings, Toggles[v])
        end

        local LastList: {string} = {"None"}
        for _, v: string in Upgrades do
            table.insert(LastList, v)
        end

        Last = AutoKit:CreateDropdown({
            Name = "Last upgrade",
            List = LastList,
            Default = "None",
            Tooltip = "Saves this upgrade for last, so your crystals go into the others until they are maxed"
        })
        GUI = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "GUI check",
            Tooltip = "Only upgrades when the frosty hammer menu is open"
        })
        table.insert(Settings, Last)
        table.insert(Settings, GUI)

        AutoKit.Settings.frost_hammer_kit = Settings
    end
end)()

BundledModules.Agni = (function()
    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity

    return function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
        local AutoKit: Module = Section("Agni", true)
        local VoidSave, Escape, Health, Range

        AutoKit.Kits.agni = function()
            local NextBoost: number = 0
            local Params: RaycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
            Params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
            Params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {Data.Storage.Map}

            repeat
                if Entity.Alive and tick() >= NextBoost and Data.Controllers.AbilityController:canUseAbility("rocket_detonate", {disableBlockedAbilityAlert = true}) then
                    local Boost: boolean = false

                    if VoidSave.Enabled and Entity.RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y <= -20 and not workspace:Raycast(Entity.RootPart.Position, Vector3.new(0, -2000, 0), Params) then
                        Boost = true
                    end

                    if not Boost and Escape.Enabled and Entity.Humanoid.Health <= Entity.Humanoid.MaxHealth * (Health.Value / 100) then
                        Boost = #Entity.Targets({
                            Origin = Entity.RootPart.Position,
                            Range = Range.Value,
                            Players = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Players.Enabled,
                            NPCs = AutoKit.Options.Targets.NPCs.Enabled
                        }) > 0
                    end

                    if Boost then
                        NextBoost = tick() + 1
                        Data.Controllers.AbilityController:useAbility("rocket_detonate")
                    end
                end

                task.wait(0.05)
            until not AutoKit.Enabled
        end

        VoidSave = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Void save",
            Default = true,
            Tooltip = "Boosts the moment you drop off the map with nothing below you"
        })
        Escape = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Escape",
            Default = true,
            Tooltip = "Boosts away once you are low and somebody is on you"
        })
        Health = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Health",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 100,
            Default = 35,
            Darker = true,
            Suffix = "%"
        })
        Range = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Range",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 60,
            Default = 20,
            Darker = true,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
            end
        })

    end

BundledModules.Beekeeper = (function()
    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity
    local Inventory = BundledModules.Inventory
    local SlotController = BundledModules.SlotController

    return function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
        local AutoKit: Module = Section("Beekeeper")
        local Collect, CollectRange, CollectDelay, Switch, LimitCollect, Deposit, DepositRange, DepositDelay

        AutoKit.Kits.beekeeper = function()
            repeat
                if Entity.Alive then
                    local LocalPosition: Vector3 = Entity.RootPart.Position

                    if Collect.Enabled and (not LimitCollect.Enabled or (Data.Storage.Hand.Tool and Data.Storage.Hand.Tool.Name == "bee_net")) then
                        for _, v: Model in Services.CollectionService:GetTagged("bee") do
                            local Root: BasePart? = v.PrimaryPart or v:FindFirstChild("Root") :: BasePart?
                            if Root and (LocalPosition - Root.Position).Magnitude <= CollectRange.Value then
                                local Net: InventoryItem? = Switch.Enabled and Inventory.Item("bee_net") or nil
                                if Net then
                                    SlotController.Switch(Net.tool)
                                end

                                Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("PickUpBee"):SendToServer({
                                    beeId = v:GetAttribute("BeeId")
                                })

                                if CollectDelay.Value > 0 then
                                    task.wait(CollectDelay.Value)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    if Deposit.Enabled and Inventory.Item("bee") then
                        for _, v: BasePart in Services.CollectionService:GetTagged("beehive") do
                            if not Inventory.Item("bee") then
                                break
                            end

                            local Prompt: ProximityPrompt? = v:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt")
                            if Prompt and (v:GetAttribute("Level") or 0) < 10 and v:GetAttribute("PlacedByUserId") == Services.LocalPlayer.UserId and (LocalPosition - v.Position).Magnitude <= DepositRange.Value then
                                task.spawn(fireproximityprompt, Prompt)

                                if DepositDelay.Value > 0 then
                                    task.wait(DepositDelay.Value)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end

                task.wait(0.1)
            until not AutoKit.Enabled

BundledModules.BountyHunter = (function()
    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity

    return function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
        local AutoKit: Module = Section("BountyHunter")
        local Track, Delay, Reroll, RerollRange

        local Abilities: {string} = {"bounty_hunter_4", "bounty_hunter_3", "bounty_hunter_2", "bounty_hunter_1"}

        local function TrackAbility(): string
            for _, v: string in Abilities do
                if Data.Controllers.AbilityController.enabledAbilities and Data.Controllers.AbilityController.enabledAbilities[v] then
                    return v
                end
            end

            local Level: number = Data.Controllers.BountyHunterUtil and Data.Controllers.BountyHunterUtil.getBountyHunterLevel(Services.LocalPlayer) or 0
            return `bounty_hunter_{math.clamp(Level + 1, 1, 4)}`
        end

        local function Use(Ability: string): boolean
            if Data.Controllers.AbilityController:canUseAbility(Ability, {disableBlockedAbilityAlert = true}) then
                Data.Controllers.AbilityController:useAbility(Ability)
                return true
            end

            return false
        end

        AutoKit.Kits.bounty_hunter = function()
            local TrackCooldown: number = 0
            local RerollCooldown: number = 0

            repeat
                if Entity.Alive then
                    local Kit: any = Data.Controllers.Store:getState().Kit
                    local Bounty: Model? = Kit and Kit.bountyHunterTarget
                    local Distance: number = math.huge

                    for _, v: Target in Entity.Entities do
                        if Bounty and v.Character == Bounty and v.RootPart then
                            Distance = (v.RootPart.Position - Entity.RootPart.Position).Magnitude
                            break
                        end
                    end

                    if Track.Enabled and Bounty and tick() >= TrackCooldown and Use(TrackAbility()) then
                        TrackCooldown = tick() + Delay.Value
                    end

                    if Reroll.Enabled and tick() >= RerollCooldown and Distance > RerollRange.Value and Use("bounty_hunter_reroll") then
                        RerollCooldown = tick() + 1
                    end
                end

                task.wait(0.1)
            until not AutoKit.Enabled
        end

        Track = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Auto track",
            Default = true,
            Tooltip = "Uses the tracking ability whenever it comes off cooldown, the marker lasts 15 seconds"
        })
        Delay = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Delay",
            Min = 0,
            Max = 5,
            Default = 0.5,
            Decimal = 10,
            Suffix = "seconds"
        })
        Reroll = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Auto reroll",
            Tooltip = "Rerolls the bounty when your target is dead, gone or further away than the range below"
        })
        RerollRange = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Reroll range",
            Min = 10,
            Max = 500,
            Default = 250,
            Darker = true,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
            end
        })

        AutoKit.Settings.bounty_hunter = {Track, Delay, Reroll, RerollRange}
    end
end)()

BundledModules.Builder = (function()
    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity
    local Inventory = BundledModules.Inventory

    return function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
        local AutoKit: Module = Section("Builder")
        local BedCheck, Animation, Limit, Blacklist

        AutoKit.Kits.builder = function()
            repeat
                if Entity.Alive and (not Limit.Enabled and Inventory.Item("hammer") or Limit.Enabled and Data.Storage.Hand.Tool and Data.Storage.Hand.Tool.Name == "hammer") then
                    local Bed: BasePart? = nil

                    if BedCheck.Enabled then
                        local NoBreak: string = `Team{Services.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Team") or -1}NoBreak`
                        local Nearest: number = math.huge

                        for _, v: BasePart in Services.CollectionService:GetTagged("bed") do
                            local Magnitude: number = (Entity.RootPart.Position - v.Position).Magnitude
                            if Magnitude < Nearest and v:GetAttribute(NoBreak) then
                                Bed, Nearest = v, Magnitude
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    for _, v: BasePart in Services.CollectionService:GetTagged("block") do
                        if not v:GetAttribute("NoBreak") and v:GetAttribute("PlacedByUserId") and not table.find(Blacklist.ListEnabled, v.Name:find("wool_") and "wool" or v.Name) then
                            if (not BedCheck.Enabled or Bed and (Bed.Position - v.Position).Magnitude <= 30) and not v:FindFirstChild("BuilderFortify") then
                                Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("FortifyBlock"):SendToServer(Data.Controllers.BlockController:getBlockPosition(v.Position))

                                if Animation.Enabled then
                                    Data.Controllers.GameAnimationUtil:playAnimation(Services.LocalPlayer, Data.Controllers.GameAnimationUtil:getAssetId(Data.Instances.Animations.BUILDER_HAMMER_HIT), {
                                        fadeInTime = 0.02
                                    })
                                    Data.Controllers.AudioManager:playAudio(Data.Instances.Sounds.FORTIFY_BLOCK, {
                                        position = Entity.RootPart.Position
                                    })
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end

                task.wait(0.1)
            until not AutoKit.Enabled
        end

        BedCheck = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Bed check",
            Tooltip = "Only fortifies blocks that are close to your bed"
        })
        Animation = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Animation",
            Default = true,
            Tooltip = "Plays the hammer sound and animation"
        })
        Limit = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Limit to items",
            Default = true,
            Tooltip = "Only fortifies when you are holding the hammer"
        })
        Blacklist = AutoKit:CreateTextList({
            Name = "Blacklist",
            Placeholder = "block",
            Default = {"cannon", "wool"}
        })

        AutoKit.Settings.builder = {BedCheck, Animation, Limit, Blacklist}
    end
end)()

BundledModules.Caitlyn = (function()
    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity

    return function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
        local AutoKit: Module = Section("Caitlyn")
        local Mode, MinHP, TargetMode, Range, TargetPriorities, DropContract

        local Abandon: number = Data.Instances.BloodAssassinUtil and Data.Instances.BloodAssassinUtil.ABANDON_TIME_SEC or 60
        local Hits: {[Model]: number} = {}
        local Threats: {[Player]: number} = {}
        local Beds: {[any]: {any}} = {}
        local DropUntil: number = 0
        local PendingId: any = nil
        local PendingUntil: number = 0
        local PriorityId: any = nil

        local function GetScore(Contract: any, Targets: {[any]: Target}): (number?, Target?)
            local Ent: Target? = Targets[Contract.target]
            if Ent then
                local Health: number = Ent.Humanoid.Health
                local Distance: number = (Entity.RootPart.Position - Ent.RootPart.Position).Magnitude
                local Score: number = 30 + ((tonumber(Contract.rewardValue) or 0) * 35)
                Score += (1 - math.clamp(Health / math.max(Ent.Humanoid.MaxHealth, 1), 0, 1)) * 35
                Score += math.max(1 - (Distance / Range.Value), 0) * 20

                if Health <= MinHP.Value then
                    Score += 20
                end
                if (Threats[Ent.Player] or 0) > tick() then
                    Score += 30
                end
                if Ent.Character:GetAttribute("BleedSource") == Services.LocalPlayer.UserId then
                    Score += 25
                end

                local Found: boolean, Team: any = pcall(Data.Controllers.TeamController.getPlayerTeam, Data.Controllers.TeamController, Ent.Player)
                local TeamId: any = Found and Team and Team.id or Ent.Player:GetAttribute("Team")
                local Bed: any = true
                if TeamId ~= nil then
                    local Cached: {any}? = Beds[TeamId]
                    if Cached and Cached[2] > tick() then
                        Bed = Cached[1]
                    else
                        local Success: boolean, Result: any = pcall(Data.Controllers.BedwarsController.getTeamBed, Data.Controllers.BedwarsController, TeamId)
                        Bed = not Success or (Result and Result.Parent)
                        Beds[TeamId] = {Bed, tick() + 1}
                    end
                end

                if not Bed then
                    Score += 20
                end

                local Reward: any = Contract.rewardExplanation
                if type(Reward) == "table" then
                    Score += (Reward.assassin and 10 or 0) + (Reward.kitClass and 8 or 0) + (Reward.gear and 6 or 0)
                end

                return Score, Ent
            end

            return nil, nil
        end

        local function GetPriority(Contracts: {any}): (any, boolean)
            local Bounty: boolean = false
            for _, v: any in Contracts do
                if v.rewardValue or v.rewardUpgrade then
                    Bounty = true

                    break
                end
            end

            if Bounty then
                local Targets: {[any]: Target} = {}
                for _, v: Target in Entity.Targets({
                    Players = true,
                    Range = Range.Value,
                    Wallcheck = true
                }) do
                    if not (v.Player.Team and v.Player.Team.Name == "Spectators") then
                        Targets[v.Player] = v
                        Targets[v.Character :: Model] = v
                    end
                end

                local Current: any, CurrentScore: number? = nil, nil
                if PriorityId then
                    for _, v: any in Contracts do
                        if v.id == PriorityId then
                            Current, CurrentScore = v, GetScore(v, Targets)

                            break
                        end
                    end
                end

                local Best: any, BestScore: number? = nil, nil
                for _, v: any in Contracts do
                    local Score: number? = GetScore(v, Targets)
                    if Score and (not BestScore or Score > BestScore) then
                        Best, BestScore = v, Score
                    end
                end

                if Current and CurrentScore and BestScore and Best ~= Current and BestScore < CurrentScore + 15 then
                    Best = Current
                end

                PriorityId = Best and Best.id or nil

                return Best, true
            end

            return nil, false
        end

        local function GetNormal(Contracts: {any}): any
            local Offered: {[string]: any} = {}
            for _, v: any in Contracts do
                if v.target then
                    Offered[v.target.Name] = v
                end
            end

            for _, v: Target in Entity.Targets({
                Players = true,
                Range = Range.Value,
                Sort = TargetMode.Value
            }) do
                local Contract: any = Offered[v.Player.Name]
                if Contract and (Hits[v.Character :: Model] or 0) > tick() and not (v.Player.Team and v.Player.Team.Name == "Spectators") and (Mode.Value ~= "On Low" or v.Humanoid.Health < MinHP.Value) then
                    return Contract
                end
            end

            return nil
        end

        local function CanDrop(Contract: any): boolean
            local Activation: number? = tonumber(Contract.activationTime)
            if not Activation or workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - Activation < Abandon then
                return false
            end

            local Victim: Target? = nil
            for _, v: Target in Entity.Entities do
                if Contract.target and (v.Character == Contract.target or v.Player == Contract.target) then
                    Victim = v

                    break
                end
            end
            if not Victim or Victim.Health <= 0 or not Victim.RootPart then
                return true
            end

            return (Victim.RootPart.Position - Entity.RootPart.Position).Magnitude > Range.Value
        end

        local function Update()
            if Entity.Alive then
                local Kit: any = Data.Controllers.Store:getState().Kit
                local Active: any = Kit and Kit.activeContract
                if not Kit or Active then
                    PendingId = nil
                    PriorityId = Active and Active.id or nil

                    if Active and DropContract.Enabled and DropUntil <= tick() and CanDrop(Active) then
                        Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("BloodAssassinSelectContract"):SendToServer({
                            contractId = nil
                        })
                        DropUntil = tick() + 5
                    end
                elseif not (PendingId and PendingUntil > tick()) then
                    PendingId = nil

                    local Contracts: any = Kit.availableContracts
                    if Contracts and #Contracts > 0 then
                        local Contract: any = nil
                        if TargetPriorities.Enabled then
                            local Available: boolean = false
                            Contract, Available = GetPriority(Contracts)
                            if not Available then
                                Contract = GetNormal(Contracts)
                            end
                        else
                            PriorityId = nil
                            Contract = GetNormal(Contracts)
                        end

                        if Contract then
                            Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("BloodAssassinSelectContract"):SendToServer({
                                contractId = Contract.id
                            })
                            PendingId = Contract.id
                            PendingUntil = tick() + 1
                        end
                    end
                end
            else
                table.clear(Hits)
                PendingId = nil
                PriorityId = nil
            end
        end

        AutoKit.Kits.blood_assassin = function()
            AutoKit:Clean(function()
                table.clear(Hits)
                table.clear(Threats)
                table.clear(Beds)
                DropUntil = 0
                PendingId = nil
                PendingUntil = 0
                PriorityId = nil
            end)

            AutoKit:Clean(Data.Events.EntityDamageEvent:Connect(function(Event: {entityInstance: Instance?, fromEntity: Instance?})
                local Character: Model? = Services.LocalPlayer.Character
                if Character and Event.entityInstance == Character then
                    for _, v: Target in Entity.Entities do
                        if v.Player and v.Character == Event.fromEntity then
                            Threats[v.Player] = tick() + 3
                        end
                    end
                elseif Character and (Event.fromEntity == Character or Event.fromEntity == Services.LocalPlayer) then
                    for _, v: Target in Entity.Entities do
                        if v.Character and v.Character == Event.entityInstance then
                            Hits[v.Character] = tick() + 1
                        end
                    end
                end
            end))

            repeat
                Update()
                task.wait(0.2)
            until not AutoKit.Enabled
        end

        Mode = AutoKit:CreateDropdown({
            Name = "Contract mode",
            List = {"On Hit", "On Low"},
            Default = "On Low",
            Tooltip = "On Hit - contracts them as soon as you start hitting them\nOn Low - contracts them once they are low on health"
        })
        MinHP = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Minimum health",
            Tooltip = "How low their health has to be before you contract them",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 100,
            Default = 30,
            Darker = true
        })

        local Methods: {string} = {"Health", "Distance"}
        for Index: string in Entity.Sorts do
            if not table.find(Methods, Index) then
                table.insert(Methods, Index)
            end
        end

        TargetMode = AutoKit:CreateDropdown({
            Name = "Target mode",
            List = Methods,
            Default = "Distance",
            Tooltip = "Who gets your contract when more than one player you hit has one up, sorted the same way as killaura"
        })
        Range = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Range",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 50,
            Default = 50,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value <= 1 and "stud" or "studs"
            end
        })
        TargetPriorities = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Target priorities",
            Function = function()
                PriorityId = nil
            end,
            Tooltip = "Takes the contract with the best reward and easiest kill in range right away, instead of waiting for contract mode and target mode"
        })
        DropContract = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Drop contract",
            Tooltip = "Drops your contract once 60 seconds have passed since taking it (the soonest the game allows) so you can take a new one. It is kept while the target is alive within range, and dropped when they die"
        })

        AutoKit.Settings.blood_assassin = {Mode, MinHP, TargetMode, Range, TargetPriorities, DropContract}
    end
end)()

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity

    return function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
        local AutoKit: Module = Section("Card", true)

                        Data.Controllers.AbilityController:useAbility("CARD_THROW")

                end

                task.wait(0.1)
            until not AutoKit.Enabled
        end

        Range = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Range",

            Max = 100,
            Default = 60,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string

        })
        Delay = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Delay",
            Min = 0.1,
            Max = 3,
            Default = 0.4,
            Decimal = 10,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value == 1 and "sec" or "secs"
            end,
            Tooltip = "Time to wait between card throws"
        })

        AutoKit.Settings.card = {Range, Delay}
    end
end)()

BundledModules.Cogsworth = (function()
    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity

    return function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
        local AutoKit: Module = Section("Cogsworth", true)
        local Collect, Steal, Range, Delay, Overclock, OverclockRange

        local NextCollect: number = 0
        local NextOverclock: number = 0

        AutoKit.Kits.steam_engineer = function()
            NextCollect = 0
            NextOverclock = 0

            repeat
                if Entity.Alive then
                    local Origin: Vector3 = Entity.RootPart.Position

                    if Collect.Enabled and tick() >= NextCollect then
                        local Bots: {[Model]: any} = {}
                        if Data.Controllers.GatherBotBasicController then
                            Bots = Data.Controllers.GatherBotBasicController.gatherBotMap
                        end

                        for Bot: Model in Bots do
                            if Bot.Parent and (Steal.Enabled or Bot:GetAttribute("PlacedByUserId") == Services.LocalPlayer.UserId) and (Bot:GetAttribute("HeldItemAmount") or 0) > 0 and (Bot:GetPivot().Position - Origin).Magnitude <= Range.Value then
                                Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("GatherBotCollectItems"):SendToServer({
                                    gatherBot = Bot
                                })
                                NextCollect = tick() + Delay.Value

                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    if Overclock.Enabled and tick() >= NextOverclock and Data.Controllers.AbilityController:canUseAbility("STEAM_ENGINEER_OVERCLOCK", {disableBlockedAbilityAlert = true}) then
                        local Found: boolean = #Entity.Targets({
                            Origin = Origin,
                            Range = OverclockRange.Value,
                            Players = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Players.Enabled,
                            NPCs = AutoKit.Options.Targets.NPCs.Enabled,
                            Invisible = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Invisible.Enabled
                        }) > 0

                        if Found then
                            NextOverclock = tick() + 1
                            Data.Controllers.AbilityController:useAbility("STEAM_ENGINEER_OVERCLOCK")
                        end
                    end
                end

                task.wait(0.1)
            until not AutoKit.Enabled
        end

        Collect = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Collect bots",
            Default = true,
            Tooltip = "The games own collect prompt stops at 10 studs, the server never checks it"
        })
        Steal = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Steal enemy bots",
            Tooltip = "Also empties gather bots that somebody else placed"
        })
        Range = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Range",
            Min = 5,
            Max = 500,
            Default = 250,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
            end
        })
        Delay = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Delay",
            Min = 0.1,
            Max = 3,
            Default = 0.3,
            Decimal = 100,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value == 1 and "sec" or "secs"
            end
        })
        Overclock = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Overclock",
            Default = true,
            Tooltip = "Overclocks when an enemy is close"
        })
        OverclockRange = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Overclock range",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 60,
            Default = 25,
            Darker = true,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
            end
        })

        AutoKit.Settings.steam_engineer = {Collect, Steal, Range, Delay, Overclock, OverclockRange}
    end
end)()

BundledModules.Conqueror = (function()
    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity
    local Inventory = BundledModules.Inventory
    local PlacementController = BundledModules.PlacementController
    local SlotController = BundledModules.SlotController

    return function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
        local AutoKit: Module = Section("Conqueror", true)
        local Banner, Mode, Range, Cooldown, Switch, SwitchDelay

        local Banners: {[string]: string} = {
            Fire = "damage_banner",
            Defense = "defense_banner",
            Heal = "heal_banner"
        }
        local NextPlace: number = 0
        local Placing: boolean = false

        local function PlaceBanner()
            local ItemType: string = Banners[Banner.Value]
            local Item: any = Inventory.Item(ItemType)

            if not Placing and tick() >= NextPlace and Entity.Alive and Item and (Item.amount or 1) > 0 then
                local Position: Vector3 = Entity.RootPart.Position
                local Nearby: boolean = false

                for _, v: Instance in Services.CollectionService:GetTagged("flag-kit") do
                    if v:IsA("BasePart") and v.Name == ItemType and (v.Position - Position).Magnitude <= Data.Instances.ConquerorBalance.CONQUEROR_FLAG_RADIUS / 2 then
                        Nearby = true
                        break
                    end
                end

                if not Nearby then
                    local Store: any = Data.Controllers.BlockController:getStore()
                    local Base: Vector3 = Position - Vector3.new(0, Entity.Humanoid.HipHeight + 1.5, 0)
                    Base = Vector3.new(math.round(Base.X / 3) * 3, math.round(Base.Y / 3) * 3, math.round(Base.Z / 3) * 3)
                    local Spot: Vector3?

                    for _, v: Vector3 in {Vector3.new(3, 3, 0), Vector3.new(-3, 3, 0), Vector3.new(0, 3, 3), Vector3.new(0, 3, -3), Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)} do
                        local Candidate: Vector3 = Base + v
                        if not Store:getBlockAt(Data.Controllers.BlockController:getBlockPosition(Candidate)) and Store:getBlockAt(Data.Controllers.BlockController:getBlockPosition(Candidate - Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))) then
                            Spot = Candidate
                            break
                        end
                    end

                    if Spot then
                        Placing = true
                        NextPlace = tick() + Cooldown.Value
                        local Slot: number = Data.Storage.Inventory.hotbarSlot

                        if Switch.Enabled then
                            SlotController.Select(Item.tool)
                            task.wait(SwitchDelay.Value)
                        end

                        PlacementController.Place(Spot, ItemType)

                        if Switch.Enabled then
                            task.wait(SwitchDelay.Value)
                            Data.Controllers.Store:dispatch({type = "InventorySelectHotbarSlot", slot = Slot})
                        end

                        Placing = false
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        AutoKit.Kits.vesta = function()
            NextPlace = 0
            Placing = false

            AutoKit:Clean(function()
                Placing = false
            end)

            AutoKit:Clean(Data.Events.EntityDamageEvent:Connect(function(Event: {damageType: number, fromEntity: Instance?, entityInstance: Instance?})
                if Mode.Value == "On attack" and Event.damageType == 0 and ((Event.fromEntity and Event.fromEntity.Name == Services.LocalPlayer.Name) or (Services.LocalPlayer.Character and Event.entityInstance == Services.LocalPlayer.Character)) then
                    task.spawn(PlaceBanner)
                end
            end))

            repeat
                if Mode.Value == "On near" and Entity.Alive and Entity.Targets({
                    Range = Range.Value,
                    Players = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Players.Enabled,
                    NPCs = AutoKit.Options.Targets.NPCs.Enabled,
                    Priority = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Priority.Value,
                    Wallcheck = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Walls.Enabled
                })[1] then
                    PlaceBanner()
                end

                task.wait(0.1)
            until not AutoKit.Enabled
        end

        Banner = AutoKit:CreateDropdown({
            Name = "Banner",
            List = {"Fire", "Defense", "Heal"},
            Tooltip = "Which banner to put down, Fire gives the damage buff"
        })
        Mode = AutoKit:CreateDropdown({
            Name = "Place on",
            List = {"On attack", "On near"},
            Tooltip = "On attack waits until you trade hits, On near drops it as soon as someone walks up"
        })
        Range = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Range",
            Min = 5,
            Max = 100,
            Default = 30,
            Darker = true,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
            end,
            Tooltip = "How close an enemy has to be for On near"
        })
        Cooldown = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Cooldown",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 60,
            Default = 30,
            Suffix = "seconds",
            Tooltip = "Time before it puts another one down, a banner lasts 30 seconds"
        })
        Switch = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Legit switch",
            Tooltip = "Holds the banner through the hotbar and puts your item back after"
        })
        SwitchDelay = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Switch delay",
            Min = 0,
            Max = 1,
            Decimal = 100,
            Default = 0.08,
            Darker = true,
            Suffix = "seconds"
        })

        AutoKit.Settings.vesta = {Banner, Mode, Range, Cooldown, Switch, SwitchDelay}
    end
end)()

BundledModules.Cyber = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity
    local Inventory = BundledModules.Inventory

    return function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
        local AutoKit: Module = Section("Cyber")
        local Mode, Whitelist, Visual, Steal, Target, Limit

        local Altitude: number = 10000
        local Flat: Vector3 = Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
        local Blacklist: {[BasePart]: number} = {}
        local Watching: {[Model]: {RBXScriptConnection}} = {}
        local Air: RaycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
        local DroneCache: Model?
        local Marker: Highlight?

        local function GetDrone(): Model?
            if Limit.Enabled and (not Data.Storage.Hand.Tool or Data.Storage.Hand.Tool.Name ~= "drone") then
                return nil
            end

            if DroneCache and DroneCache.Parent then
                return DroneCache
            end

            for _, v: Model in Services.CollectionService:GetTagged("Drone") do
                if v:GetAttribute("PlayerUserId") == Services.LocalPlayer.UserId then
                    if not Watching[v] then
                        local function Changed(): ()
                            if v:GetAttribute("HeldItem") then
                                repeat
                                    Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("DropDroneItem"):SendToServer({
                                        direction = Vector3.new(1000, 10, 0),
                                        position = (v.PrimaryPart :: BasePart).Position
                                    })
                                    task.wait(0.1)
                                until not v:GetAttribute("HeldItem") or not AutoKit.Enabled
                            end
                        end

                        Watching[v] = {
                            v:GetAttributeChangedSignal("HeldItem"):Connect(Changed),
                            v:GetAttributeChangedSignal("HeldItemAmount"):Connect(Changed)
                        }
                    end

                    DroneCache = v
                    return v
                end
            end

            if Inventory.Item("drone") and Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("FireGuidedProjectile"):CallServer("drone") then
                task.wait(0.1)
                return GetDrone()
            end

            return nil
        end

        local function Ascend(Drone: Model): ()
            local Root: BasePart? = Drone.PrimaryPart
            if Root and Drone.Parent then
                Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                Root.CFrame = CFrame.new(Root.Position.X, Altitude, Root.Position.Z)
            end
        end

        local function GetItemDrop(Drone: Model): BasePart?
            local Generator: Model? = Services.CollectionService:GetTagged(`{Services.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Team")}_TeamOreGenerator`)[1]
            local Home: Vector3 = Generator and (Generator.PrimaryPart :: BasePart).Position or Vector3.zero
            local Position: Vector3 = (Drone.PrimaryPart :: BasePart).Position
            local Children: {BasePart} = workspace.ItemDrops:GetChildren() :: {BasePart}
            local Distances: {[BasePart]: number} = {}

            for _, v: BasePart in Children do
                Distances[v] = (Position - v.Position).Magnitude
            end

            table.sort(Children, function(A: BasePart, B: BasePart): boolean
                return Distances[A] < Distances[B]
            end)

            for _, v: BasePart in Children do
                if tick() > (Blacklist[v] or 0) and table.find(Whitelist.ListEnabled, v.Name) and v.Position.Y > 0 and math.abs(v.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y) <= 0 and (not Steal.Enabled or (v.Position - Home).Magnitude > 20) and (not Target.Enabled or not Entity.Targets({
                    Origin = Position,
                    Range = 60,
                    Players = true
                })[1]) then
