                    return v
                end
            end

            return nil
        end

        AutoKit.Kits.cyber = function()
            Air.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
            Air.FilterDescendantsInstances = {Data.Storage.Map}

            AutoKit:Clean(function()
                for _, v: Model in Services.CollectionService:GetTagged("Drone") do
                    if v:GetAttribute("PlayerUserId") == Services.LocalPlayer.UserId and v.PrimaryPart then
                        v.PrimaryPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(v.PrimaryPart.CFrame.X, 500, v.PrimaryPart.CFrame.Z)
                    end
                end

                for _, v: {RBXScriptConnection} in Watching do
                    for _, Connection: RBXScriptConnection in v do
                        Connection:Disconnect()
                    end
                end

                if Marker then
                    Marker:Destroy()
                    Marker = nil
                end

                table.clear(Watching)
                table.clear(Blacklist)
                DroneCache = nil
            end)

            AutoKit:Clean(workspace.ItemDrops.ChildAdded:Connect(function(ItemDrop: BasePart)
                local Thrown: boolean = ItemDrop.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X > 100
                task.wait()

                if Thrown or ItemDrop.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X > 100 then
                    Blacklist[ItemDrop] = tick() + 5
                    local Amount: number = ItemDrop:GetAttribute("Amount") or 1
                    local LastParent: Instance? = ItemDrop.Parent

                    if Mode.Value == "Player" then
                        Cat:CreateNotification("Cyber", `Collecting {Amount} {ItemDrop.Name}`, 4)

                        repeat
                            ItemDrop.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                            ItemDrop.CFrame = Entity.RootPart.CFrame - Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)

                            task.spawn(function(): ()
                                Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("PickupItemDrop"):CallServerAsync({
                                    itemDrop = ItemDrop
                                }):andThen(function(Success: boolean): ()
                                    if Success then
                                        Data.Controllers.AudioManager:playAudio(Data.Instances.Sounds.PICKUP_ITEM_DROP)
                                        local Sound: any = Data.Instances.Items[ItemDrop.Name].pickUpOverlaySound
                                        if Sound then
                                            Data.Controllers.AudioManager:playAudio(Sound, {
                                                position = ItemDrop.Position,
                                                volumeMultiplier = 0.9
                                            })
                                        end
                                    end
                                end)
                            end)

                            task.wait(0.02)
                        until not ItemDrop or ItemDrop.Parent ~= LastParent

                        Cat:CreateNotification("Cyber", `Collected {Amount} {ItemDrop.Name}{Amount > 1 and "s" or ""}`, 4)
                    else
                        local Start: number = tick()
                        local Generator: Model? = Services.CollectionService:GetTagged(`{Services.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Team")}_TeamOreGenerator`)[1]

                        if Generator then
                            repeat
                                ItemDrop.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                                ItemDrop.CFrame = (Generator.PrimaryPart :: BasePart).CFrame
                                task.wait()
                            until (tick() - Start) >= 1 or not ItemDrop or ItemDrop.Parent ~= LastParent

                            Cat:CreateNotification("Cyber", `Dropped {Amount} {ItemDrop.Name}`, 8)
                        else
                            Cat:CreateNotification("Cyber", "Generator not found", 20)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end))

            repeat
                local Drone: Model? = GetDrone()

                if Drone then
                    local Root: BasePart = Drone.PrimaryPart :: BasePart
                    local ItemDrop: BasePart? = GetItemDrop(Drone)

                    if ItemDrop then
                        Ascend(Drone)
                        task.wait(0.3)

                        if Visual.Enabled then
                            Marker = Instance.new("Highlight")
                            Marker.FillColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
                            Marker.FillTransparency = 0
                            Marker.OutlineTransparency = 0.5
                            Marker.OutlineColor = Color3.new()
                            Marker.Parent = ItemDrop
                        end

                        local Magnitude: number = 0
                        local LastMagnitude: number = 9e9
                        local Position: Vector3 = ItemDrop.Position

                        repeat
                            if Drone.Parent then
                                Position = ItemDrop.Position
                                Root.CanCollide = false
                                Root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                                Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = CFrame.lookAt(Root.Position * Flat, Position * Flat).LookVector * 30
                                Magnitude = ((Root.Position * Flat) - (Position * Flat)).Magnitude

                                if (LastMagnitude - Magnitude) >= 25 then
                                    LastMagnitude = Magnitude
                                    Cat:CreateNotification("Cyber", `Drone is {math.floor(Magnitude)} studs away from {ItemDrop.Name}.`, 1)
                                end
                            else
                                break
                            end

                            task.wait()
                        until not ItemDrop or ItemDrop.Parent ~= workspace.ItemDrops or not AutoKit.Enabled or Magnitude <= 2

                        if Magnitude <= 5 then
                            local Start: number = tick()
                            local Burrow: Vector3?

                            if Visual.Enabled then
                                Cat:CreateNotification("Cyber", `Attempting to collect {ItemDrop.Name}`, 4)
                            end

                            repeat
                                if Drone.Parent then
                                    if not Burrow then
                                        local Ground: RaycastResult? = workspace:Raycast(Position + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), Vector3.new(0, -5, 0), Air)
                                        Burrow = Vector3.new(Position.X, (Ground and Ground.Position.Y or Position.Y) - (Drone :: any).Hitbox.Size.Y, Position.Z)
                                    end

                                    Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                                    Root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, -30, 0)
                                    Root.CFrame = CFrame.new(Burrow :: Vector3)
                                end

                                task.wait(0.02)
                            until (tick() - Start) >= 1.25

                            Ascend(Drone)
                        elseif Visual.Enabled then
                            Cat:CreateNotification("Cyber", `Too far away to collect {ItemDrop.Name} ({Magnitude} studs).`, 8)
                        end

                        if Marker then
                            Marker:Destroy()
                            Marker = nil
                        end
                    else
                        Ascend(Drone)

                        for _, v: string in Whitelist.ListEnabled do
                            local Position: Vector3 = Root.Position
                            local Children: {Model} = Services.CollectionService:GetTagged(`{v}_OreGenerator`)

                            table.sort(Children, function(A: Model, B: Model): boolean
                                return (Position - (A.PrimaryPart :: BasePart).Position).Magnitude < (Position - (B.PrimaryPart :: BasePart).Position).Magnitude
                            end)

                            local Generator: BasePart? = Children[1] and Children[1].PrimaryPart or nil
                            if Generator then
                                local Magnitude: number = 0

                                repeat
                                    if Drone.Parent then
                                        if GetItemDrop(Drone) then
                                            break
                                        end

                                        Root.CanCollide = false
                                        Root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                                        Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = CFrame.lookAt(Root.Position * Flat, Generator.Position * Flat).LookVector * 30
                                        Magnitude = ((Root.Position * Flat) - (Generator.Position * Flat)).Magnitude
                                    else
                                        break
                                    end

                                    task.wait()
                                until not AutoKit.Enabled or Magnitude <= 5
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end

                task.wait()
            until not AutoKit.Enabled
        end

        Mode = AutoKit:CreateDropdown({
            Name = "Drop mode",
            List = {"Player", "Generator"},
            Default = "Player",
            Tooltip = "Where the stolen items get dropped to"
        })
        Whitelist = AutoKit:CreateTextList({
            Name = "Whitelist",
            Default = {"emerald", "diamond"}
        })
        Visual = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Visualize",
            Default = true,
            Tooltip = "Shows which item the drone is going for and how far away it is"
        })
        Steal = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Steal split",
            Default = true,
            Tooltip = "Steals the generator split of other teams"
        })
        Target = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Target check",
            Tooltip = "Skips items that have a player close by"
        })
        Limit = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Limit to item",
            Tooltip = "Only runs when you are holding the drone"
        })

        AutoKit.Settings.cyber = {Mode, Whitelist, Visual, Steal, Target, Limit}
    end
end)()

BundledModules.Break = (function()
    local Services = BundledModules.Services
    local LocalPlayer: Player = Services.Players.LocalPlayer

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity
    local SlotController = BundledModules.SlotController

    local Break = {
        Tool = nil :: BreakTool?,
        Target = nil :: Vector3?,
        Failed = 0
    }

    local PathCache: {[string]: BreakCache} = {}
    local Requests: {BreakRequest} = {}
    local Latest: BreakRequest?
    local Focus: BreakFocus?
    local Healthbar: {Health: number, Position: Vector3} = {Health = -1, Position = Vector3.zero}

    local Sides: {Vector3} = {}
    for _, v: Enum.NormalId in Enum.NormalId:GetEnumItems() do
        table.insert(Sides, Vector3.FromNormalId(v) * 3)
    end

    Break.Hits = function(Block: any, BlockPosition: Vector3): number
        if not Block then
            return 0
        end

        local BreakType: string = Data.Instances.Items[Block.Name].block.breakType
        local Tool: any = Data.Storage.Tools[BreakType]
        Tool = Tool and Data.Instances.Items[Tool.itemType].breakBlock[BreakType] or 2

        local BlockData: any = Data.Controllers.BlockController:getStore():getBlockData(Data.Controllers.BlockController:getBlockPosition(BlockPosition))

        return (BlockData and (BlockData:GetAttribute("1") or BlockData:GetAttribute("Health")) or Block:GetAttribute("Health")) / Tool
    end

    Break.Methods = {
        Health = Break.Hits,
        Distance = function(Block: any, BlockPosition: Vector3): number
            local Position: Vector3 = Entity.Alive and (Entity.RootPart.Position - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)) or Vector3.zero

            return (Position - Vector3.new(Block.Position.X, Position.Y, Block.Position.Z)).Magnitude + Break.Hits(Block, BlockPosition) * 0.01
        end
    }

    local function March(From: Vector3, Aim: Vector3, Visit: (Vector3) -> boolean): boolean
        local Start: Vector3 = Data.Controllers.BlockController:getBlockPosition(From)
        local Direction: Vector3 = Aim - From
        local Cell: {number} = {Start.X, Start.Y, Start.Z}
        local Source: {number} = {From.X, From.Y, From.Z}
        local Heading: {number} = {Direction.X, Direction.Y, Direction.Z}
        local Steps: {number}, Nexts: {number}, Deltas: {number} = {}, {}, {}
        for Axis: number = 1, 3 do
            if Heading[Axis] == 0 then
                Steps[Axis], Nexts[Axis], Deltas[Axis] = 0, math.huge, math.huge

                continue
            end

            Steps[Axis] = Heading[Axis] > 0 and 1 or -1
            Nexts[Axis] = (((Cell[Axis] + (Steps[Axis] * 0.5)) * 3) - Source[Axis]) / Heading[Axis]
            Deltas[Axis] = 3 / math.abs(Heading[Axis])
        end

        for _ = 1, 100 do
            if Visit(Vector3.new(Cell[1], Cell[2], Cell[3]) * 3) then
                return true
            elseif Nexts[1] > 1 and Nexts[2] > 1 and Nexts[3] > 1 then
                return false
            else
                local Axis: number = 3
                if Nexts[1] <= Nexts[2] and Nexts[1] <= Nexts[3] then
                    Axis = 1
                elseif Nexts[2] <= Nexts[3] then
                    Axis = 2
                end

                Cell[Axis] += Steps[Axis]
                Nexts[Axis] += Deltas[Axis]
            end
        end

        return false
    end

    Break.Path = function(Target: any, BlockPosition: Vector3, SolidOnly: boolean?, Method: any): (Vector3?, number?, {[Vector3]: Vector3}?)
        local Origin: Vector3 = Entity.RootPart.Position
        local Cell: Vector3 = Data.Controllers.BlockController:getBlockPosition(Origin)
        local Head: Vector3 = (Entity.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") :: BasePart).Position
        local View: Vector3 = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position
        local Look: Vector3 = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector
        local Key: string = `{BlockPosition.X},{BlockPosition.Y},{BlockPosition.Z}|{SolidOnly and 1 or 0}|{Method == Break.Methods.Distance and 1 or 0}`
        local Cached: BreakCache? = PathCache[Key]
        if Cached and Cached.Cell == Cell and (SolidOnly or Cached.Camera == View and Cached.Head == Head) and os.clock() - Cached.Clock < 0.25 then
            return Cached.Position, Cached.Cost, Cached.Path
        else
            local Placed: {[Vector3]: any} = setmetatable({}, {
                __index = function(self: {[Vector3]: any}, Position: Vector3): any
                    local Block: any = Data.Controllers.BlockController:getStore():getBlockAt(Data.Controllers.BlockController:getBlockPosition(Position)) or false
                    rawset(self, Position, Block)

                    return Block
                end
            }) :: any

            local Counts: {[Vector3]: number | boolean} = setmetatable({}, {
                __index = function(self: {[Vector3]: number | boolean}, Position: Vector3): number | boolean
                    local Block: any = Placed[Position]
                    local Value: number | boolean = Block and (Position - Origin).Magnitude <= 30 and not Block:GetAttribute("NoBreak") and Data.Controllers.BlockController:isBlockBreakable({blockPosition = Data.Controllers.BlockController:getBlockPosition(Position)}, LocalPlayer) and math.max(math.ceil(Break.Hits(Block, Position)), 1)
                    rawset(self, Position, Value)

                    return Value
                end
            }) :: any

            local Routes: {[Vector3]: boolean} = {}
            local function IsOpen(Open: Vector3): boolean
                if Routes[Open] ~= nil then
                    return Routes[Open]
                end

                local Queue: {Vector3}, Seen: {[Vector3]: boolean}, Reached: boolean = {Open}, {[Open] = true}, true
                for _ = 1, 400 do
                    local Current: Vector3? = table.remove(Queue)
                    if not Current then
                        Reached = false

                        break
                    end
                    if (Current - BlockPosition).Magnitude > 15 then
                        break
                    end

                    for _, v: Vector3 in Sides do
                        local Next: Vector3 = Current + v
                        if Seen[Next] or Placed[Next] then
                            continue
                        end

                        Seen[Next] = true
                        table.insert(Queue, Next)
                    end
                end

                for v: Vector3 in Seen do
                    Routes[v] = Reached
                end

                return Reached
            end

            local Eyes: {Vector3} = {Head, View}
            if not SolidOnly then
                local Nearest: boolean = Method == Break.Methods.Distance
                local Previous: Vector3? = Break.Target
                local BestPosition: Vector3?, BestCost: number?, BestScore: number?, BestDistance: number?, BestFacing: number?, BestDirect: boolean?
                local BestPath: {[Vector3]: Vector3} = {}
                local function TracePath(From: Vector3, Aim: Vector3): ({Vector3}?, number?)
                    local Path: {Vector3} = {}
                    local Cost: number = 0
                    local Found: boolean = false
                    March(From, Aim, function(Position: Vector3): boolean
                        local Block: any = Placed[Position]
                        if Block == Target and Target.Name == "bed" then
                            if (Position - Origin).Magnitude > 30 then
                                return true
                            end
                            if Position ~= BlockPosition then
                                table.insert(Path, Position)
                            end

                            Found = true

                            return true
                        elseif Position == BlockPosition then
                            Found = (Position - Origin).Magnitude <= 30

                            return true
                        else
                            if Block then
                                local Count: number | boolean = Counts[Position]
                                if not Count then
                                    return true
                                end

                                Cost += Count :: number
                                table.insert(Path, Position)
                            end

                            return false
                        end
                    end)

                    if not Found then
                        return
                    end

                    return Path, Cost
                end

                for _, Eye: Vector3 in Eyes do
                    for X: number = -1, 1 do
                        for Y: number = -1, 1 do
                            for Z: number = -1, 1 do
                                local Path: {Vector3}?, Cost: number? = TracePath(Eye, BlockPosition + Vector3.new(X, Y, Z) * 1.35)
                                if Path then
                                    local Position: Vector3 = Path[1] or BlockPosition
                                    local Delta: Vector3 = Position - Origin
                                    local Distance: number = Delta.Magnitude
                                    if Distance <= 30 then
                                        local Facing: number = Distance > 0 and Delta:Dot(Look) / Distance or 1
                                        local Direct: boolean = Placed[Position] == Target
                                        local Score: number = Nearest and (Cost :: number) + Distance / 6 - (Position == Previous and 1.5 or 0) or Cost :: number
                                        local Better: boolean = not BestScore or Direct and not BestDirect or Direct == BestDirect and Score < BestScore
                                        if BestScore and Direct == BestDirect and Score == BestScore then
                                            if not Nearest and Previous and (Position == Previous) ~= (BestPosition == Previous) then
                                                Better = Position == Previous
                                            elseif Distance ~= BestDistance then
                                                Better = Distance < (BestDistance :: number)
                                            else
                                                Better = Facing > (BestFacing :: number)
                                            end
                                        end
                                        if Better then
                                            BestPosition, BestCost, BestScore, BestDistance, BestFacing, BestDirect = Position, Cost, Score, Distance, Facing, Direct
                                            table.clear(BestPath)
                                            for Index: number, v: Vector3 in Path do
                                                BestPath[v] = Path[Index + 1] or BlockPosition
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end

                PathCache[Key] = {
                    Cell = Cell,
                    Camera = View,
                    Head = Head,
                    Clock = os.clock(),
                    Position = BestPosition,
                    Cost = BestCost,
                    Path = BestPath
                }

                return BestPosition, BestCost, BestPath
            else
                if (BlockPosition - Origin).Magnitude <= 30 then
                    if Placed[BlockPosition] then
                        for _, v: Vector3 in Sides do
                            local Side: Vector3 = BlockPosition + v
                            if not Placed[Side] and IsOpen(Side) then
                                local Direct: {[Vector3]: Vector3} = {}
                                PathCache[Key] = {
                                    Cell = Cell,
                                    Camera = View,
                                    Head = Head,
                                    Clock = os.clock(),
                                    Position = BlockPosition,
                                    Cost = 0,
                                    Path = Direct
                                }

                                return BlockPosition, 0, Direct
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    local Visited: {[Vector3]: boolean}, Queue: {{any}}, Distances: {[Vector3]: number} = {}, {{0, BlockPosition}}, {[BlockPosition] = 0}
                    local Exposed: {[Vector3]: {Vector3}}, BreakPath: {[Vector3]: Vector3} = {}, {}
                    local function Push(Node: {any})
                        local Index: number = #Queue + 1
                        Queue[Index] = Node
                        repeat
                            local Parent: number = Index // 2
                            if Parent < 1 or Queue[Parent][1] <= Node[1] then
                                break
                            end

                            Queue[Index], Queue[Parent] = Queue[Parent], Node
                            Index = Parent
                        until false
                    end

                    local function Pop(): {any}?
                        local Node: {any}? = Queue[1]
                        local Last: {any}? = table.remove(Queue)
                        if #Queue > 0 then
                            Queue[1] = Last :: {any}
                            local Index: number = 1
                            repeat
                                local Child: number = Index * 2
                                if Child > #Queue then
                                    break
                                end
                                if Child < #Queue and Queue[Child + 1][1] < Queue[Child][1] then
                                    Child += 1
                                end
                                if Queue[Index][1] <= Queue[Child][1] then
                                    break
                                end

                                Queue[Index], Queue[Child] = Queue[Child], Queue[Index]
                                Index = Child
                            until false
                        end

                        return Node
                    end

                    for _ = 1, 10000 do
                        local Node: {any}? = Pop()
                        if not Node then
                            break
                        end
                        if Visited[Node[2]] then
                            continue
                        end

                        Visited[Node[2]] = true

                        for _, v: Vector3 in Sides do
                            local Next: Vector3 = Node[2] + v
                            if not Visited[Next] then
                                local Block: any = Placed[Next]
                                local BlockHits: number | boolean = Block and Block ~= Target and Counts[Next]
                                if not Block then
                                    if Placed[Node[2]] then
                                        local Cells: {Vector3}? = Exposed[Node[2]]
                                        if Cells then
                                            table.insert(Cells, Next)
                                        else
                                            Exposed[Node[2]] = {Next}
                                        end
                                    end

                                    BlockHits = not IsOpen(Next) and 0
                                end
                                if BlockHits then
                                    local CurrentDistance: number = Node[1] + (BlockHits :: number)
                                    if CurrentDistance < (Distances[Next] or math.huge) then
                                        Distances[Next] = CurrentDistance
                                        BreakPath[Next] = Node[2]
                                        Push({CurrentDistance, Next})
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    local Nearest: boolean = Method == Break.Methods.Distance
                    local Previous: Vector3? = Break.Target
                    local Candidates: {{any}} = {}
                    for Position: Vector3, Openings: {Vector3} in Exposed do
                        local Delta: Vector3 = Position - Origin
                        local Magnitude: number = Delta.Magnitude
                        if Magnitude <= 30 then
                            local Facing: number = Magnitude > 0 and Delta:Dot(Look) / Magnitude or 1
                            table.insert(Candidates, {Distances[Position], Position, Openings, Magnitude, Facing, Distances[Position] + (Magnitude / 6) - (Position == Previous and 1.5 or 0)})
                        end
                    end

                    table.sort(Candidates, function(a: {any}, b: {any}): boolean
                        if Nearest then
                            if a[6] ~= b[6] then
                                return a[6] < b[6]
                            end
                        else
                            if a[1] ~= b[1] then
                                return a[1] < b[1]
                            end
                            if Previous and (a[2] == Previous) ~= (b[2] == Previous) then
                                return a[2] == Previous
                            end
                        end
                        if a[4] ~= b[4] then
                            return a[4] < b[4]
                        end

                        return a[5] > b[5]
                    end)

                    local BestPosition: Vector3?, BestCost: number?
                    for _, v: {any} in Candidates do
                        for _, Opening: Vector3 in v[3] do
                            if IsOpen(Opening) then
                                BestPosition, BestCost = v[2], v[1]

                                break
                            end
                        end
                        if BestPosition then
                            break
                        end
                    end

                    PathCache[Key] = {
                        Cell = Cell,
                        Camera = View,
                        Head = Head,
                        Clock = os.clock(),
                        Position = BestPosition,
                        Cost = BestCost,
                        Path = BreakPath
                    }

                    return BestPosition, BestCost, BreakPath
                end
            end
        end
    end

    Break.Aim = function(Position: Vector3): boolean
        local Head: Vector3 = (Entity.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") :: BasePart).Position
        for _, Eye: Vector3 in {Head, workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position} do
            for X: number = -1, 1 do
                for Y: number = -1, 1 do
                    for Z: number = -1, 1 do
                        local Reached: boolean = false
                        March(Eye, Position + Vector3.new(X, Y, Z) * 1.35, function(Cell: Vector3): boolean
                            Reached = Cell == Position

                            return Reached or Data.Controllers.BlockController:getStore():getBlockAt(Data.Controllers.BlockController:getBlockPosition(Cell)) ~= nil
                        end)

                        if Reached then
                            return true
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        return false
    end

    Break.Block = function(Block: any, Effects: boolean?, AnimationMode: (string | boolean)?, CustomHealthbar: ((...any) -> ())?, AutoTool: boolean?, Wallcheck: boolean?, Method: ((any, Vector3) -> number)?, DirectOnly: boolean?, Sequential: boolean?, Session: {Cancelled: boolean?}?, SwitchDelay: number?, OnTarget: ((Vector3, {[Vector3]: Vector3}, Vector3) -> ())?): (Vector3?, {[Vector3]: Vector3}?, Vector3?, boolean?)
        if not LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("DenyBlockBreak") and Entity.Alive and (not Session or not Session.Cancelled) then
            local Timeout: number = math.max(1, LocalPlayer:GetNetworkPing() * 4 + 0.5)
            for Index: number = #Requests, 1, -1 do
                if tick() - Requests[Index].Sent >= Timeout or Data.Controllers.BlockController:getStore():getBlockAt(Data.Controllers.BlockController:getBlockPosition(Requests[Index].Position)) ~= Requests[Index].Hit then
                    table.remove(Requests, Index)
                end
            end

            Latest = Requests[#Requests]
            if Latest and (not Sequential or #Requests >= 4) then
                return Latest.Position, Latest.Path, Latest.Target, false
            else
                local Handler: any = Data.Controllers.BlockController:getHandlerRegistry():getHandler(Block.Name)
                local LocalPosition: Vector3 = Entity.RootPart.Position
                local Cost: number, Position: Vector3?, Target: Vector3?, BreakPath: {[Vector3]: Vector3}? = math.huge
                local Direct: boolean = false

                if Focus then
                    local FocusPosition: Vector3 = Data.Controllers.BlockController:getBlockPosition(Focus.Position)
                    local FocusBlock: Instance? = Data.Controllers.BlockController:getStore():getBlockAt(FocusPosition)
                    if Session and Focus.Session == Session and Focus.Block == Block and FocusBlock and not FocusBlock:GetAttribute("NoBreak") and FocusBlock.Name == Focus.Name and (LocalPosition - Focus.Position).Magnitude <= 30 and Data.Controllers.BlockController:isBlockBreakable({blockPosition = FocusPosition}, LocalPlayer) and (not Wallcheck or Break.Aim(Focus.Position)) then
                        Position, Target, BreakPath, Direct = Focus.Position, Focus.Target, Focus.Path, Focus.Direct
                    else
                        Focus = nil
                    end
                end

                if not Position then
                    for _, v: Vector3 in (Handler and Handler:getContainedPositions(Block) or {Data.Controllers.BlockController:getBlockPosition(Block.Position)}) do
                        local CellPosition: Vector3?, CellCost: number?, CellPath: {[Vector3]: Vector3}? = Break.Path(Block, v * 3, not Wallcheck, Method or nil)
                        local Distance: number = CellPosition and (LocalPosition - CellPosition).Magnitude or math.huge
                        local Hit: boolean = CellPosition ~= nil and Data.Controllers.BlockController:getStore():getBlockAt(Data.Controllers.BlockController:getBlockPosition(CellPosition)) == Block
                        if CellPosition and (Hit and not Direct or Hit == Direct and ((CellCost :: number) < Cost or (CellCost == Cost and Position ~= Break.Target and (CellPosition == Break.Target or Distance < (LocalPosition - (Position :: Vector3)).Magnitude)))) then
                            Cost, Position, Target, BreakPath, Direct = CellCost :: number, CellPosition, v * 3, CellPath, Hit
                        end
                    end
                end

                if not DirectOnly or Direct then
                    Break.Target = Position

                    if Position and (Entity.RootPart.Position - Position).Magnitude <= 30 then
                        local HitPosition: Vector3 = Data.Controllers.BlockController:getBlockPosition(Position)
                        local HitBlock: Instance? = Data.Controllers.BlockController:getStore():getBlockAt(HitPosition)
                        if HitBlock then
                            if Latest and (Latest.Hit ~= HitBlock or Latest.Position ~= Position) then
                                return Latest.Position, Latest.Path, Latest.Target, false
                            else
                                if OnTarget then
                                    OnTarget(Position, BreakPath :: {[Vector3]: Vector3}, Target :: Vector3)
                                end

                                if workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - Data.Controllers.SwordController.lastAttack > 0.4 and tick() >= SlotController.Fight then
                                    local Tool: InventoryItem? = Data.Storage.Tools[Data.Instances.Items[HitBlock.Name].block.breakType] or Data.Storage.Tools.stone
                                    if Tool and Tool.tool then
                                        local Hand: ObjectValue? = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HandInvItem") :: ObjectValue?
                                        local Changed: boolean = not Break.Tool or Break.Tool.Tool ~= Tool.tool or not Hand or Hand.Value ~= Tool.tool
                                        if Changed and SwitchDelay and SwitchDelay > 0 then
                                            task.wait(SwitchDelay)
                                            if not Entity.Alive or Session and Session.Cancelled or Data.Controllers.BlockController:getStore():getBlockAt(Data.Controllers.BlockController:getBlockPosition(Position)) ~= HitBlock or (workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - Data.Controllers.SwordController.lastAttack) <= 0.4 or tick() < SlotController.Fight then
                                                return Position, BreakPath, Target, false
                                            end
                                        end

                                        if not SlotController.Owner or SlotController.Owner == "Break" or tick() >= SlotController.Expires then
                                            SlotController.Owner, SlotController.Expires = "Break", tick() + 1

                                            local Mining: BreakTool = {Tool = Tool.tool, Expires = tick() + Timeout, Session = Session}
                                            Break.Tool = Mining
                                            if AutoTool and SlotController.Select(Tool.tool) then
                                                Data.Events.InventoryChanged:Wait()
                                            end
                                            if Changed then
                                                local Success: boolean, Equipped: any = Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("SetInvItem"):CallServerAsync({hand = Tool.tool}):await()
                                                if not Success or Equipped == false or not Entity.Alive or Session and Session.Cancelled or not Hand or not Hand.Parent then
                                                    return Position, BreakPath, Target, false
                                                end

                                                Hand.Value = Tool.tool
                                            end

                                            Mining.Expires = tick() + 0.5
                                        end
                                    end
                                end

                                if Healthbar.Health == -1 or HitPosition ~= Healthbar.Position then
                                    local Stored: any = Data.Controllers.BlockController:getStore():getBlockData(HitPosition)
                                    Healthbar.Health = Stored and (Stored:GetAttribute("1") or Stored:GetAttribute("Health")) or HitBlock:GetAttribute("Health")
                                    Healthbar.Position = HitPosition
                                end

                                if not Entity.Alive or Session and Session.Cancelled or Data.Controllers.BlockController:getStore():getBlockAt(Data.Controllers.BlockController:getBlockPosition(Position)) ~= HitBlock or not Data.Controllers.BlockController:isBlockBreakable({blockPosition = HitPosition}, LocalPlayer) then
                                    table.clear(PathCache)

                                    return nil, nil, nil, false
                                else
                                    local BeforeData: any = Data.Controllers.BlockController:getStore():getBlockData(HitPosition)
                                    local BeforeHealth: number = BeforeData and (BeforeData:GetAttribute("1") or BeforeData:GetAttribute("Health")) or HitBlock:GetAttribute("Health") or 0
                                    if Session and not Focus then
                                        Focus = {
                                            Block = Block,
                                            Position = Position,
                                            Target = Target :: Vector3,
                                            Path = BreakPath :: {[Vector3]: Vector3},
                                            Name = HitBlock.Name,
                                            Direct = Direct,
                                            Session = Session
                                        }
                                    end

                                    local Request: BreakRequest = {
                                        Position = Position,
                                        Target = Target :: Vector3,
                                        Path = BreakPath :: {[Vector3]: Vector3},
                                        Hit = HitBlock,
                                        Sent = tick(),
                                        Focus = Focus
                                    }
                                    table.insert(Requests, Request)
                                    Latest = Request

                                    Data.Controllers.ClientDamageBlock:Get("DamageBlock"):CallServerAsync({
                                        blockRef = {blockPosition = HitPosition},
                                        hitPosition = Position,
                                        hitNormal = Vector3.FromNormalId(Enum.NormalId.Top)
                                    }):andThen(function(Result: any)
                                        local Index: number? = table.find(Requests, Request)
                                        if Index then
                                            table.remove(Requests, Index)
                                        end

                                        Latest = Requests[#Requests]
                                        if (not Result or Result == "cancelled" or Result == "destroyed") and Focus == Request.Focus then
                                            Focus = nil
                                        end
                                        if Result then
                                            if Result == "cancelled" then
                                                table.clear(PathCache)
                                                Break.Failed = tick() + 0.1
                                            else
                                                if Effects and Break.Target == Position then
                                                    local AfterData: any = Data.Controllers.BlockController:getStore():getBlockData(HitPosition)
                                                    local AfterHealth: number = Result == "destroyed" and 0 or AfterData and (AfterData:GetAttribute("1") or AfterData:GetAttribute("Health")) or HitBlock:GetAttribute("Health") or BeforeHealth
                                                    local BlockDamage: number = math.max(BeforeHealth - AfterHealth, 0)
                                                    Healthbar.Health = BeforeHealth
                                                    Healthbar.Position = HitPosition
                                                    local Update: (...any) -> () = CustomHealthbar or Data.Controllers.BlockBreakController.blockBreaker.updateHealthbar
                                                    Update(Data.Controllers.BlockBreakController.blockBreaker, {blockPosition = HitPosition}, Healthbar.Health, HitBlock:GetAttribute("MaxHealth"), BlockDamage, HitBlock)
                                                    Healthbar.Health = math.max(Healthbar.Health - BlockDamage, 0)

                                                    if Healthbar.Health <= 0 then
                                                        Data.Controllers.BlockBreakController.blockBreaker.breakEffect:playBreak(HitBlock.Name, HitPosition, LocalPlayer)
                                                        Data.Controllers.BlockBreakController.blockBreaker.blockHealthbar:destroy()
                                                        Healthbar.Position = Vector3.zero
                                                    else
                                                        Data.Controllers.BlockBreakController.blockBreaker.breakEffect:playHit(HitBlock.Name, HitPosition, LocalPlayer)
                                                    end
                                                end

                                                if AnimationMode then
                                                    local Animation: AnimationTrack?
                                                    if AnimationMode ~= "Minimal" or Random.new(os.clock() * 1.2):NextInteger(0, 1) == 1 then
                                                        Animation = Data.Controllers.AnimationUtil:playAnimation(LocalPlayer, Data.Controllers.BlockController:getAnimationController():getAssetId(1))
                                                    end

                                                    Data.Controllers.ViewmodelController:playAnimation(15)
                                                    task.wait(AnimationMode == "Minimal" and 0.01 or 0.3)
                                                    if Animation then
                                                        Animation:Stop()
                                                        Animation:Destroy()
                                                    end
                                                end
                                            end
                                        end
                                        if Result == "destroyed" then
                                            table.clear(PathCache)
                                        end
                                    end):catch(function()
                                        local Index: number? = table.find(Requests, Request)
                                        if Index then
                                            table.remove(Requests, Index)
                                        end

                                        Latest = Requests[#Requests]
                                        if Focus == Request.Focus then
                                            Focus = nil
                                        end

                                        table.clear(PathCache)
                                    end)

                                    return Position, BreakPath, Target, true
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return Break
end)()

BundledModules.Davey = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity
    local Break = BundledModules.Break
    local Inventory = BundledModules.Inventory
    local Ping = BundledModules.Ping
    local PlacementController = BundledModules.PlacementController
    local SlotController = BundledModules.SlotController

    return function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
        local AutoKit: Module = Section("Davey")
        local Jump, Impact, Switch, LimitItem, Mode, Source, Reach, Put, Hold, Auto, Show, Retro, Trigger

        local Pending: boolean = false
        local Flight: {Root: BasePart}?
        local Visual: any
        local Stop: (() -> ())?
        local RayCheck: RaycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
        RayCheck.RespectCanCollide = true

        local function CanBreak(): boolean
            local Tool: Tool? = Data.Storage.Hand.Tool

            return not LimitItem.Enabled or Tool ~= nil and Data.Instances.Items[Tool.Name].breakBlock ~= nil
        end

        local function BreakCannon(Block: BasePart, KeepLast: boolean?)
            local Deadline: number = tick() + 0.6 + Ping.Get()
            local Hits: number = KeepLast and math.max(math.ceil(Break.Hits(Block, Block.Position)) - 1, 0) or math.huge

            repeat
                if not AutoKit.Enabled or not Entity.Alive or not CanBreak() or Hits <= 0 or (Block.Position - Entity.RootPart.Position).Magnitude > 30 then
                    return
                end

                Break.Block(Block, true, true, nil, Switch.Enabled)
                Hits -= 1
                task.wait(0.1)
            until not Block.Parent or tick() > Deadline
        end

        local function Arc(Delta: Vector3, Time: number): Vector3
            return (Delta + Vector3.yAxis * workspace.Gravity * Time * Time * 0.5) / Time
        end

        local function Miss(Delta: Vector3, Velocity: Vector3, Time: number): number
            return (Arc(Delta, Time) - Velocity).Magnitude
        end

        local function Placed(Position: Vector3): any
            return Data.Controllers.BlockController:getStore():getBlockAt(Data.Controllers.BlockController:getBlockPosition(Position))
        end

        local function CastBlock(Origin: Vector3, Direction: Vector3, Ignored: {Instance}): RaycastResult?
            local Filter: {Instance} = table.clone(Ignored)
            local First: RaycastResult?
            local Found: RaycastResult?

            for _ = 1, 8 do
                RayCheck.FilterDescendantsInstances = Filter

                local Result: RaycastResult? = workspace:Raycast(Origin, Direction, RayCheck)
                if not Result then
                    break
                end

                First = First or Result
                if Services.CollectionService:HasTag(Result.Instance, "block") then
                    Found = Result

                    break
                end

                table.insert(Filter, Result.Instance)
            end

            RayCheck.FilterDescendantsInstances = Ignored

            return Found or First
        end

        local function Place(): any
            local Item: InventoryItem? = Inventory.Item("cannon")
            if not Item then
                Cat:CreateNotification("Davey aim", "No cannon in your inventory.", 5)

                return nil
            end

            local Feet: Vector3 = Data.Controllers.BlockController:getBlockPosition(Entity.RootPart.Position - Vector3.new(0, Entity.Humanoid.HipHeight + 1.5, 0)) * 3
            for Drop: number = 0, 3 do
                if Placed(Feet - Vector3.yAxis * (3 * Drop)) then
                    Feet -= Vector3.yAxis * (3 * Drop)

                    break
                end
            end

            local Spot: Vector3?
            local Closest: number = math.huge
            for X: number = -3, 3 do
                for Z: number = -3, 3 do
                    for Y: number = 0, 1 do
                        local Cell: Vector3 = Feet + Vector3.new(X * 3, Y * 3, Z * 3)
                        local Distance: number = (Entity.RootPart.Position - Cell).Magnitude

                        if Distance <= Reach.Value and Distance < Closest and Cell ~= Feet and Cell ~= Feet + Vector3.yAxis * 3 and not Placed(Cell) and not Placed(Cell + Vector3.yAxis * 3) and Placed(Cell - Vector3.yAxis * 3) then
                            Spot, Closest = Cell, Distance
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            if not Spot then
                Cat:CreateNotification("Davey aim", "Nowhere to put a cannon.", 5)

                return nil
            end

            if Hold.Enabled then
                SlotController.Switch(Item.tool)
                SlotController.Select(Item.tool)
            end

            PlacementController.Place(Spot, "cannon")

            local Deadline: number = tick() + 1 + Ping.Get()
            repeat
                task.wait(0.05)

                for _, v: BasePart in Services.CollectionService:GetTagged("cannon") do
                    if (v.Position - Spot).Magnitude < 1.5 then
                        return v
                    end
                end
            until tick() > Deadline

            return nil
        end

        local function FindSpeed(Func: any, Depth: number?): number?
            local Success: boolean, Constants: any = pcall(debug.getconstants, Func)
            if not Success then
                return nil
            end

            local Speed: number?
            local Matched: boolean = false
            for _, v: any in Constants do
                if v == "LaunchSelfFromCannon" then
                    Matched = true
                elseif type(v) == "number" and v > 0 then
                    Speed = Speed or v
                end
            end

            if Matched and Speed then
                return Speed
            end

            local Found: boolean, Upvalues: any = pcall(debug.getupvalues, Func)
            if (Depth or 0) < 3 and Found then
                for _, v: any in Upvalues do
                    local Result: number? = type(v) == "function" and FindSpeed(v, (Depth or 0) + 1) or nil
                    if Result then
                        return Result
                    end
                end
            end

            return nil
        end

        local function Bisect(Delta: Vector3, Velocity: Vector3, Speed: number, Fast: number, Slow: number): number
            for _ = 1, 60 do
                local Middle: number = (Fast + Slow) / 2
                if Miss(Delta, Velocity, Middle) > Speed then
                    Fast = Middle
                else
                    Slow = Middle
                end
            end

            return (Fast + Slow) / 2
        end

        local function Clear(Origin: Vector3, Delta: Vector3, Time: number): boolean
            local Launch: Vector3 = Arc(Delta, Time)
            local Previous: Vector3 = Origin
            local Lower: Vector3 = Vector3.yAxis * math.max(Entity.Humanoid.HipHeight - 2, 0)
            local Steps: number = math.clamp(math.ceil(math.max(Time * 60, (Launch.Magnitude * Time + workspace.Gravity * Time * Time * 0.5) / 6)), 12, 240)

            for Step: number = 1, Steps do
                local Elapsed: number = Time * Step / Steps
                local Point: Vector3 = Origin + Launch * Elapsed - Vector3.yAxis * workspace.Gravity * Elapsed * Elapsed * 0.5
                local Hit: RaycastResult? = workspace:Spherecast(Previous, 2, Point - Previous, RayCheck) or workspace:Spherecast(Previous - Lower, 2, Point - Previous, RayCheck)

                if Hit and not (Step == Steps and Hit.Normal.Y > 0.7 and ((Hit.Position - Origin - Delta) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)).Magnitude <= 2.5) then
                    return false
                end

                Previous = Point
            end

            return true
        end

        local function LaunchTime(Origin: Vector3, Delta: Vector3, Velocity: Vector3, Speed: number): number?
            local Low: number, High: number = 0.0001, 20

            for _ = 1, 50 do
                local First: number, Second: number = Low + (High - Low) / 3, High - (High - Low) / 3
                if Miss(Delta, Velocity, First) < Miss(Delta, Velocity, Second) then
                    High = Second
                else
                    Low = First
                end
            end

            local Middle: number = (Low + High) / 2
            if Miss(Delta, Velocity, Middle) > Speed then
                return nil
            end

            local FastTime: number = Bisect(Delta, Velocity, Speed, 0.0001, Middle)
            local SlowTime: number = Bisect(Delta, Velocity, Speed, 20, Middle)
            local Candidates: {number} = {FastTime, SlowTime}
            for Step: number = 1, 14 do
                table.insert(Candidates, FastTime + (SlowTime - FastTime) * Step / 15)
            end

            if Retro.Enabled then
                for Step: number = -24, 24 do
                    local Span: number = Middle * (1 + Step * 0.05)
                    if Span > 0.05 and Miss(Delta, Velocity, Span) <= Speed then
                        table.insert(Candidates, Span)
                    end
                end
            end

            table.sort(Candidates, function(A: number, B: number): boolean
                local RiseA: number, RiseB: number = math.max(Arc(Delta, A).Y, 0), math.max(Arc(Delta, B).Y, 0)

                return RiseA ~= RiseB and RiseA < RiseB or RiseA == RiseB and A < B
            end)

            for _, v: number in Candidates do
                if (Entity.Humanoid.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air or Arc(Delta, v).Y > 0) and Clear(Origin, Delta, v) then
                    return v
                end
            end

            return nil
        end

        local function Mark(Hit: RaycastResult, Target: Vector3): any
            local Position: Vector3 = Data.Controllers.BlockController:getBlockPosition(Hit.Position - Hit.Normal * 1.5) * 3
            local Part: Part = Instance.new("Part")
            Part.Size = Vector3.new(3, 3, 3)
            Part.CFrame = CFrame.new(Position)
            Part.Anchored = true
            Part.CanCollide = false
            Part.CanQuery = false
            Part.CanTouch = false
            Part.CastShadow = false
            Part.Transparency = 1

            local Selection: SelectionBox = Instance.new("SelectionBox")
            Selection.Adornee = Part
            Selection.LineThickness = 0.04
            Selection.Color3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
            Selection.SurfaceColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
            Selection.SurfaceTransparency = 0.75
            Selection.Parent = Part

            local Billboard: BillboardGui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
            Billboard.Name = "Tag"
            Billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(124, 22)
            Billboard.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = (Target - Position) + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
            Billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
            Billboard.Parent = Part

            local Label: TextLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            Label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
            Label.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new()
            Label.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
            Label.BorderSizePixel = 0
            Label.TextSize = 14
            Label.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
            Label.Parent = Billboard

            Data.Controllers.GameQueryUtil:setQueryIgnored(Part, true)
            Part.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera

            return Part
        end

        local function Track(Cannon: any, Direction: Vector3, Speed: number, Time: number, Target: Vector3, Manual: boolean): ()
            local Root: BasePart = Entity.RootPart
            local Humanoid: Humanoid = Entity.Humanoid
            local Mine: {Root: BasePart} = {Root = Root}
            local Legacy: boolean = Retro.Enabled
            local AutoRotate: boolean = Humanoid.AutoRotate
            local Previous: any = Data.Controllers.CannonHandController.launchSelf
            local Velocity: Vector3 = Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
            local Origin: Vector3 = Root.Position
            local Heading: Vector3 = Arc(Target - Origin, Time)
            local Deadline: number = tick() + (Manual and 30 or 2) + Ping.Get()
            local Start: number = 0
            local Active: boolean = false
            local Cancelled: boolean = false
            local Launch: any
            local Hook: any
            local Shown: any = Visual

            local function Release(): ()
                if Data.Controllers.CannonHandController.launchSelf == Hook then
                    Data.Controllers.CannonHandController.launchSelf = Previous
                end
            end

            Hook = function(self: any, Block: any, ...: any): any
                if Block ~= Cannon or Cancelled then
                    return Previous(self, Block, ...)
                end

                Active = true
                Velocity = Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                Origin = Root.Position
                Heading = Arc(Target - Origin, Time)
                Flight = Mine
                Deadline = tick() + 2 + Ping.Get()

                local Call: any = Previous(self, Block, ...)
                Start = tick()
                Release()

                return Call
            end
            Data.Controllers.CannonHandController.launchSelf = Hook

            task.spawn(function()
                local Launched: boolean = false
                local Airborne: boolean = false
                local Elapsed: number = 0

                repeat
                    local Delta: number = Services.RunService.PreSimulation:Wait()
                    if Cancelled or not Entity.Alive or Entity.RootPart ~= Root or (Active and Flight ~= Mine) then
                        break
                    end

                    if Active and not Launched and (Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity - Velocity):Dot(Direction) > Speed * 0.5 then
                        Launched = true
                        Deadline = Start + Time + 3
                        Humanoid.AutoRotate = false
                        Humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall)
                        Root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero

                        local Needed: Vector3 = Arc(Target - Root.Position, Time)
                        if not Legacy and (Needed - Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity).Magnitude > 2 and Needed.Magnitude <= math.max(Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude, Speed) + 1 then
                            Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Needed
                        end
                    end

                    if Launched then
                        local Grounded: boolean = Humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air or (Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y <= 0 and workspace:Raycast(Root.Position, Vector3.yAxis * -(Humanoid.HipHeight + 0.05), RayCheck) ~= nil)
                        if not Grounded then
                            Airborne = true
                        elseif Airborne or tick() - Start > 0.2 then
                            break
                        end

                        Elapsed += Delta
                        if not Legacy and Elapsed >= Time then
                            break
                        elseif Legacy and Elapsed >= Time then
                            Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, 0)
                            if Elapsed >= Time + 0.5 then
                                break
                            end
                        elseif Legacy then
                            local Ideal: Vector3 = Origin + Heading * Elapsed - Vector3.yAxis * workspace.Gravity * Elapsed * Elapsed * 0.5
                            local Ceiling: number = math.sqrt(Speed * Speed + 2 * workspace.Gravity * math.max(Origin.Y - Root.Position.Y, 0))
                            local Corrected: Vector3 = Heading - Vector3.yAxis * workspace.Gravity * Elapsed + (Ideal - Root.Position) * 6
                            local Step: Vector3 = Corrected.Magnitude > Ceiling and Corrected.Unit * Ceiling or Corrected

                            if workspace:Spherecast(Root.Position, 2, Step * Delta, RayCheck) then
                                break
                            end

                            Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Step
                        end
                    end

                    if Shown then
                        Shown.Tag.TextLabel.Text = `Landing ({math.floor((Target - Root.Position).Magnitude)} studs)`
                    end
                until tick() > Deadline

                Release()

                if Flight == Mine then
                    Flight = nil
                end
                if Launched and Humanoid.Parent and not Humanoid.AutoRotate then
                    Humanoid.AutoRotate = AutoRotate
                end
                if Legacy and Launched and Entity.Alive and Entity.RootPart == Root then
                    Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, math.min(Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, 0), 0)
                end
                if Shown then
                    Shown:Destroy()
                end
            end)

            Stop = function()
                Cancelled = true
                Release()
            end
        end

        local function Aim(): boolean
            Visual = nil

            local Cannon: any
            local Cannons: {BasePart} = Services.CollectionService:GetTagged("cannon")
            local From: Vector3 = Entity.RootPart.Position

            table.sort(Cannons, function(A: BasePart, B: BasePart): boolean
                return (From - A.Position).Magnitude < (From - B.Position).Magnitude
            end)

            if Cannons[1] and (From - Cannons[1].Position).Magnitude <= Reach.Value then
                Cannon = Cannons[1]
            elseif Put.Enabled then
                Cannon = Place()
            else
                Cat:CreateNotification("Davey aim", "No cannon in range.", 5)
            end
            if not Cannon then
                return false
            end

            local Camera: Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
            local Mouse: Vector2 = Services.UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
            local Look: Ray = (Source.Value == "Camera" or Services.UserInputService.TouchEnabled) and Ray.new(Camera.CFrame.Position, Camera.CFrame.LookVector) or Camera:ViewportPointToRay(Mouse.X, Mouse.Y)
            local Hit: RaycastResult? = CastBlock(Look.Origin, Look.Direction * 10000, {Entity.Character, Camera, Cannon})
            if not Hit then
                Cat:CreateNotification("Davey aim", "No block found where you are aiming.", 5)

                return false
            end

            local Target: Vector3 = Hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, Entity.Humanoid.HipHeight, 0)
            local Velocity: Vector3 = Entity.RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity
            local Speed: number = FindSpeed(Data.Controllers.CannonHandController.launchSelf) or 200
            local Reachable: number = Speed * Speed / workspace.Gravity
            if (Target - From).Magnitude > Reachable then
                Cat:CreateNotification("Davey aim", `Too far away ({math.floor((Target - From).Magnitude)} studs away, {math.floor(Reachable)} max).`, 5)

                return false
            end

            local Time: number? = LaunchTime(From, Target - From, Velocity, Speed)
            if not Time then
                Cat:CreateNotification("Davey aim", "No clear cannon arc to that position.", 5)

                return false
            end

            local Landing: number = math.max(workspace.Gravity * Time - Arc(Target - From, Time).Y, 0)
            local Damage: number = math.max(Landing - 99, 0) * 0.884
            if Damage >= Entity.Humanoid.Health - 3 and not (Cat.Modules.NoFall and Cat.Modules.NoFall.Enabled) then
                Cat:CreateNotification("Davey aim", `That landing would deal about {math.floor(Damage)} damage ({math.floor(Landing)} studs/s down), pick a lower or closer spot.`, 5)

                return false
            end

            local Direction: Vector3 = (Arc(Target - From, Time) - Velocity).Unit
            if Show.Enabled then
                Visual = Mark(Hit, Target)
                Visual.Tag.TextLabel.Text = `Landing ({math.floor((Target - From).Magnitude)} studs)`
            end

            if Mode.Value == "Legit" then
                local Start: Vector3 = Camera.CFrame.LookVector
                local Duration: number = math.clamp(math.deg(math.acos(math.clamp(Start:Dot(Direction), -1, 1))) / 300, 0.15, 0.8)
                local Elapsed: number = 0
                local Alpha: number = 0

                repeat
                    Elapsed += Services.RunService.PostSimulation:Wait()
                    Alpha = math.clamp(Elapsed / Duration, 0, 1)

                    local Eased: number = Alpha < 0.5 and 2 * Alpha * Alpha or 1 - ((-2 * Alpha + 2) ^ 2) / 2
                    local Aimed: Vector3 = Start:Lerp(Direction, Eased)
                    if Aimed.Magnitude > 0.001 then
                        Camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Camera.CFrame.Position, Camera.CFrame.Position + Aimed.Unit)
                    end
                until Alpha >= 1 or not Entity.Alive

                if not Entity.Alive then
                    return false
                end

                Data.Controllers.CannonController:startAiming(Cannon)
                task.wait(Cannon.AimPrompt.HoldDuration)

                local Ready: number = tick() + 1
                repeat
                    Services.RunService.PostSimulation:Wait()
                until Cannon.StopAimingPrompt.Enabled or tick() > Ready or not Cannon.Parent

                Data.Controllers.CannonController:stopAiming()
            end

            task.wait(Cannon.StopAimingPrompt.HoldDuration + 0.2 + Ping.Get() + Services.RunService.PostSimulation:Wait())

            if Mode.Value == "Legit" then
                local Success: boolean, Aiming: any = pcall(function(): any
                    return Data.Controllers.CannonController:isAiming()
                end)
                if Success and Aiming then
                    pcall(function()
                        Data.Controllers.CannonController:stopAiming()
                    end)
                end
            end

            local Aimed: boolean = false
            local Deadline: number = tick() + 1
            repeat
                Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("AimCannon"):SendToServer({
                    cannonBlockPos = Data.Controllers.BlockController:getBlockPosition(Cannon.Position),
                    lookVector = Direction
                })
                task.wait(0.15)

                local Current: any = Cannon:GetAttribute("LookVector")
                Aimed = typeof(Current) == "Vector3" and (Current - Direction).Magnitude < 0.0001
            until Aimed or tick() > Deadline or not Cannon.Parent

            if not Aimed then
                Cat:CreateNotification("Davey aim", "Cannon refused the aim.", 5)

                return false
            end
            if not Entity.Alive or not Cannon.Parent then
                return false
            end

            if Auto.Enabled then
                Track(Cannon, Direction, Speed, Time, Target, false)
                Data.Controllers.CannonHandController:launchSelf(Cannon)

                return true
            end

            local Launched: boolean = false
            local Still: boolean = true
            local Connection: RBXScriptConnection = Cannon.LaunchSelfPrompt.Triggered:Connect(function(Player: Player)
                if Player == Services.LocalPlayer and Entity.Alive then
                    Launched = true
                end
            end)

            Track(Cannon, Direction, Speed, Time, Target, true)

            local Cancel: (() -> ())? = Stop
            local Limit: number = tick() + 30
            repeat
                Services.RunService.PostSimulation:Wait()

                local Current: any = Cannon.Parent and Cannon:GetAttribute("LookVector")
                Still = typeof(Current) ~= "Vector3" or (Current - Direction).Magnitude < 0.0001
            until Launched or not Still or tick() > Limit or not Entity.Alive or not Cannon.Parent

            Connection:Disconnect()
            if not Launched and Cancel then
                Cancel()

                if not Still then
                    Cat:CreateNotification("Davey aim", "Cannon was re-aimed before you launched.", 5)
                end
            end

            return Launched
        end

        AutoKit.Kits.davey = function()
            Pending = false
            Stop = nil
            Visual = nil
            Flight = nil

            local OldAim: any = Data.Controllers.CannonController.startAiming
            local OldLaunch: any = Data.Controllers.CannonHandController.launchSelf

            AutoKit:Clean(function()
                Data.Controllers.CannonController.startAiming = OldAim
                Data.Controllers.CannonHandController.launchSelf = OldLaunch
            end)
            AutoKit:Clean(function()
                if Stop then
                    Stop()
                end
                if Visual then
                    Visual:Destroy()
                end

                Stop = nil
                Visual = nil
                Flight = nil
                Pending = false
            end)

            Data.Controllers.CannonController.startAiming = function(self: any, Block: any, ...: any): any
                local Call: any = OldAim(self, Block, ...)

                if Impact.Enabled and Block and Block.Parent and Entity.Alive and CanBreak() and Break.Hits(Block, Block.Position) > 1 then
                    task.spawn(BreakCannon, Block, true)
                end

                return Call
            end

            Data.Controllers.CannonHandController.launchSelf = function(self: any, Block: any, ...: any): any
                local Breaking: boolean = Impact.Enabled and Block and Block.Parent and Entity.Alive and (Block.Position - Entity.RootPart.Position).Magnitude <= 30 and CanBreak()
                if Breaking then
                    pcall(BreakCannon, Block, true)
                end

                local Args: {any} = table.pack(self, Block, ...)
                local Done: boolean, Call: any = false, nil
                task.spawn(function()
                    local Success: boolean, Result: any = pcall(OldLaunch, table.unpack(Args, 1, Args.n))
                    Done, Call = true, Success and Result or nil
                end)
                if Breaking then
                    task.spawn(BreakCannon, Block)
                end
                if not Done then
                    repeat
                        task.wait()
                    until Done
                end

                if Jump.Enabled and Entity.Alive then
                    Entity.Humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
                end

                return Call
            end

            repeat
                if Pending then
                    Pending = false

                    if Entity.Alive and not Flight and not Aim() and Visual then
                        Visual:Destroy()
                        Visual = nil
                    end
                end

                task.wait(0.05)
            until not AutoKit.Enabled
        end

        Jump = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Jump on impact",
            Tooltip = "Jumps right after the cannon launches you"
        })
        Impact = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Break on impact",
            Default = true,
            Tooltip = "Breaks the cannon when it launches you"
        })
        Switch = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Legit switch",
            Tooltip = "Switches to the right tool like a normal player"
        })
        LimitItem = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Limit to items",
            Tooltip = "Only breaks when you hold a tool"
        })

        Trigger = AutoKit:CreateBind({
            Name = "Aim bind",
            Tooltip = "Aims a nearby cannon at your cursor and launches you onto it",
            Function = function(Down: boolean)
                if Down and AutoKit.Enabled and Data.Storage.EquippedKit == "davey" then
                    Pending = true
                end
            end
        })
        Mode = AutoKit:CreateDropdown({
            Name = "Aim mode",
            List = {"Blatant", "Legit"},
            Default = "Blatant",
            Tooltip = "Blatant snaps the cannon, legit turns your camera first"
        })
        Source = AutoKit:CreateDropdown({
            Name = "Position mode",
            List = {"Mouse", "Camera"},
            Default = "Mouse",
            Tooltip = "Where to aim from"
        })
        Reach = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Search range",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 18,
            Default = 10,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value <= 1 and "stud" or "studs"
            end
        })
        Put = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Place cannon",
            Default = true,
            Tooltip = "Puts a cannon down on the nearest free block when there is none in range"
        })
        Hold = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Auto switch",
            Default = true,
            Darker = true,
            Tooltip = "Holds the cannon before placing it"
        })
        Auto = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Launch cannon",
            Default = true,
            Tooltip = "Launches you normally, turn this off to aim and launch yourself"
        })
        Show = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Show target",
            Default = true,
            Tooltip = "Highlights the block you are landing on until you land"
        })
        Retro = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Old aim",
            Tooltip = "Uses the previous flight correction and stops horizontal movement at the landing point"
        })

        AutoKit.Settings.davey = {Jump, Impact, Switch, LimitItem, Trigger, Mode, Source, Reach, Put, Hold, Auto, Show, Retro}
    end
end)()

BundledModules.DragonSword = (function()
    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity

    return function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
        local AutoKit: Module = Section("DragonSword")
        local Range, Count

        AutoKit.Kits.dragon_sword = function()
            repeat
                if Entity.Alive and Data.Controllers.AbilityController:canUseAbility("dragon_sword_ult", {disableBlockedAbilityAlert = true}) then
                    local Origin: Vector3 = Entity.RootPart.Position
                    local Found: number = 0
                    for _, v: Target in Entity.Entities do
