                        if v.TargetCheck() and v.RootPart and (v.RootPart.Position - Origin).Magnitude <= Range.Value then
                            Found += 1
                        end
                    end

                    if Found >= Count.Value then
                        Data.Controllers.AbilityController:useAbility("dragon_sword_ult")
                    end
                end

                task.wait(0.1)
            until not AutoKit.Enabled
        end

        Range = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Range",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 60,
            Default = 25,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
            end
        })
        Count = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Enemy count",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 8,
            Default = 1,
            Tooltip = "Enemies in range before using the ultimate"
        })

        AutoKit.Settings.dragon_sword = {Range, Count}
    end
end)()

BundledModules.Drill = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity

    return function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
        local AutoKit: Module = Section("Drill", true)
        local Collect, Notify, Attack, Range, Legit, AttackDelay, CollectDelay, Sort

        local AttackDebounce: {[Model]: number} = {}
        local CollectDebounce: {[Model]: number} = {}
        local CurrentDrill: Model? = nil

        local function GetDrills(): {[Model]: BasePart}
            local Drills: {[Model]: BasePart} = {}
            local Candidates: {Model} = table.clone(Services.CollectionService:GetTagged("Drill"))

            if Data.Controllers.DrillTabletController and Data.Controllers.DrillTabletController.drillList then
                for _, v: Model in Data.Controllers.DrillTabletController.drillList do
                    table.insert(Candidates, v)
                end
            end

            for _, v: Model in Candidates do
                if typeof(v) == "Instance" and v:GetAttribute("PlacedByUserId") == Services.LocalPlayer.UserId then
                    local Part: BasePart? = v.PrimaryPart or v:FindFirstChild("RootPart") or v:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                    if Part then
                        Drills[v] = Part
                    end
                end
            end

            return Drills
        end

        AutoKit.Kits.drill = function()
            AutoKit:Clean(function()
                CurrentDrill = nil
                table.clear(AttackDebounce)
                table.clear(CollectDebounce)
            end)

            repeat
                if Entity.Alive then
                    local Now: number = tick()

                    for v: Model, Part: BasePart in GetDrills() do
                        if Collect.Enabled and ((v:GetAttribute("diamond") or 0) + (v:GetAttribute("emerald") or 0)) > 0 and Now > (CollectDebounce[v] or 0) then
                            Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("ExtractFromDrill"):SendToServer({drill = v})
                            CollectDebounce[v] = Now + CollectDelay.Value

                            if Notify.Enabled then
                                Cat:CreateNotification("Auto Drill", "Collected drill resources", 4)
                            end
                        end

                        if Attack.Enabled and Now > (AttackDebounce[v] or 0) then
                            local Target: Target? = Entity.Targets({
                                Origin = Part.Position,
                                Range = Legit.Enabled and 10 or Range.Value,
                                Players = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Players.Enabled,
                                NPCs = AutoKit.Options.Targets.NPCs.Enabled,
                                Invisible = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Invisible.Enabled,
                                Wallcheck = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Walls.Enabled,
                                Priority = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Priority.Value,
                                Sort = Sort.Value
                            })[1]

                            local Using: boolean = CurrentDrill == v
                            if Target and not Using and Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("PlayerUseDrillController"):CallServer({drill = v}) ~= false then
                                CurrentDrill = v
                                Using = true
                            end

                            if Target and Using then
                                Cat.TargetInfo.Targets[Target] = tick() + 1
                                Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("DrillAttack"):SendToServer({targetPosition = Target.RootPart.Position})
                                AttackDebounce[v] = Now + AttackDelay.Value
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end

BundledModules.Elder = (function()
    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity

    return function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
        local AutoKit: Module = Section("Elder")
        local Streamer, Animation, Range, Sync, Delay

        local Cooldowns: {[Instance]: number} = {}

        AutoKit.Kits.bigman = function()
            AutoKit:Clean(function()
                table.clear(Cooldowns)
            end)

            AutoKit:Clean(Services.ProximityPromptService.PromptShown:Connect(function(Prompt: ProximityPrompt)
                if Streamer.Enabled and Prompt.Name == "treeOrb" then
                    task.delay(0.1, Prompt.InputHoldBegin, Prompt)
                end
            end))

            repeat
                if not Streamer.Enabled and Entity.Alive then
                    local LocalPosition: Vector3 = Entity.RootPart.Position

                    for _, v: PVInstance in Services.CollectionService:GetTagged("treeOrb") do
                        local OrbPosition: Vector3? = v.Parent and v:GetPivot().Position
                        if OrbPosition and tick() > (Cooldowns[v] or 0) and (LocalPosition - OrbPosition).Magnitude <= Range.Value then
                            if Delay.Value > 0 then
                                task.wait(Delay.Value)
                            end

                            if v.Parent and Entity.Alive and (Entity.RootPart.Position - v:GetPivot().Position).Magnitude <= Range.Value then
                                if Animation.Enabled then
                                    Data.Controllers.GameAnimationUtil:playAnimation(Services.LocalPlayer.Character, Data.Instances.Animations.PUNCH)
                                    Data.Controllers.ViewmodelController:playAnimation(Data.Instances.Animations.FP_USE_ITEM)
                                    Data.Controllers.AudioManager:playAudio(Data.Instances.Sounds.CROP_HARVEST)
                                end

                                if Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("ConsumeTreeOrb"):CallServer({treeOrbSecret = v:GetAttribute("TreeOrbSecret")}) then
                                    v:Destroy()
                                end

                                Cooldowns[v] = tick() + 1
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end

                task.wait(0.1)
            until not AutoKit.Enabled
        end

        Streamer = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Streamer mode",
            Tooltip = "Useful for when ur screensharing, holds the prompt for you instead"
        })
        Animation = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Animation",
            Default = true,
            Tooltip = "Plays the collect animation",
            Darker = true
        })
        Range = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Range",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 20,
            Default = 12,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
            end,
            Darker = true
        })
        Sync = AutoKit:CreateButton({
            Name = "Sync to legit range",
            Function = function()
                local Legit: number = 10
                local Found: boolean = false

                for _, v: any in debug.getconstants(Data.Controllers.EldertreeController.createTreeOrbInteraction) do
                    if Found then
                        Legit = typeof(v) == "number" and v or Legit

                        break
                    end

                    Found = v == "maxActivationDistance"
                end

                Range:SetValue(Legit)
            end,
            Darker = true
        })
        Delay = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Delay",
            Min = 0,
            Max = 1,
            Default = 0.2,
            Decimal = 100,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value == 1 and "sec" or "secs"
            end,
            Darker = true
        })

        AutoKit.Settings.bigman = {Streamer, Animation, Range, Sync, Delay}
    end
end)()

BundledModules.Eldric = (function()
    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity
    local Ping = BundledModules.Ping

    return function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
        local AutoKit: Module = Section("Eldric", true)
        local Range, Sync, Priority, Allies, Health

        local Linked: Model? = nil

        local function GetHurtAlly(Origin: Vector3): Target?
            local Best: Target? = nil
            local BestRatio: number? = nil

            for _, v: Target in Entity.Entities do
                if v.Player and not v.Self and not v.TargetCheck() and v.Alive and v.RootPart and (v.RootPart.Position - Origin).Magnitude <= Range.Value then
                    local Ratio: number = v.Health / v.MaxHealth
                    if Ratio <= Health.Value / 100 and (not BestRatio or Ratio < BestRatio) then
                        Best = v
                        BestRatio = Ratio
                    end
                end
            end

            return Best
        end

        AutoKit.Kits.warlock = function()
            Linked = nil

            AutoKit:Clean(function()
                Linked = nil
            end)

            repeat
                if Entity.Alive and Data.Storage.Hand.Tool and Data.Storage.Hand.Tool.Name == "warlock_staff" then
                    local Origin: Vector3 = Entity.RootPart.Position
                    local Target: Target? = nil

                    if Priority.Value == "Teammates" and Allies.Enabled then
                        Target = GetHurtAlly(Origin)
                    end

                    if not Target then
                        Target = Entity.Targets({
                            Origin = Origin,
                            Range = Range.Value,
                            Players = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Players.Enabled,
                            NPCs = AutoKit.Options.Targets.NPCs.Enabled,
                            Invisible = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Invisible.Enabled,
                            Wallcheck = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Walls.Enabled,
                            Priority = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Priority.Value
                        })[1]
                    end

                    if not Target and Allies.Enabled then
                        Target = GetHurtAlly(Origin)
                    end

                    if Target and Target.Character ~= Linked then
                        if Data.Controllers.AbilityController:canUseAbility("WARLOCK_LINK", {disableBlockedAbilityAlert = true}) then
                            Data.Controllers.AbilityController:useAbility("WARLOCK_LINK")
                            task.wait(Ping.Get())
                        end

                        if AutoKit.Enabled and Target.Character and Target.Character.Parent then
                            Linked = Target.Character
                            Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("WarlockLinkTarget"):CallServer({target = Target.Character})
                        end
                    elseif not Target then
                        Linked = nil
                    end
                end

                task.wait(0.1)
            until not AutoKit.Enabled
        end

        Range = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Range",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 60,
            Default = 24,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
            end
        })
        Sync = AutoKit:CreateButton({
            Name = "Sync to legit range",
            Function = function(): ()
                Range:SetValue(Data.Instances.WarlockBalance and Data.Instances.WarlockBalance.SELECTOR_RANGE or 24)
            end
        })
        Priority = AutoKit:CreateDropdown({
            Name = "Priority",
            List = {"Enemies", "Teammates"},
            Tooltip = "Which side the staff links first when both are in range"
        })
        Allies = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Heal teammates",
            Default = true,
            Tooltip = "Links a hurt teammate when no enemy is in range"
        })
        Health = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Ally health",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 100,
            Default = 70,
            Darker = true,
            Suffix = function(): string
                return "%"
            end
        })

        AutoKit.Settings.warlock = {Range, Sync, Priority, Allies, Health}
    end
end)()

BundledModules.Farmer = (function()
    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity

    return function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
        local AutoKit: Module = Section("Farmer")
        local Harvest, Collect, Range, Delay, Sync

        local NextAction: number = 0

        local Drops: {[string]: boolean} = {
            carrot = true,
            carrot_seeds = true,
            melon = true,
            melon_seeds = true,
            watermelon = true,
            pumpkin = true,
            pumpkin_block = true,
            pumpkin_seeds = true
        }

        local function HarvestCrop(Origin: Vector3): boolean
            for _, v: Instance in Services.CollectionService:GetTagged("HarvestableCrop") do
                local Owner: number = v:GetAttribute("PlacedByUserId") or 0
                local Player: Player? = Owner ~= 0 and Services.Players:GetPlayerByUserId(Owner) or nil

                if v:IsA("BasePart") and (v.Position - Origin).Magnitude <= Range.Value and (not Player or Player:GetAttribute("Team") == Services.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Team")) then
                    Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("CropHarvest"):CallServer({
                        position = Data.Controllers.BlockController:getBlockPosition(v.Position)
                    })

                    return true
                end
            end

            return false
        end

        local function CollectDrop(Origin: Vector3): boolean
            for _, v: BasePart in Services.CollectionService:GetTagged("ItemDrop") do
                if Drops[v.Name] and (v:GetAttribute("PickupReadyTime") or math.huge) < workspace:GetServerTimeNow() and (v.Position - Origin).Magnitude <= Range.Value then
                    Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("PickupItemDrop"):CallServerAsync({itemDrop = v})

                    return true
                end
            end

            return false
        end

        AutoKit.Kits.farmer_cletus = function()
            NextAction = 0

            repeat
                if Entity.Alive and tick() >= NextAction then
                    local Origin: Vector3 = Entity.RootPart.Position

                    if (Harvest.Enabled and HarvestCrop(Origin)) or (Collect.Enabled and CollectDrop(Origin)) then
                        NextAction = tick() + Delay.Value
                    end
                end

                task.wait(0.1)
            until not AutoKit.Enabled
        end

        Harvest = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Harvest crops",
            Default = true,
            Tooltip = "Reaps anything ripe, the same call the harvest prompt makes"
        })
        Collect = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Collect drops",
            Default = true,
            Tooltip = "Picks up the crops and seeds lying on the ground"
        })
        Range = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Range",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 60,
            Default = 25,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
            end,
            Tooltip = "The games own harvest prompt stops at 6 studs, so the server may refuse anything much further out"
        })
        Sync = AutoKit:CreateButton({
            Name = "Sync to legit range",
            Function = function()
                Range:SetValue(6)
            end
        })
        Delay = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Delay",
            Min = 0.05,
            Max = 3,
            Default = 0.15,
            Decimal = 100,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value == 1 and "sec" or "secs"
            end
        })

        AutoKit.Settings.farmer_cletus = {Harvest, Collect, Range, Sync, Delay}
    end
end)()

BundledModules.GingerbreadMan = (function()
    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity
    local Inventory = BundledModules.Inventory
    local PlacementController = BundledModules.PlacementController
    local Break = BundledModules.Break
    local SlotController = BundledModules.SlotController

    return function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
        local AutoKit: Module = Section("GingerbreadMan")
        local Place, PlaceDelay, BreakPad, Jump, Switch, OwnOnly, SuccessfulOnly, Range, Delay

        local NextPlace: number = 0
        local Old: any

        AutoKit.Kits.gingerbread_man = function()
            NextPlace = 0

            AutoKit:Clean(Services.RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(): ()
                if Place.Enabled and Entity.Alive and tick() >= NextPlace and Inventory.Item("gumdrop_bounce_pad") then
                    local Raw: Vector3 = Entity.RootPart.Position - Vector3.new(0, Entity.Humanoid.HipHeight + 1.5, 0)
                    local Position: Vector3 = Vector3.new(math.round(Raw.X / 3) * 3, math.round(Raw.Y / 3) * 3, math.round(Raw.Z / 3) * 3)

                    if not Data.Controllers.BlockController:getStore():getBlockAt(Data.Controllers.BlockController:getBlockPosition(Position)) then
                        NextPlace = tick() + math.max(PlaceDelay.Value, 1 / Data.Storage.PlaceCPS)
                        PlacementController.Place(Position, "gumdrop_bounce_pad")
                    end
                end
            end))

            Old = Data.Controllers.LaunchPadController.attemptLaunch
            AutoKit:Clean(function(): ()
                Data.Controllers.LaunchPadController.attemptLaunch = Old
            end)

            Data.Controllers.LaunchPadController.attemptLaunch = function(self: any, Block: any, ...: any): any
                local LastLaunch: number = self and self.lastLaunch or 0
                local Call: any = Old(self, Block, ...)

                if not SuccessfulOnly.Enabled or (self and self.lastLaunch and self.lastLaunch ~= LastLaunch) then
                    if BreakPad.Enabled and Entity.Alive and Block and Block:IsA("BasePart") and (not OwnOnly.Enabled or Block:GetAttribute("PlacedByUserId") == Services.LocalPlayer.UserId) and (Block.Position - Entity.RootPart.Position).Magnitude <= Range.Value then
                        task.delay(Delay.Value, function(): ()
                            if AutoKit.Enabled and Block.Parent then
                                if Switch.Enabled then
                                    local BreakType: string? = Data.Instances.Items[Block.Name] and Data.Instances.Items[Block.Name].block and Data.Instances.Items[Block.Name].block.breakType
                                    local Tool: any = BreakType and Data.Storage.Tools[BreakType] or Data.Storage.Tools.Sword

                                    if Tool and not SlotController.Select(Tool.tool) then
                                        SlotController.Switch(Tool.tool)
                                    end
                                end

                                Break.Block(Block, false, nil, nil, Switch.Enabled)
                            end
                        end)
                    end

                    if Jump.Enabled and Entity.Alive then
                        Entity.Humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
                    end
                end

                return Call
            end
        end

        Place = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Place pads",
            Tooltip = "Drops a bounce pad into the cell below you whenever it is empty, so a jump lands you straight back onto one",
            Default = true
        })
        PlaceDelay = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Place delay",
            Min = 0,
            Max = 1,
            Default = 0,
            Decimal = 100,
            Darker = true,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value == 1 and "sec" or "secs"
            end
        })
        BreakPad = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Break launch pad",
            Tooltip = "Breaks the launch pad after it launches you",
            Default = true
        })
        Jump = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Jump after launch"
        })
        Switch = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Legit switch",
            Tooltip = "Switches to the right tool before breaking the pad",
            Darker = true
        })
        OwnOnly = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Own pads only",
            Default = true,
            Darker = true
        })
        SuccessfulOnly = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Successful launch only",
            Tooltip = "Only reacts when the pad actually launched you",
            Default = true
        })
        Range = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Range",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 30,
            Default = 30,
            Darker = true,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value <= 1 and "stud" or "studs"
            end
        })
        Delay = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Break delay",
            Min = 0,
            Max = 1,
            Default = 0.05,
            Decimal = 100,
            Darker = true,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value == 1 and "sec" or "secs"
            end
        })

        AutoKit.Settings.gingerbread_man = {Place, PlaceDelay, BreakPad, Jump, Switch, OwnOnly, SuccessfulOnly, Range, Delay}
    end
end)()

BundledModules.Hannah = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity

    return function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
        local AutoKit: Module = Section("Hannah", true)
        local Sort, Range, AuraTarget

        local Attempted: {[Model]: number} = {}

        AutoKit.Kits.hannah = function()
            AutoKit:Clean(function()
                table.clear(Attempted)
            end)

            repeat
                if Entity.Alive and not Data.Controllers.StatusEffectUtil:isActive(Entity.Character, "grounded") and not Data.Controllers.StatusEffectUtil:isActive(Entity.Character, "frosted") then
                    local Threshold: number = Data.Instances.BalanceFile.HANNAH_BASE_EXECUTE_THRESHOLD + Data.Instances.BalanceFile.HANNAH_MAX_COMBO * Data.Instances.BalanceFile.HANNAH_COMBO_EXECUTE_BOOST

                    for _, v: Target in Entity.Targets({
                        Origin = Entity.RootPart.Position,
                        Range = Range.Value,
                        Players = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Players.Enabled,
                        NPCs = AutoKit.Options.Targets.NPCs.Enabled,
                        Invisible = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Invisible.Enabled,
                        Wallcheck = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Walls.Enabled,
                        Priority = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Priority.Value,
                        Sort = Sort.Value
                    }) do
                        local Character: Model = v.Character :: Model
                        if Character:HasTag("HannahExecuteInteraction") and v.Health <= v.MaxHealth * Threshold and (not AuraTarget.Enabled or (Cat.TargetInfo.Targets[v] or 0) > tick()) and tick() - (Attempted[Character] or 0) >= 0.3 then
                            Attempted[Character] = tick()

                            if Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("HannahPromptTrigger"):CallServer({
                                user = Services.LocalPlayer,
                                victimEntity = Character
                            }) then
                                local Billboard: Instance? = Character:FindFirstChild("Hannah Execution Icon")
                                if Billboard then
                                    Billboard:Destroy()
                                end
                            end

                            break
                        end
                    end
                end

                task.wait(0.1)
            until not AutoKit.Enabled
        end

        local Methods: {string} = {"Health", "Distance"}
        for Index: string in Entity.Sorts do
            if not table.find(Methods, Index) then
                table.insert(Methods, Index)
            end
        end

        Sort = AutoKit:CreateDropdown({
            Name = "Target mode",
            List = Methods,
            Default = "Health"
        })
        Range = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Range",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 30,
            Default = 30,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
            end
        })
        AuraTarget = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Only killaura target",
            Tooltip = "Only executes targets that killaura is attacking"
        })

        AutoKit.Settings.hannah = {Sort, Range, AuraTarget}
    end
end)()

BundledModules.Hephaestus = function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
    local AutoKit: Module = Section("Hephaestus")
    local Summon

    local LastRepair: number = 0
    local LastSummon: number = 0

    AutoKit.Kits.tinker = function()
        repeat

                if tick() >= LastRepair and Data.Controllers.AbilityController:canUseAbility("tinker_self_repair", {disableBlockedAbilityAlert = true}) and (workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - Data.Controllers.SwordController.lastAttack) > 1 then
                    LastRepair = tick() + 0.5
                    Data.Controllers.AbilityController:useAbility("tinker_self_repair")

BundledModules.Jade = (function()
    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity
    local SlotController = BundledModules.SlotController

    return function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
        local AutoKit: Module = Section("Jade")
        local Height, FallSpeed, Switch, SwitchDelay, LimitItem

        local NextSlam: number = 0

        local function Slam(Hammer: any)
            if Data.Storage.Hand.Tool ~= Hammer.tool then
                if Switch.Enabled then
                    SlotController.Select(Hammer.tool)
                else
                    SlotController.Switch(Hammer.tool, 0)
                end

                task.wait(SwitchDelay.Value)
            end

            if AutoKit.Enabled and Entity.Alive and Data.Controllers.AbilityController:canUseAbility("jade_hammer_jump", {disableBlockedAbilityAlert = true}) then
                Data.Controllers.JadeHammerController:useJadeHammer()
            end
        end

        AutoKit.Kits.jade = function()
            local Air: RaycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
            Air.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
            Air.FilterDescendantsInstances = {Data.Storage.Map}

            NextSlam = 0

            AutoKit:Clean(Services.RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                if Entity.Alive and tick() >= NextSlam and Data.Controllers.JadeHammerController and Entity.RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y <= -FallSpeed.Value and Data.Controllers.AbilityController:canUseAbility("jade_hammer_jump", {disableBlockedAbilityAlert = true}) and workspace:Raycast(Entity.RootPart.Position, Vector3.new(0, -Height.Value, 0), Air) then
                    local Hammer: any = nil
                    local Held: any = Data.Storage.Inventory.inventory.hand

                    if Held and Data.Instances.JadeBalance.isJadeHammer(Held.itemType) then
                        Hammer = Held
                    elseif not LimitItem.Enabled then
                        for _, v: any in Data.Storage.Inventory.inventory.items do
                            if Data.Instances.JadeBalance.isJadeHammer(v.itemType) then
                                Hammer = v
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    if Hammer then
                        NextSlam = tick() + Data.Instances.JadeBalance.HAMMER_COOLDOWN
                        task.spawn(Slam, Hammer)
                    end
                end
            end))
        end

        Height = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Height",
            Min = 3,
            Max = 60,
            Default = 15,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
            end,
            Tooltip = "Slams once the ground is this close beneath you"
        })
        FallSpeed = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Fall speed",
            Min = 0,
            Max = 100,
            Default = 10,
            Tooltip = "Only slams once you are dropping this fast"
        })
        Switch = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Legit switch",
            Tooltip = "Takes the hammer out through the hotbar instead of silently"
        })
        SwitchDelay = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Switch delay",
            Min = 0,
            Max = 1,
            Decimal = 100,
            Default = 0.05,
            Darker = true,
            Suffix = "seconds"
        })
        LimitItem = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Limit to items",
            Tooltip = "Only slams if the hammer is already in your hand"
        })

        AutoKit.Settings.jade = {Height, FallSpeed, Switch, SwitchDelay, LimitItem}
    end
end)()

BundledModules.Kaida = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity
    local SlotController = BundledModules.SlotController

    return function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
        local AutoKit: Module = Section("Kaida", true)
        local Sort, SwingRange, AttackRange, Spell, SpellMode, SpellCharge, SpellRange, Swing, Limit, Mouse, GUI

        local Casting: number = 0

        local function GetClaw(): Tool?
            if Limit.Enabled then
                if Data.Storage.Hand.Tool and Data.Controllers.KaidaUtil.summoner_isItemClaw(Data.Storage.Hand.Tool.Name) then
                    return Data.Storage.Hand.Tool
                end

                return nil
            end

            for _, v: any in Data.Storage.Inventory.inventory.items do
                if Data.Controllers.KaidaUtil.summoner_isItemClaw(v.itemType) then
                    return v.tool
                end
            end

            return nil
        end

        local function CastSpell()
            local Camera: Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
            local LocalPosition: Vector3 = Entity.RootPart.Position
            local Range: number = math.min(SpellRange.Value, Data.Instances.SummonerKitBalance.SPELL_CAST_RANGE)
            local Position: Vector3?

            if SpellMode.Value == "Camera" then
                local Point: Vector3? = Data.Controllers.AbilityIndicatorUtil:calculateBlockTargetPoint(Camera.CFrame.Position, Camera.CFrame.LookVector, 300, nil, {allowArenaBarrierTarget = false})
                Position = Point and (Point - LocalPosition).Magnitude <= Range and Point or nil
            else
                local Ent: Target? = Entity.Targets({
                    Origin = LocalPosition,
                    Range = Range,
                    Players = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Players.Enabled,
                    NPCs = AutoKit.Options.Targets.NPCs.Enabled,
                    Invisible = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Invisible.Enabled,
                    Wallcheck = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Walls.Enabled,
                    Priority = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Priority.Value,
                    Sort = Sort.Value
                })[1]

                if Ent then
                    local Point: Vector3? = Data.Controllers.AbilityIndicatorUtil:calculateBlockTargetPoint(Ent.RootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), Vector3.new(0, -1, 0), 30, nil, {allowArenaBarrierTarget = false})
                    Position = Point and (Point - LocalPosition).Magnitude <= Range and Point or Ent.RootPart.Position
                end
            end

            if Position and Data.Controllers.AbilityController:canUseAbility("summoner_start_charging", {disableBlockedAbilityAlert = true}) then
                Casting = tick() + 6
                Data.Controllers.AbilityController:useAbility("summoner_start_charging", nil, {targetPosition = Position})

                local Level: number = Data.Controllers.KaidaUtil.summoner_getPlayerSpellLevel(Services.LocalPlayer) or 1
                local Charge: number = math.max(Data.Controllers.KaidaUtil.summoner_getTotalCastTimeRequired(Level) * (SpellCharge.Value / 100), Data.Instances.SummonerKitBalance.SPELL_MINIMUM_CAST_TIME)
                local Deadline: number = tick() + Charge

                repeat
                    task.wait()
                until tick() >= Deadline or not AutoKit.Enabled or not Entity.Alive or not Data.Controllers.SummonerKitController:isPlayerCastingSpell(Services.LocalPlayer)

                if AutoKit.Enabled and Entity.Alive and Data.Controllers.SummonerKitController:isPlayerCastingSpell(Services.LocalPlayer) then
                    Data.Controllers.AbilityController:useAbility("summoner_finish_charging")
                end

                Casting = 0
            end
        end

        AutoKit.Kits.summoner = function()
            AutoKit:Clean(function()
                Casting = 0
            end)

            repeat
                if Entity.Alive then
                    if Spell.Enabled and tick() > Casting and not Data.Controllers.SummonerKitController:isPlayerCastingSpell(Services.LocalPlayer) then
                        task.spawn(CastSpell)
                    end

                    local Claw: Tool? = nil
                    if (not Mouse.Enabled or Services.UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)) and (not GUI.Enabled or not Data.Controllers.AppController:isLayerOpen(Data.Instances.Layers.MAIN)) then
                        Claw = GetClaw()
                    end

                    local Ent: Target? = nil
                    if Claw and (workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - Data.Controllers.SummonerClawHandController.lastAttackTime) > Data.Instances.SummonerKitBalance.CLAW_COOLDOWN and (Swing.Enabled or not Data.Controllers.SummonerKitController:isPlayerCastingSpell(Services.LocalPlayer)) then
                        Ent = Entity.Targets({
                            Origin = Entity.RootPart.Position,
                            Range = SwingRange.Value,
                            Players = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Players.Enabled,
                            NPCs = AutoKit.Options.Targets.NPCs.Enabled,
                            Invisible = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Invisible.Enabled,
                            Wallcheck = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Walls.Enabled,
                            Priority = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Priority.Value,
                            Sort = Sort.Value
                        })[1]
                    end

                    if Ent and Claw then
                        local SelfPosition: Vector3 = Entity.RootPart.Position
                        local Delta: Vector3 = Ent.RootPart.Position - SelfPosition
                        local Direction: Vector3 = CFrame.lookAt(SelfPosition, Ent.RootPart.Position).LookVector

                        Cat.TargetInfo.Targets[Ent] = tick() + 1
                        SlotController.Switch(Claw, 0)

                        if Delta.Magnitude <= AttackRange.Value then
                            Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("SummonerClawAttackRequest"):SendToServer({
                                position = SelfPosition + Direction * math.max(Delta.Magnitude - 16.399, 0),
                                direction = Direction,
                                clientTime = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
                            })
                        end

                        Data.Controllers.SummonerClawHandController.lastAttackTime = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
                        Data.Controllers.SummonerClawController:clawAttack(Services.LocalPlayer, SelfPosition, Direction, Claw.Name)
                    end
                end

                task.wait(0.1)
            until not AutoKit.Enabled
        end

        local Methods: {string} = {"Distance", "Damage"}
        for Index: string in Entity.Sorts do
            if not table.find(Methods, Index) then
                table.insert(Methods, Index)
            end
        end

        Sort = AutoKit:CreateDropdown({
            Name = "Target mode",
            List = Methods
        })
        SwingRange = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Swing range",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 32,
            Default = 32,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
            end
        })
        AttackRange = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Attack range",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 32,
            Default = 32,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
            end
        })
        Spell = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Auto summon",
            Tooltip = "Charges and drops the summon circle on its own"
        })
        SpellMode = AutoKit:CreateDropdown({
            Name = "Summon at",
            List = {"Target", "Camera"},
            Darker = true,
            Tooltip = "Target drops the circle on the closest enemy, Camera drops it where you are looking"
        })
        SpellCharge = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Charge",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 100,
            Default = 100,
            Darker = true,
            Suffix = "%",
            Tooltip = "How far to charge before releasing, 100% is the full radius for your spell level"
        })
        SpellRange = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Summon range",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 120,
            Default = math.floor(Data.Instances.SummonerKitBalance.SPELL_CAST_RANGE),
            Darker = true,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
            end,
            Tooltip = "Capped at the range the game allows, which KitExtender can raise"
        })
        Swing = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Swing during ability",
            Default = true,
            Tooltip = "Continue claw attacks while the ability is charging"
        })
        Limit = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Limit to items",
            Tooltip = "Only attacks while the claw is held"
        })
        Mouse = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Require mouse down"
        })
        GUI = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "GUI check"
        })

        AutoKit.Settings.summoner = {Sort, SwingRange, AttackRange, Spell, SpellMode, SpellCharge, SpellRange, Swing, Limit, Mouse, GUI}
    end
end)()

BundledModules.Kaliyah = (function()
    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity

    return function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
        local AutoKit: Module = Section("Kaliyah")
        local Range, Stacks, Delay, NoSlow, Sync

        local Modifier: any, Old: any = nil, nil
        local NoSlowUntil: number = 0

        local function Punch()
            if NoSlow.Enabled then
                if not Old then
                    Modifier = Data.Controllers.SprintController:getMovementStatusModifier()
                    Old = Modifier.addModifier
                    Modifier.addModifier = function(self: any, Info: any): any
                        if NoSlow.Enabled and tick() < NoSlowUntil and Info and Info.moveSpeedMultiplier == 0 then
                            Info.moveSpeedMultiplier = 1
                        end

                        return Old(self, Info)
                    end
                end

                NoSlowUntil = math.max(NoSlowUntil, tick() + Delay.Value + 0.1)
            end

            task.wait(Delay.Value)
            Data.Controllers.AbilityController:useAbility("dragon_slayer_punch")
        end

        AutoKit.Kits.dragon_slayer = function()
            AutoKit:Clean(function()
                if Old then
                    Modifier.addModifier = Old
                end

                Modifier, Old = nil, nil
                NoSlowUntil = 0
            end)

            repeat
                if Entity.Alive and Data.Controllers.AbilityController:canUseAbility("dragon_slayer_punch", {disableBlockedAbilityAlert = true}) then
                    local LocalPosition: Vector3 = Entity.RootPart.Position

                    for Target: Model, Emblem: any in Data.Controllers.DragonSlayerController.dragonEmblems do
                        if Emblem.stackCount >= Stacks.Value and Target.PrimaryPart and (Target.PrimaryPart.Position - LocalPosition).Magnitude <= Range.Value then
                            Punch()

                            break
                        end
                    end
                end

                task.wait(0.1)
            until not AutoKit.Enabled
        end

        NoSlow = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "No slow",
            Default = true,
            Tooltip = "Stops you from being slowed down after punching"
        })
        Range = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Range",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 20,
            Default = 18,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
            end
        })
        Sync = AutoKit:CreateButton({
            Name = "Sync to legit range",
            Function = function()
                local Found: boolean = false
                local Legit: number = 14.4

                for _, v: any in debug.getconstants(Data.Controllers.DragonSlayerController.hasEligiblePunchTarget) do
                    if v == "maxActivationDistance" then
                        Found = true
                    elseif Found then
                        Legit = type(v) == "number" and v or Legit

                        break
                    end
                end

                Range:SetValue(Legit)
            end

BundledModules.Lani = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    return function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
        local AutoKit: Module = Section("Lani")
        local Delay, UseEnemy, Enemy, Player

        local Friends: {string} = {"None"}
        local Enemies: {string} = {"None"}

        local function AddConnection(TargetPlayer: Player, Connected: boolean?)
            local Friendly: boolean = TargetPlayer:GetAttribute("Team") == Services.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Team")

            if not Connected then
                Cat:Clean(TargetPlayer:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Team"):Connect(function()
                    AddConnection(TargetPlayer, true)
                end))
            end

            if Friendly and not table.find(Friends, TargetPlayer.Name) then
                table.insert(Friends, TargetPlayer.Name)
                Player:Change(Friends)
            elseif not Friendly and TargetPlayer.Team and TargetPlayer.Team.Name ~= "Spectators" and not table.find(Enemies, TargetPlayer.Name) then
                table.insert(Enemies, TargetPlayer.Name)
                Enemy:Change(Enemies)
            end
        end

        AutoKit.Kits.paladin = function()
            local Request: any = Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("PaladinAbilityRequest")
            local OldStart: any

            repeat
                local Start: any = Services.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("PaladinStartTime")
                if OldStart and OldStart ~= Start then
                    local Target: Player? = Services.Players:FindFirstChild(UseEnemy.Enabled and Enemy.Value or Player.Value) :: Player?
                    if Target then
                        task.delay(Delay.Value, function()
                            Request:SendToServer({target = Target})
                        end)
                    end
                end

                OldStart = Start
                task.wait(0.1)
            until not AutoKit.Enabled
        end

        Player = AutoKit:CreateDropdown({
            Name = "Selected player",
            List = {},
            Tooltip = "Player to use the ability on"
        })
        Enemy = AutoKit:CreateDropdown({
            Name = "Selected enemy",
            List = {},
            Darker = true,
            Tooltip = "Enemy to use the ability on"
        })
        UseEnemy = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Use enemy",
            Tooltip = "Uses the ability on the selected enemy instead of your teammate"
        })
        Delay = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Delay",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 20,
            Default = 5,
            Decimal = 10,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value <= 1 and "sec" or "secs"
            end,
            Tooltip = "How long to wait before using the ability"
        })

        for _, v: Player in Services.Players:GetPlayers() do
            AddConnection(v)
        end
        Cat:Clean(Services.Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(AddConnection))

        AutoKit.Settings.paladin = {Player, Enemy, UseEnemy, Delay}
    end
end)()

BundledModules.Lasso = (function()
    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity
    local Inventory = BundledModules.Inventory
    local SlotController = BundledModules.SlotController
    local Ballistic = BundledModules.Ballistic
    local Ping = BundledModules.Ping

    return function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
        local AutoKit: Module = Section("Lasso", true)
        local Range, FireRate, SwitchDelay

        local NextFire: number = 0

        local Arc: RaycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
        Arc.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

        local Air: RaycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
        Air.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

        local function Watch(Id: string, Origin: Vector3, Velocity: Vector3, Gravity: number, Target: Target, Lifetime: number)
            local Character: Model = Target.Character :: Model
            local Overlap: OverlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
            Overlap.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
            Overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances = {Character}

            local Steps: number = math.clamp(math.ceil(Velocity.Magnitude / 170), 1, 16)
            local Started: number = os.clock()
            local Last: Vector3 = Origin
            local Watcher: RBXScriptConnection
            Watcher = Services.RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                local Elapsed: number = os.clock() - Started
                if Elapsed > Lifetime or not Character.Parent then
                    Watcher:Disconnect()
                else
                    local Position: Vector3 = Origin + Velocity * Elapsed - Vector3.new(0, 0.5 * Gravity * Elapsed * Elapsed, 0)
                    Air.FilterDescendantsInstances = {Data.Storage.Map}

                    for Step: number = 1, Steps do
                        if Watcher.Connected and #workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(Last:Lerp(Position, Step / Steps)), Vector3.new(3, 1, 3), Overlap) > 0 then
                            Watcher:Disconnect()
                            Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("ProjectileHit"):SendToServer(Id, Character)
                        end
                    end

                    if Watcher.Connected and workspace:Raycast(Last, Position - Last, Air) then
                        Watcher:Disconnect()
                    end

                    Last = Position
                end
            end)
        end

        local function Fire(Item: InventoryItem, Target: Target): boolean
            local Meta: any = Data.Instances.ProjectileMeta.lasso
            local Source: any = Data.Instances.Items.lasso.projectileSource
            local Origin: Vector3 = Entity.RootPart.Position
            local Gravity: number = Meta.gravitationalAcceleration or 196.2
            local Speed: number = Meta.launchVelocity
            local First: Vector3? = Ballistic.Solve(Target, Origin, Speed, Gravity, true)
            if not First then
                return false
            end

            local ShootPosition: Vector3 = (CFrame.lookAlong(Origin, First) * CFrame.new(Vector3.new(-Data.Instances.BowConstants.RelX, -Data.Instances.BowConstants.RelY, -Data.Instances.BowConstants.RelZ))).Position
            local Direction: Vector3?, Time: number = Ballistic.Solve(Target, ShootPosition, Speed, Gravity, true)
            Direction = Direction or First
            local Velocity: Vector3 = Direction * Speed
            local Id: string = Data.Controllers.IdUtil.generateId(8)
            Arc.FilterDescendantsInstances = {Entity.Character, workspace.CurrentCamera, Target.Character}
            if not Ballistic.Clear(ShootPosition, Velocity, Gravity, Time, Arc) then
                return false
            end

            Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("ProjectileFire"):CallServerAsync(
                Item.tool,
                "lasso",
                Source.projectileType("lasso"),
                ShootPosition,
                Origin,
                Velocity,
                Id,
                {
                    shotId = Data.Controllers.IdUtil.generateId(8),
                    drawDurationSec = math.max(1, Source.maxStrengthChargeSec or 0)
                },
                workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - 0.045
            ):andThen(function(Result: any)
                if type(Result) == "table" and Result.accepted and Result.model then
                    Result.model.Parent = Services.ReplicatedStorage
                end
            end)
            Watch(Id, ShootPosition, Velocity, Gravity, Target, Meta.lifetimeSec or 2)

            return true
        end

        local function Throw(Item: InventoryItem)
            local Source: any = Data.Instances.Items.lasso.projectileSource
            local Facing: Vector3 = Entity.RootPart.CFrame.LookVector * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
            local Target: Target? = nil

            for _, v: Target in Entity.Targets({
                Origin = Entity.RootPart.Position,
                Range = Range.Value,
                Players = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Players.Enabled,
                NPCs = AutoKit.Options.Targets.NPCs.Enabled,
                Invisible = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Invisible.Enabled,
                Wallcheck = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Walls.Enabled,
                Priority = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Priority.Value
            }) do
                local Delta: Vector3 = (v.RootPart.Position - Entity.RootPart.Position) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
                if Facing.Magnitude == 0 or Delta.Magnitude == 0 or math.acos(math.clamp(Facing.Unit:Dot(Delta.Unit), -1, 1)) <= math.rad(60) then
                    Target = v

                    break
                end
            end

            if Target then
                NextFire = tick() + 0.5
                local Previous: Tool? = Data.Storage.Hand.Tool

                if not SlotController.Select(Item.tool) then
                    SlotController.Switch(Item.tool, 0)
                end

                task.wait(math.max(Services.LocalPlayer:GetNetworkPing() * 2, Ping.Get() or 0, 0.05))
                if AutoKit.Enabled and Entity.Alive and Target.RootPart.Parent and Data.Storage.Hand.Tool == Item.tool and Fire(Item, Target) then
                    NextFire = tick() + Source.fireDelaySec + FireRate:GetRandomValue()
                    task.wait(SwitchDelay.Value)
                end

                if Previous and Previous.Parent and (not Data.Storage.Hand.Tool or Data.Storage.Hand.Tool == Item.tool) and not SlotController.Select(Previous) then
                    SlotController.Switch(Previous, 0)
                end
            end
        end

        AutoKit.Kits.cowgirl = function()
            NextFire = 0

            repeat
                local Meleeing: boolean = tick() - Data.Controllers.SwordController.lastSwing < 0.3 or Data.Storage.Attacking or workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - Data.Controllers.SwordController.lastAttack < 0.3
                if Entity.Alive and (Data.Storage.Hand.Type == "sword" or Data.Storage.Hand.Tool and Data.Storage.Hand.Tool.Name == "lasso") and Meleeing and tick() >= NextFire then
                    local Lasso: InventoryItem? = Inventory.Item("lasso")
                    if Lasso then
                        Throw(Lasso)
                    end
                end

                task.wait(0.1)
            until not AutoKit.Enabled
        end

        Range = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Range",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 60,
            Default = 22,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
            end,
            Tooltip = "How far away someone can be for you to throw the lasso"
        })
        FireRate = AutoKit:CreateTwoSlider({
            Name = "Fire rate",
            Min = 0,
            Max = 1,
            DefaultMin = 0.05,
            DefaultMax = 0.12,
            Decimal = 100,
            Tooltip = "Extra random wait between lasso throws"
        })
        SwitchDelay = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Switch delay",
            Min = 0,
            Max = 1,
            Default = 0.02,
            Decimal = 100,
            Suffix = "seconds",
            Tooltip = "How long to wait after throwing before switching back"
        })

        AutoKit.Settings.cowgirl = {Range, FireRate, SwitchDelay}
    end
end)()

BundledModules.Lumen = (function()
    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity

    return function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
        local AutoKit: Module = Section("Lumen", true)
        local Range, FullCharge, Delay

        local Balance: {MIN_CHARGE_TIME: number, MAX_CHARGE_TIME: number} = Data.Instances.LumenBalance or {MIN_CHARGE_TIME = 0.65, MAX_CHARGE_TIME = 1.25}
        local Sword: string = "light_sword"
        local Cooldown: number = 0

        local function Swing()
            if Data.Controllers.SwordChargeController:getChargeState() == Data.Instances.ChargeState.Idle then
                Data.Controllers.SwordChargeController:startCharging(Sword)
                local Started: number = Data.Controllers.SwordChargeController:getChargeStartTime()

                if Started ~= 0 then
                    local Charged: any = Data.Instances.Items[Sword] and Data.Instances.Items[Sword].sword and Data.Instances.Items[Sword].sword.chargedAttack
                    local Min: number = Charged and Charged.minChargeTimeSec or Balance.MIN_CHARGE_TIME
                    local Max: number = Charged and Charged.maxChargeTimeSec or Balance.MAX_CHARGE_TIME
                    local Goal: number = (FullCharge.Enabled and Max or Min) + 0.05

                    repeat
                        task.wait()
                    until not AutoKit.Enabled or not Entity.Alive or tick() - Started >= Goal

                    local ChargeTime: number = tick() - Started
                    Data.Controllers.SwordChargeController:stopCharging(Sword)

                    local Tool: Tool? = Data.Storage.Hand.Tool
                    if AutoKit.Enabled and Entity.Alive and Tool and Tool.Name == Sword then
                        if not (Charged and Charged.skipSwingDamage and ChargeTime > Min) then
                            Data.Controllers.SwordController:swingSwordAtMouse(ChargeTime)
                        end

                        Data.Instances.SyncEvents.SwordChargedSwing:fire(Services.LocalPlayer, Tool, {chargeTime = ChargeTime})
                        Cooldown = tick() + Delay.Value
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        AutoKit.Kits.lumen = function()
            Cooldown = 0

            repeat
                if Entity.Alive and Data.Storage.Hand.Tool and Data.Storage.Hand.Tool.Name == Sword and tick() >= Cooldown then
                    local Target: Target? = Entity.Targets({
                        Origin = Entity.RootPart.Position,
                        Range = Range.Value,
                        Players = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Players.Enabled,
                        NPCs = AutoKit.Options.Targets.NPCs.Enabled,
                        Invisible = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Invisible.Enabled,
                        Wallcheck = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Walls.Enabled,
                        Priority = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Priority.Value,
                        Sort = "Mouse",
                        FOV = Range.Value
                    })[1]

                    if Target then
                        Swing()
                    end
                end

                task.wait(0.1)
            until not AutoKit.Enabled
        end

        Range = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Range",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 120,
            Default = 60,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
            end
        })
        FullCharge = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Full charge",
            Default = true,
            Tooltip = "Holds the swing until it is fully charged, an upgraded lumen only fires the multi beam at full charge"
        })
        Delay = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Delay",
            Min = 0,
            Max = 2,
            Default = 0.1,
            Decimal = 100,
            Suffix = "seconds"
        })

        AutoKit.Settings.lumen = {Range, FullCharge, Delay}
    end
end)()

BundledModules.Melody = (function()
    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity
    local Inventory = BundledModules.Inventory
    local SlotController = BundledModules.SlotController

    return function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
        local AutoKit: Module = Section("Melody")
        local SelfHeal, TeammateHeal, Range, UseHotbar, SwitchBack

        local NextHeal: number = 0

        AutoKit.Kits.melody = function()
            NextHeal = 0

            AutoKit:Clean(function()
                Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("StopPlayingGuitar"):SendToServer()
            end)

            repeat
                local Health: number = math.huge
                local Character: Model? = nil

                if Entity.Alive and tick() >= NextHeal then
                    if SelfHeal.Enabled and Entity.Health < Entity.MaxHealth then
                        Health = Entity.Health
                        Character = Entity.Character
                    end

                    if TeammateHeal.Enabled then
                        for _, v: Target in Entity.Entities do
                            if not v.Self and v.Player and v.Player:GetAttribute("Team") == Services.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Team") and v.Health > 0 and v.Health < v.MaxHealth and v.Health < Health and (Entity.RootPart.Position - v.RootPart.Position).Magnitude <= Range.Value then
                                Health = v.Health
                                Character = v.Character
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end

                local Guitar: any = Character and Inventory.Item("guitar")
                if Guitar then
                    local PreviousSlot: number? = Data.Storage.Inventory.hotbarSlot
                    local PreviousTool: Tool? = Data.Storage.Hand.Tool

                    if UseHotbar.Enabled then
                        SlotController.Select(Guitar.tool)
                    end

                    NextHeal = tick() + Data.Instances.MelodyKitBalance.HEAL_COOLDOWN
                    Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("PlayGuitar"):SendToServer({
                        healTarget = Character
                    })

                    if UseHotbar.Enabled and SwitchBack.Enabled then
                        if PreviousSlot and PreviousSlot ~= Data.Storage.Inventory.hotbarSlot then
                            Data.Controllers.Store:dispatch({type = "InventorySelectHotbarSlot", slot = PreviousSlot})
                        elseif PreviousTool then
                            SlotController.Switch(PreviousTool)
                        end
                    end
                end

                task.wait(0.1)
            until not AutoKit.Enabled
        end

        SelfHeal = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Self heal",
            Default = true
        })
        TeammateHeal = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Teammate heal",
            Default = true
        })
        Range = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Range",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 51,
            Default = 51,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
            end,
            Tooltip = "The guitar reaches 51 studs, which is what this defaults to"
        })
        UseHotbar = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Use hotbar",
            Tooltip = "Visibly swaps onto the guitar slot before healing instead of playing it silently"
        })
        SwitchBack = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Switch back",
            Default = true,
            Darker = true,
            Tooltip = "Returns to whatever you were holding after the heal"
        })

        AutoKit.Settings.melody = {SelfHeal, TeammateHeal, Range, UseHotbar, SwitchBack}
    end
end)()

BundledModules.Metal = (function()
    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity

    return function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
        local AutoKit: Module = Section("Metal")
        local Limit, Streamer, Animation, Range, Sync, Delay

        local Legit: number = 0
        local Found: boolean = false
        for _, v: any in debug.getconstants(Data.Controllers.HiddenMetalController.onKitLocalActivated) do
            if Found then
                Legit = typeof(v) == "number" and v or 0
                break
            end

            Found = v == "maxActivationDistance"
        end

        local Cooldowns: {[Instance]: number} = {}

        AutoKit.Kits.metal_detector = function()
            AutoKit:Clean(function()
                table.clear(Cooldowns)
            end)

            AutoKit:Clean(Services.ProximityPromptService.PromptShown:Connect(function(Prompt: ProximityPrompt): ()
                if Streamer.Enabled and Prompt.Name == "hidden-metal-prompt" and (not Limit.Enabled or Data.Storage.Hand.Tool and Data.Storage.Hand.Tool.Name == "metal_detector") then
                    task.wait(0.1)
                    Prompt:InputHoldBegin()
                end
            end))

            repeat
                if not Streamer.Enabled and Entity.Alive then
                    local Position: Vector3 = Entity.RootPart.Position

                    for _, v: any in Services.CollectionService:GetTagged("hidden-metal") do
                        if tick() > (Cooldowns[v] or 0) and (Position - v.Part.Position).Magnitude <= Range.Value and (not Limit.Enabled or Data.Storage.Hand.Tool and Data.Storage.Hand.Tool.Name == "metal_detector") then
                            if Delay.Value > 0 then
                                task.wait(Delay.Value)
                            end

                            if Entity.Alive and (Entity.RootPart.Position - v.Part.Position).Magnitude <= Range.Value then
                                if Animation.Enabled then
                                    Data.Controllers.GameAnimationUtil:playAnimation(Services.LocalPlayer.Character, Data.Instances.Animations.SHOVEL_DIG)
                                    Data.Controllers.AudioManager:playAudio(Data.Instances.Sounds.SNAP_TRAP_CONSUME_MARK)
                                end

                                Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("CollectCollectableEntity"):SendToServer({
                                    id = v:GetAttribute("Id")
                                })
                                Cooldowns[v] = tick() + 1
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end

                task.wait(0.1)
            until not AutoKit.Enabled
        end

        Limit = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Limit to item",
            Tooltip = "Only collects when you are holding the metal detector"
        })
        Streamer = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Streamer mode",
            Tooltip = "Actually does the metal prompt thing for you"
        })
        Animation = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Animation",
            Default = true,
            Tooltip = "Plays the metal collect animation"
        })
        Range = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Range",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 20,
            Default = Legit,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
            end
        })
        Sync = AutoKit:CreateButton({
            Name = "Sync to legit range",
            Function = function(): ()
                Range:SetValue(Legit)
            end
        })
        Delay = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Delay",
            Min = 0,
            Max = 1,
            Default = 0.2,
            Decimal = 5,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value == 1 and "sec" or "secs"
            end
        })

        AutoKit.Settings.metal_detector = {Limit, Streamer, Animation, Range, Sync, Delay}
    end
end)()

BundledModules.Mimic = (function()
    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity

    return function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
        local AutoKit: Module = Section("Mimic", true)
        local Range, Sync, Hidden

        local Legit: number = 25
        if typeof(Data.Controllers.MimicController.onKitLocalActivated) == "function" then
            local Found: boolean = false
            for _, v: any in debug.getconstants(Data.Controllers.MimicController.onKitLocalActivated) do
                if v == "maxActivationDistance" then
                    Found = true
                elseif Found then
                    if typeof(v) == "number" then
                        Legit = v
                    end

                    break
                end
            end
        end

        local Attempted: {[Model]: number} = {}
        local Ready: boolean = false
        local RandomGenerator: Random = Random.new()

        AutoKit.Kits.mimic = function()
            Ready = false

            AutoKit:Clean(Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("MimicBlockPickPocketReady"):Connect(function(Event: any)
                if Event.player == Services.LocalPlayer then
                    Ready = Event.ready and true or false
                end
            end))
            AutoKit:Clean(function()
                table.clear(Attempted)
            end)

            repeat
                if Entity.Alive then
                    local Position: Vector3 = Entity.RootPart.Position
                    local Nearby: {Target} = Entity.Targets({
                        Origin = Position,
                        Range = Range.Value,
                        Players = true,
                        Wallcheck = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Walls.Enabled,
                        Sort = "Distance"
                    })

                    for _, v: Target in Nearby do
                        local Character: Model = v.Character :: Model
                        if not Ready then
                            break
                        end

                        if Character:HasTag("MimicBLockPickPocketPlayer") and tick() - (Attempted[Character] or 0) >= 0.5 then
                            Attempted[Character] = tick()
                            Ready = false

                            if Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("MimicBlockPickPocketPlayer"):CallServer(v.Player) then
                                local Sound: string = `MIMIC_PICKPOCKET_{RandomGenerator:NextInteger(1, 3)}`

                                Data.Controllers.AudioManager:playAudio(Data.Instances.Sounds[Sound], {
                                    playbackSpeedMultiplier = 1.27,
                                    position = Position
                                })
                            end

                            break
                        end
                    end

                    if #Nearby <= 0 and Hidden.Enabled and Data.Controllers.AbilityController:canUseAbility("MIMIC_BLOCK_HIDDEN", {disableBlockedAbilityAlert = true}) then
                        Data.Controllers.AbilityController:useAbility("MIMIC_BLOCK_HIDDEN")
                    end
                end

                task.wait(0.1)
            until not AutoKit.Enabled
        end

        Range = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Range",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 30,
            Default = Legit,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value <= 1 and "stud" or "studs"
            end
        })
        Sync = AutoKit:CreateButton({
            Name = "Sync to legit range",
            Function = function(): ()
                Range:SetValue(Legit)
            end
        })
        Hidden = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Hide when clear",
            Tooltip = "Goes back into the block once nobody is in range"
        })

        AutoKit.Settings.mimic = {Range, Sync, Hidden}
    end
end)()

BundledModules.Noelle = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity

    return function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
        local AutoKit: Module = Section("Noelle")
        local Notify, Limit, Frosty, Heal, Sticky, Void

        local Friends: {string} = {"None"}
        local Dropdowns: {[string]: any} = {}

        local function GetSlimes(): {{Info: any, Name: string}}
            local Slimes: {{Info: any, Name: string}} = {}
            local Folder: Instance? = workspace:FindFirstChild("SlimeModelFolder")

            for _, v: Instance in Folder and Folder:GetChildren() or {} do
                local Value: any = v:FindFirstChild("SlimeData")
                local Info: any = Value and Value.Value

                if Info and Info.Tamer.Value == Services.LocalPlayer.UserId then
                    table.insert(Slimes, {
                        Info = Info,
                        Name = v.Name:gsub(`_{Services.LocalPlayer.Name}`, ""):gsub("Slime", " Slime")
                    })
                end
            end

            return Slimes
        end

        local function Track(Player: Player, Connected: boolean?): ()
            if not Connected then
                Cat:Clean(Player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Team"):Connect(function(): ()
                    Track(Player, true)
                end))
            end

            local Name: string = `{Player.DisplayName} ({Player.Name})`
            if Player:GetAttribute("Team") == Services.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Team") and not table.find(Friends, Name) then
                table.insert(Friends, Name)

                for _, v: any in Dropdowns do
                    v:Change(Friends)
                end
            end
        end

        AutoKit.Kits.slime_tamer = function()
            repeat
                if Entity.Alive and (not Limit.Enabled or Data.Storage.Hand.Tool and Data.Storage.Hand.Tool.Name == "slime_tamer_flute") then
                    for _, v: {Info: any, Name: string} in GetSlimes() do
                        local Dropdown: any = Dropdowns[v.Name]
                        local Target: Player? = nil

                        for _, Other: Player in Services.Players:GetPlayers() do
                            if Dropdown and `{Other.DisplayName} ({Other.Name})` == Dropdown.Value then
                                Target = Other
                                break
                            end
                        end

                        if Target and v.Info.Following.Value ~= Target.UserId then
                            local Chosen: Player = Target

                            Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("RequestMoveSlime"):CallServerAsync({
                                slimeId = v.Info:GetAttribute("Id"),
                                targetPlayerUserId = Chosen.UserId
                            }):andThen(function(Success: boolean): ()
                                if Success then
                                    v.Info.Following.Value = Chosen.UserId

                                    if Notify.Enabled then
                                        Cat:CreateNotification("Noelle", `Directed {v.Name} to {Chosen.DisplayName} ({Chosen.Name})`, 5)
                                    end
                                end
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                end

                task.wait(0.5)
            until not AutoKit.Enabled
        end

        Notify = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Notify on direct"
        })
        Limit = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Limit to item"
        })
        Frosty = AutoKit:CreateDropdown({
            Name = "Frosty slime target",
            List = {},
            Tooltip = "Player to send frosty slimes to"
        })
        Heal = AutoKit:CreateDropdown({
            Name = "Heal slime target",
            List = {},
            Tooltip = "Player to send heal slimes to"
        })
        Sticky = AutoKit:CreateDropdown({
            Name = "Sticky slime target",
            List = {},
            Tooltip = "Player to send sticky slimes to"
        })
        Void = AutoKit:CreateDropdown({
            Name = "Void slime target",
            List = {},
            Tooltip = "Player to send void slimes to"
        })

        Dropdowns["Frosty Slime"] = Frosty
        Dropdowns["Heal Slime"] = Heal
        Dropdowns["Sticky Slime"] = Sticky
        Dropdowns["Void Slime"] = Void

        for _, v: Player in Services.Players:GetPlayers() do
            Track(v)
        end

        Cat:Clean(Services.Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(Track))

        AutoKit.Settings.slime_tamer = {Notify, Limit, Frosty, Heal, Sticky, Void}
    end
end)()
