                            if Currency and Currency.amount >= NextUpgrade.price then
                                Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("UpgradeFlamethrower"):CallServer(Upgrade)
                                task.wait(Delay.Value)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end

                task.wait(0.1)
            until not AutoKit.Enabled
        end

        Delay = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Delay",
            Min = 0,
            Max = 2,
            Default = 0.1,
            Decimal = 100,
            Suffix = "seconds",
            Tooltip = "Wait between each upgrade it buys"
        })

        local Settings: {any} = {Delay}
        for _, v: string in Upgrades do
            Buys[v] = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
                Name = `Pyro buy {v:lower()}`,
                Default = true
            })
            table.insert(Settings, Buys[v])
        end

        AutoKit.Settings.pyro = Settings
    end
end)()

BundledModules.Raven = (function()
    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity
    local Inventory = BundledModules.Inventory

    return function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
        local AutoKit: Module = Section("Raven")
        local Button

        local function Teleport(): ()
            local Target: Target? = Entity.Targets({
                Range = 1000,
                Players = true,
                Sort = "Mouse"
            })[1]

            if Entity.Alive and Inventory.Item("raven") and Target then
                Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("SpawnRaven"):CallServerAsync():andThen(function(Projectile: Model?): ()
                    if Projectile and Projectile.PrimaryPart then
                        local BodyForce: BodyForce = Instance.new("BodyForce")
                        BodyForce.Force = Vector3.new(0, Projectile.PrimaryPart.AssemblyMass * workspace.Gravity, 0)
                        BodyForce.Parent = Projectile.PrimaryPart

                        task.spawn(function()
                            for _ = 1, 20 do
                                if Target.RootPart and Projectile.PrimaryPart then
                                    local Look: Vector3 = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector

                                    Projectile:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(CFrame.lookAlong(Target.RootPart.Position, Look))
                                end

                                task.wait(0.05)
                            end
                        end)

                        task.wait(0.3)
                        Data.Controllers.RavenController:detonateRaven()
                    end
                end)
            end
        end

        AutoKit.Kits.raven = function()
            repeat
                task.wait(0.5)
            until not AutoKit.Enabled
        end

        Button = AutoKit:CreateButton({
            Name = "Teleport",
            Tooltip = "Spawns a raven and teleports it to the player nearest your mouse",
            Function = function(): ()
                if AutoKit.Enabled and Data.Storage.EquippedKit == "raven" then
                    Teleport()
                end
            end
        })

        AutoKit.Settings.raven = {Button}
    end
end)()

BundledModules.Sigrid = (function()
    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity

    return function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
        local AutoKit: Module = Section("Sigrid", true)
        local Combat, Charge, Range, ChargeRange

        AutoKit.Kits.elk_master = function()
            local NextSummon: number = 0
            local NextCharge: number = 0

            repeat
                if Entity.Alive then
                    if tick() >= NextSummon and Data.Controllers.AbilityController:canUseAbility("elk_summon", {disableBlockedAbilityAlert = true}) then
                        local Wanted: boolean = not Combat.Enabled

                        if not Wanted then
                            Wanted = #Entity.Targets({
                                Origin = Entity.RootPart.Position,
                                Range = Range.Value,
                                Players = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Players.Enabled,
                                NPCs = AutoKit.Options.Targets.NPCs.Enabled,
                                Invisible = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Invisible.Enabled,
                                Priority = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Priority.Value
                            }) > 0
                        end

                        if Wanted then
                            NextSummon = tick() + 1
                            Data.Controllers.AbilityController:useAbility("elk_summon")
                        end
                    end

                    if Charge.Enabled and Entity.Character:FindFirstChild("elk") and tick() >= NextCharge and Data.Controllers.AbilityController:canUseAbility("elk_antler_uppercut", {disableBlockedAbilityAlert = true}) then
                        local Target: Target? = Entity.Targets({
                            Origin = Entity.RootPart.Position,

                            Priority = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Priority.Value

                        if Target then

                            local Flat: Vector3 = (Target.RootPart.Position - Root.Position) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)

                            if Flat.Magnitude > 0.001 then

            Min = 1,

            Darker = true,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value <= 1 and "stud" or "studs"
            end

BundledModules.Silas = (function()
    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity

    return function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
        local AutoKit: Module = Section("Silas")
        local Range, SwapAura, PressAttack

        AutoKit.Kits.rebellion_leader = function()
            Aura = ""

            Data.Controllers.ClientScript:WaitFor("UpdateRebellionAura"):andThen(function(Connection: any)
                AutoKit:Clean(Connection:Connect(function(Update: {player: Player, newAura: string})
                    if Update.player == Services.LocalPlayer then
                        Aura = Update.newAura
                    end
                end))
            end)

            repeat
                if Entity.Alive then

                    local Enemy: Target? = Entity.Targets({
                        Origin = Origin,
                        Range = Range.Value,

                        Data.Controllers.AbilityController:useAbility("rebellion_shield")
                    end

                    if SwapAura.Enabled then
                        local Wanted: string? = Enemy and "damage" or nil
                        if not Wanted then
                            for _, v: Target in Entity.Entities do
                                if v.Player and v.Player:GetAttribute("Team") == Services.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Team") and v.Health < v.MaxHealth and (v.RootPart.Position - Origin).Magnitude <= Range.Value then
                                    Wanted = "healing"
                                    break
                                end
                            end
                        end

                        if Wanted and Aura ~= "" and Aura ~= Wanted and Data.Controllers.AbilityController:canUseAbility("rebellion_aura_swap", {disableBlockedAbilityAlert = true}) then
                            Data.Controllers.AbilityController:useAbility("rebellion_aura_swap")
                        end
                    end
                end

                task.wait(0.1)
            until not AutoKit.Enabled
        end

        Range = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Range",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 60,

                return Value <= 1 and "stud" or "studs"
            end
        })
        SwapAura = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Swap aura",
            Default = true,
            Tooltip = "Uses the damage aura near enemies and the healing aura near hurt allies"
        })
        PressAttack = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Press the attack",
            Default = true,
            Tooltip = "Uses the shield ability when an enemy gets close"
        })

        AutoKit.Settings.rebellion_leader = {Range, SwapAura, PressAttack}
    end
end)()

BundledModules.Skoll = (function()
    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity

    return function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
        local AutoKit: Module = Section("Skoll", true)
        local Sort, Range, Aim, Detonate, DetonateMode, Health

        local Marked: {[Instance]: number} = {}
        local Old: any

        local function GetTarget(Origin: Vector3): Target?
            return Entity.Targets({
                Origin = Origin,
                Range = Range.Value,
                Players = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Players.Enabled,
                NPCs = AutoKit.Options.Targets.NPCs.Enabled,
                Invisible = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Invisible.Enabled,
                Wallcheck = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Walls.Enabled,
                Priority = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Priority.Value,
                Sort = Sort.Value
            })[1]
        end

        local function ShouldDetonate(): boolean
            if not Detonate.Enabled then
                return false
            end

            local TargetHealth: number?
            local Expiry: number = 0
            for Target: Instance, v: number in Marked do
                if Target.Parent and tick() < v then
                    local Humanoid: Humanoid? = Target:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
                    if Humanoid and Humanoid.MaxHealth > 0 then
                        TargetHealth = (Humanoid.Health + math.max(Target:GetAttribute("TotalShield") or 0, 0)) / Humanoid.MaxHealth * 100
                        Expiry = v
                        break
                    end
                end
            end

            if DetonateMode.Value == "Instantly" then
                return true
            elseif not TargetHealth then
                return false
            elseif DetonateMode.Value == "Low health" then
                return TargetHealth <= Health.Value
            end

            return tick() >= Expiry - 1
        end

        AutoKit.Kits.void_hunter = function()
            AutoKit:Clean(function()
                table.clear(Marked)
                if Old then
                    Data.Controllers.VoidHunterKitController.onAbilityUsed = Old
                    Old = nil
                end
            end)

            Old = Data.Controllers.VoidHunterKitController.onAbilityUsed
            Data.Controllers.VoidHunterKitController.onAbilityUsed = function(self: any, Character: Model, Info: any, ...: any)
                if Aim.Enabled and Info and Info.ability == "void_hunter_mark" and Character == Services.LocalPlayer.Character and Character.PrimaryPart then
                    local Origin: Vector3 = Character.PrimaryPart.Position
                    local Target: Target? = GetTarget(Origin)
                    if Target then
                        local Delta: Vector3 = (Target.RootPart :: BasePart).Position - Origin
                        if Delta.Magnitude > 0 then
                            Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("VoidHunter_MarkAbilityRequest"):SendToServer({
                                originPosition = Origin,
                                direction = Delta.Unit
                            })

                            return
                        end
                    end
                end

                return Old(self, Character, Info, ...)
            end

            AutoKit:Clean(Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("VoidHunter_TargetMarked"):Connect(function(Info: any)
                if Info.userPlayer == Services.LocalPlayer and Info.targetEntityInstance then
                    Marked[Info.targetEntityInstance] = tick() + Data.Instances.VoidHunterBalance.MARK_DURATION
                end
            end))

            AutoKit:Clean(Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("VoidHunter_TargetMarkRemoved"):Connect(function(Info: any)
                if Info.userPlayer == Services.LocalPlayer and Info.targetEntityInstance then
                    Marked[Info.targetEntityInstance] = nil
                end
            end))

            repeat
                if Entity.Alive then
                    if ShouldDetonate() and Data.Controllers.AbilityController:canUseAbility("void_hunter_detonate", {disableBlockedAbilityAlert = true}) then
                        Data.Controllers.AbilityController:useAbility("void_hunter_detonate")
                        table.clear(Marked)
                    elseif GetTarget(Entity.RootPart.Position) and Data.Controllers.AbilityController:canUseAbility("void_hunter_mark", {disableBlockedAbilityAlert = true}) then
                        Data.Controllers.AbilityController:useAbility("void_hunter_mark")
                    end
                end

                task.wait(0.1)
            until not AutoKit.Enabled
        end

        local Methods: {string} = {"Distance", "Health"}
        for Index: string in Entity.Sorts do
            if not table.find(Methods, Index) then
                table.insert(Methods, Index)
            end
        end

        Sort = AutoKit:CreateDropdown({
            Name = "Target mode",
            List = Methods
        })
        Range = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Range",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 100,
            Default = 50,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value <= 1 and "stud" or "studs"
            end,
            Tooltip = "Fenrir travels 39 studs a second and lives 3 seconds"
        })
        Aim = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Aim wolf",
            Default = true,
            Tooltip = "Throws Fenrir straight at your target instead of wherever your camera points"
        })
        Detonate = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Auto detonate",
            Default = true,
            Tooltip = "Sets the mark off, which costs you the damage buff on them"
        })
        DetonateMode = AutoKit:CreateDropdown({
            Name = "Detonate at",
            List = {"Low health", "Instantly", "Before it expires"},
            Darker = true,
            Tooltip = "Low health finishes them off, Before it expires keeps the buff until the mark runs out"
        })
        Health = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Health",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 100,
            Default = 30,
            Darker = true,
            Suffix = "%",
            Tooltip = "Blows the mark for 20 damage once they drop under this"
        })

        AutoKit.Settings.void_hunter = {Sort, Range, Aim, Detonate, DetonateMode, Health}
    end
end)()

BundledModules.Sophia = (function()
    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity
    local Inventory = BundledModules.Inventory
    local SlotController = BundledModules.SlotController
    local Ballistic = BundledModules.Ballistic
    local Ping = BundledModules.Ping

    return function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
        local AutoKit: Module = Section("Sophia", true)
        local Range, FireRate, SwitchDelay

        local NextFire: number = 0
        local NextSwap: number = 0

        local Staffs: {string} = {"frost_staff_3", "frost_staff_2", "frost_staff_1"}

        local Arc: RaycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
        Arc.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

        local function Facing(): Target?
            local Look: Vector3 = Entity.RootPart.CFrame.LookVector * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)

            for _, v: Target in Entity.Targets({
                Origin = Entity.RootPart.Position,
                Range = Range.Value,
                Players = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Players.Enabled,
                NPCs = AutoKit.Options.Targets.NPCs.Enabled,
                Invisible = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Invisible.Enabled,
                Wallcheck = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Walls.Enabled,
                Priority = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Priority.Value
            }) do
                local Delta: Vector3 = (v.RootPart.Position - Entity.RootPart.Position) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
                if Look.Magnitude == 0 or Delta.Magnitude == 0 or math.acos(math.clamp(Look.Unit:Dot(Delta.Unit), -1, 1)) <= math.rad(60) then
                    return v
                end
            end

            return nil
        end

        local function Fire(Item: InventoryItem, Source: any, Target: Target): boolean
            local Kind: string = Source.projectileType(Item.itemType)
            local Meta: any = Data.Instances.ProjectileMeta[Kind]
            if Meta then
                local Origin: Vector3 = Entity.RootPart.Position
                local Gravity: number = Meta.gravitationalAcceleration or 196.2
                local Rough: Vector3? = Ballistic.Solve(Target, Origin, Meta.launchVelocity, Gravity, true)

                if Rough then
                    local ShootPosition: Vector3 = (CFrame.new(Origin, Origin + Rough) * CFrame.new(Vector3.new(-Data.Instances.BowConstants.RelX, -Data.Instances.BowConstants.RelY, -Data.Instances.BowConstants.RelZ))).Position
                    local Direction: Vector3?, Time: number = Ballistic.Solve(Target, ShootPosition, Meta.launchVelocity, Gravity, true)
                    Arc.FilterDescendantsInstances = {Services.LocalPlayer.Character, workspace.CurrentCamera, Target.Character}

                    if Direction and Ballistic.Clear(ShootPosition, Direction * Meta.launchVelocity, Gravity, Time, Arc) then
                        Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("ProjectileFire"):CallServerAsync(
                            Item.tool,
                            Item.itemType,
                            Kind,
                            ShootPosition,
                            Origin,
                            Direction * Meta.launchVelocity,
                            Data.Controllers.IdUtil.generateId(8),
                            {
                                shotId = Data.Controllers.IdUtil.generateId(8),
                                drawDurationSec = math.max(1, Source.maxStrengthChargeSec or 0)
                            },
                            workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - 0.045
                        ):andThen(function(Result: any)
                            if type(Result) == "table" and Result.accepted and Result.model then
                                Result.model.Parent = Services.ReplicatedStorage
                            end
                        end)

                        return true
                    end
                end
            end

            return false
        end

        local function Shoot()
            local Item: InventoryItem? = nil
            for _, v: string in Staffs do
                Item = Inventory.Item(v)
                if Item then
                    break
                end
            end

            local Source: any = Item and Data.Instances.Items[Item.itemType].projectileSource
            local Target: Target? = Source and Facing()

            if Item and Item.tool and Source and Target then
                local Ready: boolean = Data.Controllers.FrostyGunController.projectileMode == Data.Instances.FrostyGunMode.PROJECTILE
                local Swapping: boolean = not Ready and tick() >= NextSwap and Data.Controllers.AbilityController:canUseAbility("frosty_gun_swap", {disableBlockedAbilityAlert = true})

                if Ready or Swapping then
                    local Previous: Tool? = Data.Storage.Hand.Tool

                    if SlotController.Select(Item.tool) or Data.Storage.Hand.Tool == Item.tool then
                        task.wait(Ping.Get())

                        if Ready then
                            if Fire(Item, Source, Target) then
                                NextFire = tick() + Source.fireDelaySec + FireRate:GetRandomValue()
                                task.wait(SwitchDelay.Value)
                            end
                        else
                            NextSwap = tick() + 1
                            Data.Controllers.AbilityController:useAbility("frosty_gun_swap")
                            task.wait(SwitchDelay.Value)
                        end

                        if Previous then
                            SlotController.Select(Previous)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        AutoKit.Kits.winter_lady = function()
            NextFire, NextSwap = 0, 0

            repeat
                if Entity.Alive and Data.Storage.Hand.Type == "sword" and tick() - Data.Controllers.SwordController.lastSwing < 0.2 and tick() >= NextFire then
                    Shoot()
                end

                task.wait(0.1)
            until not AutoKit.Enabled
        end

        Range = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Range",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 60,
            Default = 22,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
            end
        })
        FireRate = AutoKit:CreateTwoSlider({
            Name = "Fire rate",
            Min = 0,
            Max = 1,
            DefaultMin = 0.05,
            DefaultMax = 0.12,
            Decimal = 100,
            Tooltip = "Extra random wait between staff shots"
        })
        SwitchDelay = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Switch delay",
            Min = 0,
            Max = 1,
            Decimal = 100,
            Suffix = "seconds",
            Default = 0.02,
            Tooltip = "How long it holds the staff before swapping back"
        })

        AutoKit.Settings.winter_lady = {Range, FireRate, SwitchDelay}
    end
end)()

BundledModules.StarCollector = (function()
    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity

    return function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
        local AutoKit: Module = Section("StarCollector")
        local Streamer, Animation, Range, Delay

        local Cooldowns: {[Instance]: number} = {}

        AutoKit.Kits.star_collector = function()
            AutoKit:Clean(function()
                table.clear(Cooldowns)
            end)

            AutoKit:Clean(Services.ProximityPromptService.PromptShown:Connect(function(Prompt: ProximityPrompt): ()
                if Streamer.Enabled and Prompt.Name == "stars_ProximityPrompt" then
                    task.wait(0.1)
                    Prompt:InputHoldBegin()
                end
            end))

            repeat
                if not Streamer.Enabled and Entity.Alive then
                    local LocalPosition: Vector3 = Entity.RootPart.Position

                    for _, v: Model in Services.CollectionService:GetTagged("stars") do
                        if tick() > (Cooldowns[v] or 0) and v.PrimaryPart and (LocalPosition - v.PrimaryPart.Position).Magnitude <= Range.Value then
                            if Delay.Value > 0 then
                                task.wait(Delay.Value)
                            end

                            if v.PrimaryPart and (LocalPosition - v.PrimaryPart.Position).Magnitude <= Range.Value then
                                if Animation.Enabled then
                                    Data.Controllers.GameAnimationUtil:playAnimation(Services.LocalPlayer.Character, Data.Instances.Animations.PUNCH)
                                    Data.Controllers.ViewmodelController:playAnimation(Data.Instances.Animations.FP_USE_ITEM)
                                end

                                Data.Controllers.StarCollectorController:collectEntity(Services.LocalPlayer, v, v.Name)
                                Cooldowns[v] = tick() + 1
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end

                task.wait(0.1)
            until not AutoKit.Enabled
        end

        Streamer = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Streamer mode",
            Tooltip = "Presses the star prompts for you instead, useful when you are screensharing"
        })
        Animation = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Animation",
            Default = true,
            Darker = true,
            Tooltip = "Plays the collect animation"
        })
        Range = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Range",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 20,
            Default = 12,
            Darker = true,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
            end
        })
        Delay = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Delay",
            Min = 0,
            Max = 1,
            Default = 0.2,
            Decimal = 100,
            Darker = true,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value == 1 and "sec" or "secs"
            end
        })

        AutoKit.Settings.star_collector = {Streamer, Animation, Range, Delay}
    end
end)()

BundledModules.Styx = (function()
    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity

    return function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
        local AutoKit: Module = Section("Styx")
        local Reach: number = 10
        local Attempted: {[any]: number} = {}
        local Warned: number = 0

        AutoKit.Kits.styx = function()
            AutoKit:Clean(function(): ()
                table.clear(Attempted)
            end)

            repeat
                local Success: boolean, Error: any = pcall(function(): ()
                    if Entity.Alive then
                        local LocalPosition: Vector3 = Entity.RootPart.Position

                        for _, v: any in Data.Controllers.StyxKitController.exitPortals do
                            local Prompt: any = v.proximityPrompt
                            if Prompt and Prompt.ActionText == "Connect" and (v.worldPosition - LocalPosition).Magnitude <= Reach and tick() - (Attempted[v] or 0) >= 1 then
                                Attempted[v] = tick()
                                Data.Controllers.StyxKitController:tryOpenExitPortal(v)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)

                if not Success and tick() - Warned > 5 then
                    Warned = tick()
                    warn(`[catvape] Styx: {Error}`)
                end

                task.wait(0.1)
            until not AutoKit.Enabled
        end

        AutoKit.Settings.styx = {}
    end
end)()

BundledModules.Taliyah = (function()
    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity

    return function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
        local AutoKit: Module = Section("Taliyah")
        local Iron, Emerald, Diamond, Amount

        AutoKit.Kits.taliyah = function()
            local Item: any = nil
            local NextSell: number = 0

            repeat
                Item = Item or Data.Controllers.BedwarsShop.getShopItem("chicken_shop_item", Services.LocalPlayer)

                if Item and NextSell < os.clock() and Entity.Alive then
                    local ShopId: string? = nil

                    for _, v: Instance in Services.CollectionService:GetTagged("BedwarsItemShop") do
                        if ShopId == nil and (v.Position - Entity.RootPart.Position).Magnitude <= 20 then
                            ShopId = v.Name
                        end
                    end

                    if ShopId then
                        local Chicken: any = Data.Controllers.TaliyahUtil:getPrice()

                        if (Chicken.currency == "emerald" and Emerald.Enabled or Chicken.currency == "iron" and Iron.Enabled or Chicken.currency == "diamond" and Diamond.Enabled) and Chicken.price >= Amount.Value then
                            NextSell = os.clock() + 0.5

                            Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("BedwarsPurchaseItem"):CallServerAsync({
                                itemType = Item.itemType,
                                shopId = ShopId
                            }):andThen(function(Success: boolean)
                                if Success then
                                    Data.Controllers.AudioManager:playAudio(Data.Instances.Sounds.BEDWARS_PURCHASE_ITEM)
                                    Data.Controllers.Store:dispatch({
                                        type = "BedwarsAddItemPurchased",
                                        itemType = Item.itemType
                                    })

                                    if Item.tiered then
                                        Data.Controllers.BedwarsShopController.alreadyPurchasedMap[Item.itemType] = true
                                    end
                                end
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                end

                task.wait(0.1)
            until not AutoKit.Enabled
        end

        Iron = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Iron",
            Default = true,
            Tooltip = "Sells your chicken when the currency is iron"
        })
        Emerald = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Emerald",
            Default = true,
            Tooltip = "Sells your chicken when the currency is emerald"
        })
        Diamond = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Diamond",
            Default = true,
            Tooltip = "Sells your chicken when the currency is diamond"
        })
        Amount = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Amount",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 1000,
            Default = 2,
            Tooltip = "Only sells if the currency is selling for the selected amount"
        })

        AutoKit.Settings.taliyah = {Iron, Emerald, Diamond, Amount}
    end
end)()

BundledModules.Terra = (function()
    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity
    local Ballistic = BundledModules.Ballistic

    return function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
        local AutoKit: Module = Section("Terra", true)
        local Distance

        local Old: ((...any) -> ...any)?

        AutoKit.Kits.block_kicker = function()
            Old = Data.Controllers.BlockKickerKitController.getKickBlockProjectileOriginPosition
            Data.Controllers.BlockKickerKitController.getKickBlockProjectileOriginPosition = function(self: any, Origin: Vector3, Direction: Vector3, ...: any): ...any
                local Target: Target? = Entity.Targets({
                    Origin = Origin,
                    FOV = Distance.Value,
                    Sort = "Mouse",
                    Players = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Players.Enabled,
                    NPCs = AutoKit.Options.Targets.NPCs.Enabled,
                    Invisible = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Invisible.Enabled,
                    Wallcheck = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Walls.Enabled,
                    Priority = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Priority.Value
                })[1]
                local Aim: Vector3? = Target and Ballistic.Solve(Target, Origin, 100, 20, true) or nil

                if Aim then
                    for i: number, v: any in debug.getstack(2) do
                        if v == Direction then
                            debug.setstack(2, i, Aim)
                        end
                    end
                end

                return (Old :: (...any) -> ...any)(self, Origin, Direction, ...)
            end

            AutoKit:Clean(function()
                if Old then
                    Data.Controllers.BlockKickerKitController.getKickBlockProjectileOriginPosition = Old
                    Old = nil
                end
            end)
        end

        Distance = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Distance",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 1000,
            Default = 1000,
            Suffix = "px",
            Tooltip = "How far from your mouse a target can be on screen for your kicked block to aim at them"
        })

        AutoKit.Settings.block_kicker = {Distance}
    end
end)()

BundledModules.Trap = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity
    local Inventory = BundledModules.Inventory
    local Ping = BundledModules.Ping
    local PlacementController = BundledModules.PlacementController

    return function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
        local AutoKit: Module = Section("Trap", true)
        local Mode, TrapType, Side, Radius, Range, Amount, PlaceRange, Delay, IgnoreWalls, Detonate, Switch, Notify, Traps

        local TrapNames: {[string]: string} = {Snap = "snap_trap", Venom = "venom_trap", Explosive = "explosive_trap"}
        local Placed: {[Vector3]: number} = {}
        local NextThrow: number = 0
        local NextSwitch: number = 0
        local NextDetonate: number = 0
        local BedCount: number = 0
        local RayFilter: {Instance} = {}
        local SightParams: RaycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
        SightParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

        local function UpdateFilter()
            local Filter: {Instance} = {workspace.CurrentCamera, Entity.Character}
            for _, v: Target in Entity.Entities do
                table.insert(Filter, v.Character)
            end
            for _, v: Instance in Services.CollectionService:GetTagged("DontBlockAbilityRaycast") do
                table.insert(Filter, v)
            end
            RayFilter = Filter
        end

        local function Raycast(Origin: Vector3, Direction: Vector3): RaycastResult?
            SightParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = RayFilter
            return Data.Controllers.GameQueryUtil:raycast(Origin, Direction, SightParams)
        end

        local function Block(Position: Vector3): any
            return Data.Controllers.BlockController:getStore():getBlockAt(Data.Controllers.BlockController:getBlockPosition(Position))
        end

        local function HasStock(Item: string): boolean
            local Meta: any = Data.Instances.TrapperConstants.TrapperTrapMeta[Item]
            return Meta ~= nil and Data.Controllers.TrapperController:canUseAbilities() and Data.Controllers.TrapperUtil.getTrapCount(Services.LocalPlayer, Item) > 0 and Data.Controllers.TrapperUtil.getPlacedTrapCount(Services.LocalPlayer, Item) < Meta.maxPlaced
        end

        local function GetTrap(EnemyMode: boolean): string?
            local Wanted: string? = TrapNames[TrapType.Value]
            if Wanted then
                return HasStock(Wanted) and Wanted or nil
            end

            if EnemyMode then
                local Selected: string = Data.Controllers.TrapperUtil.getSelectedTrap(Services.LocalPlayer)
                if HasStock(Selected) then
                    return Selected
                end

                for _, v: string in Data.Instances.TrapperConstants.TrapperTraps do
                    if HasStock(v) then
                        return v
                    end
                end
            else
                for _, v: string in Traps.ListEnabled do
                    if Data.Controllers.TrapperUtil.isTrapperTrap(v) and HasStock(v) or not Data.Controllers.TrapperUtil.isTrapperTrap(v) and Inventory.Item(v) then
                        return v
                    end
                end
            end

            return nil
        end

        local function GetGround(Position: Vector3): Vector3?
            local Hit: RaycastResult? = Raycast(Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), Vector3.new(0, -24, 0))
            if Hit and Hit.Normal.Y > 0.99 then
                local Point: Vector3 = Hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.15, 0)
                return Vector3.new(math.round(Point.X / 3) * 3, math.round(Point.Y / 3) * 3, math.round(Point.Z / 3) * 3)
            end

            return nil
        end

        local function IsValid(Position: Vector3, Item: string): boolean
            if tick() < (Placed[Position] or 0) or Block(Position) then
                return false
            end

            local Origin: Vector3 = Entity.RootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
            if (Position - Origin).Magnitude > math.min(PlaceRange.Value, Data.Instances.TrapperConstants.TrapperBalance.ThrowRange) then
                return false
            end

            if Data.Controllers.TrapperUtil.isTrapperTrap(Item) then
                return Data.Controllers.TrapperUtil.canThrowTrap(Origin, Position, Raycast, Vector3.yAxis)
            end

            local Casting: any = Services.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("IsCasting")
            return Block(Position - Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)) ~= nil and not Data.Controllers.BlockPlacementController.disabled and not (Casting and Casting ~= 0 and Casting ~= "")
        end

        local function PlaceTrap(Position: Vector3, Item: string): boolean
            if not IsValid(Position, Item) then
                return false
            end

            if Data.Controllers.TrapperUtil.isTrapperTrap(Item) then
                if not HasStock(Item) or Data.Controllers.TrapperController.currentAim then
                    return false
                end

                if Data.Controllers.TrapperUtil.getSelectedTrap(Services.LocalPlayer) ~= Item then
                    if tick() >= NextSwitch and Data.Controllers.AbilityController:canUseAbility("trapper_switch", {disableBlockedAbilityAlert = true}) then
                        NextSwitch = tick() + math.max(Data.Instances.TrapperConstants.TrapperBalance.SwitchCooldown, 0.25)
                        Data.Controllers.AbilityController:useAbility("trapper_switch", nil, {trapType = Item})
                    end

                    return false
                end

                local Aim: {[string]: any} = {
                    character = Entity.Character,
                    trapType = Item,
                    source = "binding",
                    released = true,
                    payload = {trapType = Item, target = Position, normal = Vector3.yAxis}
                }
                Data.Controllers.TrapperController.currentAim = Aim

                local Success: boolean, Fired: any = pcall(function(): boolean
                    if not Data.Controllers.AbilityController:canUseAbility("trapper_throw", {disableBlockedAbilityAlert = true}) then
                        return false
                    end

                    Data.Controllers.AbilityController:useAbility("trapper_throw", nil, Aim.payload)
                    return true
                end)
                if Data.Controllers.TrapperController.currentAim == Aim then
                    Data.Controllers.TrapperController:cancelAim()
                end

                if not Success then
                    error(Fired)
                end

                if not Fired then
                    return false
                end
            else
                local Previous: number? = Switch.Enabled and Data.Storage.Hand.Tool and Data.Storage.Inventory.hotbarSlot or nil
                PlacementController.Place(Position, Item)
                if Previous then
                    Data.Controllers.Store:dispatch({type = "InventorySelectHotbarSlot", slot = Previous})
                end
            end

            Placed[Position] = tick() + 2
            if Notify.Enabled then
                Cat:CreateNotification("Trap", `Placed {Item}`, 3)
            end

            return true
        end

        local function GetBed(): BasePart?
            local Own: string = `Team{Services.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Team") or -1}NoBreak`
            local Closest: BasePart?, Distance: number = nil, Range.Value
            for _, v: BasePart in Services.CollectionService:GetTagged("bed") do
                local Mine: boolean = v:GetAttribute(Own) and true or false
                if Mine == (Side.Value == "Your bed") then
                    local Magnitude: number = (Entity.RootPart.Position - v.Position).Magnitude
                    if Magnitude < Distance then
                        Closest, Distance = v, Magnitude
                    end
                end
            end

            return Closest
        end

        local function TrapBed(Item: string): boolean
            local Bed: BasePart? = GetBed()
            if not Bed then
                return false
            end

            local Step: number = Radius.Value * 3
            for X: number = -Step, Step, 3 do
                for Z: number = -Step, Step, 3 do
                    if math.abs(X) == Step or math.abs(Z) == Step then
                        local Position: Vector3? = GetGround(Bed.Position + Vector3.new(X, 0, Z))
                        if Position and PlaceTrap(Position, Item) then
                            return true
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            return false
        end

        local function TrapEnemies(Item: string, Enemies: {Target}): boolean
            local Origin: Vector3 = Entity.RootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
            for _, v: Target in Enemies do
                local Position: Vector3 = v.RootPart.Position
                local Velocity: Vector3 = v.RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
                local Duration: number = Data.Controllers.TrapperUtil.trapThrowDuration(Origin, Position) + Data.Instances.TrapperConstants.TrapperBalance.SettleTime + Data.Instances.TrapperConstants.TrapperTrapMeta[Item].setupTime + (Ping.Get())
                local Lead: Vector3 = Velocity * Duration
                if Lead.Magnitude > 18 then
                    Lead = Lead.Unit * 18
                end

                for _, Factor: number in {1, 0.5, 0} do
                    local Ground: Vector3? = GetGround(Position + Lead * Factor - Vector3.new(0, v.Humanoid.HipHeight - 1.5, 0))
                    if Ground and PlaceTrap(Ground, Item) then
                        return true
                    end
                end
            end

            return false
        end

        local function DetonateTraps(PlacedTraps: {BasePart}, Enemies: {Target})
            if not Detonate.Enabled or tick() < NextDetonate or Data.Controllers.TrapperUtil.getArmedTrapCount(Services.LocalPlayer, "explosive_trap") == 0 or not Data.Controllers.TrapperController:canUseAbilities() or not Data.Controllers.AbilityController:canUseAbility("trapper_detonate", {disableBlockedAbilityAlert = true}) then
                return
            end

            for _, v: BasePart in PlacedTraps do
                if v.Name == "explosive_trap" and v:GetAttribute("PlacedByUserId") == Services.LocalPlayer.UserId and v:GetAttribute("SnapTrapState") == Data.Instances.SnapTrapState.ACTIVE then
                    local Normal: Vector3 = v:GetAttribute("TrapperSurfaceNormal") or Vector3.yAxis
                    local Center: Vector3 = Data.Controllers.TrapperUtil.trapSurfacePosition(v.Position, Normal)
                    for _, Enemy: Target in Enemies do
                        local Predicted: Vector3 = Enemy.RootPart.Position + Enemy.RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity * Data.Instances.TrapperConstants.TrapperBalance.ExplosionDelay
                        if (Enemy.RootPart.Position - Center).Magnitude <= Data.Instances.TrapperConstants.TrapperBalance.ExplosionRadius and (Predicted - Center).Magnitude <= Data.Instances.TrapperConstants.TrapperBalance.ExplosionRadius then
                            NextDetonate = tick() + math.max(Data.Instances.TrapperConstants.TrapperBalance.DetonateCooldown, Data.Instances.TrapperConstants.TrapperBalance.ExplosionDelay)
                            Data.Controllers.AbilityController:useAbility("trapper_detonate")
                            return
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        AutoKit.Kits.trapper = function()
            AutoKit:Clean(function()
                table.clear(Placed)
            end)

            table.clear(Placed)
            NextThrow, NextSwitch, NextDetonate, BedCount = 0, 0, 0, 0

            repeat
                if Entity.Alive then
                    local Enemies: {Target} = Entity.Targets({
                        Range = Detonate.Enabled and Data.Controllers.TrapperUtil.getArmedTrapCount(Services.LocalPlayer, "explosive_trap") > 0 and math.huge or PlaceRange.Value + 15,
                        Players = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Players.Enabled,
                        NPCs = AutoKit.Options.Targets.NPCs.Enabled,
                        Wallcheck = IgnoreWalls.Enabled or AutoKit.Options.Targets.Walls.Enabled,
                        Sort = "Distance"
                    })

                    DetonateTraps(Services.CollectionService:GetTagged("trapper_trap"), Enemies)

                    if tick() >= NextThrow then
                        local EnemyMode: boolean = Mode.Value == "Enemies"
                        local Item: string? = GetTrap(EnemyMode)
                        if Item then
                            UpdateFilter()

                            local Success: boolean = EnemyMode and TrapEnemies(Item, Enemies) or not EnemyMode and TrapBed(Item)
                            if Success then
                                BedCount = EnemyMode and 0 or BedCount + 1

                                local Pause: boolean = EnemyMode or BedCount >= Amount.Value
                                NextThrow = tick() + math.max(Data.Instances.TrapperConstants.TrapperBalance.ThrowCooldown, Pause and Delay.Value or 0)
                                if Pause then
                                    BedCount = 0
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end

                for Position: Vector3, Expiry: number in Placed do
                    if tick() >= Expiry then
                        Placed[Position] = nil
                    end
                end

                task.wait(0.1)
            until not AutoKit.Enabled
        end

        Mode = AutoKit:CreateDropdown({
            Name = "Mode",
            List = {"Bed ring", "Enemies"},
            Function = function(Value: string)
                BedCount = 0
            end,
            Tooltip = "Bed ring surrounds a bed, Enemies throws ahead of nearby targets so the trap lands where they are going"
        })
        TrapType = AutoKit:CreateDropdown({
            Name = "Type",
            List = {"Auto", "Snap", "Venom", "Explosive"},
            Tooltip = "Auto uses your selected stocked trap on enemies and the Traps list around beds"
        })
        Side = AutoKit:CreateDropdown({
            Name = "Bed",
            List = {"Your bed", "Enemy bed"},
            Darker = true
        })
        Radius = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Radius",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 5,
            Default = 2,
            Darker = true,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value == 1 and "block" or "blocks"
            end
        })
        Range = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Bed range",
            Min = 4,
            Max = 60,
            Default = 20,
            Darker = true,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
            end,
            Tooltip = "How close the bed has to be before placing"
        })
        Amount = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Amount",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 8,
            Default = 3,
            Darker = true,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value == 1 and "trap" or "traps"
            end,
            Tooltip = "How many traps to throw each time around a bed"
        })
        PlaceRange = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Place range",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 45,
            Default = 30,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
            end,
            Tooltip = "How far you can throw, capped at the game's throw range"
        })
        Delay = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Delay",
            Min = 0.35,
            Max = 10,
            Default = 0.5,
            Decimal = 100,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value == 1 and "second" or "seconds"
            end,
            Tooltip = "Wait between enemy throws or bed rings, never faster than the game's cooldown"
        })
        IgnoreWalls = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Ignore behind walls",
            Darker = true,
            Tooltip = "Skips enemies you can't see, the throw path is always checked"
        })
        Detonate = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Auto detonate",
            Default = true,
            Tooltip = "Sets off your armed explosives when an enemy is inside the blast and will still be there"
        })
        Switch = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Switch back",
            Default = true,
            Tooltip = "Goes back to your old hotbar slot after placing an inventory trap, Trapper throws never change your held item"
        })
        Notify = AutoKit:CreateToggle({Name = "Trap notify"})
        Traps = AutoKit:CreateTextList({
            Name = "List",
            Default = {"snap_trap", "venom_trap", "explosive_trap", "invisible_landmine", "spike_trap", "tesla_trap", "grave_trap", "lucky_block_trap"},
            Darker = true,
            Placeholder = "item",
            Tooltip = "Bed ring trap priority, Trapper traps use your kit stock and other traps use your inventory"
        })

        AutoKit.Settings.trapper = {Mode, TrapType, Side, Radius, Range, Amount, PlaceRange, Delay, IgnoreWalls, Detonate, Switch, Notify, Traps}
    end
end)()

BundledModules.Triton = (function()
    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity
    local Inventory = BundledModules.Inventory
    local SlotController = BundledModules.SlotController
    local Ballistic = BundledModules.Ballistic

    return function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
        local AutoKit: Module = Section("Triton")
        local Legit, Back, BackDelay, Limit, FallSpeed, Search

        local NextFire: number = 0

        local Ground: RaycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
        Ground.RespectCanCollide = true
        Ground.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

        local function NearGround(Origin: Vector3): Vector3?
            for Step: number = 1, Search.Value do
                for _, v: Vector3 in {Vector3.xAxis, Vector3.zAxis, -Vector3.xAxis, -Vector3.zAxis} do
                    local Result: RaycastResult? = workspace:Raycast(Origin + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0) + v * Step, Vector3.new(0, -80, 0), Ground)
                    if Result then
                        return Result.Position
                    end
                end
            end

            return nil
        end

        local function Fire(Item: InventoryItem, Spot: Vector3): boolean
            local Meta: any = Data.Instances.ProjectileMeta.harpoon_projectile
            local Source: any = Data.Instances.Items[Item.itemType].projectileSource
            local Origin: Vector3 = Entity.RootPart.Position
            local Gravity: number = Meta.gravitationalAcceleration or 196.2
            local ShootPosition: Vector3 = (CFrame.new(Origin, Spot) * CFrame.new(Vector3.new(-Data.Instances.BowConstants.RelX, -Data.Instances.BowConstants.RelY, -Data.Instances.BowConstants.RelZ))).Position
            local Direction: Vector3? = Ballistic.Point(ShootPosition, Spot, Meta.launchVelocity, Gravity)

            if Direction then
                local Previous: Tool? = Data.Storage.Hand.Tool
                SlotController.Switch(Item.tool)
                if Legit.Enabled then
                    SlotController.Select(Item.tool)
                end

                NextFire = tick() + (Source and Source.fireDelaySec or 8)
                Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("ProjectileFire"):CallServerAsync(
                    Item.tool,
                    nil,
                    Source and Source.projectileType(Item.itemType) or "harpoon_projectile",
                    ShootPosition,
                    Origin,
                    Direction * Meta.launchVelocity,
                    Data.Controllers.IdUtil.generateId(8),
                    {
                        shotId = Data.Controllers.IdUtil.generateId(8),
                        drawDurationSec = math.max(1, Source and Source.maxStrengthChargeSec or 0)
                    },
                    workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - 0.045
                ):andThen(function(Result: any)
                    if type(Result) == "table" and Result.accepted and Result.model then
                        Result.model.Parent = Services.ReplicatedStorage
                    end
                end)

                if Back.Enabled and Previous then
                    task.wait(BackDelay:GetRandomValue())
                    SlotController.Switch(Previous)
                    if Legit.Enabled then
                        SlotController.Select(Previous)
                    end
                end
            end

            return Direction ~= nil
        end

        AutoKit.Kits.harpoon = function()
            NextFire = 0
            local LastGround: Vector3? = nil

            repeat
                if Entity.Alive and tick() >= NextFire and (not Limit.Enabled or Data.Storage.Hand.Tool and Data.Storage.Hand.Tool.Name == "harpoon") then
                    local Root: BasePart = Entity.RootPart
                    local Harpoon: InventoryItem? = Inventory.Item("harpoon")
                    Ground.FilterDescendantsInstances = {Data.Storage.Map}
                    Ground.CollisionGroup = Root.CollisionGroup

                    if Entity.Humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
                        LastGround = Root.Position
                    end

                    if Harpoon and Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y < -FallSpeed.Value and not workspace:Raycast(Root.Position, Vector3.new(0, -200, 0), Ground) then
                        local Spot: Vector3? = NearGround(Root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 40, 0)) or LastGround and NearGround(LastGround + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0))
                        if Spot then
                            Fire(Harpoon, Spot)
                        end
                    end
                end

                task.wait(0.1)
            until not AutoKit.Enabled
        end

        FallSpeed = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Fall speed",
            Min = 10,
            Max = 200,
            Default = 60,
            Suffix = "studs a second",
            Tooltip = "How fast you have to be falling before it throws"
        })
        Search = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Search range",
            Min = 4,
            Max = 60,
            Default = 40,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
            end,
            Tooltip = "How far out it looks for ground to land on"
        })
        Legit = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Legit switch",
            Default = true,
            Tooltip = "Shows the item switch on your screen"
        })
        Back = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Switch back",
            Default = true,
            Tooltip = "Goes back to your last item after throwing"
        })
        BackDelay = AutoKit:CreateTwoSlider({
            Name = "Switch back delay",
            Min = 0,
            Max = 2,
            DefaultMin = 0.1,
            DefaultMax = 0.2,
            Darker = true
        })
        Limit = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Limit to item",
            Tooltip = "Only throws when you are already holding the trident"
        })

        AutoKit.Settings.harpoon = {FallSpeed, Search, Legit, Back, BackDelay, Limit}
    end
end)()

BundledModules.Trixie = (function()
    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity

    return function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
        local AutoKit: Module = Section("Trixie", true)
        local Warp, WarpRange, Rewind, Health, Infinite

        AutoKit.Kits.void_walker = function()
            local NextAbility: number = 0

            local OldCooldown: any = Data.Controllers.AbilityController.cooldownController.setOnCooldown
            local OldAbility: any = Data.Controllers.AbilityController.useAbility

            AutoKit:Clean(function()
                Data.Controllers.AbilityController.cooldownController.setOnCooldown = OldCooldown
                Data.Controllers.AbilityController.useAbility = OldAbility
            end)

            Data.Controllers.AbilityController.cooldownController.setOnCooldown = function(self: any, CooldownId: string, ...: any)
                if Infinite.Enabled and CooldownId == "void_walker_warp" then
                    return
                end

                return OldCooldown(self, CooldownId, ...)
            end
            Data.Controllers.AbilityController.useAbility = function(self: any, Ability: string, ...: any)
                if Infinite.Enabled and Ability == "void_walker_warp" then
                    if Services.LocalPlayer.Character and self:canUseAbility(Ability) then
                        Data.Instances.SyncEvents.AbilityUsed:fire(Services.LocalPlayer.Character, Ability, ...)
                    end

                    return
                end

                return OldAbility(self, Ability, ...)
            end

            if Infinite.Enabled then
                Data.Controllers.AbilityController.cooldownController:removeCooldown("void_walker_warp")
            end

            repeat
                if Entity.Alive and tick() >= NextAbility then
                    local Humanoid: Humanoid = Entity.Humanoid

                    if Rewind.Enabled and Humanoid.Health <= Humanoid.MaxHealth * (Health.Value / 100) and Data.Controllers.AbilityController:canUseAbility("void_walker_rewind", {disableBlockedAbilityAlert = true}) then
                        NextAbility = tick() + 1
                        Data.Controllers.AbilityController:useAbility("void_walker_rewind")
                    elseif Warp.Enabled and Data.Controllers.AbilityController:canUseAbility("void_walker_warp", {disableBlockedAbilityAlert = true}) then
                        local Target: Target? = Entity.Targets({
                            Range = WarpRange.Value,
                            Players = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Players.Enabled,
                            NPCs = AutoKit.Options.Targets.NPCs.Enabled,
                            Invisible = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Invisible.Enabled,
                            Wallcheck = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Walls.Enabled,
                            Priority = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Priority.Value,
                            Sort = "Distance"
                        })[1]

                        if Target then
                            local Root: BasePart = Entity.RootPart
                            Root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAlong(Root.Position, (Target.RootPart.Position - Root.Position) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1))
                            NextAbility = tick() + 1
                            Data.Controllers.AbilityController:useAbility("void_walker_warp")
                        end
                    end
                end

                task.wait(0.1)
            until not AutoKit.Enabled
        end

        Warp = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Warp to target",
            Default = true,
            Tooltip = "Turns you at the closest enemy before warping so the portal lands on them"
        })
        WarpRange = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Warp range",
            Min = 5,
            Max = 80,
            Default = 40,
            Darker = true,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
            end
        })
        Rewind = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Rewind on low health",
            Default = true,
            Tooltip = "Rifts you back out when your health gets low"
        })
        Health = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Health",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 100,
            Default = 40,
            Darker = true,
            Suffix = "%"
        })

        Infinite = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Infinite warp",
            Tooltip = "Removes Rift Warp's clientside cooldown"
        })

        AutoKit.Settings.void_walker = {Warp, WarpRange, Rewind, Health, Infinite}
    end
end)()

BundledModules.Uma = (function()
    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity
    local Inventory = BundledModules.Inventory
    local SlotController = BundledModules.SlotController
    local Ballistic = BundledModules.Ballistic

    return function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
        local AutoKit: Module = Section("Uma")
        local Range, Animation, Limit, AutoSummon, HealSpirit, AttackSpirit, TargetItemDrops, Emerald, Diamond

        local Aim: RaycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
        Aim.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

        local Sight: RaycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
        Sight.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

        local function Fire(Staff: Tool, SpiritType: string, Drop: BasePart): boolean
            local Meta: any = Data.Instances.ProjectileMeta[SpiritType]
            local Source: any = Data.Instances.Items[Staff.Name]
            if Meta then
                local LocalPosition: Vector3 = Entity.RootPart.Position
                local ShootPosition: Vector3 = LocalPosition + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
                local Gravity: number = Meta.gravitationalAcceleration or 196.2
                local Direction: Vector3?, Time: number = Ballistic.Point(ShootPosition, Drop.Position, Meta.launchVelocity, Gravity)
                Aim.FilterDescendantsInstances = Data.Storage.Map and {Data.Storage.Map} or {}

                if Direction and Ballistic.Clear(ShootPosition, Direction * Meta.launchVelocity, Gravity, Time, Aim) then
                    Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("ProjectileFire"):CallServerAsync(
                        Staff,
                        nil,
                        SpiritType,
                        ShootPosition,
                        LocalPosition,
                        Direction * Meta.launchVelocity,
                        Data.Controllers.IdUtil.generateId(8),
                        {
                            shotId = Data.Controllers.IdUtil.generateId(8),
                            drawDurationSec = math.max(1, Source and Source.projectileSource and Source.projectileSource.maxStrengthChargeSec or 0)
                        },
                        workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - 0.045
                    )

                    return true
                end
            end

            return false
        end

        local function Nearest(LocalPosition: Vector3): BasePart?
            local Drop: BasePart? = nil
            local Closest: number = Range.Value + 1

            for _, v: BasePart in Services.CollectionService:GetTagged("ItemDrop") do
                if v.Name == "emerald" and Emerald.Enabled or v.Name == "diamond" and Diamond.Enabled then
                    local Magnitude: number = (LocalPosition - v.Position).Magnitude
                    Sight.FilterDescendantsInstances = {workspace.CurrentCamera, Entity.Character, v}

                    if Magnitude <= Closest and not workspace:Raycast(LocalPosition, v.Position - LocalPosition, Sight) then
                        Drop, Closest = v, Magnitude
                    end
                end
            end

            return Drop
        end

        AutoKit.Kits.spirit_summoner = function()
            repeat
                local Staff: Tool? = nil
                if Limit.Enabled then
                    if Data.Storage.Hand.Tool and Data.Storage.Hand.Tool.Name == "spirit_staff" then
                        Staff = Data.Storage.Hand.Tool
                    end
                else
                    local Item: InventoryItem? = Inventory.Item("spirit_staff")
                    if Item and Item.tool then
                        SlotController.Switch(Item.tool, 0)
                        Staff = Item.tool
                    end
                end

                if Entity.Alive and Staff and TargetItemDrops.Enabled then
                    local AttackSpirits: number = Services.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("ReadySummonedAttackSpirits") or 0
                    local HealSpirits: number = Services.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("ReadySummonedHealSpirits") or 0

                    if AutoSummon.Enabled then
                        if AttackSpirit.Enabled and AttackSpirits < 1 and Inventory.Item("summon_stone") then
                            Data.Controllers.AbilityController:useAbility("summon_attack_spirit")
                        end

                        if HealSpirit.Enabled and HealSpirits < 1 and Inventory.Item("summon_stone") then
                            Data.Controllers.AbilityController:useAbility("summon_heal_spirit")
                        end
                    end

                    if HealSpirits + AttackSpirits > 0 then
                        local Drop: BasePart? = Nearest(Entity.RootPart.Position)
                        if Drop and Fire(Staff, AttackSpirits > 0 and "attack_spirit" or "heal_spirit", Drop) then
                            if Animation.Enabled then
                                Data.Controllers.GameAnimationUtil:playAnimation(Entity.Character, Data.Instances.Animations.WIZARD_BALL_CAST)
                                Data.Controllers.AudioManager:playAudio(Data.Instances.Sounds.SPIRIT_SUMMONER_CHANGE_AFFINITY, {})
                            end

                            task.wait(1.5)
                        end
                    end
                end

                task.wait(0.1)
            until not AutoKit.Enabled
        end

        Range = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Range",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 80,
            Default = 50,
            Decimal = 5,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value >= 2 and "studs" or "stud"
            end
        })
        Animation = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Animation",
            Default = true
        })
        Limit = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Limit to item",
            Tooltip = "Only throws when you are holding the spirit staff",
            Default = true
        })
        AutoSummon = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Auto summon",
            Tooltip = "Summons spirits for you when you run out"
        })
        HealSpirit = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Use heal spirit",
            Default = true,
            Darker = true
        })
        AttackSpirit = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Use attack spirit",
            Default = true,
            Darker = true
        })
        TargetItemDrops = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Target item drops",
            Default = true
        })
        Emerald = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Emerald",
            Darker = true,
            Default = true
        })
        Diamond = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Diamond",
            Darker = true,
            Default = true
        })

        AutoKit.Settings.spirit_summoner = {Range, Animation, Limit, AutoSummon, HealSpirit, AttackSpirit, TargetItemDrops, Emerald, Diamond}
    end
end)()
