BundledModules.VoidRegent = (function()
    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity
    local Inventory = BundledModules.Inventory
    local SlotController = BundledModules.SlotController

    return function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
        local AutoKit: Module = Section("VoidRegent")
        local Height, FallSpeed, Switch, SwitchDelay, LimitItem, Clutch, ClutchRange, ClutchDepth, ClutchSpeed, ClutchFace

        local NextSlam: number = 0
        local NextClutch: number = 0

        local function NearGround(Origin: Vector3, Reach: number): Vector3?
            local Extent: Vector3 = Vector3.new(Reach, Reach, Reach)
            local From: Vector3 = Data.Controllers.BlockController:getBlockPosition(Origin - Extent)
            local To: Vector3 = Data.Controllers.BlockController:getBlockPosition(Origin + Extent)
            local Closest: Vector3? = nil
            local Distance: number = 60

            for X: number = From.X, To.X do
                for Y: number = From.Y, To.Y do
                    for Z: number = From.Z, To.Z do
                        local Position: Vector3 = Vector3.new(X, Y, Z) * 3
                        if Data.Controllers.BlockController:getStore():getBlockAt(Vector3.new(X, Y, Z)) and not Data.Controllers.BlockController:getStore():getBlockAt(Data.Controllers.BlockController:getBlockPosition(Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))) and (Origin - Position).Magnitude < Distance then
                            Distance = (Origin - Position).Magnitude
                            Closest = Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            return Closest
        end

        local function Slam(Axe: Tool)
            if Data.Storage.Hand.Tool ~= Axe then
                if Switch.Enabled then
                    SlotController.Select(Axe)
                else
                    SlotController.Switch(Axe, 0)
                end

                task.wait(SwitchDelay.Value)
            end

            if AutoKit.Enabled and Entity.Alive and Data.Controllers.AbilityController:canUseAbility("void_axe_jump", {disableBlockedAbilityAlert = true}) then
                Data.Controllers.VoidAxeController:useVoidAxe()
            end
        end

        AutoKit.Kits.regent = function()
            local Params: RaycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
            Params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
            Params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {Data.Storage.Map}

            NextSlam = 0
            NextClutch = 0

            AutoKit:Clean(Services.RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                if Clutch.Enabled and Entity.Alive and tick() >= NextClutch and Data.Controllers.VoidAxeController then
                    local Root: BasePart = Entity.RootPart

                    if Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y < -ClutchSpeed.Value and not workspace:Raycast(Root.Position, Vector3.new(0, -ClutchDepth.Value, 0), Params) and Data.Controllers.AbilityController:canUseAbility("void_axe_jump", {disableBlockedAbilityAlert = true}) then
                        local Ground: Vector3? = NearGround(Root.Position, ClutchRange.Value)
                        local Delta: Vector3? = Ground and (Ground - Root.Position) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)

                        if Delta and Delta.Magnitude > 0 then
                            NextClutch = tick() + 0.5

                            if ClutchFace.Enabled then
                                Root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Root.Position, Root.Position + Delta.Unit)
                            end

                            Data.Controllers.VoidAxeController:useVoidAxe()
                        end
                    end
                end
            end))

            AutoKit:Clean(Services.RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                if Entity.Alive and tick() >= NextSlam and Data.Controllers.VoidAxeController then
                    local Root: BasePart = Entity.RootPart

                    if Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y <= -FallSpeed.Value and Data.Controllers.AbilityController:canUseAbility("void_axe_jump", {disableBlockedAbilityAlert = true}) and workspace:Raycast(Root.Position, Vector3.new(0, -Height.Value, 0), Params) then
                        local Axe: Tool? = nil

                        if Data.Storage.Hand.Tool and Data.Storage.Hand.Tool.Name == "void_axe" then
                            Axe = Data.Storage.Hand.Tool
                        elseif not LimitItem.Enabled then
                            local Item: InventoryItem? = Inventory.Item("void_axe")
                            Axe = Item and Item.tool
                        end

                        if Axe then
                            NextSlam = tick() + Data.Instances.VoidRegentBalance.AXE_COOLDOWN
                            task.spawn(Slam, Axe)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end))
        end

        Height = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Height",
            Min = 3,
            Max = 60,
            Default = 15,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value <= 1 and "stud" or "studs"
            end,
            Tooltip = "Slams once the ground is this close beneath you"
        })
        FallSpeed = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Fall speed",
            Min = 0,
            Max = 100,
            Default = 10,
            Tooltip = "Only slams once you are dropping this fast"
        })
        Switch = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Legit switch",
            Tooltip = "Takes the axe out through the hotbar instead of silently"
        })
        SwitchDelay = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Switch delay",
            Min = 0,
            Max = 1,
            Decimal = 100,
            Default = 0.05,
            Darker = true,
            Suffix = "seconds"
        })
        LimitItem = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Limit to items",
            Tooltip = "Only slams if the axe is already held"
        })

        Clutch = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Auto clutch",
            Tooltip = "Dashes the void axe back towards solid ground when you fall off the map"
        })
        ClutchRange = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Clutch range",
            Min = 10,
            Max = 60,
            Default = 45,
            Darker = true,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value <= 1 and "stud" or "studs"
            end,
            Tooltip = "How far to look for ground to dash back to"
        })
        ClutchDepth = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Clutch depth",
            Min = 10,
            Max = 150,
            Default = 60,
            Darker = true,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value <= 1 and "stud" or "studs"
            end,
            Tooltip = "Nothing beneath you within this counts as the void"
        })
        ClutchSpeed = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Clutch fall speed",
            Min = 0,
            Max = 100,
            Default = 10,
            Darker = true,
            Tooltip = "Only clutches once you are dropping this fast"
        })
        ClutchFace = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Clutch face ground",
            Default = true,
            Darker = true,
            Tooltip = "Turns you towards the ground first, the dash always goes where you face"
        })

        AutoKit.Settings.regent = {Height, FallSpeed, Switch, SwitchDelay, LimitItem, Clutch, ClutchRange, ClutchDepth, ClutchSpeed, ClutchFace}
    end
end)()

BundledModules.Vulcan = (function()
    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity
    local Ballistic = BundledModules.Ballistic

    return function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
        local AutoKit: Module = Section("Vulcan", true)
        local Sort, Range

        AutoKit.Kits.vulcan = function()
            repeat
                local Turret: any = Entity.Alive and Data.Controllers.Store:getState().Game.selectedTurret
                if Turret then
                    local Origin: Vector3 = Turret.Rotate.Position
                    local Target: Target? = Entity.Targets({
                        Origin = Origin,
                        Range = Range.Value,
                        Players = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Players.Enabled,
                        NPCs = AutoKit.Options.Targets.NPCs.Enabled,
                        Invisible = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Invisible.Enabled,
                        Wallcheck = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Walls.Enabled,
                        Priority = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Priority.Value,
                        Sort = Sort.Value
                    })[1]

                    if Target then
                        local Direction: Vector3? = Ballistic.Solve(Target, Origin, 320, 10, true)
                        if Direction then
                            Data.Controllers.TurretCameraController.angleX = math.atan2(-Direction.X, -Direction.Z)
                            Data.Controllers.TurretCameraController.angleY = math.clamp(math.atan2(Direction.Y, math.sqrt(Direction.X ^ 2 + Direction.Z ^ 2)), -0.8, 0.8)
                        end
                    end
                end

                task.wait(0.1)
            until not AutoKit.Enabled
        end

        local Methods: {string} = {"Distance", "Damage"}
        for Index: string in Entity.Sorts do
            if not table.find(Methods, Index) then
                table.insert(Methods, Index)
            end
        end

        Sort = AutoKit:CreateDropdown({
            Name = "Target mode",
            List = Methods,
            Default = "Distance"
        })
        Range = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Range",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 1000,
            Default = 500,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
            end
        })

        AutoKit.Settings.vulcan = {Sort, Range}
    end
end)()

BundledModules.Warrior = (function()
    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity

    return function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
        local AutoKit: Module = Section("Warrior", true)
        local Range, Amount

        AutoKit.Kits.warrior = function()
            repeat
                if Entity.Alive and Data.Controllers.AbilityController:canUseAbility("warrior_strike", {disableBlockedAbilityAlert = true}) then
                    local Found: number = #Entity.Targets({
                        Range = Range.Value,
                        Players = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Players.Enabled,
                        NPCs = AutoKit.Options.Targets.NPCs.Enabled,
                        Invisible = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Invisible.Enabled,
                        Wallcheck = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Walls.Enabled
                    })

                    if Found >= Amount.Value then
                        Data.Controllers.AbilityController:useAbility("warrior_strike")
                    end
                end

                task.wait(0.1)
            until not AutoKit.Enabled
        end

        Range = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Range",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 40,
            Default = 14,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
            end
        })
        Amount = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Enemy count",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 8,
            Default = 1,
            Tooltip = "Enemies in range before striking"
        })

        AutoKit.Settings.warrior = {Range, Amount}
    end
end)()

BundledModules.Whim = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity
    local Ballistic = BundledModules.Ballistic
    local Inventory = BundledModules.Inventory
    local Ping = BundledModules.Ping
    local SlotController = BundledModules.SlotController

    return function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
        local AutoKit: Module = Section("Whim", true)
        local Cast, Range, FireRate, SwitchDelay, Tomes, TomeRange, TomeDelay, Notify

        local NextFire: number = 0
        local NextTome: number = 0
        local Attempts: {[string]: number} = {}
        local Params: RaycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
        Params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        local Air: RaycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
        Air.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

        local function Watch(Id: string, Origin: Vector3, Velocity: Vector3, Gravity: number, Target: Target, Lifetime: number?)
            local Character: Model = Target.Character :: Model
            local Overlap: OverlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
            Overlap.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
            Overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances = {Character}

            local Steps: number = math.clamp(math.ceil(Velocity.Magnitude / 170), 1, 16)
            local Started: number = os.clock()
            local Last: Vector3 = Origin
            local Watcher: RBXScriptConnection
            Watcher = Services.RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                local Elapsed: number = os.clock() - Started
                if Elapsed > (Lifetime or 2) or not Character.Parent then
                    Watcher:Disconnect()
                    return
                end

                local Position: Vector3 = Origin + Velocity * Elapsed + Vector3.new(0, -Gravity, 0) * (0.5 * Elapsed * Elapsed)
                for Step: number = 1, Steps do
                    if #workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(Last:Lerp(Position, Step / Steps)), Vector3.new(3, 1, 3), Overlap) > 0 then
                        Watcher:Disconnect()
                        Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("ProjectileHit"):SendToServer(Id, Character)
                        return
                    end
                end

                Air.FilterDescendantsInstances = {Data.Storage.Map}
                if workspace:Raycast(Last, Position - Last, Air) then
                    Watcher:Disconnect()
                    return
                end

                Last = Position
            end)
            AutoKit:Clean(Watcher)
        end

        local function Fire(Item: InventoryItem, Kind: string, Target: Target): boolean
            local Meta: any = Data.Instances.ProjectileMeta[Kind]
            if not Meta then
                return false
            end

            local Origin: Vector3 = Entity.RootPart.Position
            local Gravity: number = Meta.gravitationalAcceleration or 196.2
            local Direction: Vector3? = Ballistic.Solve(Target, Origin, Meta.launchVelocity, Gravity, true)
            if not Direction then
                return false
            end

            local Shoot: Vector3 = (CFrame.lookAlong(Origin, Direction) * CFrame.new(-Data.Instances.BowConstants.RelX, -Data.Instances.BowConstants.RelY, -Data.Instances.BowConstants.RelZ)).Position
            local Aim: Vector3?, Time: number = Ballistic.Solve(Target, Shoot, Meta.launchVelocity, Gravity, true)
            local Velocity: Vector3 = (Aim or Direction) * Meta.launchVelocity

            Params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {Services.LocalPlayer.Character, workspace.CurrentCamera}
            if not Ballistic.Clear(Shoot, Velocity, Gravity, Time, Params) then
                return false
            end

            local Id: string = Data.Controllers.IdUtil.generateId(8)
            Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("ProjectileFire"):CallServerAsync(
                Item.tool,
                Kind,
                Kind,
                Shoot,
                Origin,
                Velocity,
                Id,
                {
                    shotId = Data.Controllers.IdUtil.generateId(8),
                    drawDurationSec = math.max(1, Data.Instances.Items[Item.itemType].projectileSource.maxStrengthChargeSec or 0)
                },
                workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - 0.045
            ):andThen(function(Result: any)
                if type(Result) == "table" and Result.accepted and Result.model then
                    Result.model.Parent = Services.ReplicatedStorage
                end
            end)
            Watch(Id, Shoot, Velocity, Gravity, Target, Meta.lifetimeSec)

            return true
        end

        local function Spell()
            local Item: InventoryItem? = Inventory.Item("mage_spellbook")
            local Element: string? = Data.Instances.BalanceFile.MAGE_ELEMENT_CYCLE[(Services.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("MageElementIndex") or 0) + 1]
            if not Element or table.find(Data.Controllers.MageKitUtil.getUnlockedMageElements(Services.LocalPlayer), Element) == nil then
                Element = "BASE"
            end

            local Meta: any = Data.Controllers.MageKitUtil.MageElementMeta[Element]
            local Source: any = Item and Meta and Meta.projectileSource
            if not Source then
                return
            end

            local Target: Target? = nil
            local Facing: Vector3 = Entity.RootPart.CFrame.LookVector * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
            for _, v: Target in Entity.Targets({
                Range = Range.Value,
                Players = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Players.Enabled,
                NPCs = AutoKit.Options.Targets.NPCs.Enabled,
                Invisible = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Invisible.Enabled,
                Wallcheck = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Walls.Enabled,
                Priority = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Priority.Value
            }) do
                local Delta: Vector3 = (v.RootPart.Position - Entity.RootPart.Position) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
                if Facing.Magnitude == 0 or Delta.Magnitude == 0 or math.acos(math.clamp(Facing.Unit:Dot(Delta.Unit), -1, 1)) <= math.rad(60) then
                    Target = v
                    break
                end
            end

            if Target and Item then
                local Slot: number = Data.Storage.Inventory.hotbarSlot
                if SlotController.Select(Item.tool) then
                    task.wait((Ping.Get()))

                    if Fire(Item, Source.projectileType("mage_spellbook"), Target) then
                        NextFire = tick() + Source.fireDelaySec + FireRate:GetRandomValue()
                        task.wait(SwitchDelay.Value)
                    end

                    Data.Controllers.Store:dispatch({type = "InventorySelectHotbarSlot", slot = Slot})
                end
            end
        end

        local function Learn(Tome: Instance)
            local Secret: string? = Tome:GetAttribute("TomeSecret")
            if not Secret or (Attempts[Secret] or 0) > tick() then
                return
            end

            Attempts[Secret] = tick() + 3
            local Result: any = Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("LearnElementTome"):CallServer({secret = Secret})
            if typeof(Result) ~= "table" or not Result.element then
                return
            end

            pcall(function()
                Data.Controllers.MageController:destroyTomeGuidingBeam()
                Data.Controllers.MageController:playLearnTomeEffect(Services.LocalPlayer, Tome, Result.element)
            end)

            task.delay(Data.Instances.BalanceFile.LEARN_TOME_DURATION or 2, function()
                pcall(function()
                    Data.Controllers.MageController:fadeOutTome(Tome)
                    if Services.LocalPlayer.Character then
                        Data.Controllers.MageKitUtil.changeMageKitAppearance(Services.LocalPlayer, Services.LocalPlayer.Character, Result.element)
                    end
                end)
            end)

            if Notify.Enabled then
                Cat:CreateNotification("Whim", `Learned the {Result.element} element`, 5)
            end
        end

        AutoKit.Kits.mage = function()
            AutoKit:Clean(function()
                table.clear(Attempts)
            end)

            NextFire = 0
            NextTome = 0

            repeat
                if Entity.Alive then
                    if Cast.Enabled and Data.Storage.Hand.Type == "sword" and tick() - Data.Controllers.SwordController.lastSwing < 0.2 and tick() >= NextFire then
                        Spell()
                    end

                    if Tomes.Enabled and tick() >= NextTome then
                        NextTome = tick() + TomeDelay.Value

                        for _, v: Instance in Services.CollectionService:GetTagged("ElementTome") do
                            local Part: BasePart? = v.Parent and (not v:IsA("Model") and v or (v.PrimaryPart or v:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)))
                            if Part and (Part.Position - Entity.RootPart.Position).Magnitude <= TomeRange.Value then
                                Learn(v)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end

                task.wait(0.1)
            until not AutoKit.Enabled
        end

        Cast = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Cast spells",
            Default = true,
            Tooltip = "Casts the magic book at whoever you are hitting"
        })
        Range = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Range",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 60,
            Default = 22,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
            end
        })
        FireRate = AutoKit:CreateTwoSlider({
            Name = "Fire rate",
            Min = 0,
            Max = 1,
            DefaultMin = 0.05,
            DefaultMax = 0.12,
            Decimal = 100
        })
        SwitchDelay = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Switch delay",
            Min = 0,
            Max = 1,
            Decimal = 100,
            Suffix = "seconds",
            Default = 0.02
        })
        Tomes = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Read tomes",
            Default = true,
            Tooltip = "Reads every Tome of the Elements it can reach so Whim unlocks its spells"
        })
        TomeRange = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Tome range",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 500,
            Default = 10,
            Darker = true,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
            end,
            Tooltip = "The prompt the game gives you stops at 10 studs"
        })
        TomeDelay = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Tome delay",
            Min = 0.1,
            Max = 5,
            Decimal = 10,
            Default = 0.5,
            Darker = true,
            Suffix = "seconds",
            Tooltip = "How often it looks for a tome"
        })
        Notify = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Notify",
            Default = true,
            Darker = true,
            Tooltip = "Tells you which element you picked up"
        })

        AutoKit.Settings.mage = {Cast, Range, FireRate, SwitchDelay, Tomes, TomeRange, TomeDelay, Notify}
    end
end)()

BundledModules.Whisper = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity

    return function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
        local AutoKit: Module = Section("Whisper")
        local Heal, Threshold, Fly, Owl, Target, FOVCheck, FOV, RangeCircle, CircleColor, CircleTransparency, CircleThickness, CircleFilled

        local Teammates: {string} = {"None"}
        local MapBottom: number = math.huge
        local FallDepth: number = 12
        local FootingCharacter: Model? = nil
        local FootingY: number = -math.huge
        local AttachRange: number = Data.Instances.OwlBalance and Data.Instances.OwlBalance.OWL_ATTACH_MAX_RANGE or 60

        local function GetOwlTarget(): Player?
            local Picked: Player? = Services.Players:FindFirstChild(Target.Value) :: Player?
            if not FOVCheck.Enabled then
                return Picked
            end

            if not Entity.Alive then
                return nil
            end

            local Camera: Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
            local Origin: Vector2 = Services.UserInputService.TouchEnabled and Camera.ViewportSize / 2 or Services.UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
            local Best: Player? = nil
            local BestDistance: number = FOV.Value

            for _, v: Player in Picked and {Picked} or Services.Players:GetPlayers() do
                local Character: Model? = v.Character
                local Root: BasePart? = Character and Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
                if v == Services.LocalPlayer or not Root or v:GetAttribute("Team") ~= Services.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Team") or v:GetAttribute("IsOwlTarget") then
                    continue
                end

                if (Root.Position - Entity.RootPart.Position).Magnitude > AttachRange then
                    continue
                end

                local Position: Vector3, Visible: boolean = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(Root.Position)
                local Distance: number = (Vector2.new(Position.X, Position.Y) - Origin).Magnitude
                if Visible and Distance <= BestDistance then
                    Best = v
                    BestDistance = Distance
                end
            end

            return Best
        end

        local function GetMapBottom(): number
            if MapBottom == math.huge then
                for _, v: BasePart in Services.CollectionService:GetTagged("block") do
                    MapBottom = math.min(MapBottom, v.Position.Y - v.Size.Y / 2)
                end
            end

            return MapBottom == math.huge and -math.huge or MapBottom
        end

        local function Track(Player: Player, Connected: boolean?): ()
            if not Connected then
                Cat:Clean(Player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Team"):Connect(function(): ()
                    Track(Player, true)
                end))
            end

            if Player ~= Services.LocalPlayer and Player:GetAttribute("Team") == Services.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Team") and not table.find(Teammates, Player.Name) then
                table.insert(Teammates, Player.Name)
                Target:Change(Teammates)
            end
        end

        AutoKit.Kits.owl = function()
            local Circle: any = Drawing.new("Circle")
            Circle.NumSides = 100
            Circle.Visible = false

            local Old: any = Data.Controllers.OwlKitController.onAbilityUsed

            AutoKit:Clean(function()
                Data.Controllers.OwlKitController.onAbilityUsed = Old
                Circle.Visible = false
                Circle:Remove()
            end)

            AutoKit:Clean(Services.RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(): ()
                Circle.Visible = Owl.Enabled and FOVCheck.Enabled and RangeCircle.Enabled
                Circle.Position = Services.UserInputService.TouchEnabled and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize / 2 or Services.UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
                Circle.Radius = FOV.Value
                Circle.Color = Color3.fromHSV(CircleColor.Hue, CircleColor.Sat, CircleColor.Value)
                Circle.Transparency = 1 - CircleTransparency.Value
                Circle.Thickness = CircleThickness.Value
                Circle.Filled = CircleFilled.Enabled
            end))

            Data.Controllers.OwlKitController.onAbilityUsed = function(self: any, Character: Model, Info: any, ...: any): any
                if Owl.Enabled and Info and Info.ability == "SUMMON_OWL" and Character == Services.LocalPlayer.Character then
                    local TargetPlayer: Player? = GetOwlTarget()
                    if TargetPlayer and TargetPlayer ~= Services.LocalPlayer then
                        Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("SummonOwl"):CallServer(TargetPlayer)
                        return
                    end
                end

                return Old(self, Character, Info, ...)
            end

            repeat
                if Owl.Enabled and not Data.Controllers.OwlAbilityController.target and GetOwlTarget() and Data.Controllers.AbilityController:canUseAbility("SUMMON_OWL", {disableBlockedAbilityAlert = true}) then
                    Data.Controllers.AbilityController:useAbility("SUMMON_OWL")
                end

                local Attached: any = Data.Controllers.OwlAbilityController.target
                local Character: Model? = Attached
                if Attached and Attached:IsA("Player") then
                    Character = Attached.Character
                end

                if Character then
                    local Root: BasePart? = Character.PrimaryPart
                    if Root then
                        if FootingCharacter ~= Character then
                            FootingCharacter = Character
                            FootingY = GetMapBottom() + FallDepth
                        end

                        if math.abs(Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y) < 2 then
                            FootingY = Root.Position.Y
                        end

                        if Fly.Enabled and Root.Position.Y < FootingY - FallDepth and Data.Controllers.AbilityController:getEnabledAbility("OWL_LIFT") ~= nil and Data.Controllers.AbilityController:canUseAbility("OWL_LIFT", {disableBlockedAbilityAlert = true}) then
                            Data.Controllers.AbilityController:useAbility("OWL_LIFT")
                        end
                    end

                    local Health: number? = Character:GetAttribute("Health")
                    local MaxHealth: number? = Character:GetAttribute("MaxHealth")
                    if Heal.Enabled and (Threshold.Value >= 100 or Health and MaxHealth and MaxHealth > 0 and Health / MaxHealth <= Threshold.Value / 100) and Data.Controllers.AbilityController:getEnabledAbility("OWL_HEAL") ~= nil and Data.Controllers.AbilityController:canUseAbility("OWL_HEAL", {disableBlockedAbilityAlert = true}) then
                        Data.Controllers.AbilityController:useAbility("OWL_HEAL")
                    end
                end

                task.wait(0.1)
            until not AutoKit.Enabled
        end

        Heal = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Heal",
            Tooltip = "Heals the player your owl is on when their health gets low",
            Default = true
        })
        Threshold = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Health",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 100,
            Default = 99,
            Darker = true,
            Suffix = "%"
        })
        Fly = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Fly",
            Default = true,
            Tooltip = "Lifts the player your owl is on once they fall well below where they last stood over the void, so it never fires on normal jumps or when bridging"
        })
        Owl = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Auto owl",
            Tooltip = "Sends the owl to the teammate you pick as soon as the ability is up"
        })
        Target = AutoKit:CreateDropdown({
            Name = "Teammate",
            List = Teammates,
            Darker = true,
            Tooltip = "Who the owl gets summoned onto"
        })
        FOVCheck = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "FOV check",
            Darker = true,
            Tooltip = "Only sends the owl to a teammate inside the FOV around your mouse, within owl range and without an owl already\nWith teammate on None it picks whoever is closest to your mouse"
        })
        FOV = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "FOV",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 1000,
            Default = 150,
            Darker = true
        })
        RangeCircle = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Range circle",
            Darker = true,
            Tooltip = "Shows the FOV as a circle around your mouse"
        })
        CircleColor = AutoKit:CreateColorSlider({
            Name = "Circle color",
            Darker = true
        })
        CircleTransparency = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Circle transparency",
            Min = 0,
            Max = 1,
            Decimal = 10,
            Default = 0.5,
            Darker = true
        })
        CircleThickness = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Circle thickness",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 10,
            Decimal = 10,
            Default = 1,
            Darker = true,
            Tooltip = "How wide the circle's outline is, has no effect when the circle is filled"
        })
        CircleFilled = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Circle filled",
            Darker = true
        })

        for _, v: Player in Services.Players:GetPlayers() do
            Track(v)
        end

        Cat:Clean(Services.Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(Track))

        AutoKit.Settings.owl = {Heal, Threshold, Fly, Owl, Target, FOVCheck, FOV, RangeCircle, CircleColor, CircleTransparency, CircleThickness, CircleFilled}
    end
end)()

BundledModules.Xurot = (function()
    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity

    return function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
        local AutoKit: Module = Section("Xurot", true)
        local Range, Delay

        local Form: boolean = false
        local Next: number = 0

        AutoKit.Kits.void_dragon = function()
            Form = false
            Next = 0

            AutoKit:Clean(function()
                Form = false
                Next = 0
            end)

            AutoKit:Clean(Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("VoidDragonAction"):Connect(function(Info: any)
                if type(Info) ~= "table" or Info.player == nil or Info.player == Services.LocalPlayer then
                    if type(Info) == "table" and Info.action == "transform" then
                        Form = true
                    elseif type(Info) == "table" and Info.action == "dragon_deactive" then
                        Form = false
                    end
                end
            end))
            AutoKit:Clean(Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("VoidDragonDeactive"):Connect(function(Info: any)
                if type(Info) ~= "table" or Info.player == nil or Info.player == Services.LocalPlayer then
                    Form = false
                end
            end))

            AutoKit:Clean(Services.LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
                Form = false
            end))

            repeat
                if Form and Entity.Alive and tick() >= Next then
                    local Target: Target? = Entity.Targets({
                        Origin = Entity.RootPart.Position,
                        Range = Range.Value,
                        Players = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Players.Enabled,
                        NPCs = AutoKit.Options.Targets.NPCs.Enabled,
                        Invisible = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Invisible.Enabled,
                        Wallcheck = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Walls.Enabled,
                        Priority = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Priority.Value
                    })[1]

                    if Target then
                        Next = tick() + Delay.Value
                        Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("DragonBreath"):SendToServer({
                            player = Services.LocalPlayer,
                            targetPoint = (Target.RootPart :: BasePart).Position
                        })
                    end
                end

                task.wait(0.05)
            until not AutoKit.Enabled
        end

        Range = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Range",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 200,
            Default = 120,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
            end
        })
        Delay = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Delay",
            Min = 0.1,
            Max = 3,
            Default = 0.5,
            Decimal = 10,
            Tooltip = "How long to wait between breaths",
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value == 1 and "sec" or "secs"
            end
        })

        AutoKit.Settings.void_dragon = {Range, Delay}
    end
end)()

BundledModules.Yuzi = function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
    local AutoKit: Module = Section("Yuzi")
    AutoKit.Kits.dasher = function()
        if Data.Controllers.DaoController and Data.Controllers.DaoController.enterChargingState then
            local Old: (...any) -> ...any = Data.Controllers.DaoController.enterChargingState
            local Field: ((...any) -> ...any)? = rawget(Data.Controllers.DaoController, "enterChargingState")
            local Hook: (any, ...any) -> ...any = function(self: any, ...: any): ...any
                local Result: any = Old(self, ...)
                if AutoKit.Enabled and self.chargingMaid then
                    self.beginChargeTime = time() - 60
                end

                return Result
            end

            AutoKit:Clean(function()
                if rawget(Data.Controllers.DaoController, "enterChargingState") == Hook then
                    Data.Controllers.DaoController.enterChargingState = Field
                end
            end)

            Data.Controllers.DaoController.enterChargingState = Hook
        end
    end

    AutoKit.Settings.dasher = {}
end

BundledModules.Zeno = (function()
    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity
    local SlotController = BundledModules.SlotController

    return function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
        local AutoKit: Module = Section("Zeno", true)
        local Sort, Limit, AFKCheck, Strike, Storm, Shockwave, ShockwaveRange, Range, Delay

        local Attempts: {[string]: number} = {}
        local LastInput: number = tick()

        local function GetStaff(): (Tool?, string?)
            if Limit.Enabled then
                local Tool: Tool? = Data.Storage.Hand.Tool
                local ItemType: string? = Tool and Tool.Name

                if ItemType and Data.Controllers.WizardUtil:isWizardStaff(ItemType) then
                    return Tool, ItemType
                end

                return nil, nil
            end

            for _, v: InventoryItem in Data.Storage.Inventory.inventory.items do
                if v.tool and Data.Controllers.WizardUtil:isWizardStaff(v.itemType) then
                    SlotController.Switch(v.tool, 0)
                    return v.tool, v.itemType
                end
            end

            return nil, nil
        end

        AutoKit.Kits.wizard = function()
            AutoKit:Clean(function()
                table.clear(Attempts)
            end)

            for _, v: RBXScriptSignal in {Services.UserInputService.InputBegan, Services.UserInputService.InputChanged} do
                AutoKit:Clean(v:Connect(function(Input: InputObject)
                    if Input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or Input.Delta.Magnitude > 0 then
                        LastInput = tick()
                    end
                end))
            end

            repeat
                if Entity.Alive and not (AFKCheck.Enabled and tick() - LastInput >= 30) then
                    local Staff: Tool?, ItemType: string? = GetStaff()

                    if Staff and ItemType then
                        local Position: Vector3 = Entity.RootPart.Position
                        local CastRange: number = math.min(Range.Value, Data.Controllers.WizardUtil:getCastRange(ItemType))
                        local Wave: boolean = Shockwave.Enabled and Data.Controllers.WizardUtil:hasAbility(ItemType, "SHOCKWAVE")
                        local Target: Target? = Entity.Targets({
                            Origin = Position,
                            Range = math.max(CastRange, Wave and ShockwaveRange.Value or 0),
                            Players = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Players.Enabled,
                            NPCs = AutoKit.Options.Targets.NPCs.Enabled,
                            Invisible = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Invisible.Enabled,
                            Wallcheck = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Walls.Enabled,
                            Priority = AutoKit.Options.Targets.Priority.Value,
                            Sort = Sort.Value
                        })[1]

                        if Target then
                            local Distance: number = (Position - Target.RootPart.Position).Magnitude
                            local Predicted: Vector3 = Target.RootPart.Position + Target.Humanoid.MoveDirection * (1 + Services.LocalPlayer:GetNetworkPing())
                            local Abilities: {{Name: string, Active: boolean}} = {
                                {Name = "LIGHTNING_STORM", Active = Storm.Enabled and Distance <= CastRange},
                                {Name = "SHOCKWAVE", Active = Wave and Distance <= ShockwaveRange.Value},
                                {Name = "LIGHTNING_STRIKE", Active = Strike.Enabled and Distance <= CastRange}
                            }

                            for _, v: {Name: string, Active: boolean} in Abilities do
                                if v.Active and (Attempts[v.Name] or 0) <= tick() and Data.Controllers.WizardUtil:hasAbility(ItemType, v.Name) and Data.Controllers.WizardStaffController then
                                    local Success: boolean, Allowed: boolean = pcall(Data.Controllers.WizardStaffController.canCastAbility, Data.Controllers.WizardStaffController, v.Name)

                                    if Success and Allowed then
                                        Success, Allowed = pcall(Data.Controllers.AbilityController.canUseAbility, Data.Controllers.AbilityController, v.Name, {disableBlockedAbilityAlert = true})

                                        if Success and Allowed then
                                            Attempts[v.Name] = tick() + math.max(Delay.Value, 0.25)

                                            if pcall(Data.Controllers.AbilityController.useAbility, Data.Controllers.AbilityController, v.Name, newproxy(true), {target = v.Name == "SHOCKWAVE" and Vector3.zero or Predicted}) then
                                                task.wait(Delay.Value)
                                                break
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end

                task.wait(0.1)
            until not AutoKit.Enabled
        end

        local Methods: {string} = {"Damage", "Distance"}
        for Index: string in Entity.Sorts do
            if not table.find(Methods, Index) then
                table.insert(Methods, Index)
            end
        end

        Sort = AutoKit:CreateDropdown({
            Name = "Target mode",
            List = Methods,
            Default = "Distance"
        })
        Limit = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Limit to item",
            Tooltip = "Only casts when you are holding a staff",
            Default = true
        })
        AFKCheck = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "AFK check",
            Tooltip = "Stops casting once you have not touched your mouse or keyboard for 30 seconds"
        })
        Strike = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Use lightning strike",
            Default = true
        })
        Storm = AutoKit:CreateToggle({Name = "Zeno use lightning storm"})
        Shockwave = AutoKit:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Auto shockwave",
            Tooltip = "Uses the shockwave ability when a target is near"
        })
        ShockwaveRange = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Shockwave range",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 12,
            Decimal = 5,
            Default = 12,
            Darker = true,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
            end
        })
        Range = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Range",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 60,
            Decimal = 5,
            Default = 35,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
            end
        })
        Delay = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Delay",
            Min = 0,
            Max = 10,
            Decimal = 5,
            Default = 0.5,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value == 1 and "sec" or "secs"
            end
        })

        AutoKit.Settings.wizard = {Sort, Limit, AFKCheck, Strike, Storm, Shockwave, ShockwaveRange, Range, Delay}
    end
end)()

BundledModules.Zephyr = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity

    return function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
        local AutoKit: Module = Section("Zephyr")
        local Lead

        local Limits: {[string]: number} = {
            Fly = 2,
            InfiniteJump = 1.7
        }

        local function GetPullIn(AirTime: number): number?
            local Down: any = Cat.Modules.TPDown
            if Down and Down.Enabled then
                return Down.PullIn
            end

            for Name: string, Limit: number in Limits do
                local Module: any = Cat.Modules[Name]
                local Option: any = Module and Module.Options["TP Down"]
                if Module and Module.Enabled and Option and Option.Enabled then
                    return Limit - (tick() - AirTime)
                end
            end

            return nil
        end

        AutoKit.Kits.wind_walker = function()
            local Humanoid: Humanoid? = nil
            local StateConnection: RBXScriptConnection? = nil
            local Used: number = 0
            local NextJump: number = 0
            local AirTime: number = tick()

            AutoKit:Clean(function()
                if StateConnection then
                    StateConnection:Disconnect()
                    StateConnection = nil
                end
            end)

            AutoKit:Clean(Services.RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function()
                if Entity.Alive then
                    if Entity.Humanoid ~= Humanoid then
                        if StateConnection then
                            StateConnection:Disconnect()
                        end

                        Humanoid = Entity.Humanoid
                        Used = 0
                        StateConnection = Entity.Humanoid.StateChanged:Connect(function(Old: Enum.HumanoidStateType, New: Enum.HumanoidStateType)
                            if New == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed then
                                Used = 0
                            elseif Old == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall and New == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then
                                Used += 1
                            end
                        end)
                    end

                    if Entity.Humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
                        AirTime = tick()
                    elseif NextJump <= tick() then
                        local Allowed: number = Data.Controllers.JumpHeightController and Data.Controllers.JumpHeightController.allowedAirJumps or 0
                        local PullIn: number? = GetPullIn(AirTime)

                        if Used < Allowed and PullIn and PullIn <= Lead.Value then
                            NextJump = tick() + 0.25
                            Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("NotifyAirJump"):SendToServer()
                            Entity.Humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
                            AirTime = tick()
                        end
                    end
                end
            end))
        end

        Lead = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Lead",
            Min = 0.05,
            Max = 0.5,
            Default = 0.15,
            Decimal = 100,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value == 1 and "second" or "seconds"
            end,
            Tooltip = "How long before the pull down it jumps"
        })

        AutoKit.Settings.wind_walker = {Lead}
    end
end)()

BundledModules.Zola = (function()
    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity

    return function(Section: (string, boolean?) -> Module)
        local AutoKit: Module = Section("Zola")
        local Mode, Range

        local Links: {[Instance]: number} = {}
        local NextLink: number = 0

        local function AttemptLink(Character: Model?)
            if Character and tick() >= NextLink and (Links[Character] or 0) <= tick() then
                local Count: number = 0

                for LinkedCharacter: Instance, Expiry: number in Links do
                    if Expiry > tick() then
                        Count += 1
                    else
                        Links[LinkedCharacter] = nil
                    end
                end

                if Count < Data.Instances.SoulBrokerConstants.MAX_SOUL_LINKS then
                    Links[Character] = tick() + 1
                    NextLink = tick() + 1
                    Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("AttemptSoulLink"):CallServerAsync(Character)
                end
            end
        end

        AutoKit.Kits.soul_broker = function()
            AutoKit:Clean(function()
                table.clear(Links)
                NextLink = 0
            end)

            AutoKit:Clean(Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("SoulLinkFormed"):Connect(function(Info: any)
                if Info.broker == Services.LocalPlayer and not Info.guard then
                    Links[Info.target] = tick() + Data.Instances.SoulBrokerConstants.SOUL_LINK_DURATION
                end
            end))

            AutoKit:Clean(Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("SoulLinkRemoved"):Connect(function(Info: any)
                if Info.broker == Services.LocalPlayer and not Info.guard then
                    Links[Info.target] = nil
                end
            end))

            AutoKit:Clean(Data.Events.EntityDamageEvent:Connect(function(Event: {entityInstance: Instance?, fromEntity: Instance?})
                if Mode.Value == "On Hit" and Event.fromEntity == Services.LocalPlayer.Character and Entity.Alive then
                    for _, v: Target in Entity.Entities do
                        if v.Character == Event.entityInstance then
                            if v.Player and not v.Self and v.TargetCheck() and (Entity.RootPart.Position - (v.RootPart :: BasePart).Position).Magnitude <= Range.Value then
                                AttemptLink(v.Character)
                            end

                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
            end))

            repeat
                if Mode.Value == "On See" and tick() >= NextLink and Entity.Alive then
                    for _, v: Target in Entity.Targets({
                        Origin = Entity.RootPart.Position,
                        Range = Range.Value,
                        Players = true,
                        Wallcheck = true
                    }) do
                        if (Links[v.Character :: Model] or 0) <= tick() then
                            AttemptLink(v.Character)

                            break
                        end
                    end
                end

                task.wait(0.1)
            until not AutoKit.Enabled
        end

        Mode = AutoKit:CreateDropdown({
            Name = "Mode",
            List = {"On See", "On Hit"},
            Tooltip = "On See - Links enemies as soon as you can see them\nOn Hit - Links enemies whenever you hit them",
            Default = "On See"
        })
        Range = AutoKit:CreateSlider({
            Name = "Range",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 50,
            Default = 30,
            Suffix = function(Value: number): string
                return Value <= 1 and "stud" or "studs"
            end
        })

        AutoKit.Settings.soul_broker = {Mode, Range}
    end
end)()

    return function()
        local function Section(Name: string, Targets: boolean?): Module
            local Module: Module
            local Thread: thread?
            local Session: number = 0

            Module = Cat.Categories.Kits:CreateModule({
                Name = `Auto{Name}`,
                Function = function(Callback: boolean)
                    Session += 1
                    if Thread then
                        pcall(task.cancel, Thread)
                        Thread = nil
                    end
                    if not Callback then
                        return
                    end

                    local Current: number = Session
                    Module:Clean(Data.Events.KitChanged:Connect(function()
                        task.defer(function()
                            if Module.Enabled and Session == Current then
                                Module:Toggle()
                                Module:Toggle()
                            end
                        end)
                    end))

                    repeat
                        task.wait()
                    until (Data.Storage.MatchState ~= 0 and Data.Storage.EquippedKit ~= "") or Session ~= Current

                    local Run: (() -> ())? = Module.Kits[Data.Storage.EquippedKit]
                    if Session == Current and Run then
                        Thread = task.spawn(Run)
                    end
                end,
                Tooltip = `Uses the {(Name:gsub("(%l)(%u)", "%1 %2"))} kit abilities for you, only runs while you have that kit equipped`
            })
            Module.Kits, Module.Settings = {}, {}

                Module:CreateTargets({
                    Players = true,
                    Walls = true
                })
            end
