BundledModules.AutoMatchDodge = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services
    local LocalPlayer: Player = Services.Players.LocalPlayer

    local writefile = BundledModules.writefile
    local Hold: MatchHold = BundledModules.Hold

    local AutoMatchDodge
    local Mode, Timeout, Skill, RankCheck, Amount, Whitelist

    local Weights: {[string]: number} = {Win = 1, Combat = 0.5, Rank = 2, Kit = 1, KitPlays = 0.2, Experience = 0.15, Streak = 0.25, FinalKills = 0.5, BedBreaks = 0.5, Level = 0.2, Device = 0.4, Recent = 0.5}
    local Roles: {[string]: number} = {Juggernaut = 1, Breaker = 0.8, Defender = 0.6, Cycler = 0.5, Support = 0.4}
    local KitRoles: {[string]: {string}} = {
        Defender = {"black_market_trader", "slime_tamer", "hannah", "fisherman", "farmer_cletus", "spirit_gardener"},
        Cycler = {"fisherman", "metal_detector", "beekeeper", "cowgirl", "farmer_cletus", "steam_engineer", "spirit_gardener", "davey", "miner"},
        Breaker = {"davey", "oil_man", "santa", "dino_tamer", "smoke", "yeti", "glacial_skater", "elk_master", "mimic", "shielder", "airbender"},
        Support = {"baker", "soul_broker", "oasis", "melody", "hatter"},
        Juggernaut = {"frost_hammer_kit", "axolotl", "summoner", "bigman", "pinata", "tinker", "blood_assassin", "miner", "aery", "nazar", "barbarian", "ice_queen", "block_kicker", "seahorse", "void_knight"}
    }
    local Devices: {[string]: number} = {PC = 1, GAMEPAD = 0.5, MOBILE = 0}
    local Ignored: {[string]: boolean} = {none = true, random = true, [""] = true}
    local Hover: number = 0
    local Prior: number = 10

    local KitValue: {[string]: number} = {}
    for Role: string, List: {string} in KitRoles do
        for _, Kit: string in List do
            KitValue[Kit] = math.max(KitValue[Kit] or 0, Roles[Role])
        end
    end
    for Kit: string, Meta: any in Data.Instances.BedwarsKitMeta or {} do
        if Meta.kitClass == 2 then
            KitValue[Kit] = math.max(KitValue[Kit] or 0, Roles.Defender)
        end
    end

    local Profiles: {[Player]: Profile} = {}
    local TopDivision: number = 1
    for Division: any in Data.Instances.RankMeta or {} do
        if type(Division) == "number" and Division > TopDivision then
            TopDivision = Division
        end
    end

    local function Queue(): (string, any)
        local Teleport: any = Services.TeleportService:GetLocalPlayerTeleportData()
        local Match: any = type(Teleport) == "table" and (Teleport.match or Teleport.customMatch)
        local Type: string = Match and Match.queueType or Data.Controllers.Store:getState().Game.queueType or "bedwars_test"

        return Type, Data.Instances.QueueMeta[Type]
    end

    local function Fetch(Player: Player): Profile
        local Entry: Profile = Profiles[Player] or {Tries = 0, Retry = 0, Started = 0}
        Profiles[Player] = Entry

        local Now: number = os.clock()
        if Entry.Done or Entry.Pending and Now - Entry.Started < 10 or not Entry.Pending and Now < Entry.Retry then
            return Entry
        end
        if Entry.Tries >= 3 then
            Entry.Done = true

            return Entry
        end

        Entry.Pending, Entry.Started, Entry.Tries = true, Now, Entry.Tries + 1
        local Try: number = Entry.Tries
        task.spawn(function()
            local Success: boolean, Result: any = pcall(function(): any
                return Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("RequestProfileData"):CallServer(Player)
            end)
            local Ranked: boolean, Rank: any = pcall(function(): any
                return Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("FetchRanks"):CallServer({Player.UserId})
            end)
            if Entry.Tries ~= Try then
                return
            end

            Entry.Pending, Entry.Retry = false, os.clock() + 5
            if Success and type(Result) == "table" and type(Result.queues) == "table" then
                local Rows: {any} = {}
                for _, Match: any in Result.matchHistory or {} do
                    for _, Row: any in (not Match.matchCancelled and Match.players or {}) do
                        if Row.playerInfo and Row.playerInfo.userId == Result.userId then
                            table.insert(Rows, {Queue = Match.queueType, Outcome = Row.generic and Row.generic.matchOutcome, Kit = Row.bedwars and Row.bedwars.kit})

                            break
                        end
                    end
                end

                Entry.Data, Entry.Rows, Entry.Done = Result, Rows, true
                Entry.Rank = Ranked and type(Rank) == "table" and Rank[1] and Rank[1].rankDivision or nil
            end
        end)

        return Entry
    end

    local function Guess(Player: Player, Entry: Profile, Draft: any, Ranked: boolean): (string?, number)
        local Kit: string? = Player:GetAttribute("PlayingAsKits")
        if Kit and not Ignored[Kit] then
            return Kit, 1
        end

        local Id: string = tostring(Player.UserId)
        local Pick: any = Draft and Draft.teamData and Draft.teamData.kitSelection and Draft.teamData.kitSelection[Id]
        for _, Team: any in (not Pick and Draft and Draft.enemyTeamData or {}) do
            Pick = Team.kitSelection and Team.kitSelection[Id]
            if Pick then
                break
            end
        end
        if Pick and Pick.kit and Pick.selectorOption ~= Hover and not Ignored[Pick.kit] then
            return Pick.kit, 1
        end
        if not Ranked or not Entry.Data then
            return nil, 0
        end

        local Banned: {[string]: boolean} = {}
        for _, Kits: {string} in (Draft and Draft.sharedData and Draft.sharedData.kitBans or {}) do
            for _, v: string in Kits do
                Banned[v] = true
            end
        end
        local Counts: {[string]: number} = table.clone(Entry.Data.favoriteKitData or {})
        for _, Row: any in Entry.Rows or {} do
            if Row.Kit then
                Counts[Row.Kit] = (Counts[Row.Kit] or 0) + 1
            end
        end

        local Best: string?, Plays: number, Total: number = nil, 0, 0
        for Name: string, Count: number in Counts do
            if not Ignored[Name] then
                Total += Count
                if not Banned[Name] and Count > Plays then
                    Best, Plays = Name, Count
                end
            end
        end

        return Best, Plays / (Total + Prior)
    end

    local function Score(Player: Player, Entry: Profile, Context: {Queue: string, Baseline: number, Ranked: boolean, Draft: any}): number
        local Profile: any = Entry.Data
        if not Profile then
            return 0
        end

        local Baseline: number = Context.Baseline
        local Stats: any = Profile.queues[Context.Queue] or {}
        local Wins: number, Losses: number = Stats.wins or 0, Stats.losses or 0
        local Rate: number = (Wins + Baseline * Prior) / (Wins + Losses + Prior)
        local RecentWins: number, RecentLosses: number = 0, 0
        for _, Row: any in Entry.Rows or {} do
            if Row.Queue == Context.Queue then
                RecentWins += Row.Outcome == "win" and 1 or 0
                RecentLosses += Row.Outcome == "loss" and 1 or 0
            end
        end

        local Recent: number = (RecentWins + Baseline * Prior) / (RecentWins + RecentLosses + Prior)
        local Matches: number = (Stats.matches or 0) + Prior
        local Kit: string?, Confidence: number = Guess(Player, Entry, Context.Draft, Context.Ranked)
        local Device: string? = Player:GetAttribute("UserInputType") or Profile.platform
        local Parts: {[string]: number} = {
            Win = math.log(Rate * (1 - Baseline) / ((1 - Rate) * Baseline)),
            Combat = math.log(((Stats.kills or 0) + Prior) / ((Stats.deaths or 0) + Prior)),
            Rank = (Entry.Rank or 0) / TopDivision,
            Kit = (Kit and KitValue[Kit] or 0) * Confidence,
            KitPlays = math.log(1 + (Kit and Profile.favoriteKitData and Profile.favoriteKitData[Kit] or 0)) * Confidence,
            Experience = math.log(1 + (Profile.globalStats and Profile.globalStats.matches or 0)),
            Streak = math.log(1 + (Stats.currentWinStreak or 0)),
            FinalKills = math.log(1 + (Stats.finalKills or 0) / Matches),
            BedBreaks = math.log(1 + (Stats.bedBreaks or 0) / Matches),
            Level = math.log(1 + (Profile.level or 0)),
            Device = Device and Devices[Device] or 0,
            Recent = math.log(Recent * (1 - Baseline) / ((1 - Recent) * Baseline))
        }

        local Total: number = 0
        for Name: string, Value: number in Parts do
            Total += Value * Weights[Name]
        end

        return Total
    end

    local function Check(): string?
        local Type: string, Meta: any = Queue()
        local Ranked: boolean = Meta ~= nil and Meta.rankCategory ~= nil
        if RankCheck.Enabled and not Ranked then
            return nil
        end

        local State: any = Data.Controllers.Store:getState()
        local Team: any = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Team")
        if Skill.Enabled then
            local Context = {Queue = Type, Baseline = 1 / math.max(Meta and Meta.teams and #Meta.teams or 2, 2), Ranked = Ranked, Draft = State.Draft}
            local Mine: Profile = Fetch(LocalPlayer)
            local Better: number = 0
            for _, v: Player in Services.Players:GetPlayers() do
                local Other: any = v:GetAttribute("Team")
                if v ~= LocalPlayer and Other ~= nil and Other ~= Team and not v:GetAttribute("Spectator") then
                    local Theirs: Profile = Fetch(v)
                    if Mine.Done and Theirs.Done and Score(LocalPlayer, Mine, Context) < Score(v, Theirs, Context) then
                        Better += 1
                    end
                end
            end
            if Better > 1 then
                return "Dodging because multiple opponents are \"better\" than you"
            end
        end

        if Amount.Enabled and Team ~= nil then
            local Listed: {[string]: boolean} = {}
            for _, v: string in Whitelist.ListEnabled do
                Listed[v:lower()] = true
            end

            local Allies: number, Enemies: {[any]: number}, Present: number, Pending: boolean = 1, {}, 1, false
            for _, v: Player in Services.Players:GetPlayers() do
                local Other: any = v:GetAttribute("Team")
                if v ~= LocalPlayer and not v:GetAttribute("Spectator") then
                    Present += 1
                    if Listed[v.Name:lower()] or Other == Team then
                        Allies += 1
                    elseif Other == nil then
                        Pending = true
                    else
                        Enemies[Other] = (Enemies[Other] or 0) + 1
                    end
                end
            end

            local Expected: number = 0
            for _, v: any in State.Game.teams or {} do
                for _ in v.members or {} do
                    Expected += 1
                end
            end

            local Drafting: boolean = Meta and Meta.drafting and Meta.drafting.enabled or false
            local Ready: boolean = Present >= Expected and (not Drafting or (State.Draft and State.Draft.sharedData and State.Draft.sharedData.matchDraftPhase or 0) >= 3)
            local Largest: number = 0
            for _, Count: number in Enemies do
                Largest = math.max(Largest, Count)
            end
            if not Pending and Ready and Allies < Largest then
                return `Dodging because you have fewer players ({Allies}) than the enemy team ({Largest})`
            end
        end

        return nil
    end

    AutoMatchDodge = Cat.Categories.Utility:CreateModule({
        Name = "AutoMatchDodge",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if not Cat.Ui.Dead then
                pcall(writefile, Hold.Flag, tostring(Callback))
            end

            if not Callback then
                Hold.Release()

                return
            end
            if not Hold.Held then
                return
            end

            Hold.Claimed = true
            local Deadline: number = Hold.Started + Timeout.Value
            repeat
                if Mode.Value == "Auto" then
                    local Reason: string? = Check()
                    if Reason then
                        Cat:CreateNotification("AutoMatchDodge", Reason, 12, "info")

                        break
                    end
                    if os.clock() > Deadline then
                        Hold.Release()

                        break
                    end
                end

                task.wait(0.1)
            until not AutoMatchDodge.Enabled or not Hold.Held
        end,
        ExtraText = function(): string
            return Hold.Held and "Dodging" or "Loaded"
        end,
        Tooltip = "Holds you on the loading screen so you can leave a match before it counts"
    })

    Cat:Clean(function()
        Hold.Release()
    end)

    Mode = AutoMatchDodge:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Mode",
        List = {"Auto", "Manual"},
        Default = "Auto",
        Function = function(Value: string)
            for _, v: any in {Timeout, Skill, RankCheck, Amount} do
                if v and v.Object then
                    v.Object.Visible = Value == "Auto"
                end
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Auto loads in after the timeout unless a check says to dodge, Manual waits for you to press Load"
    })
    AutoMatchDodge:CreateButton({
        Name = "Load",
        Function = function()
            Hold.Release()
        end,
        Tooltip = "Loads into this match now"
    })
    Timeout = AutoMatchDodge:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Load timeout",
        Min = 1,
        Max = 90,
        Default = 45,
        Suffix = function(Value: number): string
            return Value <= 1 and "sec" or "secs"
        end,
        Tooltip = "Loads into the match after this long unless a check says to dodge"
    })
    Skill = AutoMatchDodge:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Skill check",
        Default = true,
        Tooltip = "Dodges when more than one opponent looks \"better\" than you from their stats (not 100% accurate)"
    })
    RankCheck = AutoMatchDodge:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Rank check",
        Default = true,
        Tooltip = "Only dodges in ranked queues, any other match just loads"
    })
    Amount = AutoMatchDodge:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Player check",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Whitelist and Whitelist.Object then
                Whitelist.Object.Visible = Callback
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Dodges when your team has fewer players than an enemy team"
    })
    Whitelist = AutoMatchDodge:CreateTextList({
        Name = "Players whitelist",
        Visible = false,
        Tooltip = "Players that will be on your team if they are in the server"
    })
end)()

BundledModules.AutoPearl = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services
    local LocalPlayer: Player = Services.Players.LocalPlayer

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity
    local Ballistic = BundledModules.Ballistic
    local Inventory = BundledModules.Inventory
    local Ping = BundledModules.Ping
    local Projectile = BundledModules.Projectile
    local SlotController = BundledModules.SlotController

    local AutoPearl
    local Legit, Back, LandCheck, Check, BackDelay, Limit

    local Params: RaycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    Params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

    local function GetThrow(Position: Vector3, Anchor: Vector3): Vector3?
        local Speed: number = Data.Instances.ProjectileMeta.telepearl.launchVelocity
        local Gravity: number = Data.Instances.ProjectileMeta.telepearl.gravitationalAcceleration or 196.2

        for _, Radius: number in {0, 6, 12, 18, 24, 30, 36} do
            for Angle: number = 0, Radius > 0 and 7 or 0 do
                local Offset: Vector3 = Vector3.new(math.cos(Angle * math.pi / 4), 0, math.sin(Angle * math.pi / 4)) * Radius
                local Ground: RaycastResult? = workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(Position.X, Anchor.Y + 3, Position.Z) + Offset, Vector3.new(0, -300, 0), Params)

                if not Ground then
                    continue
                end

                local Direction: Vector3?, Time: number = Ballistic.Point(Position, Ground.Position, Speed, Gravity)
                if Direction then
                    local Clear: boolean, Hit: RaycastResult? = Ballistic.Clear(Position, Direction * Speed, Gravity, Time, Params)
                    if Clear or Hit and (Hit.Position - Ground.Position).Magnitude < 5 then
                        return Direction * Speed
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        return nil
    end

    local function Fire(Anchor: Vector3, Item)
        if Check.Enabled then
            for _, v: Instance in workspace:GetChildren() do
                if v.Name == "telepearl" and v:GetAttribute("ProjectileShooter") == LocalPlayer.UserId then
                    return
                end
            end
        end

        if GetThrow(Entity.RootPart.Position, Anchor) and (not SlotController.Owner or SlotController.Owner == "AutoPearl" or tick() >= SlotController.Expires) then
            SlotController.Owner, SlotController.Expires = "AutoPearl", tick() + 3

            local OldTool: Tool? = Data.Storage.Hand.Tool
            SlotController.Switch(Item.tool, 0)

            if Legit.Enabled then
                SlotController.Select(Item.tool)
            end

            task.wait(math.max(0.04, (Ping.Get())))

            if Entity.Alive then
                local Position: Vector3 = Entity.RootPart.Position
                local Velocity: Vector3? = GetThrow(Position, Anchor)
                local Thrown: Instance? = Velocity and Projectile.Fire(Item, "telepearl", "telepearl", Position, Velocity) or nil

                if Back.Enabled and LandCheck.Enabled and Thrown then
                    local Timeout: number = tick() + 10
                    repeat
                        task.wait()
                    until not AutoPearl.Enabled or tick() >= Timeout or not Thrown.Parent
                end

                if Back.Enabled and OldTool then
                    task.wait(BackDelay:GetRandomValue())

                    SlotController.Switch(OldTool)

                    if Legit.Enabled then
                        SlotController.Select(OldTool)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    AutoPearl = Cat.Categories.Utility:CreateModule({
        Name = "AutoPearl",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback then
                local Thrown: boolean = false
                local Anchor: Vector3?

                repeat
                    task.wait()
                    if Data.Storage.Map and Params.FilterDescendantsInstances[1] ~= Data.Storage.Map then
                        Params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {Data.Storage.Map}
                    end
                    if Entity.Alive and Data.Storage.Map and not (Limit.Enabled and (not Data.Storage.Hand.Tool or Data.Storage.Hand.Tool.Name ~= "telepearl")) then
                        if Entity.Humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
                            Anchor = Entity.RootPart.Position
                        end

                        if Anchor and Entity.RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y <= -98 and not workspace:Raycast(Entity.RootPart.Position, Vector3.new(0, -60, 0), Params) then
                            if not Thrown then
                                Thrown = true

                                local Pearl: InventoryItem? = Inventory.Item("telepearl")
                                if Pearl and Pearl.tool then
                                    Fire(Anchor, Pearl)
                                end
                            end
                        else
                            Thrown = false
                        end
                    end
                until not AutoPearl.Enabled
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Automatically throws a pearl onto nearby ground after\nfalling a certain distance."
    })

    Check = AutoPearl:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Pearl check",
        Default = true,
        Tooltip = "Won't throw another pearl while one of yours is still flying"
    })
    Limit = AutoPearl:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Limit to item",
        Tooltip = "Only throws while you're holding a pearl"
    })
    Legit = AutoPearl:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Legit switch",
        Default = true,
        Tooltip = "Shows the switch to the pearl on your own screen too"
    })
    Back = AutoPearl:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Switch back",
        Default = true,
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            for _, v: any in {BackDelay, LandCheck} do
                if v and v.Object then
                    v.Object.Visible = Callback
                end
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Goes back to what you were holding after the throw"
    })
    BackDelay = AutoPearl:CreateTwoSlider({
        Name = "Switch back delay",
        Min = 0,
        Max = 2,
        DefaultMin = 0.1,
        DefaultMax = 0.2,
        Decimal = 100,
        Darker = true,
        Visible = Back.Enabled,
        Tooltip = "Random wait in seconds between both ends before switching back"
    })
    LandCheck = AutoPearl:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Wait for landing",
        Darker = true,
        Visible = Back.Enabled,
        Tooltip = "Holds the pearl until it lands, then switches back"
    })
end)()

BundledModules.AutoQueue = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services
    local LocalPlayer: Player = Services.Players.LocalPlayer

    local AutoQueue
    local Delay, Random

    local Pending, NextJoin = false, 0

    local function Join()
        if Pending then
            return
        end

        Pending = true

        task.delay(Delay.Value, function()
            Pending = false

            local State: any = Data.Controllers.Store:getState()
            if not AutoQueue.Enabled or os.clock() < NextJoin or State.Game.customMatch or State.Party.leader.userId ~= LocalPlayer.UserId or State.Party.queueState ~= 0 then
                return
            end

            NextJoin = os.clock() + 5
            if not Random.Enabled then
                Data.Controllers.QueueController:joinQueue(State.Game.queueType)

                return
            end

            local Modes: {string} = {}
            for i: string, v: any in Data.Instances.QueueMeta do
                if not v.disabled and not v.voiceChatOnly and not v.rankCategory then
                    table.insert(Modes, i)
                end
            end

            Data.Controllers.QueueController:joinQueue(Modes[math.random(1, #Modes)])
        end)
    end

    AutoQueue = Cat.Categories.Utility:CreateModule({
        Name = "AutoQueue",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback then
                AutoQueue:Clean(Data.Events.EntityDeathEvent:Connect(function(Event: {finalKill: boolean?, entityInstance: Instance?})
                    if Event.finalKill and Event.entityInstance == LocalPlayer.Character and #Data.Controllers.Store:getState().Party.members <= 0 and Data.Storage.MatchState ~= 2 then
                        Join()
                    end
                end))
                AutoQueue:Clean(Data.Events.MatchEndEvent:Connect(Join))
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Automatically queues after the match ends."
    })

    Delay = AutoQueue:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Delay",
        Min = 0,
        Max = 10,
        Default = 0,
        Decimal = 10,
        Suffix = function(Value: number)
            return Value == 1 and "second" or "seconds"
        end,
        Tooltip = "How long to wait after the match ends, or after your final death when you are solo, before queueing"
    })
    Random = AutoQueue:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Random",
        Tooltip = "Chooses a random mode"
    })
end)()

BundledModules.AutoShoot = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity
    local Ballistic = BundledModules.Ballistic
    local Ping = BundledModules.Ping
    local Shots = BundledModules.Shots
    local SlotController = BundledModules.SlotController

    local AutoShoot
    local Targets, Projectiles, UseKit, FireRate, ChargeDelay, SwitchDelay

    local Listener: any?
    local FireDelays: {[string]: number} = {}
    local Session: number = 0
    local Swapped: boolean = false
    local Arc: RaycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    Arc.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

    local function Matches(Names: {string?}): boolean
        for _, v: string in Projectiles.ListEnabled do
            local Needle: string = (tostring(v):lower():gsub("[_%s]+", " "))
            if #Needle == 0 then
                continue
            end

            for _, Name: string? in Names do
                local Clean: string? = Name and (tostring(Name):lower():gsub("[_%s]+", " "))
                if Clean and (Clean == Needle or (` {Clean}`):find(` {Needle}`, 1, true)) then
                    return true
                end
            end
        end

        return false
    end

    local function Pick(): Target?
        local Root: BasePart = Entity.RootPart
        local Found: {Target} = Entity.Targets({
            Origin = Root.Position,
            Range = 22,
            Players = Targets.Players.Enabled,
            NPCs = Targets.NPCs.Enabled,
            Priority = Targets.Priority.Value,
            Wallcheck = Targets.Walls.Enabled,
            Limit = 10
        })

        local Look: Vector3 = Root.CFrame.LookVector * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
        for _, v: Target in Found do
            local Delta: Vector3 = (v.RootPart.Position - Root.Position) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
            local Angle: number = Look.Magnitude > 0 and Delta.Magnitude > 0 and math.acos(math.clamp(Look.Unit:Dot(Delta.Unit), -1, 1)) or 0
            if Angle <= math.rad(60) then
                return v
            end
        end

        return nil
    end

    AutoShoot = Cat.Categories.Utility:CreateModule({
        Name = "AutoShoot",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            Session += 1
            Swapped = false

            if Callback then
                local Current: number = Session

                Listener = Data.Instances.SyncEvents.BeginProjectileTargeting:setPriority(1000):connect(function(Event: any)
                    if Swapped then
                        Event:setCancelled(true)
                    end
                end)

                local SwingStart: number? = nil
                local Required: number = 0
                repeat
                    local Swinging: boolean = Entity.Alive and Data.Storage.Hand.Type == "sword" and tick() - Data.Controllers.SwordController.lastSwing < 0.2
                    if not Swinging then
                        SwingStart = nil
                    elseif not SwingStart then
                        SwingStart = os.clock()
                        Required = ChargeDelay:GetRandomValue()
                    end

                    if SwingStart and os.clock() - SwingStart >= Required then
                        local OldTool: Tool? = Data.Storage.Hand.Tool
                        local OldSlot: number = Data.Storage.Inventory.hotbarSlot
                        for _, Shot: AuraShot in Shots.List(UseKit.Enabled, Matches) do
                            local Id: string = Shot.Source.cooldownId or `{Shot.Item.itemType}-proj-source`
                            local Ready: boolean = (FireDelays[Shot.Item.itemType] or 0) < os.clock() and not Data.Controllers.AbilityController.cooldownController:isOnCooldown(Id)
                            local Free: boolean = not SlotController.Owner or SlotController.Owner == "AutoShoot" or tick() >= SlotController.Expires
                            local Target: Target? = Ready and Free and Entity.Alive and Pick() or nil
                            local Equipped: boolean = false
                            for _, v: any in (Data.Storage.Inventory.hotbar or {}) do
                                Equipped = Equipped or (v.item ~= nil and v.item.tool == Shot.Item.tool)
                            end

                            if Target and Equipped then
                                SlotController.Owner, SlotController.Expires = "AutoShoot", tick() + 1
                                if Data.Storage.Hand.Tool ~= Shot.Item.tool then
                                    Swapped = true
                                    SlotController.Switch(Shot.Item.tool, 0)
                                    SlotController.Select(Shot.Item.tool)
                                    task.wait(math.max(0.04, (Ping.Get())))
                                end

                                local Meta: any = Data.Instances.ProjectileMeta[Shot.Projectile]
                                if Meta and type(Meta.launchVelocity) == "number" and Entity.Alive and Target.RootPart.Parent and Data.Storage.Hand.Tool == Shot.Item.tool then
                                    local Gravity: number = Meta.gravitationalAcceleration or 196.2
                                    local Origin: Vector3 = Entity.RootPart.Position
                                    local Offset: Vector3 = Vector3.new(-(Data.Instances.BowConstants.RelX or 0), -(Data.Instances.BowConstants.RelY or 0), -(Data.Instances.BowConstants.RelZ or 0))
                                    local Launch: Vector3 = (CFrame.new(Origin, Target.RootPart.Position) * CFrame.new(Offset)).Position
                                    local Direction: Vector3?, Time: number = Ballistic.Solve(Target, Launch, Meta.launchVelocity, Gravity, true)
                                    local Ignore: {Instance} = {workspace.CurrentCamera, Entity.Character}
                                    for _, v: Target in Entity.Entities do
                                        if v.Character then
                                            table.insert(Ignore, v.Character)
                                        end
                                    end
                                    Arc.FilterDescendantsInstances = Ignore

                                    if Direction and Time <= (Meta.lifetimeSec or 3) and Ballistic.Clear(Launch, Direction * Meta.launchVelocity, Gravity, Time, Arc) then
                                        local Velocity: Vector3 = Direction * Meta.launchVelocity
                                        local Shotid: string = Data.Controllers.IdUtil.generateId(8)
                                        local Watcher: RBXScriptConnection? = Shots.Watch(Shotid, Launch, Velocity, Gravity, Target, Meta.lifetimeSec, Arc)
                                        if Watcher then
                                            AutoShoot:Clean(Watcher)
                                        end

                                        FireDelays[Shot.Item.itemType] = os.clock() + (Shot.Source.fireDelaySec or 0.1) + FireRate:GetRandomValue()
                                        SwingStart = nil
                                        task.spawn(function()
                                            local Success: boolean, Response: any = pcall(function()
                                                local Stamp: number = workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - Ping.Get() / 10
                                                local Payload: {shotId: string, drawDurationSec: number} = {
                                                    shotId = Data.Controllers.IdUtil.generateId(8),
                                                    drawDurationSec = math.max(1, Shot.Source.maxStrengthChargeSec or 0)
                                                }

                                                return Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("ProjectileFire"):CallServer(Shot.Item.tool, Shot.Ammo, Shot.Projectile, Launch, Origin, Velocity, Shotid, Payload, Stamp)
                                            end)

                                            if Success and type(Response) == "table" and Response.accepted then
                                                Shots.Launch(Shot.Item, Shot.Source)
                                                Data.Controllers.AbilityController.cooldownController:setOnCooldown(Id, Shot.Source.fireDelaySec or 0.1, {})
                                            end
                                        end)

                                        task.wait(SwitchDelay:GetRandomValue())
                                    end
                                end

                                if OldTool and OldTool ~= Shot.Item.tool then
                                    SlotController.Switch(OldTool, 0)
                                    Data.Controllers.Store:dispatch({type = "InventorySelectHotbarSlot", slot = OldSlot})

                                    local Deadline: number = os.clock() + 0.5
                                    repeat
                                        task.wait()
                                    until Data.Storage.Hand.Tool ~= Shot.Item.tool or os.clock() >= Deadline
                                end

                                Swapped = false
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    task.wait(0.02)
                until not AutoShoot.Enabled or Session ~= Current
            else
                if Listener then
                    Listener:Destroy()
                end

                Listener = nil
                table.clear(FireDelays)
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Shoots your bow or snowballs at enemies in front of you while you swing a sword"
    })

    Targets = AutoShoot:CreateTargets({
        Players = true,
        Walls = true
    })
    Projectiles = AutoShoot:CreateTextList({
        Name = "Projectiles",
        Default = {"arrow", "snowball"}
    })
    UseKit = AutoShoot:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Use Kit Items",
        Tooltip = "Also shoots items that belong to a kit, like frost staffs, spellbooks and chakrams"
    })
    FireRate = AutoShoot:CreateTwoSlider({
        Name = "Fire Rate",
        Min = 0,
        Max = 1,
        DefaultMin = 0.05,
        DefaultMax = 0.12,
        Decimal = 100
    })
    ChargeDelay = AutoShoot:CreateTwoSlider({
        Name = "Charge Delay",
        Min = 0,
        Max = 2,
        DefaultMin = 0.25,
        DefaultMax = 0.75,
        Decimal = 100,
        Tooltip = "How long your sword has to swing for before auto swapping"
    })
    SwitchDelay = AutoShoot:CreateTwoSlider({
        Name = "Switch Delay",
        Min = 0,
        Max = 1,
        DefaultMin = 0.02,
        DefaultMax = 0.04,
        Decimal = 100,
        Suffix = "seconds"
    })
end)()

BundledModules.AutoVoidDrop = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity
    local Fall = BundledModules.Fall
    local Inventory = BundledModules.Inventory

    local AutoVoidDrop
    local Owl, Reset

    local Resources: {string} = {"emerald", "diamond", "gold", "iron"}

    local function Drop(): boolean
        local Dropped: boolean = false
        for _, v: string in Resources do
            local Item: InventoryItem? = Inventory.Item(v)
            if Item then
                local Success: boolean, Result: any = pcall(function(): any
                    return Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("DropItem"):CallServer({
                        item = Item.tool,
                        amount = Item.amount
                    })
                end)
                if Success and Result then
                    if typeof(Result) == "Instance" then
                        Result:SetAttribute("ClientDropTime", tick() + 100)
                    end
                    Dropped = true
                end
            end
        end

        return Dropped
    end

    AutoVoidDrop = Cat.Categories.Utility:CreateModule({
        Name = "AutoVoidDrop",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if not Callback then
                return
            end

            local Map: Instance?, Void: number = nil, -math.huge
            local Handled: Model? = nil

            repeat
                if Data.Storage.MatchState ~= 0 and Data.Storage.Map and Map ~= Data.Storage.Map then
                    Map = Data.Storage.Map
                    Void = Fall.Floor(Map :: Instance)
                end

                local Character: Model? = Entity.Alive and Entity.Character or nil
                local Falling: boolean = Character ~= nil and Entity.RootPart.Position.Y < Void
                if Character and Map and Falling and Handled ~= Character then
                    local Lifted: boolean = (Character:GetAttribute("InflatedBalloons") or 0) > 0 or Inventory.Item("balloon") ~= nil or (Cat.Modules.Fly ~= nil and Cat.Modules.Fly.Enabled)
                    local Owned: boolean = Owl.Enabled and Entity.RootPart:FindFirstChild("OwlLiftForce") ~= nil
                    if not Lifted and not Owned then
                        Handled = Character
                        Drop()

                        if Reset.Enabled and Entity.Alive and Entity.Character == Character then
                            Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("ResetCharacter"):SendToServer()
                        end
                    end
                end

                task.wait(0.1)
            until not AutoVoidDrop.Enabled
        end,
        Tooltip = "Drops your iron, gold, diamonds and emeralds when you fall into the void so your team can pick them up"
    })

    Owl = AutoVoidDrop:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Owl check",
        Default = true,
        Tooltip = "Keeps your items while an owl is carrying you"
    })
    Reset = AutoVoidDrop:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Reset",
        Tooltip = "Resets your character right after dropping so you respawn sooner"
    })
end)()

BundledModules.CheatDetector = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services
    local LocalPlayer: Player = Services.LocalPlayer

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity
    local Ping = BundledModules.Ping
    local Hitreg = BundledModules.Hitreg

    local CheatDetector
    local Strictness
    local Toggles: {[string]: any} = {}

    local Session: number = 0
    local LastDamaged: {[Player]: number} = {}
    local LastPlaced: {[Player]: number} = {}
    local Params: RaycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    Params.RespectCanCollide = true
    Params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

    local Margins: {[string]: {speed: number, reach: number, hits: number, interval: number}} = {
        Lenient = {speed = 10, reach = 3, hits = 6, interval = 0.06},
        Balanced = {speed = 6, reach = 2, hits = 4, interval = 0.04},
        Strict = {speed = 3, reach = 1, hits = 3, interval = 0.02}
    }

    local function Exempt(v: Target, Allowance: number): boolean
        local Player: Player? = v.Player
        local Character: Model? = v.Character
        if not Player or v.Self or not Character or not v.RootPart or not v.Alive then
            return true
        end
        if Data.Storage.MatchState ~= 1 or Ping.Get() > 0.35 or Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField") then
            return true
        end
        if workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - (Player:GetAttribute("LastTeleported") or 0) <= Allowance then
            return true
        end
        if os.clock() - (LastDamaged[Player] or 0) < 1.5 then
            return true
        end

        local Humanoid: Humanoid? = v.Humanoid
        local Riding: boolean = Humanoid ~= nil and Humanoid.SeatPart ~= nil
        return Riding or (Character:GetAttribute("InflatedBalloons") or 0) > 0 or Character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("VehicleSeat", true) ~= nil
    end

    local function Inventory(Player: Player): (Tool?, any)
        local Success: boolean, Items: any = pcall(Data.Controllers.InventoryUtil.getInventory, Player)
        if Success and Items then
            local Hand: any = Items.hand
            return Hand and Hand.tool or nil, Items
        end

        return nil, nil
    end

    local Methods: {[string]: (number) -> ()} = {
        Speed = function(Current: number)
            local Histories: {[Player]: {Time: number, Position: Vector3}} = {}
            local Strikes: {[Player]: number} = {}
            local Notified: {[Player]: number} = {}

            repeat
                local Lag: number = math.clamp(Ping.Get(), 0, 0.5)
                local Margin: {speed: number, reach: number, hits: number, interval: number} = Margins[Strictness.Value]
                for _, v: Target in Entity.Entities do
                    local Player: Player? = v.Player
                    if Toggles.Speed.Enabled and not Exempt(v, 1.5) then
                        local Position: Vector3 = v.RootPart.Position * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
                        local Now: number = os.clock()
                        local Last: any = Histories[Player]
                        if Last and (Now - Last.Time) >= (0.25 + Lag) then
                            local Humanoid: Humanoid? = v.Humanoid
                            if Humanoid and Humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
                                local Limit: number = (math.max(Humanoid.WalkSpeed, 20) + Margin.speed) * (1 + Lag)
                                if ((Position - Last.Position).Magnitude / (Now - Last.Time)) > Limit then
                                    Strikes[Player] = (Strikes[Player] or 0) + 1
                                    if Strikes[Player] > Margin.hits and Now > (Notified[Player] or 0) then
                                        Notified[Player] = Now + 20
                                        Cat:CreateNotification("CheatDetector", `{Player.Name} may be speeding (held over {math.round(Limit)} studs a second)`, 10, "alert")
                                    end
                                else
                                    Strikes[Player] = math.max((Strikes[Player] or 0) - 1, 0)
                                end
                            end
                        end

                        if not Last or (Now - Last.Time) >= (0.25 + Lag) then
                            Histories[Player] = {Time = Now, Position = Position}
                        end
                    elseif Player then
                        Histories[Player], Strikes[Player] = nil, 0
                    end
                end

                task.wait(0.1)
            until Session ~= Current
        end,
        Killaura = function()
            local Attacks: {[Player]: number} = {}
            local Strikes: {[Player]: number} = {}
            local Notified: {[Player]: number} = {}
            local Swings: {[Player]: number} = {}

            CheatDetector:Clean(Data.Events.EntityDamageEvent:Connect(function(Event: {damageType: number, fromEntity: Model?, entityInstance: Model?})
                if Event.damageType ~= 0 or not Event.fromEntity then
                    return
                end

                local Attacker: Player? = Services.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(Event.fromEntity)
                local Victim: Player? = Event.entityInstance and Services.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(Event.entityInstance)
                if Victim then
                    LastDamaged[Victim] = os.clock()
                end

                if Toggles.Killaura.Enabled and Attacker and Attacker ~= LocalPlayer and Ping.Get() <= 0.35 then
                    local Now: number = os.clock()
                    if Swings[Attacker] and (Now - Swings[Attacker]) < 0.05 then
                        return
                    end

                    Swings[Attacker] = Now

                    local Tool: Tool? = Inventory(Attacker)
                    local Meta: any = Tool and Data.Instances.Items[Tool.Name]
                    local Speed: number = Tool and Hitreg.Constants.Fixed[Tool.Name] or Meta and Meta.sword and Meta.sword.attackSpeed or 0.3
                    local Margin: {speed: number, reach: number, hits: number, interval: number} = Margins[Strictness.Value]
                    local Previous: number? = Attacks[Attacker]
                    Attacks[Attacker] = Now

                    if Previous then
                        if (Now - Previous) >= (Speed - Margin.interval) then
                            Strikes[Attacker] = math.max((Strikes[Attacker] or 0) - 1, 0)
                        else
                            Strikes[Attacker] = (Strikes[Attacker] or 0) + 1
                            task.delay(45, function()
                                if CheatDetector.Enabled and Strikes[Attacker] then
                                    Strikes[Attacker] = math.max(Strikes[Attacker] - 1, 0)
                                end
                            end)

                            if Strikes[Attacker] > Margin.hits and Now > (Notified[Attacker] or 0) then
                                Notified[Attacker] = Now + 20
                                Cat:CreateNotification("CheatDetector", `{Attacker.Name} may be using killaura (swung faster than the weapon allows)`, 10, "alert")
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end))
        end,
        Reach = function()
            local Strikes: {[Player]: number} = {}
            local Notified: {[Player]: number} = {}

            CheatDetector:Clean(Data.Events.EntityDamageEvent:Connect(function(Event: {damageType: number, fromEntity: Model?, entityInstance: Model?})
                if Event.damageType ~= 0 or not Event.fromEntity or not Toggles.Reach.Enabled or Ping.Get() > 0.35 then
                    return
                end

                local Player: Player? = Services.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(Event.fromEntity)
                local AttackerPart: BasePart? = Event.fromEntity.PrimaryPart
                local VictimPart: BasePart? = Event.entityInstance and Event.entityInstance.PrimaryPart
                if Player and Player ~= LocalPlayer and AttackerPart and VictimPart then
                    local Warped: boolean = (workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - (Player:GetAttribute("LastTeleported") or 0)) <= 1
                    if Warped or (os.clock() - (LastDamaged[Player] or 0)) < 1.5 then
                        return
                    end

                    local Tool: Tool? = Inventory(Player)
                    local Meta: any = Tool and Data.Instances.Items[Tool.Name]
                    local Range: number = Meta and Meta.sword and Meta.sword.attackRange or Data.Instances.CombatConstant.RAYCAST_SWORD_CHARACTER_DISTANCE
                    local Distance: number = (AttackerPart.Position - VictimPart.Position).Magnitude
                    if Distance <= ((Range + Margins[Strictness.Value].reach) * (1 + Ping.Get())) then
                        Strikes[Player] = math.max((Strikes[Player] or 0) - 1, 0)
                    else
                        Strikes[Player] = (Strikes[Player] or 0) + 1
                        task.delay(45, function()
                            if CheatDetector.Enabled and Strikes[Player] then
                                Strikes[Player] = math.max(Strikes[Player] - 1, 0)
                            end
                        end)

                        if Strikes[Player] >= 3 and os.clock() > (Notified[Player] or 0) then
                            Notified[Player] = os.clock() + 20
                            Cat:CreateNotification("CheatDetector", `{Player.Name} may be using reach (landed hits from {math.round(Distance)} studs)`, 10, "alert")
                        end
                    end
                end
            end))
        end,
        Fly = function(Current: number)
            local Histories: {[Player]: {Y: number, Sign: number}} = {}
            local Strikes: {[Player]: number} = {}
            local Notified: {[Player]: number} = {}

            repeat
                local Margin: {speed: number, reach: number, hits: number, interval: number} = Margins[Strictness.Value]
                for _, v: Target in Entity.Entities do
                    local Player: Player? = v.Player
                    if Toggles.Fly.Enabled and not Exempt(v, 1.5) then
                        local Position: Vector3 = v.RootPart.Position
                        local Velocity: Vector3 = v.RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                        local Sign: number = Velocity.Y >= 0 and 1 or -1
                        local Last: any = Histories[Player]

                        if Last then
                            local Hovering: boolean = math.abs(Position.Y - Last.Y) < 0.4
                            local Flipped: boolean = Sign ~= Last.Sign and math.abs(Velocity.Y) > 3
                            local Cell: Vector3 = Data.Controllers.BlockController:getBlockPosition(Position - Vector3.new(0, 4, 0))
                            local Supported: boolean = Data.Controllers.BlockController:getStore():getBlockAt(Cell) ~= nil

                            Params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {v.Character, LocalPlayer.Character, workspace.CurrentCamera}
                            if Hovering and not Supported and not workspace:Raycast(Position, Vector3.new(0, -18, 0), Params) then
                                Strikes[Player] = (Strikes[Player] or 0) + (Flipped and 2 or 1)
                                if Strikes[Player] > (Margin.hits * 3) and os.clock() > (Notified[Player] or 0) then
                                    Notified[Player] = os.clock() + 20
                                    Cat:CreateNotification("CheatDetector", `{Player.Name} may be using fly (held altitude in mid air)`, 10, "alert")
                                end
                            else
                                Strikes[Player] = math.max((Strikes[Player] or 0) - 1, 0)
                            end
                        end

                        Histories[Player] = {Y = Position.Y, Sign = Sign}
                    elseif Player then
                        Histories[Player], Strikes[Player] = nil, 0
                    end
                end

                task.wait(0.15)
            until Session ~= Current
        end,
        FastBreak = function()
            local LastBreak: {[Player]: number} = {}
            local Strikes: {[Player]: number} = {}
            local Notified: {[Player]: number} = {}

            CheatDetector:Clean(Data.Instances.Network.BreakBlockEventZap.On(function(_: Vector3, ...)
                local Player: any = select(4, ...)
                if not Toggles.FastBreak.Enabled or typeof(Player) ~= "Instance" or Player == LocalPlayer or Ping.Get() > 0.35 then
                    return
                end

                local Now: number = os.clock()
                local Previous: number? = LastBreak[Player]
                LastBreak[Player] = Now

                if Previous and (Now - Previous) >= 0.02 then
                    local Tool: Tool? = Inventory(Player)
                    local Meta: any = Tool and Data.Instances.Items[Tool.Name]
                    local Best: number = 2
                    for _, Value: any in Meta and Meta.breakBlock or {} do
                        if type(Value) == "number" and Value > Best then
                            Best = Value
                        end
                    end

                    local Allowed: number = math.max(0.3 - (Best * 0.02) - math.clamp(Ping.Get(), 0, 0.2), 0.08)
                    if (Now - Previous) >= Allowed then
                        Strikes[Player] = math.max((Strikes[Player] or 0) - 1, 0)
                    else
                        Strikes[Player] = (Strikes[Player] or 0) + 1
                        task.delay(45, function()
                            if CheatDetector.Enabled and Strikes[Player] then
                                Strikes[Player] = math.max(Strikes[Player] - 1, 0)
                            end
                        end)

                        if Strikes[Player] >= Margins[Strictness.Value].hits and Now > (Notified[Player] or 0) then
                            Notified[Player] = Now + 20
                            Cat:CreateNotification("CheatDetector", `{Player.Name} may be using fastbreak (broke blocks under {math.round(Allowed * 1000)} ms apart)`, 10, "alert")
                        end
                    end
                end
            end))
        end,
        Scaffold = function()
            local Strikes: {[Player]: number} = {}
            local Notified: {[Player]: number} = {}

            CheatDetector:Clean(Services.CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal("block"):Connect(function(Block: Instance)
                task.defer(function()
                    local Player: Player? = Services.Players:GetPlayerByUserId(Block:GetAttribute("PlacedByUserId") or 0)
                    if not Toggles.Scaffold.Enabled or not Player or Player == LocalPlayer or Ping.Get() > 0.35 then
                        return
                    end

                    LastPlaced[Player] = os.clock()

                    local Tool: Tool?, Items: any = Inventory(Player)
                    local Meta: any = Tool and Data.Instances.Items[Tool.Name]
                    if not Meta or Meta.block then
                        return
                    end

                    local Holding: boolean = false
                    for _, Item: any in Items.items or {} do
                        local ItemMeta: any = Data.Instances.Items[Item.itemType]
                        if ItemMeta and ItemMeta.block then
                            Holding = true

                            break
                        end
                    end

                    if Holding then
                        Strikes[Player] = (Strikes[Player] or 0) + 1
                        task.delay(45, function()
                            if CheatDetector.Enabled and Strikes[Player] then
                                Strikes[Player] = math.max(Strikes[Player] - 1, 0)
                            end
                        end)

                        if Strikes[Player] >= (Margins[Strictness.Value].hits + 2) and os.clock() > (Notified[Player] or 0) then
                            Notified[Player] = os.clock() + 20
                            Cat:CreateNotification("CheatDetector", `{Player.Name} may be using scaffold (placed blocks without holding one)`, 10, "alert")
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end))
        end,
        ChestSteal = function()
            local Flagged: {[Player]: number} = {}
            local Bursts: {[Instance]: {Time: number, Count: number, Notified: boolean?}} = {}

            local function Added(Chest: Instance)
                task.spawn(function()
                    local FolderValue: ObjectValue? = Chest:WaitForChild("ChestFolderValue", 10) :: ObjectValue?
                    local Folder: Instance? = FolderValue and FolderValue.Value
                    if not Folder or not CheatDetector.Enabled or not Chest:IsA("BasePart") then
                        return
                    end

                    CheatDetector:Clean(Folder.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(Item: Instance)
                        if not Toggles.ChestSteal.Enabled or not Item:IsA("Accessory") or not Folder.Parent or not Chest.Parent then
                            return
                        end

                        local Burst: any = Bursts[Folder]
                        if not Burst or os.clock() > Burst.Time then
                            Burst = {Time = os.clock() + 0.05, Count = 0}
                            Bursts[Folder] = Burst
                        end

                        Burst.Count += 1
                        if Burst.Count >= 6 and not Burst.Notified then
                            Burst.Notified = true

                            local Looter: Target? = Entity.Targets({
                                Origin = Chest.Position,
                                Range = 120,
                                Players = true,
                                Teammates = true,
                                Sort = "Distance"
                            })[1]
                            if Looter and Looter.Player and Looter.RootPart then
                                local Distance: number = (Chest.Position - Looter.RootPart.Position).Magnitude
                                if Distance >= 16 and os.clock() >= (Flagged[Looter.Player] or 0) then
                                    Flagged[Looter.Player] = os.clock() + 15
                                    Cat:CreateNotification("CheatDetector", `{Looter.Player.Name} may be using cheststeal (emptied a chest from {math.round(Distance)} studs)`, 10, "alert")
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end))
                end)
            end

            CheatDetector:Clean(Services.CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal("chest"):Connect(Added))
            CheatDetector:Clean(function()
                table.clear(Bursts)
                table.clear(Flagged)
            end)
            for _, v: Instance in Services.CollectionService:GetTagged("chest") do
                Added(v)
            end
        end,
        AntiFall = function(Current: number)
            local Histories: {[Player]: number} = {}
            local Strikes: {[Player]: number} = {}
            local Notified: {[Player]: number} = {}

            repeat
                local Margin: {speed: number, reach: number, hits: number, interval: number} = Margins[Strictness.Value]
                for _, v: Target in Entity.Entities do
                    local Player: Player? = v.Player
                    if Toggles.AntiFall.Enabled and not Exempt(v, 1.5) then
                        local Position: Vector3 = v.RootPart.Position
                        local Velocity: Vector3 = v.RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                        local Last: number? = Histories[Player]

                        if Last then
                            local Delta: number = Position.Y - Last
                            local Jumped: boolean = Delta > 3 and Velocity.Y <= 1
                            local Floating: boolean = math.abs(Delta) < 0.4 and Velocity.Y > -5
                            local Clutched: boolean = (os.clock() - (LastPlaced[Player] or 0)) < 2
                            local Cell: Vector3 = Data.Controllers.BlockController:getBlockPosition(Position - Vector3.new(0, 4, 0))
                            local Supported: boolean = Data.Controllers.BlockController:getStore():getBlockAt(Cell) ~= nil

                            Params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {v.Character, LocalPlayer.Character, workspace.CurrentCamera}
                            if (Jumped or Floating) and not Clutched and not Supported and not workspace:Raycast(Position, Vector3.new(0, -300, 0), Params) then
                                Strikes[Player] = (Strikes[Player] or 0) + (Jumped and 2 or 1)
                                if Strikes[Player] > (Margin.hits * 3) and os.clock() > (Notified[Player] or 0) then
                                    Notified[Player] = os.clock() + 20
                                    Cat:CreateNotification("CheatDetector", `{Player.Name} may be using antifall (stopped falling over the void)`, 10, "alert")
                                end
                            else
                                Strikes[Player] = math.max((Strikes[Player] or 0) - 1, 0)
                            end
                        end

                        Histories[Player] = Position.Y
                    elseif Player then
                        Histories[Player], Strikes[Player] = nil, 0
                    end
                end

                task.wait(0.15)
            until Session ~= Current
        end
    }

    CheatDetector = Cat.Categories.Utility:CreateModule({
        Name = "CheatDetector",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            Session += 1
            if Callback then
                local Current: number = Session
                table.clear(LastDamaged)
                table.clear(LastPlaced)

                CheatDetector:Clean(Services.Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(Player: Player)
                    LastDamaged[Player], LastPlaced[Player] = nil, nil
                end))

                for _, v: (number) -> () in Methods do
                    task.spawn(v, Current)
                end
            else
                table.clear(LastDamaged)
                table.clear(LastPlaced)
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Watches everyone else for cheats, and only says something once it can rule out lag, knockback and kits"
    })

    Strictness = CheatDetector:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Strictness",
        List = {"Lenient", "Balanced", "Strict"},
        Tooltip = "Lenient never guesses, Strict catches more but can flag a laggy player"
    })

    for Name: string in Methods do
        Toggles[Name] = CheatDetector:CreateToggle({
            Name = Name,
            Default = true
        })
    end
end)()

BundledModules.DeviceSpoofer = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local DeviceSpoofer
    local Device

    local Old: ((...any) -> ...any)?
    local OldDevice: string?

    DeviceSpoofer = Cat.Categories.Utility:CreateModule({
        Name = "DeviceSpoofer",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback then
                OldDevice, Old = Data.Controllers.UserInputController:getUserInputType(), Data.Controllers.UserInputController.getUserInputType
                Data.Controllers.UserInputController.getUserInputType = function(): string
                    return Device.Value:upper()
                end

                Old, OldDevice = nil, nil
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Spoofs the device you show up as to the server",
        ExtraText = function(): string
            return Device.Value
        end
    })

    Device = DeviceSpoofer:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Device",
        List = {"Mobile", "PC", "Gamepad"},
        Function = function(Value: string)
            if DeviceSpoofer.Enabled then
                Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("SendUserInputType"):SendToServer({userInputType = Value:upper()})
            end
        end
    })
end)()

BundledModules.FakeLag = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity
    local Tween = BundledModules.Tween

    local FakeLag

    local Latency, Mode, Targeting, Visual

    local Part: Part = Instance.new("Part")
    Part.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
    Part.Transparency = 1
    Part.Anchored = true
    Part.CanCollide = false
    Part.CanTouch = false
    Part.CanQuery = false
    Part.Parent = workspace
    Cat:Clean(Part)

    local ColorBox: BoxHandleAdornment = Instance.new("BoxHandleAdornment")
    ColorBox.AlwaysOnTop = true
    ColorBox.Size = Vector3.new(2.5, 6, 2.5)
    ColorBox.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, -0.5, 0)
    ColorBox.ZIndex = 10
    ColorBox.Visible = false
    ColorBox.Adornee = Part
    ColorBox.Parent = Part

    FakeLag = Cat.Categories.Utility:CreateModule({
        Name = "FakeLag",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            ColorBox.Visible = Callback and Visual.Enabled or false

            if Callback then
                local Tick: number = os.clock()

                repeat
                    if Entity.Alive then
                        if Tick > os.clock() then
                            setfflag("PhysicsSenderMaxBandwidthBps", "0")
                            setfflag("S2PhysicsSenderRate", "0")
                        else
                            Tween(Part, TweenInfo.new(math.clamp(Latency:GetRandomValue() / 950, 0.07, 0.2), Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), {CFrame = CFrame.new(Entity.RootPart.Position)})

                            setfflag("PhysicsSenderMaxBandwidthBps", "38760")
                            setfflag("S2PhysicsSenderRate", "15")
                            task.wait(Services.RunService.PostSimulation:Wait() * 5)

                            Tick = os.clock() + (Latency:GetRandomValue() / 1000)
                        end
                    else
                        setfflag("PhysicsSenderMaxBandwidthBps", "38760")
                        setfflag("S2PhysicsSenderRate", "15")
                    end

                    task.wait()
                until not FakeLag.Enabled
            elseif setfflag then
                setfflag("PhysicsSenderMaxBandwidthBps", "38760")
                setfflag("S2PhysicsSenderRate", "15")
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Fakes lag to the server, can be used to avoid some anti-cheats"
    })

    Mode = FakeLag:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Mode",
        List = {"Dynamic"}
    })
    Latency = FakeLag:CreateTwoSlider({
        Name = "Latency",
        Min = 0,
        Max = 500,
        DefaultMin = 250,
        DefaultMax = 400,
    })
    Visual = FakeLag:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Show your desync position",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Part then
                ColorBox.Visible = Callback and FakeLag.Enabled or false
            end
        end,
        Default = true
    })
    FakeLag:CreateColorSlider({
        Name = "Visual Color",
        DefaultSat = 0,
        DefaultOpacity = 0.5,
        Function = function(Hue: number, Sat: number, Value: number, Opacity: number)
            if ColorBox then
                ColorBox.Color3 = Color3.fromHSV(Hue, Sat, Value)
                ColorBox.Transparency = (1 - Opacity)
            end
        end
    })
end)()
