BundledModules.NickHider = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services
    local LocalPlayer: Player = Services.Players.LocalPlayer

    local gethui = BundledModules.gethui
    local SetIdentity = BundledModules.SetIdentity

    local NickHider
    local Replacement, Others, Tags, Level, Kit

    local Hidden: {[GuiObject]: boolean} = {}
    local Swapped: {[Instance]: string} = {}
    local Watched: {[Instance]: RBXScriptConnection} = {}
    local Patterns: {string} = {}
    local Plain: {string} = {}
    local Classes: {[string]: boolean} = {TextLabel = true, TextButton = true, TextBox = true}
    local Shortest: number = math.huge
    local Fake: string = "hidden"
    local Writing: Instance?
    local Class: any
    local Old: {[string]: (...any) -> ...any}?
    local Refreshing: boolean = false

    local function Refresh()
        if Refreshing or not NickHider or not NickHider.Enabled then
            return
        end

        Refreshing = true
        task.delay(0.35, function()
            Refreshing = false
            if NickHider.Enabled then
                NickHider:Toggle()
                NickHider:Toggle()
            end
        end)
    end

    local function Collect(Player: Player)
        for _, v: string in {Player.Name, Player.DisplayName} do
            if v == "" then
                continue
            end

            local Lower: string = v:lower()
            if not table.find(Plain, Lower) then
                table.insert(Plain, Lower)
                Shortest = math.min(Shortest, #Lower)
            end
            for _, Variant: string in {v, Lower, v:upper()} do
                local Pattern: string = (Variant:gsub("%W", "%%%0"))
                if not table.find(Patterns, Pattern) then
                    table.insert(Patterns, Pattern)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local function Replace(Object: any)
        if Writing == Object then
            return
        end

        local Text: string = Object.Text
        if type(Text) ~= "string" or #Text < Shortest then
            return
        end

        local Lower: string = Text:lower()
        local Hit: boolean = false
        for _, v: string in Plain do
            if Lower:find(v, 1, true) then
                Hit = true

                break
            end
        end
        if not Hit then
            return
        end

        local New: string = Text
        for _, v: string in Patterns do
            New = New:gsub(v, Fake)
        end
        if New == Text then
            return
        end

        Swapped[Object] = Text
        Writing = Object
        Object.Text = New
        Writing = nil

        if not Watched[Object] then
            Watched[Object] = Object:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
                if NickHider.Enabled then
                    Replace(Object)
                end
            end)
        end
    end

    local function Visit(Object: Instance)
        if Classes[Object.ClassName] then
            Replace(Object)
        end

        if Kit.Enabled and Object.Name == "PlayerKitFrame" and Object:IsA("GuiObject") and Hidden[Object] == nil then
            task.defer(function()
                local Label: any = Object.Parent and Object.Parent:FindFirstChild("PlayerName", true)
                if NickHider.Enabled and Kit.Enabled and Label and Label.Text:find(Fake, 1, true) then
                    Hidden[Object] = Object.Visible
                    Object.Visible = false
                end
            end)
        end
    end

    local function Watch(Root: Instance?)
        if not Root then
            return
        end

        SetIdentity(8)
        NickHider:Clean(Root.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(Object: Instance)
            if NickHider.Enabled then
                Visit(Object)
            end
        end))

        local Clock: number = os.clock()
        for _, v: Instance in Root:GetDescendants() do
            Visit(v)

            if os.clock() - Clock > 0.002 then
                task.wait()
                if not NickHider.Enabled then
                    return
                end

                Clock = os.clock()
                SetIdentity(8)
            end
        end
    end

    NickHider = Cat.Categories.Utility:CreateModule({
        Name = "NickHider",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback then
                table.clear(Patterns)
                table.clear(Plain)
                Shortest = math.huge
                for _, v: Player in Services.Players:GetPlayers() do
                    if v == LocalPlayer or Others.Enabled then
                        Collect(v)
                    end
                end

                Fake = Replacement.Value ~= "" and Replacement.Value or "hidden"
                for _, v: string in Patterns do
                    if Fake:find(v) then
                        Fake = "hidden"

                        break
                    end
                end

                local Success: boolean, Player: any = pcall(Data.Controllers.GamePlayerUtil.getGamePlayer, LocalPlayer)
                local Meta: any = Success and Player and getmetatable(Player)
                Class = type(Meta) == "table" and type(rawget(Meta, "__index")) == "table" and rawget(Meta, "__index") or nil
                if Class and not Old then
                    local Saved: {[string]: (...any) -> ...any} = {
                        getUsername = Class.getUsername,
                        getDisplayName = Class.getDisplayName,
                        getClanTag = Class.getClanTag,
                        getLevel = Class.getLevel
                    }
                    Old = Saved

                    Class.getUsername = function(self: any, ...: any): any
                        local Owner: Player? = self:getPlayer()
                        return Owner and (Owner == LocalPlayer or Others.Enabled) and Fake or Saved.getUsername(self, ...)
                    end
                    Class.getDisplayName = function(self: any, ...: any): any
                        local Owner: Player? = self:getPlayer()
                        return Owner and (Owner == LocalPlayer or Others.Enabled) and Fake or Saved.getDisplayName(self, ...)
                    end
                    Class.getClanTag = function(self: any, ...: any): any
                        return Tags.Enabled and self:getPlayer() == LocalPlayer and "" or Saved.getClanTag(self, ...)
                    end
                    Class.getLevel = function(self: any, ...: any): any
                        local Owner: Player? = self:getPlayer()
                        if Owner and (Others.Enabled or Owner == LocalPlayer and Level.Enabled) then
                            return -1
                        end

                        return Saved.getLevel(self, ...)
                    end
                end

                NickHider:Clean(LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(Character: Model)
                    if NickHider.Enabled then
                        Watch(Character)
                    end
                end))
                NickHider:Clean(Services.Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function()
                    if Others.Enabled then
                        Refresh()
                    end
                end))
                NickHider:Clean(Services.Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function()
                    if Others.Enabled then
                        Refresh()
                    end
                end))

                for _, v: Instance? in {LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui"), Services.CoreGui, gethui(), LocalPlayer.Character} do
                    if NickHider.Enabled then
                        Watch(v)
                    end
                end
            else
                if Class and Old then
                    for Name: string, Function: (...any) -> ...any in Old do
                        Class[Name] = Function
                    end
                end
                Class, Old = nil, nil
                SetIdentity(8)

                for _, v: RBXScriptConnection in Watched do
                    v:Disconnect()
                end
                table.clear(Watched)

                for Object: GuiObject, Visible: boolean in Hidden do
                    if Object.Parent then
                        Object.Visible = Visible
                    end
                end
                table.clear(Hidden)

                for Object: any, Text: string in Swapped do
                    if Object.Parent then
                        Writing = Object
                        Object.Text = Text
                    end
                end
                Writing = nil
                table.clear(Swapped)
            end
        end,
        ExtraText = function(): string
            return Replacement.Value ~= "" and Replacement.Value or "hidden"
        end,
        Tooltip = "Replaces your username and display name everywhere it shows up on your screen"
    })

    Replacement = NickHider:CreateTextBox({
        Name = "Name",
        Default = "hidden",
        Function = Refresh
    })
    Others = NickHider:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Hide others",
        Function = Refresh,
        Tooltip = "Hides every player's username and level"
    })
    Tags = NickHider:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Hide chat tags",
        Tooltip = "Hides your clan tag wherever it shows"
    })
    Level = NickHider:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Hide level",
        Function = Refresh,
        Tooltip = "Hides your level wherever it shows"
    })
    Kit = NickHider:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Hide kit",
        Function = Refresh,
        Tooltip = "Hides your kit icon in the tab list"
    })
end)()

BundledModules.Nuker = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services
    local LocalPlayer: Player = Services.Players.LocalPlayer

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity
    local Break = BundledModules.Break

    local Nuker
    local Mode, ClosestBreak, Range, BreakSpeed, UpdateRate, Custom
    local Bed, Tesla, Hive, LuckyBlock, IronOre, Effect, CustomHealth, Animation
    local SelfBreak, Wallcheck, ViewAngle, AutoTool, SwitchDelay, LimitItem, PlayerCheck

    local Parts: {Part} = {}
    local CustomList: {BasePart} = {}
    local MouseParams: RaycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    MouseParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    local PlayerParams: RaycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    PlayerParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

    local Session: {Cancelled: boolean?}?
    local ActiveBlock: BasePart?
    local MouseHit: Instance?
    local MouseOrigin: Vector3, MouseDirection: Vector3 = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
    local NextBreak: number = 0
    local PathShown: boolean = false
    local Healthbar: {Part: Part?, Bar: Frame?, Position: Vector3?, Expires: number} = {Expires = 0}

    local function CustomHealthbar(_: any, BlockRef: {blockPosition: Vector3}, Health: number, MaxHealth: number, Change: number, Block: Instance)
        if Block:GetAttribute("NoHealthbar") then
            return
        end

        if Healthbar.Position ~= BlockRef.blockPosition or not Healthbar.Part then
            if Healthbar.Part then
                Healthbar.Part:Destroy()
            end

            Healthbar.Part, Healthbar.Bar, Healthbar.Position = nil, nil, nil

            local Percent: number = math.clamp(Health / MaxHealth, 0, 1)
            local Anchor: Part = Instance.new("Part")
            Anchor.Size = Vector3.one
            Anchor.CFrame = CFrame.new(BlockRef.blockPosition * 3)
            Anchor.Transparency = 1
            Anchor.Anchored = true
            Anchor.CanCollide = false
            Anchor.Parent = workspace
            Data.Controllers.GameQueryUtil:setQueryIgnored(Anchor, true)

            local Billboard: BillboardGui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
            Billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(249, 102)
            Billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)
            Billboard.MaxDistance = 40
            Billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
            Billboard.Adornee = Anchor
            Billboard.Parent = Anchor

            local Frame: Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
            Frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(160, 50)
            Frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 32)
            Frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new()
            Frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
            Frame.Parent = Billboard

            local Shadow: UIShadow = Instance.new("UIShadow")
            Shadow.BlurRadius = UDim.new(0, 13)
            Shadow.Transparency = 0.25
            Shadow.Parent = Frame

            local Name: TextLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            Name.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(145, 14)
            Name.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 11)
            Name.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            Name.Text = Data.Instances.Items[Block.Name] and Data.Instances.Items[Block.Name].displayName or Block.Name
            Name.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
            Name.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
            Name.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
            Name.TextScaled = true
            Name.Font = Enum.Font.Arial
            Name.Parent = Frame

            local Track: Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
            Track.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(138, 4)
            Track.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 32)
            Track.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(26, 25, 26)
            Track.Parent = Frame

            local Bar: Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
            Bar.Size = UDim2.fromScale(Percent, 1)
            Bar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(math.clamp(Percent / 2.5, 0, 1), 0.89, 0.75)
            Bar.Parent = Track

            for _, v: GuiObject in {Frame, Track, Bar} do
                local Corner: UICorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
                Corner.CornerRadius = v == Frame and UDim.new(0, 5) or UDim.new(1, 0)
                Corner.Parent = v
            end

            Healthbar.Part, Healthbar.Bar, Healthbar.Position = Anchor, Bar, BlockRef.blockPosition
        end

        Healthbar.Expires = tick() + 5
        task.delay(5, function()
            if tick() >= Healthbar.Expires then
                if Healthbar.Part then
                    Healthbar.Part:Destroy()
                end

                Healthbar.Part, Healthbar.Bar, Healthbar.Position = nil, nil, nil
            end
        end)

        local Percent: number = math.clamp((Health - Change) / MaxHealth, 0, 1)
        Services.TweenService:Create(Healthbar.Bar :: Frame, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {Size = UDim2.fromScale(Percent, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(math.clamp(Percent / 2.5, 0, 1), 0.89, 0.75)}):Play()
    end

    local function ShowPath(Start: Vector3?, Path: {[Vector3]: Vector3}?, Finish: Vector3?)
        if not Start and not PathShown then
            return
        end

        local Node: Vector3? = Start
        PathShown = Node ~= nil
        for _, v: Part in Parts do
            v.Position = Node or Vector3.zero
            if Node then
                (v:FindFirstChildOfClass("BoxHandleAdornment") :: BoxHandleAdornment).Color3 = Node == Finish and Color3.new(1, 0.2, 0.2) or Node == Start and Color3.new(0.2, 0.2, 1) or Color3.new(0.2, 1, 0.2)
            end

            Node = Path and Node and Path[Node]
        end
    end

    local function Attempt(List: {Instance}?, LocalPosition: Vector3, Route: boolean?, TeamCheck: boolean?): boolean
        if List then
            local Camera: Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
            local Block: BasePart?, Closest: number = nil, math.huge
            for _, Item: Instance in List do
                local v: BasePart = Item :: BasePart
                local Handler: any = Data.Controllers.BlockController:getHandlerRegistry():getHandler(v.Name)
                local Distance: number = math.huge
                for _, Position: Vector3 in (Handler and Handler:getContainedPositions(v) or {Data.Controllers.BlockController:getBlockPosition(v.Position)}) do
                    if Data.Controllers.BlockController:isBlockBreakable({blockPosition = Position}, LocalPlayer) then
                        Distance = math.min(Distance, (Position * 3 - LocalPosition).Magnitude)
                    end
                end

                if Distance < Range.Value and (SelfBreak.Enabled or v:GetAttribute("PlacedByUserId") ~= LocalPlayer.UserId) then
                    if TeamCheck then
                        local Placer: Player? = Services.Players:GetPlayerByUserId(v:GetAttribute("PlacedByUserId") or 0)
                        if Placer and Placer:GetAttribute("Team") == LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Team") then
                            continue
                        end
                    end
                    if v ~= ActiveBlock and Wallcheck.Enabled and not ClosestBreak.Enabled and ViewAngle.Value < 180 then
                        local Offset: Vector3 = v.Position - Camera.CFrame.Position
                        if Offset.Magnitude > 0 and math.deg(math.acos(math.clamp(Offset.Unit:Dot(Camera.CFrame.LookVector), -1, 1))) > ViewAngle.Value then
                            continue
                        end
                    end
                    if (v:GetAttribute("BedShieldEndTime") or 0) <= workspace:GetServerTimeNow() and (not LimitItem.Enabled or Data.Storage.Hand.Tool and Data.Instances.Items[Data.Storage.Hand.Tool.Name] and Data.Instances.Items[Data.Storage.Hand.Tool.Name].breakBlock) and not (PlayerCheck.Enabled and Entity.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") and workspace:Raycast(Entity.Character.Head.Position, v.Position - Entity.Character.Head.Position, PlayerParams)) then
                        if v == ActiveBlock then
                            Block = v

                            break
                        end
                        if ClosestBreak.Enabled and v ~= MouseHit then
                            local Offset: Vector3 = v.Position - MouseOrigin
                            local Along: number = Offset:Dot(MouseDirection)
                            local Spread: number = Along > 0 and (Offset - MouseDirection * Along).Magnitude or Offset.Magnitude
                            if Spread < Closest then
                                Block, Closest = v, Spread
                            end
                        else
                            if Distance < Closest then
                                Block, Closest = v, Distance
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            if Block then
                ActiveBlock = Block
                if tick() >= NextBreak then
                    local Method: any = ClosestBreak.Enabled and Break.Methods.Distance or Break.Methods[Mode.Value]
                    local Start: Vector3?, Path: {[Vector3]: Vector3}?, Finish: Vector3?, Requested: boolean? = Break.Block(Block, Effect.Enabled, Animation.Value ~= "No Animation" and Animation.Value or nil, CustomHealth.Enabled and CustomHealthbar or nil, AutoTool.Enabled, Wallcheck.Enabled, Method, not Route, true, Session, SwitchDelay:GetRandomValue(), ShowPath)
                    if Requested then
                        NextBreak = tick() + BreakSpeed.Value
                    end

                    ShowPath(Start, Path, Finish)

                    return Start ~= nil
                else
                    return true
                end
            end
        end

        return false
    end

    Nuker = Cat.Categories.Utility:CreateModule({
        Name = "Nuker",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback then
                local Current: {Cancelled: boolean?} = {}
                Session, ActiveBlock, NextBreak = Current, nil, 0
                for _ = 1, 30 do
                    local Part: Part = Instance.new("Part")
                    Part.Anchored = true
                    Part.CanQuery = false
                    Part.CanCollide = false
                    Part.Transparency = 1

                    local Highlight: BoxHandleAdornment = Instance.new("BoxHandleAdornment")
                    Highlight.Size = Vector3.one
                    Highlight.AlwaysOnTop = true
                    Highlight.ZIndex = 1
                    Highlight.Transparency = 0.5
                    Highlight.Adornee = Part
                    Highlight.Parent = Part

                    Part.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera
                    table.insert(Parts, Part)
                end

                table.clear(CustomList)
                for _, v: Instance in Services.CollectionService:GetTagged("block") do
                    if table.find(Custom.ListEnabled, v.Name) then
                        table.insert(CustomList, v :: BasePart)
                    end
                end

                Nuker:Clean(Services.CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal("block"):Connect(function(v: Instance)
                    if table.find(Custom.ListEnabled, v.Name) then
                        table.insert(CustomList, v :: BasePart)
                    end
                end))
                Nuker:Clean(Services.CollectionService:GetInstanceRemovedSignal("block"):Connect(function(v: Instance)
                    local Index: number? = table.find(CustomList, v :: BasePart)
                    if Index then
                        table.remove(CustomList, Index)
                    end
                end))

                local Mouse: Mouse = LocalPlayer:GetMouse()
                repeat
                    task.wait(1 / UpdateRate.Value)
                    if not Nuker.Enabled or Session ~= Current then
                        break
                    end
                    if Entity.Alive then
                        local LocalPosition: Vector3 = Entity.RootPart.Position
                        if ClosestBreak.Enabled then
                            local Ignore: {Instance} = {Entity.Character, workspace.CurrentCamera}
                            for _, v: Target in Entity.Entities do
                                if v.Character then
                                    table.insert(Ignore, v.Character)
                                end
                            end

                            MouseParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = Ignore
                            MouseOrigin, MouseDirection = Mouse.UnitRay.Origin, Mouse.UnitRay.Direction

                            local Result: RaycastResult? = workspace:Raycast(MouseOrigin, MouseDirection * 999, MouseParams)
                            MouseHit = Result and Result.Instance or nil
                        end
                        if PlayerCheck.Enabled then
                            local Characters: {Instance} = {}
                            for _, v: Target in Entity.Entities do
                                if v.Player and v.Character and not v.Self then
                                    table.insert(Characters, v.Character)
                                end
                            end

                            PlayerParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = Characters
                        end

                        local Busy: boolean = Attempt(Bed.Enabled and Services.CollectionService:GetTagged("bed") or nil, LocalPosition, true) or Attempt(Hive.Enabled and Services.CollectionService:GetTagged("beehive") or nil, LocalPosition, nil, true) or Attempt(Tesla.Enabled and Services.CollectionService:GetTagged("tesla-trap") or nil, LocalPosition, nil, true) or Attempt(IronOre.Enabled and Services.CollectionService:GetTagged("iron_ore_mesh_block") or nil, LocalPosition) or Attempt(LuckyBlock.Enabled and Services.CollectionService:GetTagged("LuckyBlock") or nil, LocalPosition) or Attempt(CustomList, LocalPosition)

                        if not Busy then
                            ActiveBlock = nil
                            if PathShown then
                                PathShown = false
                                for _, v: Part in Parts do
                                    v.Position = Vector3.zero
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                until not Nuker.Enabled or Session ~= Current
            else
                if Session then
                    Session.Cancelled = true
                end
                if Break.Tool and Break.Tool.Session == Session then
                    Break.Tool = nil
                end

                ActiveBlock, PathShown = nil, false
                if Healthbar.Part then
                    Healthbar.Part:Destroy()
                end

                Healthbar.Part, Healthbar.Bar, Healthbar.Position = nil, nil, nil
                for _, v: Part in Parts do
                    v:Destroy()
                end

                table.clear(Parts)
                table.clear(CustomList)
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Break blocks around you automatically"
    })

    Bed = Nuker:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Beds",
        Default = true
    })
    Tesla = Nuker:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Tesla traps",
        Default = true
    })
    Hive = Nuker:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Beehives",
        Default = true
    })
    LuckyBlock = Nuker:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Lucky blocks",
        Default = true
    })
    IronOre = Nuker:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Iron ore",
        Default = true
    })
    Custom = Nuker:CreateTextList({
        Name = "Custom blocks",
        Placeholder = "Block name...",
        Function = function()
            if not Nuker.Enabled then
                return
            end

            table.clear(CustomList)
            for _, v: Instance in Services.CollectionService:GetTagged("block") do
                if table.find(Custom.ListEnabled, v.Name) then
                    table.insert(CustomList, v :: BasePart)
                end
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Extra blocks to break by name, like wool_white"
    })
    Range = Nuker:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Range",
        Min = 1,
        Max = 30,
        Default = 30,
        Suffix = function(Value: number)
            return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
        end
    })
    BreakSpeed = Nuker:CreateSlider({
