        Min = 0,
        Max = 0.3,
        Default = 0.25,
        Decimal = 100,
        Suffix = "seconds",
        Tooltip = "Wait after each hit before the next one"
    })
    UpdateRate = Nuker:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Update rate",
        Min = 1,
        Max = 120,
        Default = 60,
        Suffix = "hz",
        Tooltip = "How many times a second Nuker looks for blocks"
    })
    ClosestBreak = Nuker:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Closest to crosshair",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Mode and Mode.Object then
                Mode.Object.Visible = not Callback
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Ignores the sort and always takes the block nearest your crosshair, seeing straight through players"
    })
    Mode = Nuker:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Sort by",
        List = {"Health", "Distance"},
        Default = "Health",
        Darker = true,
        Visible = not ClosestBreak.Enabled
    })
    SelfBreak = Nuker:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Own blocks",
        Tooltip = "Also breaks blocks you placed yourself"
    })
    PlayerCheck = Nuker:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Player check",
        Tooltip = "Skips a block while a player stands between you and it, so you dont mine through them"
    })
    Wallcheck = Nuker:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Legit mode",
        Default = true,
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if ViewAngle and ViewAngle.Object then
                ViewAngle.Object.Visible = Callback
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Breaks the blocks covering a bed instead of the bed itself,\nand only breaks what you are actually looking at"
    })
    ViewAngle = Nuker:CreateSlider({
        Name = "View angle",
        Min = 5,
        Max = 180,
        Default = 60,
        Suffix = "degrees",
        Darker = true,
        Visible = Wallcheck.Enabled,
        Tooltip = "How far off your crosshair a block can sit in legit mode, 180 breaks anything in range"
    })
    LimitItem = Nuker:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Limit to tools",
        Tooltip = "Only breaks while you're holding a tool"
    })
    AutoTool = Nuker:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Legit switch",
        Tooltip = "Shows the switch to the right tool on your own screen too"
    })
    SwitchDelay = Nuker:CreateTwoSlider({
        Name = "Switch delay",
        Min = 0,
        Max = 1,
        DefaultMin = 0.15,
        DefaultMax = 0.3,
        Decimal = 100,
        Tooltip = "Random wait in seconds between both ends before swapping to the tool a block needs\nOnly applies when your hand has to change, 0 on both ends swaps instantly"
    })
    Effect = Nuker:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Healthbar & effects",
        Default = true,
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if CustomHealth and CustomHealth.Object then
                CustomHealth.Object.Visible = Callback
            end
        end
    })
    CustomHealth = Nuker:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Custom healthbar",
        Default = true,
        Darker = true,
        Visible = Effect.Enabled
    })
    Animation = Nuker:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Animation",
        List = {"No Animation", "Minimal", "Full"},
        Tooltip = "Minimal plays the tiny stub you get while macroing, Full plays the whole swing"
    })
end)()

BundledModules.PickUpRange = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity

    local PickUpRange
    local Range, Lower

    local Picked: {[BasePart]: boolean} = {}

    PickUpRange = Cat.Categories.Utility:CreateModule({
        Name = "PickUpRange",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback then
                repeat
                    if Entity.Alive then
                        local LocalPosition: Vector3 = Entity.RootPart.Position
                        for _, v in Services.CollectionService:GetTagged("ItemDrop") do
                            if v:IsA("BasePart") and not Picked[v] and tick() - (v:GetAttribute("ClientDropTime") or 0) >= 2 then
                                if (LocalPosition - v.Position).Magnitude <= Range.Value and (not Lower.Enabled or LocalPosition.Y - v.Position.Y >= Entity.Humanoid.HipHeight - 1) then
                                    Picked[v] = true
                                    Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("PickupItemDrop"):CallServerAsync({itemDrop = v}):andThen(function(Success: boolean)
                                        Picked[v] = nil

                                        if not Success then
                                            return
                                        end

                                        Data.Controllers.AudioManager:playAudio(Data.Instances.Sounds.PICKUP_ITEM_DROP)

                                        local Meta: any = Data.Instances.Items[v.Name]
                                        if Meta and Meta.pickUpOverlaySound then
                                            Data.Controllers.AudioManager:playAudio(Meta.pickUpOverlaySound, {
                                                position = v.Position,
                                                volumeMultiplier = 0.9
                                            })
                                        end
                                    end)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    task.wait(0.1)
                until not PickUpRange.Enabled
            else
                table.clear(Picked)
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Picks up items from a farther distance"
    })

    Range = PickUpRange:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Range",
        Min = 1,
        Max = 10,
        Default = 10,
        Suffix = function(Value: number)
            return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
        end
    })
    Lower = PickUpRange:CreateToggle({Name = "Feet Check"})
end)()

BundledModules.Scaffold = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity
    local Drag = BundledModules.Drag
    local PlacementController = BundledModules.PlacementController

    local Scaffold
    local Expand, Tower, TowerMode, Downwards, Diagonal, LimitItem, Mouse, FillColor, OutlineColor, HudPosition

    local Hud: Frame?
    local HudParts: {[string]: any} = {}
    local HudTweens: {Tween} = {}
    local HudConnection: RBXScriptConnection?
    local HudBlock: string?
    local HudRatio: number, HudPeak: number, HudLast: number, HudSpeed: number, HudTime: number = 0, 0, 0, 0, os.clock()
    local Visual: Part?
    local VisualTween: Tween?
    local VisualPosition: Vector3?
    local LastPosition: Vector3 = Vector3.zero
    local LastClimb: Vector3?, ClimbTime: number = nil, 0
    local Grounded: Humanoid?

    local isnetworkowner = isnetworkowner or function(_): boolean
        return true
    end

    local function Climb(Block: string)
        local Store: any = Data.Controllers.BlockController:getStore()
        local Feet: number = Entity.RootPart.Position.Y - Entity.Humanoid.HipHeight - Entity.RootPart.Size.Y / 2
        local Cell: Vector3 = Data.Controllers.BlockController:getBlockPosition(Vector3.new(Entity.RootPart.Position.X, Feet - 1.5, Entity.RootPart.Position.Z))
        repeat
            local Taken: boolean = Store:getBlockAt(Cell) ~= nil
            if Taken then
                Cell += Vector3.yAxis
            end
        until not Taken or Cell.Y * 3 - 1.5 > Feet + 3

        if Entity.Humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude < 0.1 and Entity.Humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air and isnetworkowner(Entity.RootPart) then
            Entity.RootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(Cell.X * 3, Entity.RootPart.Position.Y, Cell.Z * 3) * Entity.RootPart.CFrame.Rotation
        end

        local Anchored: boolean = false
        for _, v: Vector3 in {-Vector3.yAxis, Vector3.xAxis, -Vector3.xAxis, Vector3.zAxis, -Vector3.zAxis} do
            if Store:getBlockAt(Cell + v) then
                Anchored = true

                break
            end
        end

        local Now: number = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
        local Ready: boolean = Now - Data.Controllers.BlockCpsController.lastPlaceTimestamp >= 1 / Data.Instances.CPSConstants.BLOCK_PLACE_CPS
        local Clear: boolean = not Store:getBlockAt(Cell) and not Store:getBlockAt(Cell + Vector3.yAxis) and not Store:getBlockAt(Cell + Vector3.yAxis * 2)
        if Anchored and Ready and Clear and Cell.Y * 3 - 1.5 <= Feet + 0.15 and (Cell ~= LastClimb or Now - ClimbTime >= 0.5) then
            LastClimb, ClimbTime = Cell, Now
            task.spawn(PlacementController.Place, Cell * 3, Block)
        end
    end

    local function GetBlock(): (string?, number)
        if Data.Storage.Hand.Type == "block" and Data.Storage.Hand.Tool then
            return Data.Storage.Hand.Tool.Name, Data.Storage.Hand.Amount
        end
        if LimitItem.Enabled then
            return nil, 0
        end

        for _, v: InventoryItem in (Data.Storage.Inventory.inventory.items or {}) do
            if v.itemType:find("wool") then
                return v.itemType, v.amount
            end
        end
        for _, v: InventoryItem in (Data.Storage.Inventory.inventory.items or {}) do
            if Data.Instances.Items[v.itemType] and Data.Instances.Items[v.itemType].block then
                return v.itemType, v.amount
            end
        end

        return nil, 0
    end

    local function BuildHud()
        HudRatio = 0

        local X: string?, Y: string? = HudPosition.Value:match("^(%-?%d+),(%-?%d+)$")
        local Frame: Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
        Frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 44)
        Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, tonumber(X) or 0, 0.5, tonumber(Y) or 60)
        Frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
        Frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 26)
        Frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45
        Frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
        Frame.Visible = Scaffold.Enabled or Cat.Ui.Click.Visible
        Drag(Frame, function(Object: GuiObject)
            HudPosition:SetValue(`{math.round(Object.Position.X.Offset)},{math.round(Object.Position.Y.Offset)}`)
        end)

        local Badge: Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
        Badge.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 32)
        Badge.Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0.5, 0)
        Badge.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
        Badge.BackgroundTransparency = 0.7
        Badge.BorderSizePixel = 0
        Badge.Parent = Frame

        local Icon: ImageLabel = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
        Icon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 22)
        Icon.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
        Icon.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        Icon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        Icon.Parent = Badge

        local Track: Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
        Track.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 4)
        Track.Position = UDim2.new(0, 48, 0.5, 0)
        Track.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
        Track.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        Track.BackgroundTransparency = 0.85
        Track.BorderSizePixel = 0
        Track.Parent = Frame

        local Trail: Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
        Trail.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
        Trail.BackgroundTransparency = 0.6
        Trail.BorderSizePixel = 0
        Trail.Parent = Track

        local Fill: Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
        Fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
        Fill.ZIndex = 2
        Fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
        Fill.Parent = Track

        local Count: TextLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        Count.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(100, 22)
        Count.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(214, 9)
        Count.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        Count.Text = "0 blocks"
        Count.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        Count.TextSize = 16
        Count.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        Count.RichText = true
        Count.Parent = Frame

        local Rate: TextLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        Rate.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(100, 15)
        Rate.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(214, 25)
        Rate.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        Rate.Text = "0.0 b/s"
        Rate.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 158)
        Rate.TextSize = 12
        Rate.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        Rate.Parent = Frame

        for _, v: GuiObject in {Frame, Badge, Track, Trail, Fill} do
            local Corner: UICorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
            Corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
            Corner.Parent = v
        end

        Frame.Parent = Cat.Ui.Gui
        Hud = Frame
        HudParts = {Badge = Badge, Icon = Icon, Trail = Trail, Fill = Fill, Count = Count, Rate = Rate}
    end

    local function UpdateHud(Block: string?, Count: number)
        if Hud then
            local Now: number = os.clock()
            local Delta: number = math.max(Now - HudTime, 0.001)
            if Block ~= HudBlock then
                HudBlock, HudPeak, HudLast = Block, 0, Count
                HudParts.Icon.Image = Block and Data.Instances.Items[Block] and Data.Instances.Items[Block].image or ""
            end

            HudSpeed += (math.max(HudLast - Count, 0) / Delta - HudSpeed) * math.min(Delta * 0.5, 1)
            HudPeak, HudLast, HudTime = math.max(HudPeak, Count), Count, Now

            local Accent: Color3 = Cat.Ui:Color(0)
            if HudParts.Fill.BackgroundColor3 ~= Accent then
                HudParts.Badge.BackgroundColor3, HudParts.Trail.BackgroundColor3, HudParts.Fill.BackgroundColor3 = Accent, Accent, Accent
            end

            local Ratio: number = HudPeak > 0 and Count / HudPeak or 0
            if Ratio ~= HudRatio then
                local Drain: boolean = Ratio < HudRatio
                HudRatio = Ratio
                for _, v: Tween in HudTweens do
                    v:Cancel()
                end

                local Fill: Tween = Services.TweenService:Create(HudParts.Fill, TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Size = UDim2.fromScale(Ratio, 1)})
                local Trail: Tween = Services.TweenService:Create(HudParts.Trail, TweenInfo.new(Drain and 0.45 or 0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, 0, false, Drain and 0.2 or 0), {Size = UDim2.fromScale(Ratio, 1)})
                Fill:Play()
                Trail:Play()
                HudTweens = {Fill, Trail}
            end

            HudParts.Count.Text = `<font color="#{Accent:ToHex()}">{Count}</font> {Count == 1 and "block" or "blocks"}`
            HudParts.Rate.Text = string.format("%.1f b/s", HudSpeed)

            local Width: number = 214 + math.ceil(math.max(HudParts.Count.TextBounds.X, HudParts.Rate.TextBounds.X)) + 14
            if Hud.Size.X.Offset ~= Width then
                Hud.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(Width, 44)
            end
        end
    end

    local function ShowHud()
        if not Hud then
            return
        end

        Hud.Visible = Scaffold.Enabled or Cat.Ui.Click.Visible
        if Hud.Visible and not Scaffold.Enabled then
            UpdateHud(GetBlock())
        end
    end

    local function HideVisual()
        if VisualTween then
            VisualTween:Cancel()
            VisualTween = nil
        end
        if Visual then
            Visual.Parent = nil
        end

        VisualPosition = nil
    end

    Scaffold = Cat.Categories.Utility:CreateModule({
        Name = "Scaffold",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Hud then
                Hud.Visible = Callback or Cat.Ui.Click.Visible
            end
            if Callback then
                HudBlock, HudSpeed = nil, 0
                repeat
                    if Entity.Alive then
                        local Block: string?, Amount: number = GetBlock()
                        UpdateHud(Block, Amount)
                        if Mouse.Enabled and not Services.UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then
                            Block = nil
                        end

                        if Block then
                            local Rising: boolean = Tower.Enabled and Services.UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) and not Services.UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox()
                            if Rising and TowerMode.Value == "Block up" then
                                if Grounded ~= Entity.Humanoid then
                                    Grounded = Entity.Humanoid
                                    Entity.Humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping, false)
                                end

                                Climb(Block)
                            elseif Rising then
                                Entity.RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(Entity.RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X, 38, Entity.RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z)
                            end

                            for Step: number = Expand.Value, 1, -1 do
                                local Drop: number = Entity.Humanoid.HipHeight + (Downwards.Enabled and Services.UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) and 4.5 or 1.5)
                                local Raw: Vector3 = Entity.RootPart.Position - Vector3.new(0, Drop, 0) + Entity.Humanoid.MoveDirection * (Step * 3)
                                local Position: Vector3 = Vector3.new(math.round(Raw.X / 3) * 3, math.round(Raw.Y / 3) * 3, math.round(Raw.Z / 3) * 3)
                                if Diagonal.Enabled and math.abs(math.round(math.deg(math.atan2(-Entity.Humanoid.MoveDirection.X, -Entity.Humanoid.MoveDirection.Z)) / 45) * 45) % 90 == 45 then
                                    local Delta: Vector3 = LastPosition - Position
                                    if ((Delta.X == 0 and Delta.Z ~= 0) or (Delta.X ~= 0 and Delta.Z == 0)) and ((LastPosition - Entity.RootPart.Position) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)).Magnitude < 2.5 then
                                        Position = LastPosition
                                    end
                                end

                                if Visual then
                                    local Target: Vector3 = Data.Controllers.BlockController:getBlockPosition(Position) * 3
                                    if VisualPosition ~= Target then
                                        if VisualTween then
                                            VisualTween:Cancel()
                                        end

                                        if Visual.Parent == workspace.CurrentCamera then
                                            VisualTween = Services.TweenService:Create(Visual, TweenInfo.new(0.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {CFrame = CFrame.new(Target)})
                                            VisualTween:Play()
                                        else
                                            Visual.CFrame = CFrame.new(Target)
                                            Visual.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera
                                        end

                                        VisualPosition = Target
                                    end
                                end

                                local Grid: Vector3 = Data.Controllers.BlockController:getBlockPosition(Position)
                                if not Data.Controllers.BlockController:getStore():getBlockAt(Grid) then
                                    local Touching: boolean = false
                                    for _, v: Vector3 in PlacementController.Offsets do
                                        if Data.Controllers.BlockController:getStore():getBlockAt(Data.Controllers.BlockController:getBlockPosition(Grid * 3 + v)) then
                                            Touching = true

                                            break
                                        end
                                    end

                                    local Anchor: Vector3? = Touching and Grid * 3 or PlacementController.Nearest(Position)
                                    if Anchor then
                                        task.defer(PlacementController.Place, Anchor, Block)
                                    end
                                end

                                LastPosition = Position
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    if Grounded and (not Entity.Alive or Grounded ~= Entity.Humanoid or TowerMode.Value ~= "Block up" or not Services.UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space)) then
                        Grounded:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping, true)
                        Grounded = nil
                    end

                    task.wait(0.03)
                until not Scaffold.Enabled
            end

            HideVisual()
            if Grounded then
                Grounded:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping, true)
                Grounded = nil
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Helps you make bridges/scaffold walk."
    })

    Expand = Scaffold:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Expand",
        Min = 1,
        Max = 6,
        Default = 1
    })
    Tower = Scaffold:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Tower",
        Default = true,
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if TowerMode and TowerMode.Object then
                TowerMode.Object.Visible = Callback
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Goes up while you hold jump"
    })
    TowerMode = Scaffold:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Tower mode",
        List = {"Jump", "Block up"},
        Default = "Jump",
        Darker = true,
        Visible = Tower.Enabled,
        Tooltip = "Jump - Pushes you up and scaffolds under you\nBlock up - Places blocks into you so they lift you, without jumping, and keeps you centered while standing still"
    })
    Downwards = Scaffold:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Downwards",
        Default = true
    })
    Diagonal = Scaffold:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Diagonal",
        Default = true
    })
    LimitItem = Scaffold:CreateToggle({Name = "Limit to items"})
    Mouse = Scaffold:CreateToggle({Name = "Require mouse down"})
    Scaffold:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Visual",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            for _, v: any in {FillColor, OutlineColor} do
                if v and v.Object then
                    v.Object.Visible = Callback
                end
            end

            if Callback then
                task.defer(function()
                    if Visual or not FillColor or not OutlineColor then
                        return
                    end

                    local Block: Part = Instance.new("Part")
                    Block.Size = Vector3.new(3, 3, 3)
                    Block.Anchored = true
                    Block.CanCollide = false
                    Block.CanQuery = false
                    Block.CanTouch = false
                    Block.CastShadow = false
                    Block.Transparency = 1
                    Cat:Clean(Block)

                    local Selection: SelectionBox = Instance.new("SelectionBox")
                    Selection.Adornee = Block
                    Selection.LineThickness = 0.04
                    Selection.Color3 = Color3.fromHSV(OutlineColor.Hue, OutlineColor.Sat, OutlineColor.Value)
                    Selection.Transparency = 1 - OutlineColor.Opacity
                    Selection.SurfaceColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(FillColor.Hue, FillColor.Sat, FillColor.Value)
                    Selection.SurfaceTransparency = 1 - FillColor.Opacity
                    Selection.Parent = Block

                    Data.Controllers.GameQueryUtil:setQueryIgnored(Block, true)
                    Visual = Block
                end)
            else
                HideVisual()
                if Visual then
                    Visual:Destroy()
                    Visual = nil
                end
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Renders an overlay on the block about to be placed"
    })
    FillColor = Scaffold:CreateColorSlider({
        Name = "Fill Color",
        DefaultSat = 0,
        DefaultOpacity = 0.4,
        Darker = true,
        Visible = false,
        Function = function(Hue: number, Sat: number, Value: number, Opacity: number)
            if Visual then
                Visual.SelectionBox.SurfaceColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(Hue, Sat, Value)
                Visual.SelectionBox.SurfaceTransparency = 1 - Opacity
            end
        end
    })
    OutlineColor = Scaffold:CreateColorSlider({
        Name = "Outline Color",
        DefaultValue = 0,
        Darker = true,
        Visible = false,
        Function = function(Hue: number, Sat: number, Value: number, Opacity: number)
            if Visual then
                Visual.SelectionBox.Color3 = Color3.fromHSV(Hue, Sat, Value)
                Visual.SelectionBox.Transparency = 1 - Opacity
            end
        end
    })
    HudPosition = Scaffold:CreateTextBox({
        Name = "HUD Position",
        Default = "0,60",
        Visible = false,
        Function = function()
            if Hud then
                local X: string?, Y: string? = HudPosition.Value:match("^(%-?%d+),(%-?%d+)$")
                Hud.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, tonumber(X) or 0, 0.5, tonumber(Y) or 60)
            end
        end
    })
    Scaffold:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Block Count",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback then
                if not Hud then
                    BuildHud()
                    HudConnection = Cat.Ui.Click:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(ShowHud)
                end

                ShowHud()
            elseif Hud then
                if HudConnection and HudConnection.Connected then
                    HudConnection:Disconnect()
                end

                HudConnection = nil
                Hud:Destroy()
                Hud = nil
                table.clear(HudParts)
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Open the menu and drag the HUD to move it"
    })

    Cat:Clean(function()
        if HudConnection and HudConnection.Connected then
            HudConnection:Disconnect()
        end
        if Hud then
            Hud:Destroy()
        end
    end)
end)()

BundledModules.SetEmote = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity

    local SetEmote
    local Emote

    local Track: AnimationTrack?
    local Gui: BillboardGui?

    local List: {string} = {}
    local EmoteTypes: {[string]: any} = {}

    for EmoteType: any, v: any in Data.Instances.EmoteMeta do
        if EmoteType ~= Data.Instances.EmoteType.NONE and v.name and not EmoteTypes[v.name] then
            EmoteTypes[v.name] = EmoteType
            table.insert(List, v.name)
        end
    end

    table.sort(List)

    local function CancelEmote(): ()
        if Track then
            Track:Stop()
            Track:Destroy()
            Track = nil
        end

        if Gui then
            Gui:Destroy()
            Gui = nil
        end

        if Entity.Alive and Entity.Character:GetAttribute("PlayingEmote") then
            Entity.Character:SetAttribute("PlayingEmote", nil)
        end
    end

    SetEmote = Cat.Categories.Utility:CreateModule({
        Name = "SetEmote",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback then
                SetEmote:Toggle()

                if Entity.Alive then
                    local EmoteType: any = EmoteTypes[Emote.Value]
                    local Meta: any = Data.Instances.EmoteMeta[EmoteType]

                    if Meta then
                        CancelEmote()
                        Entity.Character:SetAttribute("PlayingEmote", EmoteType)

                        local PlayBeginSounds: any = Data.Controllers.EmoteController.createEmoteBeginAudioPlayers
                            or Data.Controllers.EmoteController.playEmoteBeginSounds
                        if PlayBeginSounds then
                            PlayBeginSounds(Data.Controllers.EmoteController, EmoteType, Services.LocalPlayer)
                        end

                        local Animation: any = Meta.animation
                        if not Animation and Meta.emoteDisplayType then
                            local Display: any = Data.Instances.EmoteDisplayMeta[Meta.emoteDisplayType]
                            Animation = Display and Display.animation
                        end

                        if Animation then
                            Track = Entity.Humanoid:LoadAnimation(Data.Controllers.GameAnimationUtil:getAnimation(Animation.type))
                            Track.Looped = Animation.looped or false
                            Track:Play(nil, nil, Animation.speed or 1)
                        end

                        if not Meta.animation then
                            local Billboard: BillboardGui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
                            Billboard.Size = UDim2.fromScale(6, 2.5)
                            Billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
                            Billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
                            Billboard.Adornee = Entity.Character.Head

                            local Image: ImageLabel = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
                            Image.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
                            Image.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 1)
                            Image.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
                            Image.Image = Meta.image
                            Image.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                            Image.ImageTransparency = 1
                            Image.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
                            Image.Parent = Billboard

                            Billboard.Parent = Entity.Character.Head
                            Gui = Billboard

                            Services.TweenService:Create(Image, TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Exponential, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                                Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
                                Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
                                ImageTransparency = 0
                            }):Play()
                        end

                        if Meta.allowMovement then
                            task.delay(6, CancelEmote)
                        else
                            Entity.Humanoid:GetPropertyChangedSignal("MoveDirection"):Once(CancelEmote)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Plays the selected emote on your character, other players can see it too"
    })

    Emote = SetEmote:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Emote",
        List = List,
        Default = "nightmare"
    })
end)()

BundledModules.StaffDetector = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services
    local LocalPlayer: Player = Services.Players.LocalPlayer

    local Drag = BundledModules.Drag

    local StaffDetector
    local Mode, Clans, Profile, Users

    local BlacklistedClans: {string} = {"gg", "gg2", "DV", "DV2"}
    local BlacklistedUserIds: {number} = {1502104539, 3826146717, 4531785383, 1049767300, 4926350670, 653085195, 184655415, 2752307430, 5087196317, 5744061325, 1536265275}
    local Categories: {string} = {"Spectate", "Mod", "Impossible"}
    local FlagColors: {[string]: string} = {
        Spectate = "rgb(236,129,43)",
        Mod = "rgb(250,50,56)",
        Impossible = "rgb(180,90,250)"
    }
    local LeaveTooltips: {[string]: string} = {
        Spectate = "Notifies when a flagged spectator leaves",
        Mod = "Notifies when a detected staff role, blacklisted user or blacklisted clan member leaves",
        Impossible = "Notifies when a player flagged for an impossible join leaves"
    }

    local Joined: {[number]: string} = {}
    local Rejoins: {[number]: boolean} = {}
    local JoinTimes: {[number]: number} = {}
    local Watchers: {[Player]: RBXScriptConnection} = {}
    local LeaveToggles: {[string]: any} = {}
    local Entries: {StaffEntry} = {}
    local Window: TextButton?
    local InfoLabel: TextLabel?
    local Expanded: boolean = false

    local function Refresh()
        if not Window or not InfoLabel then
            return
        end

        local Counts: {[string]: number} = {Spectate = 0, Mod = 0, Impossible = 0}
        for _, v: StaffEntry in Entries do
            Counts[v.Category] += 1
        end

        local List: boolean = Expanded and #Entries > 0
        local Lines: {string} = {"<b>StaffDetector</b>", "<font size=\"4\"> </font>"}
        for _, v: string in Categories do
            table.insert(Lines, `<font color="{FlagColors[v]}">{v}: {Counts[v]}</font>`)
        end
        if List then
            table.insert(Lines, "<font size=\"4\"> </font>")
            for Index: number, v: StaffEntry in Entries do
                if Index > 8 then
                    break
                end

                table.insert(Lines, `{v.Name} <font color="{FlagColors[v.Category]}">{v.Reason}</font>`)
            end
        end

        InfoLabel.Text = table.concat(Lines, "\n")

        local Bounds: Vector2 = Cat.Ui:Measure(InfoLabel.ContentText, InfoLabel.TextSize, InfoLabel.FontFace)
        local Title: Vector2 = Cat.Ui:Measure("StaffDetector", InfoLabel.TextSize, Font.new(InfoLabel.FontFace.Family, Enum.FontWeight.Bold))
        Window.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(Bounds.X, Title.X) + 16, Bounds.Y + (List and -8 or 4))
    end

    local function Flag(Player: Player, Check: string)
        Cat:CreateNotification("StaffDetector", `Staff Detected ({Check}): {Player.Name} ({Player.UserId})`, 60, "alert")

        local Category: string = Check == "impossible_join" and "Impossible" or Check == "spectator" and "Spectate" or "Mod"
        if Player.Parent ~= nil then
            table.insert(Entries, 1, {Name = Player.Name, UserId = Player.UserId, Reason = Check, Category = Category})
        end

        Refresh()
        if Mode.Value == "Uninject" then
            task.spawn(Cat.Destroy)
            Services.StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
                Title = "StaffDetector",
                Text = `Staff Detected ({Check})\n{Player.Name} ({Player.UserId})`,
                Duration = 60
            })
        elseif Mode.Value == "Requeue" then
            Data.Controllers.QueueController:joinQueue(Data.Controllers.Store:getState().Game.queueType)
        elseif Mode.Value == "Profile" then
            Cat.Ui.Save = function() end
            if Cat.Ui.Profile ~= Profile.Value then
                Cat.Ui:Switch(Profile.Value)
            end
        elseif Mode.Value == "AutoConfig" then
            Cat.Ui.Save = function() end
            for Name: string, v: any in Cat.Modules do
                if table.find({"AutoClicker", "Reach", "Sprint", "HitFix", "StaffDetector"}, Name) or v.Category.Name == "Render" then
                    continue
                end
                if v.Enabled then
                    v:Toggle()
                end

                v.Bind:SetBind({})
            end
        end
    end

    local function CheckJoin(Player: Player, Connection: RBXScriptConnection): boolean?
        if not Player:GetAttribute("Team") and Player:GetAttribute("Spectator") and Data.Storage.MatchState == 1 and not Data.Controllers.Store:getState().Game.customMatch and tick() - (JoinTimes[Player.UserId] or 0) <= 20 then
            Connection:Disconnect()
            task.wait(5)
            if StaffDetector.Enabled and Player.Parent and not Player:GetAttribute("Team") and Player:GetAttribute("Spectator") then
                if Rejoins[Player.UserId] then
                    Cat:CreateNotification("StaffDetector", `Spectator {Player.Name} joined back after leaving`, 20, "warning")
                    if Player.Parent ~= nil then
                        table.insert(Entries, 1, {Name = Player.Name, UserId = Player.UserId, Reason = "spectator", Category = "Spectate"})
                    end

                    Refresh()
                elseif Player.FollowUserId ~= 0 and Joined[Player.FollowUserId] then
                    Cat:CreateNotification("StaffDetector", `Spectator {Player.Name} joined following {Joined[Player.FollowUserId]}`, 20, "warning")
                    if Player.Parent ~= nil then
                        table.insert(Entries, 1, {Name = Player.Name, UserId = Player.UserId, Reason = "spectator", Category = "Spectate"})
                    end

                    Refresh()
                else
                    local Success: boolean, Pages: any = pcall(Services.Players.GetFriendsAsync, Services.Players, Player.UserId)
                    if Success then
                        local Friend: string?, Finished: boolean = nil, Pages.IsFinished
                        for _ = 1, 6 do
                            for _, v: {Id: number} in Pages:GetCurrentPage() do
                                if Joined[v.Id] then
                                    Friend = Joined[v.Id]

                                    break
                                end
                            end
                            if Friend or Finished then
                                break
                            end
                            if not pcall(Pages.AdvanceToNextPageAsync, Pages) then
                                return
                            end

                            Finished = Pages.IsFinished
                        end

                        if Friend then
                            Cat:CreateNotification("StaffDetector", `Spectator {Player.Name} joined from {Friend}`, 20, "warning")
                            if Player.Parent ~= nil then
                                table.insert(Entries, 1, {Name = Player.Name, UserId = Player.UserId, Reason = "spectator", Category = "Spectate"})
                            end

                            Refresh()
                        elseif Finished then
                            Flag(Player, "impossible_join")

                            return true
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        return nil
    end

    local function Added(Player: Player)
        if Joined[Player.UserId] then
            Rejoins[Player.UserId] = true
        end

        local Teleported: number? = Player:GetAttribute("LastTeleported")
        Joined[Player.UserId] = Player.Name
        JoinTimes[Player.UserId] = Teleported and tick() - math.min(workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - Teleported, 60) or tick()
        if Player ~= LocalPlayer then
            if not table.find(BlacklistedUserIds, Player.UserId) and not table.find(Users.ListEnabled, tostring(Player.UserId)) then
                local Success: boolean, Rank: any = pcall(Player.GetRankInGroup, Player, 5774246)
                if not Success then
                    Cat:CreateNotification("StaffDetector", tostring(Rank), 30, "alert")
                end
                if (Success and Rank or 0) < 100 then
                    local Connection: RBXScriptConnection
                    Connection = Player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Spectator"):Connect(function()
                        CheckJoin(Player, Connection)
                    end)
                    Watchers[Player] = Connection
                    StaffDetector:Clean(Connection)
                    if not CheckJoin(Player, Connection) then
                        if not Player:GetAttribute("ClanTag") then
                            Player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("ClanTag"):Wait()
                        end
                        if StaffDetector.Enabled and Clans.Enabled and table.find(BlacklistedClans, Player:GetAttribute("ClanTag")) then
                            Connection:Disconnect()
                            Flag(Player, `blacklisted_clan_{Player:GetAttribute("ClanTag"):lower()}`)
                        end
                    end
                else
                    Flag(Player, "staff_role")
                end
            else
                Flag(Player, "blacklisted_user")
            end
        end
    end

    StaffDetector = Cat.Categories.Utility:CreateModule({
        Name = "StaffDetector",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback then
                StaffDetector:Clean(Services.Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(Added))
                StaffDetector:Clean(Services.Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(Player: Player)
                    if Watchers[Player] then
                        Watchers[Player]:Disconnect()
                        Watchers[Player] = nil
                    end

                    for Index: number = #Entries, 1, -1 do
                        local Entry: StaffEntry = Entries[Index]
                        if Entry.UserId == Player.UserId then
                            table.remove(Entries, Index)
                            if LeaveToggles[Entry.Category].Enabled then
                                Cat:CreateNotification("StaffDetector", `{Entry.Name} left ({Entry.Reason})`, 10, "info")
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    Refresh()
                end))
                for _, v: Player in Services.Players:GetPlayers() do
                    task.spawn(Added, v)
                end
            else
                table.clear(Joined)
                table.clear(Rejoins)
                table.clear(JoinTimes)
                table.clear(Watchers)
                table.clear(Entries)
                Refresh()
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Detects people with a staff rank ingame"
    })

    Mode = StaffDetector:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Mode",
        List = {"Uninject", "Profile", "Requeue", "AutoConfig", "Notify"},
        Function = function(Value: string)
            if Profile and Profile.Object then
                Profile.Object.Visible = Value == "Profile"
            end
        end
    })
    Clans = StaffDetector:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Blacklist clans",
        Default = true
    })
    Profile = StaffDetector:CreateTextBox({
        Name = "Profile",
        Default = "default",
        Darker = true,
        Visible = Mode.Value == "Profile"
    })
    Users = StaffDetector:CreateTextList({
        Name = "Users",
        Placeholder = "player (userid)"
    })
    for _, v: string in Categories do
        LeaveToggles[v] = StaffDetector:CreateToggle({
            Name = `Notify {v} leave`,
            Tooltip = LeaveTooltips[v]
        })
    end
    StaffDetector:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Viewer",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback and not Window then
                local Button: TextButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
                Button.Name = "StaffDetectorViewer"
                Button.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 120)
                Button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new()
                Button.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
                Button.Text = ""
                Button.AutoButtonColor = false

                local Corner: UICorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
                Corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
                Corner.Parent = Button

                local Shadow: UIShadow = Instance.new("UIShadow")
                Shadow.BlurRadius = UDim.new(0, 13)
                Shadow.Transparency = 0.25
                Shadow.Parent = Button

                local Label: TextLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                Label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -16)
                Label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8)
                Label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                Label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
                Label.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
                Label.TextSize = 16
                Label.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
                Label.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new()
                Label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.8
                Label.Font = Enum.Font.Arial
                Label.RichText = true
                Label.Parent = Button

                local Pressed: UDim2? = nil
                Button.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
                    Pressed = Button.Position
                end)
                Button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                    if Pressed == Button.Position then
                        Expanded = not Expanded
                        Refresh()
                    end
                end)
                Drag(Button)

                Button.Parent = Cat.Ui.Gui
                Cat:Clean(Button)
                Window, InfoLabel = Button, Label
            end

            if Window then
                Window.Visible = Callback
                Refresh()
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Shows a panel with detection counts, click it to list who tripped them and drag it while the GUI is open to move it"
    })

    task.delay(3, function()
        if not StaffDetector.Enabled and not StaffDetector.Removed then
            StaffDetector:Toggle(true)
        end
    end)
end)()

BundledModules.StunDisabler = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services
    local LocalPlayer: Player = Services.Players.LocalPlayer

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity

    local StunDisabler
    local Lasso, Chance, Check
    local Effects, Dizzy, Fear, Vignettes
    local Traps, Landmines, Teleports, Portals

    local Original, Hook, OriginalVignettes, Anchored = nil, nil, nil, {}

    local function Watch(Character: Model)
        StunDisabler:Clean(Character.ChildAdded:Connect(function(Child: Instance)
            if Child:IsA("Accessory") and Child:FindFirstChild("Rope") and Random.new():NextNumber(1, 100) < Chance.Value then
                if Check.Enabled and #Entity.Targets({
                    Range = 50,
                    Players = true
                }) == 0 then
                    return
                end

                local RootPart: BasePart? = Character.PrimaryPart
                if RootPart then
                    RootPart.Anchored = true
                    Anchored[RootPart] = true

                    StunDisabler:Clean(Child.Destroying:Once(function()
                        task.wait(0.5)

                        if Anchored[RootPart] then
                            RootPart.Anchored = false
                            Anchored[RootPart] = nil
                        end
                    end))
                end
            end
        end))
    end

    StunDisabler = Cat.Categories.Utility:CreateModule({
        Name = "StunDisabler",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback then
                if Lasso.Enabled then
                    if LocalPlayer.Character then
                        Watch(LocalPlayer.Character)
                    end

                    StunDisabler:Clean(LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(Character: Model)
                        task.delay(1, function()
                            if StunDisabler.Enabled and LocalPlayer.Character == Character then
                                Watch(Character)
                            end
                        end)
                    end))
                end

                if Effects.Enabled then
                    if Dizzy.Enabled then
                        Services.RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("dizzy-status")
                    end

                    if Fear.Enabled then
                        Services.RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("werewolf-fear-status")
                    end

                    if Vignettes.Enabled then
                        OriginalVignettes = Data.Controllers.VignetteController.enableOnScreenEffects
                        Data.Controllers.VignetteController.enableOnScreenEffects = false
                        Data.Controllers.VignetteController:destroyAllVignettes()
                    end

                    StunDisabler:Clean(Data.Instances.SyncEvents.StatusEffectAdded:setPriority(1000):connect(function(Event: {entityInstance: Instance?, statusEffect: string})
                        if Event.entityInstance == LocalPlayer.Character then
                            if Dizzy.Enabled and Event.statusEffect == "dizzy" then
                                Services.RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("dizzy-status")
                            end

                            if Fear.Enabled and Event.statusEffect == "werewolf_fear" then
                                Services.RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("werewolf-fear-status")
                            end
                        end
                    end))
                end

                if Traps.Enabled then
                    Original = Data.Controllers.ClientScript.Get
                    Hook = function(self: any, Name: string): any
                        if StunDisabler.Enabled and Traps.Enabled and (Name == "TriggerInvisibleLandmine" and Landmines.Enabled or Name == "StepOnTeleportBlock" and Teleports.Enabled or Name == "StepOnVoidPortal" and Portals.Enabled) then
                            return {
                                SendToServer = function() end
                            }
                        end

                        return Original(self, Name)
                    end
                    Data.Controllers.ClientScript.Get = Hook
                end
            else
                if Hook and Data.Controllers.ClientScript.Get == Hook then
                    Data.Controllers.ClientScript.Get = Original
                end

                if OriginalVignettes ~= nil then
                    Data.Controllers.VignetteController.enableOnScreenEffects = OriginalVignettes
                end

                Original, Hook, OriginalVignettes = nil, nil, nil
                for i: BasePart in Anchored do
                    i.Anchored = false
                end

                table.clear(Anchored)
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Stops lassos, debuffs and traps from taking control of you"
    })

    Lasso = StunDisabler:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Anti lasso",
        Default = true,
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            for _, v: any in {Chance, Check} do
                if v and v.Object then
                    v.Object.Visible = Callback
                end
            end

            if StunDisabler.Enabled then
                StunDisabler:Toggle()
                StunDisabler:Toggle()
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Prevents you from getting pulled by lasso projectile."
    })
    Chance = StunDisabler:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Chance",
        Min = 0,
        Max = 100,
        Default = 100,
        Suffix = "%",
        Darker = true
    })
    Check = StunDisabler:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Only when targeting",
        Darker = true
    })
    Effects = StunDisabler:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Anti effect",
        Default = true,
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            for _, v: any in {Dizzy, Fear, Vignettes} do
                if v and v.Object then
                    v.Object.Visible = Callback
                end
            end

            if StunDisabler.Enabled then
                StunDisabler:Toggle()
                StunDisabler:Toggle()
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Throws away the parts of a debuff the game plays on your own client"
    })
    Dizzy = StunDisabler:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Dizzy",
        Default = true,
        Function = function()
            if StunDisabler.Enabled then
                StunDisabler:Toggle()
                StunDisabler:Toggle()
            end
        end,
        Darker = true,
        Tooltip = "Stops the dizzy toad swinging your walk direction around, the slow itself is on the server"
    })
    Fear = StunDisabler:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Werewolf fear",

        Function = function()

                StunDisabler:Toggle()
                StunDisabler:Toggle()
            end
        end,
        Darker = true,
        Tooltip = "Stops the werewolf tail walking you away from it"
    })
    Vignettes = StunDisabler:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Vignettes",
        Default = true,

            if StunDisabler.Enabled then
                StunDisabler:Toggle()
                StunDisabler:Toggle()

        end,
        Darker = true,
        Tooltip = "Clears the coloured screen border frozen, decay, soaked and the rest put over your view"
    })
    Traps = StunDisabler:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Trap disabler",
        Default = true,

            for _, v: any in {Landmines, Teleports, Portals} do
