BundledModules.AntiAFK = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services
    local LocalPlayer: Player = Services.Players.LocalPlayer

    local Disabled: {any} = {}

    Cat.Categories.World:CreateModule({
        Name = "Anti-AFK",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback then
                for _, v: any in getconnections(LocalPlayer.Idled) do
                    v:Disable()
                    table.insert(Disabled, v)
                end

                for _, v: any in getconnections(Services.RunService.Heartbeat) do
                    local Success: boolean, Constants: {any} = pcall(debug.getconstants, v.Function)
                    if type(v.Function) == "function" and Success and table.find(Constants, "AfkInfo") then
                        v:Disable()
                        table.insert(Disabled, v)
                    end
                end

                Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("AfkInfo"):SendToServer({
                    afk = false
                })
            else
                for _, v: any in Disabled do
                    v:Enable()
                end

                table.clear(Disabled)
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Lets you stay ingame without getting kicked"
    })
end)()

BundledModules.AutoTool = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services
    local LocalPlayer: Player = Services.Players.LocalPlayer

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity
    local Break = BundledModules.Break
    local SlotController = BundledModules.SlotController

    local AutoTool
    local Mode, Delay, SwitchBack

    local Looking, Previous
    local Deadline, Switching, Event = 0, false, nil

    local function Best(Block: Instance?): Tool?
        if Block and not Block:GetAttribute("NoBreak") and not Block:GetAttribute(`Team{LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Team") or 0}NoBreak`) and not (Break.Tool and Break.Tool.Expires > tick() and not (Break.Tool.Session and Break.Tool.Session.Cancelled)) then
            local Meta: any = Data.Instances.Items[Block.Name]
            local Item: InventoryItem? = Meta and Meta.block and Data.Storage.Tools[Meta.block.breakType]
            if Item and Item.tool and Data.Storage.Hand.Tool ~= Item.tool then
                return Item.tool
            end
        end

        return nil
    end

    local function SwitchTo(Tool: Tool)
        if Switching or (SlotController.Owner ~= nil and SlotController.Owner ~= "AutoTool" and tick() < SlotController.Expires) then
            return
        end

        Switching = true
        task.spawn(function()
            if not (Break.Tool and Break.Tool.Expires > tick() and not (Break.Tool.Session and Break.Tool.Session.Cancelled)) then
                SlotController.Select(Tool)
            end

            Switching = false
        end)
    end

    AutoTool = Cat.Categories.World:CreateModule({
        Name = "AutoTool",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback then
                Looking, Deadline, Previous, Switching = nil, 0, nil, false

                local Current: BindableEvent = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
                Event = Current
                AutoTool:Clean(Current)
                AutoTool:Clean(Current.Event:Connect(function()
                    Services.ContextActionService:CallFunction("block-break", Enum.UserInputState.Begin, newproxy(true))
                end))
                AutoTool:Clean(Services.RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                    if Entity.Alive and not (Break.Tool and Break.Tool.Expires > tick() and not (Break.Tool.Session and Break.Tool.Session.Cancelled)) then
                        if Mode.Value == "Look" then
                            local Held: any = Data.Storage.Hand.Tool and Data.Instances.Items[Data.Storage.Hand.Tool.Name]
                            if Held and Held.breakBlock then
                                local Camera: Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
                                local Placer: any = Data.Storage.BlockPlacer or Data.Controllers.BlockPlacementController.blockPlacer
                                local Selector: any = Placer and Placer.clientManager and Placer.clientManager:getBlockSelector()
                                local Ray: Ray? = not Services.UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled and Camera:ScreenPointToRay(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2 - Services.GuiService:GetGuiInset().Y) or nil
                                local Info: any = Selector and Selector:getMouseInfo(1, {ray = Ray})
                                local Block: Instance? = Info and Info.target and Info.target.blockInstance or nil
                                if Block then
                                    if Block == Looking then
                                        if tick() >= Deadline then
                                            local Tool: Tool? = Best(Block)
                                            if Tool then
                                                Previous = Previous or Data.Storage.Hand.Tool
                                                SwitchTo(Tool)
                                            end
                                        end
                                    else
                                        Looking, Deadline = Block, tick() + Delay:GetRandomValue()
                                    end
                                else
                                    Looking = nil
                                    if SwitchBack.Enabled and Previous then
                                        SwitchTo(Previous)
                                        Previous = nil
                                    end
                                end
                            else
                                Looking, Previous = nil, nil
                            end
                        else
                            Looking = nil
                        end
                    end
                end))

                local Hook: (any, any, any) -> () = function(self: any, _: any, Ray: any)
                    if Mode.Value ~= "Break" then
                        return
                    end

                    local Info: any = self.clientManager:getBlockSelector():getMouseInfo(1, {ray = Ray})
                    local Tool: Tool? = Best(Info and Info.target and Info.target.blockInstance or nil)
                    if not Tool or (SlotController.Owner ~= nil and SlotController.Owner ~= "AutoTool" and tick() < SlotController.Expires) then
                        return
                    end

                    task.spawn(function()
                        if not AutoTool.Enabled or Event ~= Current or (Break.Tool and Break.Tool.Expires > tick()) then
                            return
                        end
                        if SlotController.Select(Tool) and AutoTool.Enabled and Event == Current and Services.UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then
                            Current:Fire()
                        end
                    end)
                end

                table.insert(Data.Storage.BreakCallbacks, Hook)
                AutoTool:Clean(function()
                    local Index: number? = table.find(Data.Storage.BreakCallbacks, Hook)
                    if Index then
                        table.remove(Data.Storage.BreakCallbacks, Index)
                    end
                end)
            else
                Looking, Previous, Event = nil, nil, nil
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Automatically selects the correct tool"
    })

    Mode = AutoTool:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Mode",
        List = {"Look", "Break"},
        Default = "Break",
        Function = function(Value: string)
            for _, v: any in {Delay, SwitchBack} do
                if v and v.Object then
                    v.Object.Visible = Value == "Look"
                end
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Look swaps while you are still aiming at the block, Break swaps on the first hit like it used to"
    })
    Delay = AutoTool:CreateTwoSlider({
        Name = "Delay",
        Min = 0,
        Max = 1,
        DefaultMin = 0.06,
        DefaultMax = 0.16,
        Decimal = 100,
        Suffix = "seconds",
        Darker = true,
        Tooltip = "How long you have to be looking at the block before it swaps"
    })
    SwitchBack = AutoTool:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Switch back",
        Darker = true,
        Tooltip = "Puts the item you were holding back once you look away"
    })
end)()

BundledModules.BedProtector = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services
    local LocalPlayer: Player = Services.Players.LocalPlayer

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity
    local PlacementController = BundledModules.PlacementController
    local SlotController = BundledModules.SlotController

    local BedProtector
    local Mode, Trigger, PlaceRange, Wool, Switch
    local Blacklist, Layers
    local Whitelist, Radius, NoAnimation, Limit

    local Layout: {[Vector3]: string} = {}
    local Sides: {Vector3} = {}
    for _, v: Enum.NormalId in Enum.NormalId:GetEnumItems() do
        table.insert(Sides, Vector3.FromNormalId(v) * 3)
    end

    local Old: ((...any) -> ...any)?
    local Placing: boolean = false

    local function Pyramid(Size: number): {Vector3}
        local Positions: {Vector3} = {}
        for Height: number = Size, 0, -1 do
            for Width: number = Height, 0, -1 do
                table.insert(Positions, Vector3.new(Width, Size - Height, Height + 1 - Width) * 3)
                table.insert(Positions, Vector3.new(-Width, Size - Height, Height + 1 - Width) * 3)
                table.insert(Positions, Vector3.new(Width, Size - Height, -(Height - Width)) * 3)
                table.insert(Positions, Vector3.new(-Width, Size - Height, -(Height - Width)) * 3)
            end
        end

        return Positions
    end

    local function BedNear(Range: number): BasePart?
        local LocalPosition: Vector3 = Entity.Alive and Entity.RootPart.Position or Vector3.zero
        for _, v: Instance in Services.CollectionService:GetTagged("bed") do
            if v:IsA("BasePart") and (LocalPosition - v.Position).Magnitude < Range and v:GetAttribute(`Team{LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Team") or -1}NoBreak`) then
                return v
            end
        end

        return nil
    end

    local function Build(Bed: BasePart)
        local Blocks: {{Type: string, Health: number, Tool: Tool?, Amount: number}} = {}
        for _, v: InventoryItem in (Data.Storage.Inventory.inventory.items or {}) do
            local Block: any = Data.Instances.Items[v.itemType] and Data.Instances.Items[v.itemType].block
            if Block and (Wool.Enabled and v.itemType:find("wool") or not Wool.Enabled and not table.find(Blacklist.ListEnabled, v.itemType:find("wool") and "wool" or v.itemType)) then
                table.insert(Blocks, {Type = v.itemType, Health = Block.health or 0, Tool = v.tool, Amount = v.amount or math.huge})
            end
        end
        table.sort(Blocks, function(a: {Health: number}, b: {Health: number}): boolean
            return a.Health > b.Health
        end)

        local Delay: number = 1 / Data.Storage.PlaceCPS
        for Layer: number = 1, Layers.Value do
            for _, Offset: Vector3 in Pyramid(Layer) do
                if BedProtector.Enabled and Entity.Alive and #Blocks ~= 0 then
                    local Position: Vector3 = (Bed.CFrame * CFrame.new(Offset)).Position
                    if not Data.Controllers.BlockController:getStore():getBlockAt(Data.Controllers.BlockController:getBlockPosition(Position)) and (Entity.RootPart.Position - Position).Magnitude <= PlaceRange.Value then
                        local Block: {Type: string, Health: number, Tool: Tool?, Amount: number}? = nil
                        for Index: number = 0, #Blocks - 1 do
                            local Candidate: {Type: string, Health: number, Tool: Tool?, Amount: number} = Blocks[(math.min(Layer, #Blocks) + Index - 1) % #Blocks + 1]
                            if Candidate.Amount > 0 then
                                Block = Candidate

                                break
                            end
                        end
                        if Block then
                            repeat
                                task.wait()
                            until not BedProtector.Enabled or not Entity.Alive or workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - Data.Controllers.BlockCpsController.lastPlaceTimestamp >= Delay
                            if BedProtector.Enabled and Entity.Alive then
                                if Switch.Enabled and Block.Tool and (not SlotController.Owner or SlotController.Owner == "BedProtector" or tick() >= SlotController.Expires) then
                                    SlotController.Owner, SlotController.Expires = "BedProtector", tick() + 1
                                    if SlotController.Select(Block.Tool) then
                                        task.wait()
                                    end
                                end

                                task.spawn(PlacementController.Place, Position, Block.Type)
                                Block.Amount -= 1
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local function Scan(Bed: BasePart)
        table.clear(Layout)
        for _, v: Instance in Services.CollectionService:GetTagged("block") do
            if v:IsA("BasePart") and not v:HasTag("bed") and (v.Position - Bed.Position).Magnitude <= Radius.Value then
                Layout[v.Position] = v.Name
            end
        end

        local Holes: {[Vector3]: string} = {}
        for Position: Vector3, Name: string in Layout do
            for _, Offset: Vector3 in Sides do
                local Cell: Vector3 = Position + Offset
                if Layout[Cell] or Holes[Cell] or Data.Controllers.BlockController:getStore():getBlockAt(Data.Controllers.BlockController:getBlockPosition(Cell)) then
                    continue
                end

                local Walls: number = 0
                for _, Side: Vector3 in Sides do
                    if Layout[Cell + Side] then
                        Walls += 1
                    end
                end
                if Walls >= 4 then
                    Holes[Cell] = Name
                end
            end
        end

        for Position: Vector3, Name: string in Holes do
            Layout[Position] = Name
        end
    end

    local function PatchBlock(ItemType: string): (string?, Tool?)
        if Limit.Enabled then
            local Hand: Tool? = Data.Storage.Hand.Type == "block" and Data.Storage.Hand.Tool or nil
            if Hand and (not Wool.Enabled or Hand.Name:find("wool")) and table.find(Whitelist.ListEnabled, Hand.Name:find("wool") and "wool" or Hand.Name) then
                return Hand.Name, Hand
            end

            return nil, nil
        end

        local Best: InventoryItem?, Health: number? = nil, nil
        for _, v: InventoryItem in (Data.Storage.Inventory.inventory.items or {}) do
            local Block: any = Data.Instances.Items[v.itemType] and Data.Instances.Items[v.itemType].block
            if Block and (not Wool.Enabled or v.itemType:find("wool")) and table.find(Whitelist.ListEnabled, v.itemType:find("wool") and "wool" or v.itemType) then
                if v.itemType == ItemType then
                    return v.itemType, v.tool
                elseif not Health or (Block.health or 0) > Health then
                    Best, Health = v, Block.health or 0
                end
            end
        end

        return Best and Best.itemType or nil, Best and Best.tool or nil
    end

    BedProtector = Cat.Categories.World:CreateModule({
        Name = "BedProtector",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback then
                local Bed: BasePart?
                if Mode.Value == "Patch" then
                    local Animation: any = Data.Controllers.BlockController:getAnimationController():getAssetId(0)
                    Old = Data.Controllers.AnimationUtil.playAnimation
                    Data.Controllers.AnimationUtil.playAnimation = function(self: any, Player: any, AssetId: any, Config: any): ...any
                        if Placing and NoAnimation.Enabled and AssetId == Animation then
                            return
                        end

                        return (Old :: (...any) -> ...any)(self, Player, AssetId, Config)
                    end

                    BedProtector:Clean(Services.CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal("block"):Connect(function(Block: Instance)
                        if Bed and Block:IsA("BasePart") and not Block:HasTag("bed") and (Block.Position - Bed.Position).Magnitude <= Radius.Value then
                            Layout[Block.Position] = Block.Name
                        end
                    end))
                    BedProtector:Clean(Data.Instances.Network.BreakBlockEventZap.On(function(BlockPosition: Vector3, ...)
                        local Player: Player? = select(4, ...)
                        if typeof(Player) == "Instance" and (Player == LocalPlayer or Player:GetAttribute("Team") == LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Team")) then
                            Layout[BlockPosition * 3] = nil
                        end
                    end))
                end

                repeat
                    if Mode.Value == "Build" then
                        local Far: number = 0
                        for _, v: Vector3 in Pyramid(Layers.Value) do
                            Far = math.max(Far, v.Magnitude)
                        end

                        local Found: BasePart? = BedNear(PlaceRange.Value + Far)
                        if Found then
                            local Previous: Tool? = Data.Storage.Hand.Tool
                            Build(Found)
                            if Switch.Enabled and Previous then
                                SlotController.Select(Previous)
                            end
                        elseif Trigger.Value == "On Key" then
                            Cat:CreateNotification("BedProtector", "Unable to locate bed", 5)
                            BedProtector:Toggle()

                            break
                        end
                    else
                        local Found: BasePart? = BedNear(PlaceRange.Value + Radius.Value)
                        if Found and Found ~= Bed then
                            Bed = Found
                            Scan(Bed)
                        end

                        if Bed and Entity.Alive then
                            local Previous: Tool? = Data.Storage.Hand.Tool
                            local Holes: {{Position: Vector3, Name: string}} = {}
                            for Position: Vector3, Name: string in Layout do
                                if (Entity.RootPart.Position - Position).Magnitude <= PlaceRange.Value and not Data.Controllers.BlockController:getStore():getBlockAt(Data.Controllers.BlockController:getBlockPosition(Position)) then
                                    table.insert(Holes, {Position = Position, Name = Name})
                                end
                            end
                            table.sort(Holes, function(a: {Position: Vector3}, b: {Position: Vector3}): boolean
                                return (a.Position - (Bed :: BasePart).Position).Magnitude < (b.Position - (Bed :: BasePart).Position).Magnitude
                            end)

                            for _, v: {Position: Vector3, Name: string} in Holes do
                                if not Data.Controllers.BlockController:getStore():getBlockAt(Data.Controllers.BlockController:getBlockPosition(v.Position)) then
                                    local Item: string?, Tool: Tool? = PatchBlock(v.Name)
                                    if not Item then
                                        break
                                    end
                                    if Switch.Enabled and Tool and (not SlotController.Owner or SlotController.Owner == "BedProtector" or tick() >= SlotController.Expires) then
                                        SlotController.Owner, SlotController.Expires = "BedProtector", tick() + 1
                                        if SlotController.Select(Tool) then
                                            task.wait()
                                        end
                                    end

                                    Placing = true
                                    PlacementController.Place(v.Position, Item)
                                    Placing = false
                                    task.wait(1 / Data.Storage.PlaceCPS)
                                end
                            end

                            if Switch.Enabled and Previous then
                                SlotController.Select(Previous)
                            end
                        end
                        if not Found and Trigger.Value == "On Key" then
                            Cat:CreateNotification("BedProtector", "Unable to locate bed", 5)
                            BedProtector:Toggle()

                            break
                        end
                    end

                    task.wait(0.5)
                    if Trigger.Value == "On Key" then
                        BedProtector:Toggle()

                        break
                    end
                until not BedProtector.Enabled
            else
                if Old then
                    Data.Controllers.AnimationUtil.playAnimation = Old
                    Old = nil
                end

                Placing = false
                table.clear(Layout)
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Builds a defense around your bed or patches holes in your bed defense"
    })

    Mode = BedProtector:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Mode",
        List = {"Build", "Patch"},
        Default = "Build",
        Function = function(Value: string)
            for _, v: any in {Blacklist, Layers} do
                if v and v.Object then
                    v.Object.Visible = Value == "Build"
                end
            end
            for _, v: any in {Whitelist, Radius, NoAnimation, Limit} do
                if v and v.Object then
                    v.Object.Visible = Value == "Patch"
                end
            end

            if BedProtector.Enabled then
                BedProtector:Toggle()
                BedProtector:Toggle()
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Build places layers of your strongest blocks around the bed\nPatch puts back the blocks an enemy broke out of your defense"
    })
    Trigger = BedProtector:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Trigger",
        List = {"Toggle", "On Key"},
        Default = "Toggle"
    })
    PlaceRange = BedProtector:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Place Range",
        Min = 1,
        Max = 60,
        Default = 15
    })
    Wool = BedProtector:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Wool only",
        Tooltip = "Only uses wools to defend the bed."
    })
    Switch = BedProtector:CreateToggle({Name = "Auto Switch"})
    Blacklist = BedProtector:CreateTextList({
        Name = "Blacklist",
        Default = {"siege_tnt", "tnt"}
    })
    Layers = BedProtector:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Layers",
        Min = 1,
        Max = 6,
        Default = 2,
        Tooltip = "How many layers go around your bed. Your strongest block goes closest to it, and your weakest one is reused when you have fewer block types than layers"
    })
    Whitelist = BedProtector:CreateTextList({
        Name = "Whitelist",
        Default = {"wool", "obsidian"},
        Visible = false
    })
    Radius = BedProtector:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Defense Radius",
        Min = 3,
        Max = 30,
        Default = 15,
        Suffix = function(Value: number)
            return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
        end,
        Tooltip = "How far out from the bed still counts as your defense",
        Visible = false
    })
    NoAnimation = BedProtector:CreateToggle({
        Name = "No Animation",
        Tooltip = "Hides the arm swing every patched block would otherwise play",
        Visible = false
    })
    Limit = BedProtector:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Limit to item",
        Visible = false
    })
end)()

BundledModules.BlockIn = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services
    local LocalPlayer: Player = Services.Players.LocalPlayer

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity
    local PlacementController = BundledModules.PlacementController
    local SlotController = BundledModules.SlotController

    local BlockIn
    local Mode, BedChecker, AutoPatch, PlacementMode, PlacementSpeed, Center, Priority, Switch, Return, Wool, Blacklist

    local CenterOrigin: Vector3?, Anchor: Vector3?, AimGoal: Vector3?, AimHome: Vector3?
    local AimReturning: boolean = false
    local LastPlace: number, LastWarning: number = 0, 0
    local Retries: {[Vector3]: number} = {}
    local Loaded: number = os.clock()
    local Params: RaycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    Params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

    local Scan: number, BedRange: number, TurnSpeed: number, TurnTolerance: number, RetryGap: number, FailGap: number = 30, 14, 24, 0.35, 0.3, 4
    local Directions: {Vector3} = {Vector3.new(1, 0, 0), Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0), Vector3.new(0, 0, 1), Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)}
    local Sides: {Vector3} = {}
    for _, v: Enum.NormalId in Enum.NormalId:GetEnumItems() do
        table.insert(Sides, Vector3.FromNormalId(v) * 3)
    end

    local function Origin(): Vector3
        if Data.Storage.Map and Params.FilterDescendantsInstances[1] ~= Data.Storage.Map then
            Params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {Data.Storage.Map}
        end

        local Position: Vector3 = Entity.RootPart.Position
        local Hit: RaycastResult? = workspace:Raycast(Position, Vector3.new(0, -Scan, 0), Params)
        local Raw: Vector3 = Hit and Vector3.new(Position.X, Hit.Position.Y + 1.5, Position.Z) or Position

        return Vector3.new(math.round(Raw.X / 3) * 3, math.round(Raw.Y / 3) * 3, math.round(Raw.Z / 3) * 3)
    end

    local function BedNear(Partial: boolean?): BasePart?
        for _, v: Instance in Services.CollectionService:GetTagged("bed") do
            if not v:IsA("BasePart") or (Entity.RootPart.Position - v.Position).Magnitude >= BedRange or v:GetAttribute(`Team{LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Team") or -1}NoBreak`) then
                continue
            end

            local Handler: any = Data.Controllers.BlockController:getHandlerRegistry():getHandler(v.Name)
            local Cells: {Vector3} = Handler and Handler:getContainedPositions(v) or {v.Position / 3}
            local Inside: {[Vector3]: boolean} = {}
            for _, Cell: Vector3 in Cells do
                Inside[Cell * 3] = true
            end

            local Covered: number, Open: number = 0, 0
            for _, Cell: Vector3 in Cells do
                for _, Side: Vector3 in Sides do
                    local Position: Vector3 = Cell * 3 + Side
                    if Inside[Position] then
                        continue
                    end

                    if not Data.Controllers.BlockController:getStore():getBlockAt(Data.Controllers.BlockController:getBlockPosition(Position)) then
                        Open += 1
                    elseif Side.Y >= 0 then
                        Covered += 1
                    end
                end
            end

            if Partial and Covered > 0 or (not Partial and Open == 0) then
                return v
            end
        end

        return nil
    end

    local function Blocks(): {{Type: string, Health: number, Tool: Tool?, Amount: number}}
        local List: {{Type: string, Health: number, Tool: Tool?, Amount: number}} = {}
        for _, v: InventoryItem in (Data.Storage.Inventory.inventory.items or {}) do
            local Block: any = Data.Instances.Items[v.itemType] and Data.Instances.Items[v.itemType].block
            if not Block or not (Wool.Enabled and v.itemType:find("wool") or not Wool.Enabled and not table.find(Blacklist.ListEnabled, v.itemType:find("wool") and "wool" or v.itemType)) then
                continue
            end

            local Hotbar: boolean = false
            for _, Entry: any in (Data.Storage.Inventory.hotbar or {}) do
                if Entry.item and Entry.item.tool == v.tool then
                    Hotbar = true
                end
            end
            if Hotbar or not Switch.Enabled then
                table.insert(List, {Type = v.itemType, Health = Block.health or 0, Tool = v.tool, Amount = v.amount or math.huge})
            end
        end
        table.sort(List, function(a: {Health: number}, b: {Health: number}): boolean
            if Priority.Value == "Hardest" then
                return a.Health > b.Health
            end

            return a.Health < b.Health
        end)

        return List
    end

    local function Enclosure(Base: Vector3, Grounded: boolean): {Vector3}
        local Enemy: Target? = Entity.Targets({Range = 60, Players = true})[1]
        local Facing: Vector3 = Enemy and Enemy.RootPart.Position - Base or Vector3.zero
        local Order: {Vector3} = table.clone(Directions)
        table.sort(Order, function(a: Vector3, b: Vector3): boolean
            return a:Dot(Facing) > b:Dot(Facing)
        end)

        local Cells: {Vector3} = {}
        if Grounded and not workspace:Raycast(Base, Vector3.new(0, -3, 0), Params) then
            table.insert(Cells, Vector3.new(0, -3, 0))
        end
        for _, Height: number in {0, 3} do
            for _, v: Vector3 in Order do
                table.insert(Cells, Vector3.new(v.X * 3, Height, v.Z * 3))
            end
        end
        if Grounded then
            table.insert(Cells, Vector3.new(Order[1].X * 3, 6, Order[1].Z * 3))
            table.insert(Cells, Vector3.new(0, 6, 0))
        end

        return Cells
    end

    local function StopAim()
        if AimGoal and Entity.Alive then
            if AimHome then
                Entity.RootPart.CFrame = CFrame.lookAlong(Entity.RootPart.Position, AimHome)
            end

            Entity.Humanoid.AutoRotate = true
        end

        AimGoal, AimHome, AimReturning = nil, nil, false
    end

    local function PlacePattern(Base: Vector3, Cells: {Vector3}, List: {{Type: string, Health: number, Tool: Tool?, Amount: number}}, Limit: number, Patching: boolean?)
        local Placed: number = 0
        local Previous: Tool? = Data.Storage.Hand.Tool

        for _, Offset: Vector3 in Cells do
            if Placed >= Limit or not BlockIn.Enabled or not Entity.Alive then
                break
            end

            local Position: Vector3 = Base + Offset
            if not Data.Controllers.BlockController:getStore():getBlockAt(Data.Controllers.BlockController:getBlockPosition(Position)) then
                repeat
                    local Empty: boolean = List[1] ~= nil and List[1].Amount <= 0
                    if Empty then
                        table.remove(List, 1)
                    end
                until not Empty

                local Block: {Type: string, Health: number, Tool: Tool?, Amount: number}? = List[1]
                if not Block then
                    break
                end
                if PlacementMode.Value == "Blatant" and Center.Enabled then
                    CenterOrigin = Base
                end

                local Turning: boolean = Patching == true and PlacementMode.Value == "Legit" and Offset.Y >= 0 and Offset.Y <= 3 and (Offset.X ~= 0 or Offset.Z ~= 0)
                if Turning then
                    if not AimHome then
                        local Look: Vector3 = Entity.RootPart.CFrame.LookVector * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
                        AimHome = Look.Magnitude > 0.001 and Look.Unit or nil
                    end

                    AimGoal, AimReturning = Vector3.new(Offset.X, 0, Offset.Z), false
                end

                local CPS: number = Data.Storage.PlaceCPS
                local Delay: number = 1 / math.max(PlacementMode.Value == "Legit" and math.min(CPS, PlacementSpeed.Value) or CPS, 1)
                local Deadline: number = os.clock() + 0.3
                repeat
                    task.wait()

                    local Look: Vector3 = Entity.Alive and Entity.RootPart.CFrame.LookVector * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1) or Vector3.zero
                    local Aimed: boolean = not AimGoal or Look.Magnitude < 0.001 or math.acos(math.clamp(Look.Unit:Dot(AimGoal.Unit), -1, 1)) < TurnTolerance
                until not BlockIn.Enabled or not Entity.Alive or (workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - math.max(LastPlace, Data.Controllers.BlockCpsController.lastPlaceTimestamp) >= Delay and (not Turning or Aimed or os.clock() > Deadline))
                if not BlockIn.Enabled or not Entity.Alive then
                    break
                end

                local Offset2D: Vector3 = (Entity.RootPart.Position - Base) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
                if PlacementMode.Value == "Legit" and math.max(math.abs(Offset2D.X), math.abs(Offset2D.Z)) > 1.5 then
                    break
                end
                if Switch.Enabled and Block.Tool and (not SlotController.Owner or SlotController.Owner == "Block-In" or tick() >= SlotController.Expires) then
                    SlotController.Owner, SlotController.Expires = "Block-In", tick() + 1
                    SlotController.Select(Block.Tool)
                end

                LastPlace = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
                task.spawn(PlacementController.Place, Position, Block.Type)

                local Registered: boolean = Data.Controllers.BlockController:getStore():getBlockAt(Data.Controllers.BlockController:getBlockPosition(Position)) ~= nil
                if Registered then
                    Block.Amount -= 1
                    Placed += 1
                end
                if Patching then
                    Retries[Position] = os.clock() + (Registered and RetryGap or FailGap)
                end
            end
        end

        if Patching then
            if AimHome then
                AimGoal, AimReturning = AimHome, true
            else
                StopAim()
            end
        end

        if Return.Enabled and Switch.Enabled and Previous then
            SlotController.Select(Previous)
        end
    end

    local function Build(): boolean
        if not Entity.Alive or (Mode.Value ~= "On bind" and not BedNear()) then
            return false
        end

        local List: {{Type: string, Health: number, Tool: Tool?, Amount: number}} = Blocks()
        local Early: boolean = false
        repeat
            task.wait()
            if Entity.Alive and not Early then
                local Base: Vector3 = Origin()
                local Drop: number = Entity.RootPart.Position.Y - Base.Y
                Early = Drop >= 6 and Drop <= 24
                if Early then
                    PlacePattern(Base, Enclosure(Base, false), List, PlacementMode.Value == "Blatant" and Center.Enabled and math.huge or 3)
                end
            end
        until not BlockIn.Enabled or not Entity.Alive or Entity.Humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air

        if Entity.Alive then
            local Base: Vector3 = Origin()
            PlacePattern(Base, Enclosure(Base, true), List, math.huge)
            Anchor = Base
        end

        CenterOrigin = nil

        return true
    end

    local function Patch()
        if Entity.Alive then
            local Base: Vector3? = Anchor
            local Casting: any = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("IsCasting")
            if Base and Entity.Humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air and not Data.Controllers.BlockPlacementController.disabled and (not Casting or Casting == 0 or Casting == "") then
                local Offset: Vector3 = (Entity.RootPart.Position - Base) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
                if math.max(math.abs(Offset.X), math.abs(Offset.Z)) <= 1.5 then
                    local Current: Vector3 = Origin()
                    if Current.Y <= Base.Y then
                        if Current.Y < Base.Y then
                            Base, Anchor = Current, Current
                            table.clear(Retries)
                        end

                        local Cells: {Vector3} = {}
                        for _, v: Vector3 in Enclosure(Base :: Vector3, true) do
                            local Position: Vector3 = (Base :: Vector3) + v
                            if not Data.Controllers.BlockController:getStore():getBlockAt(Data.Controllers.BlockController:getBlockPosition(Position)) and (Retries[Position] or 0) <= os.clock() then
                                table.insert(Cells, v)
                            end
                        end
                        if #Cells > 0 then
                            local List: {{Type: string, Health: number, Tool: Tool?, Amount: number}} = Blocks()
                            if #List > 0 then
                                PlacePattern(Base :: Vector3, Cells, List, math.huge, true)
                                CenterOrigin = nil
                            elseif os.clock() - LastWarning > 5 then
                                LastWarning = os.clock()
                                Cat:CreateNotification("Block-In", "No blocks left to patch with", 3, "warning")
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        else
            Anchor = nil
        end
    end

    BlockIn = Cat.Categories.World:CreateModule({
        Name = "Block-In",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback then
                if os.clock() - Loaded < 3 and Mode.Value == "On bind" and AutoPatch.Enabled then
                    task.defer(BlockIn.Toggle, BlockIn, false)
                elseif BedChecker.Enabled and not (Entity.Alive and BedNear(true)) then
                    Cat:CreateNotification("Block-In", "You are not near an enemy bed defense", 3, "warning")
                    task.defer(BlockIn.Toggle, BlockIn, false)
                else
                    LastPlace, Anchor = 0, nil
                    table.clear(Retries)
                    BlockIn:Clean(Services.RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function()
                        if not CenterOrigin or PlacementMode.Value ~= "Blatant" or not Center.Enabled or not Entity.Alive or not isnetworkowner(Entity.RootPart) then
                            return
                        end

                        Entity.RootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(CenterOrigin.X, Entity.RootPart.Position.Y, CenterOrigin.Z) * Entity.RootPart.CFrame.Rotation
                        Entity.RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, Entity.RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, 0)
                    end))
                    BlockIn:Clean(Services.RunService.PostSimulation:Connect(function(Delta: number)
                        if AimGoal then
                            if Entity.Alive then
                                local Look: Vector3 = Entity.RootPart.CFrame.LookVector * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
                                Entity.Humanoid.AutoRotate = false
                                if AimReturning and (Look.Magnitude < 0.001 or math.acos(math.clamp(Look.Unit:Dot(AimGoal.Unit), -1, 1)) < 0.02) then
                                    StopAim()
                                else
                                    Entity.RootPart.CFrame = Entity.RootPart.CFrame:Lerp(CFrame.lookAlong(Entity.RootPart.Position, AimGoal), math.clamp((TurnSpeed + 2) * Delta, 0, 1))
                                end
                            else
                                AimGoal, AimHome, AimReturning = nil, nil, false
                            end
                        end
                    end))
                    BlockIn:Clean(function()
                        CenterOrigin, Anchor = nil, nil
                        StopAim()
                    end)

                    local Guarding: boolean = false
                    repeat
                        local Bind: boolean = Mode.Value == "On bind"
                        if BedChecker.Enabled and not (Entity.Alive and BedNear(true)) then
                            Cat:CreateNotification("Block-In", "You are not near an enemy bed defense", 3, "warning")
                            BlockIn:Toggle(false)

                            break
                        end

                        if Guarding and Bind and AutoPatch.Enabled then
                            Patch()
                            task.wait(0.1)
                        elseif Guarding and Bind then
                            BlockIn:Toggle(false)

                            break
                        else
                            local Built: boolean = Build()
                            Guarding = Bind and Built and AutoPatch.Enabled
                            if Bind and not Guarding then
                                BlockIn:Toggle(false)

                                break
                            end
                            if not Bind then
                                task.wait(0.5)
                            end
                        end
                    until not BlockIn.Enabled
                end
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Automatically blocks you in by building walls around you"
    })

    Mode = BlockIn:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Mode",
        List = {"On bind", "When near"},
        Default = "On bind",
        Function = function(Value: string)
            if AutoPatch and AutoPatch.Object then
                AutoPatch.Object.Visible = Value == "On bind"
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "On bind blocks you in once per keypress, When near keeps you blocked in while you are on an enemy bed"
    })
    BedChecker = BlockIn:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Bed checker",
        Tooltip = `Won't turn on, and turns itself off with a warning, whenever you are not within {BedRange} studs of an enemy bed that has blocks around it`
    })
    AutoPatch = BlockIn:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Auto Patch",
        Tooltip = "On bind only. Stays on after blocking you in and refills any wall block that gets broken, or rebuilds around you when you drop to a lower level, until you turn the module off yourself. In Legit mode your character silently turns toward each side block it patches and back afterwards",
        Visible = Mode.Value == "On bind"
    })
    PlacementMode = BlockIn:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Placement mode",
        List = {"Legit", "Blatant"},
        Default = "Legit",
        Function = function(Value: string)
            if PlacementSpeed and PlacementSpeed.Object then
                PlacementSpeed.Object.Visible = Value == "Legit"
            end
            if Center and Center.Object then
                Center.Object.Visible = Value == "Blatant"
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Legit uses your placement speed and lets you move freely, Blatant builds at the normal limit with optional centering"
    })
    PlacementSpeed = BlockIn:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Placement speed",
        Min = 1,
        Max = math.max(Data.Storage.PlaceCPS, 1),
        Default = math.max(Data.Storage.PlaceCPS, 1),
        Suffix = "blocks/s",
        Tooltip = "Blocks placed per second in Legit mode",
        Visible = PlacementMode.Value == "Legit"
    })
    Center = BlockIn:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Center",
        Default = true,
        Visible = PlacementMode.Value == "Blatant",
        Tooltip = "Holds you in the middle of your block while it builds, so no side gets skipped"
    })
    Priority = BlockIn:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Block priority",
        List = {"Lowest cost", "Hardest"},
        Default = "Lowest cost"
    })
    Switch = BlockIn:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Switch",
        Default = true
    })
    Return = BlockIn:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Return to last slot",
        Default = true
    })
    Wool = BlockIn:CreateToggle({Name = "Wool only"})
    Blacklist = BlockIn:CreateTextList({
        Name = "Blacklist",
        Default = {"cannon", "siege_tnt", "tnt"}
    })
end)()

BundledModules.ChestSteal = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity

    local ChestSteal
    local Range, Visualize, FillColor, OutlineColor, Animate, Speed, Open, Legit, Skywars

    local Session: number = 0
    local Delays: {[Instance]: number} = {}
    local Box: Part?
    local BoxTween: Tween?
    local BoxTarget: BasePart?

    local function UpdateBox(Chest: BasePart?)
        if Box then
            if Chest ~= BoxTarget then
                if BoxTween then
                    BoxTween:Cancel()
                    BoxTween = nil
                end

                if not Chest then
                    Box.Parent = nil
                elseif Animate.Enabled and Box.Parent == workspace.CurrentCamera then
                    BoxTween = Services.TweenService:Create(Box, TweenInfo.new(Speed.Value, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {CFrame = Chest.CFrame})
                    BoxTween:Play()
                else
                    Box.CFrame = Chest.CFrame
                    Box.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera
                end

                BoxTarget = Chest
            end
            if Chest then
                local Selection: SelectionBox = Box:FindFirstChildOfClass("SelectionBox") :: SelectionBox
                Selection.Color3 = Color3.fromHSV(OutlineColor.Hue, OutlineColor.Sat, OutlineColor.Value)
                Selection.Transparency = 1 - OutlineColor.Opacity
                Selection.SurfaceColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(FillColor.Hue, FillColor.Sat, FillColor.Value)
                Selection.SurfaceTransparency = 1 - FillColor.Opacity
            end
        end
    end

    local function Loot(Value: Instance?)
        local Chest: Instance? = Value and (Value :: ObjectValue).Value or nil
        local Items: {Instance} = Chest and Chest:GetChildren() or {}
        if not Chest or #Items <= 1 or (Delays[Chest] or 0) >= tick() then
            return
        end

        Delays[Chest] = tick() + 0.2

        local Observed: ObjectValue? = Entity.Character and Entity.Character:FindFirstChild("ObservedChestFolder") :: ObjectValue?
        local Previous: Instance? = Observed and Observed.Value or nil
        Data.Controllers.ClientScript:GetNamespace("Inventory"):Get("SetObservedChest"):SendToServer(Chest)
        for _, v: Instance in Items do
            if not v:IsA("Accessory") then
                continue
            end

            task.spawn(pcall, function()
                Data.Controllers.ClientScript:GetNamespace("Inventory"):Get("ChestGetItem"):CallServer(Chest, v)
            end)
            if Legit.Enabled then
                task.wait(0.2)
            end
        end

        Data.Controllers.ClientScript:GetNamespace("Inventory"):Get("SetObservedChest"):SendToServer(Previous)
    end

    ChestSteal = Cat.Categories.World:CreateModule({
        Name = "ChestSteal",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback then
                Session += 1

                local Current: number = Session
                repeat
                    task.wait()
                until Data.Controllers.Store:getState().Game.queueType ~= "bedwars_test" or Session ~= Current or not ChestSteal.Enabled
                if Session ~= Current or not ChestSteal.Enabled or (Skywars.Enabled and not Data.Controllers.Store:getState().Game.queueType:find("skywars")) then
                    return
                end

                repeat
                    local Target: BasePart? = nil
                    if Entity.Alive and Data.Storage.MatchState ~= 2 then
                        if Open.Enabled then
                            if Data.Controllers.AppController:isAppOpen("ChestApp") then
                                local Observed: ObjectValue? = Entity.Character:FindFirstChild("ObservedChestFolder") :: ObjectValue?
                                Loot(Observed)
                                for _, v: Instance in Services.CollectionService:GetTagged("chest") do
                                    local Folder: ObjectValue? = v:FindFirstChild("ChestFolderValue") :: ObjectValue?
                                    if Observed and Observed.Value and Folder and Folder.Value == Observed.Value then
                                        Target = v :: BasePart
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        else
                            local Closest: number = math.huge
                            for _, v: Instance in Services.CollectionService:GetTagged("chest") do
                                local Distance: number = (Entity.RootPart.Position - (v :: BasePart).Position).Magnitude
                                if Distance > Range.Value then
                                    continue
                                end

                                Loot(v:FindFirstChild("ChestFolderValue"))
                                if Distance < Closest then
                                    Closest, Target = Distance, v :: BasePart
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    UpdateBox(Target)
                    task.wait(0.1)
                until not ChestSteal.Enabled or Session ~= Current
            else
                UpdateBox(nil)
                table.clear(Delays)
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Grabs items from near chests."
    })

    Range = ChestSteal:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Range",
        Min = 0,
        Max = 18,
        Default = 18,
        Suffix = function(Value: number)
            return Value == 1 and "stud" or "studs"
        end
    })
    Visualize = ChestSteal:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Visualize",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            for _, v: any in {FillColor, OutlineColor, Animate, Speed} do
                if v and v.Object then
                    v.Object.Visible = Callback
                end
            end

            if Callback then
                local Part: Part = Instance.new("Part")
                Part.Size = Vector3.new(3, 3, 3)
                Part.Anchored = true
                Part.CanCollide = false
                Part.CanQuery = false
                Part.CanTouch = false
                Part.CastShadow = false
                Part.Transparency = 1
                Cat:Clean(Part)

                local Selection: SelectionBox = Instance.new("SelectionBox")
                Selection.Adornee = Part
                Selection.LineThickness = 0.04
                Selection.Parent = Part

                Data.Controllers.GameQueryUtil:setQueryIgnored(Part, true)
                Box = Part
            else
                UpdateBox(nil)
                if Box then
                    Box:Destroy()
                    Box, BoxTarget = nil, nil
                end
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Draws a box around the closest chest being looted"
    })
    FillColor = ChestSteal:CreateColorSlider({
        Name = "Fill Color",
        DefaultSat = 0,
        DefaultOpacity = 0.25,
        Darker = true,
        Visible = false
    })
    OutlineColor = ChestSteal:CreateColorSlider({
        Name = "Outline Color",
        DefaultSat = 0,
        Darker = true,
        Visible = false
    })
    Animate = ChestSteal:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Animate",
        Default = true,
        Darker = true,
        Visible = false,
        Tooltip = "Glides the box onto the next chest instead of snapping to it"
    })
    Speed = ChestSteal:CreateSlider({
        Name = "Animation time",
        Min = 0.01,
        Max = 0.5,
        Default = 0.08,
        Decimal = 100,
        Suffix = "s",
        Darker = true,
        Visible = false
    })
    Open = ChestSteal:CreateToggle({Name = "GUI Check"})
    Legit = ChestSteal:CreateToggle({Name = "Legit mode"})
    Skywars = ChestSteal:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Only Skywars",
        Default = true,
        Function = function()
            if ChestSteal.Enabled then
                ChestSteal:Toggle()
                ChestSteal:Toggle()
            end
        end
    })
end)()

BundledModules.FastPlace = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local FastPlace
    local CPS

    FastPlace = Cat.Categories.World:CreateModule({
        Name = "FastPlace",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            Data.Instances.CPSConstants.BLOCK_PLACE_CPS = Callback and CPS.Value or Data.Storage.PlaceCPS

    })

    CPS = FastPlace:CreateSlider({

        Min = 1,
        Max = 100,
        Default = 13,

            if FastPlace.Enabled then
                Data.Instances.CPSConstants.BLOCK_PLACE_CPS = Value
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Blocks per second you can place"
    })
    FastPlace:CreateButton({
        Name = "Reset to BedWars CPS",
        Function = function()
            CPS:SetValue(Data.Storage.PlaceCPS)
        end
    })
end)()

BundledModules.KitSpy = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services
    local LocalPlayer: Player = Services.Players.LocalPlayer

    local Entity = BundledModules.Entity

    local KitSpy
    local Metal, Bees, Fishing

    local Session: number = 0
    local Spots: {[any]: Vector3} = {}

    local function Watched(Player: Player?): string?
        if not Player or not Player:IsA("Player") then
            return nil
        end

        local Team: any = Player:GetAttribute("Team")
        local Skip: boolean = Player == LocalPlayer or (Team ~= nil and Team == LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Team"))

        return if Skip then nil else Player.DisplayName
    end

    local function Loot(Player: Player): string
        local Success: boolean, Inventory: any = pcall(Data.Controllers.InventoryUtil.getInventory, Player)
        local Found: {string} = {}
        local Now: number = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
        for _, v: any in Success and Inventory.items or {} do
            if Now - (v.addedToBackpackTime or 0) <= 3 then
                local Meta: any = Data.Instances.Items[v.itemType]
                local Amount: number = v.amount or 1
                table.insert(Found, `{Amount > 1 and `{Amount}x ` or ""}{Meta and Meta.displayName or v.itemType}`)
            end
        end

        return table.concat(Found, ", ")
    end

    local function Watch(Player: Player, Current: number)
        local Dig: string = Data.Controllers.GameAnimationUtil:getAssetId(Data.Instances.Animations.SHOVEL_DIG)
        local function Load(Character: Model)
            local Humanoid: Instance? = Character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
            local Animator: Instance? = Humanoid and Humanoid:WaitForChild("Animator", 10)
            if Animator and Session == Current then
                (Animator :: Animator).AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(Track: AnimationTrack)
                    if Session == Current and Metal.Enabled and Track.Animation and Track.Animation.AnimationId == Dig then
                        task.delay(0.5, function()
                            local Name: string? = Watched(Player)
                            local Found: string = Loot(Player)
                            if Session == Current and Name and Found ~= "" then
                                Cat:CreateNotification("KitSpy", `{Name} dug up {Found}`, 6)
                            end
                        end)
                    end
                end)
            end
        end

        if Player.Character then
            task.spawn(Load, Player.Character)
        end
        KitSpy:Clean(Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(Load))
    end

    KitSpy = Cat.Categories.World:CreateModule({
        Name = "KitSpy",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            Session += 1
            table.clear(Spots)

            if Callback then
                local Current: number = Session
                for _, v: Player in Services.Players:GetPlayers() do
                    Watch(v, Current)
                end
                KitSpy:Clean(Services.Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(Player: Player)
                    Watch(Player, Current)
                end))

                KitSpy:Clean(Services.CollectionService:GetInstanceRemovedSignal("bee"):Connect(function(Bee: Instance)
                    local Id: any = Bee:GetAttribute("BeeId")
                    if Id ~= nil then
                        Spots[Id] = if Bee:IsA("Model") then Bee:GetPivot().Position elseif Bee:IsA("BasePart") then Bee.Position else nil
                    end
                end))
                KitSpy:Clean(Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("BeeRemoved"):Connect(function(Event: any)
                    task.wait()
                    local Spot: Vector3? = type(Event) == "table" and Spots[Event.beeId] or nil
                    if Bees.Enabled and Spot then
                        Spots[Event.beeId] = nil
                        local Closest: Player?, Gap: number = nil, 20
                        for _, v: any in Entity.Entities do
                            if v.Player and v.Alive and v.RootPart and (v.RootPart.Position - Spot).Magnitude <= Gap then
                                Closest, Gap = v.Player, (v.RootPart.Position - Spot).Magnitude
                            end
                        end

                        local Name: string? = Watched(Closest)
                        if Name then
                            Cat:CreateNotification("KitSpy", `{Name} picked up a bee`, 5)
                        end
                    end
                end))

                KitSpy:Clean(Data.Controllers.ClientScript:Get("FishCaught"):Connect(function(Event: any)
                    local Name: string? = Fishing.Enabled and type(Event) == "table" and Watched(Event.catchingPlayer) or nil
                    local Drops: any = Name and Event.dropData and Event.dropData.drops
                    if Drops then
                        local Found: {string} = {}
                        for _, v: any in Drops do
                            local Meta: any = Data.Instances.Items[v.itemType]
                            table.insert(Found, `{(v.amount or 1) > 1 and `{v.amount}x ` or ""}{Meta and Meta.displayName or v.itemType}`)
                        end

                        if #Found > 0 then
                            Cat:CreateNotification("KitSpy", `{Name} fished up {table.concat(Found, ", ")}`, 6)
                        end
                    end
                end))
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Notifies you when other players use their kit: metal detector digs, beekeeper bee pickups and fisherman catches"
    })

    Metal = KitSpy:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Metal Detector",
        Default = true,
        Tooltip = "Tells you what they dug up when the dig animation plays"
    })
    Bees = KitSpy:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Beekeeper",
        Default = true,
        Tooltip = "Tells you when someone picks up a bee"
    })
    Fishing = KitSpy:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Fisherman",
        Default = true,
        Tooltip = "Tells you what someone fished up"
    })
end)()

BundledModules.PhaseMine = (function()
    local Cat = BundledModules.UI.Cat

    local Services = BundledModules.Services
    local LocalPlayer: Player = Services.Players.LocalPlayer

    local PhaseMine

    local Ignored: {[Model]: {BasePart}} = {}

    local function Added(Character: Model)
        if Ignored[Character] or not Character.Parent then
            return
        end

        for Old: Model in Ignored do
            if not Old.Parent then
                Ignored[Old] = nil
            end
        end

        Ignored[Character] = {}
        for _, v: Instance in Character:GetDescendants() do
            if v:IsA("BasePart") then
                table.insert(Ignored[Character], v)
                Data.Controllers.GameQueryUtil:setQueryIgnored(v, true)
            end
        end

        PhaseMine:Clean(Character.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(Part: Instance)
            if Part:IsA("BasePart") and Ignored[Character] and not table.find(Ignored[Character], Part) then
                table.insert(Ignored[Character], Part)
                Data.Controllers.GameQueryUtil:setQueryIgnored(Part, true)
            end
        end))
    end

    local function Watch(Player: Player)
        if Player == LocalPlayer then
            return
        end

        PhaseMine:Clean(Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(Character: Model)
            task.delay(1, function()
                if PhaseMine.Enabled then
                    Added(Character)
                end
            end)
        end))
        if Player.Character then
            Added(Player.Character)
        end
    end

    PhaseMine = Cat.Categories.World:CreateModule({
        Name = "PhaseMine",
        Function = function(Callback: boolean)
            if Callback then
                for _, v: Player in Services.Players:GetPlayers() do
                    Watch(v)
                end

                PhaseMine:Clean(Services.Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(Watch))
            else
                for _, Parts: {BasePart} in Ignored do
                    for _, v: BasePart in Parts do
                        if v.Parent then
                            Data.Controllers.GameQueryUtil:setQueryIgnored(v, false)
                        end
                    end
                end

                table.clear(Ignored)
            end
        end,
        Tooltip = "Allows you to mine through opponents"
    })
end)()
